title: Operating Principal - Samlino Group
description:
Are you ready to thrive in a dynamic and exhilarating environment where you'll be entrusted with significant responsibilities? Are you seeking to join an extraordinary team of young, motivated, and highly ambitious individuals? If you have a genuine passion for connecting with people and driving remarkable outcomes, then you could be the perfect fit for our Operating Principal position.

About us

We are on a mission to help consumers save time and money by matching them with the best products for their needs with banking, insurance and utilities. Samlino Group () operates across three markets, we empowered over 10 million users last year alone, propelling them toward living healthier financial lives.

What we offer you

As our Operating Principal, you get the unique opportunity to be a key driver of our exponential growth curve. Sunny Lisbon will be your home base, but you’ll travel to and work with our three markets! To facilitate a steep growth curve, we provide you with the following:

  • The chance to create a genuine impact - experience the thrill of working in a fast-paced environment where your efforts and results are tangible, shaping the destiny of our business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - work closely with our high-performing teams alongside our international peers and founder.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we firmly believe in nurturing talent from within, fostering an environment where the sky's the limit.
  • The passport to adventure - as a part of our international organization, you spread your wings and learn from our other markets while applying both strategic and executive skills.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - fuel your interpersonal, digital, entrepreneurial, organizational, project management, and business prowess through hands-on experience in an organisation that values training and development.

Your Responsibilities

You will own your own projects and be responsible for driving results across various projects and initiatives. Responsibilities in this job will evolve and be defined and redefined throughout your time with us. The aim is to take ownership of and drive the development of progressively larger opportunities. Success requires the following:

  • Setting ambitious yet achievable goals, developing strategic plans to reach them, and executing with urgency and intensity to deliver measurable outcomes
  • Take ownership of assigned projects or tasks from inception to completion, including defining clear objectives, plans, and deliverables
  • Proactively identify potential bottlenecks or obstacles and develop mitigation strategies
  • Drive accountability by ensuring all team members understand their roles and responsibilities
  • Act as a champion for our results-driven culture within the team and organization
  • Build, coach, and empower A+ teams to reach their potential and provide 5-star experiences to our users and partners
  • Project-based assignments with clear objectives spread across different geographies
  • Deep dive into value creation, process improvement and organizational growth
  • Thinking out of the box, brainstorming and strategizing to challenge status quo and aim at accelerating our momentum and efficient scaling

What we expect from you

We are seeking a dynamic individual who thrives in a results-oriented environment to join our team and help us reach our objectives. Industry experience is not a requirement, but you do need to be highly ambitious, proactive, forward-thinking, a fast learner, and driven to succeed.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have proactive mindset, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Are self-motivated, detail-oriented, and possess a track record of successfully owning projects from conception to completion
  • Possess an unwavering drive and desire to be the very best at what they do
  • Are passionate about making an impact and driving tangible results
  • Exude an unparalleled work ethic fueled by an urgency to progress
  • Embrace ownership and proactively following through on commitments
  • Possess an insatiable curiosity about business, data, and people, relishing the opportunity to build and nurture relationships that fuel lasting success
  • Master the art of communication, wielding their words with impact both verbally and in writing
  • Showcase unrivalled organizational skills, skillfully structuring and prioritizing their work to achieve maximum efficiency
  • Danish speaker, fluent in English and an EU work permit is required

Start Date and Location

Flexible start date.

The role will be full time, onsite in Lisbon, Portugal.

It will cover all three markets, so regular travel will be part of what we have in mind for you! It will also include extended stays working hands-on with the teams in the different locations.

#LI-Onsite

title: External Communications Advisor
description:
• Help shape and protect the reputation of one of Australia's most recognised brands
  • Play a part in delivering strategic communications and media engagement across Jetstar
  • Permanent position based at our Melbourne CBD

Love travel and passionate about all things aviation. You’re in the right place. At Jetstar, you get to takeoff at work, and in life.

As a team, we’re lucky we get to do both for a living – and we want you to be part of where we go next. Helping our teammates soar is what we’re all about. And with a new fleet of state-of-the-art aircraft, plus new routes being added, the sky’s the limit.

Takeoff with your next opportunity

We are currently recruiting an External Communications Adviser to help protect and enhance Jetstar’s reputation through the delivery of proactive and reactive communications.

You’ll work on proactive and reactive media across Australia and New Zealand, building strong relationships with journalists and keeping Jetstar in the conversation for all the right reasons. You’ll find great stories across the business, working with our people and customers to showcase what makes Jetstar special. You’ll deliver exciting, high-impact communications campaigns and media events, support crisis communications, and coordinate media monitoring, reporting and our communication tools and assets, partnering closely with the Jetstar and Qantas Communications teams and senior leaders.

As our External Communications Adviser, your focus will include:

  • Managing media enquiries, preparing timely and high-quality responses while building positive relationships with journalists.
  • Drafting media releases and communications materials supporting key business announcements and initiatives.
  • Developing engaging external content including key messages, FAQs, web copy, social media content and briefing notes.
  • Partnering with subject matter experts and stakeholders across the business to create content for diverse audiences and channels.
  • Finding stories across the business that highlight the Jetstar brand, and working with media to bring them to life.
  • Collaborating closely with Jetstar and Qantas communications teams to support Group-wide announcements and strategic initiatives.
  • Building and maintaining strong media relationships to enhance Jetstar's brand profile.
  • Provide communications and logistical support for media events, launches and major milestones, including new routes, fleet additions and inaugural flights.
  • Support crisis and issues management, working with senior leaders to protect and strengthen Jetstar's reputation, while managing media monitoring, stakeholder communications and reporting.

About You

  • 3+ years' experience in External Communications, Media Relations, Public Affairs or a similar communications role within a large corporate environment.
  • Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex information into clear, engaging communications.
  • Hands on prior media relations expertise, including reputation management, and issues management
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with journalists, media contacts, senior leaders and key stakeholders.
  • Excellent organisational, project management and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Marketing or a related discipline.

Your Life At Jetstar Is Unlike Any Other

Put the craft in aircraft: There’s a new fleet of A321LR NEO’s waiting for your arrival. Beyond Jetstar, our teams get exposure to projects related to the Qantas Group’s A320/1, B787 and A321 Freighters.

Live the travel dream: You and your nominated travel companions can takeoff more with our famous Qantas Group Staff Travel discount.

Make work feel like a holiday: Join a fun, driven team where work feels like a holiday. Our people take every opportunity to takeoff together and find ways to help their teammates soar.

There’s a place for everyone at Jetstar: For us, travel and meeting new people go hand in hand. We invite our people to get involved in various Employee Network Groups that play an important role in creating our inclusive and supportive culture that we are fiercely proud of. We believe that teams with a diversity of ideas and experiences are more creative, innovative and solve problems quickly. We welcome applications from anyone who wants to takeoff with us. If you have support or access requirements, just reach out and let us know what you need.

We’re Jetstar. Let’s takeoff together

We can’t wait to hear from you. Apply now. Applications close 26th November 2026

title: Associate
description:

title: Asset Management - Governance Manager
location: Osborne, SA, Australia; Henderson, WA, Australia; South Australia, Australia; Perth, WA, Australia
description:
About the Opportunity

Reporting to the Head of Asset Management, Asset Management Governance Manager is responsible for leading ASC's asset management governance framework, maturity improvement strategy and ISO 55001 certification journey across the enterprise. The role will play a critical part in ensuring ASC develops consistent, scalable and repeatable asset management practices capable of supporting both the Collins Class Sustainment Program and Australia's future nuclear-powered submarine program.

This is a visible, consultative and strategic leadership position with enterprise-wide influence. You will work across a broad range of stakeholders, including executive leadership teams to uplift organisational capability, drive governance excellence and embed best-practice asset management principles across ASC. The role directly supports ASC's long-term sovereign capability objectives and future AUKUS readiness.

This is a full-time opportunity available in Perth or Adelaide. The role offers flexibility with a task-based approach to work, including access to ASC offices and remote working arrangements as operational requirements allow. Please note occasional travel will be required to support business objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Lead ASC's enterprise asset management governance strategy, ensuring alignment with organisational objectives, regulatory requirements and future submarine program needs.
  • Drive the uplift of asset management maturity and ISO 55001 certification across ASC, embedding consistent, scalable and repeatable practices across all sites and asset classes.
  • Provide enterprise-wide assurance, governance oversight and strategic advice to senior leaders, enabling informed decision-making and effective management of risk and performance.
  • Influence and collaborate across a broad stakeholder network to embed asset management excellence, strengthen organisational capability and support long-term sovereign capability outcomes.
  • Build and lead a high-performing team, developing enduring in-house expertise and reducing reliance on external consultancy support while delivering sustainable business outcomes.

About you

You are a strategic asset management professional who combines technical expertise with the ability to influence across complex stakeholder environments. You have experience developing governance frameworks, improving organisational maturity and driving large-scale change programs.

You will likely bring experience from defence, critical infrastructure, energy, transport, utilities, mining, maritime or consulting environments where governance, assurance and asset lifecycle performance are business-critical. Candidates with experience from specialist asset management consultancies will be highly regarded.

You will also have:

  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise asset management, governance, assurance or operational excellence initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of ISO 55001 Asset Management Systems and asset management best practice.
  • Experience developing governance frameworks, policies, standards and business processes.
  • The ability to influence outcomes across diverse stakeholder groups without direct authority.
  • Experience presenting complex information and strategic recommendations to executive audiences.
  • Strong commercial, analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Tertiary qualifications in Engineering or a related discipline.

Eligibility

This role requires a current National Police Clearance, an Australian Defence Security Clearance and an ability to access protected US defence technology. Your eligibility for this role is dependent on you obtaining and maintaining such clearances and approvals.

Whilst ASC will accept all applications for this role, as this role requires an ability to access protected US defence technology, applicants holding nationality of certain foreign countries will not be eligible.

To check your eligibility please visit the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency website.

Benefits

  • Unique and challenging work with a deeper purpose.
  • Flexibility over how, when and where you work for the best work/life balance.
  • Up to 10 days additional leave every year so you can rest and recharge.
  • Generous parental leave so you can give your family the focus it deserves.
  • Subsidised childcare to ease the financial pressure on your family.
  • Health and wellbeing initiatives so you can perform at your best at work.
  • Professional development opportunities to advance your career.
  • A diverse and supportive environment where you can thrive.
  • Discounts and exclusive offers from leading Australian brands to help you save.

About ASC – Your Career with a Deeper Purpose

At ASC, you'll contribute to work with a deeper purpose. As Australia's submarine company, we sustain the Royal Australian Navy's Collins Class fleet, deliver its Life of Type Extension, and help build Australia's future nuclear-powered submarine capability through AUKUS. With more than 2,500 specialist professionals across engineering, project management, construction, supply chain and sustainment, we are tackling some of the nation's most complex and strategically important challenges. Our work directly supports Australia's national security, offering the rare opportunity to combine meaningful impact, long-term career growth and genuine flexibility while helping shape the future of the country's sovereign submarine enterprise.

Apply today for a career with a deeper purpose.

Early applications are encouraged as shortlisting may commence immediately.

title: Network and Technical Change Lead - Manager / Senior Manager
description:
The context:

Our people work from offices, client sites and home, and they rely on fast, secure access to Scyne systems, cloud services and SaaS applications. This role looks after the Palo Alto Networks platform that makes that possible, and the change process that keeps the whole environment stable.

As the Network and Technical Change Lead, you will own Scyne's network and secure access architecture, built on Palo Alto Networks, and you will run technical change across Scyne's technology environment, including chairing the Change Advisory Board (CAB). You will make sure network, cloud and security changes are well designed, safely deployed and keep Scyne secure.

You will decide whether a change is ready to go ahead. You will chair CAB, hold our managed service provider (MSP) and internal teams to a high standard of planning, testing and rollback, and keep improving how change is delivered. You will bring practical experience of modern cloud deployment practices, such as infrastructure as code and automated pipelines, so that change is faster and safer, and you will make sure security is considered in every change.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the design, configuration and lifecycle of Scyne's Palo Alto Networks environment, including Prisma Access (SASE), GlobalProtect, next-generation firewalls, and management through Strata Cloud Manager or Panorama.
  • Manage security policy across the Palo Alto stack: rule review and clean-up, identity-based access, URL filtering, threat prevention, SSL decryption, and logging to security monitoring tools.
  • Maintain secure, reliable connectivity for users, offices and cloud environments, including remote access, site connectivity, DNS, and network integration with Azure, AWS and GCP.
  • Run Scyne's Change Advisory Board: set the agenda, chair the meeting, assess risk and impact, and approve, defer or reject changes.
  • Own the technical change management process across network, cloud, security and applications, including change types, lead times, emergency changes, freeze periods, post-implementation reviews and reporting on change success.
  • Review MSP and internal change requests for quality, including implementation steps, testing, rollback and communication plans, and send back those that are not ready.
  • Bring cloud deployment practices into change: infrastructure as code, pipeline-based deployments in GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, environment promotion and automated testing, and define where standard, pre-approved changes can safely be used.
  • Make sure every change is assessed for security impact, and work with the cyber security team on vulnerability remediation, patching windows and urgent security changes.
  • Track vulnerabilities and software versions across the Palo Alto stack, and plan and lead upgrades.
  • Lead network and change-related incident and problem management with the MSP, and drive lasting fixes.
  • Produce and maintain network diagrams, standards, configuration records, change templates and runbooks.
  • Report on change and network performance to the Director, Head of Architecture and Cloud, and recommend improvements.

Ideally, you'll have some of the following:

  • 10+ years' experience in network engineering or network security, including significant hands-on work with Palo Alto Networks technologies.
  • Practical experience designing and operating Prisma Access (SASE), GlobalProtect and Palo Alto firewalls; experience with Prisma SD-WAN, Prisma Access Browser or Prisma Cloud is valued.
  • Proven experience running a Change Advisory Board and owning change management, applying ITIL change, incident and problem practices.
  • Experience with cloud deployment practices, including infrastructure as code (such as Terraform), CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, and cloud networking in Azure, AWS or GCP.
  • Strong network security knowledge, including zero trust, segmentation, secure remote access, and familiarity with the ASD Essential Eight and the Information Security Manual (ISM).
  • Strong grasp of networking fundamentals: routing, switching, VPN, DNS and load balancing.
  • Experience directing and governing a managed service provider.
  • Experience leading technical teams and influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Clear written communication, with the ability to produce diagrams, standards and change records that others can follow.
  • Palo Alto Networks certifications are highly desirable, such as PCNSE or a Prisma Access or SASE specialisation; ITIL Foundation or higher is valued.
  • A tertiary qualification in information technology, computer science, engineering or a related discipline is desirable.

  • Market leading Parental Leave: Allows either carer to take 26 weeks of leave, flexibly, until a child is two years of age. A six-month minimum service requirement for new starters applies. We also make full superannuation contributions for up to 12 months (including unpaid parental leave).
  • Flex working: Our people have the autonomy to choose where and when they work so they can integrate their professional and personal lives, finding the right balance that fuels their growth, wellbeing, engagement and productivity. If it works for them, their teams, and their clients, it works for us.
  • Additional leave: a 5th week of paid leave to support rest, wellbeing, and inclusion during our annual summer shutdown also Birthday leave, First Nations Cultural Leave, Floating Public Holidays, Leave+ (purchased leave up to 12 weeks), Study Leave, Volunteering Leave, and more!
  • Smart Device reimbursement: Working flexibly means accessing the information you need on the go. That’s why we help pay for your smartphone or tablet, claiming up to $60 a month towards your bill.
  • Wellness and Lifestyle benefits: We’ll give you $295 a year to spend on items or activities that support your wellness, and up to $205 a year to support your balanced lifestyle.
  • Acacia: Our EAP provider, whose holistic suite of services promote wellbeing and proactively provide protection and support when it matters most for our people and their families.

Scyne Advisory: Our Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, and Impact

We champion a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion, recognising that collective intelligence and varied perspectives are crucial for delivering exceptional outcomes for Australia's public sector. We actively encourage applications from individuals within marginalised and historically underrepresented communities. Please advise us if you require any adjustments during the application process.

We are deeply passionate about improving outcomes for First Peoples, collaborating with government and community sectors on programs focused on First Nations clients, consumers, and communities. We highly value the profound knowledge, insights, capabilities, strength, resilience, and cultural competence of First Peoples.

Our recruitment process is fair and inclusive, seeking a skilled and diverse workforce reflective of the communities we serve. We consider ability, performance, potential, and alignment with our values, valuing unique experiences and contributions. Background checks and, if required, valid Commonwealth security clearances are part of our process.

For recruitment partners, please note that candidate submissions from search firms and recruiters are only accepted in alignment with a pre-existing, signed agreement for a specific position. Unsolicited resumes will not incur financial obligation.

title: BIM Project Manager
description:
About Ethos

Ethos is a collaborative team of engineers, consultants, and creative thinkers designing and delivering data centre and energy infrastructure across the world's most dynamic markets. As a multidisciplinary consultancy, we combine technical expertise, creativity, and integrated delivery to lead complex, mission-critical projects.

Built on strong relationships, clear leadership, and a can-do mindset, Ethos is entering an exciting phase of growth, expanding our capabilities and taking on increasingly high-impact projects across EMEA and beyond.

Sustainability guides how we design, collaborate, and deliver, creating innovative solutions and lasting value for our clients and communities — making Performance Made Possible.

About the Job

As we continue to expand our BIM capabilities, Ethos is seeking a BIM Project Manager to join our BIM Studio team and lead BIM delivery across a portfolio of complex and high-profile projects.

This role plays a critical part in driving digital coordination, ensuring that models, workflows and deliverables are executed to the highest standards in line with both Ethos and client expectations. You will act as the key interface between the BIM team, engineering disciplines and external stakeholders, ensuring seamless collaboration, maintaining quality and delivering BIM outputs in line with project programmes.

You will work closely with the BIM Manager (strategic oversight and escalation), BIM Project Leads (project delivery execution), Engineering Project Managers and design teams, and external consultants and client BIM representatives.

To maintain a clear separation between BIM responsibilities and engineering design ownership, the role does not include detailed modelling production (except where necessary), responsibility for engineering design decisions or calculations, overriding engineering design authority, commercial contract management or fee negotiations (unless delegated), or acting as the Engineering Project Manager.

Responsibilities

• Manage BIM resources across multiple active projects.

• Oversee BIM delivery to ensure timely, high-quality deliverables across all assigned projects, aligned with project programmes and milestones.

• Monitor project progress, risks and resource allocation.

• Provide regular BIM status reports to Engineering Management.

• Support scalable and predictable BIM resource planning by identifying upcoming resource requirements.

• Ensure all projects comply with internal BIM standards and QA processes.

• Guide BIM Project Leads in implementing both company and client-specific BIM requirements.

• Maintain consistency in modelling, coordination and data management across projects.

• Act as the primary BIM point of contact for design teams and external stakeholders.

• Attend design team and coordination meetings representing BIM.

• Manage client expectations regarding BIM deliverables and timelines.

• Collaborate closely with Engineering Leads and Project Managers.

• Provide high-level technical support across BIM tools (e.g. Revit, Navisworks, ACC).

• Support coordination strategies and issue resolution at project level.

• Drive efficient coordination workflows and minimise rework.

• Work with Engineering Leads to develop and manage the Document Issue Register.

• Take responsibility for BIM delivery performance across projects, influencing BIM-related project decisions and workflows.

• Chair internal BIM meetings between the internal Engineering team and the internal BIM team.

• Escalate technical or resource issues to the BIM Manager where required.

About You

• An experienced BIM professional from an MEP consultancy background who can lead BIM delivery across multiple projects.

• A credible communicator and stakeholder manager who acts as the key interface between the BIM team, engineering disciplines and external stakeholders.

• Someone who maintains quality and delivers BIM outputs in line with project programmes.

Technical Skills

• Proficiency in Revit, Navisworks, and common BIM collaboration platforms (e.g. ACC).

• Strong understanding of BIM standards, coordination processes and QA workflows.

• Knowledge of ISO 19650 or similar information management standards is desirable.

Experience & Qualifications

• Strong experience in BIM delivery within MEP consultancy.

• Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.

• Experience working within a structured BIM department is desirable.

• Leadership or team management experience within BIM environments is desirable.

Soft Skills

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to manage resources, priorities and deadlines effectively.

• A pragmatic, delivery-focused and outcome-driven approach is desirable.

• Credible communicator with technical and senior leadership audiences (desirable).

• Comfortable operating with authority and responsibility (desirable).

Why Join Us?

• Join collaborative leaders – Work alongside experienced, approachable professionals who

combine technical excellence with calm, supportive leadership.

• Make a real impact – Contribute to mission-critical infrastructure projects that support the digital and energy transition across EMEA and beyond.

• Grow with us – As a rapidly growing consultancy, we offer opportunities to develop your skills,

broaden your experience, and build your career.

• Shape a more sustainable future – Sustainability isn't an initiative—it's embedded in every project, every discipline, and every decision we make.

We offer:

• Flexible Fridays and a 9-day fortnight working schedule — enjoy every second Friday off to

maintain work–life balance.

• A culture that values flexibility, learning, and teamwork, with clear progression pathways and

support toward professional accreditation.

• Opportunities to work alongside some of the most experienced engineers in the industry, within a forward-thinking, technology-driven consultancy.

Benefits:

• Flexible working times

• 20 Days holidays up to 25 days

• Pension Scheme

• Refer a Friend scheme

• Gym / Fitness membership Allowance

• Subsidised Health Insurance Allowance

• Healthcare check-ups and flu vaccinations

• Working travel out-of-pocket expenses

• Travel tax scheme or bike-to-work scheme

• Regular training/mentoring / further college support

• Support for Chartership

• A Professional Subscription Fee paid by the company

• Paid Statutory Leaves

• Heavily subsidised social committee

title: Safety and Compliance Training Adviser
description:
About the role

We have an opportunity for a Safety & Compliance Training Adviser to help strengthen safety and compliance performance across Sydney Airport. This role coordinates the governance, development, administration and continuous improvement of safety, compliance and technical learning, ensuring training requirements remain current, risk-based and auditable.

Working closely with operational leaders, subject-matter experts and learning stakeholders, you will manage training controls, learning content, compliance records and review cycles. You will also play a key role in improving training effectiveness and supporting the implementation of a new learning management system across the business.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to

  • Coordinate the annual safety, compliance and technical training plan in line with operational and business requirements.
  • Maintain training registers, calendars, learning pathways and competency records, ensuring information is accurate, current and auditable.
  • Partner with business leaders and subject-matter experts to identify learning needs and develop, review and maintain practical, fit-for-purpose training content.
  • Monitor training completion, learner feedback, assurance findings and upcoming reviews, supporting training effectiveness reviews and escalating compliance, competency or record gaps where required.
  • Spend time in operational areas to assess how safety-critical training is being applied and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Lead the safety and mandatory training workstream as Sydney Airport transitions to its new learning management system.


About you

  • Experience coordinating safety, compliance, technical or operational training within a complex or regulated environment.
  • Strong learning management system administration skills, with experience maintaining accurate and auditable training and competency records.
  • An ability to work effectively with operational teams, business leaders and subject-matter experts to develop and implement learning content.
  • Understanding of training governance, adult-learning principles and competency-based learning.
  • Ability to interpret procedural, regulatory and operational requirements and translate them into practical, fit-for-purpose learning solutions.
  • Strong organisation, written communication and analytical skills, with the ability to identify compliance gaps and improvement opportunities.
  • Relevant qualifications in learning and development, training and assessment, work health and safety or a related discipline. A Certificate IV in Training and Assessment would be highly regarded.


What we offer

To find out more about the amazing work environment here at SYD, be sure to check out the Join us section of Sydney Airport’s website, where you can also see more about our flexible culture and work practices, alongside our other Employee benefits, or take a look at our LinkedIn Sydney Airport: Life page.

Make it Amazing

SYD is an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourages all suitably qualified applicants to apply, including First Nations Australians, and people from culturally diverse backgrounds.

title: Indigenous Employment Coordinator
description:
WHAT'S THE ROLE

Creating meaningful employment opportunities for Indigenous Peoples takes more than recruitment. It requires strong community relationships, consistent candidate engagement and the coordination needed to turn employment commitments into results.

As Indigenous Employment Coordinator, you will help connect Indigenous candidates and communities with employment, training and career-development opportunities across our operations in Canada. You’ll support community outreach, participate in events and career fairs, work directly with candidates, and coordinate the programs and activities that help people move from opportunity to employment.

You’ll also play an important role behind the scenes, keeping programs organized, maintaining accurate records and supporting reporting for internal teams, clients and external stakeholders.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Support relationships with Indigenous communities, organizations and employment partners to connect candidates with current and future opportunities.
  • Participate in community events, cultural gatherings, career fairs and other outreach activities that promote employment opportunities and strengthen community connections.
  • Support Indigenous recruitment activities, including candidate outreach, initial screening, interviews, onboarding and helping new hires prepare for their first work rotation.
  • Maintain engagement schedules and coordinate recruitment and community outreach activities with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Coordinate training and development programs, including registrations, schedules, placements, rotations, mentor assignments and participant documentation.
  • Follow up with mentors and participants and ensure program feedback and supporting documentation are completed and maintained.
  • Maintain accurate employment and program records and support timely reporting for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Help develop communications that promote employment initiatives, community activities and recruitment opportunities.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for someone who enjoys working with people but is equally comfortable managing the details that keep programs moving. You’re organized, approachable and a strong communicator who can move comfortably between a candidate conversation, a community event and the administrative follow-through required afterward.

  • Relevant experience in recruitment, community relations, workforce development, operations or a similar role.
  • Experience working with Indigenous Peoples and communities, along with an understanding of Indigenous history, cultures and community practices in Canada.
  • Strong administrative and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate schedules, programs, documentation and multiple priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to adapt your approach to candidates, community partners, internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • The confidence and professional presence to represent the organization at community events, career fairs and stakeholder meetings.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records and support reporting requirements.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

title: Technology Portfolio Analyst
description:
He mea whakamiharo koe technology professional? (Are you an amazing technology professional?)

Know technology projects, understand what good delivery looks like, and love turning data into insight?
This could be a great next move.

We’re looking for an experienced Technology Portfolio Analyst to help us understand how our portfolio is performing, where the pressure points are, and what leaders need to know to make good decisions.

This isn't a reporting role sitting on the sidelines of delivery. To be successful, you’ll need a strong grounding in technology project delivery and an understanding of what it takes to move a technology project from planning through delivery to closure.

You’ll use that experience to look beyond the numbers. You’ll be able to recognise when a forecast doesn’t stack up, when a milestone or dependency needs attention, when capacity is becoming a constraint, and when leaders need better information to make a decision.

He aha tāu e kawe mai (What you will bring)

We’re looking for someone who has worked close enough to technology delivery to understand the realities behind a project plan, budget, forecast and status report.

Along with your relevant qualifications and 5+ years’ experience working across technology projects, programmes, portfolios, PMO or project controls, you'll bring:

  • A sound understanding of the technology project lifecycle, including planning, delivery, governance, financial management, risk, dependencies, resourcing and project closure
  • Experience preparing portfolio or management reporting for senior stakeholders
  • Strong financial acumen, including project budgets, forecasting, variance analysis and estimates at completion
  • Strong Excel and data analysis capability, with experience using reporting tools
  • Experience with resource and capacity planning
  • The confidence to interrogate information and constructively challenge project forecasts, assumptions and status
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to turn complex project information into a clear story for decision-makers
  • A curious, organised and improvement-focused approach

Ngā āhuatanga kei a mātou (What’s In It For You)

You’ll be valued for who you are, rewarded for what you do and supported to thrive. We’ll sweeten your salary with a host of extra benefits including additional leave entitlements, flexible working arrangements and free insurances and health checks. You’ll get to work in a safe, healthy environment, supported by great people who want to see you succeed.

title: Octant Apprentice
description:
COMPANY

Octant is a clinical-stage drug discovery company developing correctors for protein misfolding diseases. Octant’s platform, The Navigator, combines high-throughput synthetic biology, generative chemistry, and AI/ML to discover and develop therapeutics against complex cellular mechanisms in human cells.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Octant is looking for the class of 2027-2028 Apprentices! You're close to graduation and excited to train in Octant's core technologies before your next professional step. Whether you're excited about startups, working in industry, or planning on going to graduate school, you're motivated by Octant's mission to engineer breakthrough medicines. As part of the Octant team, you'll learn from some of the top scientists in drug discovery, synthetic biology, HT ADMET, and chemistry to directly contribute to our therapeutic programs and platform. You love working in the lab, are organized, love learning, and take pride in all of your work. You thrive on getting things done, are eager to troubleshoot random tasks that arise in startups, and can navigate the uncertainty of an ever-changing and fast-paced environment.

Most of the OAs use the program as a gap year before entering graduate school, medical school, or continuing in industry. However, many OAs continue on at Octant at the conclusion of the program.

AS AN OCTANT APPRENTICE (OA) AT OCTANT, YOU WILL:

  • Work closely with a scientist mentor to support and expand Octant's platform technologies to develop novel therapeutics. This includes synthetic biology, multiplexed assays, chemistry, HT ADMET and drug discovery.
  • Learn technical skills relevant to your Octant work such as mammalian cell engineering, cutting edge molecular cloning techniques, high-throughput chemical synthesis, automation, cell-based assays, assay development, cutting edge HT mass spectrometry methods, and more.
  • Experience the multiple facets of a startup, including recruiting and discussing scientific and commercial strategy.
  • Expand your network with other startups, academic programs, and investors during network events and monthly fireside chats.
  • Have regular brunches with our founders, Sri Kosuri and Ramsey Homsany

THIS JOB MIGHT BE GREAT FOR YOU IF YOU HAVE:

  • Education background: You are about to graduate with a bachelor's degree in biology, chemistry, biological engineering, chemical engineering, computation biology/chemistry or related field by August 2027.
  • Experience: Participated in undergraduate research experience involving biology, biochemistry, engineering, chemistry, or other STEM fields.
  • A Detail-Oriented Approach: Attention to detail in experimental design, data collection, and analysis.
  • Flexibility & Adaptability: Flexibility to rapidly changing priorities and project needs, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • A Drive to Innovate and Build: As a startup, there are many ways to contribute to Octant’s success. As an Octant Apprentice, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to high impact projects to build the company.

Apply by January 15th, 2027. Check out our Octant Apprenticeship blog posts here and here to hear more about the apprenticeship experience!

As part of the application process, please indicate whether you are interested in the biology or chemistry roles. Candidates will be evaluated for a role focused on their technical area selection(s). Please note, cross-functional students are invited to apply to up to 2 roles (i.e., if you have a biology background, but want to learn more in chemistry, feel free to apply!).

The expected annual salary for this role is in the range of $70,000 to $80,000. We offer health benefits (medical, dental, vision), equity, and 401(k) matching.

Octant is located in Emeryville, California and we work onsite.

Octant is an equal opportunity company that values applicants of all backgrounds. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive work environment. We value less traditional backgrounds, and may consider an equivalent combination of knowledge, skills, education, and experience to meet minimum qualifications. We know that confidence-gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

title: Project Manager - Federal
location: Bremerton, WA; Seattle, WA; Tacoma, WA; Western WA (Greater Seattle/Tacoma Area)
description:
Celebrating 85 Years of Building With Purpose

At Absher Construction, we’re proud to celebrate over 85 years as one of the Pacific Northwest’s most respected general contractors. As a 100% employee-owned company, we believe our people are our greatest asset and we invest in them like it! From fully paid medical premiums for employees, to a generous PTO policy, 401(k) and ESOP retirement benefits, we offer a total rewards package that reflects the pride and ownership we bring to every project.

As a Project Manager at Absher, you’ll take ownership of federal project delivery from preconstruction through closeout. You’ll lead and support your team to ensure quality, safety, contract compliance, and profitability while building trusted relationships with government agencies, design partners, and subcontractors. You may work in collaboration with a Senior Project Manager or Project Executive depending on project scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead federal project execution to ensure successful delivery, financial performance, contract compliance, and team coordination
  • Oversee project startup, scheduling, change management, safety planning, quality control, and closeout
  • Manage relationships with government clients, contracting officers, design partners, and subcontractors
  • Supervise and mentor project engineers and other project staff
  • Review contract documents, drawings, and specifications to ensure compliance with federal requirements and constructability standards
  • Participate in preconstruction activities including planning, estimating, procurement, and schedule development
  • Manage RFIs, submittals, change orders, and contract modifications while maintaining accurate project documentation
  • Monitor project budgets, cost forecasts, schedules, and subcontractor performance to identify and mitigate risks
  • Navigate federal construction requirements, including USACE and/or NAVFAC procedures, reporting, documentation, and quality control standards
  • Proactively resolve field challenges, coordinate with project stakeholders, and maintain positive government client relationships

Why You’ll Be Successful

You're a confident leader who understands the complexities of federal construction. You know how to navigate government requirements, maintain strong relationships, and keep projects moving while balancing schedule, budget, quality, and compliance.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management or related field, or equivalent field experience
  • Proven project management experience in commercial and/or federal construction
  • Prior experience managing construction projects for the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) and/or Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command (NAVFAC) required
  • Strong understanding of federal contracting procedures, project documentation, and government quality control requirements
  • Experience with federal construction safety standards, including EM 385-1-1
  • Skilled in project budgeting, scheduling, cost forecasting, change management, and contract negotiations
  • Ability to interpret federal contract specifications, drawings, and technical requirements
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills with government representatives, design teams, and trade partners
  • Commitment to a safety-first culture and inclusive team environment
  • Familiarity with construction management platforms (e.g., Procore) a plus

Note: Absher is a Federal Contractor. All job offers are contingent upon successful completion of a background check and drug screen.

Salary offers are typically made between the entry and midpoint of the range and are based on factors such as experience, education, and internal equity.

Pay Transparency
$120,000—$150,000 USD

Background Check & Pre-Employment Screening

All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment background check and drug screening. Background checks may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and references. For positions with access to company financial accounts or credit card programs, a credit history check may also be conducted.

All screening is conducted in compliance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) and applicable state and local laws. Candidates will be asked to provide written consent prior to any screening. If results include information that may affect a hiring decision, candidates will have the opportunity to review and respond to the findings before a final decision is made.

Absher Construction is an equal opportunity employer. Background check results are evaluated in context and do not automatically disqualify applicants.

Absher’s Commitment: Our Pledge to EEOC

At Absher, we are committed to building a culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome diverse voices, perspectives, and experiences and we believe our work is stronger because of them. No employee or applicant will face discrimination based on race, color, national origin, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class.

Notice to Staffing Agencies

Please note: We are not accepting unsolicited resumes or inquiries from staffing agencies at this time. Absher employees are not authorized to bind the company to any third-party recruitment agreements.

title: Paraveterinair Senior bij Dierenkliniek Leerdam
description:
Vacature: Paraveterinair Senior bij Dierenkliniek Leerdam

Ben jij een ervaren paraveterinair die houdt van afwisseling, verantwoordelijkheid en een fijne samenwerking met collega's? Krijg jij energie van een dynamische werkdag waarin je schakelt tussen baliewerkzaamheden, spreekuur, chirurgie, opname en diagnostiek? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Bij Dierenkliniek Leerdam kom je terecht in een betrokken team waar samenwerken, aanpakken en werkplezier centraal staan. We zoeken een ervaren paraveterinair die stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat, graag zelfstandig werkt en het leuk vindt om collega's te ondersteunen en kennis over te dragen. Iemand met een nuchtere instelling die met plezier de handen uit de mouwen steekt!

Dit ga je doen

Als Senior Paraveterinair ben je een belangrijke spil binnen onze kliniek. Je ondersteunt de dierenartsen bij uiteenlopende onderzoeken en behandelingen, voert zelfstandig paraveterinaire werkzaamheden uit en zorgt ervoor dat de dagelijkse processen soepel verlopen.

Je hebt een veelzijdige functie waarin je jouw ervaring volop kunt inzetten. Daarnaast denk je actief mee over de kwaliteit van zorg en draag je bij aan een prettige samenwerking binnen het team.

  • Patiëntenzorg: Je begeleidt en verzorgt opgenomen dieren, bewaakt hun welzijn en ondersteunt bij onderzoeken en behandelingen.

  • Assistentie en chirurgie: Je assisteert de dierenartsen tijdens spreekuren, operaties en gebitsbehandelingen.

  • Diagnostiek: Je voert zelfstandig laboratoriumonderzoeken uit en ondersteunt bij verschillende diagnostische werkzaamheden.

  • Klantcontact: Je bent een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor diereigenaren, zowel aan de balie als telefonisch.

  • Begeleiding: Je ondersteunt en begeleidt collega's en stagiaires en vindt het leuk om jouw kennis en ervaring te delen.

  • Kwaliteit en organisatie: Je houdt overzicht, bewaakt de dagelijkse werkprocessen en denkt actief mee over verbeteringen binnen de kliniek.

  • Samenwerking: Je werkt nauw samen met de dierenartsen en paraveterinaire collega's en draagt bij aan een positieve werksfeer.

Dit neem je mee

Jij bent een ervaren paraveterinair die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van samenwerken. Je hebt oog voor zowel de patiënt als de eigenaar en weet ook op drukke momenten het overzicht te bewaren.

Verder neem je mee:

  • Een afgeronde opleiding tot paraveterinair en registratie in het Diergeneeskunderegister.

  • Ruime werkervaring als paraveterinair.

  • Het vermogen om zelfstandig te werken en prioriteiten te stellen.

  • Een nuchtere, praktische instelling en een echte aanpakkersmentaliteit.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte houding.

  • Enthousiasme voor het begeleiden en ondersteunen van collega's.

  • De motivatie om de kwaliteit van zorg binnen de kliniek verder te verbeteren.

  • Plezier in een afwisselende functie waarin geen dag hetzelfde is.

Dit krijg je van ons

Omdat jij iedere dag klaarstaat voor dieren, hun eigenaren en je collega's, investeren wij graag in jou. Je krijgt bij ons niet alleen een afwisselende baan, maar ook de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en jouw ervaring in te zetten.

  • Een uitdagende en afwisselende functie als Senior Paraveterinair binnen Dierenkliniek Leerdam.

  • Een salaris passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring, conform de cao Veterinaire sector.

  • Een uitstekende pensioenregeling.

  • Een gezonde werk-privébalans met 25 vakantiedagen (op basis van fulltime).

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding en 20% personeelskorting.

  • Ongekende groei via de IVC Evidensia Academy: toegang tot diverse opleidingen, trainingen en nascholingen om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

  • De mogelijkheid om jouw kennis en ervaring te delen binnen een betrokken team.

  • Een internationaal netwerk van veterinaire collega's en kennisbanken om mee te sparren.

Over IVC Evidensia

Stel je voor: de charme en het hechte teamgevoel van jouw lokale dierenkliniek, gecombineerd met de kracht en de kennis van de grootste veterinaire groep van Europa. Dát is werken bij IVC Evidensia.

Bij ons is elke vestiging uniek, met een eigen identiteit. We zijn een netwerk dat samenwerkt om ons doel te bereiken: gezonde huisdieren en gelukkige eigenaren. Jij profiteert van specialistische kennis, een breed netwerk en een supportteam dat je ondersteunt, zodat jij je kunt focussen op wat je het liefste doet: de allerbeste zorg verlenen.

Pak het moment!

Ben jij toe aan een volgende stap in je carrière en wil je jouw ervaring inzetten binnen een gezellig en betrokken team? Zie jij jezelf al werken bij Dierenkliniek Leerdam?

Dan drinken we graag een kop koffie met je! Klik op de sollicitatiebutton en stuur je cv. We kunnen niet wachten om van je te horen!

title: Vice President of Operations - Healthcare
description:
Location: Canonsburg, PA - Ideally seeking a local Pittsburgh, PA candidate!

Salary 108-130k plus bonus opportunity!

As the Vice President of Operations, a successful candidate's core responsibilities:

Private Practice Operations Leadership

  • Lead and manage the full-service delivery operation across all three service lines: Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), Medical Software Management (MSM), and Population Health Management (PHM)

  • Serve as the operational authority on every dimension of successful private practice management — from the physician's clinical workflow to the front-desk registration process to the final payment posting in the billing system

  • Oversee the physician practice conversion program — guiding doctors who are transitioning from corporate employment or hospital-based practice into independent private practice, including credentialing, payer enrollment, EHR selection and implementation, billing setup, staffing, compliance, and operational launch

  • Ensure every client practice receives service delivery that is accurate, timely, compliant, and genuinely value-added at every interaction

Revenue Cycle Management Oversight

  • Direct oversight of the RCM team and all billing operations across the client portfolio

  • Ensure clean claim rates achieve and sustain industry benchmark standards (90%+)

  • Oversee the complete revenue cycle: charge capture, claim submission, payment posting, denial management, appeals, and secondary billing

  • Manage payer relationships, contract negotiations, and fee schedule benchmarking across commercial payers, Medicare, and Medicaid

  • Implement and enforce denial management and appeal protocols with documented escalation paths through IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) and litigation when warranted

  • Establish and drive accounts receivable performance — DSO targets, AR aging thresholds, and collection rate benchmarks — with weekly reporting and accountability

Medical Coding and Compliance

  • Ensure the team applies CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, and modifier codes correctly across all supported specialty types

  • Stay current on annual CMS fee schedule updates, CPT code changes, and new billing opportunities (including Remote Patient Monitoring, Transitional Care Management, Chronic Care Management, and behavioral health code expansions)

  • Establish and enforce a compliance framework — HIPAA, OIG guidelines, payer-specific billing rules — across all client accounts and internal staff

  • Build a quality control function that identifies coding errors and workflow breakdowns before they reach the payer

EHR and Medical Software Management

  • Oversee the Medical Software Management service line — supporting client practices on the major EHR platforms including Medent, ModMed, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, Micro MD, athenahealth, and others

  • Direct the development and maintenance of platform-specific workflow documentation, staff training, and client onboarding protocols for each supported EHR system

  • Ensure no new client is onboarded on a platform for which the organization does not have internal staff competency — enforce mandatory pre-contract feasibility checks

  • Evaluate and integrate AI-assisted documentation tools (ambient AI, coding automation) across client practices and internal operations

Population Health Management

  • Partner with the PHM Manager to grow the population health service line in alignment with value-based care contracts, shared risk programs, and payer-driven quality incentive models

  • Support the operationalization of PHM services for primary care practices participating in Highmark and UPMC shared risk networks

  • Ensure PHM reporting, data sharing, and client education workflows are documented, repeatable, and consistently executed

People and Team Management

  • Lead, manage, and develop a distributed remote team of billing specialists, software managers, population health coordinators, and subcontracted staff

  • Establish structured performance management: clear role expectations, measurable KPIs, regular one-on-ones, quarterly reviews, and annual merit evaluations

  • Build and maintain a skills matrix across all staff — identifying single points of failure and ensuring cross-training and documented coverage plans for every critical function

  • Manage remote workforce accountability with clear work standards, output metrics, and communication protocols

Systems, Process, and Technology

  • Build the standard operating procedures currently lacking — documented workflows for every core process: new client onboarding, billing cycle management, denial handling, software implementation, client offboarding, and staff handoffs

  • Implement and manage the company's operating cadence: weekly team meetings, monthly performance reviews, quarterly planning cycles, and annual budgeting

  • Develop the operations plan for the migration to cloud-based infrastructure and AI-integrated workflows across billing, documentation, and internal operations

  • Optimize the use of Microsoft 365 across the team — Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Excel, and Outlook — as the core productivity and communication platform

  • Maintain and expand the use of as the OKR, project management, and team accountability platform

Financial Management

  • Own the company's operating P&L with full budget authority and accountability for revenue, cost of delivery, gross margin, and EBITDA

  • Build the company's first formal annual operating budget — including headcount planning, technology investment, partner costs, and merit budgets — and manage against it monthly

  • Develop client-level profit and loss statements to identify which client relationships are profitable on a fully loaded basis and which are not

  • Enforce financial policy consistently — including the management of accounts with overdue balances — without exception for relationship considerations

  • Partner with the Controller on weekly cash position reporting, DSO monitoring, and AR performance management

Goal Setting and Accountability

  • Define and implement functional KPIs for every team role — measurable, time-bound, and directly connected to company revenue and client retention

  • Run a weekly leadership accountability review using the commitment table format from strategic planning sessions

  • Ensure the company's OKR framework () reflects current strategic priorities and is actively used by all team members, not just leadership

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in private practice healthcare operations, revenue cycle management, physician practice management, or health information technology — not hospital administration

  • Minimum 5 years in a senior operational leadership role directly managing a team of 15 or more people in a healthcare services environment

  • Deep billing expertise — working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, and modifier coding; denial management; payer appeal processes; EOB and ERA reconciliation; clearinghouse operations; and Medicare/Medicaid billing requirements

  • Proven P&L ownership — direct budget accountability, forecasting, and financial management in a services business

  • EHR platform knowledge — hands-on experience with two or more of the following: Medent, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, ModMed, athenahealth, Micro MD, AdvancedMD, or equivalent platforms

  • Remote workforce leadership — documented experience managing geographically distributed teams with structured accountability, output metrics, and communication systems

  • Microsoft 365 proficiency — Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Excel, Outlook, and Word used as daily operational tools

  • SOP and process documentation experience — has built operational manuals, training curricula, and workflow documentation from scratch in a prior role

  • Private practice conversion knowledge — experience supporting physicians transitioning from employment or hospital-based practice into independent practice, including payer enrollment, credentialing, EHR selection, and operational launch

  • Population health familiarity — working knowledge of value-based care models, quality incentive programs, and chronic care management billing

    Preferred Qualifications

  • Active membership in

  • Familiarity with Professional Coder (CPC), or Certified Revenue Cycle Professional (CRCP)

  • Experience with the No Surprises Act (NSA) and Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR) process

  • Familiarity with Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) and Remote Therapeutic Monitoring (RTM) billing under 2024–2026 CMS guidelines

  • Familiarity with selecting, implementing, or integrating ambient AI documentation tools

  • Prior experience in a company with revenue between $3M and $15M — understands the discipline required at this scale

  • MBA, MHA, or equivalent graduate degree preferred

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI
description:
About Asha Health

Asha Health is building an AI OS for outpatient care. It’s the year of AI agents, and startups selling AI agents to healthcare organizations will do great in this wave. While we’re rooting for them, we’re building what comes after. We're backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, 186 Ventures, Reach Capital and many more. We raised an oversubscribed seed round from some of the best investors in Silicon Valley. Our team includes AI product leaders from companies like Google, physician executives from major health systems, and more.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, AI to lead our currently (and hopefully always) small AI engineering team. The twist: you’ll also be coding & building every day. Let us explain ~

  • As AI models evolve, engineering, product management, and design are all changing. We believe old job descriptions should be completely tossed out the door. The future belongs to “builders”: people that are strong engineers, but essentially act as their own PM’s, designers, and user researchers. They talk to customers, decide what to build, how to build it, and have the highest bar for product & UX “taste”.
  • As a Member of Technical Staff, AI you will call the shots - talk to customers, decide what we build, why we build it, and how we build it. You will lead an engineering team (of both humans & agents). However, you will also be an IC building a lot yourself. Why?
    • Now, more so than ever, it is impossible to be good at product without being deep, hands on building AI products using AI products every day. You have to be deep in the weeds if you want to call the shots.
    • The era of middle management is gone. With the power of AI, the next generation of product leaders will drive impact through both people and agents, master both breadth & depth over vast amounts of product surface area, and earn their influence through not just their ideas but what they build.

Requirements

  • Graduated with a bachelors in computer science or related degree.
  • Strong engineering experience AND PM experience.
  • Confident as an engineer: you feel like you can build anything you put your mind to. You spent a few years being an eng IC.
  • Confident as a PM: you’ve led the product roadmap for high impact products.
  • Must be ready to work in person in Manhattan, New York 5 days per week in person but 6 days per week total.

Is this role for you?

  • We want to take a bet. We’re not looking for seasoned product leaders with 10+ YOE. We’re looking for someone incredibly ambitious, who has maybe never even led a team before but for that very reason is ready to give it their all to step up to the challenge.
  • You’d be the 5th member of the product & engineering team. You’d be both an IC and a team lead and work directly with our CEO, CTO, and CMO every day. Lot of ownership; potentially rapid career growth. Think you could be our Tibo?
  • The math: cash comp on par with growth-stage companies, but equity substantially higher. Does the upside justify the risk for you?
  • Passion matters. Healthcare isn’t just inefficient; it’s a catastrophe. Think you got a bone to pick with it?
  • We're building a moonshot. Most AI healthcare startups are taking strategic, measured approaches. We’re rooting for them and think they'll do great in this wave. We're building what comes after. Does that scare you or excite you?
  • At Asha, engineering is the #1 lever. We can’t keep up with sales, and we have contracted ARR piling up. Unlike most of the healthcare market, product & engineering (not sales/gtm) is the biggest lever to pull.

title: Campaign Manager
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 9000 – 13000 PLN / mies. netto

Dołącz do naszego zespołu i rozwijaj się jako
CAMPAIGN MANAGER

Świat reklamy digitalowej to Twoje środowisko? Lubisz pracować z danymi, analizować wyniki i mieć wszystko pod kontrolą?

Szukamy osoby, która ma doświadczenie w prowadzeniu kampanii internetowych, dobrze zna narzędzia reklamowe i potrafi samodzielnie zadbać o ich realizację — od uruchomienia, przez bieżącą optymalizację, aż po końcowy raport.

Zależy nam przede wszystkim na dokładności, zaangażowaniu, analitycznym podejściu i umiejętności szukania rozwiązań. Cenimy osoby, które potrafią dostrzec problem, zareagować na czas i nie boją się wychodzić z inicjatywą.

Poznajmy się!

Jesteśmy zespołem, który stawia na kreatywność, technologię i współpracę. W BALANS.agency tworzymy niestandardowe rozwiązania reklamowe i realizujemy kampanie digitalowe dla największych marek. Jeśli lubisz ciekawe projekty, nowe technologie i dobrą atmosferę, to właśnie Ciebie szukamy!

Kogo szukamy?

Szukamy osoby na stanowisko Campaign Manager, która:

  • Ma minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w prowadzeniu kampanii digitalowych,

  • Dobrze zna środowisko reklamy internetowej, w szczególności kampanii display, video i programmatic,

  • Potrafi samodzielnie zarządzać kilkoma kampaniami jednocześnie i dbać o ich prawidłową realizację,

  • Lubi pracować z danymi, analizować wyniki i szukać sposobów na poprawę efektywności kampanii,

  • Jest dokładna, skrupulatna i dobrze organizuje swoją pracę,

  • Potrafi szybko reagować na problemy, szukać rozwiązań i wychodzić z inicjatywą.

Czym będziesz się zajmować?

  • Samodzielnym uruchamianiem i prowadzeniem kampanii reklamowych w systemach emisyjnych,

  • Pracą w DV360, Adform oraz naszym wewnętrznym panelu do emisji i zarządzania kampaniami,

  • Monitorowaniem wyników kampanii, kontrolą budżetów, terminów i realizacji założonych KPI,

  • Bieżącą optymalizacją kampanii pod kątem ich efektywności i jakości dostarczanego ruchu,

  • Testowaniem kreacji reklamowych, weryfikacją ustawień i kontrolą poprawności emisji,

  • Przygotowywaniem raportów, analiz i rekomendacji na podstawie wyników kampanii,

  • Weryfikacją rozbieżności w danych i rozwiązywaniem problemów technicznych związanych z emisją reklam,

  • Współpracą z zespołem sprzedażowym, kreatywnym oraz partnerami technologicznymi,

  • Udziałem w testowaniu nowych formatów reklamowych i usprawnianiu procesów związanych z realizacją kampanii.

Czego od Ciebie oczekujemy?

  • Znajomości narzędzi reklamowych – praktycznego doświadczenia w pracy z DV360 lub Adform oraz znajomości innych systemów do obsługi kampanii digitalowych,

  • Umiejętności analitycznych – swobodnej pracy z danymi, dostrzegania zależności, interpretowania wyników i wyciągania na ich podstawie konkretnych wniosków,

  • Biegłej znajomości MS Office, w szczególności Excela – sprawnego korzystania z formuł, tabel przestawnych i pracy z większymi zestawami danych,

  • Znajomości wskaźników i modeli rozliczeniowych – swobodnego poruszania się w takich pojęciach jak CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL czy Viewability etc.,

  • Dobrej organizacji pracy – umiejętności ustalania priorytetów, pilnowania terminów i odpowiedzialnego podejścia do powierzonych zadań,

  • Samodzielności i zaangażowania – zależy nam na osobie, która potrafi podejmować decyzje, przewidywać potencjalne problemy i proponować własne rozwiązania.

Dodatkowym atutem będzie znajomość Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Managera, podstaw HTML5 oraz doświadczenie w realizacji kampanii Rich Media i performance. Mile widziana będzie również znajomość Google Ads, Meta Ads lub innych platform reklamowych.

Co oferujemy?

  • Wynagrodzenie: 9 000 – 13 000 zł netto + VAT miesięcznie, w zależności od doświadczenia i umiejętności,

  • Forma współpracy: kontrakt B2B,

  • Elastyczność pracy: możliwość pracy hybrydowej lub stacjonarnej w naszym biurze na Saskiej Kępie w Warszawie,

  • Brak monotonii: różnorodne kampanie, formaty reklamowe i codziennie nowe wyzwania.

  • Przyjazną atmosferę: pracę w zespole, który ceni współpracę, otwartość i wzajemne wsparcie.

  • Dodatkowy dzień wolny w dniu Twoich urodzin!

Jak wygląda nasz proces rekrutacyjny?

Bez zbędnych formalności! Chcemy się po prostu lepiej poznać i sprawdzić, czy dobrze będzie nam się razem pracować. Cały proces składa się z trzech etapów:

1. Krótka rozmowa telefoniczna

Na początek zadzwonimy, żeby zamienić kilka słów, porozmawiać o wzajemnych oczekiwaniach i umówić się na kolejne spotkanie.

2. Spotkanie online

Porozmawiamy o Twoim doświadczeniu, umiejętnościach i kampaniach, przy których była okazja pracować. Opowiemy też więcej o BALANS.agency, naszym zespole i codziennej pracy. Będzie również przestrzeń na wszystkie Twoje pytania!

3. Poznajmy się na żywo!

Z wybraną osobą spotkamy się w naszym biurze na Saskiej Kępie, żeby poznać się osobiście i porozmawiać o ostatnich szczegółach współpracy.

Jak aplikować?

Jeśli reklama internetowa to Twoje środowisko, lubisz pracować z danymi i chcesz mieć realny wpływ na realizowane kampanie, prześlij nam swoje CV!

Dziękujemy za wszystkie zgłoszenia! Z wybranymi osobami skontaktujemy się telefonicznie, żeby porozmawiać o kolejnych krokach.

title: Intern, Engagement (Partnership)
description:
WHO WE ARE:

*SCAPE Co., Ltd. is a non-profit organisation, a registered charity, and an Institution of a Public Character that engages and nurtures youth by developing their talents. At *SCAPE, we offer a holistic network of programmes, communities, and facilities to support youth in their pursuit of interests and passion areas. Together with our partners, we inspire and empower our youth to discover boundless possibilities.


ROLE OVERVIEW
Support the Partnerships team in the research, coordination and administrative work underpinning *SCAPE's fundraising and strategic partnership efforts. The intern will gain exposure to prospect research, grant opportunities, partnership development, proposal preparation and stakeholder engagement while supporting the team in building and maintaining its fundraising pipeline.

YOU WILL BE WORKING ON:

  • Research prospective corporate partners, foundations,institutions and other potential funders, including their areas of interest, giving priorities and funding opportunities.
  • Support grant research by identifying relevant funding schemes, application requirements, eligibility criteria and submission timelines.
  • Maintain and update prospect databases, correspondence records and pipeline trackers, ensuring information and follow-up actions are properly documented.
  • Compile research findings and background information to support prospect assessment and partnership planning

  • Assist in preparing partnership proposals, sponsorship decks, funding applications and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Support the development of presentation materials by gathering programme information, relevant data, case studies and supporting content.

  • Assist in coordinating meetings and stakeholder engagements, including scheduling, preparing meeting materials and documenting discussion points and follow-up actions.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with an ability to organise information and develop clear, engaging presentation decks.

  • Able to commit on weekends

title: Senior Pavement Engineer
description:
AECOM is looking for a Senior Pavements Engineer with 10+ years of relevant experience to join our Sydney team. You’ll lead the technical delivery of pavement design and rehabilitation projects across aviation, ports and road transport, working on assets such as airport runways, port hardstands and major roads.

You’ll work directly with clients and multidisciplinary teams, taking ownership of pavement design decisions, reviewing technical work and helping develop the next generation of pavement engineers.

How you’ll make a difference

  • Lead pavement investigations, design and rehabilitation work from concept through to detailed design and construction support.

  • Develop practical pavement solutions that account for loading, materials, construction methods and long term performance.

  • Interpret pavement investigation and testing data, including FWD, HWD, GPR, LWD, profile and surface friction results, and translate findings into clear design and rehabilitation recommendations.

  • Prepare and review pavement design reports, specifications and drawings, checking that designs meet relevant standards and project requirements.

  • Coordinate pavement design with other disciplines and advise clients on design options, technical risks and constructability.

  • Mentor junior engineers and support their development through design reviews and practical technical guidance.

    The qualities that help you thrive

    The following qualifications and experience are highly desired, but if you don’t tick all the boxes you could still be a perfect fit for this role. Please apply, all applications will be considered.

    • Degree in civil engineering or a related discipline.
    • Demonstrated experience in pavement investigation, assessment, design and rehabilitation.
    • Strong understanding of pavement materials, performance and relevant design standards and road authority requirements.
    • Experience preparing technical deliverables and coordinating multidisciplinary inputs.
    • Demonstrated ability to manage work packages, communicate technical recommendations and mentor junior engineers.
    • Chartered professional status, or progress towards it, is desirable.

    Why you’ll love working with us

We are committed to connecting to Country in our work through meaningful engagement with First Nations peoples and businesses.
