title: Talent Register - Worksafe Inspector/Investigators
company: Department of Local Government, Industry, Regulation and Safety
description:
Talent Register - Worksafe Inspector/Investigators
(Pool Ref LGIRS TER - WORKSAFE)


Why LGIRS

With the Department of Local Government, Industry Regulation and Safey (LGIRS), our work spans a wide range of areas—from strengthening local government and protecting workers’ safety to regulating industries and improving customer services. Our services include WorkSafe, industry regulation and consumer protection, labour relations, building and energy regulation and support of local government, regulation of the gambling and liquor industries and corporate support services.

Our values are captured in one simple and meaningful acronym: CARE – Collaboration, Accountability, Respect and Excellence. This reflects what sits at the heart of our organisation – a genuine commitment to each other and to the work we do.

To learn more about the department and what we have to offer, please visit our website, and to keep up to date on activities, you can follow us on LinkedIn or WorkSafeWA.

What does WorkSafe do?

WorkSafe drives workplace change in WA through education, specialist advice and enforcement. This includes work health and safety compliance in the mining and general industries sectors, and safety compliance for dangerous goods, as well as regulating major hazard facilities and petroleum operations within the state.

Who will you be working with?

We are committed to creating and maintaining a diverse workforce that reflects the community we serve and have an inclusive culture where all employees feel valued, respected and connected. Our workforce's diversity is our strength; it enhances our ability to be forward-thinking and responsive in the services we deliver to the Western Australian community.

Opportunities

This register may be used to fill a range of available opportunities within the WorkSafe Group, and across LGIRS, including:

  • Fixed-term appointments to cover leave, acting or other vacancies, or projects with a finite life,
  • Secondments opportunities for employees in the wider Public Sector, and
  • Permanent appointments (in limited circumstances).

We are building a talent register for Inspector roles across a range of specialist disciplines, including Agriculture, Asbestos, Construction, Mental Health, Work Health and Safety, Triage, and Investigations.

Our inspector teams have distinct operational focuses and often require industry-specific knowledge, technical expertise, and relevant professional experience. If you have experience in any of these areas and would like to be considered for future opportunities, we encourage you to register your interest.

Positions may be available in a range of roles and the register is actively monitored for positions in these areas:

Inspectors & Senior Inspectors – General Industries and Specialist Teams

Help make Western Australian workplaces safer by conducting inspections, investigating incidents, enforcing WHS laws, and providing practical compliance advice. Opportunities are available across industry and specialist teams.

Inspector/Investigators & Senior Inspector/Investigators – Investigations

Lead complex investigations into serious and fatal workplace incidents. Gather evidence, conduct interviews, assess potential breaches of WHS legislation, and prepare reports and briefs for legal proceedings and safety outcomes.

Inspectors of Mines

Promote safety across the mining sector through inspections, investigations, stakeholder engagement, and compliance activities. Drive safety improvements and contribute to major reform and continuous improvement initiatives.

Dangerous Goods Officers

Support community safety by regulating dangerous goods and explosives across Western Australia. Conduct inspections, investigations, compliance assessments, and enforcement activities to prevent harm and manage risks.

Please reach out to the recruitment and engagement team at recruitmentandengagement@lgirs.wa.gov.au for a copy of the the Job Description Form (JDF) for further information regarding the position, including any specific requirements, leadership capabilities and pre-employment checks which will be assessed as part of the selection process.

Being on the register does not guarantee employment, but you may be contacted if a suitable opportunity arises.

Eligibility

You must be an Australian citizen, Australian permanent resident or hold a visa that entitles you to live and work in Australia for the term of the employment contract.

To be employed with LGIRS, you must meet the pre-employment requirements of the position and provide consent to undertake relevant pre-employment screening, which may include a Conflict of Interest Declaration, medical assessment, psychometric assessment, Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check (NCCHC), and/or other relevant checks and clearances.

How to apply

To register your interest, we ask for you to provide a detailed resume outlining your key achievements, work history, education and professional development along with details of two referees.

Once you’ve got this ready please click here.

Your details will stay on our temporary register for three (3) months, after which time, you will need to reapply.

Of course, we recommend you monitor our current vacancies so you don’t miss out on an opportunity

Most of the positions in Worksafe are identified as having a higher likelihood of exposure to potentially traumatic events. This is any distressing experience or situation in which an individual’s physical or psychological wellbeing may be threatened. This could involve attending or investigating safety incidents or fatalities, interacting with affected, distressed and/or aggressive people, and exposure to objectionable material such as records containing potentially traumatic content.

The department has specific Potentially Traumatic Event Response Support processes and training available for this role. If you have any questions or would like further clarification about the nature of this position and the supports available.

Supporting diversity and inclusion

LGIRS is committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful and supportive workplace. We want everyone to feel valued and empowered to contribute. Inclusion is central to our values of collaboration, accountability, respect, and excellence (CARE). We recognise that a diverse workforce strengthens our organisation. Different perspectives, experiences, and ideas help us better CARE for the Western Australian community. As an equal opportunity employer, and in accordance with the Equal Opportunity Act 1984 (WA), preference may be given to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disability, young people, and people of diverse sexualities and genders.

We are proud members of the Hidden Disability Sunflower Program and the Australian Disability Network. LGIRS is also a nationally recognised Accredited Carer Friendly Employer through the Carers + Employers program. Our engagement with these programs and networks reflects our commitment to supporting accessible and inclusive employment for individuals, as well as those with caring responsibilities through flexible work practices.

We use the National Relay Service (NRS) to ensure we are accessible to people who are deaf or have a hearing or speech impairment. NRS can help you connect with us on:

  • TTY/voice calls – 133 677
  • Speak & Listen – 1300 555 727
  • SMS relay – 0423 677 767

If you have any access needs that may require adjustment to allow you to fully participate in the application and interview process, including alternate methods of communication, or to request a document in an alternative format please contact us at RecruitmentandEngagement@lgirs.wa.gov.au.

We look forward to receiving your application and considering you for this exciting opportunity to join our team.

title: Emergency Services Liaison, Singapore
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Waymo Safety team works to promote and help to continuously improve the safety of Waymo's fully autonomous driving technology. Our experts develop safety goals and strategies, and conduct safety engineering analyses to ensure safety is being considered throughout the design and development of our vehicles. The team develops and promotes safety strategies and policies for autonomous vehicles for its work with regulatory authorities, lawmakers, law enforcement and public and non-profit organizations.

In this role you will be hybrid based in Singapore and report into our Head of Enterprise Resilience.

You Will:

  • Be accountable for all aspects of Emergency Services relationships, and outreach programs in Singapore.
  • Establish and maintain primary contact with Emergency Services (Operations Centres / SPF and SCDF coordinators) at management and executive levels in current and future areas of operation.
  • Design, present, and certify additional Emergency Services Ambassadors (ESAs) and Emergency Services stakeholders on Waymo's mission, technology, and industry concerns.
  • Provide oversight, review, and guidance to Emergency Services familiarization teams and act as the final source of truth for Emergency Services questions.
  • Represent Waymo at Emergency Services events, public safety panels, and industry events.
  • Develop internal guidance and policy on emergency management and Emergency Services expectations.

You Have:

  • A Bachelor degree or equivalent experience
  • 10+ years of service in Singapore or regional Asian emergency services (e.g., Singapore Police Force, Singapore Civil Defence Force, or regional equivalents)
  • 10+ years of experience applying Singapore or regional Asian legal frameworks (PDPA, Road Traffic Act), emergency protocols, and community engagement strategies
  • Proven experience in emergency response and building relationships with Emergency Services organizations such as SCDF, SPF, or equivalent regional entities.
  • Experience working with emergency services agencies in Singapore or APAC (e.g., SCDF, SPF, emergency medical services), including managing inter-agency relationships
  • Experience leading cross-functional programs with legal, policy, and other internal teams in a regulated industry

We Prefer:

  • At least 7 years in a leadership or management position within one of Singapore's principal emergency services or a major regional counterpart
  • Experience establishing organizational presence in new geographic locations.
  • Experience with autonomous vehicle technology and its implications for emergency services.
  • A track record of policy development related to emergency management.

title: Data Engineering Intern - Summer 2027
description:
Riot’s Data Engineers build tools and data products that help teams understand and improve the experience of players worldwide. They work across data pipelines, data modeling, data infrastructure, and data quality to make large-scale data useful, reliable, and accessible.

As a Data Engineering Intern, you’ll work with data engineers, software engineers, data scientists, analysts, and game or product partners to build and improve data products. You’ll gain exposure to transforming raw data into clean, queryable datasets, designing data models, validating data quality, and supporting data pipelines. You’ll be supported by experienced team members as you learn Riot’s tools, systems, and engineering practices.

Potential Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, data scientists, analysts, and game teams on data-focused projects.
  • Transform raw data into clean, documented datasets that can be queried and used by downstream partners.
  • Implement small data pipeline, data modeling, or data-quality tasks using established tools, templates, and technical guidance.
  • Support the design of relational data models and data products for game, product, or business use cases.
  • Help validate data for accuracy, timeliness, completeness, and sustainability.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, team rituals, and project planning.
  • Document technical proposals, implementation details, and data definitions clearly.
  • Learn how cloud, distributed-processing, and data-pipelining systems support Riot’s games and products.

Required Qualifications:

  • Graduating in the 2028 calendar year.
  • Currently enrolled in a Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related technical degree program.
  • Available to work full-time hours for the 12-week internship duration.
  • Comfortable programming in Python or Java.
  • Understanding of data structures and algorithms.
  • Familiarity with SQL and relational data concepts such as tables, keys, normalization, or indexing.
  • Minimum GPA of 2.5.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a graduate-level (Master’s or PhD) Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related technical degree program.
  • Experience developing a data pipeline, data model, database project, or data-driven application through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects.
  • Familiarity with cloud-computing basics, such as AWS or GCP.
  • Experience working with Linux operating systems.
  • Understanding of distributed systems, concurrent programming, or distributed data processing.
  • Familiarity with tools or frameworks such as Databricks, Spark, Flink, Hive, Kafka, Airflow, Luigi, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, Parquet, or Avro.
  • Experience with Scala, C++, Golang, or another programming language.
  • Familiarity with software development practices such as Git, unit testing, functional testing, or continuous integration and deployment.
  • Portfolio, website, GitHub, or other collection of original work.

Work Authorization

  • Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States for the duration of the program.
  • This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. We do not sponsor visas for this position or internship conversions.

For this role, you’ll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We’ll consider your studies and experience, as well as your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players’ experiences, this could be the role for you!

Applications close January 4th, 2027

Our Perks

Riot Internships are paid, and interns can also participate in our 401(k) plan. You can expect in-game perks and the ability to participate in our Play Fund, so you can broaden and deepen your knowledge of our players and community through games. The University Programs team also invites you to intern-focused events so you can connect with your fellow interns and Rioters and make the most of your experience.

Riot Games fosters a player and workplace experience that values teamwork embodied by the Summoner’s Code and Community Code. Our culture embraces differences as a strength, and we are committed to promoting a fair and collaborative culture where Rioters treat one another with dignity and respect. We encourage you to read more about our value of thriving together and our ongoing work to build the most inclusive company in gaming.

It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.

Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories:

title: Staff Revenue Manager (EU)
description:
Overview

Wheelhouse is seeking a Staff Revenue Manager to join our Revenue Management team. In this role, you will provide hands-on, active revenue management to a portfolio of select Wheelhouse clients, helping them drive meaningful revenue gains from their short-term and mid-length stay rental properties.

You will work within Wheelhouse’s Revenue Management department, reporting to the Head of Revenue Management. Your primary focus is your client portfolio — you are the day-to-day revenue management practitioner responsible for delivering results for the operators who trust Wheelhouse to provide excellent service and improve their performance. AI has become a core part of how this team works, and you will use it every day to automate routine tasks and build simple tools that help the function scale.

This role is based in Europe, where you’ll help expand our revenue management services into European markets as we grow there. Your initial portfolio will be North American clients, so you’ll need regular availability into US Eastern business hours.

Who We’re Looking For

The ideal Staff Revenue Manager is a revenue management practitioner who is genuinely passionate about the vacation rental and STR industry. You don’t just do this work — you care about it. You follow the space, you have opinions on where it’s heading, and you bring that energy into every client interaction and every pricing decision you make.

Wheelhouse is a fast-moving, remote-first startup, and this role reflects that. We move quickly, and we expect our teammates to bring both focus and initiative. You are someone who thrives with ownership, doesn’t wait to be told what to do next, and finds real satisfaction in doing excellent work in a dynamic environment. You’ll be joining a strong team with a proven approach, and helping take it into new markets as we grow in Europe.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has deep, hands-on experience managing revenue for North American short-term or vacation rental portfolios
  • Has hands-on experience using AI to automate daily processes and build basic tooling, such as reporting workflows, data pulls, or simple internal apps
  • Is a confident communicator who can run client-facing meetings and present data-driven recommendations with clarity and conviction
  • Is detail-oriented and process-driven, with a knack for building repeatable, scalable workflows
  • Enjoys working closely with a team and is eager to contribute to a growing department
  • Wants to build on a proven playbook and bring fresh ideas to a team that is still growing
  • Has a genuine interest in technology and is excited to deepen expertise in the Wheelhouse platform

Bonus points if you:

  • Have experience in European short-term rental or hospitality markets
  • Are bilingual in English and Spanish or another European language

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own revenue management for an assigned portfolio of Wheelhouse clients, acting as their dedicated RM point of contact
  • Run monthly strategy meetings and deliver weekly pacing reports with clear, actionable recommendations
  • Provide platform training, performance benchmarking, and market context to help clients understand and act on their data
  • Contribute to team SOPs and best practices as the Revenue Management function continues to grow and scale
  • Share practitioner insights that inform the Wheelhouse product roadmap and RM education efforts
  • Use AI to automate recurring work such as pacing reports, data pulls, and portfolio monitoring, and build simple internal tools that make the team more efficient

Your First 90 Days

You’ll begin by working directly with the Wheelhouse Onboarding team, learning the platform inside and out and observing how we train current users. You’ll use this time to build deep fluency in Wheelhouse’s tools and internal systems, while beginning to document your revenue management approach and early ideas for how you’ll manage your portfolio.

You will have the opportunity to put your skills into practice by supporting an existing Wheelhouse client under the guidance of the Head of Revenue Management. This hands-on experience will sharpen your platform expertise and help you hit the ground running with your own client portfolio.

Once you and Wheelhouse are confident in your platform proficiency, you will transition to owning your portfolio independently — running client meetings, delivering weekly reports, and contributing actively to the team’s evolving processes and playbooks.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity ($70,000 - $85,000 per year DOE)
  • Additional Benefits based on country of residence and availability

About Us:

Wheelhouse is a fintech platform for the $500B+ flex rental space. Most specifically, we enable short & mid-length stay providers with 1 to 100,000+ listings to earn 20%+ more from their rental properties.
In 2021, our target customer segment voted our platform “Innovation of the Year” at the Data & Revenue Management conference. This sentiment is shared by our customers, as evidenced by our platforms low churn and rapidly growing ARPU. In 2022, we closed a significant funding round, with participation from many of the best tech, travel & real estate investors. We’re lucky to have a long runway, low burn, and rapidly growing revenue.
As a team, we enjoy shipping products our customers love, on time or ahead of schedule, while balancing work/life & having fun together. We’re best described as transparent & collaborative, and we strive to set our teammates up for success - both professionally & personally. We’re a remote-first, work-anywhere, and “yes - you should make time for that adventure/vacation” company, who believes that “healthy hustle” is the key to good growth.
We’re experienced business & product builders who have founded multiple companies together, know our category extremely well, and recognize how rare/special it is to be perfectly positioned around a big opportunity with a very strong cross-functional team.
We’d be eager to say hello and learn more about you!

title: Director of Security
description:
About Us

At SimplePractice, we are improving access to quality care by equipping health and wellness clinicians with all the tools they need to thrive in private practice.

More than 250,000 providers trust SimplePractice to build their business through our industry-leading software with powerful tools that simplify every part of practice management. From admin work to clinical care, our suite of innovative solutions work together to reduce administrative burden—empowering solo and small group practitioners to thrive alongside their clients.

Award-winning and people-first, SimplePractice is shaping the future of health tech. In 2026, we were recognized by BuiltIn as a Best Remote Company to Work For, Software Guru's Best Places to Code, Becker Healthcare Telehealth Companies to Know, and we won a MedTech Breakthrough Award for Best Practice Management Solution Provider.


The Role

We're looking for a Director of Security to build and lead the team responsible for protecting SimplePractice's cloud infrastructure, corporate systems, and security operations. Reporting to the CISO, you'll own our security engineering strategy, have direct influence over our vendor and tooling budget, and own execution across cloud security, vulnerability management, incident response, detection engineering, identity security, and AI-driven automation.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who combines deep technical expertise with exceptional people skills. You'll build a team, establish their direction, and partner with leaders across the business to build practical security solutions that protect our customers without slowing down innovation.We're looking for someone who builds relationships as naturally as they solve technical problems, leads through influence rather than authority, and believes great security is a shared responsibility.


Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a high-performing security engineering team, initially hiring, mentoring, and developing two senior security engineers.
  • Define and own the strategy, priorities, and outcomes for security engineering, including cloud and infrastructure security, vulnerability management, security operations, and incident response.
  • Strengthen detection, monitoring, and response capabilities to improve our ability to identify and respond to security threats.
  • Partner with IT and Engineering to improve identity and access management, endpoint security, cloud security posture, and infrastructure security while supporting compliance requirements such as HIPAA and SOC 2.
  • Build trusted relationships across Engineering, Product, IT, Legal, Compliance, and other business functions, influencing security outcomes through collaboration and technical credibility.
  • Develop a risk-based security engineering roadmap that prioritizes meaningful improvements to customer trust, resilience, and security posture.
  • Drive AI-driven automation and engineering best practices that reduce manual effort, improve security effectiveness, and enable teams to operate securely at scale.
  • Establish clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and shared responsibility for security.
  • Manage the security tooling and vendor budget, ensuring cost efficiency, optimized vendor relationships, and high ROI on security investments.
  • Oversee incident response operational readiness, participating in and shaping on-call rotations to maintain rapid incident detection and mitigation capabilities.
  • Serve as a senior technical advisor to the CISO and business leaders, translating complex security challenges into clear, actionable recommendations, influencing technical strategy and organizational risk decisions.

Desired Skills and Experience

  • Extensive experience in security engineering, infrastructure security, or security operations, including leadership of technical teams and security programs.
  • Deep technical expertise in AWS security, vulnerability management, incident response, detection engineering, and modern security architecture.
  • Demonstrated success building, mentoring, and developing high-performing security engineering teams.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to build trust and influence stakeholders at all levels of an organization.
  • Experience collaborating across Engineering, IT, Product, and business teams to implement practical, scalable security solutions.
  • Strong technical judgment with the ability to balance security risks, business priorities, and engineering complexity.
  • Experience with cloud security platforms, endpoint protection, identity management, security monitoring, AI-driven automation tools, and compliance frameworks such as HIPAA and HITRUST.
  • A hands-on, collaborative leadership style with the ability to set strategic direction while remaining technically engaged.
  • A pragmatic, business-oriented approach to security that emphasizes partnership, accountability, and measurable risk reduction.

Benefits

We offer a competitive benefits program including:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life & disability insurance
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO), wellbeing days, paid holidays, and summer Fridays
  • Mental health resources
  • Paid parental leave & Backup Care
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

California Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Thank you for your interest in opportunities at SimplePractice LLC (“SimplePractice” or “us” or “we” or “our”). Please note that when you submit your resume or application materials to us for employment purposes, you are subject to the SimplePractice California Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

For more information about our privacy practices, please contact us at privacy@simplepractice.com.

Notice to Candidates

SimplePractice has been made aware of fraudulent job postings and unaffiliated third parties posing as our recruiting team. We do not have any affiliation or connection to these situations and only post open roles on our official Careers page () and reputable job boards like our official LinkedIn or Indeed pages.

All official SimplePractice recruitment emails will be sent from the domains @simplepractice.com, no-reply@greenhouse.io or no‑reply@linkedin.com email addresses.

Examples of fraudulent domains include careers-simplepractice.com, simplepractices.com, and simplepractice.careers.

Please note that SimplePractice will never ask candidates or new hires for money or payment of any kind at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process.

Base salary is one component of total compensation. Employees may also be eligible for an annual bonus or commission. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay.

The amount below represents the expected annual base compensation range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we’ll consider many factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors.

Base Compensation Range
$214,651—$268,314 USD

title: Senior Managing Consultant

title: Chief Data Officer
description:
About ESTO

Founded in 2017, we are a fast-growing fintech company on a mission to make shopping and financial decisions effortless. By combining smart technology with customer-first thinking, we enable people to pay flexibly and businesses to grow faster.

As a team, we value ambition, ownership, and constant improvement. We move fast, think big, and build solutions that make a real impact on everyday lives.

About the role:

ESTO runs on data. Credit scoring, fraud detection, pricing, treasury, regulatory reporting and every product decision go through the data platform. The Chief Data Officer owns that platform end to end, sits on the leadership team and reports to the CEO.

This is a builder's executive role. You inherit a modern lakehouse stack and a team who run operations without hand-holding, and you take ESTO from a well-run data function to a company where models and AI agents make and improve decisions in real time. Not a CDO who manages from slides: you design architecture, review model code and ship with the team.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the data platform: architecture, cost and roadmap of a modern AWS lakehouse stack (Databricks, dbt, Prefect)

  • Run machine learning in production: credit, fraud and pricing models in the live decision path, from feature platform to real-time serving, together with the Chief Credit Officer

  • Make the data layer agent-ready: semantic layer, governed access, LLM-driven analytics and internal AI tools for every team

  • Own model governance and regulatory data feeds, automated, audited and right first time

  • Deliver the finance data: automated treasury feeds and the numbers behind investor and lender reporting

  • Lead Data Engineering, Analytics and Data Science: set priorities, clear blockers, be the single point of contact for the rest of the company

  • Be accountable for results: lower credit losses, higher approval rates, faster reporting, cheaper infrastructure

What We Expect:

  • 7+ years in data and machine learning, including several years leading a data or ML function in lending, payments, banking or another regulated, decision-heavy business

  • Hands-on today: production SQL and Python, PR reviews, pipeline debugging and model performance from the confusion matrix up

  • ML models shipped to production that moved a business metric, ideally credit risk or fraud

  • Deep experience with a modern cloud data stack (AWS, Databricks or equivalent, dbt, orchestration, near-real-time pipelines)

  • Daily user of AI tools (Claude, Cursor or similar) with a clear view of where they help and where they fail

  • Comfortable owning model governance in a regulated environment and defending it to auditors and regulators

  • Direct, clear written English; you set priorities and say no with reasons

Show us what you've shipped

Tell us about one model or data system you put in production and what it changed for the business. A link beats a long CV.

Why You'll Love Working Here

• 28 days annual leave + public holidays + your birthday off, always
• Hybrid work with flexible hours
• Paid sick leave + 3 wellbeing days
• Modern, pet-friendly office in the heart of Tallinn
• Fully stocked kitchen: snacks, fruit & drinks
• Monthly Stebby allowance for sports & wellness
• Collaborative, multicultural team
• Regular events & offsites
• Room to bring ideas and make real impact

🌍 Equal Opportunity Employer
We value diversity and inclusion, and we're committed to a workplace where everyone feels welcome, has equal opportunities, and is treated fairly.

title: Mid-Level Auto Painter (2nd Shift) $4000 Bonus
description:
We’re looking for Auto Painters with a minimum of 3 years of professional automotive painting experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.
As a Mid-Level Painter, you’ll be expected to match/mix paint color and use water-based paint to paint the vehicle inside our paint booths.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

  • 100% company-paid healthcare premiums
  • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!
  • ASE and tool reimbursement programs
  • Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of paint roles available, depending on your experience - look below to see other roles available to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

  • Paint Prepper (min 6 months professional experience): prepare vehicles for cosmetic paintwork, including sanding, masking, taping, bagging, unbagging/tear down, and buffing
  • Entry-Level Painter (min 1 year professional experience): prime vehicles and perform final sanding before the vehicle is painted, along with buffing, touch-up, paint mixing, and airbrush.
  • Mid-Level Painter (min 3 years professional experience): match/mix paint color and use water-based paint to paint the vehicle inside our paint booths
  • Experienced Painter (min 5 years professional experience): painting (base coats, tri-coats, solid, metallic, and clear coats), blending adjacent panels, and paint correcting vehicles.

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles
  • Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

title: Chief Engineer
description:

Structural aspects of the hotel as well as the maintenance of grounds and external facilities all fall within the span of responsibility.

Summary of Responsibilities:

Responsibilities and essential job functions include but are not limited to the following:

  • Provide advice to senior management on all aspects of engineering support, environmental controls and the operational efficiency of the property.

  • Ensure the effective financial management of the engineering department by setting maintenance budgets, capital works programs and engineering plans and ensuring that performance against these are regularly monitored and reviewed. Responsible for the general cost control aspects of maintenance, the preparation of departmental cost budgets and their implementation and submission to management.

  • Control of Capital Project Planning, in liaison with management, to ensure capital funding is effectively allocated and budgeted in accordance with company directives and philosophy.

  • Plan, implement and administer an energy management program by establishing energy reduction objectives, the maintenance of records and regular reporting of performance against these objectives.

  • Ensure the colleagues awareness of energy management within the property by conducting regular education and training programs on energy conservation and matters related to efficient operation of equipment in a cost-effective fashion.

  • Contribute to the hotel’s profitability by ensuring the effective management of the buildings environmental controls and energy conservation systems. Evaluate, control and record energy usage and implement and upgrade energy conservation systems.

  • Contribute to guest satisfaction standards by ensuring that technical support services quickly address, and where possible, anticipate, individual needs. Ensure the safety and comfort of guests, and that any requests for service are handled in a courteous and efficient fashion.

  • Ensure adherence to all statutory regulations and fire codes by regularly reviewing policies and safety procedures. Ensure that any tests and inspections required on plant by statutory authorities are carried out as and when required and that all records and documentation associated with such tests and surveys are correctly kept and/or displayed. Ensure that the hotel fulfills all compliance requirements.

  • Ensure technically competent engineering colleagues by selecting, training and developing a motivated, well-qualified maintenance team. Carry out regular work sampling studies within the department and evaluate the performance and productivity of personnel.

  • Maintain the condition of the physical assets of the hotel by carrying out any upgrading and project work in liaison with architects, interior designers and management.

  • Ensure the effective operation of all the mechanical and electrical systems and equipment by implementing and managing a preventative maintenance program. Closely monitor the condition of the physical property and equipment by conducting continual inspections of the building. Ensure that preventative maintenance schedules are in operation and regularly upgraded.

  • Contribute to a high standard of quality control within the hotel.

  • Closely supervise outside contractors to ensure the cost effectiveness and the technical efficiency of all services performed. Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with contracts, leases, service agreements and warranties.

  • Ensure the quality of all work completed by both employees and external contracted colleagues adheres to the standards of good engineering practice.

  • Contribute to the effectiveness of management decision making by representing the engineering department at all executive and colleagues meetings and by ensuring regular liaison with heads of other departments.

  • Experience managing large and complex hotel assets, ideally within premium properties
  • Strong technical knowledge across HVAC, electrical, plumbing, BMS and fire/life safety systems
  • Demonstrated experience leading CAPEX projects,
  • Strong understanding of WHS legislation, statutory compliance and building regulations

title: Trafficking in Persons (TIP) Senior Expert and Risk Assessment Team Leader
description:
Sheladia Associates, Inc. is seeking experienced professionals to join its proposed team for an MCC-funded roads assignment in Zambia. The TIP Senior Expert and Risk Assessment Team Leader will lead the project-specific Trafficking in Persons risk assessment and coordinate the development of mitigation recommendations.

  • Coordinate with the environmental and social team, Client, and relevant stakeholders.

  • Bachelor’s degree in social science or another relevant discipline.

  • At least 10 years of post-qualification experience in human rights and law, social and political analysis, and/or community development.

  • At least 5 years of experience addressing or monitoring Counter-Trafficking in Persons (C-TIP).

  • At least 5 years of applied experience in qualitative data collection, human subjects research, and community consultations.

  • At least three analytical report writing samples, including two that analyze primary data collected by the candidate.

This is a proposal-stage opportunity, subject to contract award and Client approval. The role will require fieldwork and stakeholder engagement in Zambia. Experience with TIP risk assessment in Zambia, particularly Northwestern and/or Copperbelt Province, is preferred.

title: Winkelstage regio Kempen
description:

Wie ben jij?
  • Je volgt een relevante opleiding (bijv. Retail, Handel, Verkoop,...) verbonden aan een school instantie en zoekt een stageplek voor minstens 4 weken.
  • Je bent minstens 16 jaar.
  • Je bent een echte teamspeler met een flinke dosis enthousiasme en bent een doener die energie krijgt van concrete actie.
  • Je bent leergierig, klantgericht en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.
Wat bieden wij jou?
  • Echte praktijkervaring: een gevarieerde stage waarin je alle kneepjes van het retailvak leert kennen.
  • Topwerksfeer: een warme, open en collegiale werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich thuis voelt en gelijk is.

We zijn ervan overtuigd dat diversiteit onze organisatie sterker maakt en verwelkomen iedereen. Ongeacht leeftijd, afkomst, genderidentiteit, geaardheid, geloof, of handicap. Gelijke kansen en eerlijke beloning staan bij ons centraal.

title: Field Service Foreman
description:
Clean Harbors in Omaha, NE is seeking a Field Service Foreperson to join our safety conscious team. This position will be responsible for the direct supervision of the Field Technicians. Forepersons and Technicians will be responsible for the performance of tasks associated with emergency response (emergency spill cleanup), hazardous waste clean-up, site-remediation (tank and pit cleaning), equipment decontamination and handling of hazardous materials.

Qualifications:
  • Need a minimum of 3 years in Environmental Services and at least 1 year leading a crew.
  • Driver's License required.
  • Heavy equipment experience a plus.
  • Average an 8-10+ hour day. Overtime after 40 hrs.
  • Must be available for emergency response/project work that could take you out of town up to 2 weeks at a time, hotel and per diem provided.
  • On call responsibilities.

Please note: New hires are required to attend our Academy training out of state. The company covers all required travel and training-related expenses, and you will be paid for your time during training.
Clean Harbors is the leading provider of environmental, energy and industrial services throughout the United States, Canada, Mexico and Puerto Rico. Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. We are solving tough problems through innovation and proven methodology – come be part of the solution with us.

Why work for Clean Harbors?:
  • Health and Safety is our #1 priority and we live it 3-6-5.
  • Focus on maintaining sustainability and cleaning the Earth.
  • Pay range $26-28+ per hour.
  • Comprehensive health benefits coverage after 30 days of full-time employment including 401K with Company match.
  • Own part of the company with our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
  • Opportunities for growth and development for all the stages of your career.
  • Company paid training and tuition reimbursement.

Key Requirements:
  • Ensure Health and Safety is the number one goal by following policies, processes, and always acting in a safe manner.
  • Train and mentor the Field Service Technicians.
  • Execution of projects/jobs within budget and on time.
  • Enforce and ensure OSHA, EPA and H&S standards or regulations are compliant.
  • Understand and work with the Coordinator in the communication of manpower, equipment and resources required to complete field service and emergency response projects.
  • Manage large scale field service and emergency response projects when directed.
  • Engage in strenuous physical labor including lifting and pulling heavy objects.
  • Operate light and heavy equipment, handles various hand tools and powered industrial tools, works with vibration-producing tools.
  • Wear and properly use a variety of personal protective Equipment (PPE). Including respirators, skin, face, hand and foot protection in a multiple number of combinations.
  • Work in various temperatures indoors and outdoors in all weather conditions.
  • Work in atmospheres and locations with the potential for exposure to various chemical and physical agents, some of which may be hazardous, toxic, or corrosive.
  • Work in potentially elevated noise levels, confined spaces, including lifting in areas of low clearance.
  • Work at elevations including working from ladders and scaffolding.
  • Assist in field sampling activities and calibration of meters.
  • Climb ladders, scaffolding and into and out of trucks, tanks, and various other containers.
  • Work extended (> 8 hrs.) time periods.
  • Attend all compliance and safety update meetings.
  • Inspect drums for container integrity and regulatory compliance.
  • Safe loading and unloading of hazardous and non-hazardous waste.
  • Conduct waste stream sampling and profiling as necessary.
  • Complete associated paperwork, such as worksheets, vehicle inspections, equipment inspections and permits.
  • Follow all local, state (provincial) and federal compliance regulations and rules.
  • Safely operate vehicles in accordance with U.S. DOT, local, state (provincial) and federal requirements.
  • Safely observe all corporate operating guidelines and procedures.
  • Observe all company environmental health and safety operating guidelines.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • By position, ability to be on call for emergency response on rotating basis every other week.
  • By position, site-remediation, equipment decontamination, and the handling of hazardous materials.
  • By position, may perform lead responsibilities.

Required Qualifications:
  • Previous experience in a physically intensive role.
  • Previous experience in a supervisory, crew lead or leadership role.
  • Ability to travel for extended periods of time, overnight.
  • Ability to be on-call for emergency response.
  • Valid Driver’s license.
  • Perform physical functions per job requirements.
  • Successfully complete a background check, drug test, and physical, by position.
  • Per OSHA's Respiratory Protection standard, 29 CFR 1910.34, employees in positions requiring respirators are required to meet facial hair standards.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Previous heavy equipment experience (bobcats, excavators, etc.).
  • Previous environmental and/or industrial experience (i.e. site remediation, spill response, hydro blasting, vacuum truck, tank cleaning, refinery-based work).
  • Commercial driver license.

title: IGP_Senior Specialist Product Management_IGBT_HV_SiC
description:

· Work on meaningful projects from day one while receiving mentoring, professional guidance and tailored development opportunities.

· Return to China with the target of continuing your career in Product Management.



Your role

  • Join Infineon’s International Graduate Program (IGP) in Shenzhen and start your career in Product Management for high-power semiconductors. You will work with a portfolio of discrete IGBTs and high-voltage SiC discretes, gaining hands-on experience in the daily commercial and operational management of semiconductor products and their business in China.

    The program combines assignments in China with an international assignment in Europe. After completing the IGP, the target position is in Product Management in China.

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Support the day-to-day management of a discrete IGBT and high-voltage SiC product portfolio, working closely with experienced Product Managers.

  • Coordinate product availability and supply topics with Sales, Operations, Supply Chain and manufacturing teams, and support prioritization and allocation decisions when required.

  • Maintain and analyze product, customer and business data such as forecasts, orders, revenue, pricing, inventory, design wins and product demand.

  • Support pricing and quotation activities, including preparation of pricing information and coordination with regional Sales and global business teams.

  • Act as a product interface for the China organization and help Sales, FAEs and customers resolve commercial and product-related questions.

  • Support new product introductions and customer ramp-ups, coordinating samples, qualification status, product documentation and readiness across the relevant functions.

  • Monitor the competitive situation for discrete IGBTs and high-voltage SiC and prepare concise product and business analyses for the team.

  • Take ownership of selected Product Management projects and continuously improve tools, processes and transparency for managing the portfolio.


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


  • A recent Master’s graduate in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Semiconductor Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Engineering or a related field.

  • First practical experience through internships, university projects or working-student roles in semiconductors, power electronics, operations, sales/marketing or product-related functions is an advantage.

  • Interest in power semiconductors and the commercial and operational side of Product Management; knowledge of IGBT or SiC technology is a plus, not a prerequisite.

  • Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data, combined with a structured and pragmatic working style.

  • Good communication and coordination skills and the motivation to work with cross-functional and international teams.

  • Fluent Mandarin and strong written and spoken English.

  • Willingness to spend part of the IGP on an international assignment in Europe and then continue in the target position in China.

title: Coordinator, Legal
description:
The Opportunity

The Hyatt legal team is seeking a highly organized, tech-forward, and growth-oriented Coordinator to support multiple attorneys and legal professionals across a wide range of subject matters and hotel brands. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important\: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care for Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include\:

· Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally

· Flexible work schedule

· Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center

· A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption

· Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role


This is role is an opportunity involving both tasks to support attorneys with administrative tasks and tasks similar to a paralegal. While this is more than an administrative assistant role, prior paralegal experience is a plus but not required. It is an opportunity to become an integral part of a fast-moving, collaborative legal team that supports Hyatt’s global hospitality business. You will help keep our team organized, efficient, and connected — while also identifying smarter, more streamlined ways of working.

If you are energized by variety, enjoy learning new systems, love bringing order to complexity, and want a role that evolves with you, this is a unique opportunity to grow your career within an in-house legal environment.

Responsibilities include\:

  • Supporting attorneys on legal matters involving marketing, intellectual property, privacy, cyber, IT, hotel distribution and hotel operations matters
  • Interacting with clients to coordinate matters, assess issues and advance legal work
  • Conducting research, gathering facts, and synthesizing information
  • Working with outside counsel and colleagues across all levels of the legal team
  • Providing project management support, including leading process improvements
  • Managing complex calendars across multiple time zones; scheduling meetings with internal stakeholders and external partners
  • Coordinating virtual and in-person meetings, including preparing agendas, organizing materials, and capturing meeting notes
  • Supporting document organization, formatting, proofreading, and version control
  • Coordinating billing and other matters with outside law firms
  • Assisting with preparation and routing of contracts, correspondence, and internal documentation
  • Maintaining organized digital filing systems and shared team resources
  • Supporting legal operations initiatives, including tracking projects and deadlines
  • Utilizing tools such as Microsoft Office, collaboration platforms, and workflow tools to improve efficiency
  • Identifying opportunities for automation and process improvement to help the team work smarter
  • Assisting with expense reporting, invoice processing, and other operational tasks
  • Serving as a proactive partner to attorneys – anticipating needs, following up on action items, and ensuring smooth day-to-day operations

· This role requires exceptional organization, discretion, professionalism, and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities with confidence and calm.

What Makes This Role Unique

· An opportunity to provide both administrative support like an administrative assistant and handle substantive legal work like a paralegal with the opportunity for growth

  • Exposure to a wide variety of legal matters across hospitality operations and multiple hotel brands
  • Direct support of multiple attorneys, offering insight into diverse subject areas and business functions
  • Opportunity to influence team organization, workflows, and process improvements
  • A role that can evolve — with room to expand responsibilities based on strengths and interests
  • A culture that values curiosity, ownership, innovation, and continuous learning
  • A chance to bring positive energy and momentum to a highly collaborative legal team

Who You Are

  • An engaged, energetic, and enthusiastic professional who brings positive momentum to the team
  • A tech-savvy self-starter who genuinely enjoys learning and using new tools and platforms
  • Strong ability to use a variety of programs (e.g., productivity tools, collaboration platforms, content tools, Microsoft programs) to create or improve upon content and organize team resources
  • Exceptionally organized, with a sharp eye for detail and the ability to juggle multiple priorities smoothly
  • A true team player who collaborates easily and supports others proactively
  • Interested in automation and process improvement — you naturally look for smarter ways of working
  • Comfortable handling core administrative functions including scheduling, coordinating meetings, and creating agendas and meeting notes
  • Professional and discreet when handling sensitive information
  • Open-minded and growth-oriented, viewing this role as evolving and full of opportunity

title: Elektronik (k/m)
description:
Jesteśmy rodzinnym przedsiębiorstwem zatrudniającym około 19 000 pracowników w 71 lokalizacjach na całym świecie. Każdego dnia pracujemy nad nowymi technologiami i rozwiązaniami, które napędzają rozwój przemysłu high-tech. Poszukujemy osób myślących przyszłościowo, z niekonwencjonalnymi pomysłami i zapałem do działania. Wzajemne zaufanie i współdziałanie to dla nas kluczowe wartości, które są podstawą do przekraczania granic, wprowadzania innowacji i budowania rzeczy dotąd niewyobrażalnych. Niezależnie czy chodzi o lasery, maszyny, technologię EUV czy elektronikę – nasze technologie oferują nieograniczone możliwości. Chcesz mieć swój udział w przemyśle przyszłości? Czekamy na Twój talent!


Twój zakres obowiązków:

  • Projektowanie, a następnie wdrożenie dedykowanej elektroniki do nowej generacji projektowanych urządzeń między innymi RF, DC;

  • Opracowywanie rozwiązań układowych przeznaczonych do nowej generacji projektowanych urządzeń RF, DC;

  • Rysowanie schematów układów elektronicznych używanych w naszych urządzeniach;

  • Projektowanie wielowarstwowych obwodów drukowanych – zapewniamy szkolenie wstępne z używanych programów (Orcad 17.4 – 23.1);

  • Przeprowadzanie symulacji signal & power integrity zaprojektowanych układów i PCB;

  • Uruchamianie i testowanie zaprojektowanych urządzeń (do dyspozycji między innymi dedykowane laboratorium elektroniki);

  • Przygotowywanie dokumentacji technicznej opracowanych projektów;

  • Aktywny udział w planowaniu projektów (podejście SCRUM).


Nasze wymagania:

  • Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne (preferowane elektroniczne lub elektryczne);

  • Znajomość języka angielskiego pozwalająca na korzystanie ze specjalistycznej literatury oraz na swobodne komunikowanie się w ramach międzynarodowych projektów;

  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu obwodów drukowanych;

  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu układów zasilania typu DC/DC;

  • Praktyczna znajomość elektroniki analogowej oraz cyfrowej (szybkie przetworniki ADC, filtrowanie i kondycjonowanie sygnałów, układy FPGA, procesory DSP);

  • Umiejętność projektowania elektroniki z uwzględnieniem zagadnień związanych z kompatybilnością elektromagnetyczną (EMC);

  • Umiejętność obsługi sprzętu pomiarowego.

Oferujemy:

  • Dedykowane laboratorium elektroniki;

  • Dużą samodzielność, możliwość inicjowania i wdrażania własnych rozwiązań;

  • Możliwość zdobycia doświadczenia w pracy z nowoczesnymi technologiami we współpracy z doświadczonymi inżynierami;

  • Dostęp do szkoleń;

  • Współpracę ze światowymi liderami przemysłu półprzewodnikowego;

  • Pakiet benefitów: opieka medyczna, karta sportowa, ubezpieczenie na życie.



Drodzy Kandydaci, informujemy, że z uwagi na szczególną dbałość o przeciwdziałanie i zapobieganie naruszeniom prawa w Spółce TRUMPF HUETTINGER, jak również ze względu na kształtowanie bezpiecznego i przyjaznego środowiska pracy w Spółce, przyjęta została Procedura przyjmowania zgłoszeń wewnętrznych i podejmowania działań następczych w TRUMPF HUETTINGER Sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Zielonce. title: Data Engineer
description:
Shoptet je jedna z nejrychleji rostoucích technologických společností v regionu. Pomáháme firmám i jednotlivcům snadno začít a rozvíjet jejich podnikání online. Nabízíme nekonečné možnosti pro e-shopy – od pronájmu, přes platební služby až po propojování s profesionály z oboru.


Hledáme Data Engineera, který se postará o to, aby data v Shoptetu byla spolehlivá, dostupná a bezpečná. Budeš stavět a provozovat datovou platformu, na které stojí reporty, analýzy i rozhodování napříč firmou. Od financí přes produkt a marketing až po obchod a zákaznickou podporu. Navrhuješ architekturu, hlídáš kvalitu a bezpečnost a průběžně ladíš výkon i náklady. Chceme, abys přinášel vlastní nápady, jak to dělat líp. Denní součástí tvé práce bude využití AI nástrojů a rozvoj datové platformy tak, aby byla pro AI nástroje vhodná.


Na čem budeš pracovat?

  • Datové pipeliny. Navrhuješ, vyvíjíš a udržuješ ETL/ELT, které sbírají data z interních i externích zdrojů a posílají je dál do navazujících systémů.

  • Datová platforma. Spravuješ a rozvíjíš technický stack: datový sklad (primárně Snowflake), orchestraci a integrační nástroje (Keboola, dbt), BI vrstvu (Metabase, Power BI)

  • Transformace a datové modely. Připravuješ data v SQL a podílíš se na návrhu datových modelů a architektury skladu včetně dokumentace a data lineage.

  • Výkon a náklady. Zrychluješ transformace, zavádíš inkrementální načítání a správně dimenzuješ zdroje, aby platforma byla rychlá a zároveň levná. Odhaluješ adepty na smazání.

  • Kvalita a provoz. Hlídáš běh pipeline, řešíš chyby a incidenty a stavíš validace, testy a alerting, aby problémy odhalilo monitorování a ne náhodný kolemjdoucí.

  • AI platforma. Buduješ datovou platformu jako základ pro konverzační AI analytiku (sémantická vrstva, jednotné metriky, kvalitní metadata). Připravuješ platformu na agentický vývoj, aby AI agenti mohli bezpečně pracovat s pipeline, transformacemi a dokumentací.

  • Zabezpečení dat. Spravuješ přístupová oprávnění a přihlašovací údaje, dbáš na ochranu citlivých dat a na auditovatelnost datových toků.

  • BI. Vytváříš a udržuješ reporty a dashboardy v BI nástrojích a staráš se o jejich napojení na datovou platformu.


S kým budeš spolupracovat?

Budeš součástí datového týmu a přímo se budeš hlásit Data Team Leadovi. Denně budeš spolupracovat s Data Analysty. Společně definujete, jaká data jsou potřeba, a zajišťujete, aby byla dostupná.
Mimo tým se budeš potkávat s kolegy ze všech oddělení. Výsledky své práce budeš umět vysvětlit technickým i netechnickým kolegům.

Jak poznáme, že se ti daří?

  • Kolegové s daty rádi pracují a spoléhají se na ně.

  • Platforma je rychlá a její provoz nestojí zbytečně moc.

  • Dodržujeme bezpečnostní a compliance standardy a nemáme žádné incidenty.

  • Tvoje práce pomáhá zlepšovat procesy a rozhodování ve firmě.

  • Data i reporty jsou přesné a dodané včas.


Koho hledáme?

Nemusíš splňovat všechno, co je v seznamu, ale ideálně:

  • Máš praxi na pozici Data Engineer nebo v podobné technické datové roli.

  • Pokročile ovládáš SQL a umíš optimalizovat dotazy i celé pipeliny.

  • Máš zkušenost s budováním a provozem datových pipeline a s většími objemy dat.

  • Pracoval/a jsi s ETL/ELT a orchestračními nástroji (třeba Keboola), s cloudovým datovým skladem (třeba Snowflake) a s nějakým BI nástrojem.

  • Rozumíš datovému modelování a principům práce s datovým skladem.

  • Umíš integrovat přes API a nebojíš se různých datových formátů.

  • Používáš Git.

title: Computer Science Curriculum Intern
description:
As a Computer Science Curriculum Intern you will play a key role in developing and refining educational materials that will inspire and train the next generation of great problem solvers. At the Intern level, you will build your skills as an educational content developer while contributing to a variety of curriculum projects.

The Computer Science Curriculum Intern will:

  • Develop new educational materials with input from more senior team members
  • Incorporate feedback from team members and other stakeholders into their materials
  • Make content corrections to existing materials based on student and teacher feedback
  • Build their understanding of and experience with the students within their target audience as well as the people who will deliver their content. This may include grading, assisting, teaching, or team-teaching courses, if relevant

The ideal candidate has:

  • Experience teaching or tutoring computer science preferred, ideally including experience with K-12 students
  • Strong computer science content knowledge
  • Strong writing skills, with the ability to translate complex CS concepts into clear, engaging, and understandable content
  • Strong creativity, with the ability to develop original problems, activities, and/or puzzles
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Readily seeks out and learns from feedback
  • Passion for education

Why Join AoPS:

This is a 40-hour per week paid internship with a pay rate of $30/hour. The internship will take place in summer 2027 and will be based at our headquarters in San Diego, CA. Most of our interns are with us for 10 - 12 weeks, starting in late May or early June. Here are some things you can look forward to:

  • Impact: Help develop educational materials that will be used by some of the brightest young minds in the country, including future Informatics and AI Olympiad champions
  • Flexibility: Casual work environment with a hybrid work week and flexible scheduling
  • Future Planning: 401K with company match
  • Quality of Life: Paid Sick Leave
  • Ease of Transition: Relocation bonus (if currently located outside of San Diego)

Background Check:

Please note that employment is contingent on the successful completion of a background check.

Work Authorization:

Please note that in order to be considered for this position you must be legally authorized to work in the US. We are unable to offer sponsorship, including STEM-OPT and H-1B.

About AoPS:

Art of Problem Solving (AoPS) is on a mission to discover, inspire, and train the great problem solvers of the next generation. Since 2003, we have trained hundreds of thousands of the country’s top students, including nearly all the members of the US International Math Olympiad team, through our online school, in-person academies, textbooks, and online learning systems. While our primary focus has been math for most of our history, through the years we have expanded our unique problem solving curriculum into more subjects, such as language arts, science, and computer science.

title: Bedside PA/NP (FTE or PT)
description:
At Equum Medical, while our primary offering is innovative telehealth solutions, we recognize the critical value of bedside care. We continue to support healthcare settings where in-person, hands-on care is essential, and we are looking for a strong provider who understands the importance of direct patient care.

Our telehealth platform enables healthcare professionals to deliver exceptional care remotely, bridging access gaps and enhancing patient outcomes. By joining our team, you'll have the unique opportunity to shape the future of acute care and telehealth while also having a tangible impact on patient's lives through bedside care. We offer flexible scheduling to promote work-life balance and long-term career sustainability. Together, we can redefine healthcare, providing seamless, high-quality care wherever it's needed most.

Position Summary:

Under the direction of the CMO, the Advanced Practice Provider will work within a passionate team in the Northern NJ area caring for acute critical care patients.


Requirements:

  • Flexibility to cover both day and night 12-hour shifts, 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM and 7:00 PM to 7:00 AM.
  • Previous critical care or acute care experience, along with proficiency in procedures such as venous access and airway management, is strongly preferred.
  • Position is based in a hospital or healthcare setting with typical risks or discomforts, requiring adherence to standard safety protocols.

Key Responsibilities:

Direct Patient Care:

  • Provide bedside care for critically ill patients in the intensive care unit (ICU), emergency department, and other acute care settings.
  • Assess, diagnose, and manage complex medical conditions, including respiratory failure, sepsis, and multi-organ dysfunction.
  • Initiate and manage life-saving interventions, including ventilator support, vasopressor therapy, and dialysis.
  • Perform procedures such as central line insertions, arterial line placements, endotracheal intubation, and chest tube insertions as needed.
  • Hands-on experience with central line placement and endotracheal intubation in acute or critical care settings.

Collaborative Care:

  • Work closely with multidisciplinary healthcare teams, including nurses, respiratory therapists, pharmacists, and specialists, to ensure optimal patient outcomes.
  • Communicate effectively with family members, provide updates on patient status and prognosis, and address concerns and expectations.

Clinical Decision-Making:

  • Make real-time decisions regarding critical care interventions, treatment adjustments, and monitoring protocols based on patient response and evolving clinical conditions.
  • Interpret diagnostic tests (e.g., labs, imaging studies) and integrate findings into treatment plans.

Patient and Family Education:

  • Provide education to patients and their families about critical illness, treatment options, and recovery expectations.
  • Foster an empathetic and supportive environment, especially when discussing end-of-life decisions and advanced directives.

Documentation and Compliance:

  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of patient assessments, progress notes, treatment plans, and medical interventions in the hospital’s electronic health record (EHR) system.
  • Ensure compliance with hospital policies, clinical guidelines, and accreditation standards.

Quality Improvement and Safety:

  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives to enhance patient care and safety in the critical care unit.
  • Contribute to hospital protocols, best practices, and evidence-based care guidelines.
  • Identify and report safety concerns and participate in root cause analyses and action plans when needed.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree
  • NJ Licensure
  • Certified Physician Assistant (PA) or board-certified Acute Care Nurse Practitioner (AG-ACNP)

In addition to a base salary, this position is eligible 401k, and benefits (subject to eligibility requirements). Total compensation is based on several factors, including type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable for all full-time positions.

title: Winkelstage regio Antwerpen
description:
Wat ga je leren en doen tijdens je stage?

Als stagiair(e) krijg je een heldere inkijk in én ervaring met alle facetten van het winkelgebeuren:

  • Winkeloperatie & variatie: je ontdekt de dynamiek van de winkel — van het beheren van de groente- en fruitafdeling tot het vers afbakken van de lekkerste croissants in onze bakkerij.
  • Klantenservice & kassa: je helpt onze klanten met een glimlach verder, kijkt mee aan de kassa en zorgt voor een aangename winkelervaring.
  • Voorraad & beheer: je leert hoe de goederenstroom werkt, hoe we de versheid garanderenen hoe de winkel er altijd strak en uitnodigend bij ligt.
  • Teamwork & begeleiding: je werkt nauw samen met ervaren collega’s, Assistant Store Managers en de Store Manager. Je ziet van dichtbij hoe #teamlidl op de winkelvloer wordt aangestuurd.
Wie ben jij?
  • Je volgt een relevante opleiding (bijv. Retail, Handel, Verkoop,...) verbonden aan een school instantie en zoekt een stageplek voor minstens 4 weken.
  • Je bent minstens 16 jaar.
  • Je bent een echte teamspeler met een flinke dosis enthousiasme en bent een doener die energie krijgt van concrete actie.
  • Je bent leergierig, klantgericht en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.
Wat bieden wij jou?
  • Echte praktijkervaring: een gevarieerde stage waarin je alle kneepjes van het retailvak leert kennen.
  • Topwerksfeer: een warme, open en collegiale werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich thuis voelt en gelijk is.
  • Persoonlijke groei: volop ruimte om te ontdekken wat je in je mars hebt. We moeten allemaal ergens beginnen, toch?
  • Toekomstperspectief: klikt het langs beide kanten? Dan bekijken we graag de mogelijkheden voor een studentenjob of een vaste job na je afstuderen. Lidl biedt je alle kansen!

We zijn ervan overtuigd dat diversiteit onze organisatie sterker maakt en verwelkomen iedereen. Ongeacht leeftijd, afkomst, genderidentiteit, geaardheid, geloof, of handicap. Gelijke kansen en eerlijke beloning staan bij ons centraal.
