The individual works across Product, Customer Care, Automation, Technology and GHX India

Responsibilities

IPA and GFax Support & Team Upskilling:

  • Provide day-to-day support on IPA and GFax cases, issues and questions raised by Customer Care teams.
  • Work with product teams to understand releases, changes and fixes, and upskill self first and then the wider team

Process Gap Identification & Improvement:

  • Review how work is handled to find process gaps, repeat issues and avoidable effort, and map current state and future state processes.
  • Run root cause analysis (5 Whys, Fishbone, Pareto), define corrective and preventive actions, and track whether they worked.
  • Give leaders clear training and enhancement inputs covering the gap, the impact and a suggested fix.
  • Check processes against compliance and data privacy requirements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Resolution:

  • Work closely with product teams, other departments and CX functions to support customers and reach resolutions, acting as the link between Customer Care, Product, Automation and Technology.
  • Raise enhancement requests and customer issue trends with Product or IT, and follow up until closed.
  • Keep Customer Care teams updated on known issues, workarounds and status.

AI & Workflow Automation:

  • Use Claude, Slack AI, Agentforce and Microsoft Power Apps to find manual or repetitive work and automate workflows as and when needed.
  • Own the process side of tool changes, such as Salesforce macros, templates and automation rules, and evaluate tools to recommend the best option.
  • Check that each automation saves time or improves quality, and improve it based on use.

Automation Team Collaboration & Change Delivery:

  • Work with the Automation team and give inputs on relevant automation projects, including use cases, requirements, exceptions and acceptance criteria, in a BRD or FRD where needed.
  • Plan and run UAT, and assess the risks, dependencies and business impact of changes.
  • Create plans, timelines and milestones, run rollout communication, give regular status updates and track results after go live.

QA Audits, Process Audits & PKTs:

  • Work closely with the current BA team on QA audits and process audits, review audit rubrics and calibrate with team leaders and supervisors.
  • Create and implement PKTs (Process Knowledge Tests) to check how well the team understands key processes.
  • Use audit and PKT results to find training needs, and track coaching actions to closure.

SME Support & Training:

  • Provide active and regular SME assistance to CSAs and other Business Analysts on process, product and case questions.
  • Run onboarding and refresher training for new joiners and existing teams.
  • Maintain SOPs, process flows, and knowledge base articles so guidance stays current.

Data, Reporting & Stakeholder Communication:

  • Build and maintain KPI and quality dashboards in Power BI or Excel, set KPI baselines and targets, and track trends month to month.
  • Analyze cost per case, productivity, capacity and customer feedback (CSAT) trends to support business cases and decisions.
  • Prepare leadership updates and executive presentations with clear recommendations, and run workshops and requirement sessions with stakeholders.

Customer Escalations:

  • Handle customer escalations day to day, from first review to resolution, working with the right internal teams and keeping the customer and stakeholders updated.
  • Record the cause and learning from each escalation so it can be prevented in future.

Technical & Analytical Skills:

  • Hands on experience with Salesforce, including case management, reports and Knowledge.
  • Working knowledge of IPA and RPA solutions and the support processes around them, including GFax.
  • Practical use of AI tools (Claude, Slack AI, Agentforce) and Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate to automate workflows.
  • Proficiency in Excel, SQL or Power BI to extract, analyze and report on data.

Core Business Analyst Competencies:

  • Proven experience as a business analyst or in a similar analytical role.
  • Process mapping, gap analysis and root cause analysis, with clear documentation such as BRDs, process flows and SOPs.
  • Experience with QA audits, process audits and PKTs, and with UAT and change rollout.
  • Strong problem solving and stakeholder management, with the ability to adapt to changing priorities.

Communication, Training & Escalation Skills:

  • Strong verbal and written communication, able to present findings and recommendations to teams and leaders.
  • Ability to coach CSAs and peers, and to handle customer escalations calmly with a focus on resolution.

Core Behaviors:

  • Organized and detail-focused, proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to keep learning new tools, adapting and aligned on business goals and company vision.
  • Collaborative, able to build good working relationships with Product, Automation, Technology and CX teams.

Required Experience:

  • B.S. degree in Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, or a related discipline, or a combination of education and related work experience.
  • 2+ years of work experience as a Business Analyst or Operations Business Analyst, preferably in customer care or support operations.
  • Experience supporting RPA or IPA solutions and automation projects, and using AI tools to improve workflows.
  • Experience with QA audits, process audits and PKTs, handling customer escalations and acting as an SME for support teams.
  • Experience in Healthcare, Supply Chain, Procurement or Customer Support is preferred.

title: Maintenance Fitter and Turner
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a qualified and practical Maintenance Fitter and Turner to join Rubisco's engineering team in Christchurch. You'll help keep production machinery and supporting plant safe, reliable and available for production.

Working closely with the Engineering and Production teams, you'll respond to breakdowns, carry out planned maintenance and identify improvements that prevent repeat failures. You'll also help plan daily work, organise parts and keep maintenance records up to date. This is a hands-on role where your mechanical skills can make a direct difference to plant reliability and production performance.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Respond to breakdowns across the plant, troubleshoot faults and complete repairs safely.

  • Carry out inspections, servicing and preventative maintenance, and keep maintenance records up to date.

  • Plan daily work with Engineering and Production, and organise the parts needed to keep equipment available.

  • Investigate major or recurring failures, follow up corrective actions and suggest practical equipment improvements.

  • Follow safe work procedures and work closely with production, contractors and suppliers.

About You

You're a practical, methodical fitter who enjoys solving mechanical problems and keeping production equipment running. You're safety conscious, organised and comfortable working with production teams to set priorities and get work completed.

Ideally you'll bring:

  • A recognised New Zealand trade qualification in fitting and turning, mechanical engineering or a closely related discipline, or an overseas equivalent.

  • At least three years of relevant maintenance experience in manufacturing, processing or a similar industrial environment. We may consider less experience where it is from a comparable environment.

  • Hands-on experience maintaining and repairing production machinery and responding to breakdowns.

  • An understanding of preventative maintenance, fault investigation and accurate maintenance records.

  • Experience with MEX or another computerised maintenance management system is an advantage.

  • A safe approach to maintenance, including equipment isolation and working within your training and authorisations.

  • Good planning, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to keep others informed of priorities and delays.

About the Company

Rubisco is a New Zealand advanced materials company combining decades of natural fibre manufacturing expertise with next-generation engineering to develop high-performance fibre and bio-composite solutions from wool and hemp. Our technologies are used across flooring, construction, architectural acoustics, advanced composites, transport and other industrial applications, delivering sustainable alternatives without compromising performance.

Based in Christchurch, with a second manufacturing site in Ashburton, our facilities combine advanced processing, automation and continuous production to transform raw fibre through dyeing, blending, carding, spinning and finishing into engineered materials. As we continue to invest in new technologies, advanced manufacturing capability and international growth, Rubisco offers engineers the opportunity to help shape the future of natural materials.

Why Join Rubisco?

At Rubisco, innovation is at the heart of what we do. You'll join a close-knit team where your contribution matters and where you'll have the opportunity to work across finance, logistics and operations while supporting products that are making a difference globally.

If you're looking for a varied role where you can make an impact while enjoying flexibility and working alongside a supportive team, we'd love to hear from you.

Ready to Apply

Apply today with your cover letter and CV. You must be eligible to live and work in New Zealand to be considered for this position. Our pre-employment process is to carry out a Medical, Drug test and Criminal Conviction history check.

title: Asset Management Lifecycle Manager
location: Osborne, SA, Australia; Henderson, WA, Australia; South Australia, Australia; Perth, WA, Australia
description:
About the Opportunity

Reporting to the Head of Asset Management, the Asset Management Lifecycle Manager is responsible for leading asset lifecycle strategies across ASC's infrastructure and operational assets to maximise reliability, availability and whole-of-life value. The role will play a key part in ensuring assets are operationally ready to support both current sustainment requirements and Australia's future nuclear-powered submarine program.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing specialist asset management team that is shaping the future of ASC's sustainment capability. Working as a trusted internal consultant, you will partner with project, engineering and operational teams to bridge the gap between project delivery and sustainment, influence long-term investment decisions and build the asset management capability needed to support Australia's submarine programs into the future.

This is a full-time opportunity based primarily in Henderson, Western Australia, with access to ASC's Perth CBD office and flexibility to work remotely where business requirements allow. While applications from Perth and Adelaide will be considered, Western Australia is the preferred location given the growth of ASC's sustainment operations and the role's close engagement with frontline teams. Operating within a task-based, outcomes-focused environment, occasional travel may be required to support business objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Lead asset lifecycle strategies that improve reliability, maintainability, availability and long-term asset performance across ASC's operational and infrastructure asset portfolio.
  • Partner with project and operational teams to ensure assets are effectively transitioned into service, meet customer requirements and support long-term sustainment outcomes.
  • Drive reliability engineering, maintenance optimisation and asset management capability uplift through the deployment of best-practice processes, systems and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide strategic asset planning, investment and renewal advice that supports informed decision-making and future operational readiness.
  • Lead and develop a growing team of reliability and asset management professionals, building enduring organisational capability and supporting ASC's long-term sustainment objectives.

About you

You are an experienced asset management, reliability engineering or sustainment leader who understands the realities of operating and maintaining complex assets in high-consequence environments, ideally with expertise gained in defence, maritime, shipbuilding, sustainment or specialist asset management settings.

You combine strong technical credibility with the ability to influence stakeholders across projects, engineering, maintenance and operations. You're equally comfortable developing long-term strategies and working alongside frontline teams to ensure successful delivery.

You will also have:

  • A degree qualification in Engineering, Asset Management, Reliability Engineering, Infrastructure Management or a related discipline.
  • Experience in asset lifecycle management, reliability engineering, maintenance management or sustainment delivery within a complex operational environment.
  • Experience working across project, maintenance, engineering and operational functions.
  • Strong knowledge of reliability-centred maintenance, asset performance improvement and lifecycle planning.
  • The ability to drive process improvement, influence cultural change and build organisational capability.
  • Experience within defence, maritime, naval, shipbuilding, utilities, infrastructure or other asset-intensive industries.

Eligibility

This role requires a current National Police Clearance, an Australian Defence Security Clearance and an ability to access protected US defence technology. Your eligibility for this role is dependent on you obtaining and maintaining such clearances and approvals.

Whilst ASC will accept all applications for this role, as this role requires an ability to access protected US defence technology, applicants holding nationality of certain foreign countries will not be eligible.

To check your eligibility please visit the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency website.

Benefits

  • Unique and challenging work with a deeper purpose.
  • Flexibility over how, when and where you work for the best work/life balance.
  • Up to 10 days additional leave every year so you can rest and recharge.
  • Generous parental leave so you can give your family the focus it deserves.
  • Subsidised childcare to ease the financial pressure on your family.
  • Health and wellbeing initiatives so you can perform at your best at work.
  • Professional development opportunities to advance your career.
  • A diverse and supportive environment where you can thrive.
  • Discounts and exclusive offers from leading Australian brands to help you save.

ASC – Your Career with a Deeper Purpose

At ASC, you'll contribute to work with a deeper purpose. As Australia's submarine company, we sustain the Royal Australian Navy's Collins Class fleet, deliver its Life of Type Extension, and help build Australia's future nuclear-powered submarine capability through AUKUS. With more than 2,500 specialist professionals across engineering, project management, construction, supply chain and sustainment, we are tackling some of the nation's most complex and strategically important challenges. Our work directly supports Australia's national security, offering the rare opportunity to combine meaningful impact, long-term career growth and genuine flexibility while helping shape the future of the country's sovereign submarine enterprise.

Apply today for a career with a deeper purpose.

Early applications are encouraged as shortlisting may commence immediately.

title: Senior Manager, CQA Audit (JAPAC)
description:
Purpose:

The Sr. Manager, Clinical Quality Audit is responsible for the execution of the Clinical audit program globally, including scheduling, planning, reporting and resolution of all types of Clinical audits and assure the quality and compliance of AbbVie clinical trials and studies across all regions.

  • Supports Clinical Quality Audit leadership with the strategic direction of the Clinical Quality Audit program to ensure business objectives are met, drive key performance indicators, and lead complex improvement projects to ensure efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Assures quality and compliance in a regulated environment including AbbVie policies and procedures, country specific requirements, and other applicable standards and worldwide regulations.
  • Advances the AbbVie Quality System through robust collaboration with business partners and other GxP RDQA functions and implementation of systems and processes required to support global quality assurance requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Clinical Quality Assurance and Clinical Development Operations to understand development programs and related risk factors to drive audit planning, site selection, & scheduling.
  • Oversee and manage the external suppliers/contractors conducting audits on behalf of AbbVie. This may include providing information about company processes, known quality issues, audit scoping expectations, and/or audit guidance.
  • Plan and conduct more complex internal audits as well as external routine and for-cause GCP audits worldwide.
  • Drives development/continuous improvement of necessary quality and clinical systems by leading and/or supporting implementation of initiatives to assure compliance to regulations and corporate policies.
  • Analyses and evaluates processes that support clinical development in order to assure quality and compliance.
  • Provides expert advice and support on clinical regulations, guidance and expectations to RDQA and business colleagues including external contractors, clinical investigators, and development partners on topics related to clinical trial conduct, to facilitate identification and resolution of GCP-related issues and concerns.
  • Guide functional teams through the CAPA process to ensure robust investigation, timely action, and meaningful improvements to process.
  • Using quality management system tools, analyze audit findings and trends to drive continuous improvement.
  • Train staff on regulatory requirements, quality management processes and procedures.
  • Provide inspection support for GCP inspections onsite or remotely if needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in science (physical, life, health), a health care profession (e.g., nursing or pharmacy) or equivalent experience.
  • 5-7+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry in the fields of clinical development, clinical trials regulatory affairs and/or quality assurance supporting those areas, or with a regulatory authority
  • Detailed knowledge of quality systems and auditing standards with experience in GCP auditing.
  • Extensive knowledge of worldwide clinical regulatory requirements and industry best practices, quality management principles, including global and regional regulations and internationally recognized standards (e.g. ICH, ISO).
  • Excellent communication skills, including superior negotiation and influencing skills. Acute listening skills to gain understanding or to solve a problem and the ability to recognize the difference. Ability to manage difficult conversations and seek alignment.
  • Ability to manage complex issues and distil information. Strong analytical skills and the ability to proactively identify, rapidly assess, and effectively manage business and compliance risks.
  • Demonstrated flexibility to adapt to changing assignments and ability to effectively prioritize.
  • Ability to think strategically and communicate effectively with colleagues at all levels, including senior management.
  • Well-developed leadership competencies to deliver team objectives and projects. Willingness and ability to perform domestic and international travel.

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:
Alphanumeric is hiring a Lead Technical Consultant to work out of the Research Triangle Park, NC area with our client of 20 years committed to improving lives through medical and pharmaceutical advancements.

Pay Range: $84.50 - $86.80

The team is looking for an experienced engineer who can contribute beyond simply executing an assigned backlog. The successful candidate should be technically strong but also capable of bringing ideas forward, helping identify solutions, contributing to backlog development, and following those ideas through delivery. The contractor will work alongside the broader team within the same sprint and backlog structure. There may also be opportunities to contribute outside the candidate's primary area when their interests and delivery priorities align.

We are a full-stack shop consisting of product and portfolio leadership, data engineering, infrastructure and DevOps, data/metadata/knowledge platforms, and AI/ML and analysis platforms, all geared toward:
  • Building a next-generation data experience for scientists, engineers, and decision-makers, increasing productivity and reducing time spent on "data mechanics."
  • Providing best-in-class AI/ML and data analysis environments to accelerate our predictive capabilities and attract top-tier talent.
  • Aggressively engineering our data at scale to unlock the value of our combined data assets and predictions in real-time.

Key Responsibilities:
Our teams are building modern, cloud-native, DevOps-first systems for standardizing and templatizing biomedical and scientific data engineering for both internal and external stakeholders.
The selected candidate will be responsible for:
  • Design, build, and operate tools, services, workflows, etc. that deliver high value through the solution to key business problems.
  • Be responsible for development of key components of a scalable research data platform supporting scientists along with their collaborators.
  • Represent Onyx within the wider scientific community across internal and external collaborations.
  • Partner with Infra and DevOps team where modifications to underlying tools, e.g. infrastructure as code, Cloud Ops, DevOps, logging/alerting, are needed to serve new use cases and to ensure operations are planned.
  • Consult scientific users on application scalability to PBs of data by having a deep understanding of software engineering, algorithms, and underlying hardware infrastructure and their impact on performance.
  • Produce well-engineered software, including appropriate automated test suites, technical documentation, and operational strategy.
  • Ensure consistent application of platform abstractions to ensure quality and consistency with respect to logging and lineage.
  • Be fully versed in coding best practices and ways of working, and participate in code reviews and partnering to improve the team's standards.
  • Provide leadership to team members to help others get the job done right.

Top Skills:
  • Cloud infrastructure development, with Google Cloud preferred.
  • Software engineering, with Python preferred.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDL).
  • Approximately 5 years of relevant experience.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a remote team.
  • Ability to contribute ideas and problem-solving rather than functioning solely as a task executor.

Minimum Experience: Degree + 5 years experience.
Minimum Education: Degree in Computer Science/Software Engineering.

title: Corporate Campaigns Manager
location: Remote in the United States or Canada
description:
Mercy For Animals aims to end industrial animal agriculture by constructing a just and sustainable food system. We envision a world where animals are respected, protected, and free.

As a leading farmed animal advocacy organization, we know that achieving this goal requires a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative work environment—one that welcomes and sparks new perspectives and innovative ideas. If you are passionate about our mission, driven to make a big impact for animals, and eager to be part of a dedicated team, join us!

We currently seek a Corporate Campaigns Manager to join our Corporate Impact team. In this role, you will lead high-impact corporate pressure campaigns that persuade businesses in the food industry to adopt, implement, and uphold meaningful animal welfare and plant-based procurement policies. Manage a team that develops evidence-based strategies and executes coordinated and creative campaigns in pursuit of ending factory farming.

You will do invaluable work:

  • Own strategy and execution for a portfolio of corporate pressure campaigns, defining specific target-company demands, leverage points, milestones, and measures of success.
  • Manage and develop a team of Corporate Campaigns Specialists; set goals, delegate execution, review work, and foster strong strategic judgment and professional growth.
  • Coordinate closely with the Corporate Relations Manager to sequence outreach, negotiation, and escalation as part of an integrated target strategy.
  • Lead corporate power mapping and research into target company ownership, financial exposure, brand reputation, customers, investors, supply chains, executives, and other decision-makers.
  • Develop and execute innovative, strategic corporate campaigns using a wide range of tactics based on objectives, corporate vulnerabilities, and opportunities to secure meaningful policy changes.
  • Continuously develop campaign skills and expertise by learning from other social movements, cultural trends, and emerging forms of activism.
  • Apply insights from psychology, behavioral science and social dynamics to identify effective pressure points that influence corporate decision-making.
  • Achieve measurable policy commitments and work with colleagues to monitor follow-through and respond to noncompliance.
  • Collaborate with departments across MFA to advance shared objectives and strengthen long-term organizational power.
  • Build coalitions with organizations and advocates from animal protection and adjacent social movements to achieve campaign objectives.
  • Oversee campaign messaging and materials, approvals, risk assessment, budgets, vendor work, timelines, and post-campaign evaluations.
  • Review campaign strategies and content with the Legal and Communications departments to ensure compliance with relevant laws and consistency with Mercy For Animals’ messaging.
  • Serve as a spokesperson for Mercy For Animals at campaign actions, press conferences, industry events, conferences, and other events as needed.
  • Continuously explore and adopt emerging technologies, tools, and practices to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and impact.
  • Follow all organizational policies and procedures and ensure compliance from direct reports.
  • Perform any other duties as assigned.

Your qualifications will take our Corporate Impact team to the next level:

  • 5+ years’ experience in corporate pressure campaigns, corporate ESG affairs, or brand accountability, consumer protection advocacy, or related fields (whether in animal protection, environmental, labor or other movements that have seen successes in challenging corporate practice.
  • Demonstrated role in a campaign that changed a corporation’s policy or practices.
  • Working understanding of the food industry and the impact of factory farming on animals is preferred.
  • Comfort with challenging established norms, confronting powerful institutions, and employing bold, assertive campaign tactics that drive meaningful change.
  • Bachelor’s degree in political science, sociology, business, economics, marketing, public relations, communications, or related fields preferred.
  • Strong, emotionally-intelligent, interpersonal skills and ability to communicate professionally and persuasively in both writing and verbally.
  • Exceptionally strong work ethic and drive to succeed.
  • Exceptional organizational, time management, and project management skills.
  • Willingness and ability to travel 2-3 times per year.
  • Commitment to the mission, values, and objectives of the organization.
  • A commitment and openness to continued personal and organizational growth in diversity, equity, inclusion, and justice principles.

Compensation and Benefits (exempt)

Earn an annual salary of $66,730 to $79,700, depending on qualifications, and enjoy a commute-free life as a remote team member. In addition to a collaborative and innovative work environment, you will be able to take part in our benefits package, including no- or low-cost health, vision, and dental insurance; generous paid time off and sick leave; and 401(k) retirement plan, with a dollar-to-dollar employer match of up to 3.5% of your annual earnings.

Application Details

We consider traditional and nontraditional qualifications and carefully review each application, resume, and cover letter. Feel encouraged to go outside a traditional cover letter and state how you would add to our culture; what we would gain from having you on our team; and how you align with our organizational vision, mission, and values. To ensure fairness in the hiring process, we request that all applicants refrain from submitting materials that are generated entirely by artificial intelligence tools. We recognize that such tools can be useful in refining tone, grammar, and clarity, but please ensure that your materials reflect your personal experience, qualifications, and authentic voice.

Our Commitment to You

Mercy For Animals is a globally minded organization. We are committed to the principles of equity and justice, and our culture celebrates authenticity—enabling every team member to shine. All employment decisions are based solely on individual qualifications, job needs, and job requirements, and potential team members of every color, orientation, age, gender, origin, veteran status, and ability are encouraged to apply. We strive to include candidates from historically marginalized communities and those from or in communities impacted by environmental, social, and economic injustice. In addition, please let us know if you have a reasonable accommodation request at any point within the hiring process.

Come as you are, and help us transform our society and construct a truly compassionate food system.

By submitting your information, you are indicating that you have read our Privacy Policy and accept its terms.

title: Community Management Intern
description:

Westfield, Indiana | Summer 2027

title: Commercial Loan Manager
description:
📍 Medellín, Colombia | Full-Time

🏢 Hybrid | 3 days per week in the office

About the Role

You’ll manage the full servicing and monitoring cycle for your loans, from financial statement reviews and covenant tracking to delinquency resolution and franchise construction monitoring. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented commercial credit professional who enjoys working with borrowers, stays on top of deadlines, and takes real accountability for the health of their portfolio.

What You'll Do

  • Own and manage an assigned portfolio of commercial loans, keeping every loan current and up to date in the system

  • Use portfolio dashboards to prioritize daily work across categories such as past-due loans, outstanding financial statements, and pending monitoring tasks

  • Collect, review, and analyze borrower financial statements on a quarterly and annual basis

  • Identify credit risk trends at the customer and portfolio level and escalate changes to management

  • Track loan covenants and conduct compliance reviews

Role Overview
WatchTime Studios is looking for a Channel Director to own the holistic performance of YouTube channels within the WatchTime Studios portfolio, with accountability for both audience growth and financial results.
This role owns the P&Ls of a slate of channels and oversees them end to end, from creative direction through execution, including what gets made, how it is packaged, and how it performs. The goal is to build channels that grow consistently as WatchTime Studios grows.
The Role
Reporting to the Head of Content, the Channel Director owns the P&Ls of multiple WatchTime Studios channels, with accountability for both audience and financial performance across creative direction and execution.
You will own the holistic performance of the channels while working closely with teams that lead functions such as publishing and production, alongside cross-functional Beast Industries teams. The position also has a dotted-line reporting relationship to the GM of WatchTime Studios for P&L reviews, budgeting, and studio-level planning.
What You’ll Do
  • Own the P&L of WatchTime Studios channels, including revenue performance, per-video costs, margin targets, and team overhead.

What You’ll Bring
  • 10+ years of experience in digital video or creator-led content, including direct ownership of the performance of one or multiple YouTube or social media channels.
  • Experience owning a P&L or budget for a content business, with accountability for both revenue and costs.
  • A demonstrated track record of growing YouTube or social media channels, supported by measurable results.
  • Deep working knowledge of YouTube analytics, packaging, and platform ranking signals.
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to articulate why a video will or will not work before it is made.
  • Experience overseeing content teams and managing production budgets.

Benefits

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

description:
Groma is blending real estate and technology to unlock a new real estate asset class while making it easier for everyone – from institutional investors to the residents in our buildings – to participate in ownership. title: Associate, Corporate Finance
description:
About the Role

The Associate, Corporate Finance will play a key role within Madison Energy Infrastructure’s FP&A function, helping translate capital investment plans and corporate priorities into clear forecasts, funding requirements, and financial insights.

This role will primarily focus on capital expenditures (CapEx), including tracking investment activity, forecasting cash requirements, and explaining performance against plan. Beyond CapEx, you will help maintain a comprehensive view of corporate sources and uses of cash and support budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting.

Working across Finance, Accounting, Development, Construction, Supply Chain and Procurement, you will connect project-level information with Madison’s broader financial outlook. This role is suited to someone who combines strong financial modeling skills with sound judgment, strong attention to detail, experience working cross-functionally as a finance business partner, and the ability to turn complex information into a clear business narrative.

What You’ll Own

  • CapEx Planning & Forecasting – Maintain and improve capital expenditure forecasts, incorporating project schedules, investment assumptions, payment timing, and changes in expected spending. Partner with business teams to keep forecasts grounded in current plans.
  • Capital Performance Reporting – Track actual, committed, and forecast capital spending against approved budgets. Identify variances, explain their drivers, and highlight implications for future spending and cash requirements.
  • Corporate Sources & Uses – Help build and maintain an integrated view of corporate cash inflows and outflows, including capital investments, operating requirements, financing activity, and other corporate obligations. Coordinate assumptions with the teams responsible for each workstream.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting – Support annual budgets, monthly/periodic forecasts, and longer-term planning. Consolidate inputs, challenge assumptions constructively, and translate changes into financial impacts.
  • Financial Modeling & Decision Support – Develop models and scenario analyses that evaluate investment timing, funding needs, and competing business priorities. Clearly communicate assumptions, sensitivities, and tradeoffs.
  • Management Reporting – Prepare concise reporting and presentation materials that explain capital deployment, forecast changes, liquidity requirements, and key business risks / opportunities to Senior Leadership, Board of Directors, and/or Private Equity Ownership.
  • Process Improvement & Partnership – Strengthen planning templates, controls, and documentation. Work with Accounting to reconcile actual results and with business partners to improve the timeliness and quality of forecast inputs.

What Will Help You Succeed

(You don’t need to check every box, but here’s what will help you thrive.)

  • Education & Background – Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, economics, or a related field
  • Experience – 3–5 years of relevant experience in FP&A, corporate finance, transaction advisory, investment banking, or a related analytical role
  • Technical Skills – Strong financial modeling and Excel skills, with the ability to build clear, reliable models that others can understand and maintain; understanding of financial statements, cash flow forecasting, and the distinction between accounting recognition and cash timing
  • Presentation & Reporting – Comfort building clear, polished PowerPoint presentations, with strong attention to detail to ensure numbers, labels, and formatting are accurate and consistent
  • Analytical Approach – Ability to reconcile information across sources, investigate discrepancies, and explain the business drivers behind the numbers
  • Mindset – Strong attention to detail, communication, organization, and follow-through; comfortable working across functions and managing shifting priorities
  • Preferred Knowledge – Experience analyzing capital expenditures, project economics, or investment-driven businesses preferred; interest in renewable energy and infrastructure, with experience in either sector helpful

Benefits

  • PTO and company holidays
  • Medical, dental, vision
  • Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance
  • 401(k) and company match
  • Professional development stipend
  • Strong culture of collaboration, performance, and personal growth
$105,000 - $140,000 a year
The actual salary offered may vary depending on job-related factors including, but not limited to knowledge, skills, experience and location.

How We Work

At Madison Energy Infrastructure, we believe in the power of clean energy infrastructure to drive real impact—for our customers, our partners, and the communities we serve. We’ve quickly emerged as a preeminent developer, investor, and operator of distributed generation, helping organizations across sectors meet their energy goals with certainty, speed, and trust. Our robust portfolio consists of over half a gigawatt of clean energy infrastructure projects across more than 25 states.
We’re building a team that thrives on ownership and ambition. As we expand into direct, end-to-end services for Fortune 500 companies, public entities, and nonprofits alike, we rely on collaborative thinkers who bring structure to complexity, energy to execution, and curiosity to every challenge.
Our environment is fast-paced and outcome-oriented—but grounded in the belief that how we work together matters as much as what we deliver. If you’re excited to shape the future of clean energy and be part of a high-performance, high-integrity team, we’d love to meet you.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
About Us

nShift is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 500 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

About you

We are seeking a dynamic and accomplished Engineering Manager to lead our talented team of engineers. The ideal candidate will possess a unique blend of technical expertise, leadership acumen, and a passion for driving innovation. As a key player in our organization, you should have a proven track record of successfully managing multiple engineering teams, delivering high-quality projects, and fostering a collaborative and innovative work culture.

Purpose of role

At nShift, the primary task of the Engineering Manager is to lead, inspire, and support a group of talented developers and testers, ensuring they thrive in a collaborative, high-performing environment. Engineering Manager plays a central leadership role in ensuring the team delivers high-quality software that aligns with business goals and technical strategy.

This role blends technical leadership, people management, and delivery accountability.

As Engineering Manager in the Portal Team, you will lead a cross-functional development team, providing coaching, structure, and direction.

You’ll ensure that engineering teams are empowered, motivated, and equipped to build scalable, secure, and resilient solutions - while continuously improving how they work.

Your role includes:

· Collaborating with the Product Managers on Product Requirement Documents and balancing feature delivery with quality.

· Supporting team development and maintaining a high-performing culture.

· Communicating company goals and representing the team within the organization.

· Driving technical excellence and sustainable delivery practices.

Overall responsibility:

Technology

· Ensure that daily work aligns with the tech vision, guiding principles and quality standards.

· Make sure that the technology stack managed by the team is resilient, secure, and up to date.

· Promote internal education, collaboration, and knowledge-sharing across platforms and teams.

Process

· Challenge your team to enhance their working methods, proactively addressing opportunities and obstacles with a critical mindset.

· Ensure that your team consistently follows established processes and advocate for adopting best practices and tools.

· Provide support to the Product Manager.

People Management

· Administer and oversee personal development plans, salary structures, and recruitment processes.

· Create opportunities for team members to stay motivated through mentorship, coaching, or delegating tasks to encourage professional growth.

· Cultivate a culture of empowered employment, setting an example for your team to follow.

· Build and maintain a robust team with overlapping skills and knowledge, avoiding critical dependencies on single individuals.

Competence and Experience:

For the role of Engineering Manager in our Portal team at nShift, we are seeking candidates who embody the following characteristics:

Technical Proficiency: A strong hands-on background in .NET is required, with a proven history of technical expertise in software development. Experience with TypeScript and experience working with LLMs is a distinct advantage, but not mandatory.

Ambitious Leadership: We value individuals with a strong drive to achieve their professional goals. This ambition motivates you and your team to continually strive for greater success.

Professional: You understand that it’s a part of a manager’s role to look out for the interests of the company and the team, and you are prepared to manage difficult tasks with this in mind.

Exacting Standards: Maintaining high standards is vital as you consistently aim for excellence in both personal performance and the work produced by your team.

Effective Communication: Proficiency in both written and spoken English is essential for ensuring seamless communication within the team and with stakeholders.

Requirements:

The technologies this team uses are:

• .NET, TypeScript

• Postgres

• Docker, Bitbucket, GitHub

• AWS, IaC, OpenSearch

• SonarQube, JFrog

• Postman

• Claude

Education and experience

  • BS degree in Computer Science or related field

  • Minimum of 3 years of management experience, advanced knowledge of the above-mentioned technologies.

Please ensure you upload your CV in English.

Meet your manager: Rares Platon, Director of Engineering - Platform

How long have you worked for nShift?

2 Years

What would your current team members say about your leadership or manager style?

Transparent, disciplined and supportive.

What do you love about nShift 😊

The flexibility of working and the quality of the people that I work with which tackle complex issues decisively and with common sense. The company is always willing to invest in both people and technology.

What difference will this role make to nShift if I join?

Your role will be instrumental in leading our team towards ground-breaking achievements, shaping the future of our product, and contributing significantly to our position as industry leaders.

The nShift Platform team is responsible for the maintenance and expansion of the largest Carrier Library of its kind.

At nShift we believe in embracing diversity in all forms and fostering an inclusive environment for everyone which we believe is essential for our continued success. description:

ADESA Benefits and Perks

Other Requirements

title: Systems Engineer II
description:
Proconex is the exclusive Emerson Impact Partner for Emerson Automation Solutions in the Mid-Atlantic region. We provide a full portfolio of Process Automation Control Systems, Valves and Control Devices, and related technologies and services to a range of customers—in the Life Sciences, Chemical, Power, Refining, Oil & Gas, Food & Beverage, Paper, Metals, and other industries, as well as commercial enterprises and campus facilities. With three strategically located offices, Proconex maintains a deep dedication to its 200+ employees, a sharp focus on safety and quality, and the drive to deliver.

Systems Engineer II

Position Summary

The Systems Engineer II is a professional-level engineering role responsible for independently executing automation and control system projects and support activities with minimal supervision. This position contributes to the design, implementation, testing, commissioning, maintenance, and optimization of industrial automation systems while serving as a trusted technical resource for customers and project teams.

The Systems Engineer II applies process control knowledge and automation expertise to develop technical solutions, troubleshoot system issues, execute project deliverables, and support customer operations. This role regularly interfaces with customer stakeholders, contributes to project planning and execution, supports less experienced engineers, and continues to expand technical depth and industry expertise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, implement, and support industrial automation systems, including Distributed Control Systems (DCS), Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), SCADA systems, data historians, and related technologies.
  • Develop control strategies, interlocks, sequences, graphics, alarm configurations, historian integrations, and control modules that meet customer and project requirements.
  • Interpret customer requirements, process descriptions, P&IDs, specifications, and design inputs to develop technical solutions and project deliverables.
  • Develop and maintain engineering documentation, including functional specifications, control narratives, I/O lists, testing documentation, and related project records.
  • Execute Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, startup, validation, and change control activities.
  • Troubleshoot automation, integration, and control system issues, perform root cause investigations, and implement corrective actions to improve system reliability and performance.
  • Support lifecycle management activities, upgrades, migrations, maintenance efforts, and operational support activities.
  • Participate in customer meetings, gather technical requirements, communicate project status, and serve as a reliable technical resource during project execution and site support activities.
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, validation, IT, quality, and project management teams to support successful project delivery.
  • Mentor interns and Systems Engineer I team members through project execution, onboarding, training, and technical guidance.
  • Identify opportunities for additional engineering services and communicate those opportunities to engineering leadership and account teams.
  • Leverage emerging technologies and digital tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to improve engineering productivity, technical documentation, troubleshooting, project execution, and business processes.

Travel Requirements

This role includes up to 60% travel to customer sites to support project execution, commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, testing, training, and other customer-facing activities.

Project assignments may require extended onsite support at customer locations. Individuals in this role must be open to temporary relocation or assignment-based relocation for project work based on customer, project, and business needs.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience designing, configuring, implementing, testing, or supporting industrial automation and control systems within manufacturing, process control, engineering services, life sciences, or related technical environments.
  • 3+ years of experience developing and maintaining engineering documentation, including functional specifications, control narratives, testing documentation, design documentation, or related project deliverables.
  • 3+ years of experience troubleshooting automation, integration, process control, or manufacturing system issues in project, operational, or support environments.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting commissioning, startup, testing, validation, change control, or operational support activities.
  • 3+ years of experience working within project-based engineering environments with responsibility for technical deliverables, project execution, customer support, or cross-functional collaboration.
  • 3+ years of experience using engineering software, business applications, and Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Teams, and SharePoint.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Emerson DeltaV, Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Ignition, Wonderware, OSI PI, PLC, SCADA, or similar automation platforms.
  • Experience developing control strategies, HMI graphics, alarm management solutions, historian integrations, or automation code modifications.
  • Experience with industrial networking, system integration, databases, virtualization, cybersecurity, or industrial communication protocols.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing operations in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, chemical, energy, utilities, food and beverage, or advanced manufacturing environments.
  • Experience performing Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, startup, or validation activities.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers, interns, or technical team members.
  • Experience leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) tools to improve engineering productivity, technical documentation, software development, troubleshooting, data analysis, project execution, or other business and engineering workflows.

We are proud to be an employee-owned organization. Through our ESOP, every team member shares in the growth and success of the company, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and long-term rewards.

title: Senior Analyst, Capital Markets
description:
About the Role

The Senior Analyst, Capital Markets supports MEI’s capital formation across corporate capital raises, structured finance reporting, project-level debt financings, and project underwriting, including M&A opportunities. This role contributes directly to the capital raises that fuel MEI’s rapidly growing platform.

The Senior Analyst is expected to own recurring structured finance reporting independently, work across teams and external parties, and identify and implement improvements to reporting and deal workflows.

What You’ll Own

  • Corporate Capital Raises – Support MEI’s corporate capital raises, including preparation of investor materials, data room management, and coordination of diligence responses
  • Structured Finance Reporting – Prepare recurring reporting on MEI’s structured finance transactions, including performance, compliance, and portfolio data for investors, lenders, and internal stakeholders
  • Project Debt Financings – Contribute to project-level debt financings, including lender materials, financial model updates, diligence coordination, and closing deliverables
  • Underwriting & Capital Allocation – Maintain and review project-level models against MEI’s underwriting criteria, including for M&A opportunities; flag exceptions and recommend next steps to support capital allocation decisions
  • Leadership & Board Materials – Prepare presentations and analysis for senior leadership, the board, and external stakeholders

What Will Help You Succeed

(You don’t need to check every box, but here’s what will help you thrive.)

  • Education – Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, or related field
  • Experience – 1–4 years of experience in project finance, investment banking, private equity, corporate development, or a related finance discipline
  • Technical Skills – Advanced Excel and financial modeling; proficiency with PowerPoint and data/BI tools; working proficiency with AI tools
  • Mindset – Detail-oriented and self-sufficient, comfortable working through ambiguity while managing multiple workstreams in a fast-moving environment

Benefits

  • PTO and company holidays
  • Medical, dental, vision
  • Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance
  • 401(k) and company match
  • Professional development stipend
  • Strong culture of collaboration, performance, and personal growth
$90,000 - $110,000 a year
The actual salary offered may vary depending on job-related factors including, but not limited to knowledge, skills, experience and location.

How We Work

At Madison Energy Infrastructure, we believe in the power of clean energy infrastructure to drive real impact—for our customers, our partners, and the communities we serve. We’ve quickly emerged as a preeminent developer, investor, and operator of distributed generation, helping organizations across sectors meet their energy goals with certainty, speed, and trust. Our robust portfolio consists of over half a gigawatt of clean energy infrastructure projects across more than 25 states.
We’re building a team that thrives on ownership and ambition. As we expand into direct, end-to-end services for Fortune 500 companies, public entities, and nonprofits alike, we rely on collaborative thinkers who bring structure to complexity, energy to execution, and curiosity to every challenge.
Our environment is fast-paced and outcome-oriented—but grounded in the belief that how we work together matters as much as what we deliver. If you’re excited to shape the future of clean energy and be part of a high-performance, high-integrity team, we’d love to meet you.

title: Entry-level Auto Technician
description:
We’re looking for Automotive Mechanics with a minimum of 6 months of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Entry-Level Technician, you’ll be expected to perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Location: 1000 E Gowan Rd, North Las Vegas, NV 89030

Pay Range: $17.00-$19.00 (based on level of experience)

Other perks of the Job

  • 100% company-paid healthcare premiums
  • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!
  • ASE and tool reimbursement programs
  • Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of Technician roles in our Inspection Centers, depending on your level of experience - take a look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

  • Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.
  • Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires
  • Mid-Level (Mechanical Repair / Build / General) Technician (min 3 years of professional experience): perform light to medium automotive repairs and minimal diagnostics on our vehicles
  • Experienced Technician (min 5 years of professional experience): perform extensive repairs and heavy engine work, as well as advanced vehicle diagnostics on all makes and models, including electric and hybrid vehicles

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles
  • Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

title: Paraveterinair bij Dierenkliniek De Kempen – Valkenswaard
description:
Vacature: Paraveterinair bij Dierenkliniek De Kempen – Valkenswaard

Wil jij van jouw passie voor dierenzorg elke dag je werk maken in een professionele en collegiale omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans om het verschil te maken! Bij Dierenkliniek De Kempen in Valkenswaard kom je terecht in een betrokken team van gemotiveerde collega's die, net als jij, streven naar de allerbeste zorg voor ieder dier.

Hier krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en een band op te bouwen met de dieren en baasjes uit de regio. Je werkt in een professionele omgeving met moderne faciliteiten en wordt ondersteund door de kennis en middelen van IVC Evidensia.

Dit ga je doen

Als Paraveterinair ben jij het warme welkom en de steunpilaar van de kliniek. Je werkt nauw samen met de dierenartsen en zorgt ervoor dat iedere eigenaar met een gerust hart en iedere patiënt met de beste zorg de deur uitgaat. Jouw werkdag is een dynamische mix van dierzorg, klantcontact en coördinatie.

  • Jij bent het gezicht van de kliniek: Je verwelkomt cliënten, handelt administratieve werkzaamheden af en bent het eerste, deskundige aanspreekpunt.

  • De spil in de communicatie: Je plant afspraken in, geeft telefonisch uitslagen door en adviseert eigenaren vanuit jouw kennis en ervaring.

  • Ondersteuning in de kern van de zorg: Je assisteert de dierenarts tijdens spreekuren en behandelingen en voert verschillende laboratoriumtesten uit.

  • Zorg voor een soepel verloop van de praktijk: Je beheert de voorraad, bewaakt de hygiëne en zorgt ervoor dat de dagelijkse werkzaamheden goed verlopen.

Je werkt samen met een betrokken team waarin kennis delen, samenwerken en persoonlijke aandacht voor dier en eigenaar centraal staan.

Dit neem je mee

Jij bent een echte teamspeler met een groot hart voor dierenwelzijn. Je weet als geen ander hoe je een zenuwachtig baasje geruststelt en werkt met dezelfde zorgvuldigheid wanneer het druk is. Verder neem je mee:

  • Een afgeronde opleiding tot paraveterinair en een registratie in het Diergeneeskunderegister.

  • Een passie voor dieren die zichtbaar is in alles wat je doet.

  • Een betrokken en klantgerichte instelling.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en plezier in het contact met dieren en hun eigenaren.

  • De veerkracht om ook op drukke momenten het hoofd koel en het hart warm te houden.

Dit krijg je van ons

Omdat jij iedere dag klaarstaat voor dieren en hun eigenaren, zorgen wij ook goed voor jou. Je krijgt bij ons niet alleen een baan, maar ook volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Een salarisindicatie van € 3.113,64 - € 3.984,66 per maand (op basis van 40 uur), passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.

  • Een uitstekende pensioenregeling om ook aan je toekomst te bouwen.

  • Een gezonde werk-privébalans met 25 vakantiedagen (op basis van fulltime).

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding en 20% personeelskorting.

  • Ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden via de IVC Evidensia Academy: Je krijgt toegang tot een uitgebreid aanbod aan bij- en nascholingen. Of je nu je kennis wilt verdiepen in een specifiek vakgebied of wilt werken aan je persoonlijke ontwikkeling, onze Academy biedt volop mogelijkheden.

title: SMTS Engineer, Adv DRAM PI

description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The Emerging Memory organization develops technologies that enable the future of memory scaling. Our engineers work in an industry-leading 300mm R&D environment, collaborating across fields to advance next-generation memory technologies from concept toward manufacturable solutions.


As a Process Integration Engineer, you will help improve the performance, yield, reliability, and manufacturability of ground breaking technology. You will apply deep expertise in semiconductor device physics and process integration while collaborating with simulation, modeling, characterization, reliability, development, and process groups to address sophisticated integration and circuit challenges.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead process integration activities to enable manufacturable technologies, including charge-storage devices, thin-film transistors (TFTs), and related device components
  • Design and implement R&D fab experiments, optimize process flows, and develop solutions that meet device and product requirements
  • Analyze inline, defect, parametric, and probe data to resolve yield, performance, reliability, process-margin, and cost challenges

  • Lead continuous yield improvement and cost-reduction initiatives, clearly communicating technical findings and driving teams toward implementation

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in an engineering field with 5+ years of semiconductor industry experience
  • Demonstrated proficiency in semiconductor device physics alongside a strong knowledge of semiconductor process unification and process development
  • Detailed knowledge of mainstream memory technologies, such as DRAM or NAND, demonstrated through significant technical contributions
  • Strong understanding of process assimilation and electronic build or architectural considerations as they relate to memory technologies

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PhD in an engineering field with 12+ years of semiconductor industry experience
  • Proficiency in data analysis, design of experiments (DOE), and statistical techniques
  • Understanding of the challenges and opportunities associated with emerging or alternative memory technologies
  • Demonstrated project management skills and experience leading multi-functional technical teams
  • Experience using AI-assisted analytics to enhance data interpretation, anomaly detection, and yield improvement initiatives

title: IT Financial & Asset Management Manager
description:
Technology represents one of our most significant business investments. We are seeking an accomplished IT Financial & Asset Management Manager to drive financial accountability, optimise technology spend and provide transparent, data-driven insights that maximise the value of our IT investment across APAC.

Based in Manila and reporting to the Regional Information Officer, APAC, you will be the trusted financial and asset lead for our regional IT function. You will bring discipline to complex budgets and recharge models, lead audit and assurance across our technology estate, and give leadership the insight it needs to make confident, informed decisions.

Key responsibilities

Financial stewardship

  • Lead the planning, forecasting and management of regional IT budgets at a G&A level.
  • Govern cost allocation across local and global recharge finance models, ensuring accuracy, transparency and alignment with Group policy.
  • Identify, deliver and evidence sustainable savings across hardware, software, cloud and managed services.
  • Partner with Finance on month-end close, accruals and cost reallocation.

Audit and assurance

  • Plan and execute regular audits of software and hardware spend, entitlements and usage.
  • Maintain complete, accurate asset records across the full lifecycle, from acquisition to disposal.
  • Reconcile IT and financial records, resolving variances and strengthening controls.
  • Ensure licence compliance and proactively address risk and optimisation opportunities ahead of renewal.

Insight and reporting

  • Design and maintain executive dashboards that provide clear visibility of spend, utilisation, savings and return on investment.
  • Translate complex financial and asset data into concise insights and recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Champion automation and AI-enabled reporting, including ServiceNow workflows, to improve efficiency and data quality.

Commercial management

  • Oversee vendor contract renewals.
  • Collaborate with regional and global IT, Finance and Procurement teams to drive consistent governance.
  • Lead continuous improvement in how technology is procured, tracked and utilised across the region.

  • Substantial experience in IT finance, IT asset management or technology value management, ideally within a multinational or professional services environment.
  • A demonstrated track record of managing complex IT budgets and delivering measurable cost savings.
  • Deep understanding of local and global recharge and cost allocation models at a G&A level.
  • Proven experience leading audits of software and hardware spend, licensing and asset data.
  • Advanced Excel and data visualisation capability, with strong Power BI experience.
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow, ITIL practices and enterprise technology management.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to influence senior leaders.
  • A tertiary qualification in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

As our Founder's Associate, you get the unique opportunity to be a key driver of our exponential growth curve. Sunny Lisbon will be your home base, but you’ll travel to and work with our three markets! To facilitate a steep growth curve, we provide you with the following:

  • The chance to create a genuine impact - experience the thrill of working in a fast-paced environment where your efforts and results are tangible, shaping the destiny of our business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - work closely with our high-performing teams alongside our international peers and founder.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we firmly believe in nurturing talent from within, fostering an environment where the sky's the limit.
  • The passport to adventure - as a part of our international organization, you spread your wings and learn from our other markets while applying both strategic and executive skills.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - fuel your interpersonal, digital, entrepreneurial, organizational, project management, and business prowess through hands-on experience in an organisation that values training and development.

Your Responsibilities

You will own your own projects and be responsible for driving results across various projects and initiatives. Responsibilities in this job will evolve and be defined and redefined throughout your time with us. The aim is to take ownership of and drive the development of progressively larger opportunities. Success requires the following:

  • Setting ambitious yet achievable goals, developing strategic plans to reach them, and executing with urgency and intensity to deliver measurable outcomes
  • Take ownership of assigned projects or tasks from inception to completion, including defining clear objectives, plans, and deliverables
  • Proactively identify potential bottlenecks or obstacles and develop mitigation strategies
  • Drive accountability by ensuring all team members understand their roles and responsibilities
  • Act as a champion for our results-driven culture within the team and organization
  • Build, coach, and empower A+ teams to reach their potential and provide 5-star experiences to our users and partners
  • Project-based assignments with clear objectives spread across different geographies
  • Deep dive into value creation, process improvement and organizational growth
  • Thinking out of the box, brainstorming and strategizing to challenge status quo and aim at accelerating our momentum and efficient scaling

What we expect from you

We are seeking a dynamic individual who thrives in a results-oriented environment to join our team and help us reach our objectives. Industry experience is not a requirement, but you do need to be highly ambitious, proactive, forward-thinking, a fast learner, and driven to succeed.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have proactive mindset, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Are self-motivated, detail-oriented, and possess a track record of successfully owning projects from conception to completion
  • Possess an unwavering drive and desire to be the very best at what they do
  • Are passionate about making an impact and driving tangible results
  • Exude an unparalleled work ethic fueled by an urgency to progress
  • Embrace ownership and proactively following through on commitments
  • Possess an insatiable curiosity about business, data, and people, relishing the opportunity to build and nurture relationships that fuel lasting success
  • Master the art of communication, wielding their words with impact both verbally and in writing
  • Showcase unrivalled organizational skills, skillfully structuring and prioritizing their work to achieve maximum efficiency
  • Danish speaker, fluent in English and an EU work permit is required

Start Date and Location

Flexible start date.

The role will be full time, onsite in Lisbon, Portugal.

It will cover all three markets, so regular travel will be part of what we have in mind for you! It will also include extended stays working hands-on with the teams in the different locations.
