title: H&M Department Manager - Arrowhead Towne Center
description:
About the Role

As a Department Manager, you’ll be the leader supporting and encouraging your whole team. By bringing everyone together, you’ll be able to create an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration and an entrepreneurial spirit, helping you, your team, and H&M succeed. Ensuring an excellent operational & visual experience for your store, customers & colleagues. You’ll be aware of your store’s strengths, opportunities, and competitors. Analyze and follow up on sales, and create plans to optimize results and profits.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

  • You are responsible for the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to global guidelines
  • Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during customer interactions
  • Be aware of and take responsibility of your department's strengths and identifying commercial opportunities and acting on them
  • Establish & analyze sales and budget goals, creating plans to optimize results
  • Ensure customer service is provided in all areas of the store and that your team has the ability to work towards actively promoting and selling products to customers
  • Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
  • Manage your department in a cost-efficient way
  • Ensure correct routines in fitting room and checkout, including transaction, returns and exchanges
  • Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way


Fashion & Trend Awareness

  • Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors and relevant influencers, etc
  • Ensure your team provides product and fashion knowledge as well as other relevant information during customer interactions


Team & Development

  • Responsible for recruitment, onboarding, performance management, upskilling & developing your team in-store
  • Complete performance evaluations and succession planning to support business & team needs
  • Retain and share your knowledge and skills with your team
  • Collaboration, planning & teamwork with in-store Visual Merchandiser team
  • Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
  • Responsible for the teams planning & scheduling
  • Regular communication to store colleagues to inform, motivate and inspire – daily, weekly meetings, etc
  • Ensure all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store are followed
  • Participate in relevant available Onboarding & introduction processes, trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development


Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

  • Secure a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house including stockroom areas
  • Ensure high fashion quality, visual and commercial product presentation, with good garment care
  • Secure good stock levels and provide input on allocation to Area team
  • Ensure the full garment cycle – from delivery to garment presentation – and fitting room routines are according to our standards and routines set internally, utilizing all tools and technology provided
  • Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
  • Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in-store and throughout the sales floor/store following guidelines according to global and local strategies & sales market/regional requirements to ensure a strong and consistent price perception throughout store
  • Updating & upkeep of BOH Areas for all colleagues (key information, health & safety, tidiness etc)
  • Responsible for opening & closing of store daily

Who You Are

  • To be a successful and effective Department Manager, you’ll be a strong leader who enjoys taking responsibility for others.
  • You must be ambitious, an effective communicator, supportive, an analytical solution finder, capable of working with numbers and managing statistics.
  • You are achievement-oriented, motivated by performance and competition to be truly customer centric.


Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

  • We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
  • We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
  • You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
  • We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
  • You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
  • We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
  • You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Compensation: expected base salary range is $23.56 - $27.09 hourly**
EEOC Code: SLS
Pay Status: Non-Exempt, Hourly


*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company’s discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

We offer: 25% Staff Discount - Medical, Pharmacy Vision and Dental Coverage – Employee Assistance Program - Vacation, Wellness, Holiday and Parental Pay – 401K – Commuter Benefits, Health and Dependent Care FSA. Plus, additional Voluntary Benefits.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organisation. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

At H&M, our purpose is to liberate fashion for the many. We want to shape a new world in Fashion. A world with one ultimate goal: to unleash your self-expression. As an H&M colleague, you’re encouraged to be yourself & more. You’ll take on new responsibilities from day one, learn skills for life, and find new ways to make your big dreams come true.

Our company is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we actively seek colleagues who share our commitment.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

To manage the high volume of applications for roles with leadership responsibilities, we use an online assessment method. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies to predefined criteria set by H&M Group.

After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions.
If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact your application. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

title: 2027 Spring Software Engineer Co-op (Billerica, MA)
description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.


What We Offer


Location:

Billerica,MA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Software Engineering Co-Op students will have the opportunity to design software that directly manipulates machinery in a factory process setting. Software Engineering at Applied NEXX is a highly hands-on environment, with many days spent in the lab developing software directly on the machines themselves. This provides a unique opportunity to see the direct impact of your efforts in a way that few engineers get to experience. At Applied NEXX, students will have the opportunity to develop software that directly contributes to the production of chips that power phones, computers, and IoT (Internet of Things) devices used across the globe.


Co-Op students in the Software Engineering group become full members of the team and participate in all aspects of software design, extending beyond coding alone. You will join a cohort of students serving in vital roles across Engineering and Operations at Applied NEXX. In addition, you will participate in monthly co-op events, including lunch with the General Manager of Applied NEXX, a career panel, and final presentations.


Responsibilities:

  • Design/code/test new features for various software applications, including but not limited to: robotics, motion control, automation, data analysis and user interfaces
  • Work closely with Software, Mechanical, Electrical, and Process Engineers to coordinate the development of new software features as well as resolve field issues
  • Analyze data from customer machines to find and resolve software issues

Position Requirements:

  • Actively pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science,
    Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering
  • Experience in Object Oriented languages and design
  • Ability to thoroughly consider edge cases and unintentional side effects of software changes being made
  • Capability to document, explain and design test plans for software they have developed

Preferred Requirements:

  • Third or fourth year student in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering
  • C, C#, .NET, and Windows software development experience
  • Experience in user interface design using C# and XAML
  • Experience in robotics and motion control

Compensation:
$37 - $45

Additional Information

Time Type:

Full time

Employee Type:

Intern / Student

Travel:

Not Specified

Relocation Eligible:

Yes

In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable.

title: Senior Platform Performance Engineer
description:
WE ARE GAME MAKERS

Who We Are:

We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games. We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better.

Who we are:

We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games. 31st Union is looking for a Senior Platform Performance Engineer to help support our AAA multiplatform Unreal Engine 5 title on consoles and PC with 60+ FPS Quality and 120+ FPS Performance modes.   • Minimum 5+ years experience in AAA game development, including at least one shipped console title
  • Deep understanding of modern real-time rendering techniques and GPU hardware
  • Deep understanding of Unreal Engine 5 and underlying technologies
  • Ability to write, debug, and analyze shaders and pipelines using platform GPU performance and debugging tools
  • A shipped rendering optimization or approximation of your own design that you can walk us through in detail
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

Relevant Experience:

  • Experience with PS5, PS5 Pro, and Xbox Series X|S development tools and platform requirements
  • Unreal Engine 5 optimization
  • Experience defining content budgets and standards with technical artists, such as LOD, asset validation, mesh and texture streaming, etc.

title: International Student Recruitment Officer
description:
Nazarbayev University is seeking a for International Student Recruitment Officer to support the implementation of the University’s international recruitment activities.

The Officer will work with prospective international students, educational agents, schools, and internal stakeholders to attract qualified applicants to foundation, undergraduate, master’s, and doctoral programs, including fee-paying programs.

Key responsibilities:

  • Implement international student recruitment activities in line with the Department’s approved plans and targets;
  • Represent the University at international education fairs, exhibitions, webinars, presentations, and other recruitment events;
  • Deliver presentations and consultations to prospective international students on academic programs, admission requirements, student life, and career opportunities;
  • Coordinate operational communication with education agents, recruitment partners, consultants, and international schools;
  • Organize training sessions for recruitment agents on the University’s programs, admission requirements, and student experience;
  • Provide administrative support in preparing agreements, documentation, and reports related to recruitment agents and partners;
  • Collect feedback and proposals from agents and submit relevant matters to the Director for consideration;
  • Analyze previous recruitment results and contribute to annual recruitment planning;
  • Conduct market research to identify new recruitment opportunities, target markets, and international education trends;
  • Prepare recommendations aimed at improving recruitment performance and achieving enrollment targets;
  • Support international applicants throughout the admissions process and refer complex cases to the relevant specialists when required;
  • Participate in discussions related to admission rules and partial scholarship opportunities for international students;
  • Collaborate with Schools and other University units on recruitment events, marketing activities, and applicant support.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in education, management, international relations, or another relevant field;
  • A master’s degree in a relevant field is an advantage;
  • A degree from an institution where English was the language of instruction is an advantage.

Professional experience:

  • At least five years of relevant professional experience in higher education, student recruitment, student services, international cooperation, education consulting, or event coordination;
  • Demonstrated experience working with external partners, educational agencies, international schools, or student recruitment agents;
  • Experience in international student recruitment is strongly preferred.

Knowledge and skills:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment;
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills;
  • Ability to manage several activities and projects simultaneously and meet deadlines;
  • Ability to prepare professional reports, analytical briefs, and presentations;
  • Understanding of international education trends and cross-cultural communication;
  • Knowledge of Kazakhstan’s education and migration requirements relevant to international students is an advantage;
  • Strong attention to detail, personal responsibility, and results orientation;
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.

Language requirements:

  • Fluency in English;
  • Knowledge of Kazakh and Russian;
  • Knowledge of additional languages is a strong advantage.

The role involves regular cooperation with academic Schools, administrative units, international partners, educational agents, prospective students, and their families. The successful candidate must be willing to travel internationally and represent Nazarbayev University at recruitment events, partner meetings, and education exhibitions.

The position requires a high level of professionalism, discretion, accountability, and commitment to the mission and values of Nazarbayev University.

Recruitment and selection process

Recruitment and selection at Nazarbayev University include preliminary selection based on experience and qualifications, followed by assessments and formal interviews. Formal interviews are typically based on organizational values and behaviors and conducted in English.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Every mind is unique. Yet much of the world is still built for what’s considered "normal," leaving too many people behind. At Everway, we change that by creating technology that helps everyone understand and be understood. By understanding and addressing the unique needs of each individual, we're creating a world where differences are recognized and valued.

Our careers fit real life. When you join us, you’re not just taking a job. You’re joining a movement to build a more neuroinclusive world. We’re a global community of over 800 employees spanning North America, UK, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. A career here is purposeful and fast-moving, with clear expectations, modern tools, and the clarity to focus on what matters most.

Our people are supported and encouraged to show up as they are, with different ways of thinking welcomed and valued. We pride ourselves on our core values that are embedded within our culture. These are to be curious, have courage, and commit fully.

Join us at Everway - together, we can unlock the full potential of every mind.

About the role

Everway is building a modern data capability to help teams make better decisions across the business. As a Data Analyst, you'll work with colleagues across Information Systems and other functions to transform data into meaningful insight that supports operational, commercial and product decisions.

You'll be part of our Data Team, helping maintain high-quality data, developing reporting, and identifying trends that enable the business to act with confidence.

Main Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Collect, clean and analyse data from a variety of sources.
  • Help maintain data quality, accuracy and consistency.
  • Develop and maintain data models, dashboards and reports.
  • Work with stakeholders to understand data requirements and business questions.
  • Analyse trends and patterns to generate actionable insights.
  • Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support data-driven initiatives across the business.
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of data-driven solutions.
  • Keep up to date with developments in data analysis tools and best practice.

Essential Criteria

  • Degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, computer science or software engineering.
  • 2+ years' experience in a Data Analyst or similar role.
  • Proficiency with SQL, Excel and at least one analytical programming language such as Python or R.
  • Understanding of data modelling and statistical analysis.
  • Experience creating dashboards and visualisations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI or Looker Studio.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and works effectively with colleagues across the business.
  • Demonstrates attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, reliable data.

Desirable Criteria.

  • Experience with Databricks or similar data platforms
  • Experience working in an agile environment.
  • Experience within the education technology sector.
  • Familiarity with Confluence or a similar documentation platform.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve analysis, reporting or workflow efficiency.

title: Car Detailer - Bronx, NY (PT)
description:
We’re looking for entry-level Lot Attendants to build an exciting career at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500! As a Lot Attendant, you will be focused on maintaining the cleanliness and appearance of the vehicles at our Market Hubs. As part of this role, you will be expected to coordinate with fellow employees to ensure timely deliveries and the highest level of customer satisfaction. Interested in joining the team? Check out more below:

  • This is a part-time position
  • PTO and paid holidays + your birthday is a holiday

Unlock Your Earning Potential!

We offer a competitive starting hourly rate of $19/hr with significant growth opportunities based on performance. You can boost your earnings within a short timeframe:

  • Pay Range: $19-$20 hourly
  • Starting Pay: $19/hr
  • At 3 Months: $19.25/hr
  • At 6 Months: $19.50/hr
  • At 9 Months: $19.75/hr
  • At 12 Months: $20/hr

In your first year, you can progress from $19hr to $20hr through our performance-based Careers Not Jobs program, which provides four merit opportunities annually. Through this program, eligible team members can enjoy an additional $0.25 increase in their pay every 90 days.

We’re looking for enthusiastic, energetic, and self-motivated team players to:

  • Ensure each vehicle is inspected for mechanical, drivability or cosmetic concerns
  • Wash and vacuum all inventory on a regular basis
  • Complete multi-point inspection on arriving inventory to include fuel level, safety features, drivability test and proper display of all company and state disclosures
  • Maintain positive relationships with coworkers and external vendors
  • Interact and communicate with team members and management across all lines of the business.
  • Must adhere to regular and predictable attendance.

General qualifications and requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent is desirable
  • Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver’s license
  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record for the past 3 years
  • Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels.
  • Must be able to carry and transport up to 60 pounds up to 20 feet.
  • Requires standing for an extended period of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking and stooping, pushing and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance.
  • Requires working outdoors in all weather conditions.
  • Requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity.
  • Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment.
  • Requires frequent driving and some typing.
  • Must adhere to regular and predictable attendance.

About Carvana

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

Being a brand ambassador of Carvana means having a passion for our vision and having a motor that never quits when it comes to representing our brand and values. Our Market Operations team members work as a team to deliver awesome customer experiences in their markets, while also remaining agile enough to keep up with the ever-changing beat and cadence of your daily activities.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

title: Hi-ab and Logistics Operator (12-month fixed term)
description:

title: Staff SW QA Engineer
description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:

Provides technical expertise for software quality assurance activities, including risk management activities following ISO 14971. Supports the development and implementation of scalable quality systems, risk management practices, and software compliance strategies that ensure product safety, effectiveness, and regulatory compliance. Partners with senior R&D engineering, quality, regulatory, clinical, cybersecurity, and business leaders to drive continuous improvements to SDLC, and quality excellence throughout the product lifecycle. Influences organizational quality strategy and serves as a recognized subject matter expert in software quality.

Where you come in:

  • You will serve as a technical leader and subject matter expert for software quality, risk management, software lifecycle compliance activities.
  • You will lead the effective application, compliance, and continuous improvement of software development and V&V processes, including: Risk Management, Software Design Controls for Class I/II Exempt Applications & Components
  • You will lead complex software quality initiatives spanning multiple products, programs, and functional organizations.
  • You will lead risk assessments for software anomalies, cybersecurity vulnerabilities, emerging technologies, and post-market issues.
  • You will support digital transformation initiatives (ALM, SCM, PLM) to evolve use of electronic systems supporting SDLC as defined per IEC62304.
  • You will provide technical oversight and direction for software risk management activities, including DFMEA, PFMEA, SHA, and hazard analysis.
  • You will review and approve critical quality deliverables, including software development lifecycle documentation, risk artifacts, V&V protocols, and design history file content.
  • You will drive organizational improvements related to software quality systems, development practices, automation, verification, validation, and compliance processes.
  • You will evaluate emerging regulations, standards, and industry trends and assess impact to existing and future products.
  • You will collaborate with senior leadership to define quality strategies supporting business objectives and product roadmaps, implementing a right-sized QMS applications based on Software Classification per IEC62304.
  • You will mentor and provide technical leadership to software quality engineers and cross-functional development teams.
  • You will influence project, product, and organizational decisions through expert risk-based quality assessments and recommendations.
  • You will assume and perform other duties as assigned.

What makes you successful:

  • You have extensive medical device experience demonstrated expertise in FDA 21 CFR Part 820, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 82304, EU MDR, and applicable global regulatory requirements.
  • You have advanced knowledge of software development lifecycle processes and software development methodologies including Agile, Waterfall, DevOps, Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), and Test Automation.
  • You have deep experience with software quality engineering across requirements, architecture, design, development, testing, release, and post-market activities.
  • You have advanced understanding of software risk management principles, methodologies, and regulatory expectations.
  • You have demonstrated ability to influence organizational direction and lead cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
  • You have strong understanding of software architectures, cloud technologies, distributed systems, cybersecurity principles, and data platforms.
  • You have experience supporting regulatory inspections and direct interactions with FDA, notified bodies, and external auditors.
  • You have exceptional written, verbal, and executive-level communication skills.
  • You have the ability to manage ambiguity, influence senior stakeholders, and drive complex programs to successful completion.
  • You have demonstrated success mentoring engineers and developing organizational quality capabilities.

What you’ll get:

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.
  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.
  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.

title: Sr. Food Science & Data Analytics Specialist
description:
The Senior Food Science & Data Analytics Specialist serves as the technical and analytical lead for the Research & Development department, leading data management, reporting, and insights. This role requires a curious, results-driven, and self-starting individual who can combine a strong food science background with analytical thinking to identify meaningful trends, investigate what is driving the data, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

This position is responsible for transforming complex information into actionable business intelligence that supports product trends, sensory evaluation, risk management, regulatory compliance, supplier performance, product quality, and operational excellence. The successful candidate will go beyond reporting what the data shows by determining what is important, identifying risks and opportunities, asking the right follow-up questions, and recommending specific actions and improvements based on their findings.

The role partners across R&D (FSQR & Product Development), Supply Chain, Operations, International, Distribution, IT, and supplier partners to develop data-driven solutions that improve decision making and strengthen food safety and quality performance throughout the Dairy Queen system.

This position combines expertise in food science with data analytics, serving as a subject matter expert for data analytics, regulatory intelligence, emerging risk identification, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to build and shape a growing R&D analytics capability, with broad exposure across Food Safety, Quality, Regulatory, and Product Development. The individual will have the opportunity to expand their technical and business expertise, influence how data is used across R&D, and grow their impact as the capability evolves. Success in this role means leveraging food science expertise and data analytics to uncover meaningful insights and translate them into actions that drive results and continuous improvement.

Accountabilities:

R&D Data Strategy, Governance, Reporting & Executive Insights

  • Establish and lead a new R&D data analytics capability that enables Food Safety, Quality, Regulatory, and Product Development teams to use data to identify risks and opportunities, solve problems, improve products, and support business decisions.

  • Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, recurring reports, and executive summaries across R&D data, including project performance, supplier and product performance, quality trends, emerging issues, and key risk indicators.

  • Translate complex datasets into clear insights, recommendations, presentations, and business cases that drive action and inform R&D leadership and cross-functional decision making.

  • Establish data governance and reporting practices that improve data quality, consistency, accessibility, and effective use of analytics across R&D.

  • Build R&D capability through technical guidance, training, and adoption of data and analytics tools.

FSQR Data Analytics & Insights

  • Analyze food safety, quality, supplier, audit, complaint, regulatory, operational, cold chain, and laboratory testing data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.

  • Develop predictive and risk-based analytics that enable proactive identification and management of food safety, supplier quality, product performance, and compliance concerns.

  • Support regulatory and traceability initiatives, including FSMA 204 data management, compliance reporting, and restaurant support through established data management tools.

Product Development & Innovation Analytics

  • Analyze sensory evaluation, product benchmark, consumer insight, market performance, and competitive data to improve product success criteria and inform innovation strategy.

  • Build and leverage consolidated, searchable product profiles across current and historical products, LTOs, formulations, product attributes, launch details, market performance, and key learnings to identify sensory white spaces, competitive and regional trends, product similarities, benchmarking opportunities, and process improvements that accelerate concept development and product matching.

The US national base salary range for this position is $74,968 - $89,962. The base salary range displayed reflects the targeted hiring range for positions across all US locations. Individual pay is determined by job-related skills, work location and relevant education or experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Nutrition, Quality Assurance, or equivalent related experience in lieu of a degree. Coursework, experience, or demonstrated interest in data analytics or statistics.

  • 3- 5 years of progressive responsibility experience in food safety, quality assurance, regulatory affairs, data analytics, or related disciplines.

  • Experience working within restaurants/food service, food manufacturing, franchising, or supply chain environments preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex projects and cross-functional initiatives from analysis through implementation.

  • Proficiency with data visualization and business tools such as Power BI, Domo, Tableau, or similar platforms, along with strong Microsoft Office Skills.

  • Experience with SQL, databases, data modeling, reporting automation, and data governance/validation practices

  • Knowledge of AI-enabled productivity and analytics tools, including Microsoft Copilot, with the ability to identify opportunities to improve efficiency and analytical capabilities

  • Experience with food safety, quality, audit, complaint, regulatory, or workflow management systems.

  • Strong understanding of food science principals and current industry and technical issues, with the ability to apply technical knowledge to root cause analysis, problem-solving, and risk identification.

  • Demonstrated ability to organize and analyze complex data, identify meaningful trends and conclusions, and apply statistical concepts to translate findings into actional recommendations.

  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical and analytical information into clear, easy to understand insights for a variety of audiences.

  • Ability to influence through logic, data, and technical credibility, build effective relationships with internal and external partners, and deliver constructive feedback when needed.

  • Self-starter with strong initiative, accountability, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive work through completion in a fast-paced changing environment.

  • Ability to work occasionally during evenings and weekends as needed to meet project deadlines and travel up to 20%.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Benefits

Benefit eligible employees may receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical and dental coverage, 401K match, paid time off (including volunteer time as well as parental leave) and so much more! To learn more about our great benefit offerings, Click Here.

Work Environment

Most positions located out of our global headquarters in Bloomington, MN will work a hybrid work schedule where you will work 3 collaboration days a week. Additional in office time may be required to support team/project needs.

Inclusion & Belonging

We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging for all who touch DQ. We believe in and commit to fostering a community where employees bring their authentic selves to work, and where we recruit, engage, and retain employees, franchise owners, and suppliers based on qualifications and merit. We strive to maintain an environment where everyone feels welcome.

IDQ is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we use E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new team members. You must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship.

title: SurreySussexPDL
description:
Senior MSK Physiotherapist and Physiotherapy Development Lead | Sussex and Surrey
Salary £36,000 - £48,000

Your purpose

Our Physiotherapy Development Lead will play a leading role in advancing our patient care standards and clinical excellence, taking Ascenti to the next level.

You will empower our Leadership Team to build the clinical capability of their teams, plan and manage clinical skills development and upgrading, leading specialist clinical training across your region; at the same time as being on hand to provide expert clinical advice and direction where needed.

Building strong relationships within your partner region, you will provide top quality advice about clinical standards and the optimal development of each individual clinician. You’ll ensure that we live our values from the inside out, particularly in relation to safeguarding, patient safety and clinical procedures.

How your role fits within our team

The Physiotherapy Development Lead will report to the Area Leadership Team and will have a dotted-line to our Head of Clinical Excellence. You’ll be a senior MSK physiotherapist, so you’ll know what best practice looks like and you’ll role model this in your everyday work.

You’ll be responsible for facilitating the clinical development and empowering high performance of all clinicians within your region. Clinicians will seek you out when they need advice and support in their clinical practice; particularly when a clinical mentor suggests that a more complex or serious case, needs a more experienced hand to resolve.

Key responsibilities

In addition to your normal duties and responsibilities of a physiotherapist, your role has following additional responsibilities:

United - collaboration

  • Identifying learning and development needs of your team of clinicians and addressing them directly and through your team of mentors; ensuring that all physiotherapists maintain required records of their continuous professional development
  • Support area and regional managers with the induction processes
  • Assisting, where needed, in clinical processes such as the promotion pathway and assessment and addressing any practice concerns amongst your team
  • Supporting Ascenti’s culture of recognition and our commitment to high performing teams, by identifying clinicians who demonstrate excellence in their practice
  • Promote staff wellbeing, engagement and collaboration; through technology, development programs and company-wide initiatives. This helps to create a safe environment where colleagues feel safe and bring their true selves to work, promoting a culture of openness, diversity and healthy well-being

Dependable – clinical excellence

  • Act as the clinical expert and role model for your region; be available and confident to answer complex clinical questions
  • Maintain high standards of professional conduct and abide by core standards of practice outlined by the HCPC and CSP
  • Delivering one-to-one and group training, both face-to-face and remotely
  • Coaching and developing a team of clinical mentors to deliver effective teaching sessions
  • Ensuring the consistent application of our clinical development programme in line with regional and individual learning needs
  • Effectively managing patients with complex conditions using a wide range of advanced physiotherapy skills, including injection therapy (where appropriate), manual physiotherapy techniques, self-management advice, virtual physiotherapy and therapeutic handling

Caring - performance and reporting

  • Taking responsibility for the clinical quality and performance metrics of your region by regularly evaluating clinical data; identifying and implementing improvement strategies, where necessary, to deliver excellent outcomes and experience to all patients and clients
  • Demonstrate a broad range of advanced and specialised communications skills (with patients, physiotherapists, mentors, managers, peers) including appropriate written communication and the ability to engage in critical dialogue with a range of audiences of different levels of knowledge and expertise
  • Manage complaints in a timely and professional manner
  • Support the regional managers and area managers with the SASSY policy
  • Demonstrating excellence in report writing and records keeping on the Ascenti IT system
  • Keeping up with best practice, ensuring that our services are delivered in line with our high standards

Great benefits and rewards

Join Ascenti and you will enjoy a great benefits package with a range of hours options such as flexible, part-time and condensed hour '4 day weeks', along with 25 days' holiday (+bank holidays), enhanced family (mat & pat) leave, Vitality at Work membership, free and discounted healthcare services and many other perks and rewards. If you think this job looks good but isn't for you, you can even earn rewards without working for Ascenti. Refer a friend by following the instructions here and receive a £200 shopping voucher if they are successful.

Join us today

Ascenti can also offer you sponsorship to work in the UK if you need it, so please don't let that put you off applying. You probably feel like clicking apply. If you do, then go for it. It will take you two minutes and it is not essential that you include a CV. If you are a qualified physiotherapist then Ascenti want to talk to you, and someone will be in touch soon.

Click apply and find out more!

Qualifications

Knowledge experience and qualifications

  • A competent leader with excellent people skills and the ability to support the development of peers and teams into high performers.
  • Demonstrates a commitment to learning, being able to evaluate your own practice, takes responsibility for learning and seeking opportunities to develop self and support immediate teams.
  • Experience in mentoring clinicians, to support and coach them to realise their full potential.
  • Proven experience as a specialist practitioner where you wish to mentor other specialists.
  • Minimum 4 years post-graduate musculoskeletal physiotherapy practice experience; preferably in both public and private settings.
  • Full HCPC and CSP registered Physiotherapist
  • An up to date CPD folder which demonstrates your commitment to professional development (must be verified by Head of Clinical Excellence prior to interview)

title: Installation Engineer
description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.


What We Offer


Location:

Kiryat Gat,ISR

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.

As an Installation Engineer, you are part of the Customer Engineer Team, and you will play a key role in bringing cutting-edge semiconductor equipment online at some of the world's most advanced manufacturing facilities. Working alongside experienced Customer Engineers, you'll gain hands-on exposure to complex technologies, solve challenging technical problems, and directly impact customer success.

This is an exciting opportunity for engineers who enjoy hands-on technical work, customer interaction, international travel, and working in diverse manufacturing environments.

Travel abroad : Up to 75% to customer sites abroad

As part of our comprehensive development program, you will complete an initial paid six-month onboarding and training phase. This immersive experience will provide extensive technical learning, practical field exposure, and the opportunity to collaborate with global experts.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Senior Customer Engineers to install, commission, maintain, and upgrade Applied Materials equipment at customer sites.
  • Support equipment startup and acceptance activities to ensure successful deployment and operational readiness.
  • Utilize digital diagnostic tools, equipment analytics, and troubleshooting methodologies to identify and resolve technical issues.
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on advanced electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas delivery systems.
  • Diagnose equipment performance issues and implement solutions with support from senior team members and technical experts.
  • Build strong relationships with customers through professional communication and technical expertise.
  • Maintain compliance with all safety, quality, and operational procedures while working in customer manufacturing environments.
  • Document maintenance activities, service reports, and technical findings accurately and professionally.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and other business needs as required.

Prior semiconductor experience is beneficial but not required for candidates with strong technical aptitude and relevant industry experience.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Associate degree / bachelor's degree in electrical engineering / mechanical engineering / Mechatronics, Military technical training, Trade certification, or equivalent technical experience
  • 1+ years of experience in field service, maintenance, manufacturing support, installation engineering, or a related technical role
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
  • Basic mechanical and technical aptitude involving pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum systems, or thermodynamics
  • Familiarity with hand tools, power tools, and test equipment, including digital multimeters
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills both in Hebrew and in English
  • Basic proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Valid driver's license
  • Willingness and ability to travel abroad ~75% of the time

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with semiconductor equipment or in cleanroom environments
  • Experience supporting customers in a technical field service capacity
  • Knowledge of vacuum systems, automation, robotics, process equipment, or precision manufacturing technologies
  • Experience identifying and resolving technical issues through structured troubleshooting

As this role is frequently performed within semiconductor manufacturing cleanrooms, employees are required to wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), including coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields where required.

Additional Information

Time Type:

Full time

Employee Type:

Assignee / Regular

Travel:

Relocation Eligible:

No

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Customer Experience Representative
description:
Certified Group is committed to partnering with customers to deliver innovative scientific solutions and expertise – So The World Can Trust In What It Consumes™. Our network of 30+ North American and European laboratories serves the food & beverage, dietary supplements, cosmetics, OTC, tobacco/nicotine, cannabis, and hemp industries.

Our Brands

Certified Group is comprised of a set of specialized brands that collectively deliver laboratory testing, regulatory consulting, and certification & audit services across highly regulated industries:

  • Certified Laboratories – Provides comprehensive analytical and microbiological testing, primarily supporting food, beverage, cosmetics, OTC, and dietary supplement industries.
  • Food Safety Net Services (FSNS) – A leading network of ISO-accredited laboratories across North America, focused on food safety testing, operational support, and technical services for the food industry.
  • Labstat – A global leader in contract research and testing for nicotine, tobacco, cannabis, hemp, and next-generation products, with deep expertise in analytical chemistry and toxicology.
  • EAS Consulting Group – A regulatory consulting firm offering expert guidance, training, and auditing support across FDA, USDA, and other regulated sectors, powered by a large network of independent advisors.
  • FSNS Certification & Audit – Provides accredited third-party auditing and certification services, including food safety, animal welfare, and GMP programs.

We are currently looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our team!


The Customer Experience Representative I is the primary interface between the clients and the laboratory for daily phone interactions and routine daily client requests. This role is responsible for all client services’ work necessary to support the field sales team and lab, sample submissions, and related duties.

This position will route requests to the appropriate expert: Supervisor, Associate Director, Director of Laboratory Technical Services, Technical Supervisor, Lab Manager, as well as other subject matter experts to assist clients, managing follow-up to ensure responses are received by the customer in a timely manner.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Works directly with clients, technical teams, and sales to ensure the optimum customer experience.
  • Provides proactive customer service to include contacting customers via phone, email, video chat and other means to communicate relevant information and updates about their testing.
  • Monitors testing report due dates, follows up with lab managers on delayed due dates and proactively informs the customer of any delays prior to the initially anticipated due date.
  • Ensure all customer inquiries, by all points of communication, are handled in a timely and efficient manner. Ensures that all client issues are resolved.
  • Keeps a pulse on client interactions and proactively communicates escalating issues to the Laboratory Director and Sales.
  • Routes customer requests and complaints to the appropriate team members and follows up to ensure a timely closure of each case.
  • Carries out client requests per instructions and keeps appropriate records.
  • Collaborates with sales on current and new business opportunities.
  • Assists management and sales in client relations, client communications, client literature dispersal (including special presentations, letters, mail outs, memos, overnight shipping, and packets), special arrangements or administrative projects and standard operating procedures.
  • Awareness of processes, procedures, and techniques in accordance with the Certified Group’s Methods Manual, Quality Manual, Chemical Hygiene Plan, Safety Manual, and approved laboratory procedures as they relate to the administrative functions of the laboratory.
  • Performs other duties as needed.

Education and Experience:

  • Preferred one or more years of experience in customer relations to include clerical assistance, customer service, MS Office software usage, preferred.
  • Some college education is required. Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Applied business experience with food, cosmetic, nutraceuticals, or CPG related companies desired.
  • Laboratory and scientific experience are a plus.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience is acceptable.

Skills:

  • Read and comprehend instructions, correspondence, and memos and convert them into action.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Commitment to detailed, accurate, and timely results.
  • Ability to multi-task, plan, and organize.
  • Effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients, and other employees of the organization.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.
  • Basic Excel skills are essential.

General Requirements:

  • Some schedule flexibility will be required as work load my vary from week to week.
  • Ability to work constructively with others in a traditional office environment.
  • Comfort with prolonged sitting and viewing of computer screens.
  • Work effectively under stress with interruptions and deadlines.
  • Ability to think logically and plan strategies to achieve desired outcomes.

Physical Demands/Work Environment:

  • Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse and to handle other communications/computer components
  • Potential exposure to odors, fumes, airborne particles, hazardous chemicals, and microbiological pathogens
  • Noise level varies from quiet to loud
  • Temperature varies from hot to cold
  • Color vision and depth perception
  • Interactive and fast-paced team-oriented tasks
  • Regularly lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Schedule: Monday-Friday from 8:00am-5:00pm, evening and weekends if needed.

title: Silicon Front End CAD Engineer
description:
Grow with us

About this opportunity:

Silicon Front-End CAD Engineer
Austin, Texas.This is not a remote work opportunity

Shape the platform Ericsson’s silicon engineers use every day to simulate, verify, check, and emulate their designs. Combine Python software engineering with front-end EDA expertise and practical AI to make our flows faster, broader, and easier to use.
Work on ASIC and FPGA programs for Ericsson’s 5G and 6G portfolio at advanced nodes, including Intel 18A and TSMC 3/2nm. Drive measurable gains in flow runtime, onboarding time, and engineering productivity by taking new flows from pilot to production and extending OneRun to hardware emulation.

Ericsson Silicon develops ASICs and FPGAs for telecommunications infrastructure. We are seeking a hands-on engineer to extend and optimize OneRun, our Python-based front-end flow platform used by more than 600 engineers—not simply support existing tools. OneRun gives engineers one consistent interface to simulation, formal, and lint/CDC/RDC flows, and lets equivalent tools from different EDA vendors be swapped without changing how they work.
You will join our front-end CAD team across Austin, Stockholm, Lund, and India, partnering with IP and SoC design and verification teams, emulation engineers, CI and back-end flow owners, and EDA vendors. Own qualified engineering solutions in your area; partner with the Silicon CAD Technical Program Manager on delivery and adoption. Project technical leads retain signoff approval.
What you will do
• Evolve the OneRun platform: Extend its architecture, plugins, and APIs with clean, well-tested Python. Keep tool abstraction layers vendor-agnostic so flows run unchanged across Cadence and Synopsys tools.
• Bring up new pilot flows: Script and integrate new tools and flows, pilot them on real IP and SoC designs, and promote them to production once they meet agreed acceptance criteria.
• Enable emulation through OneRun: Bring emulation compile, run, and debug into OneRun so teams move from simulation to emulation with the same project setup and workflow.
• Optimize performance and usability: Reduce flow runtime, startup overhead, and compute and license use. Simplify setup with project templates, clear error messages, and documentation that shorten onboarding.
• Apply AI to CAD engineering: Use and improve AI tools such as Kiro and ChipAgents for spec-driven development, flow debug, and first-line user support. Validate benefits against reproducible baselines; retain engineering review.
• Deliver production-ready capabilities: Automate OneRun regression testing and release qualification in Jenkins CI, support controlled rollout without disrupting active tapeout schedules, and resolve complex flow issues with users and EDA vendors.

Join our Team

What you will bring
• 5+ years in front-end CAD, EDA flow development, or silicon infrastructure software, with evidence of production deployment supporting ASIC or FPGA projects.
• Strong Python software engineering skills, including modular design, APIs, automated testing with PyTest or equivalent, Linux, Git, code review, CI, and controlled releases.
• Hands-on experience integrating front-end EDA tools such as Xcelium, VCS, JasperGold, or VC SpyGlass, including tool configuration, licensing, and compute farms such as LSF. Specialist depth in one or more domains is valued; expertise in every domain is not required.
• Working knowledge of ASIC/SoC design and verification flows, SystemVerilog, and UVM, so you understand what designers and verification engineers need from their tools.
• Demonstrated ability to turn recurring user problems into reusable platform features, explain technical trade-offs, and collaborate effectively in distributed teams.
• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
Critical exposure:
Hands-on emulation experience with platforms such as Siemens Veloce or Cadence Palladium; practical application of AI/ML or LLM-based tools to flow automation, debug, or user support; building vendor-agnostic EDA frameworks; or measurable improvements in flow runtime, compute efficiency, and adoption.

Own the engineering behind the platform—not just a script within it. Shape how hundreds of engineers run their flows, work directly with design and verification teams and EDA vendors, and turn new tools and AI ideas into production capabilities. Your impact will be measured in faster flows, smoother adoption, and a platform that engineers trust across programs.

What happens once you apply?
Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.

Ericsson uses a merit-based hiring approach that values people with different experiences, perspectives and skillsets. We truly believe this approach drives innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer, learn more.

If you need assistance or to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact Ericsson at hr.direct.americas@ericsson.com.

DISCLAIMER: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees in this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required for this position, and you may be required to perform additional job tasks as assigned.

Primary country and city: USA || Austin, Texas

Job details: Developer

Primary Recruiter: Jim Everett

Compensation and Benefits at Ericsson
At Ericsson, we know that our people are the key to our success. We offer a competitive package to help with your individual needs and goals.

Your Pay
The salary range for this position is dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, location, and the candidate’s combination of job-related knowledge, qualifications, skills, education, training, and experience.

Short-Term Variable Compensation Plan: Your pay also includes the opportunity for an annual bonus. Actual bonus payouts are based on performance of the business against the unit’s objectives, individual performance, and the individual bonus target. Certain eligibility and pro-ration rules apply.

Your Health
Ericsson offers excellent health benefits including the choice of three medical plan options and a dental plan option that allow an employee to select the level of coverage that suits their needs. Employees will receive company credits in an amount equal to the cost that Ericsson pays toward the cost of their medical and dental premiums for themselves and eligible covered dependents.

Your Financial Security

We invest in both your short and long-term financial wellbeing. The Ericsson US 401(k) Plan offers an automatic 3% company contribution and Ericsson match $1 for every $1 you put into the 401(k) Plan on the first 3% of your eligible pay, plus 50 cents on every $1 on the next 2% of eligible pay. When you contribute at least 5% of eligible pay, you are receiving Ericsson’s full matching contributions of 4%. Matching and company automatic contributions stop when your total eligible pay for the year reaches the IRS limits. Employees will also receive company credits in an amount equal to the cost of basic life insurance and basic accidental death and dismemberment coverage, as well as short-term and long-term disability coverage. Employees also have the option to participate in Ericsson’s Stock Purchase Plan.

Your Time
Your work-life balance is important to us. New employees are provided a minimum of 15 days of accrued vacation, up to 3 personal days per year, 11 annual holidays, 8 hours of volunteer time, and 80 hours of sick time annually. Please note paid time off is pro-rated based on the employee’s start date. Furthermore, Ericsson provides up to 16 weeks of paid maternity leave and 6 weeks of parental or adoption leave at 100% of pay.

Additional Benefits
Ericsson offers many other company-paid benefits such as financial wellness programs, educational assistance, matching gifts, and recognition programs.

title: Applied AI Engineer - Consumer Robotics & Voice Systems
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA (on-site/hybrid, 5 days/week)

Type: Full-time hours, hourly contract-to-hire (W-2)

Pay: $40–$80/hour, depending on experience

Schedule: 40 hours/week

Expected duration: 1–3 months, with possible extension

Start: As soon as possible

About Rhem

Rhem Labs is a YC-backed consumer robotics company making personal health companions for the home. We're working on our first two products:

  • Rhemy is a tabletop companion robot you can talk to. It helps you keep track of your health, manage appointments and routines, call family, and get everyday tasks done.
  • Rhosie is a droid with two arms and a wheeled base. We're building it to bring physical help into the home, not just conversation.

For both, the challenge starts with making a robot that can understand you naturally, remember what you need, and follow through.

What you'll work on

  • Build and integrate full-duplex voice models that listen and speak naturally, including streaming audio, barge-in, interruptions, turn-taking, and latency optimization.
  • Design AI orchestration so the assistant can select tools, call APIs, execute multi-step tasks, and reliably manage background work across conversations.
  • Run and debug the voice and agent stack on Android and embedded hardware, including microphones, speakers, audio pipelines, and device-level integration.
  • Test on the actual tabletop device, identify failures end-to-end, and ship improvements quickly with the founding team.

What we're looking for

  • Real-time voice AI experience: hands-on work with duplex speech-to-speech models or comparable low-latency streaming voice systems. You understand audio streaming, turn-taking, and interruption handling.
  • AI orchestration experience: you've built agent workflows with tool/function calling, state management, async jobs, failure handling, and real-world integrations—not just chat demos.
  • Android + device integration: experience developing or integrating software on Android, and comfort debugging audio and software on physical embedded devices.
  • Strong Python skills; ability to own, debug, and ship features independently.
  • Available on-site in San Francisco, 40 hours per week, with an ASAP start.
  • Nice to have: Kotlin/Java, C++, WebRTC, Android audio APIs, audio DSP/echo cancellation, or embedded Linux. Robotics experience is not required.

Why join

You'll work directly with the founders on some of the hardest problems in voice AI and consumer robotics. You'll own core parts of Rhemy's voice and agent systems, ship code directly to hardware, and have the freedom to make real technical decisions.

We're hiring initially on a 1–3 month contract, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time founding engineering role as we grow.

title: APPPreston
description:
Advanced Physiotherapy Practitioner | Preston | Full-time

Salary: £50,000-£58,000

Your purpose

As an Advanced Physiotherapy Practitioner (APP) you will be a clinical leader within Ascenti and work at the highest level to promote research-informed practice and clinical excellence across all that we do.

You will provide an advanced level of care to NHS patients presenting with a variety of complex conditions, using contemporary evidence-informed methodologies and with the technology, tools, and support that you need to thrive as an APP.

How your role fits within our team

You will work on your own in clinic or from home, but you will never feel alone.

As an Advanced Physiotherapy Practitioner (APP) you will collaborate with a range of other senior staff and departments across Ascenti, helping to shape our clinical philosophy and development curriculum.

You will also work closely with partners from the NHS service you work on and the managers in your region, at the same time as using our modern online tools to connected with our wider community of 300+ Ascenti physiotherapists.

Key responsibilities

  • Managing patients Independently manage your own clinical caseload of NHS patients presenting with a wide variety of complex conditions and goals.
  • Use high quality neuromusculoskeletal assessment skills to develop evidence-informed and highly effective management plans, utilising advanced theoretical and practical knowledge of complex and / or chronic presentation.
  • Determine clinical diagnosis and formulate individualised management and treatment plans, which may include: advice and discharge, referral to physiotherapy or other professions for management, request further investigations and diagnostic procedures (MRI, X-rays, blood tests) and interpret these in order to appropriately lead the assessment and direction of the patient’s pathway of care.
  • Work to fully understand the wider integrated NHS MSK service and local pathways across primary care, secondary care, and the voluntary sector, including referral criteria and scope of services.
  • Use your outstanding and well-developed patient communication skills to build rapport and inspire trust, managing sensitive subjects and cultural differences diplomatically and professionally.
  • Manage high quality patient notes, future appointments, PROMS (patient reported outcome measures) and compliance using the appropriate NHS and Ascenti systems.

Quality & safety

Maintain high standards of professional conduct and abide by core standards of practice outlined by the HCPC and CSP.

Complete advanced physiotherapy training modules and uphold these standards across all that you do.

Work closely with your manager to identify and manage any risks that may affect quality of care or service.

Personal development

  • Work closely with our Clinical Development Team and your regional training leads to collaborate on any complex cases and advance your practice and the practice of others.
  • Use our award-winning clinical development resources, including our online training platform Absorb, to elevate your knowledge and stay on top of best practice.
  • Attend regular online and offline courses and events, that will contribute to your development as a practitioner and keep up-to-date records of your CPD achievements.

Collaboration

  • Build strong working relationships with your NHS colleagues, regional physiotherapy team and contract providers and partners.
  • Develop strong links with secondary care providers in your area, enabling fast track referrals to specialists and consultants for patients who may need further intervention.
  • Act as the first port of call for expertise in the management of musculoskeletal conditions in your area, providing advice to patients, physiotherapists, other healthcare professionals, GPs and consultants.
  • Stay connected and network with the wider Ascenti team using our award-winning staff newsletter, intranet, events, and other social resources.

Knowledge experience and qualifications

Knowledge/skills

  • Performing treatment interventions appropriately for this advanced level of clinical care.
  • Conducting advanced clinical assessments and prescribing evidence-based treatment plans.
  • Core standards of physiotherapy practice and code of conducted outlined by the HCPC and CSP.
  • Excellent IT skills and computer literacy. Strong verbal patient communication skills.
  • Appreciation of ethical obligations in physiotherapy, with a strong sense of professional integrity.
  • Understanding of safety and legal obligations, including patient rights and consent.
  • Knowledge of emerging clinical trends and contemporary best practice. Mentoring or clinical leadership skills.

Experience

  • Extensive post registration experience working at a senior level within speciality area (at least five years in MSK field).
  • Demonstrable experience in ordering and interpreting diagnostics and histology results.
  • Identifying adverse events/near misses and minimises risk associated with assessment and intervention.
  • Evidence of conducting initial assessments, providing diagnosis, and prescribing advanced treatment plans across a wide range of complex MSK conditions.
  • Track record of strong people skills and outstanding communication with patients.
  • Using communication skills effectively and working collaboratively as part of a team or with other physiotherapists.
  • Evidence of reading / studying in the English language and producing well-structured written documents or reports.

Qualifications /membership

  • Chartered Society of Physiotherapy (CSP) recognised degree or diploma in physiotherapy.
  • Post-registration qualification (MSc or equivalent) in Advanced Practice, Orthopaedic Medicine or equivalent.
  • MSc module / diploma in injection therapy (or working towards).
  • Full Health & Care Professions Council (HCPC) membership.
  • Full Chartered Society of Physiotherapists (CSP) membership.
  • CPD folder with evidence of continued professional development.
  • Enhanced DBS check.


Professional standards

We care about doing the right thing by our people and everyone that we work with.

We also expect our people to do the right thing and to model our values and the behaviours outlined in our Code of Conduct.

As an Ascenti employee you will follow key principles and policies covering Safeguarding, Equality Diversity and Inclusion, Data Protection and Risk Management

Additional benefits: hybrid working (1-2 days WFH per week), fully funded Injection Course training, and the option of a condensed working week.
