title: Director II, Enterprise Data Foundation and Operations
description:
Role Summary: We are seeking an experienced and visionary technical leader to join our organization as the Director II, Enterprise Data Foundation & Operations, reporting directly to the Senior Director, APEX Enterprise. In this pivotal role, you will serve as the strategic business owner of the U.S. Commercial Therapeutics and Patient Services data ecosystem—the core engine powering advanced AI, analytics, and commercial products across the enterprise. Holding ultimate accountability for foundational architecture, data governance, acquisition, and operations, you will shape our organization's data-driven culture by ensuring the ecosystem delivers trusted, scalable assets ready to fuel our ML and AI solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Business Data Architecture: Serve as Business Owner of the end-to-end data lifecycle across the Raw, Curated, and Consumption layers. Engineer the definitive, certified enterprise data assets (e.g., 360-degree HCP and Patient views) that serve as the mandatory foundation for all downstream analytics and commercial products.
  • Data Operations Modernization: Lead the transformation of manual, rules-based data operations (syndicated data, promotional data, patient claims, Commercial/Patient MDM) into an automated, AI-driven operations hub.
  • Fit-For-Purpose (FFP) Engineering & Architectural Sign-Off: Partner with the Enterprise Product Organization to engineer FFP data layers that meet precise business requirements. Establish data product standards to ensure that all data product requests are scalable, secure, and minimize technical debt introduced into the ecosystem.
  • Data Governance & Quality Standards: Establish and enforce rigorous enterprise data governance, compliance, and quality frameworks. Partner with business stakeholders and legal/compliance teams to ensure data is clean, secure, and fully compliant with healthcare regulations before it reaches the semantic or application layer.
  • Enterprise Master Data Management (MDM): Direct the strategy and execution of Commercial and Patient MDM. Ensure rigorous data mastering, identity resolution, and interoperability to deliver pristine, 360-degree customer and patient views that serve as the unified source of truth for all downstream analytics, reporting, and AI solutions.
  • Ecosystem Consolidation & Acquisition: Oversee the strategy and operations for acquiring new commercial data streams and managing external data vendors. Lead the consolidation of fragmented legacy data ecosystems into a unified, high-performance data fabric.
  • Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Serve as the principal data engineering liaison to BTS (IT), co-designing the future-state cloud and AI-ready data infrastructure. Lead, manage, and mentor a large, diverse team of business data architects, data stewards, and data operations experts, fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline such as computer science, information technology, engineering, math, or related field (Advanced degree preferred).
  • 15+ years of related professional experience, with 8+ years of deep experience in data engineering, data architecture, or data operations.
  • 5+ years of technical leadership experience, successfully managing large, diverse teams in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Experience in the Pharmaceutical or Life Sciences industry is required, with strong knowledge of industry regulations and compliance requirements related to healthcare data.
  • Proven track record of scaling enterprise data warehouses, MDM solutions, and cloud data ecosystems (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Databricks).
  • Experience transforming manual data operations into automated, DataOps-driven environments (utilizing anomaly detection, automated pipelines, etc.).
  • Exceptional matrix-leadership skills; ability to confidently partner with Business Product Owners while enforcing strict architectural and engineering standards alongside IT (BTS).
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and present highly technical business cases and architectural roadmaps to senior executive leadership.

title: Entry-level Auto Technician
description:
We’re looking for Automotive Mechanics with a minimum of 6 months of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Entry-Level Technician, you’ll be expected to perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 6:00AM-3:00PM

Other perks of the Job

  • 100% company-paid healthcare premiums
  • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!
  • ASE and tool reimbursement programs
  • Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of Technician roles in our Inspection Centers, depending on your level of experience - take a look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

  • Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.
  • Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires
  • Mid-Level (Mechanical Repair / Build / General) Technician (min 3 years of professional experience): perform light to medium automotive repairs and minimal diagnostics on our vehicles
  • Experienced Technician (min 5 years of professional experience): perform extensive repairs and heavy engine work, as well as advanced vehicle diagnostics on all makes and models, including electric and hybrid vehicles

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles
  • Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

title: Solutions Architect

description:

You excel at bridging communication between Engineering, Sales, Design, Operations, and client teams, ensuring everyone shares a clear and unified vision.

You thrive in fast-paced environments where you can influence both strategy and execution, continuously researching and adapting to new technology trends.   • Solid understanding of the end-to-end Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), architectural design principles, and modern software development practices.

  • Proven experience leading technical discovery workshops, gathering requirements, and translating business challenges into solution proposals.
  • Experience developing technical estimates, including effort assessment, team sizing, cost considerations, and delivery risks.

  • Experience creating clear, structured architecture diagrams and technical documentation.

  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to engage directly with C-level executives and international clients.
  • Strong analytical thinking, adaptability, technical curiosity, and ability to research and evaluate emerging technologies.
  • Advanced English proficiency (C1/Fluent) for direct communication with US-based clients.
  • Availability to work 100% on-site in El Salvador.
  • Availability to travel approximately 10% of the time as required.

Nice to Have:

  • Cloud certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Agile certifications related to Scrum, Kanban, or other relevant frameworks.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with Commercial, Sales, and Operations teams throughout the pre-sales process to understand client needs and develop technically and commercially viable solutions.
  • Lead technical discovery workshops to identify business, functional, architectural, infrastructure, and security requirements.
  • Translate client objectives into scalable solution architectures, technical approaches, and implementation recommendations.
  • Develop solution estimates covering effort, team composition, costs, dependencies, and delivery risks.

title: Senior Tech Lead - Devops Engineering
description:
The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Lead with a strong background in DevOps, Cloud Engineering​, AI Engineering and modern infrastructure technologies to lead the design, development and evolution of our technology platforms.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who combines deep expertise in AWS, Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies with the ability to drive engineering best practices, lead technical initiatives and mentor development and infrastructure teams.
The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping our cloud architecture, improving platform scalability, reliability and security, and driving automation across our software delivery lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Provide technical leadership and direction across engineering and DevOps teams.
  • Define and implement scalable, resilient and secure cloud-native architectures.
  • Lead technical design discussions, architecture reviews and technology decisions.
  • Establish engineering standards, best practices and development guidelines.
  • Drive continuous improvement across infrastructure, application delivery and operational processes.
  • Mentor engineers and support the development of technical capabilities within the team.

Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering

  • Design, build and manage cloud infrastructure primarily within AWS.
  • Develop and maintain highly available, scalable and secure cloud environments.
  • Manage containerised applications and orchestration platforms using Kubernetes (K8s).
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Optimise cloud infrastructure for performance, availability, security and cost efficiency.
  • Manage networking, IAM, storage, compute and cloud security configurations.

DevOps & CI/CD

  • Design, implement and optimise CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
  • Drive automation across build, test, release and deployment workflows.
  • Champion DevOps culture, collaboration and continuous delivery practices.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting and observability solutions.
  • Improve system reliability through automation, incident management and proactive problem-solving.
  • Establish and promote effective release management and deployment strategies.

Platform Reliability & Security

  • Drive platform stability, scalability, resilience and operational excellence.
  • Implement best practices around disaster recovery, backup and business continuity.
  • Embed security best practices throughout the development and deployment lifecycle.
  • Identify and resolve complex infrastructure and production performance issues.
  • Promote Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles and practices.

AI, Generative AI & Agentic Engineering

Explore, design and implement AI-driven solutions to enhance engineering productivity, automation and operational efficiency.
Work with Generative AI technologies, Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI-powered development tools.
Design and support the integration of AI agents and agentic workflows into existing applications, platforms and business processes.
Understand agentic AI architectures, including autonomous agents, tool calling, orchestration, multi-agent systems and workflow automation.
Leverage AI coding assistants and development tools to improve software engineering productivity, code quality and delivery speed.
Support the deployment, integration and scaling of AI/ML workloads within AWS and Kubernetes environments.
Work with AI APIs and frameworks such as OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, LangChain or LangGraph.
Understand the infrastructure, security, scalability and governance considerations associated with deploying and operating AI-powered applications.
Champion the responsible adoption of AI technologies across engineering teams, identifying opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve technical delivery.

Additional AI & Agentic Technology Experience
Ideally, candidates will also have exposure to:
Generative AI, LLMs and prompt engineering.
Agentic AI frameworks and architectures.
AI agent orchestration and multi-agent workflows.
Amazon Bedrock or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI or similar frameworks.
Integration of AI models and services through APIs.
Deploying and managing AI-powered applications in cloud-native environments.
AI-assisted software development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or Claude Code.
Understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases and AI application architecture.

AI & Agentic Mindset

We are looking for someone who is genuinely interested in the evolution of AI and agentic technologies, and who can help the organisation understand how these capabilities can be practically applied across its technology landscape. The successful candidate should be comfortable experimenting with emerging AI tools, identifying opportunities for intelligent automation and helping engineering teams adopt AI-enabled development practices.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Significant experience in a Senior DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering or Technical Lead role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS, including services such as EC2, EKS, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudWatch and Lambda.
  • Extensive experience with Kubernetes (K8s) and containerisation technologies such as Docker.
  • Strong experience designing and managing cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation or Pulumi.
  • Strong experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash or Go.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog or ELK.
  • Strong understanding of networking, security, distributed systems and cloud architecture.
  • Experience working with microservices and modern software development architectures.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.

Leadership & Communication

  • Proven ability to lead technical teams and influence engineering direction.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and promoting a culture of knowledge sharing.
  • Ability to balance hands-on technical delivery with strategic technical decision-making.
  • Comfortable taking ownership of complex technical challenges and driving initiatives through to completion.
  • A proactive mindset with a passion for engineering excellence and continuous improvement.

Nice to Have

  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional or equivalent).
  • Experience with AWS EKS and large-scale Kubernetes environments.
  • Exposure to service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd.
  • Experience with GitOps tools such as ArgoCD or Flux.
  • Experience with Helm and Kubernetes operators.
  • Knowledge of serverless architectures and event-driven systems.
  • Experience implementing SRE practices, SLIs, SLOs and error budgets.
  • Experience in highly regulated or enterprise-scale environments.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a technically strong leader who can operate at both architectural and implementation levels. Someone who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, building scalable cloud platforms, driving DevOps transformation and helping engineering teams deliver high-quality software faster and more reliably.
The ideal candidate will be a hands-on technical leader rather than purely a people manager, with the credibility and experience to influence architecture, guide engineering teams and take ownership of mission-critical platforms.

title: Entry-level Auto Technician
description:
We’re looking for Automotive Mechanics with a minimum of 6 months of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Entry-Level Technician, you’ll be expected to perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

    • Starting pay for this position is $16.00/hr
  • Schedule: We are staffing for our first shift at this location. Please keep in mind that all locations are subject to mandatory overtime based on business need.
    • First shift: Mon-Fri 6am-3pm
  • Location: Our inspection center is located at: 5500 S Rockwell Ave Oklahoma City, OK 73179

Other perks of the Job

  • 100% company-paid healthcare premiums
  • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!
  • ASE and tool reimbursement programs
  • Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of Technician roles in our Inspection Centers, depending on your level of experience - take a look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

  • Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.
  • Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires
  • Mid-Level (Mechanical Repair / Build / General) Technician (min 3 years of professional experience): perform light to medium automotive repairs and minimal diagnostics on our vehicles
  • Experienced Technician (min 5 years of professional experience): perform extensive repairs and heavy engine work, as well as advanced vehicle diagnostics on all makes and models, including electric and hybrid vehicles

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles
  • Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

title: Senior Counsel, Europe Litigation
description:
Everyone says they want to change the world. We're looking for people who actually will.

Alliance Defending Freedom is a faith-based legal advocacy organization that protects fundamental freedoms and promotes the inherent dignity of all people. Please visit our career site to view our Statement of Faith and Doctrinal Distinctives.

Senior Counsel, Europe Litigation

Alliance Defending Freedom is looking for a Senior Counsel, Europe Litigation, to join us full-time in our Brussels, Belgium office. As Senior Counsel, Europe Litigation, you are a vital part of the Global Free Speech team. In this role, you will report to Director, Europe and will be responsible for evaluating, developing, and leading high-level, high-impact litigation in pursuit of ADF generational wins in Europe. While the role will support litigation across ADF's mission areas, its main focus is freedom of speech, with particular emphasis on Germany and France, and other top European jurisdictions, and on litigation before the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) and the Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU).

Your primary role will be to undertake complex European litigation: shaping case strategy, handling litigation work, representing ADF and its clients before the ECtHR and the CJEU, coordinating with national counsel in domestic proceedings, and training and supervising more junior lawyers. You will work closely with the Global Free Speech team, Legal Counsel, Litigation (based in Vienna) and the Legal Officers in Brussels, as well as the wider ADF to combat state-sponsored and corporate censorship, including in relation to EU laws such as the Digital Services Act.

Your Essential Responsibilities:

Strategic Litigation

  • Develop and implement litigation strategies in pursuit of generational wins across Europe, with a particular focus on free speech.
  • Identify, evaluate, and select cases with the potential to secure positive precedents at the highest available courts, and help draw together potential clients, national counsel, experts, and other supporting professionals.
  • Lead and litigate complex cases in support of free speech and other ADF mission areas, from domestic proceedings through to the ECtHR and the CJEU.
  • Represent ADF and its clients before the ECtHR, including drafting applications, observations, and third-party interventions, and presenting oral arguments.
  • Represent ADF and its clients in proceedings before the Court of Justice of the European Union and the General Court, including direct actions and references for a preliminary ruling under Article 267 TFEU arising from national proceedings, and present oral arguments.
  • Coordinate with counsels in German and French courts (including constitutional and supreme courts) regarding cases for European and EU-level review.
  • Develop strategy, arguments, and evidence in preparation for the presentation of cases.
  • Produce, review, edit, and file high-quality legal papers, including applications, briefs, pleadings, written observations, interventions, and memoranda.
  • Conduct advanced legal research on European human rights law, EU law, and German and French law relevant to free speech advocacy.
  • Monitor legislative and judicial developments affecting free speech in Europe, including EU digital regulation, hate speech and "disinformation" laws, and identify emerging threats and litigation opportunities.

Leadership, Training, and Supervision

  • Supervise and mentor mid-level and junior lawyers in all phases of European and national litigation.
  • Train allied lawyers internally and externally on European and EU litigation within ADF mission areas.
  • Advise allied lawyers on legal issues within areas of competence.

Public Advocacy and Alliance Building

  • Represent ADF's free speech advocacy efforts in the court of public opinion.
  • Interview and interact with the media regarding cases and issues, through op-eds, commentaries, and radio or television interviews.
  • Draft scholarly articles, present at conferences, and conduct training events.
  • Network and develop relationships with allied groups and lawyers, parliamentarians, civil servants, academics, digital rights, tech companies, and members of the legal profession, particularly in Germany, France, and other key European jurisdictions.
  • Cooperate with the Development team, including speaking engagements and other fundraising events.

Other Responsibilities:

  • You will be asked to perform related duties or special projects as assigned.

Skills You Need To Succeed:

Knowledge of:

  • EU law, including the Charter of Fundamental Rights, EU digital regulation (including the Digital Services Act, European Democracy Shield, Chat Control), and the procedures of the CJEU and General Court
  • European human rights law, the European Convention on Human Rights, and the procedures of the ECtHR and Council of Europe
  • Freedom of expression jurisprudence at the European level
  • ADF's mission, strategic objectives, and key threats to free speech, religious freedom, life, and marriage and the family in Europe

Demonstrated proficiency in:

  • Complex and appellate litigation, including written and oral advocacy before supranational or apex courts
  • Legal analysis, research, and writing of the highest standard
  • Case strategy and the management of multi-jurisdictional litigation
  • Alliance-building, networking, and relationship development
  • Leadership and supervision of lawyers
  • Microsoft Office and other computer applications

Ability to:

  • Fluently speak and write in English. Additionally, German and/or French would be preferred.
  • Handle multiple complex matters simultaneously across multi-disciplinary teams under tight deadlines
  • Perform in high-pressure situations and make sound judgements
  • Manage confidential information professionally
  • Work independently and collaboratively
  • Live and work in Brussels and travel internationally, sometimes at short notice

Education and/or Experience:

  • Master's level law degree or higher; specialised qualification in EU or European human rights law preferred
  • Qualified lawyer, admitted to the bar in an EU Member State or other Council of Europe jurisdiction, with an active practicing license in good standing
  • Rights of audience permitting representation of parties before the CJEU (under Article 19 of the Statute of the Court of Justice) and the ECtHR
  • Ten or more years of relevant litigation experience, including substantial EU law experience
  • Experience litigating before the ECtHR and/or the CJEU strongly preferred

Valid work permit for the EU/Belgium or EU citizenship required.

title: Risk Specialist
description:
About the Position

We’re seeking an experienced Risk Specialist to support large, heavy-civil infrastructure programs, including highways, roads, bridges, transit (both rail and bus), aviation, and water/wastewater projects delivered through both traditional and alternative methods. This role focuses on program and project risk management: maintaining the risk register and reporting tools, running cost and schedule risk analysis, and working with project teams and stakeholders to strengthen risk oversight across the program.

This is a long-term, full-time, on-site position located in Sacramento, CA.

Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Support the team in establishing and maintaining cost and schedule baselines to assess risk exposure.
  • Support development of risk inputs for external stakeholders, grant applications, and program reporting.
  • Develop and maintain risk reporting tools for cost and schedule risk analysis.
  • Manage the program risk register, ensuring proper coordination between program-level and project-level risks.
  • Maintain and update the Program Risk Management Plan and prepare quarterly risk management reports.
  • Provide guidance and templates for project risk management, including qualitative risk registers and quantitative risk assessments.
  • Support project teams in implementing risk management strategies and maintaining project risk contingency plans.
  • Review and challenge project-level risk assessments to verify accuracy and effectiveness.

title: Lead (ASIC) Development & Integration Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.


What We Offer


Salary:

€70.400,00 - €96.800,00

Location:

Heimstetten,DEU

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As an Electrical Engineer, you are responsible for designing, modifying, and troubleshooting electrical or electronic engineering assemblies, layouts, schematics, and drawings to advance the equipment that supports our technology. Using your technical experience and critical thinking skills, you will perform engineering analysis, generate test reports, develop innovative solutions, and create documentation for product releases. You will also coordinate the procurement and assembly of components, identify sources of critical parts, and resolve technical issues to ensure peak performance.

We are looking for an experienced Engineer (m/f/d) to lead the development, testing, and integration of advanced ASIC-based electronics for high-performance applications.


The role will be a key technical interface between internal engineering teams and external development partners, with a strong focus on ASIC testing, characterization, module integration, and technical project execution. The position can be based at either our Munich/Heimstetten site in Germany or our Delft site in the Netherlands, depending on the candidate.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead ASIC development activities across requirements, solution alternatives, engagement with design and integration partners, and execution planning, including testing, qualification, and system integration.
  • Act as the technical interface to ASIC design partners, coordinating requirements, design reviews, technical decisions, risks, and deliverables.
  • Define and drive ASIC test, characterization, silicon bring-up, and debugging activities.
  • Lead integration of ASICs into advanced electronic and MEMS modules, including flip-chip assembly, interposers, and associated electrical and mechanical interfaces.
  • Define test hardware, setups, automated measurements, and data analysis for device and module characterization.
  • Coordinate development plans, technical risks, and interfaces across internal teams and external partners.
  • Drive technical issues to resolution and support transition to robust, manufacturable solutions.

Qualifications


  • Degree in electrical engineering, electronics, physics, or a related field.
  • Strong experience in electronic hardware development and testing.
  • Experience with ASIC/IC testing, characterization, validation, or silicon bring-up.
  • Good understanding of ASIC development and the ability to work effectively with ASIC designers and external design houses.
  • Experience with advanced electronic packaging or module integration, such as flip-chip, interposers, MEMS integration, or similar technologies, is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge of analog/mixed-signal electronics, measurement techniques, and laboratory test equipment.
  • Strong hands-on debugging, problem-solving, and data-analysis skills.
  • Experience leading complex technical projects involving multiple disciplines and external partners.
  • Direct ASIC design experience is a plus, but not required.


Additional Information

Assignee / Regular

Yes, 10% of the Time

No

title: Head of Engineering – Tech Superdomain
description:
Shoptet je jedna z nejrychleji rostoucích technologických společností v regionu. Pomáháme firmám i jednotlivcům snadno začít a rozvíjet jejich podnikání online. Nabízíme nekonečné možnosti pro e-shopy – od pronájmu, přes platební služby až po propojování s profesionály z oboru.

Shoptet pohání přes 46 000 e-shopů v České republice a na Slovensku. To mimo jiné znamená 46 000 databází, které musejí fungovat. Infrastruktura, která za tím stojí – servery, spolehlivost, bezpečnost, core backend – to je přesně territory Tech Superdomény, do které hledáme Head of Engineering.

Nová role, která vznikla jako součást plánovaného rozšiřování engineering leadershipu. Budeš jeden z pěti Heads of Engineering v Shoptetu.

Co bude tvoje teritorium

Tech Superdomain dnes tvoří čtyři týmy:

  • Infrastructure – správa serverové infrastruktury na Linuxu, základ, na kterém stojí všech 46 000 e-shopů

  • SRE – spolehlivost, monitoring, on-call, péče o to, aby 46 000 e-shopů skutečně fungovalo

  • Purple – engineering tým starající se o vývoj automatizačních nástrojů a skriptů, úzce spolupracující s Infrastructure týmem

  • Security – bezpečnost produktu a infrastruktury s přímým přesahem do celé Engineering organizace

Celkem přes deset engineerů a tři team leadery. Přímý nadřízený: Pavel C

vetler, CPTO.

O roli

Strategické směřování superdomény spolutvoříš ty spolu s kolegy – nejsi vykonavatel cizích rozhodnutí.

Co to v praxi znamená: jsi dost blízko kódu, aby ses mohl bavit s vývojáři o architektuře, databázích a serverové infrastruktuře na rovinu. Zároveň máš přehled a klid na to v pravý moment přibrzdit, srovnat priority a pomoct týmu dělat dobrá rozhodnutí. Blíž k CTO stacku než k procesnímu managementu.

Co budeš dělat

  • Vést Infrastructure, SRE, Purple a Security týmy – budeš jejich nejdůležitější opora i první eskalační bod.

  • Spolu s ostatními Head of Engineering a Pavlem budeš definovat strategické směřování a prioritizaci vývoje.

  • Budeš spoluvytvářet složení svých týmů – aktivně se zapojíš do náboru, budeš posilovat týmy tam, kde to situace vyžaduje, a tam, kde vznikne nová potřeba, pomůžeš postavit tým od základů.

  • Mentorovat team leadery – pomáhat jim růst odborně i manažersky.

  • Hlídat, aby technická rozhodnutí dávala smysl nejen vývojově, ale i produktově a byznysově.

  • Jít blízko k technickým tématům – debugování databází, Linux servery, bezpečnost infrastruktury – a být v té konverzaci skutečnou součástí, ne pozorovatelem.

  • Pomáhat týmům rozhodovat, kdy zrychlit, kdy zpomalit a kdy si raději dvakrát ověřit, že stavíme správnou věc správným způsobem.

  • Průběžně zlepšovat vývojové praktiky, procesy a metriky.

Koho hledáme

Máš zkušenost z podobné role – Head of Engineering, CTO nebo jiného seniorního tech leadershipu. Ideálně z prostředí, kde jsi nebyl odtržený od reality: víš, co se skutečně děje uvnitř systémů a nemáš problém si "ušpinit ruce".

  • Umíš se bavit s vývojáři o architektuře, databázích a technických rozhodnutích. Nejsi jen manažer, co přišel řídit bez hlubší znalosti.

  • Linux servery a správa infrastruktury ti nejsou cizí. Chápeš principy SRE – reliability není jen buzzword.

  • Jsi sebevědomý/á a umíš se rozhodnout – ale nejsi sólista. Nejlepší řešení tě zajímá víc než to, čí nápad byl. Dokážeš prosadit svůj pohled i přijmout lepší argument.

  • Umíš číst provozní data – grafy, logy, metriky – a aktivně je využíváš k optimalizaci, hledání příčin problémů a jejich předcházení. Data jsou pro tebe pracovní nástroj, ne reportingová povinnost.

  • Jsi přirozený partner pro produkt i design. Chápeš, že dobrý vývoj není jen o kódu, ale o prioritách, dopadu a dlouhodobé udržitelnosti.

  • Máš senioritu přibrzdit, když je potřeba. Pojmenovat rizika, srovnat očekávání, pomoct najít nejlepší cestu – bez dramatu.

  • Chceš mít reálný dopad na technologické směřování Shoptetu, ne jen spravovat backlog.

Náš stack

S čím se u nás potkáš:

  • Observability & monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Opensearch, Sentry

  • Dev tools: GitHub, GitLab, Jira

  • Databáze: MariaDB, Galera Cluster

  • Aplikační vrstva: PHP, Symfony

  • Infrastruktura: Docker, OpenResty (Nginx), Ansible

A co by ti mělo být blízké z praxe:

  • Síťařina – síťová komunikace, protokoly, troubleshooting

  • Provoz aplikací pod vysokou zátěží

  • Návrh a optimalizace serverové infrastruktury

  • Orientace v cenových poměrech na HW trhu

Výběrový proces

  1. Úvodní call s recruiterem Martinem – vzájemné seznámení, základní očekávání na obou stranách

  2. Kolo s peers Head of Engineering – odborná diskuse, technický přesah, leadership přístup

  3. Káva s Pavlem (CPTO) – neformální setkání, vize, fit pro spolupráci

  4. Zadání case study – po odsouhlasení od Pavla ti ji pošle Martin; máš přibližně týden na přípravu

  5. Prezentace case study – praktická ukázka přístupu k reálnému problému

Co ti nabídneme?

  • 5 týdnů dovolené, 4 extra volné dny na cokoli a dorovnání mzdy při nemocenské nebo péči o blízké do 100 %.

  • Příspěvek na Multisportku, stravenkový paušál, odměna za doporučení nového kolegy.

  • Zvýhodněný Shoptet tarif pro tvůj vlastní eshop.

  • Budget na vlastní vzdělávání, kurzy angličtiny a interní systém vzdělávání “Produktová Akademie”.

  • Počítač dle tvého výběru (Mac nebo Win) a výhodný mobilní tarif pro tebe a tvé blízké.

  • Opravdu nám záleží na duševním zdraví zaměstnanců a nabízíme možnost využít 6 terapií za rok.

  • Kanceláře v Holešovicích, bike-friendly zázemí, velká zásoba kávy od Nordbeans, ovoce, zelenina a další zdravé svačinky.

  • Máme skvělé komunitní eventy - týmové večeře, narozeniny, firemní piva nebo teambuildingy.

Co by tě o nás mohlo zajímat?

O tom, jak to u nás vypadá, si můžeš přečíst od našich současných i bývalých kolegů na Atmoskopu.

Nebo si přečti, co o naší firmě píší na CzechCrunch nebo Forbes. Mrkni na náš Instagram nebo si pusť náš podcast, ať se o nás dozvíš více!

title: Head of Travel Portfolio and Partnership Management
description:
A new transformational adventure awaits you…

How does 5 weeks of annual leave, a fulfilling career you'll genuinely enjoy, and working for a reputable organization that promotes wellbeing and drives digital transformation sound to you?

As one of Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ and Fortune’s ‘World’s Most Admired Companies’ for 2025, Zurich - a leader in the insurance industry, is on a journey towards a brighter future… A brighter future for you - focused on your career, your wellbeing, and your community - as well as our customers and the planet.

Join us on this thrilling journey as we work towards our vision of becoming Australia's leading digital insurer. Let’s create a brighter future together, let’s make a difference

It’s important to know, what you do matters. At Zurich, we don’t just cover, we care.

We are in market for a key role, as Head of Travel Portfolio and Partnership Management, you’ll lead the Travel portfolio and partnership agenda across Zurich Cover-More ANZ, with a particular focus on global accounts and strategic partnerships. You’ll play a key role in strengthening portfolio performance, partner outcomes and the continued development of Travel within Zurich’s broader ANZ business.

Reporting to the Head of Travel ANZ, you’ll bring together commercial strategy, portfolio management and partnership leadership to unlock growth opportunities, strengthen key relationships and help shape the future of our Travel business.

You will also be responsible for the following:

  • Lead the Travel portfolio across Zurich Cover-More ANZ, driving performance, profitability, growth and successful portfolio integration.
  • Strengthen existing global account and strategic partner relationships, improving retention, commercial outcomes and renewal performance.
  • Identify and progress new growth opportunities across partner-led, B2B2C and broader Zurich Retail channels.

  • Provide senior leadership across local, APAC and global stakeholders, ensuring ANZ priorities and partner outcomes remain aligned.

Important to your success – let’s grow together

You’ll be a commercially minded and collaborative leader who can see the bigger picture while maintaining a strong focus on delivery. You’ll be comfortable navigating complex stakeholder environments, building trusted relationships and using data and insight to make clear decisions.

To be successful, you will have the following:

  • Senior leadership experience in consumer insurance, travel or financial services, ideally across global accounts, strategic partnerships or business development.
  • A strong track record of managing and growing significant strategic or global partnerships and delivering revenue and profitability outcomes.
  • Experience leading portfolio growth and identifying commercial opportunities across B2B2C, partner-led or Retail distribution environments.
  • Strong program management, execution and operating model experience, including working within a larger group environment.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across portfolio management, partnerships, delivery, optimisation or related commercial functions.
  • Strong commercial negotiation, stakeholder management and data-driven decision-making capability within a complex, matrixed environment.

Belong. Zurich is here to support you

There are so many reasons why Zurich is a great place to be and the right choice for you, but here are just a few.

  • Enjoy 5 weeks of annual leave for permanent staff through our Z leave initiative, along with 15 days of personal/carer’s leave as we empower our people to manage their own wellbeing. Plus, access to Family Care (parental leave).

  • Access programs to stay healthy and feel healthier, receive an AUD$500 wellbeing payment per year, and a AUD$295 new starter e-voucher for your work-from-home setup (flex work - hybrid working), along with other great benefits through our Shine portal.
  • Grow and thrive in your career with our award-winning training programs. We support and encourage your development because our strength lies in our people, and we value your individuality.
  • Work with global, diverse, and inclusive teams; explore your passions, fuel innovation, drive equity, collaborate, and make a positive difference beyond your role.

  • We plant a tree for every new employee.
  • Not to mention our various employer of choice awards/memberships – WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Employer, Pride in Diversity… to name a few.

We could go on, but the main point is that Zurich is a great place to be, where you can truly belong, be yourself, maintain work/life balance, and thrive in a supportive environment.

Zurich is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment process is fair and accessible for all candidates. If you require any special accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, we encourage you to please let us know at the time of your application.

title: Programista FPGA (k/m)
description:
Jesteśmy rodzinnym przedsiębiorstwem zatrudniającym około 19 000 pracowników w 71 lokalizacjach na całym świecie. Każdego dnia pracujemy nad nowymi technologiami i rozwiązaniami, które napędzają rozwój przemysłu high-tech. Poszukujemy osób myślących przyszłościowo, z niekonwencjonalnymi pomysłami i zapałem do działania. Wzajemne zaufanie i współdziałanie to dla nas kluczowe wartości, które są podstawą do przekraczania granic, wprowadzania innowacji i budowania rzeczy dotąd niewyobrażalnych. Niezależnie czy chodzi o lasery, maszyny, technologię EUV czy elektronikę – nasze technologie oferują nieograniczone możliwości. Chcesz mieć swój udział w przemyśle przyszłości? Czekamy na Twój talent!

Lokalizacja: ul. Marecka 47, 05-220 Zielonka

Wymiar: pełen etat

Tryb pracy: hybrydowa (elastyczne godziny rozpoczęcia pracy, między 7:00 a 10:00)


Dołącz do międzynarodowego zespołu programistów układów FPGA, realizującego projekty nowoczesnych generatorów dużej mocy wykorzystywanych w technologiach plazmowych i laserowych. Projektowane przez nas urządzenia wspierają czołowych producentów półprzewodników na całym świecie.

Czekają na Ciebie wyzwania związane z projektowaniem, implementacją i wdrażaniem innowacyjnych algorytmów sterujących, algorytmów cyfrowego przetwarzania sygnałów oraz interfejsów komunikacyjnych

Twój zakres obowiązków:

  • projektowanie i implementacja w układach FPGA algorytmów wykorzystywanych do sterowania generatorami dużych mocy

  • testowanie i weryfikacja zaimplementowanych funkcjonalności

  • uruchamianie i analiza działania opracowanych algorytmów we współpracy z innymi członkami zespołu projektowego

  • rozwój i utrzymanie narzędzi optymalizujących tworzenie oprogramowania na układy FPGA

  • rekomendowanie i wdrażanie nowych rozwiązań w projektowanych urządzeniach – współpraca w zespole interdyscyplinarnym

  • tworzenie dokumentacji technicznej do realizowanych zadań


Nasze wymagania:

  • wykształcenie wyższe, preferowane kierunki: informatyka, elektronika lub automatyka

  • dobra znajomość języka VHDL

  • dobra znajomość architektury układów FPGA (Altera, Xilinx)

  • dobra znajomość narzędzi syntezy (Quartus, Vivado) i symulacji (ModelSim)

  • znajomość narzędzi do kontroli wersji (GIT, SVN)

  • podstawowa znajomość języków TCL i Python

  • umiejętność czytania i tworzenia schematów elektrycznych

  • znajomość języka angielskiego pozwalająca na swobodne komunikowanie się w ramach międzynarodowych projektów​


Mile widziane:

  • znajomość zagadnień związanych z układami sterowania i regulacji oraz cyfrowym przetwarzaniem sygnałów

  • praktyczna wiedza dotycząca układów FPGA firmy Altera


Oferujemy:


Pracuj przy ambitnych i międzynarodowych projektach hich-tech. Projektuj rozwiązania dla liderów rynku high-tech i zmieniaj świat technologii. Nasze produkty, które spotkasz w przedmiotach, których używasz na co dzień - telefonach, telewizorach są również wykorzystywane w sektorze kosmicznym, automotive, lotnictwie, odnawialnej energii, a nawet w medycynie!

Rozwijaj się razem z nami. W naszej firmie możesz rozwinąć skrzydła dzięki profilowanym szkoleniom. Mocno wierzymy też w peer learning i rozwijamy kompetencje poprzez wewnętrzną akademię. Działają u nas również dofinansowania do nauki języków obcych a nasi pracownicy mogą skorzystać z ofert rozwoju i awansu wewnętrznego.

Pracuj wygodnie. dzięki elastycznym godzinom pracy możesz dostosować zadania do swoich priorytetów życiowych – zazwyczaj zaczynamy między 7 a 10. Nie przejmuj się parkowaniem (darmowy parking pod każdą lokalizacją) dress codem (nie ma oficjalnego wymogu) ani załatwianiem posiłków (możesz skorzystać z kantyny pracowniczej i codziennie zakupić śniadania i obiady z pracowniczą zniżką). Tam, gdzie to możliwe, oferujemy hybrydowy tryb pracy!

W TRUMPF dbamy:

o twoje zdrowie i bezpieczeństwo. Prywatna opieka medyczna dla Ciebie w 100% finansowana przez pracodawcę. Specjaliści, badania – będziesz mieć zdrowie pod kontrolą z możliwością rozszerzenia pakietu na twoich bliskich – partnera, rodziców, dzieci. Dodatkowo oferujemy platformę, która zapewnia profesjonalne, poufne wsparcie psychologiczne online dla wszystkich pracowników

o twoje życie. Ubezpieczenie na życie dla pracowników w pełni opłacane przez firmę z możliwością rozszerzenia go o twoich bliskich.

o twoją formę. Pracownicy TRUMPF Huettinger korzystają z karty sportowej MultiSport Light bez wkładu własnego – pakiet jest w 100% finansowany przez pracodawcę! W firmie działają cztery sekcje sportowe (biegowa, rowerowa, piłkarska, siatkarska) i cyklicznie odbywają się rywalizacje sportowe z nagrodami. W jednej z naszych lokalizacji możesz także skorzystać z firmowej siłowni przed lub po pracy!

o tych, którzy potrzebują wsparcia. TRUMPF aktywnie wspiera lokalne instytucje, np. Dom Samotnej Matki, Rodzinny Dom Dziecka, wspieramy Koła Naukowe, szkoły i instytucje naukowe a także włączamy się w akcje charytatywne, takie jak Szlachetna Paczka – jeżeli masz ochotę, możesz być tego częścią!

a ponadto:

  • W kuchniach czeka na ciebie woda, kawa, herbata i owoce

  • Możesz zgarnąć bonus w Systemie Rekomendacji pracowników


Drodzy Kandydaci, informujemy, że z uwagi na szczególną dbałość o przeciwdziałanie i zapobieganie naruszeniom prawa w Spółce TRUMPF HUETTINGER, jak również ze względu na kształtowanie bezpiecznego i przyjaznego środowiska pracy w Spółce, przyjęta została Procedura przyjmowania zgłoszeń wewnętrznych i podejmowania działań następczych w TRUMPF HUETTINGER Sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Zielonce. Procedura ta jest udostępniona do wglądu zainteresowanym kandydatom, na ich żądanie.

W naszej firmie obowiązuje regulamin wynagradzania, z którego wynikają szczegółowe zasady płacowe – jest on dostępny do wglądu w siedzibie pracodawcy i zostanie udostępniony kandydatowi na życzenie

title: Senior Manual QA engineer
