title: Graphic Designer
description:
Szukamy osoby, która rozumie, że dziś dobra grafika to nie tylko estetyka, ale i decyzje.

Pracujemy w duchu simpler, smarter, great, czyli robimy rzeczy proste, które zatrzymują uwagę, i na tyle sprytne, że zostają w głowie na dłużej.

Dlatego dobrze odnajdziesz się u nas, jeśli:

  • masz ok. 3 - 5 lat doświadczenia w agencji kreatywnej i mile widziane wykształcenie kierunkowe w obszarze projektowania

  • potrafisz zaprojektować mocny key visual, ale też dowieźć 15 prostych assetów do kampanii

  • wiesz, co się klika i co nie zginie w feedzie

  • używasz AI nie jako ciekawostki, ale jako kreatywnego narzędzia do codziennej pracy (Midjourney, Nano banana, Claude, eksperymenty? yes please!)

  • masz oko do digitalowej estetyki i projektowanie sprawia Ci frajdę

  • rozumiesz trendy, ale wybierasz je świadomie, zamiast ślepo gonić (a do tego pamiętasz o CI marki i zasadach brandingu).

MILE WIDZIANE UMIEJĘTNOŚCI MOTION DESIGNERA:

  • Praktyczna znajomość Adobe After Effects oraz zasad animacji (np. timing, spacing, płynność ruchu) na poziomie średniozaawansowanym.

  • Umiejętność wprawiania w ruch statycznych grafik (zarówno wektorowych, jak i rastrowych) na potrzeby social media, kampanii marketingowych czy prezentacji produktowych.

  • Podstawowa znajomość tworzenia animacji 2D (np. animacja postaci, infographic motion, animacja typografii).

  • Biegłość w montażu i składaniu form wideo w programach takich jak Adobe Premiere Pro

  • Umiejętność pracy z tempem, rytmem filmu oraz synchronizacją obrazu z dźwiękiem (sound design / dobór muzyki i efektów dźwiękowych).

  • Znajomość i umiejętność używania narzędzi AI do generowania oraz edycji wideo i animacji (np. Seedance, Veo, higgsfield).

Szukamy świeżej głowy, kogoś, kto nie tylko projektuje, ale też zauważa, analizuje, ma własne zdanie i potrafi powiedzieć: „to nie zatrzyma scrolla” albo „to możemy zrobić prościej, ale sprytniej” (bo tak lubimy robić rzeczy).

W zamian:

  • projekty, które żyją w digitalu jak i platformy ATL dla globalnych marek

  • miejsce, gdzie pomysły wychodzą poza slajdy i masz szansę zrealizować nawet te odważne koncepcje, które do tej pory siedziały w szufladzie

  • ludzie, z którymi można myśleć i eksperymentować

  • praca 100% zdalna z dowolnego miejsca, które lubisz

  • dopłata do ubezpieczenia zdrowotnego.

Pokaż nam swoje portfolio: może być to zaprojektowany przez Ciebie post, który wyjątkowo lubisz i który zadziałał, plakat ze studiów, bądź swoje własne sociale!

title: Brand Storytelling Specialist / Spécialiste en mise en récit de marque
description:
ABOUT US

Earth Rated is driven by the knowledge that we can make things better — for dogs, for the people who love them, and for the planet we all share. We make thoughtfully designed, genuinely useful products that turn everyday dog-owner moments into simpler and more joyful ones. We’re a team that cares deeply about what we build, how we build it, and who we build it for.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Brand Storytelling Specialist is Earth Rated’s editorial voice: the writer who finds the human truth in a brief and turns it into copy dog owners actually feel. This role turns product insights, positioning and creative direction into copy for every consumer and retail touchpoint: packaging, PDPs, email, digital campaigns, trade tools and PR.

We’re hiring a writer first. Someone who reads nuance, brings real insight to every brief, and knows what makes Earth Rated sound like Earth Rated: warm, witty and honest. As our portfolio, channels and content calendar grow, you’ll use AI as an accelerant to explore more angles, build out variations and move ideas to finished work faster. The tools help you go further. The insight, the craft and the final word are yours.

You’ll report to the Creative Lead and work closely with Product, Digital, eCommerce and our PR agency. You’re the connective tissue between creative vision and commercial messaging, and the person colleagues come to when they need words that work and sound like us.

RESPONSIBILITIES – What you own

Brand Messaging & Copywriting

  • Lead copy development across packaging, PDPs, campaign assets, trade tools and digital channels, so every word earns its place and sounds like Earth Rated
  • Own the packaging copy deck and approval process end to end, keeping every SKU accurate, legally compliant and on-brand
  • Partner with the Creative Lead to evolve and protect our tone of voice, and keep it live and usable in the GTM playbook, in a form both people and AI tools can work from
  • Work with Product and Marketing to turn claims, insights and RTBs into consumer-ready language that is clear, engaging and differentiated

Amazon PDP Optimization

Amazon is one of our biggest channels, and listing copy is a large share of this role. The Amazon team owns keyword research, SEO and performance data. This role owns the words: making them compelling, compliant and scalable.

  • Write Earth Rated’s Amazon listing copy (titles, bullet points, product descriptions, A+ Content and Brand Store copy) so it persuades dog owners and sounds unmistakably like us
  • Work keywords and priorities from the Amazon team into copy that still reads naturally and sells, never like a keyword list
  • Make sure every listing is legally compliant: claims match approved packaging and legal language, and copy follows Amazon’s style guides, character limits and category rules
  • Build and maintain listing copy templates (title formulas, bullet frameworks, A+ module structures and claim libraries) so new SKUs, scents, sizes and bundles can be written quickly and consistently
  • Use AI with these templates to produce on-brand drafts and marketplace variations at speed, while owning the final copy and its accuracy
  • Partner with the Amazon team on listing refreshes and tests, bringing copy options to the table and folding results back into the templates

Email & Content

  • Own brand voice across B2C email (newsletters, flows and promotional sends) in close collaboration with the Digital team
  • Draft, edit, test and optimize email content, using performance data and AI-assisted analysis to improve copy that lifts open rates, click-throughs and conversion
  • Partner with SEO and content partners on blog direction and editing, using AI to speed up research and first drafts while keeping every published piece true to our voice and product strategy

Scaling Our Brand Voice with AI

  • Build and maintain Earth Rated’s AI copy toolkit (voice prompts, templates, example banks and do/don’t guides) so the voice you set holds up at scale
  • Use AI to scale volume where it matters most: PDP and marketplace variations, email subject lines, ad copy variants, retailer-specific adaptations and A/B test options
  • Run structured A/B and multivariate tests on copy, using AI to generate hypotheses and variants, and document what wins so it feeds back into future briefs and prompts
  • Stay close to new AI tools and techniques for content creation, test them against our standards, and bring the ones that work to the wider marketing team

PR Support

  • Keep the yearly PR content calendar current and aligned with launches and brand moments
  • Act as day-to-day contact for our PR agency: brief pitches, and review press releases and product blurbs so external storytelling stays on-brand
  • Share PR results with the team as they come in

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the message continuity bridge between Product, Digital, Creative and eCommerce, so strategy turns into consistent, consumer-ready language in every channel
  • Bring a copy and messaging point of view to creative briefs, campaign narratives and GTM planning early in the process
  • Manage external copy and content partners as needed, holding them to our brand standards and timelines

What Success Looks Like

  • Earth Rated’s voice is consistent and recognizable on packaging, PDPs, email, digital and PR, and partners know where to go to get it right.
  • AI is built into how copy gets made. There’s a working voice toolkit, the team uses it, and output volume and test velocity are clearly higher than before the role existed.
  • Scale hasn’t cost quality. Copy sounds human, specific and unmistakably ours everywhere it shows up, even as volume and test velocity grow.
  • Amazon listings are compelling, on-brand and legally compliant, and a working set of templates lets the team launch new listings quickly without losing quality.
  • Packaging copy decks are accurate, approved on time, and never the reason for a reprint or launch delay.
  • Email and content performance improves quarter over quarter, with documented test learnings shaping future briefs and prompts.
  • PR runs smoothly: the calendar is current, the agency is well briefed, and results are shared.
  • Partners describe copy handoffs as smooth: on time, on brief, and rarely needing more than one round of revisions.

What you bring

  • A portfolio of published consumer copy across packaging, ecommerce product pages and email, ideally for a consumer products brand.
  • Experience writing Amazon listings (titles, bullets, A+ Content) within marketplace style guides and character limits, working from keyword priorities set by others.
  • Precision with claims. You keep copy accurate to approved packaging and legal language, and you can run a copy deck through approvals without missing a print date.
  • Hands-on use of AI writing tools, including prompts, templates or example banks you’ve built, and the judgment to know when a draft isn’t good enough yet.
  • Comfort with performance data. You’ve tested copy, read the results, and fed what you learned into the next brief.

Why Earth Rated

We're a Montreal-built, globally distributed pet products company with big ambitions and the team to back them up. Innovation is our moat: we win by bringing better products to market, faster. We move quickly, hold ourselves to a high bar, and take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. P&C sits at the strategy table here, helping build the company we're becoming!

Perks

  • RRSP with employer matching up to 3%. Your financial well-being matters to us.
  • Annual performance bonus for every team member, tied to corporate and personal objectives. When you succeed, we succeed.
  • Telehealth, health & dental insurance — 100% funded by Earth Rated. Because when you feel your best, you do your best.
  • Chef-catered lunches, snacks, and coffee served daily at the office.
  • On-site gym — move, lift, stretch, or sweat, whatever helps you feel your best.
  • Cell phone plan covered by Earth Rated.
  • Paid holiday office closure from December 24 through January 1, on top of your paid annual vacation.
  • & more

À PROPOS DE NOUS

Chez Earth Rated, nous savons que nous pouvons améliorer les choses : pour les chiens, pour les personnes qui les aiment et pour la planète que nous partageons tous. Nous créons des produits bien pensés et vraiment utiles qui rendent les petits moments du quotidien avec un chien plus simples et plus joyeux. Notre équipe tient profondément à ce qu’elle crée, à la façon de le créer et aux personnes pour qui elle le crée.

Aperçu du poste

Le ou la spécialiste en mise en récit de marque est la voix éditoriale d’Earth Rated : la plume qui trouve la vérité humaine dans un brief et la transforme en textes qui touchent vraiment les propriétaires de chiens. Ce rôle transforme les connaissances sur les produits, le positionnement et l’orientation créative en contenus pour chaque point de contact avec les consommateurs et les détaillants : emballages, pages produits (PDP), courriels, campagnes numériques, outils commerciaux et relations de presse.

Nous recrutons d’abord une plume. Une personne qui saisit les nuances, apporte un vrai regard à chaque brief et sait ce qui fait qu’Earth Rated sonne comme Earth Rated : chaleureux, plein d’esprit et honnête. À mesure que notre portefeuille, nos canaux et notre calendrier de contenu grandissent, vous utiliserez l’IA comme accélérateur pour explorer plus d’angles, décliner des variantes et passer plus vite de l’idée au produit fini. Les outils vous permettent d’aller plus loin. Le regard, le savoir-faire et le dernier mot vous appartiennent.

Relevant de la direction créative (Creative Lead), vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Produit, Numérique et Commerce électronique ainsi qu’avec notre agence de relations de presse. Vous faites le lien entre la vision créative et le message commercial, et vous êtes la personne vers qui les collègues se tournent quand ils ont besoin de mots qui fonctionnent et qui nous ressemblent.

Responsabilités – ce que vous prenez en charge

Messages de marque et rédaction

  • Diriger la rédaction pour les emballages, les pages produits, les éléments de campagne, les outils commerciaux et les canaux numériques, afin que chaque mot ait sa raison d’être et sonne comme Earth Rated
  • Prendre en charge de bout en bout le document de textes d’emballage et son processus d’approbation, en veillant à ce que chaque produit (UGS) soit exact, conforme aux exigences légales et fidèle à la marque
  • Collaborer avec la direction créative pour faire évoluer et protéger notre ton, et le garder vivant et utilisable dans le guide de mise en marché, sous une forme que les personnes comme les outils d’IA peuvent utiliser
  • Travailler avec les équipes Produit et Marketing pour transformer les allégations, les connaissances et les raisons d’y croire (RTB) en messages clairs, engageants et distinctifs pour les consommateurs

Optimisation des pages produits Amazon

Amazon est l’un de nos plus grands canaux, et la rédaction des fiches représente une part importante de ce rôle. L’équipe Amazon est responsable de la recherche de mots-clés, du référencement (SEO) et des données de performance. Ce rôle est responsable des mots : les rendre convaincants, conformes et faciles à décliner à grande échelle.

  • Rédiger les fiches Amazon d’Earth Rated (titres, puces, descriptions de produits, Contenu A+ et textes de la Boutique de marque) pour qu’elles convainquent les propriétaires de chiens et nous ressemblent sans l’ombre d’un doute
  • Intégrer les mots-clés et les priorités de l’équipe Amazon dans des textes qui se lisent naturellement et qui vendent, et non comme une liste de mots-clés
  • Veiller à ce que chaque fiche soit conforme aux exigences légales : les allégations correspondent aux textes d’emballage et aux libellés juridiques approuvés, et les textes respectent les guides de style, les limites de caractères et les règles de catégorie d’Amazon
  • Créer et tenir à jour des gabarits de fiches (formules de titres, structures de puces, structures de modules A+ et bibliothèques d’allégations) pour rédiger rapidement et de façon cohérente les fiches des nouveaux produits, parfums, formats et ensembles
  • Utiliser l’IA avec ces gabarits pour produire rapidement des ébauches fidèles à la marque et des variantes par marché, tout en restant responsable du texte final et de son exactitude
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe Amazon aux mises à jour et aux tests de fiches, en proposant des options de texte et en intégrant les résultats aux gabarits

Courriels et contenu

  • Être responsable de la voix de la marque dans les courriels aux consommateurs (infolettres, séquences automatisées et envois promotionnels), en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe Numérique
  • Rédiger, réviser, tester et optimiser le contenu des courriels à l’aide des données de performance et d’analyses appuyées par l’IA, afin d’améliorer les taux d’ouverture, les taux de clics et les conversions
  • Collaborer avec les partenaires SEO et de contenu sur l’orientation et la révision du blogue, en utilisant l’IA pour accélérer la recherche et les premières ébauches, tout en gardant chaque texte publié fidèle à notre voix et à notre stratégie de produits

Déployer notre voix de marque à grande échelle avec l’IA

  • Créer et tenir à jour la trousse d’outils de rédaction IA d’Earth Rated (requêtes de voix, gabarits, banques d’exemples et guides de choses à faire et à éviter) afin que la voix que vous définissez tienne la route à grande échelle
  • Utiliser l’IA pour augmenter le volume là où ça compte le plus : variantes de pages produits et de fiches par marché, objets de courriels, variantes publicitaires, adaptations par détaillant et options de tests A/B
  • Mener des tests A/B et multivariés structurés sur les textes, en utilisant l’IA pour générer des hypothèses et des variantes, et documenter ce qui fonctionne pour alimenter les prochains briefs et requêtes
  • Suivre de près les nouveaux outils et techniques d’IA pour la création de contenu, les tester selon nos normes et faire connaître ceux qui fonctionnent à l’ensemble de l’équipe Marketing

Soutien aux relations de presse

  • Tenir à jour le calendrier annuel de contenu de relations de presse, en l’arrimant aux lancements et aux moments clés de la marque
  • Agir comme personne-ressource au quotidien pour notre agence de relations de presse : préparer les briefs des propositions aux médias et réviser les communiqués et les descriptions de produits pour que le récit externe reste fidèle à la marque
  • Communiquer les résultats de relations de presse à l’équipe au fur et à mesure

Collaboration interfonctionnelle

  • Assurer la continuité des messages entre les équipes Produit, Numérique, Création et Commerce électronique, afin que la stratégie se traduise par un langage cohérent et adapté aux consommateurs dans chaque canal
  • Apporter tôt dans le processus un point de vue sur la rédaction et les messages aux briefs créatifs, aux récits de campagne et à la planification de la mise en marché
  • Gérer au besoin les partenaires externes de rédaction et de contenu, en veillant au respect de nos normes de marque et de nos échéanciers

À quoi ressemble le succès

  • La voix d’Earth Rated est cohérente et reconnaissable sur les emballages, les pages produits, les courriels, le numérique et les relations de presse, et les partenaires savent où s’adresser pour bien faire les choses.
  • L’IA fait partie intégrante de la façon dont les textes sont produits. Une trousse d’outils de voix fonctionnelle existe, l’équipe l’utilise, et le volume de production et le rythme des tests sont nettement plus élevés qu’avant la création du poste.
  • La croissance du volume ne s’est pas faite au détriment de la qualité. Les textes sonnent humains, précis et indéniablement Earth Rated partout où ils apparaissent, même si le volume et le rythme des tests augmentent.
  • Les fiches Amazon sont convaincantes, fidèles à la marque et conformes aux exigences légales, et un ensemble de gabarits fonctionnels permet à l’équipe de lancer rapidement de nouvelles fiches sans perte de qualité.
  • Les documents de textes d’emballage sont exacts, approuvés à temps et ne sont jamais la cause d’une réimpression ou d’un retard de lancement.
  • La performance des courriels et du contenu s’améliore d’un trimestre à l’autre, et les apprentissages documentés des tests orientent les prochains briefs et requêtes.
  • Les relations de presse se déroulent sans accroc : le calendrier est à jour, l’agence est bien informée et les résultats sont communiqués.
  • Les partenaires décrivent les remises de textes comme fluides : à temps, conformes au brief et nécessitant rarement plus d’une ronde de révisions.

Ce que vous apportez

  • Un portfolio de textes publiés pour les consommateurs, couvrant les emballages, les pages produits en ligne et les courriels, idéalement pour une marque de produits de consommation.
  • De l’expérience en rédaction de fiches Amazon (titres, puces, Contenu A+) dans le respect des guides de style et des limites de caractères de la plateforme, à partir de priorités de mots-clés établies par d’autres.
  • De la rigueur avec les allégations. Vous gardez les textes conformes aux libellés d’emballage et juridiques approuvés, et vous savez mener un document de textes jusqu’à l’approbation sans manquer une date d’impression.
  • Une utilisation concrète des outils de rédaction IA, y compris des requêtes, des gabarits ou des banques d’exemples que vous avez créés, et le jugement nécessaire pour savoir quand une ébauche n’est pas encore à la hauteur.
  • De l’aisance avec les données de performance. Vous avez testé des textes, analysé les résultats et intégré vos apprentissages au brief suivant.

Pourquoi Earth Rated

Nous sommes une entreprise de produits pour animaux de compagnie née à Montréal et distribuée partout dans le monde, avec de grandes ambitions et l’équipe pour les réaliser. L’innovation est notre avantage concurrentiel : nous gagnons en mettant de meilleurs produits sur le marché, plus rapidement. Nous avançons vite, nous visons haut et nous prenons notre travail au sérieux, sans nous prendre trop au sérieux. Ici, l’équipe Personnes et culture a sa place à la table stratégique et contribue à bâtir l’entreprise que nous sommes en train de devenir!

Avantages

  • REER avec cotisation de l’employeur jusqu’à 3 %. Votre bien-être financier nous tient à cœur.
  • Prime de rendement annuelle pour chaque membre de l’équipe, liée aux objectifs de l’entreprise et aux objectifs personnels. Quand vous réussissez, nous réussissons.
  • Télésanté, assurance maladie et dentaire entièrement payées par Earth Rated. Parce que lorsque vous vous sentez au mieux, vous donnez le meilleur de vous-même.
  • Dîners préparés par un chef, collations et café servis tous les jours au bureau.
  • Gym sur place : bougez, soulevez, étirez-vous ou transpirez, peu importe ce qui vous fait du bien.
  • Forfait de téléphone cellulaire payé par Earth Rated.
  • Fermeture des bureaux payée pendant les Fêtes du 24 décembre au 1er janvier, en plus de vos vacances annuelles payées.
  • Et plus encore

title: Infrastruktur | Senior Projektledare | Offentlig Sektor
description:
Redo att ta en nyckelroll i utvecklingen av samhällsviktig verksamhet och framtidens infrastruktur? Chief söker nu projektledare och ledande roller inom offentlig sektor till Stockholm. Hos oss blir du en del av ett konsultbolag med starkt fokus på utveckling, struktur och ledarskap. Du driver projekt inom IT, bygg och infrastruktur – uppdrag som bidrar till verklig samhällsnytta och gör skillnad på riktigt.

Om rollen

Som konsult på Chief med inriktning mot offentlig sektor arbetar du i samhällsnära uppdrag där din kompetens bidrar till verklig nytta. Du tar en ledande roll i projekt som projektledare, programledare, systemägare, Product Owner eller Scrum Master, ofta i komplexa organisationer.

I rollen ingår även att driva upphandlingar och förfrågningar inom bygg, IT och infrastruktur samt att säkerställa leverans enligt uppsatta krav, tidplaner och budget.

Du koordinerar tvärfunktionella team och intressenter i större myndigheter och offentliga verksamheter, och bidrar till att skapa struktur och framdrift i komplexa sammanhang. Arbetet omfattar även utveckling och förvaltning av system och digitala lösningar som stödjer samhällsviktig verksamhet, samt att driva förändrings- och förbättringsinitiativ i både tekniska och organisatoriska miljöer.

Vi arbetar brett mot den offentliga sektorn, vilket ger dig möjlighet att delta i uppdrag hos flera olika offentliga organisationer och utanför Stockholm.

Vem söker vi?

Har du ett starkt driv att ta ansvar, skapa struktur och leda komplexa uppdrag från idé till genomförande? Då kan det här vara rätt roll för dig. Du är kommunikativ och har förmågan att hitta kreativa lösningar, samtidigt som du är prestigelös och tar ägarskap i ditt arbete. Med din problemlösningsförmåga, ditt fokus och din energi driver du arbetet framåt och säkerställer att resultat uppnås på ett effektivt sätt.

Vem är du?

Du är en driven och strukturerad ledare som trivs med att ta ansvar och skapa tydlighet i komplexa organisationer. Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta i eller mot offentlig sektor och förstår samspelet mellan verksamhet, IT, bygg och infrastruktur. Med ett tryggt och coachande ledarskap skapar du engagemang, struktur och framdrift i uppdrag som gör verklig skillnad i samhället. Med fördel har du erfarenhet från verksamheter som Trafikförvaltningen, Region Stockholm, Trafikverket, Skatteverket, Kronofogdemyndigheten, Försäkringskassan, Arbetsförmedlingen m.fl.

  • Har relevant utbildning och/eller arbetslivserfarenhet, med tillhörande certifieringar

  • Har mer än 8 års erfarenhet i ledande roller, till exempel som projektledare, programledare, systemägare, Product Owner eller Scrum Master

  • Erfarenhet av att driva projekt inom offentlig sektor, myndighet eller större organisation med större budgetansvar

  • Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, i såväl tal som skrift

Vilka är Chief?

Chief är en ledande aktör i konsultbranschen med en stark familjär kultur där teknik och ledarskap möts. Hos oss får du en personlig och utvecklande miljö där karriärresa och ledarskap står i centrum – med möjligheterna som följer med att vara en del av en global koncern.

Vad erbjuder vi?

  • Gemenskap & utveckling: Vi investerar i dig och din utveckling genom branschöverskridande och spännande kunduppdrag, mentorskapsprogram, Chief Academy, möjlighet till certifiering samt andra interna initiativ som stärker både din kompetens och ditt ledarskap.

  • Större möjligheter: Lokalt engagemang kombinerat med ett globalt nätverk genom vår koncern Alten Group, karriärvägar och spännande uppdrag – utan att kompromissa med den familjära känslan.

  • Trygg anställning: Hos oss får du en kollektivavtalad anställning med konkurrenskraftig lön, friskvårdsbidrag, utbildningsbudget med mera.

Vill du vara med och forma framtidens teknik och ledarskap? Då är vi rätt plats för dig.🤝

Skicka in din ansökan med CV och personligt brev, eller något annat innovativt som uppfyller samma syfte. Intervjuer och återkoppling sker löpande så skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Vill du veta mer om Chief och rollen så kontakta gärna mig så berättar jag mer!

Joshua George, Talent Acquisition Partner
joshua.george@alten.se

title: Employment Consultant
description:
Are you passionate about supporting people with disability to secure employment that could change their life? Do you have a knack for identifying an individuals’ employment match?

If so, YOU could be our next Employment Consultant at our Rockingham, WA site within our Inclusive Employment Australia Program.

Who Are We:

APM is a global health and human services organisation transforming lives since 1994. Be part of a 15,000-strong team across 11 countries, empowering people of all abilities to lead independent and fulfilling lives. Thrive with us, benefiting from exceptional career growth and development opportunities across our global network of brands.

Who You Are:

A champion of diversity and inclusion – you believe that everyone, no matter their abilities, deserves a chance to succeed

A natural connector – you know how to create opportunities for participants and speak to stakeholders with confidence

Innovative and solutions focused – You see the challenge as an opportunity and have experience creating pathways to success

Compassionate and empathetic – You want to make a lasting and positive impact on the lives of others

You may also have experience in another industries or roles like sales, retail, call centre, hospitality, consulting, business development, and administration. These skills can set you up for success in this role!

What You’ll Be Doing:

Find the perfect match – you’ll support participants with disability to prepare for, find and maintain sustainable employment.

Boost Confidence – You will help participants see their strengths, overcome obstacles, and take on their new employment with a renewed sense of purpose

Shake Things Up – You will provide creative solutions to overcome employment challenges, making sure every participant has the tools and support for success

Advocating – You will be an advocate for inclusive hiring practices and workplace adjustments

Celebrate the Moments That Matter – Every successful placement is a success, and we are all about celebrating success, big and small with our participants

Building lasting connections – You will form partnerships with companies that are passionate about diversity and inclusion, making sure everyone has a chance to shine!

Why You’ll Love It

This isn’t your average desk job. We are all about breaking barriers, creating opportunities and helping people with disability thrive by securing and supporting them into employment.

  • Competitive salary plus performance-based incentives that reward your success.
  • Ongoing training and career development – we are committed to your growth.
  • Supportive and inclusive team environment where your contributions make a difference every day.
  • Celebrating milestones – we love to recognise and rewards hard work with fun events.
  • EAP | Employee Wellbeing Program.
  • Purchased Annual Leave.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • Funded Certificate IV in Community Services or Mental Health Peer Support (eligibility criteria applies).
  • Service recognitions.
  • APM Family Hub.
  • Maxxia | Vehicle salary packaging.

To be considered, you will have...

  • Eligibility to work in Australia
  • A current driver’s licence and a comprehensively insured vehicle
  • A MyGovID (Standard level)
  • Willing to complete a National Police Check
  • Able to pass a Working with Children Check
  • Available to work Full-Time Monday to Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm

At APM we are strengthened by diversity. We are committed to providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. We encourage applications from people of all ages, nationalities, abilities and cultures including indigenous peoples, the LGBTQI+ community and people with disability.

Ready to change the game? If you are looking for a role where no two days are the same, where you get to inspire, motivate and create a lasting impact, we want to hear from you! Let’s work together to break down barriers, shatter expectations and build a more inclusive world- one individual at a time.

Join us as we continue to #enable better lives!

title: ADESA Customer Experience Advocate
description:
IN PERSON HIRING EVENT - Monday, November 16th.

This event is only open for the ADESA Customer Experience Advocate - Onsite (Tempe, AZ) position only. No interviews will be hosted for other open Carvana roles on this day.

Compensation: Starting at $18/hour; bilingual candidates start at $19/hour

About Us

ADESA, a Carvana-owned company, currently operates over 50 locations throughout the U.S. We remarket hundreds of thousands of vehicles across North America from Dealers, Commercial Lenders, Manufacturers & more. We work in a service industry and embrace a "we" versus "I" culture - help others, and they will help you. Our industry is fun, fast-paced, and competitive, and filled with the best people who are passionate about what they do.

Build a Career with Us

We want team members who aren't afraid to dive in, solve problems, and level up their skills. Because we’re always evolving, there is always room for high performers to step into higher-level roles. Hard work doesn't go unnoticed here—if you drive an impact, you'll find plenty of space to advance.

We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused Customer Experience Advocate to join the ADESA Central Operations team. This role is crucial for resolving a diverse range of product and service issues, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for our customers (buyers, sellers, transporters, and dealers).

Important Note: We have a similar job posting for Carvana-focused Customer Experience Advocates, but please note that this position is exclusively for the ADESA CX Advocate role, which focuses solely on ADESA's wholesale remarketing operations.

Location & Working Hours

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Clarify and resolve customer concerns efficiently to achieve First Contact Resolution.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues quickly, ensuring accurate logging of interactions in Salesforce and escalating complex backend issues to appropriate technical support or internal departments when necessary.
  • Navigate cross-functional issues like a pro by connecting customers with internal departments, including Titles, Dealer Registration, Arbitration, Payments, Technical Support, Financial Operations, IT, and Auction partners.
  • Practice active listening to provide personalized support and effectively address unique customer needs.
  • Provide feedback on system inefficiencies or common customer pain points to support continuous improvement initiatives.

What You’ll Bring

  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1+ year of previous customer service or contact center experience.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with active listening and the ability to provide personalized, empathetic support.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking abilities, demonstrating an ownership mentality to solve problems thoroughly.
  • Basic technical proficiency, including the ability to utilize multiple screens and quickly learn new systems.
  • Flexibility and ability to adapt in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Familiarity with automotive titles, logistics, or dealership operations is a plus.
  • Experience in multi-channel customer support (chat, email, phone) or knowledge of ADESA/Carvana systems is a plus.
  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.

title: QC specialist / coordinator QC
description:
Als QC Specialist zorg je ervoor dat grondstoffen, verpakkingsmaterialen en eindproducten voldoen aan onze kwaliteits- en klantspecificaties. Je bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor dagelijkse kwaliteitsvraagstukken en werkt nauw samen met productie, QA en andere betrokken afdelingen.

Je bent regelmatig op de productievloer te vinden. Naast je inhoudelijke werkzaamheden houd je overzicht over de dagelijkse QC-activiteiten, stel je prioriteiten en bewaak je dat afwijkingen en kwaliteitsissues goed worden opgevolgd.

Concreet ga je:

  • onderzoeksresultaten beoordelen en eindproducten vrijgeven voor verzending naar klanten;
  • afwijkingen signaleren, bespreken en de opvolging bewaken;
  • grondstoffen en verpakkingsmaterialen controleren en vrijgeven voor gebruik in productie;
  • ingangskeuringen uitvoeren en onder andere kleur, geur, smaak en structuur beoordelen;
  • onderzoek doen naar oorzaken van klachten en afwijkingen en adviseren over corrigerende en preventieve maatregelen;
  • klachten en blokkades rondom grondstoffen en verpakkingsmaterialen opvolgen;
  • interne audits uitvoeren en ondersteunen bij externe audits;
  • kwaliteitsgegevens en vrijgaven verwerken in SAP;
  • Certificates of Analysis (CoA's) opstellen en tijdig beschikbaar stellen voor klanten;
  • contact onderhouden met leveranciers over kwaliteit en de verwerkbaarheid van materialen;
  • bijdragen aan het beoordelen en verbeteren van onze kwaliteitsprocessen;
  • de dagelijkse QC-werkzaamheden coördineren en zorgen voor een goede afstemming met productie en QA.

Jouw ontwikkeling

Deze functie is nadrukkelijk bedoeld als een ontwikkelrol richting Manager Quality. De ambitie is om je, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en persoonlijke groeicurve, binnen circa twee jaar te laten doorgroeien naar Manager Quality in Warffum.

Je start vanuit de inhoud en coördinatie van QC. Naarmate je onze processen, producten en organisatie beter leert kennen en jezelf verder ontwikkelt, krijg je stapsgewijs meer verantwoordelijkheid. Zo groei je geleidelijk van QC Specialist naar een bredere leidinggevende verantwoordelijkheid binnen Quality.

De periode van circa twee jaar is onze ambitie. De daadwerkelijke doorgroei hangt samen met jouw ontwikkeling, resultaten en geschiktheid voor de rol.

Je werkt nauwkeurig, herkent afwijkingen snel en wilt begrijpen waar een probleem vandaan komt. Je neemt initiatief, kunt prioriteiten stellen en durft binnen je verantwoordelijkheden beslissingen te nemen.

Omdat deze functie zich ontwikkelt richting een leidinggevende rol, zoeken we iemand die makkelijk samenwerkt, collega's kan meenemen en hen op een prettige maar duidelijke manier kan aanspreken. Je hoeft nog geen ervaren leidinggevende te zijn, maar de ambitie en het potentieel om je in die richting te ontwikkelen zijn belangrijk.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • hbo werk- en denkniveau;
  • een afgeronde opleiding in de richting van food, levensmiddelentechnologie, analytische chemie of vergelijkbaar;
  • ervaring met kwaliteitszorg en kwaliteitsprocessen, bij voorkeur binnen de voedingsmiddelenindustrie;
  • een sterk kwaliteitsbewustzijn en oog voor detail;
  • goede communicatieve vaardigheden;
  • een proactieve houding en gevoel voor eigenaarschap;
  • ambitie om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen richting een leidinggevende rol;
  • een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

title: Engineering Technician II - (T2)
description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.


What We Offer


Salary:

$21.50 - $29.20

Location:

Austin,TX

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Key Responsibilities

Performs routine to moderately complex electro-mechanical technical functions and activities such as design, test, checkout, fabrication, modification, troubleshooting and assembly of electronics and electro-mechanical systems, experimental design circuitry, prototype models, specialized test equipment, tools and test fixtures.

May test and troubleshoot system level and component level problems in electrical and mechanical systems and sub-systems. May perform new system and NPI installations and field upgrades.

Works from schematics, diagrams, written and verbal descriptions, layouts or plans to perform routine testing and troubleshooting.

Compiles logbooks and test procedures documentation utilizing good writing skills.

May perform mechanical, electrical, pneumatic & vacuum and process testing on AMAT platforms to Engineering and Manufacturing documentation and specifications.

Observes all safety standards. Maintains a secure, safe, clean and healthy work environment. Attends required health and safety training and follows safety and security policies, procedures and practices. Promptly reports accidents, injuries, safety hazards, or emergencies to supervisor or Safety dept. Follows operating instructions, uses protective equipment when required, and uses equipment and materials properly. Actively strives to prevent accidents and injuries.

Becomes familiar with current manufacturing and/or engineering processes and stays informed of any changes in procedures. Assists in the correction of problems.

May perform rework as a result of testing. Generates Quality Notifications.

Other Requirements: This is a physically demanding position that often requires standing for extended periods of time, walking, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting, the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, the use of hand and power tools, and driving or operating heavy machinery including forklifts.

Additionally, because this position may involve working in a clean room, the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields may be required.

Functional Knowledge

  • Has developed analytical skills and application of scientific methods to perform a variety of activities

Business Expertise

  • Has good understanding of how the team integrates with others

Leadership

  • Has no supervisory responsibilities

Problem Solving

  • Recognizes and solves typical problems that can occur in own work area without supervisory approval; evaluates and selects solutions from established operating procedures and/or scientific methods

Impact

  • Impacts the quality of own work

Interpersonal Skills

  • Uses communication skills to exchange of information

Additional Information

Time Type:

Full time

Employee Type:

Assignee / Regular

Travel:

Yes, 10% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:

No

The salary offered to a selected candidate will be based on multiple factors including location, hire grade, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and with consideration of internal equity of our current team members. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable.

For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Team Lead, Market Operations
description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we sell cars, but we are not salespeople. We have made it our mission to create a hassle-free way for people to buy and sell cars. We saw a huge problem with how much of a headache it is to buy a car the traditional way, so we committed ourselves to put customer satisfaction at the core of our business, we have built a no-pressure, no-haggle online car buying experience that saves our customers time and money. Customers can search through thousands of vehicles online, see full 360-degree views of both the interior and exterior of the vehicles before deciding to go through the purchasing process. Our Customer Advocates will then either deliver the purchased vehicle to our customer’s driveway using one of our kick-ass one car haulers, or they will meet our customers at one of our amazing coin-operated Vending Machines.

For more information on Carvana and our mission, sneak a peek at our company introduction video.

About the team and position

Carvana’s Market Operation department is known for its team-oriented, fast-paced environment. We hire bright people who are willing to roll up their sleeves, step in wherever needed, mentor and develop team members, and assume additional responsibilities as needed while juggling multiple projects. Don’t forget to bring your personality! We thrive from each unique perspective. Our strength is in our diversity of opinions.

Job Description

The Team Lead, in our Market Operations group, is responsible for running the local Carvana hub and everything that comes with it, including (but not limited to); market launch, operations, logistics, consumer branding, team engagement and effectiveness and, of course, the market’s ongoing success. We are looking for someone who is a big picture thinker with the ability to manage the employee and customer experience. A Team Lead not only crushes daily operations, but they have the savvy to assess business trends and proactively create solutions to potential roadblocks. We need a strong people leader, as a Team Lead works closely with a team of extremely talented Customer Advocates and is responsible for providing vision and development opportunities.

What you’ll be Doing

  • Be a continuous positive force within the market and create strong morale and spirit throughout the team.
  • Help interview, select, onboard and train a team of Customer Advocates and provide the tools, resources and guidance they need to be successful. Employee development is an essential part of this role.
  • Actively develop a team of Customer Advocates by providing feedback, conducting performance check-ins, and setting goals to improve performance and skill set.
  • Recognize and reinforce individual and team accomplishments by using existing organizational tools and programs as well as by finding new, creative and effective methods of recognition.
  • Generate and monitor regular reports like a boss and presenting to upper management… also like a boss.
  • Be the go to expert for your team. You’re always ready to jump in alongside an Advocate to wash cars or jump into our kick-ass single-car hauler and deliver cars to our customers while providing a stellar customer experience.
  • Drive production in a fast-paced customer service environment and keep every detail of your market operating like a well oiled machine
  • Actively look for ways to improve the overall customer and Advocate team experience.
  • Address and effectively manage complex and sensitive customer-facing issues.

What you should have

  • 5+ years work experience in a customer facing team environment
  • 3+ years of management experience
  • Proven history of developing and coaching employees
  • Prior experience with strategic planning, process improvement, and guiding teams to exceed goals
  • Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills
  • Ability to diagnose and solve problems with varying complexity while maintaining focus on the customer experience
  • Willingness to work on weekends
  • Enthusiasm and energy to contribute to and thrive in a rapidly growing start-up atmosphere where roles continually adapt as the company evolves

It would be great if you also had

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Experience with Salesforce or Tableau
  • An analytical mind
  • Experience handling logistics

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-Time Salary Position
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • 401K with company match
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally
  • Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization
  • A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development
  • A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.
  • The ability to walk/stand and sustain physical activity for extended periods of time (8+ hours).
  • Requires high and low levels of movement with the ability to reach with arms, twist, kneel, crouch, climb, balance, and squat.
  • Requires the grasping, carrying, lifting, pushing, and pulling of items up to 50lbs.
  • Frequent driving requires excellent visual activity and manual dexterity.
  • Requires to work in outdoor weather conditions.
  • Must be able to stay in stationary positions for extended periods of time (when driving) up to 3 hours at a time.
  • Frequently communicates with customers and must be able to exchange accurate information

* California, Colorado, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Nevada, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia and Wisconsin employees must apply for a Salesperson license within the first two weeks of employment (process sponsored by Carvana). Obtaining this license is a condition of employment; failure to secure it may impact continued employment in this role.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

title: Vice President of Operations
description:
At Northern Communications, we are committed to delivering reliable, secure, and innovative emergency communication and monitoring services that help keep communities and businesses safe. For over 70 years, our team has supported organizations across Canada, the United States, and Mexico with services spanning emergency call handling, fire dispatch, monitoring, and customer support. Our mission-driven culture is grounded in trust, urgency, innovation, and collaboration, creating an environment where you can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful difference every day. We’re growing and excited to welcome new team members who value continuous learning and meaningful work.

When someone dials 9-1-1, a smoke alarm trips at 3 a.m., or a connected car senses a crash, Northern911 is the team that picks up and makes the call that gets help moving. Our APCO-certified telecommunicators answer, triage, and route 9-1-1 and emergency calls to the right police, fire, or medical agency, and dispatch fire services for rural and volunteer departments. Our TMA-certified specialists provide 24/7 alarm monitoring, responding to fire, intrusion, environmental, and connected-device alerts.. Our customer support specialists extend that care beyond emergencies, handling after-hours answering, on-call escalation, and municipal support for organizations that need someone empathetic and reliable on the line around the clock. Public safety agencies, technology partners, and business customers rely on our teams to gather critical information quickly and accurately and respond with care. Learn more at And .

What this role is about:
When someone reaches out in an emergency, the first voice they hear is one of ours. As VP, Operations, you will lead the people behind that voice: about 150 public safety telecommunicators, monitoring agents, and customer support specialists working around the clock. Each service has built deep expertise of its own, and we are looking for the leader who will take us to the next level by bringing them together into one operation that is stronger than the sum of its parts. And we’re just getting started: as we expand into new markets and grow our international footprint, including opening and integrating new centres, you will build the operation that makes that growth possible.

As a member of the leadership team, you will drive operational excellence, financial performance, and an exceptional employee experience, designing scalable operating models and developing innovative solutions along the way. You will shape how the teams are staffed, trained, coached, and supported, and bring AI and automation onto the floor to support our teams and extend how many people they can help. Combining operational discipline, financial acumen, entrepreneurial thinking, and strong people leadership, you will empower teams to solve problems, embrace change, and innovate in the pursuit of service excellence. You will also partner with RapidSOS product and engineering teams to put new technology to work in a live 24/7 operation.

This is a chance to lead the people who answer when it matters most, and to build an operation that lets them do their best work every day.

What you'll do:

  • Lead 24/7 operations across 9-1-1 call handling, monitoring, and customer support, keeping service reliable every hour of every day for customers across Canada, the US, and Mexico
  • Own the path from company vision to results: set quarterly plans with measurable outcomes, then build and maintain the operational scorecard with meaningful KPIs, using the data to monitor performance, identify trends, and drive clear accountability and improvements
  • Unite our service lines through integration and continuous improvement, connecting teams, leveraging shared capabilities, and building efficient, scalable operating models while preserving service-specific requirements
  • Lead our operational expansion, opening and integrating new centres, bringing acquired operations onto a common operating model, and building cross-border teams that serve customers wherever they are
  • Build the operating budget and staffing plan with Finance and People & Culture, and find new ways to improve efficiency, productivity, and profitability that strengthen service quality and make work better for your teams
  • Raise the standard of every call and customer interaction by continuously improving training, procedures, and quality assurance, and by investigating incidents and service failures to uncover root causes and turn each one into a lasting improvement
  • Drive organizational transformation, shaping the structural and process improvements that move the operation forward, building commitment across teams, and seeing each change through to results
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement AI, automation, and emerging technologies, and drive their adoption so our teams can deliver higher-quality service to more people
  • Apply emerging industry standards and best practices across our service lines, staying current on regulatory changes and ensuring compliance with regulations, collective agreements, and contractual obligations while managing operational risk
  • Partner with RapidSOS product and engineering teams, bringing frontline insight from our live 24/7 operation to test new technology and help shape the products public safety teams rely on
  • Foster a culture where people want to stay and grow, through engagement, recognition, and leadership development that strengthens retention and empowers your team members, and where creative problem-solving is encouraged and celebrated
  • Represent Northern Communications and Northern911 across the industry as a trusted voice in public safety, building relationships with customers, agencies, and associations and sharing your expertise through speaking engagements and industry events

What we're looking for in our ideal candidate:

  • 5-10+ years leading 24/7 operations in emergency communications, enterprise monitoring, or contact centre operations environment, or equivalent experience, including leading an organization of 50+ people
  • Senior operational leadership experience with demonstrated success in operational performance, financial management, and organizational improvement, and strong knowledge of workforce planning, training, quality assurance, performance management, and regulatory compliance
  • Proficiency in data analysis, performance measurement, and the use of operational scorecards / metrics to inform decisions, identify trends, and drive improvements
  • Proven track record of leading organizational change, building commitment and communicating effectively across functions, optimizing operational systems and processes, and developing high-performing teams
  • Demonstrated experience implementing AI-enabled solutions or automation to achieve measurable operational improvements, with a strong aptitude for adopting emerging technologies
  • Ability to see complex processes holistically, identify root causes, and design scalable solutions, with an entrepreneurial mindset that experiments with new ideas and technology and stays adaptable through ambiguity
  • Ability to lead with empathy, develop capable employees, and foster a culture where people are engaged, accountable, and empowered, with clear communication and collaboration across teams and with customers
  • Natural curiosity and a willingness to challenge the status quo, with the creativity to look beyond how things have always been done and find better ways to serve our customers and support our teams
  • Ability to travel up to 15% and work onsite in Greater Sudbury, Ontario, Canada

Nice-to-have experience (but not required!):

  • Experience leading complex, service-oriented operations; experience in emergency communications (PSAP), contact centres, or monitoring
  • Experience scaling operations across borders or opening new sites, particularly expanding into the US
  • Experience extending services into new international markets, including supporting customers in additional languages and adapting to local regulations and expectations
  • Experience building employee wellness or critical incident stress programs for frontline teams
  • Industry-specific certifications (e.g., Emergency Number Professional (ENP), Communications Center Manager (CCM), Certified Public-Safety Executive (CPE)) and relevant professional development
  • Experience working in a unionized environment
  • French / Spanish fluency

What we offer:

  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Base salary range of $175,000 – $215,000 CAD, plus a comprehensive benefits package and pension plan
  • Equity Participation: This role is eligible to receive equity options in RapidSOS, our parent company.
  • Relocation Assistance: Comprehensive relocation support to Greater Sudbury, Ontario, Canada is provided if required. Enjoy over 300 lakes, extensive trails, and an affordable cost of living, with the amenities of Northern Ontario’s largest city.
  • A Seat at the Table: Join the leadership team and help shape the future of the company as it grows across North America
  • A Fun & Vibrant Culture: A dynamic and fun work environment that celebrates a great team with events like staff appreciation parties, Telecommunicators Week, and summer BBQs.
  • Mission-Driven Impact (A RapidSOS Company): Northern Communications is proudly part of RapidSOS, the emergency response data platform connecting over 730 million devices directly to first responders. You’ll join a passionate, mission-driven team using cutting-edge technology to solve one of the world's most critical challenges—saving lives when seconds count.

If you’re curious to learn more, visit and



Northern911 is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status.

Interested in the role but you don’t meet 100% of the requirements? We’d love to hear from you! We encourage you to apply; we’d be excited to see if your unique skill set and experience could be a match.

title: Senior UI Artist
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games. We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better.

WHAT WE NEED

We’re looking for a Senior UI Artist who excels at visual hierarchy, color theory, dynamic composition, and typography to help elevate and set the standard for visual excellence in our game. You operate, innovate, and drive UI systems, establishing high-fidelity, game-ready assets while architecting scalable, future-proof UI pipelines. You’ll work closely with UX and UI Technical Designers to translate player needs into beautiful solutions that will delight and impress.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Drive Asset Creation & Craft: Establish and define clean, high-fidelity visual targets and production-ready UI assets, including icons, menus, HUDs, and exceptional UI motion graphics concepts. Support and drive the visual identity of the project, establishing style guides that serve to elevate the entire UI teams’ execution and alignment.
  • Lead Technical Integration: Optimize the asset pipeline and work directly with engine tools to support UI Tech Designers, leveraging a solid understanding of technical UI implementation standards. Solve advanced dynamic scaling, localization, and multi-platform layout challenges while strictly enforcing performance budgets, draw call optimizations, modular texture packing, and project-wide file systems.
  • Champion Autonomy & Workflow: Collaborate with UX design to create comprehensive UI art solutions with minimal to no supervision. Take end-to-end ownership of full features by managing complex asset pipelines, anticipating technical bottlenecks, and driving iterative design reviews.
  • Foster Collaboration & Communication: Partner with Leads, UI Engineers, UX Designers, and the XD Director to define technical constraints, refine workflows, and align cross-functional teams. Articulate art rationale clearly across disciplines, help drive feature reviews, and mentor peer artists to elevate the overall quality bar of the UI Art team.
WHAT WILL MAKE YOU A GREAT FIT

  • Design Mastery: Exceptional eye for core UI art principles, demonstrating expertise in visual hierarchy, color theory, dynamic composition, and typography.
  • Production Craft: Proven experience creating high-fidelity, production-ready UI assets, including polished HUDs, icons, and motion graphics concepts.
  • Technical Acumen: Deep understanding of technical UI implementation standards, including performance budgets, draw call optimizations, modular texture packing.
  • Pipeline Architecture: Experience managing complex asset pipelines, anticipating bottlenecks, and building scalable, future-proof UI file systems.
  • Mentorship & Communication: Strong ability to articulate artistic rationale across disciplines and a proven track record of mentoring junior or intermediate team members.
BENEFICIAL QUALIFICATIONS / NICE TO HAVES

  • Advanced proficiency working directly in game engines (e.g., Unreal Engine) and associated UI toolsets (e.g., UMG).
  • Strong background in motion graphics, animation, or visual effects specifically tailored to UI feedback loops and dynamic compositions.
