title: Onsite Specialist
description:
Who You Are

Swoogo seeks a hands-on, customer-focused Onsite Specialist to deliver our onsite services from first scope to final tear down. You will scope and quote custom engagements, order the hardware and consumables, and manage each project from start to finish. You will also lead our network of contract onsite technicians, who deliver most of our onsite work, and travel to events as the onsite technician yourself when an engagement calls for it. This role combines technical skill, project discipline, and the composure to run live check-in for a client's event. You report to the Senior Director, Onsite and work closely with Professional Services, Support, and our hardware partners.

Responsibilities

Scope and quote custom engagements

  • Run discovery with clients to understand event format, attendance, venue, check-in flow, badge and printing needs, and staffing requirements
  • Build scopes of work and quotes covering hardware, consumables, staffing, travel, and shipping
  • Price each engagement accurately and flag margin or scope risk before a quote goes out
  • Recommend the right mix of hardware and onsite staffing for each event
  • Track quotes through approval and hand off signed engagements with a complete scope

Order hardware and consumables

  • Place hardware and consumable orders (printers, scanners, tablets, badge stock, cables) with Swoogo's fulfillment partners and vendors
  • Confirm delivery dates, tracking, and return logistics so equipment arrives onsite and comes back on time
  • Keep an accurate record of orders, inventory, and cost per engagement
  • Stage, configure, and test equipment before it ships or travels with you

Manage engagements from start to finish

  • Own each engagement from signed quote through post-event wrap-up, and act as the client's point of contact
  • Gather venue details early, including network, power, load-in, and floor plan, and confirm them before travel
  • Build and maintain the project timeline, task list, and status for every engagement
  • Communicate progress, risks, and dependencies clearly to clients and internal stakeholders
  • Manage multiple engagements at once across different dates and locations
  • Close out each engagement with a wrap-up of equipment used, issues, and the inputs needed for accurate billing

Lead the contractor network

  • Onboard new contract technicians and enroll them in Swoogo Onsite Certification
  • Coordinate contractor availability and assign the right technician to each engagement
  • Prepare project briefs for handover, covering scope, venue details, equipment, schedule, and client contacts
  • Provide remote support to contractors during live events, and step in directly when an issue needs escalation
  • Generate post-event reconciliation reports covering hours, equipment, expenses, and billing inputs
  • Collect feedback from contractors and clients after every event, and report trends to the Senior Director, Onsite
  • Maintain contractor records, certification status, and performance history

Deliver onsite

  • Travel to events as the onsite technician on engagements you deliver yourself, representing Swoogo to the client
  • Set up, configure, and test check-in stations, badge printers, and related hardware and networking
  • Train client and event staff on check-in, badge printing, and equipment use
  • Troubleshoot hardware, printing, connectivity, and software issues in real time during live events, and escalate to Support or Product when needed
  • Tear down, pack, and return all equipment, and document its condition
  • Bring field feedback and recurring issues back to Product so our offerings improve
  • Follow Onsite Services processes, standards, and billing practices

Education, Experience, and Skills Required

  • At least 2 years of experience in a customer-facing, project-based role, such as event technology, event production, AV, or field services
  • Hands-on experience working at live events, ideally with check-in, badge printing, or event hardware such as printers, scanners, and tablets
  • Working knowledge of networking basics, including Wi-Fi and connectivity troubleshooting
  • Experience scoping, pricing, or quoting services, and coordinating contractors, vendors, or freelance technicians
  • Excellent project management skills, with strong attention to process, detail, and deadlines; experience with project management tools is a plus
  • Confident, client-facing, and an excellent communicator, comfortable training groups of adults
  • Calm, resourceful problem solver who stays steady when something breaks during a live event
  • Bachelor's degree in a related business or technical field, or equivalent experience
  • Experience with Zebra ZD621, ZC10L, Epson ColorWorks and similar label printers is a plus
  • Experience with event registration or check-in platforms is a plus

Travel and Physical Requirements

  • Travel to client events throughout the year, including evenings and weekends when events require about 75%
  • Lift, carry, and set up equipment cases up to 50 lbs
  • Occasional travel for company offsites; the role is otherwise remote

Swoogo & How We Work

Learn more about Swoogo and how we work.

Swoogo is committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination, sexual harassment, and all forms of abusive conduct. We do not tolerate harassment or discrimination of any kind—whether committed by managers, peers, clients, or vendors. We strictly comply with all applicable employment laws, including Title VII of the Civil Rights Act, the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), and the Age Discrimination in Employment Act (ADEA).

title: Advanced Physiotherapy Specialist
description:
Advanced Physiotherapy Specialist | Virtual/Remote | Full-time or part-time
Salary: £42,000 - £50,000 (pro rata if part-time)
Job Description

We are Ascenti. The leading provider of physiotherapy, mental health, and government assessment services in the UK. Our three Business Units – Ascenti Physio, Advo Health, and Six Physio – are bound together by our common purpose to help people live fuller lives. With more than 25 years’ experience serving both the public and private sectors, we are industry leading experts and passionate believers in our distinct clinical philosophy, because we know how it works and see first-hand how it helps people every day.

Your purpose

You will be a highly experienced physiotherapist with the ability to work independently and deliver the highest standards of clinical skills to patients. You will be responsible for delivering advanced musculoskeletal assessment, triage, and care to a varied caseload.

You will be responsible for referring patients into the most appropriate services within the agreed pathways, including referrals for appropriate imaging, GP review for bloods/investigations, orthopaedics, and rheumatology. How your role fits within our team As an Advanced Physiotherapist Specialist, you will be managed by an Area Manager and work within an Area team of other clinicians.

You will be supported clinically by an Advanced Physiotherapy Practitioner (APP) Lead, a Physiotherapy Development Lead (PDL), and more broadly by the Clinical Performance Lead.

Responsibilities

How your role fits within our team

As an Advanced Physiotherapist Specialist, you will be managed by an Area Manager and work within an Area team of other clinicians. You will be supported clinically by an Advanced Physiotherapy Practitioner (APP) Lead, a Physiotherapy Development Lead (PDL), and more broadly by the Clinical Performance Lead.

Key responsibilities

  • To work as an autonomous advanced practitioner, providing and delivering neuromusculoskeletal virtual physiotherapy assessments and management plans in 20-minute appointments.
  • To act independently to assess, analyse, and provide a clinical diagnosis for individual patients, including those presenting with complex conditions, to determine their need for further MSK or non-MSK intervention. This should involve an understanding of when to refer to other services such as diagnostics, pathology, trauma & orthopaedics, medication reviews, pain management, rheumatology, community physiotherapy, and injection therapy.
  • To understand each patients’ needs and expectations, and irrespective of their backgrounds and/or beliefs, to provide them with the quality of service to the standards the company expects.
  • To demonstrate excellence in report writing, and evidence an ability to complete reports autonomously without the need for further support.
  • To maintain up-to-date records in line with professional standards. These must be completed in a timely manner, whilst abiding by Ascenti internal procedures and Service Level Agreements. Keeping an up-to-date file of your CPD achievements, in line with HCPC guidelines.
  • To identify and manage any risks to quality, such as workload, communication, and team working, with the support of your manager and APP lead, and to advise on any issues regarding service delivery.
  • To work as part of a team and liaise with other physiotherapists internally to ensure delivery of clinically effective care.
  • To communicate effectively with all stakeholders (including patients, clinical colleagues, support functions, and external healthcare professionals etc.) on relevant matters in line with Ascenti procedures.
  • Ensuring effective patient management and working in collaboration with and/or referring to clinical colleagues in private hospitals and community settings including the GP where necessary.

This role profile is not exhaustive, and you may be directed to complete other tasks as required. These duties will always be reasonable and deemed within the expectations of your position.

Qualifications

Knowledge, experience, and qualifications

  • Extensive knowledge of neuromusculoskeletal symptomatology and evidence-informed practice.
  • Demonstrate advanced clinical examination skills (virtually), for example recognising MSK masquerades and nonMSK presentations.
  • Strong and accurate diagnostic skills from a virtual subjective and objective assessment.
  • Knowledge of medicines management, Injection therapy options, Imaging options that are most appropriate for various conditions/presentations.
  • Excellent communication skills, proven through positive feedback from patients.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, prioritise effectively and manage your time efficiently.
  • 5 years + of post-graduate musculoskeletal physiotherapy practice experience; preferably in both public and private settings, unless exceptional clinical skills and knowledge can be demonstrated in those who have less than 5 years of MSK clinical experience.
  • Using modern IT systems or software to support your practice, e.g. videocall technology or electronic note taking.
  • Experience of working as a virtual Physiotherapist.
  • Demonstrable experience in referring for appropriate diagnostics.
  • Risk assessment and management.
  • Evidence of conducting initial assessments, providing diagnosis, and prescribing advanced treatment plans across a wide range of complex MSK conditions.
  • Experience working with a wide range of patients as part of a multidisciplinary team, communicating clinical information clearly and providing consistent patient care.
  • Evidence of producing well-structured written documents or reports. BSc (hons) Physiotherapy degree of 2:2 or above or Pre-Reg Masters in Physiotherapy.
  • Evidence of continued professional development which evidences the skills / competencies required for this role. MSc degree in Physiotherapy / Advanced Practice.
  • Working towards MSc in Advanced Practice. Masters (L7) level modules relating to FCP competencies.
  • Demonstrable competence through accredited courses in imaging (MRI/CT/DXA/UKS) training; IR(ME)R Training. Full HCPC membership is essential and must be maintained throughout employment
Experience

Professional standards

We care about doing the right thing by our people and everyone that we work with. We also expect our people to do the right thing and to model the behaviours outlined in our Code of Conduct.

As an Ascenti employee you will follow key principles and policies covering Safeguarding, Equality Diversity and Inclusion, Data Protection, and Risk Management.

title: Software Integration Engineer III/IV
description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

Position Summary

At Zone5 Technologies, we’re redefining what’s possible in unmanned aircraft systems. Our team of engineers and innovators is developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions that push the boundaries of UAS technology — solving complex challenges that matter.

We’re building the future of UAS capabilities, and we’re looking for exceptional talent to join us. If you’re driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on next-generation flight systems, you belong here.

The Software Integration Engineer III–IV is a senior individual contributor role responsible for owning system interfaces and integrating subsystems so they communicate reliably with one another. The engineer will integrate flight software, avionics, sensors, payloads, datalinks, ground systems, and vendor equipment; verify interfaces through laboratory, ground, and flight testing; and work closely with GNC, avionics, software, systems, and flight test teams to ensure safe and reliable aircraft performance. Engineers at this level are the technical authority for the interfaces they own.

The ideal candidate combines:

  • Interface Control Documents (ICDs) & Interface Requirements
  • System & Subsystem Integration
  • Communication Protocols & Data Buses (Ethernet, Serial, CAN, MIL-STD-1553, ARINC 653, WOSA)
  • Messaging Middleware (DDS, ROS2, MAVLink)
  • Interface Verification & Validation (V&V)
  • Hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) & Software-in-the-loop (SITL)
  • Network & Bus Analysis
  • Systems Engineering & Requirements Management
  • Test Automation
  • Root Cause Analysis

Level Expectations

Level III (5+ years of experience)

  • Owns multiple subsystem interfaces end to end, from ICD definition through implementation, verification, and configuration control.
  • Authors and maintains ICDs and negotiates interface agreements with internal teams and external vendors.
  • Plans integration sequences and interface test campaigns and defines pass/fail criteria.
  • Leads root cause investigations for complex, cross-subsystem interface anomalies.
  • Provides technical guidance and peer review to junior engineers.

Level IV (8+ years of experience)

  • Serves as interface authority for a full platform or across multiple platforms, owning the overall interface architecture and system data flow.
  • Defines interface standards, messaging architecture, and versioning and compatibility strategy used across products.
  • Leads integration of third-party, customer, and government-furnished systems and represents interfaces design reviews and customer engagements.
  • Resolves the most ambiguous, high-risk integration problems and mentors engineers at all levels.

Responsibilities

Interface Ownership

  • Own system and subsystem interfaces across flight software, avionics, sensors, payloads, datalinks, and ground control systems.
  • Collaborate with systems engineering to author, maintain, and configuration-control ICDs, interface requirements, message definitions, and data dictionaries.
  • Coordinate interface changes with internal teams, vendors, and customers.
  • Define interface architecture, including protocols, message sets, rates, timing, and error handling.
  • Assess the impact of proposed interface changes and manage versioning and backward compatibility.
  • Write software to integrate new components into Zone 5 systems and write software to integrate Zone 5 systems into existing platforms.

Integration & Verification

  • Plan integration sequences and system build-up from component level through the full air vehicle.
  • Develop and execute interface and system-level integration and verification tests traceable to ICDs and requirements.
  • Develop simulators, emulators, and test harnesses for external systems.
  • Troubleshoot complex failures using bus and network captures, telemetry, logs, and system diagnostics.
  • Plan and support hardware-in-the-loop (HITL), software-in-the-loop (SITL), iron-bird, simulator, ground, and flight testing, serving as a representative from the software org to the test community at large.
  • Ensure test execution complies with safety requirements and test objectives.
  • Lead anomaly investigations, identify root causes, and drive corrective actions to closure.

Technical Ownership & Collaboration

  • Coordinate software integration activities across multiple platforms.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including software, systems, controls, guidance, avionics, and hardware engineers.
  • Design and improve automated interface testing, continuous integration, and HITL/SITL infrastructure.
  • Provide technical mentorship and code, ICD, and test reviews for junior engineers.
  • Integrate feedback from Test and Evaluation, and Production into procedures and test plans.
  • Represent interfaces and integration in design reviews, test readiness reviews, and customer engagements.
  • Support integration events, flight testing, field testing, and mission operations as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards, safety requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Research emerging technologies and recommend improvements to current integration activities.
  • Operate effectively in fast-paced prototype and development environments.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Level III: 5+ years of relevant experience in system integration, interface development, or V&V of aerospace, defense, or other safety-critical systems.
  • Level IV: 8+ years of relevant experience in system integration, interface development, or V&V of aerospace, defense, or other safety-critical systems.
  • Demonstrated experience authoring and owning ICDs and interface requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of communication protocols and data buses such as Ethernet (TCP/UDP), serial (RS-232/422/485), CAN, MIL-STD-1553, ARINC 653.
  • Experience integrating subsystems from multiple teams or vendors into a working system.
  • Understanding of aircraft systems and avionics integration.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more of the following: C/C++, Python, MATLAB/Simulink.
  • Hands-on experience with software-in-the-loop (SITL) and/or hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) test environments.
  • Experience with network and bus analysis tools such as Wireshark or CAN/1553 bus analyzers.
  • Proven track record of planning and executing integration campaigns from requirements through final report.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, including negotiating interface agreements and briefing technical results to engineering leadership and customers.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with autonomous aircraft, UAVs, missiles, or robotic systems.
  • Familiarity with DDS, ROS2, MAVLink, STANAG 4586, or other UAS messaging standards.
  • Experience working with UAI (Universal Armaments Interface) and experience integrating, testing, or supporting mission stores on fixed-wing jet aircraft
  • Experience with military-grade GNSS receivers and navigational systems
  • Familiarity with open architecture standards such as WOSA.
  • Experience integrating datalinks, radios, and ground control systems.
  • Understanding of guidance, navigation, and control architectures.
  • Experience with time synchronization (e.g., PTP, IRIG-B, GPS time).
  • Familiarity with DO-178C, DO-160, and Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), including SysML interface modeling.
  • Experience with flight-critical or safety-critical software.
  • Familiarity with VxWorks or other RTOS environments.
  • Experience with DevOps workflows and automated infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting flight tests or operational deployments.
  • Active U.S. security clearance.

Level III: $136,000 - $182,000/yr.

Level IV: $164,000 - $210,000/yr.

Pay range for this role
$136,000—$210,000 USD

What's in it for you:

Benefits:

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • Comprehensive benefit package options include medical, dental, vision, life, and more.
  • 401k with company-match
  • 3 weeks of paid time off each year
  • 40 hours of sick time
  • 12 annual company holidays

Why Join Zone 5 Technologies?

  • Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge technology that is shaping the future of defense and aerospace.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

If you are passionate about unmanned aircraft technology and want to be a part of a dynamic and growing company, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and join the Zone 5 Technologies team!

title: Associate/Manager, Zapp Media Services (Retail Media)
description:
Associate/Manager, Zapp Media Services (Retail Media)

Vauxhall, London.

About Zapp

Zapp is London's leading premium convenience retail platform. Founded in 2020, our vision is to disrupt the multi-trillion dollar convenience retail market, currently dominated by major players, by developing best-in-class customer-centric technology and fulfilment solutions. Zapp partners with some of the world's leading brands to deliver an exclusive range of hand-picked products 24/7, delivered in minutes.

Job Summary

Zapp Media Services (ZMS) is Zapp's retail media business. We help premium brands reach London's most valuable grocery customers through in-app media, CRM, sampling, packaging, out-of-home and experiential activations, and we prove what that investment delivered.

Our Category Managers own each brand relationship and lead the Joint Business Plan (JBP). You will sit alongside them as the ZMS specialist: you shape the media section of the JBP, agree objectives and measures up front, then run every activation from brief to go-live to results. You will report performance back to brands, and to our senior leadership, in a way that earns the next, bigger plan. The brands we work with expect the quality of a global agency at the speed of a startup.

At this level, success is defined by flawless delivery: every booked activation lands on time, looks premium and is measured properly, and every brand leaves a campaign wanting to rebook. You will also help build ZMS as a function, turning what you learn on each campaign into better packages, processes and tools.

Key Responsibilities and Expectations

Shape the plan

  • Join Category Managers in JBP conversations with brand partners and build the ZMS section of each plan: objectives, media mix, timings, investment and the measures we will report against.

  • Build proposals from Zapp's rate card and media inventory, matching each activation to the brand's goal, whether that is trial, penetration, a new product launch or a seasonal sales moment.

  • Turn brand briefs into clear internal briefs for Marketing, CRM, Creative, Supply Chain and Category teams, each with an owner and a deadline.

Deliver the activations

  • Own end-to-end delivery of every campaign in your portfolio across multiple channels: in-app placements and sponsored listings, homepage and category takeovers, push and email CRM, sampling and gift-with-purchase, bag drops and inserts, social, experiential and out-of-home.

  • Run the campaign calendar and media inventory so we never double-sell a placement, miss a go-live date or run a campaign without stock behind it.

  • Work across Marketing, Supply Chain, Product, Legal, Finance and Operations to land each campaign seamlessly, including getting sampling and gift-with-purchase stock to the right fulfilment centres on time with clear picking instructions.

  • Check every activation live in the app and on before confirming launch to the brand, and fix issues the same day.

  • Manage creative and asset approvals with brands and their agencies, holding the line on Zapp's brand standards.

Prove the results

  • Deliver post-campaign reports within agreed timelines, covering delivery (impressions, clicks, samples distributed), sales uplift, new-to-brand customers and repeat rate against the objectives set in the JBP.

  • Pull your own data from Claude, and turn it into a clear story with a recommendation for the next campaign.

  • Present campaign results and insights to brand partners and to Zapp's senior leadership.

  • Keep a live campaign tracker so Category Managers, Finance and leadership can see what is booked, live, delivered and invoiced at any time.

  • Raise the billing paperwork for each campaign with Finance, so every pound committed is invoiced and collected.

    Build ZMS

  • Establish and document best practice for campaign delivery, so every brand gets the same standard whoever runs their campaign.

  • Capture what worked and what did not after each campaign, and turn repeatable wins into standard packages on the rate card.

  • Spot upsell opportunities in campaign results and hand them to the Category Manager with the data to support the conversation.

  • Stay ahead of retail media and premium brand trends, and bring new activation ideas that keep ZMS ahead of the market.

Core Competencies and Skills

  • 2–5 years in retail media, trade or shopper marketing, media agency account management, or partnerships at a retailer, marketplace or FMCG brand. At Manager (L5) level, you have run multi-channel brand campaigns on your own from brief to results.

  • Proven experience executing marketing campaigns and improving their performance using data.

  • Highly organised: you run many campaigns at once, each with different stakeholders and deadlines, and nothing slips.

  • Data driven: confident in Excel, Google Sheets and AI tools, and able to turn campaign results into a clear, honest story.

  • Builds strong relationships with brand partners and internal teams, and presents insights to senior audiences with confidence.

  • High standards for detail and presentation: you notice the wrong pack shot before the brand does.

  • Proactive, entrepreneurial and hands-on, willing to roll your sleeves up and seek solutions in a fast-paced environment.

title: Manager II, Software Engineering
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Recovering entrepreneur? Frustrated with bureaucracy? Want to build the team and write the roadmap, not inherit one?

We’re hiring Engineering Managers across multiple verticals. The nice thing about growing 30%+ at ~$2.1B ARR is that we need great engineering leaders everywhere, and we have the room to shape the team around the right person. You lead like a founder. We give you the platform to do it at scale.

About the role:

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We’re still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we’re hiring the leaders who will build the teams that build what comes next.

We’re at ~$2.1B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We’re looking for Engineering Managers who want to define what ships next by building and leading great teams. You’ll manage engineers across platform and product, and we’re open to shaping team scope around the right person’s strengths and interests. That window won’t stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US or Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software your team builds will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn’t metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.
  • You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. Your team will build new systems from scratch, not babysit old ones. You’d own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.
  • You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.
  • You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You and your team will participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.
  • You believe great teams are the real product. You get energy from hiring exceptional people, growing them, and creating the conditions for them to do the best work of their careers. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn’t tooling or process. It’s ambition, and your job is to unlock it.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and grow a team of engineers: hire top talent, coach and develop individuals, manage performance, and build a culture of ownership, quality, and velocity.
  • Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.
  • Define and drive technical strategy and roadmap for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.
  • Guide your team to design and ship full-stack features end to end, delivering AI-powered products that solve real operational problems across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile.
  • Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans, staffing, and measurable outcomes.
  • Oversee the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators, and stay close enough to the technical work to guide architecture and make sound tradeoffs.
  • Raise the bar across engineering through design reviews, hiring standards, mentorship of senior engineers and future leaders, and by setting the standard for quality, velocity, and craft.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.
  • 3+ years of experience directly managing software engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development.
  • Strong technical fundamentals across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile), enough to guide architecture, review designs, and earn your team’s respect.
  • Familiarity with modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.
  • Experience building or leading teams that build AI-powered or data-driven products. You don’t need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executives.
  • A track record of building: zero-to-one products, teams and systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that’s LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.
  • Experience leading teams through AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply output and accelerate delivery.
  • Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.
  • A proven track record of managing and developing senior engineers, building managers-of-managers, and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.
  • Experience scaling teams through fast growth, including building hiring pipelines and onboarding.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$155,000—$260,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. title: Control Room Operator
description:
The Enviva team is driven by our shared vision for a renewable energy future. We are a fast-growing, purpose-driven, global energy company specializing in delivering sustainable wood bioenergy solutions. We are the world’s largest producer of sustainable wood pellets, which provide a low-carbon alternative to fossil fuels.

The Control Room Operator is responsible for monitoring the status of all plant systems on a continuous basis. The operator will respond to alarms by taking appropriate corrective actions and procedures and ensure that the plant meets its generating requirements while operating safely and efficiently.
The operator will also monitor activities and ensure the smooth functioning of systems and equipment. To succeed in this role, these individuals require an understanding of control room operations, the ability to prepare accurate records, and a range of other technical and soft skills.

Responsibilities

  • Operate plant functions from the control room.
  • Manage chip feed system, fuel feed system, furnace, dryer system, primary and secondary sizing and pellet presses.
  • Act as overall contact for plant operations.
  • Monitoring: Checking indicator screens and signal lights, and monitoring production rates and system statuses. Monitor spark detection equipment. Manage and monitor various levels and feed rated to ensure continuous plant operation.
  • Adjusting: Translating signals into production realities and adjusting production line processes. Operate computers, monitors and corrects operational values.
  • Maintaining: Maintaining working schedules, equipment temperature, and safety standards
  • Resolving issues: Assess and adjust accordingly to criticality of potential malfunctions and equipment failures, and using technical skills to resolve problems
  • Communicating: Communicating with team members and responding to calls for assistance. Multi-task with equipment alarms and radio commands/communication.
  • Strong aptitude in math; ability to use addition, subtraction, multiplication and division to perform flow, pressure, performance and meter calculations
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team environment
  • Knowledge of generating unit operation, engineering, or maintenance practices

Qualifications

  • Ability to understand and follow written and verbal job instructions.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and written procedures.
  • Be able to use basic hand tools.
  • Must possess basic computer & math skills.
  • Able to learn how to operate HMI touch screens.

Preferred Qualifications - What Sets You Apart

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Experience in wood products, furnace/dryer operations, or similar manufacturing environment
  • High attention to detail.
  • Ability to work under stressful conditions.
  • Problem solving skills.
  • Prior experience working in a Control Room

Working conditions

  • Must be able to work in outdoor environments and occasionally in temperatures above 100 degrees and below 32 degrees
  • Willing and able to work in a hot, humid, cold and noisy industrial environment
  • Willing and able to maintain strict adherence to safety rules and regulations, to include wearing safety equipment.
  • Occasionally walk on slippery or uneven surfaces.
  • Ability to work shift assignments up to 12 hours that include weekends, nights or rotating shifts.

title: Stringer Operator (Pitman Day Shift)
description:
Summary of Position

The Stringer Operator is responsible for the safe, efficient, and precise operation of the Stringer machine. This role requires a combination of production expertise, technical understanding, and mechanical aptitude to ensure consistent product quality, maximum equipment uptime & FTT (first time through). The Stringer Operator will monitor Stringer performance, operate using HMIs, perform hands-on preventive and autonomous maintenance, and assist with troubleshooting and minor repairs under the guidance of maintenance and engineering teams. The schedule for this position is 12 hour rotating shifts from 6AM - 6PM.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

· Safely operate and monitor stringer machinery, ensuring proper function and throughput.

· Load materials, visually inspecting solar cells and verifying product quality against established standards.

· Operate and navigate HMI and NC equipment interfaces for machine control, diagnostics, and basic troubleshooting.

· Perform hands-on preventive maintenance (PM) and autonomous maintenance tasks such as cleaning, lubrication, and inspection of key components.

· Troubleshoot, communicate and help resolve basic machine faults issues to minimize downtime, escalate as needed

· Record hourly production and performance data accurately and report deviations or abnormalities.

· Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and quality teams to implement process improvements and corrective actions.

· Follow all established safety, quality, and operational procedures, maintaining a clean and organized work area.

· Support training and onboarding of new operators on stringer operation and maintenance best practices.

· Other duties as assigned by Lead Hand and Supervisor

Skills

· Experience working with HMIs and operating numerical control (NC) or automated production equipment.

· Strong understanding of preventive maintenance and basic mechanical/electrical troubleshooting.

· Fine motor control and steady hand-eye coordination for handling delicate solar components.

· Clear and effective communication skills for documenting and reporting equipment or process issues.

Traits

· Critical thinker with the ability to identify root causes and propose practical solutions.

· High attention to detail and commitment to producing quality work.

· Team-oriented with a proactive approach to safety and continuous improvement.

· Dependable, adaptable, and eager to develop advanced technical skills.

Education and/or Experience

· High School Diploma or equivalent required; technical diploma or certificate preferred.

· Minimum 2 years of production experience in an autonomous manufacturing environment.

· Hands-on experience operating HMI-controlled equipment, NC machinery, and performing preventive/autonomous maintenance.

· Familiarity with basic mechanical, pneumatic, or electrical systems preferred.

We are the Ascenti Group. The leading provider of physiotherapy, mental health, and government assessment services in the UK. As the Virtual Physiotherapy Service Lead, you are a senior leader and the operational engine behind our inhouse virtual service lines. You will lead service delivery activity, take accountability for the balanced operational performance of the in-house virtual physiotherapy services across people, patient experience, quality, customer, productivity, capacity, compliance and agreed financial measures, and ensure that the virtual-only team are well managed, engaged and supported. You will help to ensure that virtual and digital services deliver high-quality patient and customer experience through clear operational focus, consistent resource planning, proactive performance oversight and close collaboration with clinical, operational and transformation colleagues.

How your role fits within our team

As the Virtual Physiotherapy Service Lead, you will provide line management for the virtual-only team and support the day-to-day operational management of key virtual and digital service lines. You will lead the delivery of our in-house virtual physiotherapy service lines, acting as an expert in virtual and digital healthcare pathways. You will deliver a consistent, high-quality service, continually improving standards and spotting opportunities to drive clinical efficiencies and revenue growth. This includes full operational ownership of day-to-day SLA and KPI tracking, management of performance reporting cycles, and close collaboration with the Head of Operations – Virtual and the Transformation team on service updates and new client onboarding.

You will develop meaningful working relationships with your team, regularly reviewing their performance, listening to their feedback, coaching them to improve, and celebrating their successes. You know that the best way to lead a team of remote physiotherapists is to respect their clinical opinion, collaborate effectively across digital platforms, and provide support whenever they need your help.

You will naturally take accountability and be ready to motivate and lead your team members to deliver excellence, ensuring you have the right blend of skills to meet the demands of the service. You will support clinicians to achieve their professional ambitions, managing performance consistently and fairly to achieve agreed clinical measures and KPIs. Above all, you will celebrate diversity and create a remote environment where your team feels connected, engaged, and able to bring their true selves to work.

You will work directly with internal stakeholders, such as the Account Management team, Clinical Governance and the Product Owner for Ascenti Reach, to ensure quarterly and annual performance targets are achieved. You will use service, activity, workforce and financial data to understand performance drivers, identify risks and opportunities and take informed corrective action within your delegated authority. You will play a critical role in shaping the future functionality of our digital tools, providing feedback to improve the user experience for both patients and clinicians, thereby supporting the sustainable growth of Ascenti’s virtual services.

Key responsibilities

Pioneering – Leading the organisation

  • Deliver our business plan objectives and our commitment to high standards of performance.
  • Manage your resources within agreed budgets and achieve agreed deadlines.
  • Raise and maintain Ascenti’s profile and reputation by achieving agreed contractual standards, taking an innovative approach to shared challenges, and positioning Ascenti as a partner of choice.
  • Ensure sustainability by protecting customers, colleagues, and Ascenti from unnecessary risks.
  • Create a culture of open and honest communication, cascading communications, feeding back concerns through appropriate channels, and celebrating success across the organisation.
  • Manage informal and formal change projects to achieve shared business goals.
  • Spot opportunities for improvement and provide feedback on how we can do things better.
  • Build and maintain productive stakeholder relationships, providing oversight of service delivery, performance outcomes, resource requirements and areas of concern.
  • Proactively implement new ways of working, launch new services, and create new sources of revenue through digital integration.
  • Take an active role in the opening of new clinics and/or new services to customers.
  • Lead regular operational performance reviews for in-house virtual services, using data and insights to understand performance drivers, agree prioritised actions and monitor delivery.

Dependable – Leading self

  • Discuss and agree measurable annual, quarterly and monthly goals with management.
  • Become a trusted advisor to your stakeholders, communicate clearly and meet agreed deadlines.
  • Have a clear and detailed understanding of your contractual obligations. Regularly present performance and assurance information to Ascenti colleagues, commissioners and other external stakeholders.
  • Grow your leadership skills through formal and informal learning opportunities, Continuing Professional Development and reflective practice.
  • Manage your time effectively to optimise team and personal performance, minimise unnecessary travel and expenses, support team members consistently and meet your goals and objectives.
  • Demonstrate an operationally focused, evidence-based and practical approach to decision making.
  • Collaborate with internal specialists to achieve service, regional and company goals and objectives.
  • Oversee resource and capacity management across our in-house virtual and digital service lines, maintaining demand, capacity and workforce forecasts to ensure resources are aligned to current and anticipated service demand.
  • Understand and actively manage the operational and financial drivers within your delegated authority, including productivity, workforce utilisation, capacity and agreed controllable costs, escalating material risks and opportunities to the Head of Operations – Virtual.
  • Make timely operational decisions within delegated authority and escalate material commercial, contractual, financial, clinical or strategic decisions to the Head of Operations – Virtual.

United – Leading others

  • Create an environment where colleagues feel safe and can bring their true selves to work, ensuring that Ascenti is an equal, diverse, and inclusive workplace.

  • Support the Performance Development Lead (PDL) and mentors to direct clinical and operational focus
  • Support your team to achieve their career goals and give regular feedback about team and individual performance, through 1:1s, meetings, appraisals, competency assessments, etc.
  • Ensure that all mandatory learning modules are completed by your team.
  • Where performance falls below expected standards, you will proactively address performance concerns, ensuring appropriate interventions are implemented in accordance with organisational policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Protect the wellbeing of your team with the support of the People Team and other partners.

Caring – Delivering great customer service and high standards of patient care

  • Be an ambassador for Ascenti and our values, both internally and to external stakeholders.
  • Ensure that your team complies with all legal, regulatory, and governance requirements at all times.
  • Support your team to manage customer expectations and to respond to direct feedback, complaints and/or concerns in a constructive way.
  • Respond promptly to escalated client concerns, identifying root causes to minimise repeated issues and protect the brand reputation.

Knowledge, experience, and qualifications

  • Sound understanding of leadership principles, managing resources and budgets, leading teams, and providing high standards of customer care.
  • Good computer literacy and IT skills – particularly working with Microsoft Office and bespoke systems.
  • Appreciation of ethical obligations in physiotherapy/healthcare, with a strong sense of professional integrity. Strong written and oral communications skills to meet the needs of diverse audiences.
  • Comprehensive understanding of resource and capacity management for large, remote clinical workforces.

  • Advanced leadership skills
  • Understanding of tech-enabled healthcare trends, including automation and digital triage platforms
  • Experience of line management and team development of a specialist virtual team of practitioners. Experience of account, relationship and/or contracts management.
  • Experience interpreting operational and financial performance data and translating insight into practical action.
  • Experience implementing project plans, corporate goals/objectives and sustainability activities.
  • Experience working in an environment of ongoing change.
  • Experience supporting or managing performance, disciplinary or conduct matters in line with organisational policies and formal procedures.
  • Demonstrable experience within a cluster/area management role.
  • Experience of working in a leadership role in a regulated environment - such as Health/Medical/Finance.
  • Experience managing large, dispersed or remote clinical teams at a national scale.
  • Experience managing large revenue budgets.
  • Experience leading the strategic implementation of new digital health services or large-scale clinical pilots.
  • Level 5 leadership qualification, educated to degree level or equivalent professional experience.

Waymo’s Product Management Team is a mission-driven team responsible for writing and enacting first-of-their-kind playbooks to bring fully autonomous driving technology to market. title: Sales Enablement Specialist (Proposal Design)
description:
WHAT'S THE ROLE

We’re looking for someone who knows how to take complex information and make it clearer, sharper and more compelling, both visually and in writing.

As our new Sales Enablement Specialist, you’ll have the opportunity to take real ownership of the design and production side of sales enablement, while partnering with teams across the business to bring important ideas to life.

This is a role for someone who combines strong design instincts, business writing skills and a collaborative mindset, and who wants the opportunity to make the function their own.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your time will be split approximately 50/50 between strategic pursuits (proposal design) and event design, giving you the opportunity to work on everything from major proposals and client presentations to high-profile corporate events.

  • Turn complex business ideas into clear, visually engaging presentations, proposals and communications.
  • Design PowerPoint presentations, infographics, diagrams and other visual content that help tell the story.
  • Bring structure, creativity and polish to major proposals, RFPs and strategic pursuits.
  • Support corporate events with presentation design, infographics and other visual communications.
  • Write, edit and simplify content so the message is as strong as the design.
  • Partner with people across the business, combining their expertise with your design and communication skills to create audience-ready materials.
  • Own the work from rough concept through revisions and final production, keeping collaborators engaged and the work moving.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You’re a designer who can write and a communicator who thinks visually. You know how to balance ownership with collaboration. You’re comfortable taking the lead, making recommendations and moving work forward, while knowing when to ask questions, gather input and bring others into the process.

  • 3–5 years of professional experience creating polished, corporate-level presentations, documents and communications.
  • Strong PowerPoint and Word skills, including sophisticated layouts, templates, diagrams and long-form documents.
  • A strong eye for layout, typography, visual hierarchy and information design.
  • Excellent business writing, editing and proofreading skills.
  • Experience turning complex information into something clear, concise and compelling.
  • A strong sense of ownership, with the confidence to take the lead and drive work through to completion.
  • A collaborative approach, with the ability to build relationships, gather input and work effectively across different teams.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.
  • Proposal, RFP or B2B pursuit experience is a strong asset.
  • Adobe Creative Suite experience is an asset, but PowerPoint and Word expertise matters most for this role.
  • YES! we'll want to see your portfolio demonstrating professional presentation, infographic and document design.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • Be part of an industry that's more important than ever!
  • Award winning safety culture.
  • Supportive team environment with room to grow together.
  • Onsite Hybrid work model.
  • Employee Referral Program.
  • We are growing!
  • Certified as a Great Place to Work 2025-2026!

title: Talotekninen valvoja / Projektipäällikkö
description:
Tervetuloa töihin ennakkoluulottomaan rakentamisen ja rakennetun ympäristön suunnittelu- ja konsulttitoimistoon! A-Insinööreissä luomme kulttuuria, jossa asiantuntijamme ja asiakkaamme voivat onnistua yhdessä. Tarjoamme ison yrityksen edut, mutta pienen talon mutkattomuuden innostavassa, palkitussa työyhteisössä.

Haussa nyt
Talotekninen valvoja / Projektipäällikkö

Tule rakentamaan kanssamme rohkeasti parempaa! Kanssamme pääset osaksi innokasta ja vahvan osaamisen omaavaa tiimiä, jonka kanssa on mukavaa kehittää alaa parempaan suuntaan. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden tulla vahvistamaan toimialamme yksikköä Keski-Suomen alueella. Etsimme osaavia ihmisiä ratkaisemaan mielenkiintoisia haasteita monipuolisissa projekteissa ja kasvavassa sekä kehityshaluisessa työyhteisössä.

Taloteknisenä valvojana / projektipäällikkönä pääset mukaan rakentamaan kasvavaa ja kehittyvää organisaatiota, monipuolisiin ja vaihteleviin hankkeisiin rakennuttamisen projektihallinnan ja taloteknisen valvonnan tehtävissä Jyväskylän alueella. Toimit hankkeissa taloteknisenä asiantuntijana, osallistut suunnittelunohjaukseen ja varmistat osaltasi, että hankkeiden tekniset ratkaisut toteutetaan suunnitelmien, sopimusten ja asetettujen laatuvaatimusten mukaisesti. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä tilaajan, suunnittelijoiden, urakoitsijoiden ja muun valvontatiimin kanssa.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi taloteknisten töiden laadun ja etenemisen seuranta, työmaakatselmukset, dokumentointi sekä havaittuihin poikkeamiin reagoiminen ja korjaavien toimenpiteiden johtaminen/seuranta. Hankkeesta ja osaamisestasi riippuen tehtävässä voi painottua esimerkiksi LVIA- tai sähkötekninen valvonta.

Tehtävän nimetty toimipiste on Jyväskylä, osittaisin etätyömahdollisuuksin. Kohteet sijaitsevat Keski-Suomen alueella ja satunnaisesti valvontakohteet voivat sijaita kauempana, tehtävät edellyttävät ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.

Tehtävässä onnistumiseen tarvitset

· tehtävään soveltuvan rakennus- tai talotekniikan koulutuksen

· kokemusta rakennusteknisistä tai taloteknisistä valvontatehtävistä ja ymmärrystä työmaiden käytännöistä

· kykyä tulkita suunnitelmia, sopimusasiakirjoja ja teknisiä vaatimuksia sekä viedä havaintoja käytännön toimenpiteiksi

· oma-aloitteista, järjestelmällistä ja vastuullista työskentelyotetta

· hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kykyä toimia luontevasti tilaajien, suunnittelijoiden ja urakoitsijoiden kanssa

· sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa, kerrothan mikäli pystyt käyttämään työkielenä myös englantia tai ruotsia.

Eduksi katsomme RAV-pätevyyden sekä kokemuksen P1- ja Terve talo -rakentamisesta ja teollisuuden hankkeista. Myös muu tehtävää tukeva valvonta-, rakennuttamis- tai talotekninen osaaminen on meille plussaa.

Satsaamme sinuun ja työyhteisöösi
Haluamme, että ihmisemme voivat kehittyä osaajina omannäköisellään tavalla. Saat ympärillesi osaavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön sekä laajan asiantuntijaverkoston, jonka kanssa pääset ratkaisemaan vaativia suunnitteluhaasteita.

Tarjoamme sinulle joustavat työskentelytavat, monipuoliset henkilöstöedut sekä ison yrityksen mahdollisuudet työyhteisössä, joka kuuluu työntekijöidensä arvioimana Suomen innostavimpiin ja tekniikan alan ammattilaisten silmissä alan vetovoimaisimpiin työnantajiin (Innostavimmat 2026 ja Universum 2026).

Kiinnostuitko?
Jätä meille CV:si ja vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi 2.12.2026 mennessä osoitteessa . Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, joten suosittelemme hakemaan tehtävää mahdollisimman pian. Tietoturvasyistä emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä sinulle antaa:
Rakennuttajapäällikkö Matti Lappalainen, matti.lappalainen@ains.fi tai 040 5770 580.

A-Insinöörit - ihmisiä, joiden kanssa rakennat rohkeasti parempaa. Tutustu meihin ja rakennuttamisen, arkkitehtisuunnittelun, rakennesuunnittelun, korjaussuunnittelun, teollisuus- ja talotekniikka sekä yhdyskunta- ja ympäristösuunnittelun toimialoihimme .

title: Materials Specialist, Fuel Cladding and Irradiation Effects
description:
What we do at Blykalla

Blykalla is a global leader in advanced nuclear technology, commercialising the next generation of clean, reliable energy through its lead-cooled reactor, the SEALER. By combining decades of specialised research with world-class partners, Blykalla is building the backbone of the global AI and industrial economy. For more information, visit .


What you’ll get to do

Our team at Blykalla is looking for a materials specialist with deep expertise in fuel cladding, fuel-cladding interaction and irradiation effects. You will define how our cladding behaves inside the core, how the cladding reacts chemically with uranium fuel on the inside and liquid lead on the outside, and how the material changes under neutron irradiation. Your work decides which cladding we can qualify, and how to get the data needed.

You join the materials team as the technical owner for qualifying the fuel cladding. The cladding is the first barrier around the fuel, and it must keep its integrity for the full core life in a hot, irradiated, liquid-metal environment. You will work closely with the fuel, core design, and safety analysis teams as well as research institutions across Europe and the US.

Responsibilities

  • Own the technical basis for the cladding material and its corrosion-protective layer, from specification through qualification.

  • Assess and test fuel-cladding chemical interaction with uranium fuel, including carbon and nitrogen transport.

  • Assist with the irradiation programme to ensure all needed data is gathered. Interpret post-irradiation examination data on hardening, embrittlement, swelling, irradiation creep and helium effects.

  • Turn test results into design limits and lifetime models, together with the core design and fuel teams.

  • Map nuclear codes and standards, such as ASME Section III Division 5, onto cladding qualification, and contribute to the safety case for licensing with SSM and NRC.

  • Write and review technical reports and data packages and keep the team manager and other projects updated on progress, challenges and risks.

Who you’ll get to work with

The Materials Specialist sits in the Materials Engineering Team within Blykalla, and reports to the Head of Materials. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla.

Who you are

You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help in order for you to succeed in this role, these are:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in materials science, nuclear engineering or a related field.

  • Proven experience with fuel cladding materials for fast reactors or other advanced reactors, including fuel-cladding chemical interaction.

  • Solid understanding of irradiation effects in steels and how they translate into design limits and qualification requirements.

  • Hands-on experience of microstructural analysis.

  • Experience working with test reactor operators, research institutes or suppliers on material development.

  • Fluency in English, spoken and written. Swedish is an advantage.

Nice to have

  • Experience with various fuel systems.

  • Knowledge of liquid metal corrosion and liquid metal embrittlement.

  • Experience with ferritic, FeCrAl or oxide-dispersion-strengthened steels, or with thermal spray and laser cladding of tubes.

  • Familiarity with ASME, RCC-MRx and nuclear quality assurance requirements such as NQA-1.

  • Experience with fuel performance or materials modelling.

Salary range is flexible based on candidate profile, our band is from 57 000 - 75 000 sek/monthly.

Location

This position is for our office in Stockholm.

So, what do you think?

Don't miss the chance to be at the forefront of revolutionizing nuclear power. Join our team as Materials Specialist and help shape the energy landscape of tomorrow. Apply today with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and achievements.

We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply, and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about power supply!

Reference & Background Checks

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates. We may also conduct reference checks to gain a well-rounded understanding of your professional experience, performance, and ways of working. This includes both references provided by you and, where relevant, conversations with other professional contacts who have worked closely with you. We strive to be transparent about our reference-checking process and handle all personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. Any additional references will be sought with professional judgment and only when considered relevant to the role.

We offer competitive compensation aligned with our internal salary framework and growth potential in the role.

We do not accept applications via email.

We are not open to external help from recruitment agencies.

Note on AI Use: Blykalla may use AI technology to assist with certain administrative aspects of the hiring process, such as note-taking, interview documentation, and reporting. However, every resume and application is reviewed directly by our recruiting team. AI tools are used solely for operational support and do not influence candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. We have a lab, and we also power our own models in our own proprietary inference environment. Our models serve 500M+ inference calls monthly, and process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for the best talent we can find to join a rapidly scaling team that's defining the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - and are rapidly approaching $1M ARR per employee. We sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. We have thousands of customers building with us including the top startups and world-renowned enterprises, and are serving at tremendous scale: we process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily and handle more than 15 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven, the revenue is durable, and the growth trajectory is steep and getting steeper. We have a super flat culture and expect our employees to be deeply intimate with the details at all levels.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

About the role

Applied AI Engineers are the technical half of every deal at AssemblyAI. You'll partner with two Digital Native Account Executives and own the technical side of their book: from the first conversation with customers, to helping them win technical evaluations, to driving successful technical implementations.

Our digital native customers are the fastest-growing AI companies building with voice: voice agents, AI notetakers, dictation, and conversation intelligence. They move fast and test on their own, so speed matters at every step.

This is pre-sales engineering, but far more hands-on than a typical SE role. You'll write code for customers, build MVPs, debug their integrations, tune our models on their real audio, and do whatever it takes to make sure customers have successful implementations. Your AE owns the business case and the commercials. You own the developer and the technical work, and together you make customers happy and get them scaled up.

What you'll do

Customer-facing technical work

  • Join early, often on the first call, and become the developer's direct line to AssemblyAI in a shared communication channel (often Slack)
  • Help our customers evaluate and test our products: get their success criteria up front, help them design fair benchmarks, and catch mistakes (wrong model, bad truth files, misconfigured streams) early
  • Tweak configurations and help customers design robust implementations for their unique use cases
  • Build demos, prototypes, and proofs of concept in the customer's stack
  • Debug customer code and production issues across our streaming and async APIs
  • Stay close to the customer, earn their technical trust, and deliver first-class service that turns them into champions
  • Work collaboratively with your AEs on every account
  • Meet customers in person, including flying around the world to work with them onsite
  • Stay with the customer through production rollout, then hand off cleanly to our post-sale Forward Deployed Engineers

Product and roadmap influence

  • Influence our roadmap by bringing what you hear from customers to Product, Research, and Engineering, and test new models and features before customers see them
  • Turn customer issues into reproducible cases for Research and Engineering, and track patterns across accounts
  • Contribute to docs, guides, and example code that help developers integrate faster

Community and events

  • Represent AssemblyAI at Voice AI meetups, conferences, and customer events
  • Build developer-facing resources that are shared publicly

What you'll need

  • A strong technical foundation: an engineering degree, a coding bootcamp, a software engineering role, or a sales or solutions engineering role
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript, and the ability to read and debug code in other languages
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; you'll write customer Slack messages, emails, and technical guides every day
  • Experience with web APIs, WebSockets, and real-time data streaming
  • An understanding of audio fundamentals (sample rates, encodings, codecs), or the drive to learn them quickly
  • Fluency with AI tools like Claude or Cursor to prototype, debug, and solve problems fast
  • A high sense of urgency and persistence
  • Comfort with ambiguity and context-switching: you can take a vague problem, figure out what matters, and drive it to resolution, while keeping many customers and priorities moving at once
  • Must be based in San Francisco, London, or New York City, with an expectation of 3 days a week in-office attendance, and willing to travel roughly 10–25% of the time for customer visits, events, and team offsites

Nice to have

  • Experience at a startup or API-first company
  • Customer-facing experience as a solutions engineer, sales engineer, or developer advocate
  • Hands-on work with voice agent frameworks (LiveKit, Pipecat) or speech models
  • Public speaking or community involvement

Pay transparency

AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity across our team. Our salary ranges are set to be competitive for our size, stage, and industry, and reflect just one component of the full compensation, benefits, and rewards we offer.

Salary determinations consider a variety of factors, including relevant experience, technical depth, skills demonstrated during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below represents a general expectation for the posted position. However, we are open to considering candidates who may fall above or below the outlined experience level—in those cases, we will communicate any adjustments to the expected salary range.

The range provided applies to candidates located in the United States and London, UK. For candidates outside of these locations, compensation ranges may differ; any adjustments will be communicated throughout the interview process.

Salary range (US): $150,000 – $250,000 OTE

Salary range (London): £90,000 – £145,000 OTE

The expected total compensation for this role is listed above (including base salary and variable pay). Our total compensation package includes competitive equity grants, 100% employer-paid benefits, and working alongside the team in our San Francisco, New York City or London office. A 401k match up to 4% is offered to all US-based full time team members.

Using AI in your interview
If you’re selected for an interview, please read our Candidate AI Guidance. It explains how you can use AI at each stage of our process, from your application and take-home to the interviews themselves.

GDPR privacy notice
If you’re applying from the EU or UK, please review our Job Applicant Privacy Notice before applying.
