title: Freelance Graphic Designer
description:
About the Role

Tashas Group is looking for a talented, creative and detail-driven Freelance Graphic Designer to work across NALA and CRMNY, two distinct concepts within our Fast Casual division.

We are looking for someone with exceptional design sensibility, a strong background in packaging and labelling, and the ability to deliver beautiful, on-brand creative work at pace.

This is an ongoing freelance partnership, working closely with our Brand and Marketing teams across packaging, print, digital and in-store touchpoints. We are looking for a reliable creative partner who can develop a deep understanding of both brands, work independently and consistently deliver exceptional results with minimal direction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create engaging, high-quality design assets that reflect the unique identities of NALA and CRMNY.

  • Design packaging graphics, labels, stickers, sleeves and other branded applications.

  • Produce creative collateral for campaigns, product launches, menus, signage, social media and digital platforms.

  • Prepare accurate, print-ready artwork, with a strong understanding of dielines, print specifications and production requirements.

  • Maintain exceptional attention to detail across typography, layout, colour and final artwork.

  • Manage multiple briefs and deliver outstanding work within tight turnaround times.

  • Collaborate closely with the Brand and Marketing teams, responding quickly and thoughtfully to feedback.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven graphic design experience, ideally within food and beverage, FMCG, hospitality or lifestyle brands.

  • Strong, demonstrable experience in packaging and label design is essential.

  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, InDesign and Photoshop.

  • Excellent understanding of print production and artwork preparation.

  • A refined creative eye with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Ability to work quickly, independently and accurately without compromising quality.

  • Strong communication skills, reliability and a proactive, solutions-focused approach.

  • Experience in structural packaging design or developing new packaging formats is a bonus, but not essential.

The Person We're Looking For

You are creative, meticulous and naturally drawn to beautiful design. You understand that every detail matters, from the placement of a label to the balance of a layout. You thrive in a fast-moving environment, take pride in your work and consistently deliver creative that feels considered, polished and unmistakably on-brand.

How to Apply

Please share your portfolio, freelance availability and rates.

Your portfolio must include examples of packaging and label design you have personally developed, including both production-ready artwork and photographs of the finished packaging.

We are particularly interested in seeing how your designs translate from concept to finished product, demonstrating your understanding of print production, technical accuracy and attention to detail.

title: DRAM Architect – Staff Engineer - Solution
location: Boise, Idaho, United States of America
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Job Summary

We are advancing DRAM technology to deliver memory solutions that balance performance, power, cost, and reliability across a wide range of applications! Our teams work globally across technology, design, product, business, and systems engineering to solve sophisticated memory challenges and develop future generations of DRAM.

As a DRAM Architect, you will help define and optimize DRAM architectures while pioneering new memory features and system-level innovations. You will influence architectural decisions across current and future DRAM generations, build alignment across technical fields, and help deliver reliable, power-efficient solutions that meet aggressive performance and time-to-market goals.

Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate device, process, circuit, architecture, and system-level trade-offs to optimize DRAM performance, power, cost, and reliability
  • Define and evaluate innovative architectural solutions and features for current and future DRAM technologies
  • Drive architectural alignment across business, technology, design, product, and system teams
  • Apply AI-enabled workflows and tools to accelerate analysis, design-space exploration, and architecture development
  • Communicate complex technical concepts across fields and support industry standards discussions and partner negotiations

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
  • 5+ years of DRAM industry experience in design, architecture, or product engineering
  • Strong knowledge of DRAM and memory systems, including standards such as LPDDR5/6 and DDR5/6
  • Knowledge of DRAM circuit solutions, including command and algorithm logic, data path, address decoding, array and sensing, and power delivery networks
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills spanning circuit, architecture, and system levels

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced education or equivalent experience in semiconductor technology, circuits, or memory architecture

title: Regional Manager
description:
ABOUT US:

Cornerstone Residential is a comprehensive property management company committed to providing exceptional service while maximizing revenue for our partners. Our mission is to protect and enhance the value of the properties we manage, ensuring they thrive in a competitive market. Today, we manage over 23,000 housing units across 229 communities throughout the western and mid-United States.


At the heart of our operation is a strong focus on resident and employee satisfaction, which we believe is essential for maintaining high occupancy rates and fostering community loyalty. We strive to create welcoming and enjoyable living environments for all residents, ultimately driving income growth for property owners.


JOB SUMMARY:

The Regional Property Manager is a business leader who focuses on resident customer service and manages operations, leasing activity, renewals, collections, financial reporting, supplies, and communications for two or more residential properties. The ideal candidate should have experience with Market Rate lease-up and LIHTC affordable multi-residential properties. This position will report to the Utah Operations department.


CLASSIFICATION: Full-Time, Salary/Exempt


SHIFT: Monday - Friday 8 am-5 pm


COMPENSATION: $114,400- $124,800 year DOE (Eligible for Monthly Commissions and Quarterly Bonuses)


ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

1. Manage property operations -

  • Inspect Property on a regular basis and verify the condition of vacant units on both scheduled and unscheduled intervals.
  • Manage daily property requirements and maintain long-range capital improvements planning.
  • Ensure all monies received are deposited and recorded on a regular basis, and confirm proper bookkeeping procedures are followed.
  • Review weekly/monthly property status and financial reports.
  • Promptly respond to resident concerns, comments, and/or complaints.
  • Create a sense of team among properties while maintaining the policy of non-fraternization.
  • Review and refer any liability claims, legal complaints, or other violations to the legal department and/or corporate office.
  • Cultivates and retains relationships with owners, partners and executives for assigned portfolio.

2. Oversee property maintenance with the assistance of the maintenance team.

  • Review reports for repairs and maintenance and evaluate timely completion of work orders.
  • Oversee compliance with required permits for operating the property, such as, poll, elevator, etc.
  • Monitor electric, water, and gas usage on the property.
  • Ensure make ready turn times being met in compliance with company policy.

3. Maintain and manage all financial responsibilities.

  • Review and approve yearly operating budgets/forecasts and sales/marketing plans. Oversees compliance with budget goals.
  • Control cost by reviewing expenses on an on-going basis.
  • Review and approve capital invoices for payment in a timely manner.
  • Review variance reports and other weekly reports.
  • Assist and review reclass and accrual needs with site and accounting team.

4. Manage property personnel.

  • Create, mentor, and manage a cohesive property management teams in accordance with policies.
  • Coordinate orientation and ongoing training programs for property managers.
  • Review and approve performance reviews for staff and make recommendations for salary increases and/or advancement.
  • Manage time off for property managers and submit payroll for processing.
  • Ensure staff completes new hire safety orientation, as well as annual safety training.
  • Follow company procedures and report any Workers Compensation issues and/or employee incidents immediately to the Workers Compensation carrier, to management, and to Human Resources.
  • Develop employee performance goals and plans. Work with Human Resources on any employee concerns and terminations.

5. Manage, create, and monitor marketing activities.

  • Understand the market and any other aspects of the sub-market that could impact occupancy and/or income of the property.
  • Review and provide input on the creation of marketing surveys and approve marketing strategies to secure prospective residents.
  • Consistently reviews, evaluates and interprets market conditions and recommends adjusted rental and renewal pricing strategies as needed to drive occupancy and revenue growth.
  • Ensures that web sites and collateral materials are accurate and updated.

6. Perform other duties as assigned or requested to support property operations.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
About Us

At SimplePractice, we are improving access to quality care by equipping health and wellness clinicians with all the tools they need to thrive in private practice.

More than 250,000 providers trust SimplePractice to build their business through our industry-leading software with powerful tools that simplify every part of practice management. From admin work to clinical care, our suite of innovative solutions work together to reduce administrative burden—empowering solo and small group practitioners to thrive alongside their clients.

Award-winning and people-first, SimplePractice is shaping the future of health tech. In 2026, we were recognized by BuiltIn as a Best Remote Company to Work For, Software Guru's Best Places to Code, Becker Healthcare Telehealth Companies to Know, and we won a MedTech Breakthrough Award for Best Practice Management Solution Provider.

The Role

As a Senior Data Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping our data-driven culture. Your day-to-day will blend technical problem-solving with strategic thinking—developing metrics frameworks, optimizing reporting pipelines, and uncovering insights that guide Product, Design, Engineering and other key business areas. Using SQL, Tableau, and advanced analytics techniques, you’ll transform raw data into actionable insights, empowering stakeholders with the clarity they need. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally to define success, measure impact, and drive continuous improvement.

You’ll have the opportunity to mentor others and foster a culture of innovation by using data to drive product enhancements and business improvements. Whether designing experiments, optimizing user experiences, or translating insights into action, your work will directly contribute to better business outcomes and customer experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Develop automated reports and dashboards to support product and business operations, ensuring data accessibility and efficiency.
  • Analyze complex datasets using SQL and Tableau to uncover trends, drive actionable insights, and influence product roadmaps and executive decisions.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Design teams to deliver data-driven solutions that align with business goals.
  • Apply advanced analytics and statistical methods to identify key business trends and optimize decision-making.
  • Design and implement scalable data models that integrate multiple sources, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and accessibility.
  • Effectively communicate insights and analysis results to stakeholders across SimplePractice, highlighting opportunities to better serve both the business and its customers.
  • Mentor team members and act as a data subject matter expert, driving best practices in analytics and reporting.

Desired Skills & Experience

  • 7 years of experience in data analysis and analytics, with a proven track record of mentoring team members.
  • Advanced knowledge of data analysis tools and programming languages such as SQL and Python.
  • Experience building dashboards and visualizations in Tableau or similar BI tools.
  • Ability to interpret complex data using advanced analytics, such as predictive modeling, to forecast trends and optimize business outcomes.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information to multiple stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and effectively collaborate with multiple stakeholders.
  • Enthusiastic about data and analytics, learning new techniques and skills, and working with data scientists and engineers.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with dbt Cloud or similar tools
  • Knowledge of ETL pipelines and data warehouse best practices
  • Knowledge of techniques such as regression analysis, hypothesis testing, and multivariate analysis.

Benefits

We offer a competitive benefits program including:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life & disability insurance
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO), wellbeing days, paid holidays, and summer Fridays

title: Manager, Technical Account Management
description:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

You will build a team that is outcome-obsessed about rapid deployment, product adoption, partner retention, and growth, while making sure every Technical Account Manager delivers on the promise of the role.

Give a $h*t by stepping into problems early, removing blockers, and ensuring your team supports more than the immediate account request. You will create space for TAMs to bring useful product feedback, support marketing efforts, and coordinate with teams across Huntress. Candor will shape how you coach, set expectations, and address missed commitments. title: Facilities Technician Lead Hand
description:
Summary of Position

The Facilities Technician Lead Hand is responsible for operating, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing facility equipment and systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient manufacturing operations. This position serves as a senior technical resource within the Facilities team, providing hands-on leadership, technical guidance, and support to Facilities Technicians while assisting in the coordination of daily operations and maintenance activities.

The Facilities Technician Lead Hand must possess a strong understanding of facility systems, equipment operations, and critical operating parameters. Key responsibilities include performing preventive and predictive maintenance, conducting electrical and mechanical troubleshooting and repairs, monitoring equipment performance, and ensuring compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements. Additionally, this role supports the Facilities Supervisor by reviewing operational data, prioritizing work orders, verifying completed maintenance activities, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to minimize downtime, optimize system performance, and maximize equipment reliability.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Maintain facility equipment and systems to maximize operating performance, reliability, and efficiency while minimizing unplanned downtime.
  • Perform troubleshooting, maintenance, and repairs on mechanical, electrical, and facility process systems to restore equipment to proper and safe operating conditions.
  • Serve as a senior technical resource and provide guidance, training, and hands-on support to Facilities Technicians.
  • Assist the Facilities Supervisor with coordinating daily maintenance activities, assigning work priorities, and ensuring timely completion of work orders.
  • Review and audit preventive and predictive maintenance activities completed by other technicians to ensure accuracy, quality, and compliance with established procedures.
  • Perform preventive and predictive maintenance on facility equipment in accordance with manufacturer recommendations and established maintenance schedules.
  • Troubleshoot facility process operations and make necessary adjustments to maintain optimal performance.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot facility systems, including wastewater treatment (WWT), mechanical chillers, cooling towers, emission scrubbers, boilers, industrial air compressors, HVAC systems, pumps, valves, and water treatment equipment.
  • Take equipment and process data readings and maintain accurate operational logs and documentation in accordance with local, state, and federal requirements.
  • Utilize handheld instruments such as voltage meters, LEL meters, gas detection meters, pH meters, and other diagnostic tools to monitor and troubleshoot facility systems.
  • Support electrical and mechanical repairs, installations, modifications, and improvement projects as directed by the Facilities Supervisor or Facilities Manager.
  • Identify equipment deficiencies, recurring failures, and opportunities for process improvements; recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Assist with maintaining spare parts inventory levels and identifying critical replacement parts needed to support facility operations.
  • Ensure facility equipment breakdowns or unsafe operating conditions do not unnecessarily jeopardize production schedules.
  • Follow Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures when servicing equipment or addressing unsafe operating conditions.
  • Ensure compliance with Process Safety Management (PSM), Risk Management Program (RMP), and applicable permit requirements, including maintaining equipment records and documentation associated with regulated processes.
  • Maintain organized work areas in accordance with housekeeping and 5S requirements.
  • Promote a strong safety culture by demonstrating safe work practices and ensuring adherence to company safety policies, environmental regulations, and applicable OSHA requirements.
  • Support emergency response activities and participate as an on-site Emergency Response Team (ERT) member when required.
  • Assist with training and onboarding new Facilities Technicians, including equipment operation, troubleshooting procedures, preventive maintenance, and safe work practices.
  • Communicate equipment status, maintenance concerns, and operational updates to the Facilities Supervisor and other relevant departments.
  • Support small facility improvement projects and coordinate maintenance activities as assigned.
  • Perform other duties, projects, and special assignments as directed by the Facilities Supervisor or Facilities Manager.
  • Ensure all facility systems operate within established operational parameters and performance standards

Skills

  • Strong knowledge of industrial facility equipment, maintenance practices, and process operations.
  • Experience troubleshooting and maintaining wastewater treatment systems, mechanical chillers, cooling towers, emission scrubbers, boilers, industrial air compressors, HVAC systems, pumps, valves, and related facility equipment.
  • Strong electrical and mechanical troubleshooting skills, including the ability to use hand tools, power tools, and diagnostic instruments.
  • Experience with chemical handling and safe work practices associated with industrial chemical systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical diagrams, mechanical drawings, equipment manuals, and technical documentation.
  • Knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance practices and computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS).
  • Understanding LOTO, PSM, RMP, environmental compliance, and industrial safety requirements.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance, mentor team members, and assist with coordinating daily maintenance activities.
  • Strong problem-solving, organizational, and troubleshooting abilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across departments.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple maintenance activities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Traits

  • Self-motivated, dependable, and team-oriented.
  • Demonstrates leadership through technical expertise, accountability, and a hands-on approach.
  • High degree of attention to detail, precision, and follow-through.
  • Strong commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to work independently while providing guidance and support to other team members.
  • Adaptable and capable of responding effectively to changing operational priorities.
  • Willing and able to work rotating shifts, weekends, and overtime as required.

Education and/or Experience

  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience within a related field

Preferred:

  • At least 8 years of experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment working within a Facilities or Maintenance department.
  • Previous experience as a Lead Technician, Senior Facilities Technician, or similar technical leadership role.
  • Licensed operator of a wastewater treatment system (South Carolina Physical/Chemical).
  • Advanced knowledge of mechanical chillers, cooling towers, emission scrubbers, boilers, industrial air compressors, water treatment systems, and HVAC equipment.
  • Associate degree or certificate from a technical trade school in Industrial Maintenance, Mechanical Technology, Electrical Technology, or a related field.
  • Military experience in a mechanical, electrical, or facilities maintenance role.
  • Experience with CMMS systems, preventive maintenance planning, and maintenance work order coordination.
  • Experience in safe chemical handling and management

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive Market Wages
  • Paid Time Off (vacation, sick, and holiday)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance Plans
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Recognition Programs
  • Employee PV Panel Purchase Program

Additional Information

Silfab Solar is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Any information provided during the application process will be maintained in accordance with applicable privacy laws and Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) requirements.

title: Vuoropäällikkö, Hyvinkää
description:
Haluatko päästä hyödyntämään osaamistasi vastuullisessa roolissa, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan keittiön arkeen ja laadukkaiden ruokapalveluiden toteutumiseen? Etsimme vuoropäällikköä Hyvinkään Kauniston tuotantokeittiöön. Lue lisää tehtävästä ja hae mukaan osaavaan tiimiimme!

Työtehtävät

Etsimme vuoropäällikköä Hyvinkään Kauniston tuotantokeittiöön vastaamaan keittiön päivittäisen toiminnan sujuvuudesta. Tehtävässä toimit keskeisessä roolissa tuotannon, tilausten ja käytännön keittiötyön yhteensovittajana varmistaen, että palvelumme toteutuvat laadukkaasti, tehokkaasti ja aikataulussa.

Vastaat erityisesti Aromi-järjestelmän tilaustoiminnoista sekä raaka-aine- ja tuotetilausten hallinnasta, huolehdit yhteistyöstä tavarantoimittajien kanssa ja osallistut aktiivisesti keittiön käytännön toimintaan. Työhösi kuuluu myös omavalvonnan toteutumisen seuranta, dokumentaation ylläpito, elintarvikekustannusten ja hävikin hallinta sekä tuotannon ja toimitusten sujuvuuden varmistaminen. Lisäksi toimit tärkeänä tukena tiedonkulun koordinoinnissa, uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttämisessä ja keittiön arjen kehittämisessä yhteistyössä muun henkilöstön kanssa.

Työskentelet osana ammattitaitoista tiimiä, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan toiminnan sujuvuuteen ja laadukkaan ruokapalvelun toteutumiseen joka päivä. Työskentelet osana Kiljavan keittiön ja esihenkilön muodostamaa tiimiä. Tehtävään ei sisälly esihenkilövastuuta, mutta toimit tärkeänä tukena päivittäisen toiminnan organisoinnissa ja sujuvuuden varmistamisessa.

Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassaoleva. Työaika on pääsääntöisesti arkisin maanantaista perjantaihin klo 7.00-15.00.

Miksi meille?

Teemme Palmialla arjen palvelutyötä, jolla on suora vaikutus ihmisten jokapäiväiseen arkeen. Meillä olet osa kehittyvää, monipuolista ja osaavaa työyhteisöä, jossa avautuu säännöllisesti urapolkumahdollisuuksia. Työntekijöidemme urakehitystä tuemme tarjoamalla mahdollisuuden suorittaa ammattiosaamista tukevia oppisopimuskoulutuksia, kuten esimerkiksi lähiesihenkilötyön ammattitutkinnon.

Tarjoamme työsuhde-etuna Epassin, jota voit käyttää työmatka-, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointipalveluihin. Työterveyspalvelumme kattavat lakisääteisen työterveyshuollon lisäksi tuki- ja liikuntaelinsairauksien ja mielenterveyden sairauksien ennaltaehkäisevät palvelut.

Lue työnantajalupauksemme ja katso mitä ammattilaisemme kertovat työstään!

Edellytämme sinulta

Edellytämme sinulta aikaisempaa työkokemusta suurkeittiön vastuutehtävistä ja suoritettua alan tutkintoa. Menestyäksesi työssäsi tarvitset erinomaista suomen kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa. Hygieniapassi on tehtävässä välttämätön. Kokemus Aromi14 tuotannonohjausjärjestelmästä katsotaan tehtävässä eduksi.

Menestyt tehtävässä, kun työskentelet järjestelmällisesti, otat vastuuta kokonaisuuksista ja viihdyt yhteistyötä vaativassa roolissa. Arvostamme, että työnteko sujuu sinulta sekä tiimissä että itsenäisesti.

Kiinnostuitko?

Hae heti, sillä aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Hakuaika päättyy 22.11.2026. Huomioithan, että vastaanotamme hakemuksia ainoastaan sähköisen rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta. Emme käsittele sähköpostitse saapuneita hakemuksia.

Työt alkavat mahdollisimman pian.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat rekrytointitiimiltämme sähköpostitse osoitteesta rekrytointi@palmia.fi.

Ihmisten arjen sujuvaksi tekeminen on työtä, joka ei tule koskaan loppumaan. Palmia on merkittävä palvelualan toimija ja tarjoaa laajasti uramahdollisuuksia eri alojen tekijöille. Tarvitsemme jatkuvasti lisää ammattilaisia turvallisuus-, ruoka- ja ravintola-, siivous- sekä kiinteistö- ja talotekniikkapalvelujen tehtäviin. Tule meille jättämään oma kädenjälkesi!

title: GRC Staff Engineer
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

The Fivetran information security organization is a motivated and innovative team responsible for ensuring the continuous integrity, confidentiality, and availability of customers’ data. Our customers trust us with all their most sensitive information, and we consider maintaining that trust to be a critical, core component of our product and business. Fivetran is seeking a motivated candidate for a GRC Senior Engineer of the Security Team. The role requires a compliance-focused engineer with knowledge and expertise in building data sets that will be used to turn our compliance into a continuous data-driven function. The position reports to the Director, GRC.
Will build and own a security data lake that aggregates evidence and telemetry from across our environment, and use it to power continuous control monitoring (CCM) that replaces manual control testing with automation. You will also support core GRC operations, including internal and external audits, risk management, and vendor assessments. Acts as a subject matter expert within specific responsibility area(s) and applies internal audit best practices and keeps current with applicable rules and regulations for security compliance frameworks, as well as any authoritative pronouncements issued by relevant governing bodies. Advanced security risk or audit certifications are required and leading cybersecurity certifications are preferred.

This is a full-time position based out of our Denver office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

Technologies You’ll Use

AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Secureframe, Wiz, GitHub

What You’ll Do

  • You will build and maintain a security data lake on Fivetran itself, using our own platform to centralize the data that powers continuous control monitoring.
  • Govern the lake itself: enforce data quality, retention, least-privilege access, and sensitive-data handling
  • Build compliance-as-code: automated evidence collection, continuous control monitoring, and policy-as-code checks across cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, identity, and SaaS systems
  • Integrate and extend GRC tooling and internal platforms with APIs, scripts, and workflows that replace manual audit work and give real-time visibility into control health
  • Support Fivetran's certifications and attestations: ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 42001, PCI DSS, SOC 2, and HITRUST

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years in GRC, security engineering, data engineering, or a related fieldUnderstanding and ability to perform control testing, documentation, and control design
  • Strong SQL and proficiency in Python (or similar) for automation and data transformation
  • Hands-on experience with a modern data stack (cloud warehouse/lake, ETL/ELT, orchestration, transformation tooling)
  • Experience automating control testing or replacing manual compliance processes with code-driven checks
  • Working knowledge of several of: ISO 27001 family, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HITRUST
  • Familiarity with cloud security controls in [AWS / GCP / Azure] and common SaaS security configurations
  • Ability to translate control language into technical tests, and technical results into audit-ready narratives
  • Clear written communication and comfort working across Security, IT, Engineering, Legal, and Finance

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience in dealing with external audits
  • Professional audit or information security certifications preferred (CISA, CISSP, AWS, SANS GIAC, etc.).
  • An understanding of control frameworks Fivetran follows: SOC 1/2, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, HITRUST, FedRAMP

The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process.

Pay Range
$148,788—$185,984.75 USD

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

title: Product Director, Public Sector
description:
The Role

Unit4 supports hundreds of public sector organizations across the UK, Netherlands, the Nordics, and similarly managed geographies - municipalities, local authorities, agencies, non-department public bodies, and emergency services. These organizations operate under a persistent double constraint: budgets that do not grow and teams that are stretched thin, often without the dedicated technology capacity that private-sector counterparts take for granted. The gap between what they are expected to deliver for communities and what their current systems enable them to do keeps widening. As Product Director for Public Sector, you own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap that helps close that gap.

This is not a policy advisory role. You will have dedicated engineering capacity to build vertical depth that makes Unit4 genuinely competitive for local government and specialist agencies. You will work closely with horizontal product teams to ensure the platform delivers end-to-end across finance, HR, procurement, and operations, but the vertical product strategy and roadmap are yours.

The right person has built enterprise software for public sector organizations - municipalities, local authorities, agencies, or emergency services. You understand what public finance management looks like from the inside, what compliance and audit obligations demand in practice, and you have shipped features that public sector finance and operations teams actually use.

AI presents a genuine opportunity for public sector organizations: automating administrative burden, accelerating compliance processes, and providing better insight for decision-making. But these are not commercial organizations free to move fast and iterate. They are stewards of public funds, citizen data, and community trust, operating under transparency and security obligations that set a higher bar. This role exists to ensure Unit4's public sector roadmap is complete, balanced, and innovative without being reckless: a portfolio that earns the confidence of government buyers and gives public servants more time to focus on what they are there to do - building stronger communities.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Public Sector product vision, strategy, and multi-horizon roadmap; align it with Unit4's platform strategy and commercial growth targets.

  • Lead a prioritized product backlog with dedicated engineering capacity - defining outcomes, success metrics, release plans, and quality criteria.

  • Own feature outcomes, not just delivery — define clear adoption, usage, and customer impact goals for every capability you champion, and track performance against them after launch.

  • Serve as the internal authority on the Public Sector vertical, providing product, marketing, analyst relations, and pre-sales teams with the industry grounding they need to position, demonstrate, and sell effectively.

  • Translate deep sector knowledge into specific, investment-backed product requirements: problem statements, opportunity sizing, and build-vs-partner decisions.

  • Define industry-specific solution blueprints, reference configurations, and pre-built templates that reduce implementation time for public sector customers.

  • Work closely with horizontal product teams to ensure public sector requirements are reflected in platform investment across finance, HR, procurement, and operations.

  • Partner with the Industry Growth Director on launch readiness, pricing, packaging, and field enablement.

  • Engage directly with strategic customers and the Public Sector Industry Board to validate roadmap direction, co-innovate, and capture outcome evidence.

  • Ensure regulatory, security, accessibility, and localisation requirements across our supported geographies are systematically reflected in the roadmap.

  • Monitor the competitive landscape - know what Civica, Visma, Centric, CGI, and others are shipping and what it means for Unit4's positioning.

  • Work with partners to extend the value proposition for public sector customers.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven product management experience building enterprise software - ERP or enterprise SaaS - for public sector organizations, particularly municipalities, local authorities, or specialist agencies. You have shipped products used by public sector finance and operations teams, not just consulted for them.

  • Deep knowledge of public finance management, public sector accounting, and government budgeting practices.

  • Solid understanding of public procurement frameworks and how they translate into practical ERP requirements - from approval workflows and audit trails to supplier management and contract compliance.

  • Understanding of the security, data residency, and audit expectations of government buyers and what that means for cloud ERP product decisions.

  • A clear point of view on how AI can responsibly empower public sector organizations - balancing real opportunity for efficiency and insight with the accountability, transparency, and security obligations these organizations carry.

  • Commercial orientation: you understand how product decisions drive ARR, win rate, and customer retention.

  • Strong communication skills at Head of Finance, Head of ICT, and senior public service leadership level.

  • Experience in product management for enterprise SaaS platforms.

  • Deep understanding of professional services business models, including project-based delivery, utilization, billing, scheduling and compliance.

  • Strong ability to influence without authority and work cross-functionally in a matrixed environment.

  • Proven ability to translate complex industry needs into scalable product solutions.

  • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with ERP or PSA platforms

  • Familiarity with mid-market services firms and their operational challenges.

  • Familiarity with in AI-driven or data-rich product environments.

Who we are?

We are a people-first community that nurtures all the areas that surround your working experience. With us, you’ll be surrounded by a high-performance team that supports your authentic self and celebrates your uniqueness.

We believe that ‘How work should feel’ is an evolving statement. Work goes beyond tasks and everyday responsibilities it’s about feeling valued, empowered, promoted, impactful, seen, and appreciated. We are reimagining how work makes people feel.

What we offer

  • a culture built on trust and accountability - giving you the freedom and autonomy to be successful and make an impact
  • balance - with our Flexible Leave Paid Time Off policy, remote working opportunities, Global Wellbeing Days, and other great benefits
  • growth opportunities - we provide the tools and guidance required so that you can focus on what really matters to you and so, ultimately, you can achieve your best work
  • talented colleagues, role models and mentors - work, learn and be inspired by some of the best talent in the software industry
  • a commitment to sustainability - with initiatives such as our Environmental, Social, and Governance strategy and Act4Good programme
  • a safe and inclusive working environment – supported by our Employee Resource Groups, which are open to all.

Our commitment to equity

Unit4 is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for everyone. We make our hiring decisions solely based on skills, qualifications, and our current business needs. We know that diversity brings fresh perspectives, ideas, and solutions to our company. This is the essence of our culture. We also welcome and encourage people who are pregnant and/or parents-to-be to apply. If you would like to know more about our commitment to diversity, visit our blogs:

  • Our focus to DEI remains central to who we are
  • Inclusive hiring at Unit4: Building equal opportunities for all

This role may require security clearance required for customer projects and access to sensitive (customer) data. That means that after you have accepted our offer, we could ask for background checks. Subject to applicable local laws, such security checks may require disclosure of personal information including criminal record declaration, right to work, personal identification and work history. No worries though – we'll handle it according to local privacy laws and keep your info safe. Questions? Feel free to reach out!

title: Volunteer Site Coordinator
description:
Overview

In addition to managing the day to day operations of a LifeWise program, Site Coordinators act as the primary point of contact with the host site and the school.

Qualifications and Experience

description:

title: Senior Media Manager
description:
Tatari is on a mission to revolutionize TV advertising. Founded in 2016 to help transform the antiquated world of TV advertising through the intelligent application of AI and machine learning, Tatari helps some of the world’s fastest growing brands including Chime, Calm, Tecovas, Manscaped, Saatva, and Liquid I.V., reach their customers using linear and streaming TV ads. Our platform combines sophisticated media buying with proprietary analytics to turn TV advertising into an automated, digital-like experience, enabling businesses of any size to advertise on TV.

That approach has earned Tatari broad industry recognition, including being named Best CTV AdTech Platform in the 8th annual MarTech Breakthrough Awards, as well as honors from Digiday (Best Connected TV Platform), AdExchanger (Most Innovative TV Advertising Technology), and Business Insider (Hottest AdTech Companies). Tatari has also been recognized as the Best Place to Work by Inc. Magazine. Backed by an executive team of former founders and senior leaders from companies including Shazam, TrueCar, AdapTV, LiveRail, Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and Yahoo, Tatari continues to scale rapidly as TV advertising enters its next major era.

Tatari is growing, and we're looking for a Senior Media Manager to join the team to support our Enterprise and Mid-Market accounts. In this role, you will use the knowledge and experience you’ve had at previous media or tech companies and leverage the latest technology and measurement utilized at Tatari to plan, buy and optimize our clients’ streaming and linear TV campaigns.

This role is a hands-on, in-platform media buying role where you’ll plan, buy, optimize, and manage campaigns day to day across multiple clients. On the Enterprise side, you’ll partner with large, established brands that run sophisticated, full-funnel marketing strategies and treat TV as a core part of their media mix, driving continued growth through scaled, performance-focused advertising. On the Mid-Market side, you’ll manage and scale mid-sized brands that are new to TV or looking to expand their linear and streaming efforts. These clients focus on lower-funnel KPIs while increasingly investing in upper-funnel brand building, and they often start with weekly remnant and ROS buying while setting their sights on sports, sponsorships, premium inventory, and upfront deals over the long term.

Qualifications

  • 5-8+ years of experience with TV/Video media buying, planning, and platform/programmatic trading. Direct Response experience a bonus, but not required
  • Understand linear TV and streaming inventory (you should be very familiar with networks, publishers, programs, shows, personalities, and media calendar), pricing, and ability to build insightful and strategic media plans
  • Experience negotiating and purchasing sports and high-premium placements (e.g., live events, tentpole programming, sponsorships, etc.), with a strong understanding of how to evaluate value, secure inventory, and manage pricing in competitive, high-demand environments
  • Experience optimizing media buys based on performance outcomes and KPIs
  • Understanding of marketing strategy, sales funnel KPIs, and how media, programmatic, data, measurement, and technology fit into the full picture
  • Advanced presentation and communication skills. You are a strong communicator, both verbally and written, with the ability to blend quantitative analysis and creative thinking to present recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders
  • You appreciate tech, product, engineering, data and analytics, and are comfortable and quick at learning software and systems (i.e. Tatari’s proprietary buying platform)
  • Curiosity and fluency in using AI tools to work smarter, such as accelerating research, reporting, and client deliverables, with sound judgment on when and how to apply them
  • Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills, including intermediate to advanced skills in Excel and/or Google Sheets
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to manage multiple workflows simultaneously

Benefits

  • Total compensation ($90,000-$120,000)
  • Equity compensation
  • Health insurance coverage for you and your dependents
  • 401K, FSA, and commuter benefits
  • $150 monthly spending account
  • $1,000 annual continued education benefit
  • $500 Newbie Productivity Perk
  • Unlimited PTO and sick days
  • Monthly Company Wellness Day Off
  • Snacks, drinks, and catered lunches at the office
  • Team building events
  • Hybrid RTO of 2 days per week in office

At Tatari, we believe in the importance of cultivating teams with diverse backgrounds and offering equal opportunities to all. We strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment where every team member feels valued and diversity is celebrated.

description:

title: Aerodynamics Engineer
description:
About the Role

The Aerodynamics Engineer is responsible for design and development of Mark-X airframe and its aerodynamic performance. The role involves conducting CFD simulations and potentially wind tunnel tests in the future, as well as collaborating with missile experts to optimize designs for enhanced performance, safety, and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conducting aerodynamic analyses using computational fluid dynamics (CFD) software to predict airflow behavior around designs.

  • Conducting feasibility studies to evaluate the aerodynamic performance of different design concepts and modifications for ATBM interceptors.

  • Collaborating within the missile design team to develop efficient and innovative aerodynamic shapes for missiles especially for the Radome and motor section.

  • Participating in technical interchange meetings to align aerodynamic concepts with overall missile performance goals and objectives.

  • Staying updated with the latest advancements in aerodynamics technologies and methodologies to enhance design processes.

  • Conduct detailed research and analysis to develop innovative design concepts for new ATBM missile models.

  • Create and review technical drawings and specifications, ensuring all designs meet industry standards and regulations.

  • Plan, conduct wind tunnel tests for verification of aerodynamic model /design.

  • Provide validated aerodynamic Parameter set for ETE 6-DOF Missile Simulation

  • Participate in testing and evaluation of prototypes to validate design performance.

  • Prepare technical documentation, including specifications, reports, and presentations for stakeholders and clients.

  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in missile technology and design methodologies to enhance project outcomes.

We Would Love You to Have

  • Master's degree in Physics, (Aerospace) Engineering, or related technical field

  • 5-10 years of Missile development programs and project management experience in international defense organizations

  • Strong hands-on technical background in the design and development of Ground to Air and/or Missile defense interceptor systems (10+ years)

  • Thorough knowledge of most advanced engineering methods, tools and procedures for Aerodynamic modelling & design

  • Has the ability to perform analyses to verify the integrity of the detailed thermal and flow systems solutions using appropriate tools, including but not limited to hand calculations, spreadsheets and other software

  • Collects and researches data skillfully; uses intuition and experience to complement data; ability to perform preliminary or final analyses

  • Must have excellent written and verbal skills with the ability to communicate with all levels of personnel within the organization and customers.

  • Holds or is eligible obtaining a NATO SECRET Clearance

Our Values

Our mission is ambitious, and it takes a team that works with the same intensity.

  • Own the Mission: Mission first. Always.
    We choose impact — we focus on what moves the mission forward fastest instead of “nice-to-haves". We fix it now — when delays or problems appear, we step up, rally the right people, and solve them immediately. We keep momentum — when time matters, we stay focused and move forward without waiting for perfect conditions.

  • Strive for More: Dare more. Do more. Achieve the impossible.
    We challenge the status quo — we question, test, and improve instead of accepting “the usual way.” We embrace discomfort — we step outside comfort zones and turn challenges into growth. We anticipate the future — we build solutions that scale and set higher standards each time.

  • Build with Trust: Be open. Keep promises.
    We walk the talk — what we say, we do. No excuses, no exceptions. We share openly — we communicate clearly and early, even when the news is hard. We own outcomes — we admit errors quickly, fix them, and prevent them from repeating.

Ready to Make a Real Impact?

Apply now! The deadline is November 30, 2026.Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and we may close the position once we find the right candidate.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Databricks)
description:
Who is Artefact?
Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm that transforms organizations through data and AI. With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders. From our Lausanne and Zurich offices, we help leading Swiss and international companies turn data and AI into measurable results, working with the leading data platforms, including Databricks.

Main Responsibilities
You will design and deliver the data platforms our clients run their business and their AI on, combining hands-on engineering with client advisory.

  • Build modern data platforms: End-to-end lakehouse architectures, mainly on Databricks, built for reliability, observability, and cost.
  • Engineer pipelines: Batch and streaming pipelines with Python, Spark, and SQL, with data quality built in.
  • Migrate and modernize: Move legacy warehouses and ETL to the cloud, from assessment to cut-over.
  • Make data ready for AI: Governed data products and semantic layers that analytics and AI agents can rely on.
  • Run it properly: Data governance, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Advise and support: Translate business needs into roadmaps, coach junior engineers, and support proposals.

Candidate Profile
Engineer first, consultant second, with a track record of shipping to production.

  • 5+ years in data engineering, including hands-on Databricks experience in production.
  • Expert Python and SQL, with strong Spark and data modeling skills.
  • Databricks Data Engineer Professional certification, or a commitment to obtain it within 6 months (we support you).
  • Experience on Azure, AWS, or GCP, plus DataOps (Git, CI/CD, Terraform, testing).
  • Strong consulting skills: requirements gathering, documentation, stakeholder management.
  • Fluent English plus French or German (both is a plus); eligible to work in Switzerland.

Nice to have: Experience with other data platforms (Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, BigQuery), dbt, MLOps, and industry experience (consumer goods, pharma, logistics, insurance, manufacturing).

Why Join Us

  • Strategy with a Data Edge: Build the platforms behind boardroom priorities.
  • Swiss Impact: High visibility from day one on flagship programs, working directly with senior leadership.
  • Strong Tech Ecosystem: Certified peers across Artefact and close partnerships with leading data and cloud platforms.
  • Growth and Culture: Certifications, training, international missions, and a team of doers who move fast and support each other.

If you don’t meet 100% of the criteria, we still want to hear from you. Tell us about your passion, curiosity, and impact.

title: Midweight Designer
description:
You are a designer refining your craft. Your days are spent relentlessly authoring ideas, designing identities, collaborating with the team around you.

Your Responsibilities

  1. You generate great ideas and know how to articulate them well both visually and verbally.

  2. You spend a significant amount of time designing and have a strong understanding of symbolism, typography, colour, illustration, iconography and art-direction. You can compose all of these components into complete brand identities.

  3. You collaborate intimately with the team around you, learning from them and supporting junior staff. You are able to follow direction from the senior team.

  4. You can construct components of client presentations and are beginning your journey to present work.

  5. You assist with and demonstrate an interest in our immersion and strategic phases of work.

  6. You demonstrate an active interest in branding and want to deliver work for the most impactful companies of today and the founders defining tomorrow.

  7. You demonstrate ownership of your role and can both take and action feedback from your manager to progress within it and beyond.

  8. You are able to manage your calendar, your time and deadlines to finish tasks.

  9. You have a willingness to work in person in our Sydney studio and are open to travel globally, from Shanghai to San Francisco.

  10. You have a great understanding of Figma, InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Pitch.

Our Responsibilities

  1. We will ensure you have meaningful and regular access to your manager to support your personal development and career trajectory.

  2. We will actively reward performance with promotions, pay increases and a discretionary annual bonus of up to 10% of salary to all employees.

  3. We ensure Koto is an equal environment for all its employees regardless of race, gender, age, or sexual preference.

  4. We will support you in taking family leave and offer significant paid maternity and paternity.

  5. We will actively encourage you to take 25 days holiday yearly, in addition to NSW public holidays, one additional holiday day per year (capped at 5 additional days), and a studio closure between Christmas and New Year.

  6. We will contribute to anyone wanting to engage in a pension scheme, appropriate to your location.

  7. We deploy a monthly ‘employee wellness’ benefits package via Juno of $140 per month.

  8. We offer access to YCN and fund relevant training opportunities to any employee looking to develop themselves and career.

  9. We reward five years of service with $5,000 and five days holiday. We reward ten years of service with $10,000 and four weeks holiday. (Note: Final Reward program to be confirmed for Sydney.)

  10. We will give you the opportunity to work from any of the four koto studios globally, with appropriate planning and application.

Our Culture

  • At Koto we encourage our team to be ‘rationally optimistic’ about the potential of our work, our clients, their businesses, and the power of brand.

  • We pursue the best briefs, want to inspire meaningful work, and for those interested provide an opportunity to make the work of their lives. We are actively cultivating leadership, culture and spaces to encourage this.

  • We work in person with an optional WFH day on Friday, and an additional two weeks remote a year. We believe this produces the best work, mentoring opportunities, collective learning and culture.

  • We encourage autonomy in each member of our team, allowing them to manage their own time, hours and personal commitments appropriately to complete work.

title: Senior IT-sikkerhedsarkitekt
description:
Om jobbet

Som senior IT-sikkerhedsarkitekt er du den strategiske stemme i vores IT-sikkerhedsteam. Du har ansvaret for, at Danske Spils sikkerhedsrammeværk, NIST 2.0, bliver til prioriterede indsatser med reel effekt, og du bygger det flerårige roadmap for IT-sikkerhed, både for processer og tekniske foranstaltninger.

Du skriver beslutningsoplæg, roadmap-prioriteringer og konkrete risikobilleder til afdelingschef og CIO, og du leverer saglige og afbalancerede billeder frem for skræmmekampagner. Du belyser risici og laver oplæg, mens beslutningerne ligger hos ledelsen. Du er også den, kolleger i hele huset går til, når sikkerhed skal tænkes ind i løsninger og projekter.

Dine opgaver

  • Eje NIST-rammeværket og vurdere den reelle værdi af en given indsats i forhold til roadmappet.

  • Udarbejde flerårige roadmaps for IT-sikkerhed for hele Danske Spil og sætte retning for fremtidens sikkerhed.

  • Lave risikovurderinger og trusselsmodellering, herunder for brug af AI

  • Rådgive projekter, IT-arkitekter og udviklere, stille sikkerhedskrav og hjælpe med kontraktudbud.

  • Skrive beslutningsoplæg og risikobilleder til afdelingschef og CIO og bidrage med IT’s perspektiv på sikkerhed til vores Jura- og Compliance-team.

  • Vurdere indhold af sikkerhedsrapporter og rådgive om løsninger.

Hvem er du?

Du har mindst 5 års dokumenteret erfaring med at præsentere for ledelse og udarbejde roadmaps. Du kender sikkerhedsrammeværker som NIST CSF, ISO 27001 og CIS-kontroller og kan omsætte teori til prioriterede, forretningsrelevante indsatser. Du er stærk skriftligt og analytisk og trives med at formulere strategisk materiale til ledelsesniveau.

  • Du kan omsætte forretningsmål til sikkerhedsarkitektur.

  • Du kan stille og validere sikkerhedskrav i systemdesign og projekter.

  • Du er analytisk i risikovurdering og trusselsmodellering.

  • Du rådgiver og formidler komplekse emner klart, også til ikke-tekniske medarbejdere.

  • Du får resultater i samarbejde med andre teams og ledelse.

Hvorfor Danske Spil?

Hos os har sikkerhedsarbejdet stor betydning og er højt prioriteret – også i topledelsen. Du arbejder i en reguleret virksomhed, hvor sikkerhed og certificeringer med krav fra blandt andre Spillemyndigheden og World Lottery Association er kritiske krav, og du får stor indflydelse på retningen for vores IT-sikkerhed de kommende år.

Teamet dækker alle områder inden for IT-sikkerhed, og AI-sikkerhed er et centralt tema, hvor du kan sætte dit præg fra start. Du bliver en del af afdelingen Infrastructure & Service Management, hvor vi tager ejerskab for stabil drift og sikkerhed, hjælper hinanden og er handlekraftige, når det gælder. Tonen er uformel med plads til humor og personlighed.

Vil du være med til at underholde danskerne?

Vi læser ansøgninger igennem løbende, men deadline for at søge er den 3. december 2026. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jesper Tjørnlund på jest@danskespil.dk. Hvis du har spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Business Partner, Mette Overgaard Holm på MEHO@danskespil.dk.

Stillingen er placeret i en afdeling, hvor fremvisning af straffeattest er påkrævet. Hvis du indkaldes til samtale, skal straffeattesten derfor indhentes og uploades i rekrutteringssystemet inden 1. samtale.

title: Group Head of Compliance
description:
About ESTO

Founded in 2017, we are a fast-growing fintech company on a mission to make shopping and financial decisions effortless. By combining smart technology with customer-first thinking, we enable people to pay flexibly and businesses to grow faster.

As a team, we value ambition, ownership, and constant improvement. We move fast, think big, and build solutions that make a real impact on everyday lives.

About the role:

ESTO holds consumer credit licences in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania and operates where lending , data and AI meet. As Group Head of Compliance, you lead the strategic oversight and implementation of our compliance framework across all three countries. You ensure that ESTO's policies, procedures, products and services align with regulatory requirements and internal standards at group level, and you work closely with cross-functional teams to foster a culture of integrity, manage regulatory risk and support sustainable business growth through proactive compliance management.

Compliance is an independent second-line function, reporting to the CEO with direct access to the Supervisory Board. You build it, lead it, and work closely with Legal, Risk, Product, Data and the country teams to keep ESTO compliant and inspection-ready as it grows.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and lead the Compliance function across Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania, including country Compliance Managers and the MLRO, and build a risk-based monitoring programme that tests ESTO's products and processes against regulatory requirements in all three markets: creditworthiness, pricing and disclosures, advertising, data protection, AML and sanctions, outsourcing, ICT, complaints and collection

  • Monitor regulatory developments in all three markets and at EU level, assess their impact, and keep Legal, management and the business informed; own the regulatory change register and compliance calendar

  • Maintain compliance policies, procedures and internal controls; run compliance risk assessments and the enterprise-wide risk assessment

  • Run monitoring and testing the way a regulator would, with risk-based file samples and automated checks, so ESTO is inspection-ready at all timesAutomate first: data-driven checks over manual reviews, with Data and Engineering building the hooks

  • Set the compliance standard for AI and credit models: AI Act classification of each model, model register, bias testing and EU AI Act documentation

  • Provide compliance reporting and management information to management and the Supervisory Board, and track remediation to closure

  • Ensure the internal rules filed with the regulators are kept up to date and applied in practice, and own licensing and regulatory reporting for each entity

  • Lead the relationship with supervisory authorities in all three countries: inquiries, inspections, audits and regulatory proceedings

  • Provide compliance sign-off on new products and material changes, working with Product and Legal

  • Run compliance training across the business

What We Expect:

  • 5+ years in legal, compliance or supervisory work in the financial sector, in consumer lending, payments or banking, ideally including time at a regulator, an auditor or as head of compliance under an EU licence

  • Master’s degree in law

  • You have built or rebuilt a compliance function and can show what it found and what changed as a result

  • Working knowledge of consumer credit law, responsible lending, AML/CFT, GDPR and the EU AI Act in the Baltic countries, and the judgement to know which rules carry real risk

  • Experience working with regulators in more than one Baltic country

  • Hands-on with data: you read SQL output, define a risk-based sample and specify an automated check rather than requesting a report

  • Daily user of AI tools (Claude or similar) and a clear view of how they change compliance work

  • Independent, with strong judgement and integrity: you challenge constructively, in writing, and hold your position when it matters

  • Fluent English; Estonian, Latvian or Lithuanian is a strong plus

  • Impeccable professional reputation and a clean criminal record

Why You'll Love Working Here

• 28 days annual leave + public holidays + your birthday off, always
• Hybrid work with flexible hours
• Paid sick leave + 3 wellbeing days
• Modern, pet-friendly office in the heart of Tallinn
• Fully stocked kitchen: snacks, fruit & drinks
• Monthly Stebby allowance for sports & wellness
• Collaborative, multicultural team
• Regular events & offsites
• Room to bring ideas and make real impact

🌍 Equal Opportunity Employer
We value diversity and inclusion, and we're committed to a workplace where everyone feels welcome, has equal opportunities, and is treated fairly.

title: Loader Operator
description:
Job Summary: Loader Operator- Day Shift

Harsco Environmental is seeking a skilled and safety-focused Loader Operator to support onsite steel mill and industrial material processing operations. The Loader Operator is responsible for operating front-end loaders and other heavy equipment to move, load, stockpile, and transport slag, scrap metal, and other industrial by-products. The successful candidate will work in a demanding industrial environment while maintaining strict adherence to safety, environmental, and operational standards.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Operate front-end loaders and other heavy mobile equipment in a safe and efficient manner.
  • Load, unload, stockpile, and transport slag, scrap, aggregates, and processed materials.
  • Feed material processing equipment, crushers, screens, conveyors, and other production systems.
  • Assist with cleanup activities and maintain orderly work areas throughout the facility.
  • Perform daily pre-shift and post-shift equipment inspections.
  • Identify and report equipment defects, safety hazards, and maintenance needs.
  • Maintain production targets while ensuring safe operating practices.
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors, dispatch personnel, and coworkers regarding material movement and operational requirements.
  • Follow all site-specific safety policies, lockout/tagout procedures, traffic patterns, and environmental regulations.
  • Assist with general labor duties and support other operational functions as required.
  • Complete operational reports, equipment inspection forms, and production documentation accurately and timely.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED preferred.
  • Previous experience operating front-end loaders, wheel loaders, excavators, dozers, haul trucks, or similar heavy equipment.
  • Ability to work safely in a heavy industrial environment, including steel mills and outdoor conditions.
  • Understanding of equipment inspection and preventative maintenance practices.
  • Ability to read and understand safety procedures, operating instructions, and work orders.
  • Strong work ethic, reliability, and attendance record.
  • Ability to work various shifts, including nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in steel mills, mining, quarry, aggregate, recycling, or industrial material handling operations.
  • OSHA safety training or industrial safety certifications.
  • Experience handling slag, scrap metal, and bulk materials.
  • Mechanical aptitude and minor maintenance experience.

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently sit, climb, bend, twist, and enter/exit heavy equipment.
  • Ability to work in extreme temperatures, dust, noise, and varying weather conditions.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds occasionally.
  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including hard hat, safety glasses, hearing protection, steel-toed boots, gloves, and high-visibility clothing.

“We offer competitive benefits, including health insurance, life insurance and disability plans, as well as a 401k with company matching.

Harsco is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

The Fulfillment Associate is responsible for receiving, storing, and distributing material, tools, equipment, and products within the warehouse or distribution center.

In this role, you will:

  • Record amounts of materials or items received or distributed
  • Weigh or counts items for distribution to ensure conformance to company standards
  • Arrange stock parts in specified sequence for assembly by other workers
  • Inspect products for defects prior to packing for shipping
  • Unload trucks and places materials in proper location in the warehouse
  • Enter and maintains inventory records in the computer

We are looking for:

title: Software Cybersecurity Engineer V/VI
description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

Position Summary

Zone 5 Technologies is seeking a Software Cybersecurity Engineer to lead the design, development, and implementation of cybersecurity protections for advanced unmanned aircraft systems, embedded software, and mission-critical defense platforms.

This hands-on technical leadership role is responsible for integrating cybersecurity throughout the product lifecycle, including embedded software, hardware interfaces, communications, cryptographic protections, and secure software deployment.

The ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise in embedded systems security, software engineering, threat analysis, and secure system architecture, with the ability to translate complex security requirements into practical, mission-ready solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead cybersecurity architecture and engineering activities for embedded flight software, mission-critical systems, and supporting applications.
  • Design and implement protections against unauthorized access, software exploitation, malicious modification, and cybersecurity threats.
  • Develop and integrate secure boot, cryptographic key management, software signing, secure storage, authentication, and integrity verification mechanisms.
  • Conduct threat modeling, attack surface analysis, vulnerability assessments, and cybersecurity risk evaluations across hardware and software interfaces.
  • Define cybersecurity requirements, architecture, verification methods, and technical acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborate with Software, Systems, Hardware, GNC, and Platform Engineering teams to integrate security protections without compromising mission performance, real-time constraints, or system safety.
  • Lead product security testing, vulnerability remediation, penetration testing coordination, and cybersecurity verification activities.
  • Establish secure software development practices and support automated security analysis within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Develop cybersecurity technical documentation, security control evidence, risk assessments, and security engineering artifacts.
  • Support customer technical reviews, cybersecurity assessments, and applicable DoD security requirements.
  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to engineering teams on secure architecture, secure coding, and embedded cybersecurity practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent technical experience.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, embedded software engineering, systems security, or related disciplines.
  • Strong programming experience in C, C++, Python, or comparable systems programming languages.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing cybersecurity protections for embedded systems, real-time operating systems, or resource-constrained computing platforms.
  • Strong understanding of cryptography, secure boot, authentication, software integrity, and secure communications.
  • Experience conducting threat modeling, vulnerability analysis, and security architecture reviews.
  • Knowledge of hardware/software security boundaries, processor security features, and secure software deployment.
  • Ability to independently develop technical solutions and lead cybersecurity engineering activities across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with aerospace, defense, unmanned systems, or other mission-critical embedded platforms.
  • Experience with ARM-based processors, VxWorks, embedded Linux, or similar real-time operating environments.
  • Knowledge of hardware roots of trust, trusted execution environments, and secure key provisioning.
  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-160, NIST SP 800-171, RMF, CMMC, and applicable DoD cybersecurity requirements.
  • Experience with secure software supply chains, SBOMs, software signing, and automated security testing.
  • Familiarity with safety-critical systems, MIL-STD-882, and cybersecurity considerations in airworthiness and system safety.
  • Experience with GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, Docker, Artifactory, and embedded development toolchains.
  • Experience developing cybersecurity architectures, security control matrices, security verification procedures, and risk assessments.
  • Active U.S. security clearance.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will establish practical, effective cybersecurity protections that are integrated into Zone 5 products from initial architecture through deployment.

This individual will balance security, safety, performance, and operational requirements while ensuring our systems remain resilient against cyber threats, unauthorized access, and software vulnerabilities.

Level V: $176,000 - $223,000/yr.

Level VI: $196,000 - $250,000/yr.

What's in it for you:

Benefits:

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • Comprehensive benefit package options include medical, dental, vision, life, and more.
  • 401k with company-match
  • 3 weeks of paid time off each year
  • 40 hours of sick time
  • 12 annual company holidays

Why Join Zone 5 Technologies?

  • Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge technology that is shaping the future of defense and aerospace.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

If you are passionate about unmanned aircraft technology and want to be a part of a dynamic and growing company, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and join the Zone 5 Technologies team!
