title: Senior Protocol Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Protocol Engineer to join our Rollup team. This is a hands-on, full-time engineering role focused on building and scaling our Bitcoin-secured Layer 2 rollup on Rootstock. This is a protocol role: you’ll work directly on the chain on topics such as sequencing, block derivation, consensus and finality, bridge and proof system. You will join a small team of senior engineers with high ownership. You will design, build, test and operate core components, and you will take part in the technical decisions of the project.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build and maintain core protocol components: execution and consensus clients, sequencer, block derivation and batch submission to the parent chain.
  • Work on the bridge and the proof system: deposits, withdrawals, cross-layer messages and state validation.
  • Maintain a large open source codebase: learn how its parts work together, make changes that are safe for a live network, and keep the code easy to evolve.
  • Review code, write design docs and RFCs, and take part in architecture decisions.
  • Test and debug a distributed system: unit to adversarial tests, local devnets, reorgs, node desync and performance problems.
  • Deliver and operate releases on public chains: upgrades, hard forks, monitoring and incidents, etc.
  • Collaborate with Product, DevOps and Security to plan and ship each release.

WHAT YOU BRING

Must have

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering, with at least 2 years in blockchain core or protocol development (node clients, consensus, etc.).
  • Solid production experience in mainstream languages (for example Go, Rust or Java).
  • Deep knowledge of blockchain internals and the EVM: consensus, P2P networking, state and storage, transaction lifecycle, JSON-RPC, etc.
  • Experience working effectively in large codebases you did not write.
  • AI-assisted development is a core part of your work, while owning what you deliver.
  • Autonomy and ownership: you help define the work, not only execute assigned tasks.
  • Good English, spoken and written, since the team is international and remote.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience with Go and/or Rust.
  • Hands-on experience with Ethereum Layer 2 rollups (optimistic or ZK).
  • Understanding of rollup design: sequencing, data availability, derivation, finality, etc.
  • Contributions to open source blockchain clients or rollup stacks.
  • Experience with fault proof systems or validity proofs.
  • Knowledge of Bitcoin and EVM compatible chains.
  • Experience with Docker, cloud providers, Prometheus and Grafana.
  • Able to read and review Solidity (bridge and system contracts).




ROOTIES BENEFITS

At RootstockLabs, we don’t just offer a job, we offer a community. Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

  • Competitive compensation package and unique benefits designed to support your growth and well-being.
  • 100% Remote Work from Europe & Latin America, with access to global CoWorking spaces.
  • Work-Life Balance: Paid vacation and sick leave days
  • Continuous Learning: Access to training programs, language courses, and learning sponsorship annually.
  • Unique Projects: Work with cutting-edge blockchain technology in a global, diverse team.



ABOUT ROOTSTOCKLABS

RootstockLabs is a key contributor to Rootstock, Bitcoin's Financial Infrastructure for lending, yield, and onchain capital markets. We build and commercialize the institutional infrastructure that turns Bitcoin into productive capital.

  • What we do: Develop and commercialize Bitcoin-backed lending, tokenized real-world assets, and onchain financial strategies
  • Who we work with: Leading custodians, asset managers, and financial institutions
  • Why it matters: Rootstock is secured by 80%+ of Bitcoin's hash power and has run with 100% uptime since 2018 (bringing Ethereum-style programmability to the world's hardest money).
  • Proof it works: 200+ dApps live on Rootstock, from BTCFi protocols like Sushiswap and Oku to institutional names like Mercado Bitcoin, Animoca Brands, and Paystand

title: Process Excellence & Digital Transformation Manager (SAP)
description:
Knauf stands for opportunity. We know that opportunity looks different to each person, and we are proud that we see opportunity in everyone.

This exciting role within the Business & Process Department could be the perfect next opportunity for you to build a unique career, in a values-led culture with a clear purpose of making tomorrow a home for all of us.

We are a family-owned global manufacturer of construction materials and within our Group, our 43,500 team members in 90 countries across 320 sites provide a huge opportunity for anyone with ambition and energy. We value everyone's contribution equally and we ask that you bring your whole self to work, to enrich the business further, as together we achieve more in a safe and inclusive environment.

In Asia Pacific, since the 1990s Knauf has been established as a leading and trusted brand for drywall products and system solutions. Today, with over 5,500 experienced, talented, and diversified people operating nearly 35 production facilities and offices across the region, coupled with an extensive expertise-backed sales and support network, our teams deliver the best of Knauf to our customers, while supporting positive changes to the industry and communities where we operate – in Australia, China, Korea, Japan, India, Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore, Central Asia, and the Caucasus.

Reporting into Senior Business Process Manager, we are searching for a team member to join us as Process Excellence & Digital Transformation Manager (SAP).

Can you say yes?

The Process Excellence & Digital Transformation Manager leads regional initiatives to simplify, standardise, and improve business processes across Asia-Pacific. The role helps business units move from inconsistent, manual, or complex ways of working to clearer, faster, and more efficient processes supported by common definitions, practical guidelines, best practices, and fit-for-purpose system solutions.

The role works closely with business units, Global Process Owners, and IT to identify operational pain points, analyse root causes, and design practical improvements that can be scaled across countries. This includes optimising SAP and other ERP processes, improving system usage and data quality, and reducing manual work through tools such as workflows, Robotic Process Automation (RPA), system interfaces, reporting solutions, and other automation opportunities.

The successful candidate must be able to operate at both strategic and detailed levels: influencing senior stakeholders with clear recommendations while also working hands-on with process flows, data, system logic, and operational teams to deliver sustainable change. The role includes people management responsibility for one to two direct reports, guiding and developing team members to support the delivery of overall regional initiatives. The role requires strong ownership, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead through influence in a regional, multi-country environment.

What you will be doing

  1. Process Improvement & Change Leadership

    · Drive end-to-end process improvement initiatives, from problem definition through to solution design and implementation

    · Define and monitor success measures to assess adoption, process performance and realized business outcomes using feedback and data to drive continuous improvement.

    · Lead structured root cause analysis (e.g. data-driven analysis, process diagnostics) to identify underlying issues in business processes and systems.

    · Design practical, scalable process solutions, balancing standardization, control, and local business needs.

    · Act as a change agent, proactively challenging the status quo and guiding stakeholders through change.

    · Translate complex analysis and process issues into clear, compelling executive-level narratives, recommendations and business cases that enable senior management decision making

  2. Project & Stakeholder Management
    · Take end-to-end ownership of assigned transformation initiatives, independently driving progress, resolving ambiguity and escalating decisions or risks where appropriate
    · Gather, document, and prioritize detailed business requirements.
    · Lead or support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring solutions meet real business needs.
    · Act as a trusted partner to Global Process Owners, providing strong APAC input into global designs.

  3. Digitization & System Enablement
    · Identify opportunities to digitize and automate manual or inefficient processes.
    · Work closely with IT and data teams to translate business requirements into system and reporting solutions.
    · Support regional digitization efforts through:
    · Clear functional specifications
    · Data and logic validation
    · Hands-on testing and iteration

  4. People Management & Team Enablement
    · Coach and guide team members to strengthen process thinking, problem-solving capability, and business partnering skills.
    · Set clear priorities, expectations, and ways of working to ensure the team delivers against agreed objectives.
    · Drive team performance by providing regular feedback, removing roadblocks, and enabling ownership of key deliverables.

What we would love for you to have

  • Minimum 8 years’ experience in business process improvement, business analysis, or a similar role.

  • Proven ability to diagnose complex business and system problems, perform deep root cause analysis, design and implement pragmatic, data-driven solutions

  • Strong working knowledge of at least one SAP module (e.g. SD, FI/CO, PtM) with an understanding of associated business processes and data structures

  • Hands on experience designing or implementing workflow automation solutions (e.g. Microsoft Power Platform/ Power Automate, SAP Build Process Automation, Nintex, ProcessMaker or other similar platforms) or Working knowledge of basic coding or scripting to support digitization and automation (e.g. Python, JSON, SQL)

  • Cross-functional SAP knowledge across multiple modules

  • SAP BW / business intelligence and reporting solutions such as Tableau or Power BI

  • Experience mapping end-to-end processes with Business Process Model and Notation(BPMN) or similar process-modelling standards

What happens next?

Your application will be reviewed by our Hiring Team to determine if your experiences and skills are what we are looking for in the role. If you are, our Talent Acquisition representative will contact you promptly to arrange for next steps.

At Knauf, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. For information about how we collect, use and protect your personal data during the recruitment process, please read our Privacy Notice For Job Applicants. The hiring legal entity is Malaysia.

title: Sr Research Associate, Tech Transfer
description:
Senior Research Associate (Onsite in Wilsonville, OR)

Twist Bioscience's Tech Transfer team is hiring a Senior Research Associate in Wilsonville, Oregon, to help new products and process improvements, with a particular focus on supporting orders ahead of full integration and scale. This role builds on our Research Associate II position and calls for someone who is an independent, vigilant, and detail-driven scientist who can both execute hands-on production work and help optimize the processes that bridge R&D and operations.

You will perform manual production steps for workflows that have not yet been fully automated, while partnering closely with R&D scientists and operations to vet new processes before and during their transfer into manufacturing. This person should be able to run experiments independently, communicate effectively, and optimize processes to drive CPI and NPI success, executing experiments that deliver high-quality end products for our customers. The work can vary between DNA and protein work, so the ability to learn new techniques and methodologies quickly is a real asset.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently design, execute, and troubleshoot experiments, escalating when plans fall outside established protocols.
  • Support the build-out and vetting of new processes ahead of launch, working closely with R&D scientists, automation engineers, operators, and LIMS developers to confirm a process is ready for production.
  • Perform manual experiments with the intention of automating them for production processing of new or in-development workflows, helping fulfill early access orders while automation is still being built out.
  • Identify process gaps, bottlenecks, and risks before they reach manufacturing, and help implement optimizations.
  • Serve as a vigilant check on process quality, catching inconsistencies or at-risk steps and raising them before they affect downstream production or customer orders.
  • Support the writing of work instructions and training materials for manufacturing operators.
  • Operate a range of automated and manual lab equipment to execute experiments and production runs.
  • Support testing & validating Twist's LIMS platforms to generate, track, and analyze data.
  • Collect, analyze, and summarize data, and communicate findings clearly across cross-functional teams.
  • Mentor and train others on new processes and best practices.
  • Maintain thorough, organized, and audit-ready experimental and production records.

Qualifications and Required Skills

  • B.S. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, or a closely related field, with at least 4 years of relevant industry or research experience; or an M.S. in a related field with at least 2 years of relevant experience.
  • Strong, hands-on background in molecular biology techniques, DNA or protein purification, DNA quantification, PCR, enzymatic and or cell-based assays, including antibody characterization assays.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and exercise sound scientific judgment with minimal day-to-day direction.
  • Comfortable partnering cross-functionally with R&D and operations, as well as automation engineers, LIMS developers, and R&D scientists to support building and vetting new processes.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to present data clearly and work effectively across teams.
  • Able to prepare technical documents, including SOPs, data summaries, and technical or analytical reports.
  • Comfortable working in a LEAN manufacturing or controlled laboratory environment, including supporting manual processing ahead of automation.
  • Self-motivated and detail-oriented, with a track record of catching issues before they escalate.
  • Experience mentoring or training other lab staff.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience working with lab automation.
  • Experience with SQL and/or JSON.
  • Experience using LIMS systems.
  • Experience working with antibodies.
  • Experience supporting new product or process launches, including Early Access or limited-release programs.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing lab environments.

About Twist Bioscience

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as “writing” DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. In fields such as health care, agriculture, industrial chemicals and data storage, our unique silicon-based DNA Synthesis Platform provides precision at a scale that is otherwise unavailable to our customers.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
About the Role

The R&D team in the Office of the CTO builds AI-driven tools that help Mirantis test, monitor and understand the k0rdent AI platform. We are hiring a Software Development Engineer to help own these tools.

This is an entry-level, hands-on engineering role. You will work directly with senior engineering leadership, ship to production environments that other teams depend on, and work at the point where classical ML, LLMs and distributed systems meet.

What You'll Work On

1. AI-Driven Testing Systems and Solutions

Build and maintain the web driver and test agents that run end-to-end scenarios against the k0rdent web UI and APIs, then turn what they find into clear, reproducible defects for the teams that own the code. A large part of the work is making test runs safe to point at live systems: keeping sessions and context across runs, cleaning up every change a run makes, and requiring a review step before anything is written to shared systems such as Jira. You will also evaluate language models for the harness with repeatable test scenarios, and recommend changes based on measured results.

2. Anomaly Detection and Root-Cause Analysis Systems and Solutions

Develop anomaly detection and capacity forecasting models, such as disk fill and memory leak prediction, using metrics and logs from running k0rdent environments. Measure detection quality against labeled failure sets and real workloads, and improve the models from the results. Build LLM-assisted root-cause analysis that turns a raw alert into a likely cause and a suggested fix, and work with the observability team to deliver confirmed findings into the platform's alerting and Grafana dashboards.

3. AI in the Development Lifecycle

Help bring these tools into day-to-day engineering at Mirantis, so the test harness runs against new builds and pull requests and reports to the owning teams. Work with the KOF, QA and k0rdent engineering teams to find other places where AI models and data science can improve our software and tooling. Package and deploy what you build to Kubernetes with container images, Helm charts and CI pipelines that follow Mirantis release conventions.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 0 to 2 years of professional software development experience, including internships.

  • Strong Python, including practical experience with at least one ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow or Keras).

  • Working proficiency in TypeScript.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: anomaly detection, time-series forecasting, or outlier detection.

  • Experience building LLM applications, such as agentic loops, tool use, prompt design or model evaluation.

  • Working knowledge of Docker, Git and CI pipelines.

  • Demonstrated ability to ship end-to-end projects, from data ingestion through a working interface or report.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Kubernetes and Helm.

  • Experience with observability stacks such as Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry and Grafana.

  • Experience with browser automation or end-to-end test frameworks.

  • Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM gateways or multi-model routing.

  • Experience with graph-based or topology-aware root-cause analysis.

What You'll Get

  • Direct mentorship from the Office of the CTO and senior R&D engineers.

  • Ownership of production tools that other engineering teams rely on.

  • Work on AI infrastructure: agentic testing, applied ML on live platform telemetry, and Kubernetes-native platforms.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Work for an established leader in the Cloud Native industry with over 800 enterprise customers, HQ’d in Silicon Valley.
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented, and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune and Global 2000 customers implement modern open-source cloud technologies.
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation.
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued.
  • Flexible working schedule and remote / or hybrid work environment.
  • Receive a competitive compensation package.

Mirantis ranked in the top 50 of G2's Best IT Cloud Products of 2021!

title: Director, Clinical Scientist
description:
Company Overview:

Dyne Therapeutics is focused on delivering functional improvement for people living with genetically driven neuromuscular diseases. We are developing therapeutics that target muscle and the central nervous system (CNS) to address the root cause of disease. The company is advancing clinical programs for Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) and myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1) as well as preclinical programs for facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD), Pompe disease and multiple DMD mutations. At Dyne, we are on a mission to deliver functional improvement for individuals, families and communities. Learn more at https://www.dyne-tx.com/, and follow us on X, LinkedIn and Facebook.

Role Summary:

The Director, Clinical Scientist serves as a scientific and clinical development leader responsible for supporting the strategy, design, execution, interpretation, and communication of Dyne’s clinical studies. This role partners closely with the Clinical Development Lead and cross-functional teams to advance high-quality clinical programs for people living with rare, genetically driven neuromuscular diseases.

This Director-level role requires strong clinical development expertise, scientific judgment, and the ability to translate emerging clinical data into actionable insights that inform study conduct, program strategy, regulatory interactions, and external scientific communications. The Director contributes to clinical development plans, protocol strategy, study execution, data review, regulatory deliverables, investigator engagement, and internal and external data presentations.

The ideal candidate brings a collaborative, patient-focused mindset and can lead complex clinical science workstreams with independence, accountability, and cross-functional influence in a fast-paced, growing biotechnology environment.

This role is based in Waltham, MA.

Primary Responsibilities Include:

Clinical Development Strategy & Study Leadership:

  • Serve as a clinical science lead or key clinical science contributor for assigned studies, partnering with the study medical director to support study strategy, design, execution, data interpretation, and reporting.
  • Provide scientific input into study design, patient population, eligibility criteria, endpoints, biomarkers, assessments, visit schedules, and data collection strategies to ensure trials are scientifically sound, operationally feasible, and aligned with program objectives.
  • Interpret emerging clinical data and translate findings into clear recommendations for study conduct, clinical development strategy, internal governance discussions, regulatory interactions, and external scientific communications.
  • Maintain current knowledge of rare disease, neuromuscular disease, genetic medicine, oligonucleotide therapeutics, clinical trial innovation, regulatory expectations, competitive developments, and relevant scientific literature.

Clinical Trial Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Partner closely with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Translational Medicine, Medical Affairs, Quality, CROs, vendors, and other stakeholders to support high-quality study execution.
  • Monitor study progress, identify scientific, clinical, operational, or data-related risks, and partner with cross-functional teams to define practical mitigation strategies that support quality, timelines, and patient safety.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Operations on oversight of study milestones and overall study metrics.
  • Represent Clinical Development on cross-functional study teams, workstreams, and governance discussions, as assigned providing clear scientific input and influencing alignment without direct authority.
  • Collaborate with investigators, key opinion leaders, external experts, CROs, and vendors to support scientific exchange, study execution, issue resolution, and alignment with clinical development objectives.
  • Support Study Medical Monitor in overseeing CRO Medical Monitoring team, including review of meeting minutes, meeting materials, and support for medical monitoring deliverables.

Clinical Data Review, Interpretation & Safety Oversight:

  • Support ongoing patient-level and aggregate clinical data review, including safety, efficacy, biomarker, pharmacodynamic, endpoint, and protocol compliance data, to identify trends, insights, risks, protocol deviations, safety trend review, patient profile review and other potential issues.
  • Partner with Pharmacovigilance and Clinical Development colleagues to support safety surveillance, signal evaluation, benefit-risk assessment, safety narratives, and timely escalation of clinically meaningful findings.

Clinical and Regulatory Deliverables:

  • Lead or contribute to the development of clinical study concepts, protocol synopses, protocols, protocol amendments, informed consent forms, investigator brochures, clinical study reports, briefing documents, regulatory responses, and other key clinical and regulatory deliverables.
  • Contribute to regulatory submissions and interactions by preparing, reviewing, and interpreting clinical content for INDs, CTAs, briefing books, annual reports, DSURs, submission dossiers, and responses to regulatory questions.
  • Support investigator meetings, site engagement, advisory boards, data monitoring committee materials, steering committee materials, and other internal or external scientific forums as needed.
  • Contribute to internal and external presentations, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, publications, and other scientific communications that summarize clinical data clearly and accurately.

Leadership, Mentorship & Dyne Culture:

  • Mentor, coach, or provide guidance to clinical scientists, study team members, or cross-functional colleagues as appropriate, helping strengthen clinical science capabilities and quality of execution.
  • Model Dyne’s core values and demonstrate accountability, collaboration, urgency, integrity, scientific excellence, and commitment to patients in all internal and external interactions.

Education and Skills Requirements:

  • Advanced degree in life sciences, healthcare, pharmacy, medicine, nursing, or a clinically relevant discipline required; PhD, PharmD, MD, or equivalent advanced degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in clinical development, clinical science, clinical research, or related roles within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Experience supporting or leading interventional clinical trials across multiple phases of development; experience in rare disease, neuromuscular disease, genetic medicines, oligonucleotide therapeutics, or other complex therapeutic areas strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting global, late-stage clinical trials and submissions.
  • Demonstrated understanding of clinical development strategy, study design, protocol development, regulatory documentation, data review, clinical trial execution, and study reporting.
  • Strong knowledge and experience with GCP, ICH guidelines, FDA, EMA, and other applicable global regulatory requirements for clinical trials.
  • Experience developing or contributing to clinical and regulatory documents, including protocols, protocol amendments, informed consent forms, investigator brochures, clinical study reports, briefing documents, regulatory responses, abstracts, posters, and manuscripts.
  • Strong ability to interpret clinical, safety, biomarker, pharmacodynamic, efficacy, and endpoint data and translate findings into clear insights, recommendations, and communications.
  • Experience with clinical data review tools and systems, including EDC systems, data listings, patient profiles, dashboards, Excel, PowerPoint, and other tools used to support clinical data review, analysis, and reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex clinical science workstreams, manage competing priorities, identify risks, resolve issues, and drive deliverables in a fast-paced, matrixed biotechnology environment.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to build alignment across Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Translational Medicine, Medical Affairs, external vendors, and study sites.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly to internal and external audiences.
  • Strong scientific judgment, critical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to operate with independence, sound judgment, accountability, urgency, and flexibility in a growing clinical-stage biotechnology company.
  • Experience working with CROs, investigators, study sites, key opinion leaders, advisory boards, or external experts preferred.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally for trial site visits, investigator meetings, advisory boards, scientific congresses, and internal meetings; approximately 20% travel.

title: Workforce Management Analyst 1
description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.


Meet the team:


We're expanding our Resource Strategy & Optimization (RSO) organization and are looking for new talent to join our Real-Time Analyst (RTA) team!

Our RTA team plays a critical role in ensuring smooth day-to-day operations across the business. By monitoring real-time performance, adjusting staffing in the moment, and supporting operational leaders with timely insights, we help maintain service levels and ensure our customers receive the high-quality support they deserve.

As the front line of workforce execution, our RTAs make sure the right people are available at the right time, schedules are optimized, and agent preferences are applied whenever possible. We collaborate closely with leaders across functions to anticipate needs, mitigate risks, and maintain operational stability. If you're passionate about using data to make fast, meaningful decisions, thrive in dynamic environments, and enjoy being at the center of where operations come to life, this is the team for you.

Where You Come In

As a Real-Time Analyst within the Resource Strategy & Optimization (RSO) team, you will:

  • Monitor live operational performance across multiple lines of business to ensure service levels remain on track.
  • Make real-time, data-driven decisions that keep staffing aligned with demand.
  • Support operational leaders by identifying risks early and recommending timely intraday actions.
  • Ensure schedules are optimized, agent preferences are considered where possible, and business needs are met.
  • Act as a front-line partner during escalations, outages, system issues, or any production-impacting situations.
  • Play a critical role in maintaining smooth, efficient operations that directly impact patient support and experience.

What Makes You Successful

You will excel in this role if you:

  • Bring 1+ year of Real-Time Analyst or WFM experience.
  • Have strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally across written, verbal, and email channels.
  • Stay organized and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced, real-time environment.
  • Are proactive, collaborative, and comfortable taking initiative.
  • Adapt quickly to change and contribute ideas for continuous improvement.
  • Are flexible with shift schedules and hybrid work.
  • Are proficient in Microsoft Excel and familiar with Genesys and Salesforce.
  • Have experience with reporting automation, Tableau, or other WFM tools.

What you’ll get:


  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.
  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.
  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and 0-2 years previous experience.

title: Robotics Software Lead
company: Galactic Resource Advancement Mechanism Technologies Corporation
description:
Robotics Software Lead

GRAM, Los Angeles moving to the San Francisco Bay Area

About the company

GRAM is building a standalone, legged robot for critical infrastructure, with utilities as the initial focus. The locomotion policy is trained in simulation, and the engineering team today is hardware heavy and software light: mechanical and electromagnetics, electrical and power distribution, prototyping and chassis, and engineering leadership.

The role

You will be the architect of the full onboard software stack and the central node of the system. You own the message passing architecture, the middleware and the real time performance, so that every module (perception, controls, planning and drivers) communicates at the right speed with no latency surprises. You are not expected to own locomotion, perception or controls directly.

This is a hands on role, you report to the Head of Engineering, start as an individual contributor, and have a path to build a team as the company scales.

What you will do

  • Own the onboard software architecture: how perception, estimation, planning and control fit together and communicate.
  • Own real time performance across the stack, with latency and jitter budgets for every loop that touches hardware, and find where cycle time is being lost.
  • Define and own the middleware layer and time synchronization across sensors and compute. The team is leaning towards Zenoh over DDS and is migrating its middleware.
  • Partition workloads across CPU, GPU and microcontrollers so safety critical loops stay isolated from autonomy and AI.
  • Lead the upgrade of the current ROS stack to a supported release and define a modular architecture across all software layers.
  • Build the logging and replay tooling used to debug field runs.

What you bring

  • Real production experience with pub/sub middleware, Zenoh or DDS.
  • 8+ years experience
  • Real time OS experience, including profiling, tracing and latency analysis.
  • A solid understanding of concurrency and inter process communication, including memory management.
  • Strong C++ and working knowledge of Python. Rust is a bonus.
  • You have designed the software architecture of a robot or a similar real time system and carried it through to production or field deployment.

Nice to have

  • Experience with legged, humanoid or other mobile robots, ideally standalone and battery powered rather than fixed arm.
  • EtherCAT or other fieldbus implementations.
  • GPU platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson and onboard AI inference runtimes.
  • A mechatronics to software background with real time systems deployed in production.
  • Experience from autonomous vehicles, aerospace or drones where real time architecture is a core discipline.

Why join

  • A clean slate architecture, with the freedom to build things properly from scratch.
  • Early equity, included in the package.
  • The chance to own a domain and build a team around it.
  • A small, hands on team where everyone does real work

Interview process

  • Recruiter screen
  • Hiring manager screen with the Head of Engineering.
  • One to two technical rounds, including a live coding exercise and an architecture discussion.
  • Onsite Interview

title: Lead Cloud Architect - Senior Manager
description:
The context:

Scyne runs a multi-cloud environment that supports our consultants, our internal platforms and the AI capabilities we build for clients. Our business systems, including Dynamics 365, SharePoint and other SaaS applications, are connected through an integration platform built on Azure Integration Services. Day-to-day operations are delivered with a managed service provider (MSP). This role is the technical authority that makes the three clouds and the integration platform work as one secure, well-governed estate.

As the Lead Cloud Architect, you will own the design, build, security and ongoing health of Scyne's cloud platforms across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and of the integration platform that connects Scyne's business systems. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set the architecture and guardrails, and you will also write the infrastructure code, review the changes and resolve the hard problems yourself.

You will define how workloads land in each cloud, how identity, networking, logging and security controls are applied consistently, and how changes move safely from design to production. You will maintain and uplift the existing integration platform so it is secure, observable and ready for new integrations. You will direct the MSP's work, hold them to agreed standards and service levels, and make sure that what is built matches the architecture Scyne has approved.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the end-to-end cloud architecture across Azure, AWS and GCP, including landing zones, account and subscription structure, identity, networking, logging and shared services.
  • Design, deploy and maintain cloud infrastructure hands-on using infrastructure as code (such as Terraform or Bicep) and CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
  • Define and enforce guardrails in each cloud, such as Azure Policy, AWS Service Control Policies and Control Tower, and GCP Organisation Policies, so that secure configuration is the default.
  • Lead the security posture of the cloud estate, including identity and access management, privileged access, encryption and key management, network segmentation, and vulnerability and configuration management.
  • Own Scyne's integration platform on Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Azure Functions and Event Grid), keeping existing integrations reliable, secure and well supported.
  • Lead the uplift of the integration platform: define the target architecture, reusable integration patterns and API standards, and deliver improvements to resilience, security, monitoring and deployment automation.
  • Design and deliver new integrations between business systems such as Dynamics 365, SharePoint and other SaaS applications, applying secure authentication (managed identities, OAuth) and secrets management.
  • Operate and tune cloud-native security tooling (such as Microsoft Defender for Cloud, AWS Security Hub and GuardDuty, and GCP Security Command Center) and work with the security team to act on findings.
  • Orchestrate the MSP: set technical direction, review designs and change requests, approve or challenge implementation approaches, and track delivery against service levels.
  • Prepare and present cloud changes at the Change Advisory Board, and ensure every change has a clear implementation, test and rollback plan.
  • Align cloud controls with relevant frameworks and obligations, including the ASD Essential Eight, the Information Security Manual (ISM), ISO/IEC 27001 and CIS Benchmarks.
  • Manage cloud cost and capacity, applying FinOps practices such as tagging standards, budgets, rightsizing and reserved capacity.
  • Produce and maintain architecture decisions, standards, patterns and as-built documentation that others can rely on.
  • Support the AI Engineering team with secure, scalable platforms for AI workloads, including model hosting, data services and workload identity.
  • Lead cloud incident response and problem management with the MSP, and drive root-cause fixes.

Ideally, you will have some of the following:

  • 10+ years' experience in infrastructure, cloud or platform engineering, including at least 5 years designing and running production workloads in public cloud.
  • Hands-on, demonstrable depth in at least two of Azure, AWS and GCP, and working knowledge of the third.
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code skills (Terraform preferred; Bicep, ARM or CloudFormation also valued) and experience building CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing landing zones, policy guardrails and identity models across multiple cloud tenancies.
  • Hands-on experience maintaining and improving an enterprise integration platform, ideally Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Functions), including integration with Dynamics 365 or similar business systems.
  • Sound knowledge of integration patterns, including REST APIs, event-driven and message-based integration, error handling, retries and monitoring.
  • Solid understanding of cloud security, including Microsoft Entra ID, workload identity federation, zero trust networking, key management and security monitoring.
  • Experience directing and governing a managed service provider, including change, incident and service-level management.
  • Familiarity with Australian government security expectations such as the ASD Essential Eight and the ISM.
  • Ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to senior, non-technical stakeholders.
  • Professional-level cloud certifications are highly desirable, such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or cloud security certifications.
  • A tertiary qualification in information technology, computer science, engineering or a related discipline is desirable.
  • Market leading Parental Leave: Allows either carer to take 26 weeks of leave, flexibly, until a child is two years of age. A six-month minimum service requirement for new starters applies. We also make full superannuation contributions for up to 12 months (including unpaid parental leave).
  • Flex working: Our people have the autonomy to choose where and when they work so they can integrate their professional and personal lives, finding the right balance that fuels their growth, wellbeing, engagement and productivity. If it works for them, their teams, and their clients, it works for us.
  • Additional leave: a 5th week of paid leave to support rest, wellbeing, and inclusion during our annual summer shutdown also Birthday leave, First Nations Cultural Leave, Floating Public Holidays, Leave+ (purchased leave up to 12 weeks), Study Leave, Volunteering Leave, and more!
  • Smart Device reimbursement: Working flexibly means accessing the information you need on the go. That’s why we help pay for your smartphone or tablet, claiming up to $60 a month towards your bill.
  • Wellness and Lifestyle benefits: We’ll give you $295 a year to spend on items or activities that support your wellness, and up to $205 a year to support your balanced lifestyle.
  • Acacia: Our EAP provider, whose holistic suite of services promote wellbeing and proactively provide protection and support when it matters most for our people and their families.

Scyne Advisory: Our Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, and Impact

We champion a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion, recognising that collective intelligence and varied perspectives are crucial for delivering exceptional outcomes for Australia's public sector. We actively encourage applications from individuals within marginalised and historically underrepresented communities. Please advise us if you require any adjustments during the application process.

We are deeply passionate about improving outcomes for First Peoples, collaborating with government and community sectors on programs focused on First Nations clients, consumers, and communities. We highly value the profound knowledge, insights, capabilities, strength, resilience, and cultural competence of First Peoples.

Our recruitment process is fair and inclusive, seeking a skilled and diverse workforce reflective of the communities we serve. We consider ability, performance, potential, and alignment with our values, valuing unique experiences and contributions. Background checks and, if required, valid Commonwealth security clearances are part of our process.

For recruitment partners, please note that candidate submissions from search firms and recruiters are only accepted in alignment with a pre-existing, signed agreement for a specific position. Unsolicited resumes will not incur financial obligation.

description:

title: Brake and Tire Auto Technician (2nd Shift)
description:
We’re looking for Automotive Mechanics with a minimum of 1 year of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As a Brake & Tire Technician, you’ll be expected to perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires and performing:

  • Technician services, such as routine inspections/maintenance
  • Basic mechanical repair for brake pads/calipers/rotors, tire installations, and wheel alignments


At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

  • You can wear Business Casual attire, nothing too formal needed
  • Resumes are always welcome to bring
  • Come with any questions for your interviewer
  • You can let the Security Gate know you are there for an interview with Carvana


Other perks of the Job

  • 100% company-paid healthcare premiums
  • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!
  • ASE and tool reimbursement programs
  • Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of Technician roles in our Inspection Centers, depending on your level of experience - take a look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

  • Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.
  • Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires
  • Mid-Level (Mechanical Repair / Build / General) Technician (min 3 years of professional experience): perform light to medium automotive repairs and minimal diagnostics on our vehicles
  • Experienced Technician (min 5 years of professional experience): perform extensive repairs and heavy engine work, as well as advanced vehicle diagnostics on all makes and models, including electric and hybrid vehicles

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles
  • Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

title: Sr Director Privacy & AI Legal
description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:

Dexcom is seeking a seasoned privacy leader to serve as its Senior Director, Privacy & AI Legal. Reporting to the VP, Employment, Corporate Governance, & Privacy Law, this role will serve as Dexcom’s Chief Privacy Officer, lead Dexcom’s global privacy program, and help shape the future of privacy, AI governance, and data stewardship across the enterprise. The ideal candidate will bring deep experience in privacy, cybersecurity, AI governance, a proactive mindset, and a collaborative leadership style. You will work with a team of motivated and passionate professionals globally and have the opportunity to interact and counsel Dexcom’s leaders.

At Dexcom, our mission is to empower people to take control of health through innovative continuous glucose monitoring technology. The Global Privacy team helps enable that mission by ensuring the responsible, ethical, and compliant use of personal data and AI across our products, services, employees, research activities, and business operations worldwide.

Where you come in:

  • You lead and continuously mature Dexcom’s global privacy program by developing and overseeing privacy governance frameworks and policies, monitoring privacy risks and developing risk mitigation strategies, conducting enterprise privacy risk assessments and program reviews, and presenting program updates and strategic initiatives
  • You partner closely with Information Security, Product Security, R&D, Marketing, and Commercial teams to provide strategic and business oriented advice and embed privacy by design principles into company processes and solutions and enable product development
  • You advise on AI , cybersecurity, and data governance, monitoring legislative and regulatory updates, and supporting AI impact assessments and reviews
  • You oversee privacy and AI operational workflows, including incident response and data subject rights requests, establish metrics, dashboards, and KPIs to measure program effectiveness, and drive automation and scalability
  • You lead and develop a high performing global privacy team and work effectively with outside counsel, consultants and vendors, as needed

What makes you successful:

  • You have at least 10 years of experience in privacy, data protection, or related fields preferably in medical device or healthcare sector
  • Proven track record of managing global privacy programs, AI governance, and global teams
  • Comfortable presenting to, counseling, and interacting with C-level executives and Directors.
  • You are committed to teamwork and maintaining strong relationships and lines of communication with business partners and other key stakeholders across the organization.
  • You have excellent decision-making skills, practical business judgement, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • You are able to work in person in the San Diego office 2-3 days per week and as required, local within 75 miles is strongly preferred.

What you’ll get:

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.
  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.
  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Travel Required:

  • 5-15%

Experience and Education Requirements:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree with 17+ years of industry experience
  • 13+ years of successful leadership management experience in relevant industry

Flex Workplace: Your primary location will be a home office. You will not have an assigned workstation and will work with your manager to determine office visit needs. You must live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km).

title: Equipment Engineer, MTC Clean
location: Boise, Idaho, United States of America
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Micron Technology is seeking an Equipment Support Clean Equipment Engineer to support advanced photomask manufacturing within the Mask Technology Center (MTC). This hands-on equipment engineering role is responsible for maintaining, solving issues with, improving, and qualifying cleanroom support equipment critical to safe and reliable manufacturing. The engineer will work closely with technicians, process engineering, facilities, manufacturing, and equipment vendors to improve equipment reliability, contamination control, automation, and overall performance!


This position supports MTC manufacturing and may require a flexible schedule or occasional overtime to support equipment recovery, installations, training, and Fab needs!

Responsibilities:

  • Troubleshoot, repair, maintain, qualify, and optimize wet process equipment to ensure safe, reliable, and high-performing operations.
  • Support and improve cleanroom systems, including wet-processing, chemical delivery, contamination control, robotics, automation, material handling, and facility utility interfaces.
  • Analyze equipment performance data to identify reliability issues, recurring failures, contamination risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Lead equipment upgrades, corrective actions, new tool installations, acceptance testing, qualifications, and preventive maintenance program development.
  • Collaborate across engineering, manufacturing, facilities, vendors, and technicians while demonstrating AI, automation, and predictive analytics to improve equipment uptime, quality, efficiency, and cost performance.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Associate degree in Electronics, Electrical Technology, Mechanical Technology, Mechatronics, Automation, or a related technical field with 5+ years of relevant equipment experience OR bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related field with 2+ years of relevant equipment experience.
  • Hands-on experience maintaining and troubleshooting problems in complex semiconductor or photomask or other advanced cleanroom manufacturing equipment.
  • Strong technical expertise in electrical, mechanical, chemical, pneumatic, controls, robotics, software/firmware, and automated equipment systems.
  • Knowledge of cleanroom operations, contamination control, wet-processing, chemical delivery, filtration systems, and related manufacturing processes.
  • Proven ability to support equipment installations, qualifications, modifications, and facility coordination while demonstrating AI, machine learning, and automation to improve equipment dependability and engineering efficiency.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong root-cause analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to drive complex technical issues to closure.
  • Experience with engineering and automation tools such as AutoCAD, Solid Edge, SQL, data analytics platforms, and AI-enabled productivity solutions.
  • Proven ability to manage projects and collaborate effectively across engineering, manufacturing, facilities, and vendor organizations.
  • Excellent interpersonal, technical documentation, and communication skills, with experience using AI tools for data analysis, workflow automation, and engineering productivity
  • Experience with PLCs, sensors, motors, pumps, valves, pneumatics, temperature-control systems, and equipment monitoring/data-analysis tools.

title: Systems Administrator - Carmel
description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we’re changing the way people buy and sell cars. With an ambitious vision and a fundamentally different approach designed to be fun, fast, and fair, Carvana became the fastest-growing automotive retailer in history. We expanded nationally, went public on the New York Stock Exchange, sold our 1 millionth car, and reached the Fortune 500, all in just eight years.

Today, with 4 million retail customers and counting, Carvana is both the fastest-growing and the most profitable public automotive retailer, and we’re just getting started. We continue to raise the bar for our customers as we tackle the enormous opportunity still ahead in the largest consumer vertical.

Working here means being part of a team that embraces change, celebrates creative problem solving, and always strives to be better. At Carvana, you’ll have the opportunity to take on meaningful challenges, learn quickly, and help shape the future of automotive retail. If you’re driven to grow and make an impact as part of a collaborative team, you’ll fit right in. Learn more about what it’s like to work here from the people that already do.

THIS IS A 100% ON-SITE POSITION (Monday through Friday)

About the team and position

We need to be super approachable and always willing to go above and beyond to help our Carvana family. It could be as simple as connecting their monitor to as complicated as tuning their flux capacitor to precisely 1.21 gigawatts! We expect smart people who are doers with bright ideas, willing to put their game-face on, take on new challenges, and juggle many assignments at once.

In return for your hard work, you'll have an opportunity to work at one of the fastest growing and creative technology companies around, as well as help us promote a life-changing product and develop a world-class team every day.

What you’ll be doing

  • Travel up to 60% to help set up and support new and existing remote Carvana Locations to include (desktop, server, network, security surveillance, and AV).
  • Communicate with internal and external users and vendors on project timeline and completions.
  • Deal with anything that is powered (wired or wireless)
  • When not on the road, take incoming calls, emails, and walk-ups related to all IT issues and requests from both PC and Mac users.
  • Set up IT accessories (monitors, docking stations, phones, etc.) for all new hires and help current users with occasional desk moves.
  • Document solutions to new problems and share them with the rest of the team.
  • Monitoring system performance to ensure everything runs smoothly and securely.
  • Configuring and maintaining networked computer systems including hardware, system software, and applications to ensure availability, reliability and security.
  • Maintain physical security for all infrastructure and endpoint devices and ensure to follow Carvana security best practices.
  • Provides support for implementation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of Information Technology platforms.
  • Participate in hardware refresh project assigned to Carvana locations
  • Participate in providing internal business support by resolving escalation requests and provide technical support when requested.
  • Diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, networking, and system issues when they arise.
  • Monitor helpdesk ticketing system and ensure tickets are resolved on time to meet Carvana defined SLA.
  • Coordinate with 3rd party vendors, IT providers and other business units for any specific requirements or on-site installation or upgrade.
  • Maintain inventory for all infrastructure related hardware in the Carvana inventory System.
  • Document solutions for new problems in Jira.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation and after hours work when needed

What you should have

This is a service desk and user-facing support role. The qualifying candidate must be enthusiastic, energetic, and must take pride in helping people solve their computer problems. Service with a smile is a requirement! Additionally, you will have...

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Valid and current driver’s license.
  • Advanced skills administering Windows Server, Active Directory, DHCP, and other network services.
  • Advanced skills in Windows Operating System (recent flavors: Windows 7,8,10) and the knowledge to create and push images.
  • Knowledge in Mac OS X (recent flavors: El Capitan, Sierra, High Sierra).
  • Experience working with Meraki Security Appliances.
  • Experience with all major types of mobile devices (iOS, Android, Windows).
  • An understanding of enterprise network environments .
  • Basic knowledge and troubleshooting skills for IP Phones.
  • Experience with G-Suite including Gmail, Calendar, and Drive.
  • Intermediate skills supporting MS Office suite, especially Outlook and Office 365.
  • Experience with troubleshooting AV equipment such as HD TVs or Projectors.
  • Project management experience is a plus.
  • 4-6 years of IT experience in fast-paced environments

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-Time Salary Position with a competitive salary.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
  • 401K with company match.
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.
  • Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization.
  • A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development.
  • A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country.

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.
  • Must be able to lift up to 70 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels.
  • Must be able to carry and transport up to 70 pounds up to 20 feet.
  • Requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

title: Senior Engineer Reliability & Qualification
description:
This role focuses on ensuring the reliability of new semiconductor package technologies through assessment planning, electrical testing, failure analysis and qualification support. The engineer will identify potential reliability risks, validate performance against customer application requirements, and drive improvements in reliability methods and digitalisation.

Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Reliability Strategy & Planning: Define and implement comprehensive reliability assessment plans for emerging package technologies. Align strategies with package requirement profiles and failure-mechanism-based FMEA to validate technical capability against specified reliability requirements, including rigorous customer mission profile compliance.
  • Test Capability Development: Establish and validate electrical test infrastructure to support feasibility studies for new package/product technologies. Lead early-stage reliability assessments utilizing prototype chips to de-risk product development cycles.
  • Risk Identification & Analysis: Proactively identify novel failure modes beyond the scope of current industry standards. Apply advanced statistical analysis to quantify potential risks and inform decision-making.
  • Execution & Evaluation: Direct the execution of reliability stress tests, integrating electrical and physical analyses within system-level application contexts. Synthesize data to derive conclusive reliability assessments and provide strategic recommendations.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Participate in high-level project discussions regarding package delta analyses and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Qualification Support: Provide technical oversight and support for the qualification of new packages, process introductions, and production changes.
  • Innovation & Digital Transformation: Lead departmental initiatives focused on digital transformation and the development of next-generation reliability methodologies to enhance operational efficiency and accelerate business outcomes.

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Materials Science, Physics, or Electrical & Electronics Engineering.
  • Experience: 0–5 years of progressive experience in the semiconductor industry, covering both frontend and backend manufacturing. Demonstrated expertise in reliability engineering, test program setup, and product qualification testing is required.
  • Professional Competencies:

o Demonstrates strong autonomous work ethics and proactive leadership in driving continuous improvement initiatives.

o Possesses superior communication and interpersonal skills, fostering effective cross-functional teamwork.

o Proficient in problem-solving frameworks, statistical analysis, and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) methodologies.

  • Preferred Assets: Proven track record in implementing digitalization solutions or advanced reliability methodologies.

title: Fulfillment Planning Analyst
description:
Fulfillment Planning Analyst

About Carvana
At Carvana, we’re changing the way people buy and sell cars. With an ambitious vision and a fundamentally different approach designed to be fun, fast, and fair, Carvana became the fastest-growing automotive retailer in history. We expanded nationally, went public on the New York Stock Exchange, sold our 1 millionth car, and reached the Fortune 500, all in just eight years.

Today, with 4 million retail customers and counting, Carvana is both the fastest-growing and the most profitable public automotive retailer, and we’re just getting started. We continue to raise the bar for our customers as we tackle the enormous opportunity still ahead in the largest consumer vertical.

Working here means being part of a team that embraces change, celebrates creative problem solving, and always strives to be better. At Carvana, you’ll have the opportunity to take on meaningful challenges, learn quickly, and help shape the future of automotive retail. If you’re driven to grow and make an impact as part of a collaborative team, you’ll fit right in. Learn more about what it’s like to work here from the people that already do.

About the team and position
This is an individual contributor position in Fulfillment Strategy & Analytics. The analyst plans and optimizes Carvana's middle-mile network: the movement of vehicles between inspection centers, logistics hubs, and last-mile markets. You will forecast vehicle flow and capacity, evaluate routing and operational changes, and deliver frequency plans to labor schedulers.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

This is a fully on-site position, Monday through Friday, at our corporate HQ in Tempe, Arizona.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build demand forecasts and frequency plans for the middle-mile logistics network.
  • Combine sales demand, trip execution, site capacity and headcount data to forecast network volume and capacity.
  • Update forecasts and demand models as actual results, capacity changes and demand constraints come in.
  • Evaluate network changes such as new lanes, meet points, and operating hours. Quantify their effect on load factor, third-party trip use, headcount needs and speed to the customer.
  • Identify demand trends and the network capacity they require, including site overflow and rerouting needs.
  • Communicate promptly with stakeholders when changes to the network plan affect operations, and coordinate the response to capacity and demand constraints.
  • Own your analyses from the initial question to the final recommendation.
  • Present findings to stakeholders, with the definitions, date ranges and caveats behind the numbers.
  • Use AI tools daily for analysis, querying and drafting.
  • Build and maintain sheets, dashboards and planning tools.

What you should have/know

  • Bachelor's degree, or 6+ years of equivalent work experience, in a quantitative discipline such as supply chain, engineering, operations or another STEM field.
  • 2+ years of experience in network, transportation or supply chain planning.
  • Hands-on experience with AI deeply integrated into your analytical workflow, including writing queries, building analyses, drafting findings, and automating recurring work.
  • Advanced skill in Excel and/or Google Sheets.
  • Familiarity with SQL, or the ability to learn it quickly.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: scheduling software, demand modeling, transportation management systems, geographic information systems.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to manage several requests at once, set priorities, and deliver accurate work on tight timelines.
  • Ability to work through complex problems with incomplete information.
  • Sound judgment and discernment, including the ability to spot when a number, data source or AI-generated answer is wrong, incomplete or conflicts with another source.
  • Ability to work on-site at our Tempe headquarters, with extensive use of computers.

It would be great if you also have

  • Experience with Snowflake or another data warehouse.
  • Experience with BI and dashboard tools such as Tableau.
  • Background in logistics, fleet or transportation operations.
  • Experience with routing, optimization or network design models.

Don't Meet 100% of the Qualifications?
At Carvana, we value diverse backgrounds and experiences. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't fit every single bullet point. Give it a shot—we'd love to hear from you!

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-Time position with a competitive salary.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
  • 401K with company match.
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.
  • Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.
  • A company culture focused on high performance and bar-raising, with vast opportunity to learn and grow.

Other requirements
To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff
