We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles
  • Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

title: DRAM interface designer, Principal / MTS
location: Boise, Idaho, United States of America
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

We are seeking a Principal IO/Clocking Design Engineer to be a part of our design team working on critical high-speed circuits common to all DRAM related memory products! In this position, you will be responsible for the development, design, optimization, verification, and fan out of these high-speed circuits to all DRAM related projects at Micron. You will work on equalization and bandwidth extension to push the speed limits of the circuit and process technology, analyze resulting IO impairments, clock jitter and duty error impact to DRAM system and timing budget, and develop effective engineering solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Innovate, design, optimize and verify high-speed IO and clocking circuits used in new DRAM products.
  • Apply proven high-speed circuit design techniques and enhance critical performance evaluation of the IO data path and clocking path at circuit level.
  • Develop accurate modeling, analysis and simulation methodology to capture key circuit performance metrics and their impact to product specifications at full-chip and system level.
  • Work with Product Engineering and SI team to compare silicon performance with simulation results and support correlation activities.
  • Collaborate with process integration and transistor modeling teams on Micron's next groundbreaking process node.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Minimum MSEE + 10 years or BSEE + 12 years of industry experience in analog and mixed-signal circuit design.
  • Proficiency with UNIX and CADENCE design environment (simulation, schematic entry, SPF extraction).
  • Understanding of device physics and basic CMOS processing techniques.
  • Ability to supervise layout work and understand good layout practices for high-speed circuits to minimize parasitic impacts.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to convey sophisticated technical concepts to other design peers both verbally and written.
  • Mental agility is a must for this position as we work with all product types (commodity, mobile, graphics) and product teams in parallel with silicon validation efforts.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in high-speed transmitter, receiver and clocking circuit design and optimization with proven silicon successes.
  • Prior experience in channel modeling and characterization, transceiver noise and timing budget analysis, equalization techniques, SI knowledge, etc.
  • Demonstrated ability in mentoring and coaching engineers early in their careers.
  • Demonstrated ability with AI/ML usage and fluency in scripting languages such as PERL/Python.
  • The Use of Agentic AI

Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. title: Lead Data Scientist, People Analytics
description:
Get to Know the Team

The People Science team, within Grab's Office of Organisational Capabilities, turns people data, research, and AI into better organisational decisions. We are building a user-centric intelligence capability that helps Grabbers, managers, People teams, and business leaders understand what is happening, identify what matters, and take effective action.

Get to Know the Role

As Data Scientist, People Analytics you will apply strategic consulting, applied research, and structured problem-solving to complex people and organisational challenges. You will build AI systems and agents that automate People Science workflows, develop an organisational listening engine that turns signals into action, and advise People and business leaders on real problems. This is a hands-on role requiring research rigour, analytical judgement, and user-centric product thinking.

You will report to the Head, People Science.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Build an organisational listening and action engine using employee listening, workforce, behavioural, and operational data to identify signals, diagnose root causes, and guide action.
  • Build user-centric AI systems and agents that automate People Science workflows, from data discovery and analysis to hypothesis testing, programme evaluation, insight generation, and recommendations.
  • Conduct applied organisational research using qualitative and quantitative methods, including surveys, interviews, experiments, and mixed-method approaches.
  • Design hypotheses and evaluate People programmes or interventions using appropriate research, experimental, or quasi-experimental methods.
  • Act as a strategic advisor to People and business leaders by framing ambiguous problems, conducting analysis, evaluating options, and translating evidence into practical decisions.
  • Democratise people data through accessible AI agents, self-service tools, and data products that help non-technical users make better decisions.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • 8 - 12 years of experience in strategic consulting, applied research, organisational research, decision science, analytics, or a related field, with hands-on end-to-end problem solving.
  • Experience advising senior stakeholders by defining ambiguous problems, diagnosing root causes, evaluating options, and translating evidence into practical decisions.
  • Strong applied research capability across qualitative and quantitative methods, including research design, hypothesis development, surveys, interviews, experiments, and mixed-method approaches.
  • Practical knowledge of programme evaluation, experimental design, causal or quasi-experimental analysis, and the ability to interpret evidence and its limitations.
  • Experience synthesise data, research findings, and user perspectives into clear recommendations.
  • Working proficiency in at least one analytical language, such as SQL, Python, or R, with the ability to conduct and interpret analysis.
  • Experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to improve research, analysis, workflows, and decision support, with an understanding of responsible AI, privacy, and bias considerations.

Good To Have

  • Experience in People Analytics, organisational psychology, behavioural science, workforce strategy, or social research.
  • Experience building or prototyping AI systems, AI agents, LLM-enabled workflows, or analytical automation.
  • Experience with employee listening, behavioural interventions, productivity measurement, programme implementation, or organisational change.

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave

title: Performance Creative Specialist
description:
Performance Creative Specialist

Location: Charlotte, NC

About the Role

Home Solutions is seeking a Performance Creative Specialist to help build and scale our video creative strategy for our Paid Social team. We’re looking for a hands-on creator who loves developing compelling content and is equally energized by leveraging data to understand what makes it perform. Every ad is an opportunity to test, learn, and improve, and we’re looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, experimentation, and measurable results.

You’ll own the creative process from ideation to execution, collaborating closely with our media and analytics teams to turn insights into high-performing ads That includes developing original concepts and compelling hooks, producing and editing your own scroll-stopping video ads, getting out in the field with partners to capture authentic footage, and getting in front of the camera as needed.

Our team is also driving innovation in AI to rethink how creative gets developed, tested, and scaled, and we want someone who is excited to embrace and experiment with new tools and resources to build smarter ways of working. We’re a quickly growing business, and as a creative owner on a small team, your work here will have an outsized impact. Our video creative playbook is still being written, which means open white space for you to define it, shape how we create, and grow your role as far as your results take you. For someone who brings creativity, curiosity, and a bias for action, there's significant opportunity to make an impact and grow alongside the business.

What You’ll Do

  • Own creative strategy and ideation: Develop original concepts, compelling hooks, and high-performing paid social creative grounded in a deep understanding of our customers, partners, competitive landscape, and emerging trends through market research, competitive landscape, and keeping a strong pulse on channel trends.
  • Create video content end-to-end: Script, shoot, and edit high volumes of scroll-stopping, platform-native video ads, ranging from selfie-style and UGC-inspired content to more polished productions. Step in front of the camera when the concept calls for it.
  • Capture authentic content in the field: Organize and lead ride alongs with our partners to capture real-world footage, customer experiences, and compelling stories that bring our ads to life.
  • Test, learn, and optimize: Collaborate closely with media and analytics teams to evaluate ad performance, identify winning concepts, and continuously iterate on creative to improve customer acquisition results.
  • Drive creative experimentation: Lead brainstorming sessions, bring fresh perspectives and ideas to the table, and translate insights from the market and performance data into a consistent pipeline of new creative tests.
  • Leverage AI to work smarter and scale: Experiment with AI tools, LLMs, and automation to accelerate ideation, streamline production, increase creative output, and build more efficient, scalable workflows.

About You

  • 4+ years of experience in creative production, content marketing, or performance creative roles.
  • A portfolio of platform-native, scroll-stopping video for platforms like Meta, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts (preferably including UGC-style ad content).
  • Strong intuition on original concepts, storytelling, copywriting, and the hook that earns the first second of attention.
  • Commercial mindset and understanding of funnel metrics like CPL and ROAS, and a willingness to let data overrule personal taste.
  • Hands-on proficiency with short-form video editing tools
  • AI-first mindset for brainstorming, iteration, audio, and video production. You actively leverage and test tools like Google Flow, Claude, ChatGPT, etc.
  • Comfortable being on camera and producing selfie-style or voiceover-driven footage.
  • Experience working with creators or UGC talent
  • Scrappy and hungry, ready to dive into any problem and roll up your sleeves to get things done
  • Collaborative and open to input from non-creative stakeholders and group decisions, while pushing back with a point of view and evidence rather than defensiveness
  • Highly organized, able to create and manage systems that create production efficiency (e.g. digital asset libraries and prompt repositories).
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift, with good judgment about what to work on first.

Why You Should Join Us

  • Results: We’re building a high-growth, high-performance business with strong momentum and meaningful impact across the home services ecosystem.
  • Opportunity: Home services is a $600 billion market that largely still operates like it’s 1999. Home Solutions is shaping the industry’s digital transformation and creating innovative experiences to better serve consumers and service providers.
  • Ownership & Impact: We operate with a high-ownership culture where individuals are expected to drive outcomes. You won’t just execute—you’ll help shape the business.
  • Exposure & Learning: You will have a front-row seat in growing a business. Your teammates have built and sold companies, managed 100s of employees, and run campaigns with Fortune 500 brands. The opportunity to build new skills and learn from smart people is endless.
  • Career Growth: We’re building quickly, which means new opportunities emerge constantly. If you’re hungry to grow, you’ll have the chance to move fast and take on more.
  • Stability: As a privately held, debt-free company, we make disciplined, long-term financial decisions—investing in sustained growth and pursuing strategic acquisitions.
  • Culture: We’re a team that plays to win- holding a high bar for excellence while creating an environment where people enjoy the work and the people they do it with.

The Package

We offer a competitive base salary based on experience. As a full-time team member at Home Solutions, you'll also enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including health, medical, and vision insurance, a 401(k) match, short-term disability coverage, and a cell phone reimbursement. Additionally, we support your well-being and growth with flexible time off, a bi-annual $500 Relax & Recharge bonus, a learning and development stipend, and a Charity Match program to give back to causes you care about.

EEOC Statement

All applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, gender identity, or any other discriminatory factors. Please note that we do not provide immigration sponsorship for this role. All offers are subject to a background check.

title: IT/OT Solutions Architect
description:
Proconex is the exclusive Emerson Impact Partner for Emerson Automation Solutions in the Mid-Atlantic region. We provide a full portfolio of Process Automation Control Systems, Valves and Control Devices, and related technologies and services to a range of customers—in the Life Sciences, Chemical, Power, Refining, Oil & Gas, Food & Beverage, Paper, Metals, and other industries, as well as commercial enterprises and campus facilities. With three strategically located offices, Proconex maintains a deep dedication to its 200+ employees, a sharp focus on safety and quality, and the drive to deliver.

IT/OT Solution Architect

Job Overview

The IT/OT Solution Architect designs and implements integrated architectures that bridge information technology (IT) and operational technology (OT) systems within manufacturing environments centered around Distributed Control Systems (DCS). This role ensures seamless data flow between process automation, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and enterprise IT systems while leading the design of scalable, future-ready solutions that support secure, compliant, and high-performing digital manufacturing operations. The position requires strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, effective communication across engineering, IT, and operations teams, and the ability to translate technical design into business value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop end-to-end IT/OT solution architectures integrating DCS, Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA), MES, and enterprise IT systems (Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS)).
  • Define connectivity standards between DCS and higher-level systems using protocols such as Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture (OPC UA), Modbus, Ethernet Industrial Protocol (EtherNet/IP), and Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT).
  • Design secure network topologies, including plant network segmentation, firewalls, and industrial demilitarized zone (DMZ) configurations.
  • Support the development of edge and cloud data architectures for real-time process monitoring, historian integration, and predictive analytics.
  • Evaluate and recommend technology platforms to support digital transformation and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead the integration of DCS with MES and data historians (OSIsoft PI, Aveva, or Aspen InfoPlus.21).
  • Collaborate with process automation and IT teams to establish standardized data models, interfaces, and asset hierarchies.
  • Provide guidance on DCS modernization, virtualization, and cybersecurity hardening strategies.
  • Ensure architectures meet performance, reliability, and compliance requirements (e.g., U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) 21 Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) Part 11 for regulated industries).
  • Define and enforce IT/OT architectural governance, design patterns, and configuration management practices, ensuring adherence to International Society of Automation (ISA)-95, ISA/International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) 62443, and National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-82 standards for industrial cybersecurity and integration.
  • Support the development of lifecycle management and migration plans for enterprise systems, and participate in audits, risk assessments, and cybersecurity incident response planning.
  • Partner with engineering, operations, and digital transformation teams to align architecture with business objectives, and lead workshops to define requirements, solution designs, and technology roadmaps.
  • Mentor cross-functional teams on IT/OT convergence, automation data flow, and best practices for DCS-to-enterprise integration.

This role is hybrid or onsite depending on facility needs and requires travel up to 75% for site assessments, design reviews, and deployment support.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in industrial automation, IT infrastructure, or control systems architecture.
  • 3+ years of experience with DCS configuration, system design, and lifecycle management.
  • 3+ years of experience with industrial networks, including Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs), switches, firewalls, and remote access solutions.
  • 3+ years of experience integrating automation systems with MES, LIMS, ERP, and data historian environments.
  • 3+ years of experience with virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V) and industrial servers and workstations.
  • 3+ years of experience with industrial communication protocols, including OPC Classic/UA, Modbus Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), MQTT, and EtherNet/IP.
  • 3+ years of experience applying cybersecurity frameworks for industrial control systems (ISA/IEC 62443).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in pharmaceutical, specialty chemical, or life sciences manufacturing environments.
  • Experience with Emerson Syncade MES, OSIsoft PI, AspenTech, or Aveva solutions.
  • Experience with cloud integration (Microsoft Azure Internet of Things (IoT), Amazon Web Services (AWS) IoT) and edge computing for manufacturing data.
  • Certifications such as The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), ISA/IEC 62443, or Emerson DeltaV professional certifications.
  • Experience applying Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Good Automated Manufacturing Practice (GAMP) 5, and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance principles.

We are proud to be an employee-owned organization. Through our ESOP, every team member shares in the growth and success of the company, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and long-term rewards.

title: Manager II, Software Engineering
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Recovering entrepreneur? Frustrated with bureaucracy? Want to build the team and write the roadmap, not inherit one?

We’re hiring Engineering Managers across multiple verticals. The nice thing about growing 30%+ at ~$2.1B ARR is that we need great engineering leaders everywhere, and we have the room to shape the team around the right person. You lead like a founder. We give you the platform to do it at scale.

About the role:

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We’re still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we’re hiring the leaders who will build the teams that build what comes next.

We’re at ~$2.1B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We’re looking for Engineering Managers who want to define what ships next by building and leading great teams. You’ll manage engineers across platform and product, and we’re open to shaping team scope around the right person’s strengths and interests. That window won’t stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US or Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software your team builds will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn’t metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.
  • You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. Your team will build new systems from scratch, not babysit old ones. You’d own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.
  • You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.
  • You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You and your team will participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.
  • You believe great teams are the real product. You get energy from hiring exceptional people, growing them, and creating the conditions for them to do the best work of their careers. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn’t tooling or process. It’s ambition, and your job is to unlock it.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and grow a team of engineers: hire top talent, coach and develop individuals, manage performance, and build a culture of ownership, quality, and velocity.
  • Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.
  • Define and drive technical strategy and roadmap for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.
  • Guide your team to design and ship full-stack features end to end, delivering AI-powered products that solve real operational problems across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile.
  • Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans, staffing, and measurable outcomes.
  • Oversee the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators, and stay close enough to the technical work to guide architecture and make sound tradeoffs.
  • Raise the bar across engineering through design reviews, hiring standards, mentorship of senior engineers and future leaders, and by setting the standard for quality, velocity, and craft.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.
  • 3+ years of experience directly managing software engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development.
  • Strong technical fundamentals across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile), enough to guide architecture, review designs, and earn your team’s respect.
  • Familiarity with modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.
  • Experience building or leading teams that build AI-powered or data-driven products. You don’t need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executives.
  • A track record of building: zero-to-one products, teams and systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that’s LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.
  • Experience leading teams through AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply output and accelerate delivery.
  • Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.
  • A proven track record of managing and developing senior engineers, building managers-of-managers, and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.
  • Experience scaling teams through fast growth, including building hiring pipelines and onboarding.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$142,800—$184,800 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Car Detailer Bronx, NY - (FT)
description:
We’re looking for entry-level Lot Attendants to build an exciting career at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500! As a Lot Attendant, you will be focused on maintaining the cleanliness and appearance of the vehicles at our Market Hubs. As part of this role, you will be expected to coordinate with fellow employees to ensure timely deliveries and the highest level of customer satisfaction. Interested in joining the team? Check out more below:

  • This is a full-time position
  • PTO and paid holidays + your birthday is a holiday

Unlock Your Earning Potential!

We offer a competitive starting hourly rate of $19/hr with significant growth opportunities based on performance. You can boost your earnings within a short timeframe:

  • Pay Range: $19-$20 hourly
  • Starting Pay: $19/hr
  • At 3 Months: $19.25/hr
  • At 6 Months: $19.50/hr
  • At 9 Months: $19.75/hr
  • At 12 Months: $20/hr

In your first year, you can progress from $19hr to $20hr through our performance-based Careers Not Jobs program, which provides four merit opportunities annually. Through this program, eligible team members can enjoy an additional $0.25 increase in their pay every 90 days.

We’re looking for enthusiastic, energetic, and self-motivated team players to:

  • Ensure each vehicle is inspected for mechanical, drivability or cosmetic concerns
  • Wash and vacuum all inventory on a regular basis
  • Complete multi-point inspection on arriving inventory to include fuel level, safety features, drivability test and proper display of all company and state disclosures
  • Maintain positive relationships with coworkers and external vendors
  • Interact and communicate with team members and management across all lines of the business.
  • Must adhere to regular and predictable attendance.

General qualifications and requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent is desirable
  • Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver’s license
  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record for the past 3 years
  • Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels.
  • Must be able to carry and transport up to 60 pounds up to 20 feet.
  • Requires standing for an extended period of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking and stooping, pushing and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance.
  • Requires working outdoors in all weather conditions.
  • Requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity.
  • Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment.

About Carvana

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

Being a brand ambassador of Carvana means having a passion for our vision and having a motor that never quits when it comes to representing our brand and values. Our Market Operations team members work as a team to deliver awesome customer experiences in their markets, while also remaining agile enough to keep up with the ever-changing beat and cadence of your daily activities.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

title: Director of Rooms
description:
Reporting to the Hotel Manager, responsibilities and essential job functions include but are not limited to the following:

Strategic Leadership

  • Serve as a member of the Hotel Executive Committee, contributing to the development, execution, and achievement of the property's strategic business plan.
  • Translate organizational objectives into actionable departmental strategies that drive guest satisfaction, market positioning, and profitability.
  • Lead the Rooms Division in alignment with Fairmont, Accor Luxury, Forbes Travel Guide, and LQA service standards.
  • Act as the Rooms Division ambassador, cultivating a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Guest Experience & Service Excellence

  • Champion a guest-centric service culture, ensuring every arrival, stay, and departure exceeds expectations.
  • Drive performance against key guest satisfaction metrics, including Guest Voice, TrustYou, LQA, and internal service benchmarks.
  • Lead hotel-wide service recovery strategies and ensure prompt, personalized resolution of guest concerns.
  • Collaborate with operational leaders to continuously enhance the luxury guest journey and identify opportunities for innovation.

Operational Leadership

  • Provide strategic and operational leadership across Front Office, Housekeeping, Fairmont Gold, Guest Services, Loyalty and ALL member experience, Royal Service, the Health Club, and Valet and Transportation.
  • Keep cleanliness, presentation and operational readiness at the highest standard throughout the hotel.
  • Lead operational audits, quality assurance and compliance reviews.
  • Serve as primary liaison with third-party valet operators and key Rooms partners.

Financial & Commercial Performance

  • Develop and manage annual operating budgets, capital planning requirements, and monthly forecasts for all Rooms Division departments.
  • Drive departmental profitability through labor management, productivity optimization, expense control, and revenue-enhancement initiatives.
  • Partner closely with the Revenue Management team to maximize RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, and total hotel profitability.
  • Leverage business intelligence, operational analytics, and forecasting tools to support data-driven decision making.
  • Ensure accountability for financial results and achievement of departmental KPIs.

Talent Development & Culture

  • Build and sustain a high-performance culture focused on engagement, inclusion, recognition, and continuous growth.
  • Lead succession planning initiatives and develop a strong pipeline of future leaders within the Rooms Division.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop Department Heads and emerging leaders through regular performance and career development conversations.
  • Partner with Talent & Culture to attract, recruit, onboard, and retain top hospitality talent.
  • Foster positive labor-management relations within a unionized environment.

Quality, Safety & Sustainability

  • Ensure full compliance with all health, safety, security, and emergency preparedness standards.
  • Promote a workplace culture focused on colleague wellbeing and psychological safety.
  • Champion sustainability and responsible hospitality initiatives in alignment with Accor environmental goals.
  • Maintain compliance with all corporate, legislative, and brand standards.

Partnership & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary liaison with Third Party Valet operators and key Rooms Division service partners.
  • Collaborate closely with the Director, Food & Beverage, Director, Spa, Executive Chef and other Executive Committee members to deliver an integrated luxury guest experience.
  • Represent the hotel professionally with owners, brand partners, community organizations, and industry stakeholders as required.

What is in it for you:

  • Salary Range: $150,000 – $190,000 USD
  • Discounted hotel rooms and food & beverage rates at our sister properties around the globe
  • Learning programs through our Academies to help you grow and perform at your full potential
  • A seat on the Executive Committee of one of Los Angeles’s most iconic hotels
  • Opportunity to grow your career across Fairmont and Accor’s global luxury portfolio
  • The chance to make a difference through Corporate Social Responsibility activities like Planet 21 and WATCH
  • [Health benefits, 401(k), relocation assistance if applicable, other perks]

Your experience and skills include:

  • 5–7 years of progressive Rooms Division leadership in luxury hotels, resorts or complex hospitality operations
  • Previous experience as Director of Rooms, Executive Assistant Manager – Rooms, Hotel Manager or an equivalent senior operations role
  • Proven success leading large teams and driving guest satisfaction, colleague engagement and financial results
  • Experience managing a unionized workforce is strongly preferred
  • Strong financial acumen: budgets, forecasts, labor productivity and P&L management
  • Advanced analytical skills and proficiency with PMS, RMS, labor management and guest experience platforms
  • An inspiring leadership presence, with strong emotional intelligence and influencing skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; bilingual English/Spanish is highly desirable
  • A bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Business or a related field is preferred; an MBA or executive leadership certification is an asset
  • Flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, holidays and major events

Your team and working environment:

What was true in 1966 remains true to this day: The Century Plaza Hotel is part of a visionary development intent on doing what others could only imagine. Previously deemed the “Western White House” (as the only venue outside the White House to host state dinners), Century Plaza’s place in history remains unshakeable. A modernized take on luxury and elevated guest experience from product to people enlivens the real wow factor.

This experience begins with a new kind of workplace, one where the energy is contagious, the stories are invigorating, and the challenges present inspiring opportunities to make your mark. We provide an environment of trust, respect and integrity, a home away from home where diversity and inclusion are celebrated. Privacy and personal information are protected. Through Accor’s Employee Value Proposition, we ensure fair treatment and a workplace free from discrimination and harassment.

Visa Requirements: Must provide proof of eligibility to be employed in the United States of America.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:
We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent. We commit to a future where diverse identities are celebrated, and equitable and inclusive practices are woven into the fabric of everything we do as an organization.

Fairmont Century Plaza is an Equal Opportunity Employer EEO M/F/V/D

Why work for Accor?
We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.

By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow’s hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit

Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo! #BELIMITLESS

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Staff Software Engineer

ROLE / DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW

Pathstream is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead large, cross-team technical work on our platform. This is a senior individual contributor role on one of our engineering pods. Our pods are small, fast-moving teams that own their area end to end and ship to production often. You will report to your pod's engineering lead and have no direct reports.

You will be an expert in the systems your team owns, and you will understand how data moves through the rest of Pathstream's platform. You will lead multi-person projects from design to production, set the technical bar for your pod, and help the engineers around you grow.

A core expectation of this role is the ability to advance Pathstream's AI-native engineering practices. AI adoption is already deeply embedded in how we build software at Pathstream. We are looking for a technical leader who not only embraces this approach but actively pushes the organization forward in building, evaluating, and deploying AI-enabled development tools and agentic engineering workflows. Both as a hands-on practitioner and as a force-multiplier for engineers across the org.

WHAT WE DO

Pathstream was founded on the premise that substantial unrealized economic and human potential exists within each organization's frontline workforce. We are reshaping the way employees and managers on the frontlines excel in their careers. In this age of rapid tech evolution, our enterprise partnerships transform frontline teams from transactional to relational, and from task-oriented to strategic.

We impact companies' bottom lines with improved productivity, increased retention, and differentiated quality of customer experience, while employees experience greater success in their current roles and unlock future professional growth.

We're a tight-knit, hardworking, mission-driven team of ~60 employees eager to scale our solution and transform the careers of our customers.

THE ROLE

AI-NATIVE ENGINEERING

  • Own how your team delivers with AI, in addition to your own output. Reshape how projects are scoped, sequenced, and staffed now that implementation is cheaper, so the team's throughput goes up.
  • Own the team's shared AI patterns as a set: context files, skills, conventions, and workflows, including ones others wrote. Keep them maintained, and retire the ones that no longer help.
  • Lead adoption of new AI tools and methods in your area. Our current toolset includes Claude Code, Claude skills, MCP servers, and AI code review.
  • Notice when the team's verification practices fall behind how fast code is now produced, and drive the fix end to end. Test strategy, staged rollout, and observability are part of that work.
  • Make room for the team to experiment, and keep it safe to report that something did not work. Tell an experiment worth running from a distraction, and say no to distractions without killing the team's appetite to try new things.

TECHNICAL OWNERSHIP & DELIVERY

  • Lead large feature releases end to end. These are usually multi-person projects that cross team boundaries.
  • Take on significant, unique engineering problems where the data is incomplete and the trade-offs include intangibles. Diagnose root causes quickly and guide others through the trade-offs.
  • Break complex initiatives into clear, maintainable pieces that less experienced teammates can own.
  • Know when to focus on stability and quality, and when to ship quickly and iterate.
  • Write architecture documents that show how systems work together and where they are weak. Review other teams' technical documents with clear, timely feedback.

QUALITY, SECURITY & OPERATIONS

  • Recognize when systems or workflows need reinforcement to protect quality, and drive the solution end to end.
  • Apply strong security practice in your domain. Partner with engineering leadership on SOC2, vulnerability management, and the controls that protect our enterprise customers and learners.
  • Give code review that others seek out because it is thorough, helpful, and kind.
  • Jump into incidents outside your normal scope in an emergency. Improve how the team detects, prevents, and responds to incidents.

COLLABORATION & MENTORSHIP

  • Grow other engineers over an extended period. Tailor feedback to each person's skills, background, and working style.
  • Build strong relationships with product, design, and cross-functional partners. Represent your team's technical view in conversations about scope, sequencing, and trade-offs.
  • Write clear narratives that create understanding and help decisions get made. Adapt how you communicate to your audience.
  • Influence hiring and help develop strong engineering talent.

ABOUT YOU

AI PRACTICE

  • AI is a core part of how you work today. You can describe, with examples, how it changed the way you scope, build, and review software.
  • You have built AI tooling for yourself and for others: skills, MCP servers, context files, evaluation harnesses, or multi-step agentic workflows. Other engineers adopted and kept using at least one of them.
  • You have shipped AI features in production systems where an LLM is a first-class component. You have dealt with evaluation, observability, and cost.
  • You verify AI output with rigor. You can name the failure modes you watch for and the checks you added to catch them.
  • You keep up with the tools because you want to, not because someone asked you to. You run your own experiments, you have opinions about what works, and you share what failed as readily as what worked.

EXPERIENCE

  • You bring 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record as a senior engineer.
  • You are an expert in one or more technical areas and proficient across a broad range of others.
  • You have led projects that crossed team boundaries, and you have shipped systems that other engineers depend on.
  • You bring deep familiarity with modern web application stacks similar to ours: Ruby on Rails, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Docker, PostgreSQL, and AWS.
  • You have practical experience operating production systems that hold customer data, including security and compliance work in a SaaS environment.

HOW YOU WORK

  • You lead through influence. Other engineers seek you out for technical feedback because your advice is thorough, helpful, and kind.
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities. You make data-informed decisions when perfect information is not available.
  • You stay calm under pressure and help your team through change.
  • You ask for feedback and act on it. You celebrate the work of others, and you treat disagreement as a way to reach a better answer.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Transparent and social culture, challenging work, fast learning cycles, practical training, and meaningful feedback
  • Strong sense of ownership and strategic work that impacts our product, users, colleagues, business, and world
  • Salary and total compensation offerings are contingent upon the candidate's level of expertise and geographic location, ensuring equitable remuneration.
    • Tier 1: San Francisco Bay Area and New York City: $190,000 to $220,000
    • Tier 2 metropolitan markets: $171,000 to $198,000
    • Tier 3 regional markets: $152,000 to $176,000

Comprehensive benefits package:

  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision for you; 50% for partner/spouse and dependents
  • Health, commuter, and parking flexible spending accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program (mental health, financial health, legal support)
  • Free access to wellbeing apps (Ginger, Headspace)
  • Flexible paid time off and paid holidays
  • Generous paid parental leave
  • Short and long-term disability insurance
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Remote-first culture
  • Life insurance (100% company paid)
  • 401(k)

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

Our company values diversity and believes diverse teams make innovation possible. We work on complex, difficult problems with no linear or clear solutions. We need a diverse team that can bring different perspectives and approaches, and whose experiences reflect the full set of stakeholders we seek to serve. Pathstream is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage all qualified applicants from any race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or other characteristics to apply.

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Interview Integrity Notice
Pathstream is committed to maintaining a fair and authentic hiring process. As part of our recruitment process, we may utilize fraud detection and identity verification practices, including IP address monitoring, AI-generated video detection, live skills assessments, and identity verification during interviews. Depending on the role, candidates may also be asked to participate in an in-person interview or other identity verification steps before an offer is extended.

title: Teknisk Projektledare - Västerås
description:
Vi söker en erfaren teknisk projektledare för uppdrag inom bland annat teknik, industri och automation. Rollen innebär att leda och driva komplexa utvecklingsprojekt, ha det övergripande ansvaret för projektportföljen och samordna arbete mellan avdelningar och externa partners i en dynamisk och innovativ miljö.

Om rollen

Som projektledare hos oss har du en nyckelroll i att driva och genomföra tekniska projekt från idé till färdig leverans. Dina dagar kommer bland annat att bestå av att leda och koordinera projekt, ansvara för kvalitet, tidplan och budget, samt samarbeta med tvärfunktionella team och externa partners.

Ansvarsområden

  • Leda och koordinera tekniska projekt från start till mål, med fokus på komplexa och tvärfunktionella miljöer

  • Ansvar för projektets kvalitet, tidplan, budget och resursallokering

  • Säkerställa kommunikation och framdrift i alla projektfaser, inklusive rapportering till ledning

  • Bidra med teknisk kompetens och strategisk vägledning

Vem är du?

Du är en nyfiken och driven person som ständigt vill utveckla både dig själv och ditt team. Du är van att strukturera och optimera processer, drivs av att göra arbetsuppgifter bättre och har förmåga att se helheten och driva förändring. Din flexibla, analytiska och positiva inställning bidrar till projektens framgång.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Ingenjörsexamen eller motsvarande utbildning

  • Minst 8 års erfarenhet av projektledning inom teknik, industri eller automation

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda komplexa projekt och projektportföljer

  • God teknisk förståelse och erfarenhet av komplexa projektmiljöer

  • Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Meriterande är om du även har erfarenhet av:

  • Certifiering inom PMP, IPMA eller liknande projektledningsmetoder

  • Erfarenhet av SAP eller andra affärssystem

  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med automation, robotik och industriell IT

  • Erfarenhet av att leda små till medelstora team eller avdelningar

Vilka är Chief?

Chief är en ledande aktör i konsultbranschen med en stark familjär kultur där teknik och ledarskap möts. Hos oss får du en personlig och utvecklande miljö där karriärresa och ledarskap står i centrum – med möjligheterna som följer med att vara en del av en global koncern.

Vad erbjuder vi?

  • Gemenskap & utveckling: Vi investerar i dig och din utveckling genom branschöverskridande och spännande kunduppdrag, mentorskapsprogram, Chief Academy, möjlighet till certifiering samt andra interna initiativ som stärker både din kompetens och ditt ledarskap.

  • Större möjligheter: Lokalt engagemang kombinerat med ett globalt nätverk genom vår koncern Alten Group, karriärvägar och spännande uppdrag – utan att kompromissa med den familjära känslan.

  • Trygg anställning: Hos oss får du en kollektivavtalad anställning med konkurrenskraftig lön, friskvårdsbidrag, utbildningsbudget med mera.

Vill du vara med och forma framtidens teknik och ledarskap? Då är vi rätt plats för dig!

Skicka in din ansökan med CV redan idag. Intervjuer och återkoppling sker löpande.

Vill du veta mer om Chief och rollen? Kontakta oss eller läs mer på vår karriärhemsida!

title: Security Analyst - Governance, Risk, and Compliance
description:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly's Governance, Risk, and Compliance team is hiring a Security Analyst III to facilitate the definition, implementation, and operation of security and privacy programs at LaunchDarkly.

LaunchDarkly is critical infrastructure. Our security team keeps it safe for the global systems that depend on us and the GRC team demonstrates that to earn the trust of our customers. As a member of the team, you'll drive initiatives to assess and reduce security risks to the company, advise stakeholders, and maintain compliance with the frameworks that we adhere to including ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and FedRAMP.

You'll report to the Director of Security and partner closely with stakeholders in Legal, Revenue, and other members of our security team. We expect you to bring a sharp point of view on where AI can take work off the team's plate and make our coverage deeper.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design and operate security controls that comprise the LaunchDarkly GRC program

  • Use technology to automate compliance activities like gathering evidence and verifying controls

  • Operationalize the health and maturity of the program by tracking metrics based on quantitative and qualitative data

  • Drive progress towards results for GRC-related continuous improvement projects

  • Contribute to documentation for security standards, policies, and processes

  • Support audits and assessments with internal and external stakeholders

  • Work with product and infrastructure delivery teams on engineering projects related to GRC requirements

Qualifications:

  • Deep cybersecurity, privacy, and risk management knowledge and skill

  • Excellent communication skills - written and verbal

  • Experience working on collaborative projects

  • Depth with modern cloud-based SaaS organizations - specifically AWS control environments

  • Information security experience at an organization with significant compliance requirements

  • Strong familiarity with security standards (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, FedRAMP) as well as privacy laws (CCPA and GDPR)

  • Familiarity with LaunchDarkly’s collaboration tools like Confluence, Slack, and Github

Nice to Have:

  • Considerable knowledge of software development and architecture

  • CCSP, PCI QSA, CISSP, or CISA / CISM certifications

Qualifications:

  • You're proactive by default. You'd rather spot compliance drift early and fix the cause rather than chase symptoms during an audit.

  • You believe good governance is a craft of habits and systems. Small consistent improvements beat heroic one-offs.

title: Member of Technical Staff (Storage)
location: New York, NY; Remote, United States; San Mateo, CA; Toronto, Canada
description:
Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.

For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.

At Cockroach Labs, you'll solve problems that didn't exist five years ago alongside people who believe the simplest solutions often require the most sophisticated thinking. Your work will run in production at some of the most innovative companies in the world. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.

The Role

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Storage Team to help shape and build CockroachDB’s storage systems. Storage is the foundation of CockroachDB, responsible for the safe, durable and efficient persistence and retrieval of data, on top of which the rest of the database is built. Our team develops and maintains Pebble, an innovative Log Structured Merge (LSM) Tree storage engine purpose built for Multi Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) data, and Plenum, the elastic, disaggregated storage layer that separates a cluster’s storage from its compute and allows them to scale independently.

In this role, you’ll bring deep storage expertise to complex problems spanning Pebble, Plenum, encryption at rest (EAR), CockroachDB’s storage interfaces, and the cloud environments in which they operate. You’ll work hands-on, lead the design and delivery of significant improvements, and help the team make sound tradeoffs among durability, performance, scalability, cost, and operational simplicity.

You Will

  • Work on hard technical problems. Apply your deep knowledge of storage systems to solve technical challenges at the core of CockroachDB and its storage layers.
  • Lead through collaboration. Partner with engineering and product leadership to identify, design, and drive significant Storage initiatives, making tradeoffs clear and building alignment across involved teams.
  • Be a trusted partner across the company. Work closely and collaboratively with other engineers across the database and cloud organizations, product, support, and field engineering.
  • Set the standard for engineering excellence. Raise the effectiveness of the team through design reviews, mentorship, and clear technical communication. Help the team leverage AI to produce high-quality software in a modern development environment.
  • Ship mission-critical software. Ensure that CockroachDB remains scalable, survivable, and consistent as we continue to grow as a company. We work in Go and Rust, but if you don't know them, you'll learn while you're here.

The Expectations

In your first 30 days, you will establish relationships with the Storage team and learn about the Storage team’s domain and CockroachDB architecture. You will ship your first project.

After 3 months, you will be fully integrated into the team and comfortable contributing to the Storage team’s roadmap in partnership with Product. You’ll have built an understanding of the Storage team’s tech stack and feel comfortable with the architecture and components the team develops and maintains.

After 6 months, you will have led a meaningful piece of Storage work and participate in the Storage oncall rotation.

You Have

  • Deep systems experience. 8+ years building complex distributed systems or storage software, including significant time working on distributed systems, concurrency control, file systems, data replication, I/O performance, or memory management.
  • Storage architecture expertise. You have built or evolved a storage system such as log-structured merge-trees, blob storage, or cloud object storage.
  • Production experience. Experience building, running, and debugging large-scale distributed systems in production and evolving systems through rolling upgrades.
  • A collaborative approach. You have a passion for solving hard technical problems with others, sharing context, giving and receiving thoughtful feedback, and helping teammates succeed. You enjoy mentoring other engineers and helping them grow.
  • Hands-on ability. You write production-ready code in systems programming languages like Go, Rust, or C/C++. You dig into hard bugs, profiles, and incidents when it matters.

The Team

Rachael Harding - Manager, Engineering

Rachael leads the Storage team within the Database Engineering organization, where she oversees the development of Pebble and Plenum. Based in the Bay Area with her family, Rachael enjoys sampling pastries, exploring local parks, and baking with her kids.

Nick Travers - Director, Engineering

Nick joined Cockroach Labs in 2021 and leads Database Engineering - the group of teams building CockroachDB. Originally from Perth, Australia, he lives in Los Angeles with his family. Arsenal supporter, cook, outdoors person.

Isaac Wong - EVP of Research & Development

Isaac is responsible for the health of the engineering organization at Cockroach Labs. He partners closely with teams to ensure we have a balanced culture that promotes quality and innovation in pursuit of our goals. Before joining Cockroach Labs Isaac was in life sciences for 16 years with Medidata Solutions where he had a front row seat on the exciting ride from a 30 person startup to more than 2000 people worldwide. But the lure of distributed, resilient, and consistent SQL databases, along with the amazing technology and culture at Cockroach Labs proved too much. When not working he likes to draw, play the piano, and search NYC for cannoli's with his wife and kids.

Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs.com.

Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.

description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Micron’s Innovation, Technology & Products (ITP) organization seeks a Director of AI Forward Deployed Engineering to build and lead a team working side-by-side with ITP product teams. The organization aims to bring artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, automation, and AI-powered engineering capabilities into the spaces where Micron engineers invent and develop memory and storage products.


This leader will be responsible for the final stage of ITP AI delivery, improving AI agents, custom models, and AI-enhanced engineering workflows from initial exploration to production release and ongoing management. The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team will handle both the deployment and maintenance of these solutions. Their focus includes production reliability, scalability, optimization, telemetry, and observability across the ITP AI stack, covering applications, agents, models, data, and infrastructure.


Responsibilities


  • Direct forward deployed delivery for ITP product teams by integrating FDE engineers into engineering departments. They discover high-impact use cases and develop production-ready solutions. These cover AI agents, agentic workflows, data science, custom models like small language models (SLMs), and AI-powered engineering and CAD workflows.
  • Advance AI solutions from pathfinding through pilot and into production, incorporating operational readiness, monitoring, runbooks, support, security, scalability, and reliability from day one. Produce repeatable deployment instructions and reference architectures that speed up delivery cycles across ITP.
  • Accelerate adoption and measurable business impact by partnering with product team leaders to translate engineering challenges into prioritized AI opportunities and track improvements in adoption, efficiency, engineering cycle time, quality, reliability, and cost.
  • Develop and lead the FDE organization by sourcing, growing, and retaining a skilled team of forward deployed engineers, SRE/operations engineers, and AI/ML engineers. Handle team resources, priorities, and budget guided by ITP business value while partnering with architecture, platform, support, product, and Information Technology teams.
  • Own production operations and reliability for deployed ITP AI solutions by establishing service-level objectives (SLOs), appropriate service-level agreements (SLAs) and error budgets, on-call rotations and blocking issue response models, incident management, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and change, release, and rollback practices that protect production stability.
  • Provide accountable leadership during production incidents by driving rapid service restoration. Communicate clearly with impacted product teams and help prevent recurrence. Proactively identify and eliminate single points of failure, capacity risks, and operational toil through automation.
  • Drive telemetry, observability, and continuous optimization across the AI stack through logging, tracing, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and health scorecards that provide access to production system health and usage. Use operational insights to continuously improve performance, reliability, cost efficiency, model quality, and ITP AI, data, and platform roadmaps.
  • Measure and communicate the success of deployed AI capabilities, including business value delivered as solutions move from pathfinding to production, production availability and SLO attainment, performance and cost improvements, solution adoption, and happiness among ITP engineers.

Minimum Qualifications


  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a similar field.
  • 15 years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML, data science, or engineering solutions, with more than 7 years managing engineering teams.
  • Proven experience owning production operations for enterprise-critical systems, including on-call operations, incident management, observability, root-cause analysis, service-level objectives, and production reliability.
  • Demonstrated experience deploying AI/ML, generative AI, or related AI-enabled solutions into production and driving adoption across multiple engineering or product teams.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership across AI/ML engineering, production software and infrastructure, data systems, automation, and operational reliability.

Preferred Qualifications


  • PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, AI/ML, Data Science, or a related technical area.
  • Experience in semiconductor, memory, storage, or related product development environments, with knowledge of complex engineering, building, verification, and CAD workflows.
  • Experience building and leading forward deployed, customer-embedded, SRE, production engineering, AI/ML, or similar technical groups.
  • Extensive background in AI agents and autonomous workflows, generative AI, machine learning models, compact language models, AI-assisted engineering processes, production AI monitoring, and model performance.
