title: Technician Team Lead
description:
About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

Position Overview:
Line Lead is a front-line supervisor role, responsible for directly managing and developing a team of hourly associates in an Inspection Center to regularly achieve production targets.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Manage the movement of cars into and out of the Inspection Center safely for repairs, while meeting or exceeding set production and quality goals.
  • Meet or exceed inventory production goals on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.
  • Oversee day-to-day activities of assigned team; identify team’s strengths and weaknesses; determine areas of opportunity and the appropriate steps to improve.
  • Engage assigned team, provide appropriate coaching, development and performance management; offer feedback and demonstrate desired skills.
  • Create a work and team environment that inspires positive communication, team cohesion, and adherence to Carvana’s Values.
  • Proactively communicate information to team members, providing clear understanding of expectations, performance measures, and goals.
  • Prevent and resolve conflict among team members.
  • Monitor and ensure adherence to systems, policies, procedures, and performance standards.
  • Review and approve identified mechanical and physical defects of incoming inventory.
  • Lead a team of production associates and partner with the Inspection Center General Manager to repair or reject inventory based on estimated cost of repairs and/or the overall quality of the vehicle.
  • Train a team of production associates using Quality Control standards to identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, minimizing re-checks and delays in production.
  • Identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, to minimize re-work and delays in production.
  • Conscientiously work in ways that decrease the possibility of injury to yourself or other team members in the shop due to spills or other preventable hazardous conditions.
  • Effectively manage multiple associates, including ensuring appropriate employee development and performance management.

What the job requires:
To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent
  • Experience using computers
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Demonstrated functional expertise in one or more areas pertaining to Carvana’s reconditioning process
  • Demonstrated understanding of our current reconditioning processes and lean principles
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record (no DUIs and no more than two moving violations in the last 3 years).
  • Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels
  • Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance.
  • Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment.
  • Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to effectively delegate tasks to team members.
  • Ability to communicate and interact with others effectively in a professional, courteous manner.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both written and oral.
  • Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
  • Ability to resolve complex issues with guidance from others.
  • Ability to work overtime and on weekends.
  • Ability to work variable schedule(s) as necessary.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-Time Position with a competitive salary
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • 401K with company match
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy, both physically and mentally
  • Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization
  • A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development
  • A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Legal stuff
Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Software QA Engineer IV
description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.


What We Offer


Salary:

$128,000.00 - $176,000.00

Location:

Billerica,MA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Debugs a wide range of complex software products through the use of systematic tests to develop, apply and maintain quality standards for company products.

  4. Maintains documentation of test results to assist in debugging and modification of software.

  7. Provides feedback in preparation of technical appraisals of programming languages, systems and computation software. Assists in technically leading and/or executing complex software test projects.
  8. Ensures quality computer integration into the overall functions of scientific computation, data acquisition and processing. May track new requirements for the QA division and suggest improvements. Prepares reports on developments for the benefit of the QA manager.

Functional Knowledge

Business Expertise

  • Interprets internal/external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes or services

Leadership

  • May lead functional teams or projects with moderate resource requirements, risk, and/or complexity

Problem Solving

  • Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions

Impact

  • Impacts the achievement of customer, operational, project or service objectives; work is guided by functional policies

Interpersonal Skills

  • Communicates difficult concepts and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view

No

For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

In addition, Applied endeavors to make our careers site accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us via e-mail at Accommodations_Program@amat.com, or by calling our HR Direct Help Line at 877-612-7547, option 1, and following the prompts to speak to an HR Advisor. title: Data Science Intern
description:
As a Data Science Intern, you will do real data science work in support of our mission to discover, inspire, and train the great problem solvers of the next generation. Paired with a data scientist mentor, you will frame questions, build and evaluate models, analyze experiments, and present findings to the teams who act on them.

We hire for data sense, not a specific major. Strong data scientists come from economics, psychology, education, linguistics, and the humanities as well as math and computer science. What matters is that you can work with data in SQL and Python, reason carefully about what it does and does not tell you, and explain what you found.

The Data Science Intern will:

  • Own a scoped data science project from question to recommendation under the guidance of experienced data scientists
  • Use SQL and Python to gather, clean, explore, and validate data
  • Build and evaluate statistical and machine learning models, with attention to their assumptions and limitations
  • Analyze and separate real effects from noise and bias
  • Write reproducible, documented code and participate in code reviews
  • Present findings to the Data team and to stakeholders through clear visualizations and recommendations
  • Use AI tools to accelerate your work while critically evaluating their output
  • Complete other tasks and responsibilities, as assigned

The ideal candidate has:

  • A bachelor's or graduate degree in progress in any field
  • Hands-on experience using Python (e.g. pandas, polars, scikit-learn, matplotlib) and SQL to work with data, through coursework, research, or personal projects
  • Experience in statistics, including hypothesis testing and regression
  • Strong data sense: you ask where data came from, what it leaves out, and whether it actually answers the question
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical results to non-technical audiences and to give and receive constructive feedback

Why Join AoPS:

This is a 40-hour per week paid internship with a pay rate of $30 / hour. The internship will take place in summer 2027 and will be based at our headquarters in San Diego, CA. Most of our interns are with us for 10 - 12 weeks, starting in late May or early June. Here are some things you can look forward to:

  • Impact: Do real data science on questions that shape how the next generation of problem solvers learns
  • Mentorship: Weekly 1:1s with a data scientist mentor
  • Flexibility: Casual work environment with a hybrid work week and flexible scheduling
  • Future Planning: 401K with company match
  • Quality of Life: Paid Sick Leave
  • Ease of Transition: Relocation bonus (if currently located outside of San Diego)

Background Check:

Please note that employment is contingent on the successful completion of a background check.

Work Authorization:

Please note that in order to be considered for this position you must be legally authorized to work in the US. We are unable to offer sponsorship, including STEM-OPT and H-1B.

About AoPS:

Art of Problem Solving (AoPS) is on a mission to discover, inspire, and train the great problem solvers of the next generation. Since 2003, we have trained hundreds of thousands of the country’s top students, including nearly all the members of the US International Math Olympiad team, through our online school, in-person academies, textbooks, and online learning systems. While our primary focus has been math for most of our history, through the years we have expanded our unique problem solving curriculum into more subjects, such as language arts, science, and computer science.

title: Associate Director/Director, Head of DEL Discovery Strategy and Informatics
description:
About Us

Valo Health is a human-centric, AI-enabled biotechnology company working to make new drugs for patients faster. The company’s Opal Computational Platform transforms drug discovery and development through a unique combination of real-world data, AI, human translational models and predictive chemistry.

Our talented team of biologists, chemists and engineers, armed with advanced AI/ML tools, work together to break down traditional R&D silos and accelerate the speed and scale of drug discovery and development.

Valo is committed to hiring diverse talent, prioritizing growth and development, fostering an inclusive environment, and creating opportunities to bring together a group of different experiences, backgrounds, and voices to work together. We embrace new ways of learning, solve complex problems and welcome diverse perspectives that can help us advance patient-centric innovation.

Valo is headquartered in Lexington, MA, with additional offices in New York, NY and Tel Aviv, Israel. To learn more, visit .

The Role

Valo is seeking a Head of DEL, encompassing discovery strategy and selections, DEL chemistry and informatics to advance DNA-encoded library (DEL) technology as a core engine for initiating chemistry efforts across the portfolio. This leader will set the strategy for how DEL is deployed from target assessment and selection design through hit identification, off-DNA validation, and chemistry-start decisions. The role will lead a team DEL team and partner medicinal chemistry, computational chemistry, biology, protein sciences, and data science to turn DEL outputs into high-quality, model-ready data and chemically tractable starting points for the Opal Computational Platform™.

What You’ll Do…

  • Set the strategic roadmap for using DEL as a first-line discovery approach to initiate chemistry campaigns across Valo’s portfolio
  • Lead and develop a team of 4 to 5 scientists spanning DEL informatics, on-DNA chemistry, analysis, and discovery strategy
  • Define DEL deployment strategy, including target tractability, library fit, selection design, controls, counterscreens, and project-start decision criteria
  • Translate DEL selection outputs into actionable chemistry starts through enrichment analysis, hit-family triage, SAR hypotheses, off-DNA validation, and analog prioritization
  • Partner with medicinal chemistry, computational chemistry, biology, protein sciences, in vitro pharmacology and data science to advance DEL-derived hits into validated, chemically tractable series
  • Lead a team to build scalable DEL data workflows that generate high-quality, reusable, model-ready datasets for Opal and AI/ML-driven discovery
  • Scout, evaluate, and apply emerging DEL technologies, including next-generation library design, DNA-compatible chemistry, advanced selection methods, sequencing analytics, and ML-guided interpretation
  • Communicate strategy, tradeoffs, and recommendations to project teams and senior leaders to drive portfolio decisions

What You Bring...

  • PhD in protein sciences, chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, or related field with 8+ years of relevant industry experience for the application of DEL in a drug discovery setting
  • Demonstrated deep expertise in identifying and executing strategies for successful DEL campaigns for a variety of targets, including protein classes which are typically challenging for DEL selections
  • Strong understanding of DEL strategy from library design and selection through data analysis, hit identification, off-DNA validation, and chemistry-start planning
  • Demonstrated track record using DEL-derived data to initiate or advance medicinal chemistry programs and generate validated chemical matter
  • Strong grounding in protein sciences, organic chemistry, on-DNA chemistry, medicinal chemistry principles, cheminformatics, and large experimental datasets
  • Current knowledge of emerging DEL technologies and ability to assess which innovations should be adopted, partnered, or built internally
  • Experience working across AI/ML, data science, computational chemistry, biology, and protein sciences to turn DEL data into predictive insight and project decisions
  • Proven people leadership, cross-functional influence, and ability to communicate strategic recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders

How You Lead at Valo

At Valo, how you lead matters as much as what you deliver. At this level, our four core values show up as:

  • Ownership: Challenges oneself to step out of comfort zone while delegating, to help others grow. Leads cross-functional teams in owning results and failures together, with a solutions mindset. Cares for company resources as one’s own, driving value through best utilization and ROI.
  • Emergence: Builds and supports strong teams with clear direction, enabling structures, and resources. Thinks strategically, encouraging teams to leverage cross-disciplinary data, insights, and perspectives. Builds channels for open two-way communication and exhibits strong skills in facilitating meetings and driving decisions.
  • Humility: Creates a culture where learning from setbacks is normalized and fuels team growth. Encourages constructive debate to sharpen thinking, ensuring challenge leads to better solutions. Leads with humility, creating space for strong ideas to surface over personal views.
  • Impact: Advocates for bold approaches with peers and leadership; makes strategic bets and backs them with resources. Translates innovative ideas into strategic initiatives or programs. Challenges legacy processes, structures, or strategies when misaligned with goals; mobilizes teams and peers around better alternatives.

More on Valo

Valo Health, LLC (“Valo”) is a technology company built to transform the drug discovery and development process using human-centric data and artificial intelligence-driven computation. As a digitally native company, Valo aims to fully integrate human-centric data across the entire drug development life cycle into a single unified architecture, thereby accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing drugs while simultaneously reducing costs, time, and failure rates. The company’s Opal Computational Platform™ is an integrated set of capabilities designed to transform data into valuable insights that may accelerate discoveries and enable Valo to advance a robust pipeline of programs across cardiovascular metabolic renal, oncology, and neurodegenerative diseases. Founded by Flagship Pioneering and headquartered in Lexington, MA. To learn more, visit .

MA Salary Range
$190,000—$210,000 USD

Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. Valo Health currently offers healthcare coverage, annual incentive program, retirement benefits and a broad range of other benefits. Compensation and benefits information is based on Valo Health's good faith estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future.

Please note: At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who currently have permanent US work authorization without the need for immediate or future sponsorship.

title: Senior Associate/Manager, Finance
description:
Who We Are:

Click Therapeutics, Inc., develops, validates, and commercializes software as prescription medical treatments for people with unmet medical needs. As a leading innovator of Digital Therapeutics™, Click delivers accessible, clinically proven, FDA-regulated prescription treatments to the smartphone in your hand. Click’s treatments are defined by a commitment to applying technical and scientific rigor and patient-centric design to the development process. This results in uniquely engaging experiences that achieve compelling clinical outcomes for patients seeking new treatment options. Click Therapeutics continuously expands and refines its platform with novel cognitive, behavioral and neuromodulatory mechanisms of action and advanced data-driven tools such as artificial intelligence and machine learning. The digital therapeutics under development on Click’s platform address diverse areas of therapeutic need, including indications in psychiatry, neurology, oncology, immunology, and cardiometabolic diseases. Consistently named a best place to work, Click fosters an inclusive, diverse workforce of innovators, clinicians, scientists, researchers, designers, technologists, engineers and more, united in a common mission to provide patients everywhere access to safe and effective prescription digital therapeutics. For more information, visit and connect with us on LinkedIn.

About the Role:

Click Therapeutics is seeking a Senior Associate / Manager, Finance to join our Finance team, reporting to the Head of Finance. This is a generalist role at the center of a lean team, combining work like budgeting, reporting, and accounting support with the opportunity to reshape how the work gets done using AI.

Together with Finance leadership, you will help shape our AI transformation and serve as the hands-on builder who brings it to life. We are looking for an AI-native finance professional who can re-architect our processes and systems, automating routine work and embedding AI into how we close the books, forecast, and report. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable tackling complex work like revenue forecasting and rolling up their sleeves on the day-to-day tasks that keep the function running.

This position is based out of Click’s headquarters located in Tribeca, NYC, at the center of one of the fastest-growing digital health communities. We have a hybrid working model that consists of at least 4 days in office each week.

Responsibilities:

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Forecasting & Budgeting: Develop and maintain the company’s budgets, forecasts, and financial models, including revenue forecasting, and keep them current as the business evolves.
  • Management & Board Reporting: Prepare management reporting and contribute to board and investor materials, translating results into clear, actionable insights for leadership.
  • Variance & Performance Analysis: Analyze actuals against budget, identify the drivers behind performance, and flag risks and opportunities early.
  • Business Partnership: Work with leaders across the company to support planning, vendor and spend decisions, and day-to-day financial questions, building scenario analyses as needed to inform strategic and operating decisions.

Accounting & Finance Operations

  • Accounting & Controllership Support: Partner with the Controller and step in as needs arise across the close process, accounts payable, cash, and audit and tax support.
  • Controls & Documentation: Prepare entries and supporting schedules with clear documentation, keeping review and control standards in place as processes evolve.

AI-Enabled Finance Transformation

  • Process Re-Architecture: Partner with Finance leadership to assess existing finance workflows and systems, such as invoice processing and accrual calculations, and redesign them to reduce manual effort and embed AI where it creates meaningful leverage.
  • Design & Implementation: Develop, prototype, and deploy AI-enabled workflows and automations, and bring an independent perspective on the right tools and integrations for our needs.
  • Measurement & Impact: Document solutions, measure their results, and help set the standard for how AI is applied across Finance.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify the next opportunity for improvement, with sound judgment on where automation can be trusted and where human review remains essential.

Qualifications:

At Click, we aren't just looking for talent; we are looking for the next evolution of the modern professional. To us, AI is not a future possibility, it is a present-day prerequisite. We expect every Click colleague to have seamlessly integrated AI into their professional workflow and personal productivity, using it as a force multiplier to move faster, think deeper, and deliver superlative results that were previously out of reach. If you do not yet view AI as an essential partner in your daily pursuit of excellence, you will find it impossible to keep pace with our mission. High performers who harness AI technology to transcend traditional boundaries and set new benchmarks for professional excellence will thrive at Click.

  • AI Fluency: Demonstrated, hands-on fluency with modern AI tools, supported by concrete examples of using them to automate work, strengthen analysis, or redesign a process. Coding or scripting experience (e.g., Python, SQL) is a plus.
  • Experience: 2+ years of corporate finance experience, including financial modeling and forecasting, ideally across more than one finance role or function.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field.
  • Generalist Mindset: Comfortable moving between high-judgment analysis and detailed operational work, with a strong sense of ownership and attention to detail.
  • Systems Thinking: Willing to question established approaches, design better ways of working, and carry ideas through to implementation.
  • Work Style: Self-directed, resourceful, and at ease with ambiguity. Thrives in a fast-paced environment; pragmatic about process, thoughtful about controls.
  • Accounting Foundation: Working knowledge of US GAAP and month-end close mechanics (accruals, prepaids, reconciliations).
  • Communication: Clear and concise communicator who can explain financial and technical concepts to non-finance colleagues.

Click Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of or experience with Digital Therapeutics and/or Prescription Digital Therapeutics is considered a plus
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and modern ERP or accounting systems; CPA.
  • Thrive in a high-velocity startup setting by driving initiatives from 0-to-1 with minimal guidance, adapting quickly to shifting priorities, and optimizing workflows for rapid growth

Compensation:

The base salary range for this position is between $100,000 - $135,000. The final base salary will be dependent upon skills, experience and location. In addition to the base salary, Click Therapeutics offers an annual performance-based cash bonus and a generous equity package.

Benefits:

The role includes great benefits and is an excellent wealth-building opportunity at a fast-growing pre-IPO company in a nascent and extremely exciting space.

Competitive Salary with Annual Review | Cash Bonus | Stock Options | 5% 401(k) matching | Medical | Dental | Vision | Life Insurance | Voluntary Benefits | Unlimited PTO | Uber One | Nectar Rewards | One Medical | Fitness Reimbursement | Bike Membership | Professional Development Stipend | DoorDash Lunches | Parent Benefits | Gemini Enterprise Stack | Claude | Industrious Workspaces | Commuter Subsidies | Flexible Work Arrangement | Sponsored Company Events | Office Snacks and Beverages | Much More…

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Click Therapeutics is committed to equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status. Click Therapeutics also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act. All applicants must have authorization to work for Click Therapeutics in the U.S. In certain circumstances it may be advantageous to Click Therapeutics to support the application(s) for temporary visa classification and/or sponsor applications for permanent residence so that a foreign national colleague can accept or remain in a work assignment in the U. Employment applicants requiring immigration sponsorship must disclose, when initial application for employment is made, whether or not they are legally authorized to work for Click Therapeutics in the U.S. and, if so, whether that authorization permits them to work in the job they seek. In no case should Click Therapeutics support of a colleague's temporary visa application or sponsorship of a colleague for permanent residence be construed to guarantee success of that application or amend or otherwise invalidate the "at-will" employment relationship between the colleague and Click Therapeutics.

title: Center Administrator
description:
Position Summary

The Center Administrator is an entry level operations role that establishes the foundation for future growth within the organization. This role is responsible for the overall operational functions within the center. Duties include cleanliness, maintenance, and facilities needs; ordering and managing supplies for the center; and assisting team members in the center as needed. Individuals in this role will need to provide excellent customer service by consistently demonstrating a professional disposition with all customer and team member relations over the phone and during day-to-day center operations.

Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Day-to-Day Administrative Support
    • Center Administrative Support
      • Open/close center when needed.
      • Greet new and existing clients and other visitors to the center and give tours when necessary.
      • Complete any related administrative tasks such as providing printed materials, etc.
      • Work with Operations Director to maintain center supply inventory and ensure staff has the required items to operate.
      • Ensure the center is clean, attractive, and safe for team members and clients, and report to others as needed.
      • Keep furniture and therapy equipment in good working condition and arrange for repairs and maintenance as needed.
      • Maintain records to ensure compliance with local, state, and federal mandates.
      • Receive deliveries, as needed.
    • Ensure documentation is completed on time and following established Centria procedures.
    • Appropriately report all critical incidents and safety concerns in accordance with payor requirements and Centria's reporting policies.
    • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized environment to effectively work with the client and provide therapy services.
    • Ensure required company postings are displayed in an appropriate area.
  2. Administer effective center operations and facilities management.
    • Partner with the Operations Director to ensure team members adhere to best practices and show up on a timely basis.
    • Partner with Operations Director to ensure effective communication with families and Behavior Technicians.
    • Partner with Operations Director to ensure client and Behavior Technicians schedules are maintained and up to date in Centria EMR system.
    • Be a go-to person for general center-related questions. Able to either answer their questions or connect them with someone who can.
    • Ensure state and Centria guidelines and policies are followed, and incidents documented and escalated to the appropriate parties as necessary.
  3. Maintain compliance and acquire technical knowledge by completing required training and attending meetings. Adhere to Centria's established policies and procedures.
  4. Participate in an agency-wide Compliance Program to ensure services are consistent with the individual's authorized services.
  5. Follow guidelines, i.e., mandated reporting, compliance, and company guidelines.
  6. Compliance with Centria’s Code of Conduct, policies and procedures, and Federal and State laws.
  7. Responsibility to report violations of Company policies or the Code of Conduct.

Rate

$22.00 - $24.00/HR

Qualifications

Education

High School Diploma or equivalent, minimum requirement

Work Experience

Previous experience in a customer service role

Related Training

Attend training and other company in-services and training as directed by the direct leader and compliance teams.

Equipment and Technology Requirements

  • Basic computer skills and working knowledge of tablets/iPads
  • Laptop
  • G Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Google Meet)
  • ABA Platforms, preferred

Other Competency Requirements

  • Ability to follow written instructions
  • Ability to use computers and computer/software programs

Knowledge and Skills

  • Proficiency in PC software, including virtual meeting platforms;
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to do repetitive things in a precise manner with attention to detail and quality;
  • Ability to interpret and implement verbal and written clinical protocols;
  • Ability to accept constructive feedback and develop expertise and skillsets accordingly;
  • Effective time management skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks at once;
  • Ability to build and maintain professional relationships with clients, co-workers, supervisors, and community members;
  • Ability to adhere to organizational policies and procedures
  • Commitment to maintain client confidentiality and adhere to HIPAA laws;
  • Commitment to ongoing training and development as it relates to clinical skills, professional development, ethics, and technology, and training to perform job responsibilities to the required standard;
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with clients, internal and external stakeholders;
  • Strong cultural competency with the ability to remain flexible and open-minded.

Working Conditions

The work location varies on a case-by-case basis and includes a company facility or community.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the team member may be exposed to a client who exhibits physically aggressive behavior, which can include kicking, pinching, punching, biting, hitting, etc. The team member may need to use appropriate behavior management techniques with a client, which requires agility, quick reflexes, strength, the ability to run, utilize approved de-escalation procedures, and the ability to use physically evasive movement. The team member will be required to stand, walk, sit, grasp, reach, bend, kneel, crouch, squat, lift and carry the child, hear, type, see, and write. title: IT Construction Monitoring and Commissioning Inspector
description:
Proconex is the exclusive Emerson Impact Partner for Emerson Automation Solutions in the Mid-Atlantic region. We provide a full portfolio of Process Automation Control Systems, Valves and Control Devices, and related technologies and services to a range of customers—in the Life Sciences, Chemical, Power, Refining, Oil & Gas, Food & Beverage, Paper, Metals, and other industries, as well as commercial enterprises and campus facilities. With three strategically located offices, Proconex maintains a deep dedication to its 200+ employees, a sharp focus on safety and quality, and the drive to deliver.

IT Construction Monitoring and Commissioning Inspector

Job Overview

The IT Construction Monitoring and Commissioning Inspector verifies that IT infrastructure and technical fit-out elements are built, installed, and checked out in accordance with engineering design drawings, project specifications, and quality standards. This role bridges physical construction and IT hardware deployment by conducting daily site inspections, identifying technical deviations early, and resolving installation issues with general contractors and design engineers. The position requires critical thinking, the capacity to anticipate operational issues and propose viable engineering alternatives, and clear, diplomatic communication when negotiating fixes between field contractors and design engineers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct daily on-site inspections to verify that construction matches IT, telecommunications, electrical, and mechanical design drawings.
  • Inspect structural and pathway elements, including fiber conduits, stub-ups, underground piping, cable trays, and equipment racks and cabinets.
  • Monitor supporting infrastructure deployments for compliance, including data center and Intermediate Distribution Frame (IDF) room Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC), cooling distribution, and dedicated IT power systems (Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS), Power Distribution Unit (PDU), and grounding).
  • Audit the physical placement and mounting of IT hardware, including switches, routers, servers, patch panels, and wireless access points (WAPs).
  • Verify copper and fiber structured cabling installations for proper bend radius, support, slack loops, and termination quality.
  • Perform Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) audits on asset tags, cable labels, and port mapping against the approved labeling schema and matrix.
  • Identify field conflicts, design gaps, and contractor deviations from design intent.
  • Lead collaborative problem-solving sessions with general construction contractors and Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) and IT engineering designers to resolve field issues.
  • Issue and track Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and participate in the Request for Information (RFI) process.
  • Monitor field construction progress against the master project schedule, identifying potential bottlenecks and milestone risks.
  • Author daily and weekly progress reports that include photographic evidence, deviation logs, and remediation proposals.
  • Maintain the project punch list from initial rough-in through final IT checkout and owner handover.

This role requires on-site work at active construction sites and the use of required personal protective equipment (PPE).

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in IT infrastructure construction monitoring, telecom project inspection, data center fit-outs, or Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD)-level field representation.
  • 5+ years of experience managing technical fit-outs involving multi-disciplinary coordination (Electrical, HVAC, Low Voltage, Network Engineering).
  • 5+ years of experience reading and interpreting blueprints, architectural drawings, MEP schedules, single-line diagrams, and IT schematic layouts.
  • 5+ years of experience applying Building Industry Consulting Service International (BICSI) standards, National Electrical Code (NEC), and structured cabling practices.
  • 5+ years of experience using construction management software (e.g., Procore, Autodesk Build, PlanGrid) and scheduling tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as BICSI RCDD or BICSI Technician.
  • Certifications such as Certified Technical Inspector (CTI) or relevant Amazon Web Services (AWS) or data center infrastructure credentials.
  • Certifications such as Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 10-Hour or 30-Hour Construction Safety.

We are proud to be an employee-owned organization. Through our ESOP, every team member shares in the growth and success of the company, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and long-term rewards.

  • Identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, to minimize re-work and delays in production.
  • Conscientiously work in ways that decrease the possibility of injury to yourself or other team members in the shop due to spills or other preventable hazardous conditions.
  • Effectively manage multiple associates, including ensuring appropriate employee development and performance management.

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent

  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both written and oral.
  • Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
  • Ability to resolve complex issues with guidance from others.
  • Ability to work overtime and on weekends.
  • Ability to work variable schedule(s) as necessary.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

What we’ll offer in return

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

You will act as a key link between business stakeholders, technical teams, and external suppliers, taking responsibility for the full service lifecycle – from service development and transition to daily operations and continuous optimization.

Key Responsibilities:

Service Lifecycle Management

  • Ensure service documentation is accurate, complete, and up to date.

  • Manage the lifecycle of hardware, software, licenses, warranties, and configuration items (CIs).

  • Maintain accurate service relationships and configuration data within the CMDB.

  • Identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and service improvements.

  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial follow-up.

Service Delivery & Operations

  • Ensure effective management of incidents, problems, changes, and service requests in accordance with agreed SLAs.

  • Coordinate operational teams to secure stable and efficient service delivery.

  • Manage releases, updates, patches, and change processes, including participation in CAB meetings.

  • Drive continuous service improvement and operational excellence.

Service Development & Governance

  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business needs into IT service demands.

  • Support service development initiatives and ensure compliance with service management processes and governance frameworks.

  • Lead service transition activities and ensure smooth handovers from projects to operations.

  • Monitor industry trends, technologies, and best practices relevant to the service portfolio.

Stakeholder & Customer Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with business stakeholders and end users.

  • Lead service review meetings and operational governance forums.

  • Report on service performance, risks, challenges, and improvement initiatives.

  • Ensure continuous improvement of user documentation, knowledge articles, and self-service capabilities.

Supplier & Contract Management

  • Manage external IT suppliers and service providers.

  • Monitor supplier performance, service quality, contractual commitments, and costs.

  • Drive supplier governance and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Ensure compliance with procurement processes and supplier management guidelines.

Requirements:

  • 4–6+ years of experience as a Service Manager or in a similar service ownership role.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) solutions.

  • Proven experience working with IFS Cloud.

  • Experience managing IT service operations, service transitions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Experience in supplier management, contract governance, and vendor coordination.

  • Ability to take ownership, lead initiatives, and independently drive assignments from start to finish.

  • Strong understanding of IT Service Management frameworks, processes, and governance.

Technical & Methodological Skills

  • ITIL and IT Service Management principles.

  • Incident Management.

  • Problem Management.

  • Change Management.

  • Service Request Management.

  • CMDB and IT Asset Management.

  • Understanding of Agile ways of working.

  • Strong technical understanding and the ability to bridge business requirements and IT delivery.

Languages

  • Fluent in Swedish.

  • Full professional proficiency in English.

What We Offer:

  • A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies

  • The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package

  • A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development

  • Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance

  • 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax

  • An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

title: Amenities Attendant
description:
About the role

As an Amenities Attendant, you’ll be the quiet hero of the guest experience. While others see “just bathrooms and facilities”, you know this is where guests decide how clean, comfortable and cared for they feel.

What You'll do

  • Keep guest amenities (bathrooms, showers, laundry and common areas) clean, tidy and well stocked

  • Report maintenance issues promptly to keep everything in safe working order
  • Assist guests with basic queries about facilities and the property

No two days are exactly the same – some days are all about keeping ahead of the rush, others are about the details that make our guests say, “Wow, this place is spotless!”

What you’ll bring

As part of the role requirements, successful candidates will need to hold a current Working With Children Check.

Know you belong
We’re for inclusion, diversity, and representing the members, guests, customers, and communities we serve. title: GRC Staff Engineer
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

The Fivetran information security organization is a motivated and innovative team responsible for ensuring the continuous integrity, confidentiality, and availability of customers’ data. Our customers trust us with all their most sensitive information, and we consider maintaining that trust to be a critical, core component of our product and business. Fivetran is seeking a motivated candidate for a GRC Senior Engineer of the Security Team. The role requires a compliance-focused engineer with knowledge and expertise in building data sets that will be used to turn our compliance into a continuous data-driven function. The position reports to the Director, GRC.
Will build and own a security data lake that aggregates evidence and telemetry from across our environment, and use it to power continuous control monitoring (CCM) that replaces manual control testing with automation. You will also support core GRC operations, including internal and external audits, risk management, and vendor assessments. Acts as a subject matter expert within specific responsibility area(s) and applies internal audit best practices and keeps current with applicable rules and regulations for security compliance frameworks, as well as any authoritative pronouncements issued by relevant governing bodies. Advanced security risk or audit certifications are required and leading cybersecurity certifications are preferred.

This is a full-time position based out of our Oakland office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

Technologies You’ll Use

AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Secureframe, Wiz, GitHub

What You’ll Do

  • You will build and maintain a security data lake on Fivetran itself, using our own platform to centralize the data that powers continuous control monitoring.
  • Govern the lake itself: enforce data quality, retention, least-privilege access, and sensitive-data handling
  • Build compliance-as-code: automated evidence collection, continuous control monitoring, and policy-as-code checks across cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, identity, and SaaS systems
  • Integrate and extend GRC tooling and internal platforms with APIs, scripts, and workflows that replace manual audit work and give real-time visibility into control health
  • Support Fivetran's certifications and attestations: ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 42001, PCI DSS, SOC 2, and HITRUST

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years in GRC, security engineering, data engineering, or a related fieldUnderstanding and ability to perform control testing, documentation, and control design
  • Strong SQL and proficiency in Python (or similar) for automation and data transformation
  • Hands-on experience with a modern data stack (cloud warehouse/lake, ETL/ELT, orchestration, transformation tooling)
  • Experience automating control testing or replacing manual compliance processes with code-driven checks
  • Working knowledge of several of: ISO 27001 family, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HITRUST
  • Familiarity with cloud security controls in [AWS / GCP / Azure] and common SaaS security configurations
  • Ability to translate control language into technical tests, and technical results into audit-ready narratives
  • Clear written communication and comfort working across Security, IT, Engineering, Legal, and Finance

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience in dealing with external audits
  • Professional audit or information security certifications preferred (CISA, CISSP, AWS, SANS GIAC, etc.).
  • An understanding of control frameworks Fivetran follows: SOC 1/2, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, HITRUST, FedRAMP

title: Entry Level Operations Role
description:
Position Summary

The Center Administrator is an entry level operations role that establishes the foundation for future growth within the organization. This role is responsible for the overall operational functions within the center. Duties include cleanliness, maintenance, and facilities needs; ordering and managing supplies for the center; and assisting team members in the center as needed. Individuals in this role will need to provide excellent customer service by consistently demonstrating a professional disposition with all customer and team member relations over the phone and during day-to-day center operations.

Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Day-to-Day Administrative Support
    • Center Administrative Support
      • Open/close center when needed.
      • Greet new and existing clients and other visitors to the center and give tours when necessary.
      • Complete any related administrative tasks such as providing printed materials, etc.
      • Work with Operations Director to maintain center supply inventory and ensure staff has the required items to operate.
      • Ensure the center is clean, attractive, and safe for team members and clients, and report to others as needed.
      • Keep furniture and therapy equipment in good working condition and arrange for repairs and maintenance as needed.
      • Maintain records to ensure compliance with local, state, and federal mandates.
      • Receive deliveries, as needed.
    • Ensure documentation is completed on time and following established Centria procedures.
    • Appropriately report all critical incidents and safety concerns in accordance with payor requirements and Centria's reporting policies.
    • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized environment to effectively work with the client and provide therapy services.
    • Ensure required company postings are displayed in an appropriate area.
  2. Administer effective center operations and facilities management.
    • Partner with the Operations Director to ensure team members adhere to best practices and show up on a timely basis.
    • Partner with Operations Director to ensure effective communication with families and Behavior Technicians.
    • Partner with Operations Director to ensure client and Behavior Technicians schedules are maintained and up to date in Centria EMR system.
    • Be a go-to person for general center-related questions. Able to either answer their questions or connect them with someone who can.
    • Ensure state and Centria guidelines and policies are followed, and incidents documented and escalated to the appropriate parties as necessary.
  3. Maintain compliance and acquire technical knowledge by completing required training and attending meetings. Adhere to Centria's established policies and procedures.
  4. Participate in an agency-wide Compliance Program to ensure services are consistent with the individual's authorized services.
  5. Follow guidelines, i.e., mandated reporting, compliance, and company guidelines.
  6. Compliance with Centria’s Code of Conduct, policies and procedures, and Federal and State laws.
  7. Responsibility to report violations of Company policies or the Code of Conduct.

Rate

$22.00 - $24.00/HR

Qualifications

Education

High School Diploma or equivalent, minimum requirement

Work Experience

Previous experience in a customer service role

Related Training

Attend training and other company in-services and training as directed by the direct leader and compliance teams.

Equipment and Technology Requirements

  • Basic computer skills and working knowledge of tablets/iPads
  • Laptop
  • G Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Google Meet)
  • ABA Platforms, preferred

Other Competency Requirements

  • Ability to follow written instructions
  • Ability to use computers and computer/software programs

Knowledge and Skills

  • Proficiency in PC software, including virtual meeting platforms;
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to do repetitive things in a precise manner with attention to detail and quality;
  • Ability to interpret and implement verbal and written clinical protocols;
  • Ability to accept constructive feedback and develop expertise and skillsets accordingly;
  • Effective time management skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks at once;
  • Ability to build and maintain professional relationships with clients, co-workers, supervisors, and community members;
  • Ability to adhere to organizational policies and procedures
  • Commitment to maintain client confidentiality and adhere to HIPAA laws;
  • Commitment to ongoing training and development as it relates to clinical skills, professional development, ethics, and technology, and training to perform job responsibilities to the required standard;
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with clients, internal and external stakeholders;
  • Strong cultural competency with the ability to remain flexible and open-minded.

Working Conditions

The work location varies on a case-by-case basis and includes a company facility or community.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the team member may be exposed to a client who exhibits physically aggressive behavior, which can include kicking, pinching, punching, biting, hitting, etc. The team member may need to use appropriate behavior management techniques with a client, which requires agility, quick reflexes, strength, the ability to run, utilize approved de-escalation procedures, and the ability to use physically evasive movement. The team member will be required to stand, walk, sit, grasp, reach, bend, kneel, crouch, squat, lift and carry the child, hear, type, see, and write. The team member must be able to push independently, pull, lift, move, and carry objects weighing up to seventy-five (75) pounds.

title: Technician 3, Manufacturing Equipment Maintenance
description:
Western Digital
The next big thing in data is you!
As Equipment Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining specific tools on a media manufacturing production line. The successful candidate will be able to work with minimal supervision, take initiative and collaborate effectively; they will demonstrate a willingness to learn, flexibility, creative problem solving, exemplary communication skills and an ability to think on their feet. Candidates must be flexible to work a 12 hour AWS Shift and overtime, as required by the team.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform preventive maintenance and corrective maintenance on sputter equipment according to maintenance schedules.
  • Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, vacuum, and control system failures.
  • Perform equipment inspections and ensure machines operate within specified performance conditions.
  • Document maintenance activities, equipment failures, and corrective actions in maintenance databases.
  • Provide technical support to junior technicians during troubleshooting and equipment recovery.
  • Support engineers in equipment improvement projects, machine upgrades, and system modifications.
  • Analyze recurring equipment problems and provide improvement suggestions to engineers.
  • Use diagnostic tools such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and measurement instruments for troubleshooting.
  • Ensure maintenance activities comply with safety regulations and cleanroom standards.
  • Support production during equipment recovery to minimize downtime.

REQUIRED:

  • Diploma or Advanced/Higher Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronic, Mechatronics, or Electromechanical Engineering.
  • Minimum 3–6 years of experience in equipment maintenance in manufacturing environment.
  • Experience working with vacuum systems or sputtering equipment is preferred.
  • Ability to interpret electrical schematics and system diagrams.
  • Experience using diagnostic tools such as multimeters and oscilloscopes.
  • Ability to work in 12-hour AWS shift environment.

PREFERRED:

  • Experience in a sputter media or semiconductor manufacturing environment.
  • Knowledge of high-vacuum technology, plasma processes, or thin-film deposition systems.

SKILLS:

  • Strong troubleshooting capability in mechanical, electrical, and control systems.
  • Good understanding of vacuum systems and sputter equipment operation.
  • Ability to guide junior technicians during maintenance activities.
  • Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong teamwork and communication with engineers and cross-functional teams.

title: Maintenance Assistan
description:
About the role

This two-year contract, based on King Island, will see you join the Production and Maintenance team and provide practical support across maintenance, operations, condition monitoring and asset improvement activities. Working alongside experienced technicians, you’ll help keep generation and distribution infrastructure safe, reliable and ready to perform.

Salary from $76,600 plus super and allowances ($21,000 single and $31,000 with dependants)

Benefits

  • A varied, hands-on role supporting essential renewable energy assets.

  • Practical learning alongside experienced generation and maintenance teams.

  • Career development, internal mobility and LinkedIn Learning access.

  • Electricity discount, salary packaging and financial wellbeing support

  • Unique leave options including 15 weeks paid parental leave, Public Holiday Substitution, zero debit Sick Leave and School Holiday Rebate.

  • A unique King Island lifestyle with strong community connection.

We are an endorsed employer for women, for more information on our inclusive policies, procedures and benefits visit Hydro Tasmania group | WORK180 Endorsed Employer.

Key responsibilities

  • Complete basic maintenance, operational tasks and condition monitoring.

  • Support minor repairs, preventative maintenance and functional testing.

  • Assist with refurbishment, upgrade and outage activities.

  • Record work accurately and close maintenance work orders in SAP.

  • Support safe work, environmental compliance and emergency response.

  • Coordinate with contractors, stores and other teams when required.

  • Participate in an after-hours availability roster if required.

More information can be found in the attached Position Description: PD - A&I - Maintenance Assistant - HT2.pdf

Skills& experience

  • Post‑trade qualification and/or high‑risk skills such as rigging/dogging, confined space, first aid, working at heights, truck or chainsaw licence, and experience with scaffolding or crane operations.

  • Experience maintaining industrial electrical or mechanical equipment.

  • Sound workshop practices and a practical approach to problem-solving.

  • Confidence using Microsoft Office and learning work systems such as SAP.

  • A current Australian driver licence.

Living on King Island

King Island offers space to breathe, genuine community connection and a lifestyle shaped by the coast. Located in Bass Strait, it is a short flight from mainland Tasmania and Victoria, while offering a noticeably different pace from city life.

Outside work, rugged coastlines, beaches, farmland and ocean views are part of everyday life. Fishing, surfing, diving, hiking, golf and exploring the island are all close at hand. King Island is also known for premium local produce, including beef, seafood and cheese.

For individuals and families, the island offers a welcoming community, minimal traffic and opportunities to build strong local connections. Relocating to an island is a meaningful lifestyle choice, so we encourage applicants to consider both the professional opportunity and the practical realities of island living.

title: Inspector II
description:
Position Summary:
Responsible for inspection of incoming products and internally manufactured products. Must demonstrate proficiency setting up and operating CMM, MicroVu (multisensor), hand tools, and plate for part inspection. Assist on the shop floor with first piece buy-off, in-process inspection, final inspection, and incoming inspection.

Essential Functions:
  • Working knowledge of GD&T; when and how to use inspection equipment such as micrometers, dial indicators, height gauges, pin gauges, gauge blocks and plate inspection.
  • Assists in creating and updating of inspection procedures, protocols and checklists.
  • Demonstrates ability to setup and measure product using CMM, vision, plate and other hand tools.
  • Coordinates calibration of test equipment and fixtures.
  • Implement and maintain quality requirements and standards (ISO 9001:2015) for the development and manufacture of products.
  • Maintain all quality records and documentation for manufacturing facility in accordance with the quality manual and customer specific requirements.
  • Performs required inspections in accordance with drawing, specifications, standard work and planning requirements.
  • Perform visual, in-process and final dimensional inspections using standard measurement instruments on tightly tolerance materials, components and subassemblies in the production areas.
  • Visual inspection and basic dimensional measurements of incoming materials.
  • Documentation of non-conformances on materials, parts or processes.
  • Reviews supplier paperwork, verifying material pass/fail criteria against engineering inspection requirements.
  • Perform detailed inspections on both Electrical and Mechanical components at the piece part level and sub-assembly level.
  • Must be able to operate ERP, have computer knowledge and the ability to learn new programs.
  • Complies with department ISO 9001 Quality Procedures and Policies.
  • Maintains inspection records and inspection reports.
  • Participate in internal quality audits.
  • Promote and execute quality standards, inspection processes, test methodology, quality plans, documents and reports.
  • Interface with supplier quality representatives concerning problems with quality assurance and assure that effective corrective action is implemented.
  • Serve as primary quality assurance for all manufacturing issues pertaining to the quality of the product from incoming inspection to final inspection of products.
  • Manage and log time worked daily by project/job code, as required.
  • Work towards our goals of 100% On-Time Delivery and 100% Quality.
  • Communicates with co-workers and supervisor to receive instructions and coordinate general work activities.
  • Clean-up of work area, and other areas of the facility as asked adhering to 5S principles.
  • Performs other duties as assigned or needed to better a department or company.

Education and Experience:
  • High School Diploma AND 2 to 4-years inspecting parts in a manufacturing environment.
  • Moderate knowledge of ISO 9001:2015, AS9100, or ISO 13485.
  • Knowledge of Epicor (ERP), preferred.
  • Proficient with Windows and Microsoft Office programs (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.).
  • History of progressive responsibility a plus.

Physical Demands:
  • Stand, walk, push, pull, reach overhead, and bend to the floor frequently, and/or.
  • Exert 20 to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or,
  • Exert 10 to 25 pounds of force frequently, and/or.
  • Exert up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects, and/or.
  • Work with hand and machine tools as well as small parts requires visual acuity and hand/eye coordination, and/or.
  • Exposure to loud manufacturing equipment sounds and smells.

Additional Requirements:
  • Full time position consisting of 40+ hours per week. Normal hours of operation are Monday through Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm; shift work Monday through Friday 7:00am through 3:30pm. This position may require overtime and/or weekend work due to production, rework or customer deadlines. Subject to change shift start and end times.
  • Pre-employment drug and background checks required.

VirTra is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: Consultant Solicitor (Remote)
description:
About Rocket Lawyer
Founded in 2008, we believe everyone deserves to be legally protected. In one seamless experience that combines trusted legal AI and the right attorney for each legal matter, Rocket Lawyer members have always-on access to affordable legal guidance and services they need. To date we’ve helped over 30 million consumers and small businesses get the legal help they need and are now expanding the team in order to bring affordable legal protection to even more.

About Rocket Lawyer

We believe everyone deserves access to affordable and simple legal services. Founded in 2008, Rocket Lawyer is the largest and most widely used online legal service platform in the world. With offices in North America and Europe, Rocket Lawyer has helped over 25 million people create over 50 million legal documents, and get their legal questions answered.

Rocket Lawyer invented and patented the first complete, cloud-based legal service, which is now used by millions of individuals and organisations in the UK & USA to access free legal information, create and manage legal documents, consult with lawyers, resolve disputes and incorporate businesses, at a fraction of the traditional cost of working directly with a law firm.

We are in a unique position to enhance and expand the Rocket Lawyer platform to a scale never seen before in the company's history, to capture audiences worldwide. We are expanding our team to take on this challenge.

About the role

We’re looking to expand the number of consultants we work with to provide legal advice to our business and consumer customers. As a Consultant Lawyer, you will represent Rocket Lawyer's commitment to making high-quality legal services more accessible to small businesses. You will combine strong legal expertise with a pragmatic, client-focused approach, helping entrepreneurs make confident business decisions through clear, commercially minded advice.

We’re particularly interested in people with experience in the following non-contentious areas:

  • Advising start-ups
  • Company law
  • Company registration
  • Shareholders agreements
  • Share transfers and share issues
  • Articles of Association
  • Directors' service contracts
  • Mergers and acquisitions
  • Contract negotiations

We expect that:

  • You’ll work remotely (we’ll send you referrals which you can deal with in your own time and when it suits you).
  • You'll respond to leads in a timely manner (we want to try and minimise the connection times between the lawyer and the client).
  • You’ll be experienced in your area of law with at least 5 years’ PQE (we need lawyers of all levels).
  • You hold a valid England and Wales solicitor’s practising certificate.
  • You'll be familiar with basic levels of IT and technology (such as virtual conferencing and Google Suite).
  • You'll support our mission of providing simple and affordable legal services.

What makes you successful in this role:

  • You build trust with clients.
  • You communicate complex legal concepts in layman terms
  • You balance legal accuracy with commercial awareness
  • You are responsive and comfortable managing your own caseload
  • You enjoy working on a technology-enabled, fast-moving environment
  • You take ownership of the client experience from first contact through completion

What we’re not:

  • A traditional law firm. Rocket Lawyer is modernizing the way legal services are delivered, increasingly automating legal advice and building a large scale platform for a network of lawyers to work with small business and consumers online to provide affordable legal advice.
  • We can’t advise on Reserved Legal Activities or immigration matters.

What you can expect from working with Rocket Lawyer:

You'll become part of one of the world's largest online legal platforms, working with a modern legal model that combines technology, automation and experienced solicitors to deliver accessible legal support at scale.

  • You'll work under Rocket Lawyer's Professional Indemnity Insurance.
  • We'll provide backend technical support and administration (we help collect KYC and AML documents).
  • Unlimited access to the Rocket Lawyer website and our library of documents.

Essentially, if you want to work remotely when it suits you, Rocket Lawyer has the work, the back office functionality, and the insurance.

You can also service your existing clients via our insurance and back office.

By applying for this position, your data will be processed as per Rocket Lawyer Privacy Policy.

title: Arkkitehti korjausrakentamisen projektipäälliköksi
description:
Tervetuloa töihin ennakkoluulottomaan rakentamisen ja rakennetun ympäristön suunnittelu- ja konsulttitoimistoon! A-Insinööreissä luomme kulttuuria, jossa asiantuntijamme ja asiakkaamme voivat onnistua yhdessä. Tarjoamme ison yrityksen edut, mutta pienen talon mutkattomuuden innostavassa, palkitussa työyhteisössä.

Haemme nyt
Arkkitehtia korjausrakentamisen projektipäälliköksi Espooseen

Tule rakentamaan kanssamme rohkeasti parempaa! Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden erottautua massasta, tule työkaveriksemme ja pääset mukaan vahvistamaan korjausrakentamisen toimialamme yksikköä Etelä-Suomen alueella konsernimme muiden suunnittelupalveluiden vahvalla tuella. Etsimme osaavia ihmisiä ratkaisemaan korjausrakentamisen haasteita kiinnostavissa projekteissa, kasvavassa ja kehityshaluisessa työyhteisössä.

Korjausrakentamisen arkkitehtisuunnittelun projektipäällikkönä työskentelet monipuolisissa korjausrakentamisen suunnittelutehtävissä tiiviissä yhteistyössä sisäisten ja ulkoisten sidosryhmien kanssa.

Kokeneena suunnittelijana vastaat itsenäisesti vaativista arkkitehtisuunnittelun tehtävistä muun henkilöstömme tuella ja johdat vahvasti omaa työtäsi. Suunnitteluprojektimme ovat monipuolisia ja tarjoamme mahdollisuuden päästä mukaan pääkaupunkiseudun mielenkiintoisiin hankkeisiin.

Projektipäällikkönä johdat lisäksi projektin tiimiä, järjestelmällisyydelläsi pystyt pitämään hankkeen langat käsissäsi. Osallistut myös projektien tarjous- ja sopimustoimintaan.

Kuulemme mielellämme millaista osaamista ja kokemusta toisit mukanasi, huomioimme toiveesi ja pääset mukaan monipuolisiin korjaus- ja laajennussuunnitteluhankkeisiin. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä sekä ottaa haltuun erilaisia vastuualueita oman kyvyn ja kiinnostuksen mukaan, tarkempi tehtäväkuvaus räätälöidään sinulle sopivaksi.

Tehtävän nimetty toimipiste on Espoo, osittaisin etätyömahdollisuuksin. Kohteet sijaitsevat Etelä-Suomen alueella ja satunnaisesti kohteet voivat sijaita kauempana.

Tehtävässä onnistumiseen tarvitset uteliasta mieltä, tarkkuutta ja halua osoittaa asiantuntemustasi sekä kehittyä. Toivomme sinulta rohkeutta tuoda osaamisesi esille, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja itsenäistä työotetta, tiimityöasennetta unohtamatta.

Arvoihimme kuuluvat kestävät työntekijäsuhteet ja osaamisen jatkuva kehittyminen. Jos ”ihan jees” on sinulle kirosana ja uusimpien teknologioiden käyttäminen asiakkaan hyväksi intohimo, hae meille! Saatat hyvinkin olla A-Insinööri, vaikket itse vielä tietäisikään sitä.

Edellytämme sinulta arkkitehdin tai rakennusarkkitehdin tutkintoa ja aikaisempaa työkokemusta projektipäällikön tehtävistä. Toivomme, että sinulla on ymmärrystä vanhoista rakenteista ja rakennusmateriaaleista sekä vähintään viiden vuoden kokemus korjausrakentamisen tietomallipohjaisesta arkkitehtisuunnittelusta. Eduksi katsomme pääsuunnittelijan pätevyyden sekä rakennuttamisen pätevyydet tai edellytykset niiden hakemiseen.

Satsaamme sinuun ja työyhteisöösi
Haluamme, että ihmisemme voivat kehittyä osaajina omannäköisellään tavalla. Saat ympärillesi osaavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön sekä laajan asiantuntijaverkoston, jonka kanssa pääset ratkaisemaan vaativia suunnitteluhaasteita.

Tarjoamme sinulle joustavat työskentelytavat, monipuoliset henkilöstöedut sekä ison yrityksen mahdollisuudet työyhteisössä, joka kuuluu työntekijöidensä arvioimana Suomen innostavimpiin ja tekniikan alan ammattilaisten silmissä alan vetovoimaisimpiin työnantajiin (Innostavimmat 2026 ja Universum 2026).

Kiinnostuitko?
Jätä meille CV:si ja vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi 2.12.2026 mennessä osoitteessa .

Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, joten suosittelemme hakemaan tehtävää mahdollisimman pian. Tietoturvasyistä emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä sinulle antaa:
Yksikönjohtaja Seppo Raiski, seppo.raiski@ains.fi tai 0400 422 591
Varayksikönjohtaja Tuomas Koski-Lammi, Tuomas.Koski-Lammi@ains.fi tai 040 6700 131.

A-Insinöörit - ihmisiä, joiden kanssa rakennat rohkeasti parempaa. Tutustu meihin ja rakennuttamisen, arkkitehtisuunnittelun, rakennesuunnittelun, korjaussuunnittelun, teollisuus- ja talotekniikka sekä yhdyskunta- ja ympäristösuunnittelun toimialoihimme .
