title: Sr. People Business Partner Director, GTM
location: Boston, Massachusetts, United States; Remote, US; Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: Washington, D.C Metro, Boston, MA or Remote, US - Eastern, Central U.S. timezones
Travel: Up to 25%, domestic or international
Job ID: 1956

The Role:

We are seeking a Sr. PBP Director, GTM to lead People Business Partner support for IonQ's global Go-To-Market organization.

This leader will serve as the primary People partner to the global GTM organization, including the Chief Business Officer and their leadership team, working closely across sales, marketing, customer success, field engineering, revenue operations, and other commercial functions to translate business priorities into people and organizational strategies that drive growth and performance.

This is a highly visible, hands-on role at a pivotal moment for IonQ's commercial growth. You'll play a central role in scaling a high-performing sales and GTM culture, elevating the talent and organizational foundations this fast-growing, geographically distributed team needs, and proving out a PBP model that can expand as the org does.

The ideal candidate combines strong business and sales HR acumen and executive presence with a pragmatic, roll-up-your-sleeves approach. They will enjoy operating the fast moving and “bias to action” culture of GTM, and be a true business partner. They’re a highly collaborative driver with a firm and flexible point of view on how to accelerate the business via strategic and operationally excellent people solutions.

Responsibilities:

Partner with the Business

  • Serve as the senior People advisor to GTM leadership, building trusted relationships and providing counsel on organizational effectiveness, talent, workforce planning, leadership, and culture.
  • Translate GTM's commercial strategy and revenue priorities into practical people strategies that support pipeline growth, sales productivity, and go-to-market execution.
  • Build a deep understanding of IonQ's commercial motion — sales segments, quota structures, territory design, and buyer landscape — to proactively identify organizational opportunities and risks.
  • Coach senior leaders through complex organizational, talent, performance, and leadership decisions.

Build the PBP Function for GTM

  • Design a PBP model and coverage plan appropriate to a fast-growing, quota-carrying commercial organization, with a clear point of view on when and how to add headcount as the org grows.
  • Partner with Sales Compensation and Total Rewards so GTM's comp and rewards programs - plan design, quota-setting support, leveling and offer governance - are fit for purpose in a fast-growing commercial organization.
  • Act as the voice of the business with Talent Acquisition on GTM hiring: translate the growth plan into a workforce plan and role requirements, hold hiring managers to a consistent bar and a disciplined process, and feed quality-of-hire and ramp signals back into the profiles we recruit against.
  • Partner with managers and enable onboarding and ramp, with a point of view on what's driving time to full productivity and what needs to change.
  • Serve as execution partner for enterprise-wide People practices across GTM - performance management cycle, annual compensation review, and engagement survey cycle.
  • As the team expands, hire, develop, and set clear priorities and performance expectations for the PBPs who join.

Lead Organization Design & Change

  • Lead organizational design initiatives across GTM, including territory and coverage models, team structures, leadership accountabilities, and workforce planning.
  • Guide leaders and the organization through growth, restructuring, and evolving go-to-market priorities.
  • Balance enterprise-wide consistency with the unique needs of a commercial, revenue-driven organization.

Drive Talent & Organizational Performance

  • Own talent outcomes across GTM, with particular focus on seller retention, ramp-time, succession, leadership effectiveness, and performance.
  • Build robust talent and succession plans, identify capability gaps across the sales leadership bench, and partner with leaders to strengthen it.
  • Coach leaders on performance management, feedback, seller development, and difficult people decisions, including performance-based exits common in a quota-driven environment.
  • Use people and sales performance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and translate them into action.
  • Strengthen employee engagement, organizational health, and a high-performance culture aligned with IonQ's values.

Requirements:

  • 12+ years of progressive HR/People experience, including significant senior HR Business Partner leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated experience partnering directly with senior sales, marketing, or commercial leadership teams.
  • Hands-on involvement in annual comp planning alongside Finance and Sales Ops, including quota setting and plan changes.
  • Experience supporting quota-carrying, revenue-focused, or commercial/GTM organizations.
  • Experience supporting a business through significant commercial scaling, market expansion, or transformation, including acquisition integration.
  • Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to connect people strategy directly to revenue and commercial outcomes.
  • Proven expertise in organizational design, talent management, succession planning, leadership coaching, and change management.
  • Experience operating as a function of one or close to it, including a clear point of view on prioritization and what you deliberately chose not to do.
  • Strong executive presence, judgment, and the ability to influence and challenge senior leaders constructively.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, ambiguous, high-growth environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience building a PBP or HRBP function from the ground up, including a track record of scaling from individual contributor to team leader.
  • Experience supporting global or internationally distributed sales organizations (EMEA, public sector/federal, or emerging markets).
  • Experience with sales compensation design, territory planning, or quota methodology.
  • Experience working within a high-growth technology or deep-tech company.

What Success Looks Like:

Within the first 6–12 months, this leader will have:

  • Established themselves as a trusted, high-impact partner to GTM leadership.
  • Proven the value of dedicated PBP support for GTM, building the case (and the plan) for additional PBP headcount as the org scales.
  • Created greater clarity around GTM's organizational structure, leadership accountabilities, and critical talent.
  • Strengthened succession and talent plans across the sales and GTM leadership bench.
  • Delivered measurable progress on seller retention, ramp-time, engagement, and leadership effectiveness.
  • Partnered effectively with Sales Compensation and Total Rewards to ensure GTM's comp and incentive programs support desired seller behavior.
  • Accelerated cultural alignment and adoption of IonQ's values and ways of working across a fast-scaling commercial team.

The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity, and a range of benefit options found on our career site.

If this role has a commission structure, the compensation range below just reflects the base compensation range.

Wage Transparency:
$176,000—$220,000 USD

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

title: Digital Design Director
description:
The Role

You are equal parts designer and leader. You understand creativity and practicality. You lead and inspire the development of exceptional UX and UI, bringing brand ideas to life across digital experiences. You manage up and down. You navigate all of these dualities to deliver exceptional digital experiences.

Your Responsibilities

  1. You identify, curate and refine great digital experiences in collaboration with the Creative Director. You know how to realise and frame them expertly. You encourage and nurture all of this in your team, teaching them to do the same.

  2. You spend your time leading and designing in equal parts. You champion exceptional development and delivery of UX and UI work across brand and pure digital projects. You do whatever is required practically or creatively to make them a reality. You can direct animators and developers to produce outstanding digital work.

  3. You collaborate intimately with the team around you, mentoring wherever possible. You manage both up and down acting as the conduit between Creative Director and Designers.

  4. You can build strong narratives, construct presentations and lead workshops with the client, continuing the dialogue around the work with them beyond the presentation.

  5. You collaborate intimately with the strategy and brand teams to ensure all UX and UI feels aligned with the original vision.

  6. You demonstrate an exceptional understanding of branding and the digital applications within it. You assist in scoping new digital projects and help recommend appropriate partners and suppliers. You consistently deliver work for the most impactful companies of today and the founders defining tomorrow.

  7. You demonstrate ownership of your role and can both take and action feedback from your manager to progress within it. You can deliver actionable feedback and valuable support for any member of your team.

  8. You have a strong awareness of the time and team required to produce excellent work. You are able to successfully manage your own time, your team’s time, calendars and meetings to deliver work within scope.

  9. You have a willingness to work in person in our Sydney studio and are open to travel globally, from Shanghai to San Francisco.

  10. You have a great understanding of HTML, Javascript, Figma, Illustrator and Pitch. Experience with Webflow and/or Framer is also an advantage.

  11. You're optimistic and curious about AI: you explore new tools and pick the right ones to elevate projects.

Our Responsibilities

  1. We will ensure you have meaningful and regular access to your manager to support your personal development and career trajectory.

  2. We will actively reward performance with promotions, pay increases and a discretionary annual bonus of up to 10% of salary to all employees.

  3. We ensure Koto is an equal environment for all its employees regardless of race, gender, age, or sexual preference.

  4. We will support you in taking family leave and offer significant paid maternity and paternity.

  5. We will actively encourage you to take 25 days holiday yearly, in addition to NSW public holidays, one additional holiday day per year (capped at 5 additional days), and a studio closure between Christmas and New Year.

  6. We will contribute to anyone wanting to engage in a pension scheme, appropriate to your location.

  7. We deploy a monthly ‘employee wellness’ benefits package via Juno of $140 per month.

  8. We offer access to YCN and fund relevant training opportunities to any employee looking to develop themselves and career.

  9. We reward five years of service with $5,000 and five days holiday. We reward ten years of service with $10,000 and four weeks holiday. (Note: Final Reward program to be confirmed for Sydney.)

Our Culture

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Solutions Engineer, Pre-Sales

Customer Solutions Group | North America

GrowthLoop is on a mission to help marketing teams activate their data with speed and precision. As a Solutions Engineer, you'll play a critical role in driving GrowthLoop’s expansion by partnering closely with the sales team to bring our Compound Marketing Engine to life for prospective clients. You’ll bridge the gap between product and customer, helping marketers and technical stakeholders - including data engineers, analytics teams, and IT - realize the power of activating data from the data cloud to drive real business outcomes. Your ability to navigate both business and technical conversations will be key to unlocking value for complex, data-savvy organizations.

You’re comfortable speaking with confidence in a sales environment, leading demos, and answering product and technology-related questions. You have a strong understanding of Customer Data, Marketing Technology, Data Warehouses like BigQuery and Snowflake, Marketing KPIs, and Marketing Channels.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Account Executives from discovery through close to qualify technical fit, shape account strategy, and guide customer evaluations.
  • Lead discovery with marketing and data teams to understand how they store customer data, build audiences, run campaigns, and measure results.
  • Create tailored demos, prototypes, and proofs of value with clear success criteria that show how GrowthLoop fits into each prospect’s data and marketing stack.
  • Serve as the primary technical contact during evaluations, explaining architecture, integrations, and tradeoffs to both data teams and marketing leaders.
  • Work with Account Executives on pricing and scope when technical requirements affect the proposed solution.
  • Document requirements and open questions, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate with Product and Engineering to keep evaluations moving.
  • Answer competitive questions using your knowledge of CDPs, data warehouses, identity resolution, AI in marketing, and cross-channel activation.
  • Bring recurring customer pain points and product feedback to the teams that can act on them.
  • Travel for customer meetings when being there will meaningfully help an opportunity.

What We Look For

  • 3+ years in sales engineering or technical presales, supporting complex B2B SaaS sales cycles from discovery through technical evaluation.
  • Experience supporting evaluations for enterprise data or marketing platforms, including how audiences are built from warehouse data and activated through downstream integrations.
  • Working knowledge of Snowflake or BigQuery, how customer data flows through a modern data stack, and where LLMs can add value in marketing workflows.
  • An understanding of how marketing teams choose audiences, messages, offers, and channels, and how they measure whether a campaign worked.
  • Familiarity with experimentation and incremental lift, including why a high response rate does not necessarily mean a campaign changed customer behavior.
  • Experience explaining technical concepts to both data teams and marketing leaders, adapting your approach to what each audience needs to decide.
  • Strong judgment in complex sales cycles. You can prioritize technical questions, communicate what still needs validation, and work across teams to keep an evaluation moving.
  • Direct experience in marketing, marketing operations, or marketing strategy is a plus

About GrowthLoop

GrowthLoop built the first composable CDP, helping marketers leverage live, first-party data from their cloud warehouse to launch highly targeted campaigns. That composable foundation gave way to the Compound Marketing Engine, an evolution of the composable CDP that drives compound growth by using agentic AI to accelerate the marketing cycle.

Now, we’re building what comes next: an agentic system that uses causality data to find the actions that actually improve customer outcomes and gets smarter with every campaign cycle.

Founder-led, we’re partnering with the world’s most innovative brands to close the loop between people, data, and AI. Enterprise marketing teams at Google, Costco, Ford, and Whirlpool (to name a few) choose GrowthLoop to launch smarter, more personalized marketing programs that compound growth with every campaign.

What We Offer

The on-target earnings range for this role is USD $180,000–$200,000 or CAD $260,000–$280,000.Total compensation includes equity. Final base salary decisions will be based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors unique to each candidate, such as the individual’s skill set, location, depth of experience, and qualifications.

Rewards

  • See your work impact some of the most important businesses in the world, including Google, Priceline, and Indeed.
  • Spot bonuses for major milestones and product feature graduations
  • Opportunities for career progression and dynamic collaboration across teams
  • Equity incentives for employees making an impact

Flexible Work Style

  • Remote-First Culture
  • Flexible schedules and goal-based work style
  • Unbounded PTO
  • Monthly Recharge Days

Competitive Benefits

  • Free Platinum Health Insurance with Aetna
  • 401(k) Program with Generous Company Match

Learn and Grow

  • Quarterly Hackathons to focus on team passion projects
  • Education Stipend towards your professional development
  • Work closely with our world-class executive team
  • Learners’ mindset culture

GrowthLoop is an Equal Opportunity Employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Enterprise Applied AI Engineer
description:
Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. We have a lab, and we also power our own models in our own proprietary inference environment. Our models serve 500M+ inference calls monthly, and process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for the best talent we can find to join a rapidly scaling team that's defining the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - and are rapidly approaching $1M ARR per employee. We sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. We have thousands of customers building with us including the top startups and world-renowned enterprises, and are serving at tremendous scale: we process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily and handle more than 15 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven, the revenue is durable, and the growth trajectory is steep and getting steeper. We have a super flat culture and expect our employees to be deeply intimate with the details at all levels.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

About the role

We're building out our Enterprise go-to-market team, and we're hiring our first Applied AI Engineers dedicated solely to enterprise deals. You'll be the technical counterpart to our Enterprise Account Executives on a focused set of strategic accounts: large companies bringing voice AI into products and operations used by millions of people.

You'll go deep into each customer's technical organization, earn trust from the developers up to the CTO, and run evaluations rigorous enough to stand up to world-class data science teams and developers. Working collaboratively with Enterprise AEs, you'll own the technical path to vendor selection.

What you'll do

  • Act as the technical lead on strategic enterprise deals, from discovery through vendor selection and production rollout
  • Map and multi-thread the customer's technical organization (developers, data science and evaluation teams, platform, security), building champions at each level
  • Design and run evaluations with customers: agree on success criteria, test sets, and metrics up front, and correct flawed methodology before it shapes the outcome
  • Present evaluation results and technical recommendations to engineering leaders and executives
  • Advise on architecture, deployment options, scaling, concurrency, data privacy, and compliance
  • Lead the technical side of security reviews, RFPs, and questionnaires, running in parallel with your AE's commercial and legal track
  • Build proofs of concept and production pilots on the customer's stack, and support A/B tests in production
  • Work onsite with customers for workshops, evaluation reviews, and implementation planning
  • Partner with Research and Engineering on enterprise requirements, and bring the enterprise voice of the customer into the roadmap
  • Hand off cleanly to our post-sale Forward Deployed Engineers once AssemblyAI is selected, and stay close through launch
  • Help build the enterprise technical playbook: evaluation frameworks, reference architectures, and templates the team can reuse

What you'll need

  • Significant experience in an enterprise customer-facing technical role
  • A strong track record of closing enterprise business as the technical counterpart in the sales cycle
  • Experience leading multi-month technical evaluations with large organizations and many stakeholders
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript, and the ability to read and debug code in other languages
  • Fluency in ML evaluation: metrics, test set design, and what makes a benchmark fair
  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), enterprise security and compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR), and data residency
  • Excellent communication with every audience, from a developer debugging a WebSocket to a CTO deciding on a vendor
  • Comfort with real-time streaming APIs, WebSockets, and audio fundamentals
  • Fluency with AI tools like Claude or Cursor
  • The autonomy and judgment to run your own accounts with little oversight
  • Must be based in San Francisco, New York City, or London, with an expectation of 3 days a week in-office attendance
  • Willing to travel roughly 25–40% of the time for customer onsites, events, and team offsites

Nice to have

  • Experience with speech, audio, or voice AI products
  • Experience selling into contact center, healthcare, or other regulated industries
  • Experience at a high-growth startup or API-first infrastructure company
  • Public speaking or conference experience

Pay transparency

AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity across our team. Our salary ranges are set to be competitive for our size, stage, and industry, and reflect just one component of the full compensation, benefits, and rewards we offer.

Salary determinations consider a variety of factors, including relevant experience, technical depth, skills demonstrated during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below represents a general expectation for the posted position. However, we are open to considering candidates who may fall above or below the outlined experience level—in those cases, we will communicate any adjustments to the expected salary range.

The range provided applies to candidates located in the United States and London, UK. For candidates outside of these locations, compensation ranges may differ; any adjustments will be communicated throughout the interview process.

Salary range (US): $240,000 – $300,000 OTE

Salary range (London): £145,000 – £175,000 OTE

The expected total compensation for this role is listed above (including base salary and variable pay). Our total compensation package includes competitive equity grants, 100% employer-paid benefits, and working alongside the team in our San Francisco, New York City or London office. A 401k match up to 4% is offered to all US-based full time team members.

Using AI in your interview
If you’re selected for an interview, please read our Candidate AI Guidance. It explains how you can use AI at each stage of our process, from your application and take-home to the interviews themselves.

GDPR privacy notice
If you’re applying from the EU or UK, please review our Job Applicant Privacy Notice before applying.

title: Senior Projektledare – ERP & Business Applications
description:
Led komplexa implementationer och transformationer inom ERP och Business Applications. Driv förändring i gränslandet mellan verksamhet, processer och IT, med särskilt fokus på Microsoft Dynamics 365 och SAP.

Låter det inspirerande att få vara en del av en mindre verksamhet inom en global koncern med möjlighet att arbeta med talangfulla kollegor som brinner för ledarskap? Då kan vi på Chief i Stockholm ha konsultrollen för dig. Hos oss blir du en del av Chief och är med och skapar något unikt inom ledarskap och konsultverksamhet!

Om rollen

Som Senior Projektledare inom ERP & Business Applications på Chief har du en central roll i våra kunders digitala transformationsresor. Du leder initiativ kopplade till införande, utveckling och modernisering av affärssystem och verksamhetskritiska plattformar, där Microsoft Dynamics 365 och SAP är särskilt relevanta.

Uppdragen kan omfatta allt från större ERP- och CRM-implementationer till uppgraderingar, migreringar, globala utrullningar och verksamhetstransformationer. Du arbetar nära både verksamhet och IT och säkerställer att processer, teknik och organisation utvecklas tillsammans.

Beroende på uppdrag kan du arbeta som exempelvis projektledare, programledare, ERP Lead eller Transformation Lead, med ansvar för hela eller delar av transformationen.

Exempel på vad du gör i rollen:

  • Leder komplexa implementationer och transformationer inom ERP, CRM och Business Applications

  • Driver initiativ kopplade till exempelvis Microsoft Dynamics 365 eller SAP

  • Leder och koordinerar tvärfunktionella team inom verksamhet, IT och externa leverantörer

  • Säkerställer framdrift mellan olika delar av programmet, exempelvis process, data, integration, test och implementation

  • Ansvarar för projektplanering, budget, riskhantering, resursplanering och styrning

  • Driver dialog och beslutsfattande tillsammans med styrgrupper, verksamhetsledning och andra nyckelintressenter

  • Koordinerar implementationspartners och andra externa leverantörer

  • Säkerställer verksamhetsförankring och bidrar till förändringsledning och användaradoption

  • Följer upp leverans, effekter och affärsnytta

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är en trygg och erfaren ledare med förmåga att skapa struktur och framdrift i komplexa miljöer. Du förstår att en ERP- eller CRM-transformation handlar om betydligt mer än teknik och trivs i gränslandet mellan verksamhetsprocesser, organisation och IT.

Du är van att hantera många intressenter och beroenden och kan kommunicera med såväl specialister och projektteam som verksamhetsledning och styrgrupper.

Du är konsultmässig i ditt arbetssätt: lyhörd, lösningsorienterad och affärsmässig, med förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya verksamheter och bygga förtroende hos kunden.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Relevant högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet

  • 8 års erfarenhet av projekt- eller programledning inom IT, ERP, CRM eller verksamhetstransformation

  • Erfarenhet av att leda större implementationer, transformationer eller förändringsinitiativ inom ERP och/eller CRM

  • Erfarenhet av Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP eller motsvarande större affärssystem/Business Applications-plattform

  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta i komplexa organisationer med många intressenter och beroenden

  • Erfarenhet av budget, riskhantering, resursplanering och projektstyrning

  • Förmåga att arbeta i gränslandet mellan verksamhet, IT och externa leverantörer

  • Flytande svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift

Meriterande är om du även har erfarenhet av:

  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance, Supply Chain Management och/eller CRM/Customer Engagement

  • SAP S/4HANA eller andra delar av SAP-ekosystemet

  • Större internationella eller globala ERP- och CRM-program

  • Verksamhetsprocesser inom exempelvis Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, Sales eller Customer Service

  • Förändringsledning, business readiness och användaradoption

  • Data migration, integration, test eller cutover i samband med större implementationer

  • Integration mellan ERP, CRM och andra verksamhetskritiska system

  • Upphandling och styrning av implementationspartners och externa leverantörer

  • Agila, traditionella eller hybrida leveransmodeller

  • Relevant certifiering inom exempelvis projektledning, SAP eller Microsoft Dynamics 365

Vilka är Chief?

Chief är en ledande aktör i konsultbranschen med en stark familjär kultur där teknik och ledarskap möts. Hos oss får du en personlig och utvecklande miljö där karriärresa och ledarskap står i centrum, med möjligheterna som följer med att vara en del av en global koncern då Chief är en division inom Alten Group.

Våra uppdrag finns inom flera branscher, exempelvis retail, industri, bank/finans, energi, life science, fordon, försvar och offentlig sektor, vilket ger dig möjlighet att arbeta i olika typer av organisationer och transformationsresor.

Vad erbjuder vi?

  • Gemenskap & utveckling: Vi investerar i dig och din utveckling genom branschöverskridande och spännande kunduppdrag, mentorskapsprogram, Chief Academy, möjlighet till certifiering samt andra interna initiativ som stärker både din kompetens och ditt ledarskap.

  • Större möjligheter: Lokalt engagemang kombinerat med ett globalt nätverk genom vår koncern Alten Group, karriärvägar och spännande uppdrag, utan att kompromissa med den familjära känslan.

  • Trygg anställning: Hos oss får du en kollektivavtalad anställning med konkurrenskraftig lön, friskvårdsbidrag, utbildningsbudget med mera.

Skicka in din ansökan med CV redan idag. Intervjuer och återkoppling sker löpande.

Vill du veta mer om Chief och rollen? Kontakta oss eller läs mer på vår karriärhemsida!

• Je beoordeelt de huidige stand van zaken ten opzichte van de geldende IFS- en BRC-eisen en brengt eventuele tekortkomingen in kaart

  • Je bewaakt de voortgang van openstaande acties, stelt prioriteiten en schakelt tijdig met betrokken collega's
  • Je controleert of procedures, registraties, verificaties en overige auditdocumentatie volledig en actueel zijn
  • Je ondersteunt de verschillende afdelingen bij het oplossen van verbeterpunten en bereidt medewerkers voor op de audit
  • Je adviseert het Quality-team en management over voedselveiligheid, kwaliteitssystemen en auditvereisten

  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met IFS- en/of BRC-certificering binnen de voedingsmiddelenindustrie
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het zelfstandig voorbereiden en begeleiden van externe certificeringsaudits
  • Je beschikt over gedegen kennis van voedselveiligheid, kwaliteitssystemen en auditmanagement
  • Je hebt ervaring binnen een productieomgeving in de voedingsmiddelenindustrie

  • You will be working in an ambitious and enthusiastic team

  • Additional week bonus paid at Christmas after 1 years’ service
  • Company car, phone and laptop
  • Working in an international environment with lots of opportunities.

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for a position in which you can set direction and help shape our company? If so, then you could be the newest addition to our team as Finance Business Partner.

Be part of the movement – and play your part

About the role

DFDS operates through two divisions – Logistics and Ferry. In this role, you will join the central Business Finance team for the Logistics Division and take part in how financial performance is measured, steered, and improved across a rapidly growing European logistics business. You will report to the Head of Central Business Finance Logistics, who reports to the Divisional CFO Logistics.

The central Business Finance team holds ownership of all core financial planning, reporting, functional finance, and commercial support activities of the Logistics Division. You will join a team of four Finance Business Partners in Copenhagen and two Business Analysts in our Shared Service Center in Poznan.

Within the team, you will take responsibilities in:

  • Driving the divisional monthly- and quarterly performance cycle, incl. reporting and budgeting

  • Driving improvement initiatives for the reporting framework, automation and data quality

  • Engaging in improvement initiatives in the data models, and planning frameworks relevant to the performance cycle

  • Supporting the adoption of new KPI frameworks and models for risk assessment to the performance outlook

  • Supporting financial insight and decision material to senior stakeholders in central functions

  • Financial processes, data models and analytical tooling incl. usage of EPM, BI and AI tools

Further, you will work closely with the Group FP&A team and the Senior Finance Business Partners across business units to ensure aligned financial processes, shared standards, and timely reporting.

Your role will be hands on, performing reporting- and analytical activities, together with a team that sits at the centre of the division’s performance agenda.

You will be based at our headquarters in Copenhagen and join a driven and dedicated Business Finance team where colleagues work closely together, support each other, and take pride in driving clarity and impact for the business. The division has more than tripled in size in recent years, and the business finance function is at the core of driving performance in this setting.

About you

You thrive in a role that combines the recurrent periodic reporting activities with hands-on analytical work, contributing to the strategic direction for the division. With this in mind, we imagine that the ideal candidate brings:

  • +2 years of experience within FP&A or Business Finance, preferably from large, international, or complex organisations

  • Understanding of financial processes, planning cycles, P&L, balance sheet and cash flow

  • Strong analytical skills and structured problem solving abilities

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

  • A collaborative mindset and strong personal drive

  • Fundamental understanding of EPM or ERP systems (e.g., OneStream/HFM, D365/SAP/Oracle or similar)

  • Experience with and/or interest in leveraging AI to improve reporting, analysis, and ways of working

  • Experience in the logistics sector and project management is a plus, but not required

A degree in finance, economics, business administration, or similar is expected. Full professional proficiency in English is required.

We think the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills, and strong characters bring out the best in us all. And we cannot wait for you to join.

Working at DFDS

Join the movement and grow with us

As part of the Logistics Division - a business that has tripled in size over recent years - you will be at the heart of major strategic transformation as the division works to develop its network and digitise a traditionally manual industry.

While you’re with us, we want you to develop. At DFDS, development happens first and foremost through real work. We will also offer training and support when needed.

We promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply now.

If you think your personality, skills, and experience match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet candidates on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Jens Beck, Head of Logistics Finance Business Partnering, Central, at jenbeck@dfds.com.

We look forward to hearing from you.

This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

title: Field Service Supervisor
description:
Why IPS?
If you're searching for a place where you can grow, continue learning, and make a meaningful impact while still having time for the people and moments that matter most, welcome to Integrated Power Services! We believe your value extends far beyond your job title because the best work comes from people who feel supported, challenged, and fulfilled both professionally and personally. Here, you'll find opportunities to develop your career, work alongside exceptional teammates, and be part of a culture that recognizes that your life is worth just as much as your work—if not more. Because when people thrive, businesses thrive. If that sounds like the kind of place you've been looking for, we invite you to join us!

Benefits:
  • Paid Time Off (PTO).
  • 401k Employer Match.
  • Bonus Incentives.
  • Extensive Training & Career Development Programs.
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program.
  • Medical, Dental and Vision plans.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • And more!

Responsibilities & Expectations:
We are seeking a Field Service Supervisor who shares our commitment to providing an Unmatched Customer Experience (UCE). This individual will be responsible for overseeing and supporting the Field Service Technicians, ensuring efficient operations, and delivering exceptional service to our customers. The Field Service Supervisor will play a key role in managing daily activities, providing guidance, and fostering a safety-first culture.
  • Supervise and support Field Service Technicians, ensuring efficient execution of daily tasks and customer commitments.
  • Coordinate the deployment of field service resources to meet customer needs and project requirements.
  • Maintain regular communication with customers to ensure an Unmatched Customer Experience by addressing inquiries and keeping them informed about services and project status.
  • Foster a culture of safety by promoting compliance with all safety protocols and procedures.
  • Collaborate with the Area Manager and service center leaders to ensure alignment with operational goals and customer expectations.
  • Provide coaching, training, and professional development opportunities for Field Service Technicians to enhance skills and performance.
  • Monitor and manage job progress, ensuring timely completion and adherence to quality standards.
  • Assist in the development of action plans to achieve operational goals, including resource planning and scheduling.
  • Support Continuous Improvement Process Solution (CIPS) initiatives to drive operational efficiency and effectiveness.

Qualifications and Competencies:
  • Valid Driver’s License.
  • NETA certification preferred.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to manage and mentor a team.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to safety and fostering a safe working environment.
  • Customer-focused mindset with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships.
  • Technical knowledge of field service operations, equipment, and procedures.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
  • Previous experience in a supervisory role or equivalent experience preferred.

You’ll thrive at IPS if you:
  • Lead with integrity and prioritize safety. You demonstrate high standards and commit to a safe, ethical workplace.
  • Value teamwork and accountability. You work well with others, take responsibility, serve others, and deliver on your commitments.
  • Focus on the customer. You are dedicated to providing an unmatched customer experience and exceeding expectations.
  • Have an entrepreneurial spirit. You’re proactive, innovative, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Communicate effectively and with purpose. You keep everyone informed with clear, concise communication.
  • Stay curious and love to learn. You continuously seek new knowledge and grow personally and professionally.

Who We Are:
At IPS, we're committed to empowering you to make a meaningful impact. As the industry's leading and fastest-growing service provider, IPS offers single-source electromechanical and power management solutions to enhance the reliability of critical infrastructure across North America and the United Kingdom. We serve over 40,000 essential customer locations, from renewable energy pioneers to hospitals, manufacturers, and municipalities, helping them avoid costly downtime and ensure mission-critical operations.

When you join IPS, you're joining a team that's revolutionizing equipment and process reliability across diverse sectors, from power generation to petrochemicals, and beyond. You'll learn from industry experts, grow alongside a talented workforce, and be part of a company that is built on the Shared Values of Safety, Integrity, Teamwork, Accountability, Customer Focus, and Entrepreneurial Spirit.

IPS is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

Any offer of employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background and driving record investigation. As a federal contractor, our company is committed to maintaining a safe and drug-free workplace. Candidates for this position are required to complete a pre-employment drug screen successfully. The drug screening process will include testing for substances that may impair one's ability to perform the job safely and effectively.

title: Brake and Tire Auto Technician
description:
We’re looking for Automotive Mechanics with a minimum of 1 year of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As a Brake & Tire Technician, you’ll be expected to perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires and performing:

  • Technician services, such as routine inspections/maintenance
  • Basic mechanical repair for brake pads/calipers/rotors, tire installations, and wheel alignments


At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

  • Pay Range: $17.00 - $21.00 hourly (based on level of experience)
    • Starting pay for this position is $17.00/hr
  • Schedule: We are staffing for our first shift at this location. Please keep in mind that all locations are subject to mandatory overtime based on business need.
    • First shift: Mon-Fri 6am-3pm
  • Location: Our inspection center is located at: 5500 S Rockwell Ave Oklahoma City, OK 73179

Other perks of the Job

  • 100% company-paid healthcare premiums
  • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!
  • ASE and tool reimbursement programs
  • Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of Technician roles in our Inspection Centers, depending on your level of experience - take a look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

  • Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.
  • Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires
  • Mid-Level (Mechanical Repair / Build / General) Technician (min 3 years of professional experience): perform light to medium automotive repairs and minimal diagnostics on our vehicles
  • Experienced Technician (min 5 years of professional experience): perform extensive repairs and heavy engine work, as well as advanced vehicle diagnostics on all makes and models, including electric and hybrid vehicles

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles
  • Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

title: Senior Quality Risk Management Engineer
description:
The Senior Quality Engineer is responsible for carrying out Manufacturing Quality Assurance functions within the plant including resolution of deviations, performance of product impact analysis and corrective and preventive action for events, leading and participating in investigations, approval of standard operating procedures, oversight of the plant calibration program, quality improvement programs, and assurance of cGMP and Abbott policy compliance for the manufacturing plant.
Supports the Quality Engineering group by auditing of commissioning and validation documentation completed by others, authoring and execution of newly identified qualification/validation protocols, review and approval of critical planned maintenance routines, and other quality assurance tasks assigned by the MQA Section Manager and/or the Plant QA Manager.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the site liaison between the Quality Risk Management Center of Excellence (QRM COE) and local stakeholders to support deployment of global QRM processes and communication of site feedback.
  • Provide QRM SME oversight and guidance for risk management activities, such as FMEAs and other risk assessments specified in local and/or global procedures, by supporting cross-functional teams with methodology, procedural expectations, documentation quality, and risk-based rationale
  • Provide QRM training and guidance as required, facilitate assignment of appropriate QRM training curricula to site personnel based on their risk-related responsibilities, and promote QRM best practices.
  • Support Management Review activities by compiling and presenting required QRM metrics, site plans for upcoming FMEAs or other relevant risk assessments, significant residual risks, upcoming and past due mitigation actions.
  • Monitor the site Quality Risk Management program to support adherence to global QRM procedures, risk outputs, and mitigation action status.
  • Participate in global and local QRM documentation changes and change control activities by assessing site impact and providing QRM input as applicable.
  • Participate in the Validation Review Board discussions as the QRM SME, providing risk-based input to support validation, commissioning, qualification, and change-related decisions.
  • Support the ensure that all quality goals are met, and all practices and procedures comply with company policies and applicable regulations for the Quality areas under his/her responsibility.
  • Own and maintain applicable site-level Quality Risk Management documents and provide QRM expertise for the development, review, and facilitation of risk assessments used to support risk-based decisions, quality event investigations, and other site or product-specific risk evaluations.
  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Biology, Chemistry or Engineering
  • 6+ years of overall experience in Manufacturing, Quality or Engineering
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Good problem solving and analytical skills
  • Good interpersonal relations / communications skills
  • Good negotiation skills
  • Knowledge of quality / compliance management as well as regulations and standards affecting API, Bulk Drug or Finished goods manufacturing.

Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. title: Manager, CEO's Office - Samlino Group
description:
Are you ready to thrive in a dynamic and exhilarating environment where you'll be entrusted with significant responsibilities? Are you seeking to join an extraordinary team of young, motivated, and highly ambitious individuals? If you have a genuine passion for connecting with people and driving remarkable outcomes, then you could be the perfect fit for our Manager, CEO's Office position.

About us

We are on a mission to help consumers save time and money by matching them with the best products for their needs with banking, insurance and utilities. Samlino Group () operates across three markets, we empowered over 10 million users last year alone, propelling them toward living healthier financial lives.

What we offer you

As our Manager, CEO's Office, you get the unique opportunity to be a key driver of our exponential growth curve. Sunny Lisbon will be your home base, but you’ll travel to and work with our three markets! To facilitate a steep growth curve, we provide you with the following:

  • The chance to create a genuine impact - experience the thrill of working in a fast-paced environment where your efforts and results are tangible, shaping the destiny of our business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - work closely with our high-performing teams alongside our international peers and founder.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we firmly believe in nurturing talent from within, fostering an environment where the sky's the limit.
  • The passport to adventure - as a part of our international organization, you spread your wings and learn from our other markets while applying both strategic and executive skills.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - fuel your interpersonal, digital, entrepreneurial, organizational, project management, and business prowess through hands-on experience in an organisation that values training and development.

Your Responsibilities

You will own your own projects and be responsible for driving results across various projects and initiatives. Responsibilities in this job will evolve and be defined and redefined throughout your time with us. The aim is to take ownership of and drive the development of progressively larger opportunities. Success requires the following:

  • Setting ambitious yet achievable goals, developing strategic plans to reach them, and executing with urgency and intensity to deliver measurable outcomes
  • Take ownership of assigned projects or tasks from inception to completion, including defining clear objectives, plans, and deliverables
  • Proactively identify potential bottlenecks or obstacles and develop mitigation strategies
  • Drive accountability by ensuring all team members understand their roles and responsibilities
  • Act as a champion for our results-driven culture within the team and organization
  • Build, coach, and empower A+ teams to reach their potential and provide 5-star experiences to our users and partners
  • Project-based assignments with clear objectives spread across different geographies
  • Deep dive into value creation, process improvement and organizational growth
  • Thinking out of the box, brainstorming and strategizing to challenge status quo and aim at accelerating our momentum and efficient scaling

What we expect from you

We are seeking a dynamic individual who thrives in a results-oriented environment to join our team and help us reach our objectives. Industry experience is not a requirement, but you do need to be highly ambitious, proactive, forward-thinking, a fast learner, and driven to succeed.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have proactive mindset, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Are self-motivated, detail-oriented, and possess a track record of successfully owning projects from conception to completion
  • Possess an unwavering drive and desire to be the very best at what they do
  • Are passionate about making an impact and driving tangible results
  • Exude an unparalleled work ethic fueled by an urgency to progress
  • Embrace ownership and proactively following through on commitments
  • Possess an insatiable curiosity about business, data, and people, relishing the opportunity to build and nurture relationships that fuel lasting success
  • Master the art of communication, wielding their words with impact both verbally and in writing
  • Showcase unrivalled organizational skills, skillfully structuring and prioritizing their work to achieve maximum efficiency
  • Danish speaker, fluent in English and an EU work permit is required

Start Date and Location

Flexible start date.

The role will be full time, onsite in Lisbon, Portugal.

It will cover all three markets, so regular travel will be part of what we have in mind for you! It will also include extended stays working hands-on with the teams in the different locations.

#LI-Onsite

title: Distribution Network Reliability Team Lead
description:
Distribution Network Reliability Team Lead

About Us:

Jemena is an Australian energy company who own and operate more than $12.4 Billion worth of gas and electricity transportation assets across Australia supplying millions of households and businesses with these essential services every day.

We pride ourselves on our innovative approach, technical expertise, and dedication to safety, quality, and sustainability. Our Group’s over 3000 team members, consistently strive to make a difference in the communities we serve.

At Jemena Electricity Networks, we're looking for a collaborative and strategic Distribution Network Reliability Team Lead to shape the reliability performance of Victoria's electricity network.

This is a high-impact leadership role where you'll bring people, data and ideas together to improve customer outcomes, drive innovation and deliver measurable improvements across SAIDI, SAIFI, MAIFI and STPIS performance.

You'll thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy bringing diverse teams together to solve complex challenges
  • Are passionate about creating better outcomes for customers and communities
  • Combine strong technical expertise with commercial insight
  • Use data and evidence to influence decisions and drive meaningful change
  • Build trust, capability and accountability through collaboration

What you'll bring

  • Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional improvement programs

Notice to Third Parties: Jemena does not accept unsolicited resumes (or liability associated with fees or costs) from recruitment agencies, search firms or third parties. Interested candidates are welcome to submit their application independently.

title: Handyperson
description:
Key Duties

  • Respond to and complete general maintenance requests throughout the property.
  • Carry out routine preventative maintenance to ensure facilities remain safe, functional, and presentable.
  • Perform general repairs including basic carpentry, painting, patching, silicone work, minor plumbing, and other handyperson tasks.
  • Maintain guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house areas to a high standard.
  • Assist with the routine maintenance, cleaning, testing, and operation of swimming pool and spa equipment.
  • Liaise with contractors and assist with maintenance projects as required.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce wastage.
  • Maintain workshop areas, tools, equipment, and maintenance supplies in a clean, safe, and organized manner.
  • Conduct routine property inspections and report maintenance issues requiring specialist attention.
  • Ensure external areas of the property are clean, safe, and well maintained.
  • Follow all workplace health and safety procedures, company policies, and legislative requirements.
  • Undertake other maintenance and handyperson duties as directed by the Chief Engineer or Maintenance Manager.

Skills, Personal Attributes, Experience and Qualifications Required:

Essential

  • Previous experience in a handyperson, maintenance, facilities, or building services role.
  • Practical skills in general repairs and property maintenance.
  • Experience with painting, patching, touch-up work, and basic refurbishment tasks.
  • Ability to use hand and power tools safely and effectively.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage effectively across all levels.
  • Physically fit and capable of performing manual tasks, including lifting, carrying, and climbing ladders.
  • Reliable, professional, and detail-oriented.
  • Service-oriented with a commitment to excellence in both maintenance and aesthetic presentation.
  • Demonstrated multicultural awareness and ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams.
  • Ability to work a flexible roster, including weekends and public holidays if required.

title: Master's Thesis: Context and Memory for On-Device LLM Policy Selection
description:
About Huawei Sweden R&D

Founded in 1987, Huawei Technologies has grown into a global leader in telecommunications and network solutions, with innovation at the core of everything we do. Huawei established its first overseas R&D office in Sweden in 2000, and since then, we’ve expanded rapidly. Today, our R&D engineers are pushing boundaries in Stockholm, Gothenburg, and Lund, working on groundbreaking 6G wireless systems that shape tomorrow’s technology.

Join us on our journey to develop the future of tech and be a part of a team that thrives on innovation, works hard to solve the industry’s biggest challenges, and collaborates with top engineers worldwide. If you’re ready to contribute to world-changing advancements, we want you on board!

About the Project: IntentBridge — Managing Uplink Traffic on a Mobile Device

IntentBridge investigates how an LLM agent on a mobile device can use current measurements and stored history to decide how the device prioritises and paces its uplink traffic. The study explores which observations to retain from previous journeys, application traffic patterns and earlier policy decisions, and how to select and present relevant history for each new decision. The student will build an experimental environment in which real-time applications and background transfers share the device’s uplink as it moves through changing radio conditions. Experiments will vary the context available to the agent and measure how its policy choices affect timely delivery of real-time messages and background throughput.

Timeline

Given our current project schedules, we are looking for master’s students available to start in spring 2027.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Background: Master’s student in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications or a related field, with an interest in AI, mobile networks and evaluating system behavior through simulation and data analysis.

  • Communication: Strong command of English, both spoken and written.

  • Team & Independence: Capable of working effectively both in teams and independently.

  • Commitment to Quality: High attention to detail and dedication to producing high-quality work.

  • Desirable Experience: Programming experience in Python and familiarity with data analysis. Experience with LLMs or AI agents, particularly in managing memory and context, is an advantage, as is familiarity with networking protocols or control systems. Knowledge of C++ or simulation tools such as OMNeT++ or Simu5G is beneficial but not required.

Are you ready to apply your skills in a real-world setting and help us lead the charge in tech innovation? Join Huawei Sweden R&D, and let’s make tech history together!

title: Senior Administrative Analyst, Transit Division, SFMTA (1823)
description:
The Train Control Upgrade Project (TCUP) is an SFMTA capital project which invests in the Muni Metro rail system by replacing the nearly 30-year-old Automatic Train Control System (ATCS) in the subway with a new Communications-Based Train Control (CBTC) system. The project also expands CBTC managed territory outside of the subways to the surface portions of Muni Metro, where signals and switches are currently independently operated in a first come, first serve configuration. Under CBTC, Muni’s entire rail network can be managed centrally with a single, modernized system. Replacing the ATCS with a state-of-the-art CBTC system will maintain the excellent safety record of the current system, while also increasing the subway’s efficiency and reliability.

With a $700 million capital budget, the Train Control Upgrade Project represents a bold step forward for SFMTA and the Muni Metro system. Through a phased implementation plan, an integrated team approach, and flexible contract structures, TCUP is designed to overcome challenges and set a new standard for urban transit infrastructure projects. With a targeted completion date of 2032, the project promises lasting benefits for San Francisco’s public transit system and its riders. Join this exciting team at the cutting edge of urban rail technology!

title: AI Solutions Intern
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
About Judi Health

Judi Health is a health technology company providing benefit administration solutions to employers, unions, health plans, and government entities. Judi Health replaces fragmented, outdated systems with the industry's first Unified Claims Processing™ architecture, seamlessly consolidating pharmacy and medical benefit administration on a single, secure platform. By delivering true price transparency, eliminating unnecessary middleman fees, and leveraging advanced AI-powered care delivery, Judi Health helps clients achieve unprecedented operational efficiency and service levels.

At Judi Health, we're deploying the infrastructure our country needs to deliver the healthcare we all deserve. We are the intelligence platform powering benefits plans for millions of Americans and proudly leading the next generation of care. To learn more, visit .

Location: Hybrid (Local to NYC)

Position Summary:

The AI Solutions Intern is a developmental, entry-level role designed to prepare the intern for the AI Solutions Analyst role. Working under the close guidance of experienced team members, the intern supports business discovery, workflow analysis, requirements documentation, testing, implementation, and adoption of AI-enabled solutions. The intern gains hands-on experience building and evaluating solutions using AI agents, agentic coding harnesses, Copilot, automation, and approved enterprise tools across low-, medium-, and high-complexity use cases. The role also contributes to the company's AI-native transformation by helping identify opportunities to reuse and scale solutions, and by supporting research, documentation, demonstrations, training materials, and value measurement. Work is performed according to established procedures, with assignments reviewed for accuracy and quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Discovery and Analysis: Supports business discovery sessions with stakeholders to understand current processes, pain points, and opportunities for AI-enabled improvement; assists with mapping workflows and documenting current- and future-state processes.
  • Requirements Documentation: Helps gather, organize, and document business and functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria under the direction of senior team members.
  • Solution Building and Evaluation: Gains hands-on experience building, configuring, and evaluating solutions using AI agents, agentic coding harnesses, Microsoft Copilot, automation platforms, and other approved enterprise tools.
  • Use Case Support: Contributes to low-, medium-, and high-complexity use cases by completing assigned tasks, conducting analysis, and supporting delivery under the guidance of experienced team members.
  • Testing and Implementation: Assists with test planning, test case execution, defect tracking, and validation of solution outputs for accuracy, quality, and responsible AI use; supports implementation and deployment activities.
  • Adoption and Enablement: Supports user adoption by helping develop training materials, user guides, quick-reference documents, and solution demonstrations.
  • Reuse and Scalability: Helps identify how individual solutions can be reused across teams, scaled across the company, or developed into client-facing capabilities; documents reusable components, patterns, and lessons learned.
  • Research and Innovation: Researches emerging AI tools, techniques, and industry practices and summarizes findings to inform team recommendations.
  • Value Measurement: Assists with tracking and reporting solution outcomes, including time savings, efficiency gains, adoption metrics, and other measures of business value.
  • Collaboration and Development: Partners with AI Solutions Analysts and cross-functional stakeholders to build foundational skills in solution analysis, delivery, and change management in preparation for progression to the AI Solutions Analyst role.
  • Compliance and Governance: Follows company policies, data privacy and security standards, and responsible AI guidelines when using AI tools and handling enterprise data.

Education Requirements

  • Currently enrolled in an accredited bachelor's or master's degree program in Engineering (e.g., Computer, Software, Electrical, Industrial, or Systems Engineering) or a closely related technical field such as Computer Science or Data Science.
  • Relevant coursework in artificial intelligence, machine learning, software development, data analysis, or automation preferred.

Experience Requirements

  • No prior professional experience required.
  • Demonstrated interest in AI, software, data, or automation, supported by hands-on academic, personal, hackathon, research, or project experience.
  • Exposure to AI tools and technologies such as large language models, AI agents, Microsoft Copilot, prompt engineering, or automation platforms (e.g., Power Automate) preferred.
  • Familiarity with at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, JavaScript, SQL) preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down business processes and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document requirements and explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).
  • Curiosity, eagerness to learn, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Business Consulting Manager
description:
As a Business Consulting Manager, you will play a key role in driving complex enterprise sales opportunities by combining deep logistics industry knowledge, strong business acumen, and a consultative, value-driven approach.

Acting as a trusted advisor to customers and a strategic partner to the Sales team, you will take ownership of the business consulting activities throughout the sales cycle, from initial discovery to solution positioning, business case development, and customer decision-making.

You will be expected to work autonomously, challenge assumptions, and proactively contribute to winning strategic deals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pre-Sales Leadership & Solution Design: Take ownership of business consulting activities across complex enterprise opportunities. Lead discovery workshops, identify customer challenges, and design relevant, scalable solutions aligned with business objectives and product capabilities.

  • Business Case & Value Development: TTranslate customer challenges into clear business value propositions, identify measurable value drivers, and develop compelling business cases, including ROI and TCO assessments where relevant.

  • Complex Sales & RFP Management: Actively contribute to complex sales cycles, taking the lead on the business consulting aspects of RFI/RFP responses, solution proposals, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), and Proofs of Value (PoVs).

  • Strategic Customer Engagement: Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at different organizational levels, including senior executives and C-level decision-makers. Deliver compelling presentations, facilitate workshops, and confidently challenge customer assumptions when appropriate.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a strategic partner to Sales, Product, and Delivery teams, ensuring alignment between customer expectations, business value, product capabilities, and delivery feasibility..

  • Continuous Improvement: Capture customer insights, market trends, and competitive intelligence to contribute to product strategy, sales enablement, and the continuous improvement of business consulting methodologies.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Transport & Logistics Expertise: Strong understanding of the transport and logistics industry, including the operational and strategic challenges faced by shippers, freight forwarders, and carriers.

  • Enterprise Sales Excellence: Proven experience supporting or leading business consulting activities within complex B2B sales cycles, involving multiple stakeholders, strategic accounts, and long decision-making processes.

  • Consultative & Value-Based Selling: Ability to identify underlying business needs, challenge requirements, articulate value propositions, and connect digital solutions to tangible business outcomes.

  • Ownership & Autonomy: Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex assignments, anticipate challenges, take initiative, and proactively drive activities forward without constant supervision.

  • Critical Thinking & Active Listening: Strong analytical mindset, excellent listening skills, and the confidence to constructively challenge internal and external stakeholders.

  • Executive Communication: Excellent presentation, workshop facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to adapt communication to both operational teams and senior executives.

  • Digital & Technology Awareness: Familiarity with digital solutions in transport and logistics, such as TMS, freight procurement platforms, or logistics SaaS solutions, is a strong advantage.

  • Languages: Fluent English (C1 level or equivalent professional proficiency) is required. Professional proficiency in German is a strong advantage; additional European languages are welcome.

Benefits:

  • Private LuxMed healthcare, free preventive check-ups, spine-relieving massages.

  • Budget for remote workstation equipment and gift vouchers.

  • On-site buffet breakfasts prepared fresh daily.

  • Team-building and family trips to a private lakeside resort.

  • Subsidy for a Multisport card.
