About the Team

ACCEL Schools is seeking an Instructional Aide at NorthStar School of Innovation & Leadership in Cleveland, Ohio.

Be part of the difference at NorthStar School of Innovation & Leadership! Celebrating over 20 years of service to Broadway-Slavic Village families, NorthStar School of Innovation & Leadership is an award-winning public charter school serving EK-8th grade students. Deeply rooted in the community, the school has a long-standing staff and involved families. The school provides a college prep education enhanced with arts, sports, Career Technical Education, and STEM learning plus a lively campus life. NorthStar School of Innovation & Leadership is part of ACCEL Schools, an established network of public charter schools serving K-12 students throughout the United States since 2014.

About the Opportunity:

The Instructional Aide assists the Teacher with classroom activities and helps to promote positive student behaviors in both academics and extra-curricular activities. The Instructional Aide provides oversight to ensure student safety and a positive school climate. The Instructional Aide assists the School Leader and Teachers by administering the assigned duties in conformity with the philosophy and policies of ACCEL Schools, the assigned school, the school’s governing board, the State Board of Education, and all applicable laws.

Duties:

  • Supports lessons taught by the teacher to individual students or groups of students and follows instructional plans as assigned by the Teacher or School Leader
  • Helps plan classroom activities as directed by the Teacher and supports the Teacher in all student and parent relations
  • Assists with school activities, including, but not limited to, parent-faculty nights, faculty meetings, assemblies, commencement exercises, fundraiser, chaperoning student activities, providing guidance for students, participating on faculty committees, etc.
  • Performs clerical duties, including, but not limited to, grading papers and making copies
  • Assists the Teacher in the use of classroom technology
  • Helps maintain the cleanliness of the classroom, lunchroom and other school areas
  • Understands, accepts, abides by, and implements the school’s philosophy and mission statement in all school activities
  • Other duties as assigned, including, but not limited to, field trips, morning duty, dismissal duty, and lunch duty

Performance Expectations:

  • Works cooperatively with the Teacher and others
  • Acts in accordance with directives from the Administrator (or designee) and teacher
  • Contributes to a positive climate and culture by exhibiting high professional standard

About You:

  • Associate degree, two years of college coursework, or the passage of the Paraprofessional’s Exam
  • Proficiency in MS Office
  • Successful completion of BCI/FBI check
  • Ability to meet educational standards as applicable
  • Ability to work well under pressure, and effectively prioritize and execute tasks to meet deadlines consistently
  • Understanding and ability to manage confidential information
  • High quality written and verbal communication skills
  • Physical ability to lift 25-40 lbs.
  • Experience in a school or social services setting is a plus

About Us

“We believe that every child should be able to be anything they want in life, regardless of their birthplace and circumstances.” – Ron Packard, CEO & Founder

ACCEL Schools is a network of 80+ high-performing, public charter schools serving PK-12 students. We proudly advocate for school choice and work to address educational inequities throughout the United States. Our schools are inclusive and widely differ to reflect the unique values of the many urban, suburban, and rural communities we serve. Our brick and mortar, and virtual schools specialize in closing educational gaps and offer innovative models such as career-technical education, sports training, bilingual programming, and more. We have been recognized and praised by legislators, authorizers, and researchers for providing exceptional education options to students in historically under-resourced communities.

We offer the following benefits:

Compensation

The starting hourly rate for this position is $14.75/hour. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Life benefits – time & peace of mind

  • Paid time off
  • Retirement contributions
  • Optional Basic Life and AD&D insurance
  • Voluntary life insurance (employee, spouse, child)
  • Discounted childcare at Early Learning Academies locations

Health benefits – stay well & thrive

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Voluntary short-term disability insurance
  • Voluntary long-term disability insurance

Career benefits – keep growing

  • Career advancement opportunities throughout Accel Schools and our strong network of 4,000+ instructors and education professionals

title: Palveluohjaaja siivouspalveluihin, Helsinki
description:
Oletko sinä huolellinen puhtausalan ammattilainen? Etsitkö uutta mahdollisuutta hyödyntää osaamistasi ja tarkkaa siivoussilmääsi? Lue lisää!

Työtehtävät

Palveluohjaajana tehtävässä hyödynnät käytännön ammattitaitoasi perehdyttäessä työntekijöitämme ja annat asiakaspalveluasenteesi loistaa asiakasyhteistyön äärellä. Ammattitaitosi näkyy erityisesti pintamateriaalien, kemikaalien ja siivouskoneiden tuntemuksessa ja hyvässä ajan hallinnassa.

Suurin osa työpäivistäsi kuluu perehdytyksen ja laadunvarmennuksen parissa. Huolehdit myös alueesi siivouskohteiden päivittäisen toiminnan sujuvuudesta, sijaisjärjestelyistä ja tarviketilauksista. Osallistut toisinaan siivoustyöhön satunnaisten sijaistusten muodossa.

Työskentelet Helsingin alueella monipuolisissa siivouskohteissa. Alueellasi sijaitsee peruskoulu, toimistotiloja, laboratorioita, museoita ja muita mielenkiintoisia asiakaskohteita. Kaikki kohteet ovat Helsingin alueella, ja liikut työpäiväsi aikana Palmian autolla kohteiden välillä.

Työaika on arkisin pääsääntöisesti klo 7.00-15.00. Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen.

Miksi meille?

Teemme Palmialla arjen palvelutyötä, jolla on suora vaikutus ihmisten jokapäiväiseen arkeen. Meillä olet osa kehittyvää, monipuolista ja osaavaa työyhteisöä, jossa avautuu säännöllisesti urapolkumahdollisuuksia esimerkiksi palveluohjaajasta palveluesihenkilöksi.

Urapolku mahdollisuuksien lisäksi panostamme työntekijöidemme ammatilliseen osaamiseen. Tavoitteemme on, että jokainen siivouspalveluidemme työntekijä suorittaa työn ohessa toimitilapalvelualan ammattitutkintoon johtavan, Palmian oman PRYL-koulutuksen. Lisäksi tuemme esihenkilöidemme osaamista tarjoamalla heille mahdollisuuden suorittaa lähiesihenkilötyön ammattitutkinnon.

Tarjoamme työsuhde-etuna Epassin, jota voit käyttää työmatka-, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointipalveluihin. Työterveyspalvelumme kattavat lakisääteisen työterveyshuollon lisäksi tuki- ja liikuntaelinsairauksien ja mielenterveyden sairauksien ennaltaehkäisevät palvelut.

Lue työnantajalupauksemme ja katso mitä ammattilaisemme kertovat työstään!

Edellytämme sinulta

Edellytämme sinulta aikaisempaa työkokemusta palveluohjaajan tehtävistä vähintään kahden vuoden ajalta ja suoritettua puhtausalan perus- tai ammattitutkintoa. Sinulta löytyvät hyvät IT-taidot ja B-luokan ajokortti. Tehtävässä menestyäksesi tarvitset hyviä kommunikaatiotaitoja, sekä sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

Etsimme organisaatiokykyistä, asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja tarkkaa palveluohjaajaa, joka viihtyy vaativassa työympäristössä. Kerrothan hakemuksessasi miksi juuri sinä olisit täydellinen valinta tehtävään!

Tehtävään valittavalle henkilölle teetetään suppea turvallisuusselvitys. Voit tutustua turvallisuusselvitysprosessiin ja sen vaatimuksiin Suojelupoliisin verkkosivuilla tästä linkistä. Työsuhde solmitaan heti turvallisuusselvitysprosessin päätyttyä.

Kiinnostuitko?

Hae heti, sillä aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävät sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakuaika päättyy 22.11.2026. Huomioithan, että vastaanotamme hakemuksia ainoastaan sähköisen rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta. Emme käsittele sähköpostitse saapuneita hakemuksia.

Aloitamme turvallisuusselvitykset mahdollisimman pian, ja työt alkavat heti niiden valmistuttua.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat rekrytointitiimiltämme sähköpostitse osoitteesta rekrytointi@palmia.fi.

Ihmisten arjen sujuvaksi tekeminen on työtä, joka ei tule koskaan loppumaan. Palmia on merkittävä palvelualan toimija ja tarjoaa laajasti uramahdollisuuksia eri alojen tekijöille. Tarvitsemme jatkuvasti lisää ammattilaisia turvallisuus-, ruoka- ja ravintola-, siivous- sekä kiinteistö- ja talotekniikkapalvelujen tehtäviin. Tule meille jättämään oma kädenjälkesi!

title: Guest Experience Manager
description:
• Leads and supports all Guest Experience initiatives at the property.

title: Entry-Level Automotive Detailer / Lot Attendant
description:
We’re hiring for entry-level auto roles at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

In these entry-level roles, you’ll have a number of positions to choose from:

  • Detailer: detailing vehicles, including washing, interior cleaning, and exterior buffing
  • Lot Attendant: move vehicles from one department to the next in our Inspection Centers
  • Photobooth Associate: take photos of our vehicles so customers can see our vehicles in our spinners
  • Inspection Associate: inspect the interior and exterior of the vehicles and accurately identify any imperfections/defects
  • Pay: Starting pay for this position is $x/hr.
  • Schedule: We offer two shifts at this location. Please keep in mind that all locations are subject to mandatory overtime based on business need.
    • First shift: Mon-Fri 6am-3pm
    • Second shift: Mon-Thurs x-x

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

  • 100% company-paid healthcare premiums
  • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!
  • ASE and tool reimbursement programs
  • Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started - join the Carvana team by applying on this page!

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

General qualifications and requirements

  • Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

title: Senior Director, Payments and Embedded Fintech
description:
Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

We also offer:

  • A generous benefits program that supports the whole you with medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and 401(k)
  • Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it paid time off
  • Equity in a rapidly growing startup backed by top-tier VCs
  • Monthly tech reimbursements
  • A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from

Role Overview

As the Senior Director, Payments and Embedded Fintech, you lead and grow HCP's Payments and Embedded Fintech business, driving revenue growth, product adoption, and long-term business performance. You own a portfolio of financial products, including card, Automated Clearing House (ACH), and check payments, consumer financing, Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL), and business financing. You identify new opportunities to expand fintech offerings, improve payment experiences, and help our Pros manage cash flow, get paid faster, and spend less time chasing payments. You develop business cases for investment, own strategic fintech partnerships, and drive initiatives that increase Gross Merchandise Volume (GMV), revenue, and customer lifetime value.

You lead and develop a high-performing team, setting a high bar for execution, accountability, and AI-first ways of working. You use data, experimentation, and modern technology to make smarter decisions, improve operational efficiency, and identify opportunities for growth. You collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Risk, and Legal to bring new ideas to market, strengthen existing offerings, and deliver measurable business results. You balance long-term growth opportunities with day-to-day business performance, ensuring the fintech portfolio continues to scale and deliver meaningful value to our Pros.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our service professionals (our Pros). Their success is our success.

What you do each day:

  • Own GMV and revenue targets across Payments and Embedded Fintech, driving increased adoption, product usage, and monetization across our Pro base
  • Define and execute the growth strategy for the fintech portfolio, identifying new product offerings, customer segments, and opportunities to improve revenue, net take rate, and customer lifetime value
  • Experiment with product experiences, incentives, pricing, and packaging to increase adoption and revenue, using performance data to evaluate results and guide investment decisions
  • Lead product-led and sales-led go-to-market initiatives, partnering with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to drive fintech adoption and engagement
  • Oversee day-to-day business performance, establishing clear accountability, financial forecasts, key performance indicators (KPIs), and operating rhythms to track progress and inform decisions
  • Own strategic relationships with fintech partners, including performance management, commercial negotiations, contract renewals, and opportunities to improve partnership economics
  • Drive AI-first ways of working by implementing AI-enabled workflows, automation, and modern data tools to streamline reporting, improve decision-making, and increase team efficiency
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance, Risk, Compliance, and Legal to influence product roadmaps, manage regulatory and operational risks, and improve the overall fintech experience
  • Analyze Pro behaviors, product performance, and financial data to identify growth opportunities, guide structured pilots, and determine which initiatives to scale, optimize, or retire
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team, fostering accountability, continuous improvement, and a culture of experimentation and innovation

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in payments, fintech, embedded finance, strategic finance, or a related field, including 3+ years leading cross-functional teams
  • Proven track record of growing payments or fintech GMV and revenue, including direct ownership of revenue or profit and loss (P&L) targets
  • Deep expertise in payments economics, including card and ACH processing, interchange, take rates, monetization, compliance, and risk management
  • Experience sourcing, negotiating, and managing complex fintech partnerships and commercial contracts, with a focus on improving long-term economics and performance
  • Demonstrated experience driving product-led and sales-led go-to-market strategies that increase product adoption, usage, and revenue
  • Strong quantitative and financial modeling expertise, with the ability to develop business cases, evaluate investment opportunities, and present recommendations to Finance and executive leadership
  • Proven experience driving team efficiency or output quality through the strategic use of AI tools and automation
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience required

What will help you succeed:

  • Strong business ownership mindset with the ability to balance long-term growth opportunities with day-to-day execution and financial performance
  • Analytical and data-driven approach to decision-making, with the ability to separate meaningful insights from noise and turn complex information into clear actions
  • Bias for action, experimentation, and continuous improvement, with a focus on moving quickly, testing ideas, and delivering measurable results
  • Executive presence and strong communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership, external partners, and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Collaborative leadership style with the ability to develop high-performing teams, navigate ambiguity, and drive alignment across diverse business functions
  • A rich portfolio of active, self-directed exploration showing either an exceptional breadth of cross-functional interests or a profound depth of specialized mastery
  • Personal resilience to learn from scratch, and successfully thrive in ambiguity

Location Dependent Information

The specific salary for the successful candidate will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible to participate in Housecall Pro’s equity plan and the following benefits: health care insurance (medical, dental, vision, disability), employee assistance program, 401(K), flexible time off, paid parental leave, tech reimbursement, and other company benefits. Housecall Pro is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth.

$221,100 - $298,100 USD + bonus + equity. Applicable for: San Francisco Bay Area, CA + NYC Metro

$197,370 - $267,030 USD+ bonus + equity. Applicable for: All other US locations.

Founded in 2013, Housecall Pro helps home service professionals (Pros) streamline every aspect of their business. With easy-to-use tools for scheduling, dispatching, payments, and more, Housecall Pro enables Pros to save time, grow profitably, and provide best-in-class service.

Housecall Pro’s brand portfolio includes Business Coaching by Housecall Pro, a business coaching solution for home services businesses. Our brands are united by a singular mission to champion our Pros to success.

We support more than 50,000 businesses and have over 2,000 ambitious, mission-driven, genuinely fun-loving teammates across the globe. If you want to do work that impacts real people, supported by a team that will invest in you every step of the way, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Montör
description:
Vill du utvecklas tillsammans med en arbetsgivare som bryr sig på riktigt?

På Thalamus vet vi att våra konsulter är vår viktigaste tillgång. Därför lägger vi stor vikt vid att skapa en arbetsplats där du känner dig uppskattad, delaktig och har möjlighet att utvecklas i din yrkesroll.

Nu söker vi montörer inom mekanik, el och elektronik för uppdrag hos några av Sveriges mest spännande teknik- och industriföretag.

Om rollen

Som montör kommer du att arbeta med montering, installation och test av produkter och system. Arbetsuppgifterna varierar beroende på uppdrag och kan bland annat omfatta:

  • Mekanisk montering enligt ritning och instruktioner

  • El- och kabeldragning

  • Montering av elektronikkomponenter

  • Felsökning, test och kvalitetskontroller

  • Dokumentation av utfört arbete

  • Samarbete med produktion, teknik och kvalitet

Du får möjlighet att arbeta i tekniskt intressanta miljöer där kvalitet, utveckling och samarbete står i fokus.

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av montering inom mekanik, el eller elektronik. Du är noggrann, lösningsorienterad och trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i team.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

  • Erfarenhet av mekanisk montering, elmontage eller elektronikmontage

  • Förmåga att läsa ritningar, scheman eller instruktioner

  • God förståelse för kvalitet och säkerhet

title: Real Property Manager
description:
FEDITC, LLC is a fast-growing business supporting DoD and other intelligence agencies worldwide. FEDITC develops mission critical national security systems throughout the world directly supporting the Warfighter, DoD Leadership, & the country. We are proud & honored to provide these services.

FEDITC, LLC is a fast-growing business supporting DoD and other intelligence agencies worldwide. FEDITC develops mission critical national security systems throughout the world directly supporting the Warfighter, DoD Leadership, & the country. We are proud & honored to provide these services.

Overview of position:

FEDITC is seeking a Real Property Manager to support an Air Force installation. This position is responsible for managing installation real property assets, coordinating support agreements, conducting space utilization assessments, and ensuring accurate property accountability and reporting. The selected candidate will support real property acquisition, facility management, capital improvement projects, and property disposal while ensuring compliance with Air Force and DoD regulations and standards.

A United States Citizenship and an active Secret DoD Security Clearance is required to be considered for this position.

Requirements:

  • Assist with management and coordination of support agreements and provide comprehensive planning and real property support.
  • Assist with space utilization analysis using both Automated Civil Engineer System (ACES) as well as Geospatial data and make associated recommendations.
  • Manage and support all aspects of installation properties.
  • Provide reporting including annual and monthly reports and variance analysis.
  • Ensure all capital improvement projects include a completed and appropriate forms.
  • Support installation with real property acquisition, management, accounting, reporting, facility use, temporary use of real property, and disposal.
  • Review real property holdings annually and report unused, underused, or excess property. Submit all inventory and inspection reports.
  • Provide technical direction and advice on procedural actions in preparation of administrative documents and supporting case data for real property actions.
  • Maintain applicable security clearance(s) at the level required by the client and/or applicable certification(s) as requested by FEDITC and/or required by FEDITC’S Client(s)/Customer(s)/Prime contractor(s).
  • Other support duties as needed/directed.

Experience/Skills:

  • One (1) year of experience working with Air Force related Real Property Management; or two (2) years of experience working with DoD related Real Property Management. Alternatively, have certification documenting completion of the Air Force Institute of Technology (AFIT) Real Property Management Course WMGT 424.
  • Experience with facility engineering concepts, Air Force or DoD space use standards and programs as well as standard DoD Real Estate reports.

Clearance:

  • Active Secret Security Clearance is required
  • Must be a United States Citizen and pass a background check.
  • Maintain applicable security clearance(s) at the level required by the client and/or applicable certification(s) as requested by FEDITC and/or required by FEDITC’S Client(s)/Customer(s)/Prime contractor(s).

FEDITC, LLC. is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment. We do not employ AI tools in our decision-making processes. Regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran, FEDITC, LLC. ensures that all employment decisions are made in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Our commitment to non-discrimination in employment extends to every location in which our company operates.

title: Copy Editor
description:
About Us

ISMG is a global intelligence firm and media powerhouse, leading the way in cybersecurity, enterprise IT, and digital transformation. With 10+ brands, 38 digital media properties, and over 400 premier events annually—ISMG connects a network of over 2M executives, decision-makers, and innovators with the insights and opportunities they need to stay ahead.

The Opportunity

ISMG is seeking a Copy Editor to join our Global Copy Desk, a centralized team which provides editing, proofreading, and ghostwriting as a service across ISMG's brands and business units. In this role, you will edit, proofread, fact-check and write content across formats including articles, interviews, newsletters, blogs, white papers and custom content. Additionally, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of editorial processes and procedures that meet global standards.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editing and proofreading articles, audio and video interviews, webinars, newsletters, blogs, white papers and custom content for grammar, spelling, punctuation, style and readability.

  • Ensuring that content follows AP style and ISMG's global editing guidelines and maintains the appropriate tone, voice, clarity, flow and structure before publication.

  • Verifying the accuracy of facts, including names, dates and statistics.

  • Transcribing video and audio interviews, webinars and event sessions, and editing the transcripts.

  • Using AI-assisted editing and transcription tools to improve speed and consistency, while independently verifying all AI-generated output for accuracy, style and tone.

  • Writing and ghostwriting content for marketing and other lines of business as required.

  • Coordinating with the creative team on illustrations, infographics and photographs for layouts.

  • Working with editors, writers and stakeholders across ISMG brands and business units to deliver content on deadline.

  • Helping develop and maintain the desk's editorial processes and guidelines.

  • Keeping up with developments and trends in cybersecurity and technology.

What You Bring to the Table

  • 3-5+ years of experience in a similar role.

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, English or a related field. Master's degree preferred.

  • Strong editing skills and knowledge of the AP Stylebook.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize and meet deadlines under pressure.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong attention to detail, a proactive mindset and the ability to independently identify and resolve editorial challenges.

  • Knowledge of cybersecurity and technology would be an advantage.

🎯 Why ISMG?

  • High-growth, global organization with clear momentum and market leadership

  • Collaborative team of innovative thinkers and creative professionals

  • Supportive culture that values autonomy and excellence

  • Continuous learning and professional development

👉 Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now or visit to learn more!

title: Postdoctoral Fellow (Ref. PD/26/21)
description:
IRB Barcelona is seeking a highly motivated and talented Postdoctoral Fellow to participate in cutting edge research line of the Molecular Biophysics Research Group led by Dr. Xavier Salvatella.

This position is co-funded by project AY2AX000267, under the Biogami 2026 Call, funded by the Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Independently design and test hypotheses regarding the conformational and oligomerization properties of intrinsically disordered proteins or regions of proteins.

  • Plan, perform and interpret using solution nuclear magnetic resonance experiments.

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary research team, tapping into the expertise of fellow researchers and external collaborators.

  • Contribute to a culture of scientific excellence, efficiency, and teamwork.

  • Contribute to other lab projects and to the maintenance of protocols and laboratory resources in the group.

  • Critically analyze analytical results, participate in scientific discussions and in preparation of diverse forms of scientific communication (seminars and conferences).

  • Participate in the project activities: meetings, presentations, visits to other labs, collaboration, exchange of data sets, preparing project reports/deliverables.

  • Perform excellent research according to the high standards of the lab and the IRB Barcelona.

YOU HAVE

  • PhD in chemistry/physics/biochemistry/biotechnology or a related field.

  • Experience in conceptual or technical aspects related to the use of solution nuclear magnetic resonance to investigate the conformational and oligomerization properties of intrinsically disordered proteins or regions of proteins.

  • Demonstrated ability to design and conduct solution nuclear magnetic resonance experiments independently.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively.

  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills.

  • Attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Proficiency in English (both written and spoken).

  • Highly motivated, enthusiastic and collaborative person.

  • Willing to keep on learning.

  • Ability to work independently in a demanding research environment.

YOU MIGHT ALSO HAVE

  • Familiarity with solution nuclear magnetic resonance of phase separated proteins.

  • Familiarity with solid state nuclear magnetic resonance proteins of aggregated proteins.

  • Good communication and teamwork abilities.

  • Experience with data analysis software.

  • Skills: Independence, self-learning abilities, goal-oriented.


WHAT WE OFFER:

To be a part a part of something meaningful: We are a biomedical research centre that tirelessly works to achieve a society free of diseases. Our mission is to carry out research of excellence to cure cancer and other diseases linked to ageing.

Good Working conditions: Contract linked to the project AY2AX000267, under the Biogami 2026 Call, funded by the Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health.

Employed in compliance with Spanish legislation and regulations under a full-time contract. Employees receive the benefits of the Spanish Social Security system covering sickness, maternity/paternity leave and injuries at work.

Competitive salary: commensurate with experience and qualifications.

International Environment: Nearly 90 Postdoctoral researchers (more than a half non-Spanish nationals) are currently working at IRB Barcelona.

Multidisciplinary Research: Research of excellence at the unique interface between biology, chemistry, and structural and computational biology.

Training and Career: Postdoctoral researchers joining IRB Barcelona gain access to the Institute’s advanced research training and career development opportunities, all within in a competitive international environment. Courses and workshops on themes of particular interest to postdocs are offered regularly by the Institute.

Relocation & Visa Assistance: Trained staff provides support on visa paperwork, administrative requirements, and practical information on living and working in Barcelona, etc.

Social Life: We like to have fun. We promote several activities, like a Football League, an annual skiing trip, a Mountaineering Club, a Running Club and "Cool-off sessions", where members meet informally for drinks, snacks and scientific discussions.

Fairness: Our recruitment is open, transparent and merit-based, and all applicants compete on the same terms. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, nationality, ethnic origin or disability.

HOW TO APPLY & SELECTION PROCESS:

  • Deadline for applications: 24/11/2026 (If no suitable candidate is found, the deadline will be extended)

  • Number of positions available: 1

  • Selection process:

    • Pre-selection: Will be based on CV, motivation letter & experience.

    • Interviews: Short-listed candidates will be interviewed.

    • Job offer: Will be sent to the successful candidate after the interview.


IRB BARCELONA endorses the Requirements and Principles of the European Charter for Researchers, the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers, and Open, Transparent, Merit-based recruitment promoted by the European Commission and follows Equal Opportunities policies.

On 9 December, 2014, IRB Barcelona was awarded the "HR Excellence in Research" logo. This recognition reflects the commitment of the Institute to the continuous improvement of its human resources policies in line with the Charter & Code. The Institute works to ensure fair and transparent recruitment and appraisal procedures.

Please check our Recruitment Policy.

Note: The strengths and weaknesses of the applications will be provided upon request.

ABOUT IRB BARCELONA,

Created in 2005 by the Generalitat de Catalunya (Government of Catalonia) and the University of Barcelona, IRB Barcelona is a Severo Ochoa Centre of Excellence—a seal that was awarded in 2011.

The institute is devoted to conducting research of excellence in biomedicine and to transferring results to clinical practice, thus improving people’s quality of life, while simultaneously promoting the training of outstanding researchers, technology transfer, and public communication of science. Its 27 laboratories and 9 core facilities address basic questions in biology and are orientated to diseases such as cancer, metastasis, Alzheimer’s, diabetes, and rare conditions.

IRB Barcelona is an international centre that hosts 500 members and 45 nationalities. It is located in the Barcelona Science Park. IRB Barcelona forms part of the Barcelona Institute of Science and Technology (BIST) and the “Xarxa de Centres de Recerca de Catalunya” (CERCA).

title: Operational Excellence Lead
description:
What we do at Blykalla

Blykalla is a global leader in advanced nuclear technology, commercialising the next generation of clean, reliable energy through its lead-cooled reactor, the SEALER. By combining decades of specialised research with world-class partners, Blykalla is building the backbone of the global AI and industrial economy. For more information, visit .

As Operational Excellence Lead, you’ll build how Blykalla works and keep improving it. We’re growing fast and building a first-of-a-kind reactor, so our management system needs to grow with us. You’ll set up and own the framework for processes, KPIs and digital tools, and work with owners across the business who drive improvement in their own areas. We’re kick-starting this as a focused effort now; over time it becomes a continuous improvement function at the heart of the company.


What you’ll get to do

You’ll be Blykalla’s specialist in operational excellence and coordinate improvement work across the organisation. This includes but is not limited to:

Management System & Processes

  • Coordinate development and improvement of Blykalla’s management system: how processes, roles, KPIs and governance fit together.

  • Work with process owners to define, map and prioritise our critical processes, and keep them simple enough that people follow them.

  • Make sure every process has a clear owner and is published where people can find it, in close cooperation with Quality Assurance.

  • Bring methods and tools for improvement, and coach managers and teams in using them.

KPIs & Control Tower

  • With relevant function define KPIs per function, each tied to a real decision and a reliable data source.

  • Work with our digital team so that processes and systems fit together: one system of record per process, and data that flows into one place.

  • Enable control tower view for progress tracking and management communication.

Business Planning & Governance

  • Coordinate the annual business planning cycle, OKRs and performance follow-up together with Finance.

  • Set up clear forums, mandates and escalation paths, a decision register and a delegation-of-authority framework.

  • Tie ways of working into plans, budgets and forums, so improvements last.

Who you’ll get to work with

The Operational Excellence Lead reports to the Head of Projects. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla.

Who you are

You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help in order for you to succeed in this role, these are:

  • 5+ years in operational or business excellence, or a related field such as management consulting with an operations focus, organisational development, or strategy and business operations.

  • You’ve helped set up or improve how an organisation works: processes, roles, KPIs or governance that people actually use.

  • Hands-on in defining and mapping processes; you turn complex work into simple, clear processes.

  • Ideally, experience from business planning, OKRs or performance follow-up.

  • You lead without line authority: you coordinate, coach and influence senior people with strong views.

  • Structured and pragmatic, good at prioritising and saying no to the less important.

  • Clear communicator who turns detail into a sharp message for management.

  • Fluent in English.

  • Bonus: experience with digital tools and systems (process or QMS tools, PLM-type systems, data and dashboards); familiarity with management system standards such as ISO 9001; experience from engineering-heavy, industrial or regulated industries such as energy or nuclear, or from a scale-up; familiarity with project controls such as planning, cost control and earned value; Swedish.

Location

This position is for our office in Stockholm.

Why Blykalla?

You’ll join a passionate team developing one of the most promising energy technologies of our time. We offer a fast-paced, mission-driven environment where your contributions have a real impact. Few roles let you shape how a company works while it is still being built. You’ll help build not just our company, but the clean-energy future.

Our Culture & Values

We’re building more than a reactor, we’re building a company where people do their best work, together. Our values are the foundation of everything we do:

Take Responsibility

  • We never compromise on radiation safety.

  • We act like owners, accountable, honest, and proactive.

There Is No ‘I’ in Team

  • We believe in respect, inclusion, and psychological safety.

  • We win and lose together, and we enjoy the ride.

Get Things Done

  • We take the first step, even when we don’t have all the answers.

  • We iterate fast and embrace a test-and-learn mindset.

Ask Why

  • We challenge assumptions and speak up with candor and respect.

  • Curiosity drives us forward.

Another World Is Possible

  • We’re tackling one of humanity’s biggest problems.

  • We don’t give up, and we’re optimistic that we can make a difference.

As Operational Excellence Lead, you will be a steward of these values, building ways of working that help people take responsibility, work as one team and get things done.


Reference & Background Checks

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates. We may also conduct reference checks to gain a well-rounded understanding of your professional experience, performance, and ways of working. This includes both references provided by you and, where relevant, conversations with other professional contacts who have worked closely with you. We strive to be transparent about our reference-checking process and handle all personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. Any additional references will be sought with professional judgment and only when considered relevant to the role.

Salary Range: SEK 60 000 – 70 000/ month, depending on experience and qualifications.

We offer competitive compensation aligned with our internal salary framework and growth potential in the role.

We do not accept applications via email.

We are not open to external help from recruitment agencies.

Note on AI Use: Blykalla may use AI technology to assist with certain administrative aspects of the hiring process, such as note-taking, interview documentation, and reporting. However, every resume and application is reviewed directly by our recruiting team. AI tools are used solely for operational support and do not influence candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.

title: Senior Associate, Corporate Finance
description:
About the Role

The Senior Associate, Corporate Finance will play a key role within Madison Energy Infrastructure’s FP&A function, helping translate capital investment plans and corporate priorities into clear forecasts, funding requirements, and financial insights.

This role will primarily focus on capital expenditures (CapEx), including tracking investment activity, forecasting cash requirements, and explaining performance against plan. Beyond CapEx, you will help maintain a comprehensive view of corporate sources and uses of cash and support budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting.

Working across Finance, Accounting, Development, Construction, Supply Chain and Procurement, you will connect project-level information with Madison’s broader financial outlook. This role is suited to someone who combines strong financial modeling skills with sound judgment, strong attention to detail, experience working cross-functionally as a finance business partner, and the ability to turn complex information into a clear business narrative.

What You’ll Own

  • CapEx Planning & Forecasting – Maintain and improve capital expenditure forecasts, incorporating project schedules, investment assumptions, payment timing, and changes in expected spending. Partner with business teams to keep forecasts grounded in current plans.
  • Capital Performance Reporting – Track actual, committed, and forecast capital spending against approved budgets. Identify variances, explain their drivers, and highlight implications for future spending and cash requirements.
  • Corporate Sources & Uses – Help build and maintain an integrated view of corporate cash inflows and outflows, including capital investments, operating requirements, financing activity, and other corporate obligations. Coordinate assumptions with the teams responsible for each workstream.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting – Support annual budgets, monthly/periodic forecasts, and longer-term planning. Consolidate inputs, challenge assumptions constructively, and translate changes into financial impacts.
  • Financial Modeling & Decision Support – Develop models and scenario analyses that evaluate investment timing, funding needs, and competing business priorities. Clearly communicate assumptions, sensitivities, and tradeoffs.
  • Management Reporting – Prepare concise reporting and presentation materials that explain capital deployment, forecast changes, liquidity requirements, and key business risks / opportunities to Senior Leadership, Board of Directors, and/or Private Equity Ownership.
  • Process Improvement & Partnership – Strengthen planning templates, controls, and documentation. Work with Accounting to reconcile actual results and with business partners to improve the timeliness and quality of forecast inputs.
  • CapEx Forecast Ownership – Own the CapEx forecast end to end, including its accuracy, and present capital deployment and forecast updates directly to Senior Leadership.

What Will Help You Succeed

(You don’t need to check every box, but here’s what will help you thrive.)

  • Education & Background – Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, economics, or a related field
  • Experience – 4–6 years of relevant experience in FP&A, corporate finance, transaction advisory, investment banking, or a related analytical role
  • Technical Skills – Strong financial modeling and Excel skills, with the ability to build clear, reliable models that others can understand and maintain; understanding of financial statements, cash flow forecasting, and the distinction between accounting recognition and cash timing
  • Presentation & Reporting – Comfort building clear, polished PowerPoint presentations, with strong attention to detail to ensure numbers, labels, and formatting are accurate and consistent
  • Analytical Approach – Ability to reconcile information across sources, investigate discrepancies, and explain the business drivers behind the numbers
  • Mindset – Strong attention to detail, communication, organization, and follow-through; comfortable working across functions and managing shifting priorities
  • Preferred Knowledge – Experience analyzing capital expenditures, project economics, or investment-driven businesses preferred; interest in renewable energy and infrastructure, with experience in either sector helpful

Benefits

  • PTO and company holidays
  • Medical, dental, vision
  • Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance
  • 401(k) and company match
  • Professional development stipend
  • Strong culture of collaboration, performance, and personal growth
$105,000 - $140,000 a year
The actual salary offered may vary depending on job-related factors including, but not limited to knowledge, skills, experience and location.

How We Work

At Madison Energy Infrastructure, we believe in the power of clean energy infrastructure to drive real impact—for our customers, our partners, and the communities we serve. We’ve quickly emerged as a preeminent developer, investor, and operator of distributed generation, helping organizations across sectors meet their energy goals with certainty, speed, and trust. Our robust portfolio consists of over half a gigawatt of clean energy infrastructure projects across more than 25 states.
We’re building a team that thrives on ownership and ambition. As we expand into direct, end-to-end services for Fortune 500 companies, public entities, and nonprofits alike, we rely on collaborative thinkers who bring structure to complexity, energy to execution, and curiosity to every challenge.
Our environment is fast-paced and outcome-oriented—but grounded in the belief that how we work together matters as much as what we deliver. If you’re excited to shape the future of clean energy and be part of a high-performance, high-integrity team, we’d love to meet you.

title: Hatch's Summer 2027 Internship Program
description:
Join the Rest Revolution

The world is wired and tired. It's plagued by screens, notifications, and the sense that you should always be doing ... something. But hey, you're reading this job application right now, so you probably know exactly what we're talking about.

So here's a bit of good news amidst all the noise: Hatch is a sleep wellness company that's betting on rest in a culture obsessed with optimization. While most technology is designed to keep you engaged, our devices use the science of habit formation to help people unplug, unwind, and recharge. Through genuinely enjoyable routines, habit building, and gentle guidance (no sleep scores or wearables here), we help people build healthier sleep habits and feel the difference in everyday life.

More than a decade ago, we started with a mission to help parents navigate the complexities of newborn sleep. Today, we're helping more than 5 million people (and counting) take care of themselves and the people they love through the power of rest.

🌙 The Opportunity: Summer Internships at Hatch (June–August)

At Hatch, we believe great sleep changes everything — and our team is on a mission to help people make space for rest. We’re looking for curious minds and kind hearts to join us as Summer Interns and help bring that mission to life.

This is more than just an internship. We’re seeking thoughtful, motivated individuals who want to lean in, ask questions, and contribute meaningfully to the work we do every day. Whether you’re exploring your future in design, marketing, engineering, or something in between — if you’re excited to learn and ready to roll up your sleeves, we’d love to hear from you.

This general internship application is open now! Specific department openings will be shared during our official Intern Selection Process — but submitting here ensures you’re on our radar when the time comes.

✨ What We Look For

  • A genuine interest in sleep, wellness, and people-first technology
  • An organized, proactive mindset
  • Comfort working independently and asking thoughtful questions
  • Kindness, curiosity, and a collaborative spirit

📍Location Details

This internship is Hybrid - 3 days a week in office. We are based out of Redwood City, CA.

We’ll stay connected through regular check-ins, collaborative projects, and moments of team connection — because building trust and community doesn’t have to be in-person to be real.

🌟 Past Summer Internships

Our interns work on real projects alongside teams across the company. Past Summer Interns have joined teams including:

  • Product & Design: Product, Design, Research & Design
  • Engineering: Mobile/iOS, Embedded, Web, R&D, QA
  • Data: Data & Analytics
  • Marketing & Brand: Marketing, Acquisition Marketing, Content, Social, PR
  • Business & Operations: Finance, Supply Chain, Retail/Channel Management, Employee Experience

Each cohort also takes part in weekly Learning Lounges, where Hatch leaders from different departments share what they do and how their teams work.

Why You’ll Love Working at Hatch

  • We’re a certified Great Place to Work
  • We help people sleep better. Our products make a real, meaningful difference in our customers’ lives
  • Our team is collaborative, fun, and full of brilliant minds, and you’ll work with leadership that truly values every contribution
  • We’re backed by world-class investors (and growing fast)

title: Compliance Associate – Monitoring & Testing
description:
OppFi is a leading tech-enabled digital finance platform that works with banks to provide financial products and services for everyday Americans. Through a transparent and responsible platform, which includes financial inclusion and excellent customer experience, the Company supports consumers who are turned away by mainstream options to build better financial health.

We are a team of caring, innovative, and inclusive individuals who thrive in being immersed in diverse talents, expertise, perspectives, and backgrounds. Our employees approach every new challenge with an unparalleled ability to see what could be rather than settle for what is. Our business principles guide us and create an open and collaborative culture where we improve 1% every day, and the best ideas always win! We welcome individuals who want to make an impact in the financial system by facilitating credit access, expanding financial inclusion, promoting financial health, and delivering exceptional customer service.

A few other fun facts about us. OppFi is one of the top consumer-rated financial platforms online, maintaining a 4.4/5.0-star rating on Trustpilot. We are a 2025 Crain’s Fast 50™ company and were named on Built In's 2026 Best Places to Work in Chicago.

About the job:

The OppFi Compliance department is looking for a Compliance Associate eager to join the second-line compliance testing team. In this role, you will be instrumental in our compliance testing program, which reviews policies, procedures, applications, loans, marketing, and communications for compliance with applicable consumer protection laws and regulations. Your responsibilities will include planning and executing targeted transactional testing and reviewing relevant documentation, including company procedures, according to the team’s testing schedule. You will also be responsible for preparing reports about testing scope and results for senior management and bank partners.

What you get to do:

  • Second line monitoring and testing against applicable State and Federal regulations as part of our Compliance Management System
  • Assess compliance risk through performing analysis of accounts, policies, procedures, marketing material, complaints, reports, and more.
  • Assist with and collect data, files, and other materials for monitoring and testing
  • Work in collaboration with various business departments and other team members in different phases of testing and monitoring including planning, execution, reporting, and follow-up
  • Assess the material, report on the findings, provide recommendations, receive review and approval when required
  • Work with Issues Management Team to ensure issues are recorded
  • Assist with and draft concise reports that provide value to business and management to improve compliance controls and mitigate risks
  • Assist departmental senior leaders/managers in process improvements for the Monitoring and Testing Program
  • Assist in the monitoring for changes to the business to enhance testing processes
  • Assist in the monitoring for regulatory changes to update testing procedures to ensure compliance with applicable regulations

What you will bring to the team:

  • Three years’ experience in regulatory compliance or state regulatory oversight with a focus on consumer lending
    • Knowledge could come from on the job experience or education, such as paralegal certification, JD, or Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager (CRCM) certification
  • Experience in designing or implementing a compliance monitoring and testing program
  • Applicable knowledge of consumer financial regulations, including the Truth in Lending Act, Equal Credit Opportunity Act, Fair Credit Reporting Act, Unfair Deceptive and Abusive Acts or Practices, Servicemembers Civil Relief Act, Electronic Funds Transfer Act, Telephone Consumer Protection Act, CAN-SPAM Act, Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act, Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act, Fair Debt Collections Practices Act.
  • Ability to do root cause analysis and to learn and understand how technology infrastructure works at a level adequate to inform the root cause analysis

Familiarity with data queries and using SQL; experience with data tools including Snowflake, Tableau, a plus.

Reports to: Compliance Director

Job Level: Associate

Candidates are encouraged to discuss compensation expectations during the hiring process. In addition to base pay, the total compensation package includes eligibility and potential for performance-based bonuses and equity grants dependent upon the role and job level.

OppFi offers a flexible, remote environment, 401(k) matching program, and generous paid time off. Other benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, and tuition reimbursement. Additional benefits include DoorDash DashPass, Figo pet insurance, Rocket Lawyer, and access to LinkedIn Learning. title: Site Leader - Minneapolis
description:
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our car’s are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

About the team and position

The Inspection Center General Manager is responsible for the overall performance of the center. Providing leadership for up to 500 associates working multiple shifts in a lean manufacturing environment. Maintaining a culture of continuous improvement and high associate engagement while ensuring the facility meets quality, production, and cost objectives.

What you’ll be doing

Leadership 30%

  • Leads strategic planning to ensure the facility will have the capability to meet future demands.
  • Provides strategic vision and guidance to the location
  • Ensures management beliefs and behaviors are in line with the Carvana culture
  • Frequent visits to the shop floor to ensure connection with the realities of the business and model leadership behaviors throughout the organization
  • Positively challenge and engage the team to continuously improve quality production and cost performance
  • Live the Carvana values

Production Management 30%

  • Lead production planning for the Inspection Center
  • Ensure the Inspection Center has adequate capacity to meet production targets
  • Oversee weekly performance review meetings for each area and report out on the Inspection Centers performance
  • Identify problems impacting the Inspection Center’s performance. Prioritize problems, allocate resources, and ensure the resolution of issues
  • Ensure operating standards such as standardized work, operating rules, 5S, and visual management tools are consistently executed
  • Ensure compliance with all health and safety and loss prevention guidelines

People Management 30%

  • Participate in the selection and hiring process, ensure a pipeline of associates to fill current and future positions
  • Maintain a bench of candidates for each leadership position
  • Ensure progression path training and certification process is consistently executed
  • Model effective teamwork and ensure it’s embraced at all levels of the organization
  • Provide competency-based feedback and ensure leaders throughout the organization are also providing appropriate feedback
  • Mentor reconditioning managers

Continuous Improvement 10%

  • Lead the selection of continuous improve events, allocate resources to support events, and hold the team accountable for results
  • Participate in and lead continuous improvement efforts
  • Train and mentor reconditioning managers on problem-solving
  • Other duties as assigned.

What you should have

  • Minimum of 8 years of management experience either in automotive or a lean manufacturing environment leading multiple work groups
  • A valid driver’s license
  • Valid unrestricted driver’s license with a clean driving record in the last 3 years
  • Knowledge of lean manufacturing principles
  • Proven track record of leading and developing associates
  • Proven ability to obtain project deliverables and company metrics
  • Ability to work a flexible work schedule
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Excellent communications skills, oral and written
  • Ability to work with and through teams to achieve results
  • Strong analysis and decision making ability
  • Proficient computer skills

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-Time Position with a competitive salary
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • 401K with company match
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy, both physically and mentally
  • Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization
  • A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development
  • A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

  • Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Must have a valid driver's license
  • A clean driving record with no more than two moving violations or DUI’s in the last three years
  • The physical environment requires the employee to work both inside and outside in heat/cold, wet/humid, and dry/arid conditions
  • Will be required to use personal protective equipment to prevent exposure to hazardous materials
  • May be requested to work overtime and weekends for special programs and events.
  • Frequent standing and sitting with varying periods of each
  • May at times require working different shifts
  • Lift up to 40 pounds frequently
  • Walk up to three miles each day

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

title: Communications Coordinator
location: New York, NY or Santa Barbara, CA
description:
The Firm:

Lead Edge Capital is a $9 billion growth equity firm backing software, internet, and tech-enabled businesses around the world. Since 2011, we’ve partnered with over 100 companies, including Alibaba, Asana, Toast, Duo Security, Wise, and Benchling, and have seen more than 60 successful exits. We look for companies where our network can make a difference, and where speed, access, and execution matter. We’re powered by a global network of 700+ operators, executives, and entrepreneurs who do more than commit capital. They help our companies hire, grow, and win. Lead Edge has offices in New York, London, and Santa Barbara.

Overview:

Lead Edge Capital is hiring a Communications Coordinator to serve as a hands-on, jack-of-all-trades partner to the Chief Communications Officer. This person will support content creation and repurposing, day-to-day LinkedIn management, value creation communications across the portfolio, and help expand the firm's media presence and bench of spokespeople. The role is well suited to someone who can move fluidly between strategic thinking and execution, including writing, project management, and relationship-building.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Content & Editorial

  • Audit existing content (webinars, decks, articles, past coverage) and identify what can be refreshed or repackaged into evergreen assets.
  • Create new content (thought leadership, LinkedIn posts, newsletters, talking points) tailored to founders and existing/prospective LPs as primary audiences.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and content library for consistent cadence and to ensure nothing goes stale or unused.
  • Use AI tools to support content development, repurposing, and multimedia creation, including videos and visual assets, and introduce best practices to improve communications workflows.

LinkedIn & Digital Strategy

  • Work with the Chief Communications Officer to build and manage a LinkedIn content strategy for the firm and its partners, including posting cadence, formats, and performance tracking.
  • Turn long-form content into a pipeline of shorter, platform-native posts.

Value Creation Communications

  • Track existing and upcoming portfolio company projects and milestones as an ongoing comms pipeline.
  • Draft announcement materials, media lists, press releases, and communications plans for portfolio company news.
  • Over time, build cross-portfolio toolkits and templates so portfolio companies can self-serve on standard comms needs.
  • Help plan and execute an inaugural cross-portfolio communications summit in NYC.

Media & Spokesperson Development

  • Identify and build relationships with new media platforms, particularly podcasts and newsletters, to diversify beyond traditional trade press.
  • Help develop additional spokespeople for the firm beyond Managing Partners, including identifying pitch angles, prepping talking points, and identifying opportunities for other partners to build public profiles.

Requirements:

  • 3–6 years of experience in communications, content, or marketing; PE, VC, or financial services experience is a plus, but not required.
  • Strong writer who can adapt tone across formats: LinkedIn, press materials, investor-facing content.
  • Ability to own projects end-to-end and work independently with minimal oversight in a lean team environment.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to track multiple portfolio company workstreams simultaneously.
  • Advanced proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, etc., with demonstrated ability to apply them to content creation while maintaining accuracy, quality, and brand voice.
  • Genuinely curious and proactive about media, with a finger on the pulse of emerging trends: new podcasts, shows, and up and coming reporters worth building relationships with early.
  • This is an in-person role based in New York or Santa Barbara. Applicants must be in or willing to relocate to the New York or Santa Barbara area.

Compensation

  • The budgeted base salary range is $100,000-$130,000. Total compensation will include base salary and performance-based bonus. Total package will be commensurate with qualifications and experience and will be highly competitive relative to market. Actual pay will be adjusted based on experience.

title: Medewerker Debiteuren
description:
Hoe jij het verschil maakt

Als Specialist Debiteurenbeheer zorg jij ervoor dat openstaande vorderingen zorgvuldig en effectief worden opgevolgd. Je pakt complexe dossiers op, doorgrondt waar problemen ontstaan en komt tot oplossingen die zowel financieel als klantgericht verantwoord zijn.

Naast je werk in de dagelijkse operatie kijk je kritisch naar onze processen, systemen en werkwijzen. Je herkent terugkerende knelpunten, vertaalt analyses naar concrete verbeteringen en helpt het team om slimmer en efficiënter te werken. Met jouw ervaring ben je een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en een belangrijke sparringpartner voor de teamleider.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je behandelt complexe debiteurendossiers en zorgt voor een zorgvuldige opvolging van openstaande vorderingen;

  • Je analyseert betalingsachterstanden, afwijkingen en terugkerende oorzaken en zet de juiste vervolgacties uit;

  • Je maakt en bewaakt betalingsafspraken en schakelt waar nodig met incassopartners of andere betrokken partijen;

  • Je controleert financiële gegevens en zorgt ervoor dat dossiers volledig en correct zijn vastgelegd;

  • Je signaleert risico’s en knelpunten in processen, systemen en werkwijzen en doet concrete verbetervoorstellen;

  • Je neemt deel aan verbeterprojecten en kunt hierin een coördinerende of voortrekkersrol vervullen;

  • Je ondersteunt de teamleider bij het bewaken van de werkvoorraad, voortgang en kwaliteit;

  • Je deelt jouw kennis met collega’s en draagt bij aan een professionele, gestructureerde manier van werken;

  • Je werkt nauw samen met onder andere Finance, Customer Operations, Sales en externe partners.

Hier laad jij van op!

Bij NieuweStroom geloven we dat werk en welzijn hand in hand gaan. Daarom bieden we:

  • Een salaris tussen € 3.500,- en € 4.200,- bruto per maand op fulltime basis, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • Volledige betaling van de pensioenpremie door NieuweStroom;

  • In totaal 34 verlof- en ADV-dagen op fulltime basis;

  • Een persoonlijk vitaliteitsbudget van bruto € 1.100,- per jaar;

  • De ruimte om jouw expertise in te zetten en zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de verdere professionalisering van het debiteurenbeheer.

De energie die je meebrengt!

Je bent analytisch, zorgvuldig en gewend om zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen binnen jouw vakgebied. Je houdt overzicht in complexe dossiers, stelt de juiste prioriteiten en durft kritisch te zijn wanneer processen beter kunnen. Tegelijkertijd verlies je de klant en de commerciële belangen van NieuweStroom niet uit het oog.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een financiële of bedrijfseconomische richting;

  • Meerdere jaren ervaring binnen debiteurenbeheer, creditmanagement of een vergelijkbare financiële omgeving;

  • Ervaring met het behandelen van complexe debiteurendossiers en betalingsvraagstukken;

  • Ervaring met het analyseren en verbeteren van financiële processen;

  • Een goede beheersing van Excel en bij voorkeur ervaring met financiële software;

  • Het vermogen om analyses en bevindingen te vertalen naar duidelijke acties en adviezen;

  • Een stevige en professionele communicatiestijl, zowel richting klanten als collega’s;

  • Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 32 uur per week.

title: Senior Data Scientist (Trust & Fraud)
description:
Get to Know Our Team

We are architects of trust. Our mission: shield Grab ecosystem from evolving fraud and safety threats by turning massive datasets into applicable intelligence. From deploying sequence-based models for payment risk to applying graph algorithms that unmask complex money laundering networks, we operate at intersection of deep learning and platform security. We innovate constantly, researching latest methods to neutralise tactics before they surface.

Get to Know the Role

You fight fraud by analysing transactional data, developing and deploying machine learning models, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate fraud detection systems. Reporting to Executive Director, Data Science and Analytics, you will work as Individual Contributor in full-time on-site role at Grab KL office. You will push boundaries of machine learning and LLM applications at super-app scale, growing expertise in cutting-edge agentic systems. Apply today to help keep Grab platform safe and trustworthy!

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • You will partner with teams to architect scalable data science solutions that translate complex operational challenges into strategic wins, integrating traditional ML and agentic LLM systems.
  • You will conduct research to incorporate advancements in algorithms and generative AI into defense systems to counter emerging fraud tactics.
  • You will master data orchestration by preparing, augmenting, and combining diverse data types to build high-fidelity training datasets, using LLMs to generate synthetic data and labels.
  • You will design, train, and fine-tune model architectures, utilizing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), Transformers, fine-tuned open-source LLMs (like Qwen), and Gradient Boosted Trees.
  • You will lead end-to-end lifecycle of models—from production deployment to performance monitoring—iterating alongside software and product engineering teams.
  • You will leverage Generative AI tools (like coding assistants and analytical co-pilots) in daily workflows to accelerate code generation, automate testing, and enhance overall productivity.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • You hold degree in Computer Science, Physics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or related quantitative field.
  • You have at least 3 years of experience with proficiency in Python and SQL, alongside practical experience using distributed engines like Spark to wrangle large-scale datasets.
  • You have hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models using standard libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, LightGBM, or Scikit-learn.
  • You have practical experience with deep learning architectures (Transformers, RNNs, CNNs) and traditional ML (Boosted Trees), demonstrating ability to choose optimal architecture for specific problems.
  • You have experience with LLM and Agentic system foundations (e.g., RAG, Transformers) and hands-on experience building or using frameworks like LangGraph, LangChain, or Claude subagents.
  • You have experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas.

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.

What we stand for at Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Process Technician (R&D Advanced Packaging in Optical Interconnect & Co-Packaged Optics)
description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.


What We Offer


Location:

Singapore,SGP

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Process Technician, you'll be responsible for preparing wafers for experimentation, operating reactors to perform thin film processes, and using scanning electron microscopes for analyses and imaging. You'll record process conditions and experimental observations, perform routine maintenance procedures, and evaluate wafers and thin films. Process Technicians are tasked with preparing cross-section samples for analysis, identifying patterns of interest in imaging, and operating laboratory process equipment and instrumentation. Your expertise in troubleshooting, equipment maintenance, and process optimization drives higher levels of productivity, quality, and efficiency in our manufacturing processes.

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Process Technician in R&D to join our CTO Office Photonic Technology Group (PTG) with a focus on the area of optical interconnect and co-packaged optics. This position is based in Applied Materials Singapore.

As a Process Technician in R&D, you will support the development of advanced packaging processes on a variety of semiconductor processing tools. Working closely with process engineers, you will run experiments on process tools, collect metrology and inspection data, and help keep development schedules on track. This role suits someone who is detail-oriented, hands-on, disciplined with data, good and clear communication, and keen to work on cutting-edge technology.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Execute assigned process steps on process development for advanced semiconductor processes following SOPs and engineer instructions.
  • Perform metrology and inspection (e.g., film thickness, profiler step height, AFM, optical inspection, etc.) and organize and share data with engineers in a clear, traceable format.
  • Perform first-level tool and recipe checks during process runs and escalate abnormalities promptly to the team or equipment owners.
  • Implement recipe or process changes as directed by the engineer and record the changes accurately.
  • Coordinate tool time with internal and external tool owners to keep the development on schedule.
  • Maintain lot tracking, logbooks, and wafer/sample inventory.
  • Logistics support for samples transport between Singapore facilities and shipping in and out of Singapore.

Requirements:

  • 3 years+ experience in semiconductor R&D or manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Familiarity with cleanroom operations and semiconductor processing equipment is a plus.
  • ITE/ Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Materials Science) or related field.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to take new tasks.
  • Basic understanding of process control and data analysis.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills.
  • Able to support occasional overtime when required.

Work Location:

  • Science Park II (Moving to Tampines in 2027 Q1-Q2), Singapore


Shift Pattern:

  • Normal office hours (Mon - Fri)

Additional Information

Time Type:

Full time

Employee Type:

Assignee / Regular

Travel:

No

Relocation Eligible:

No
