title: Clinical Quality and Audit Lead
description:
As a member of our esteemed Clinical Excellence Team, you will play a vital role in upholding the efficacy, safety, and overall quality of our patient-centered, technology-enabled physiotherapy services. Specifically, in the capacity of Clinical Quality & Audit Lead, you will leverage your extensive clinical expertise, ideally in Musculoskeletal (MSK) Physiotherapy, to become a senior contributor to our Clinical Excellence directorate.

In this influential position, you'll take charge of robust oversight, proactive leadership, and rigorous validation to ensure clinical excellence, maintain high-quality standards, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Your role is characterized by its data-centric and analytical nature, emphasizing the meticulous execution of quality assurance protocols, comprehensive auditing, and focused improvement activities.

Your responsibilities span a wide spectrum, including the evaluation of patient experience metrics, treatment effectiveness, clinical outcomes, pathway compliance, legislative adherence, risk assessment, and audit protocols. Your contributions will be integral in preserving our commitment to delivering outstanding patient care and advancing the field of physiotherapy.

How your role fits within our team

Auditing is a key aspect of this role, where you'll conduct thorough clinical audits across various service lines, identifying areas for improvement and best practices. Data analytics will be your ally, enabling you to evaluate incidents, enhance patient safety, optimize patient experiences, and measure outcomes effectively.

Collaboration is integral, and you'll work closely with our Clinical Development, Clinical Governance, and Digital Teams, fostering a culture of excellence throughout the organisation. Additionally, you'll establish robust systems for the early detection of quality issues and risk factors, ensuring that our services continually improve.

Your role will also involve generating regular reports that provide valuable insights for our internal leadership and enhance transparency and trust with our external customers.

About you

In this data-centric and analytical position, you will drive the quality, safety, and effectiveness of our patient-centered, tech-enabled physiotherapy services. With a focus on Musculoskeletal (MSK) Physiotherapy, you'll become a cornerstone in upholding the clinical excellence that defines us.

Your responsibilities encompass strategic leadership, where you'll spearhead our clinical audit, quality agenda, and continuous improvement efforts, ensuring that we consistently deliver the highest standards of care. You'll innovate by developing and implementing comprehensive quality frameworks and methodologies that set the bar for excellence in patient care.

Culture and benefits

You will benefit from a competitive salary, 25 days of annual leave (+ bank holidays) and a great loyalty-based benefits package, which includes Vitality at Work membership, enhanced family (mat & pat) leave, free and discounted healthcare services and many other perks and rewards.

Ascenti is committed to continuous learning and progression, meaning that there will also be ample support and coaching in your role, with opportunities for you to develop if you wish. The goal is for Ascenti to be a workplace that creates a sense of belonging for everyone. This means that they actively work to promote equal opportunities across all that they do, including when recruiting new talent.

Apply now

If you're passionate about driving clinical excellence and dedicated to improving patient care, we invite you to apply for the role of Clinical Quality & Audit Lead. Join us in making a difference in the lives of our patients and contributing to the future of physiotherapy.

As part of our Safer Recruitment procedures, this role will require a criminal reference check.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • HCPC registered Physiotherapist
  • Extensive experience in a clinical role, preferably in Musculoskeletal (MSK) Physiotherapy (Minimum 4 years post-graduate musculoskeletal physiotherapy practice experience; preferably in both public and private settings).
Experience
  • Experience in conducting clinical audits and implementing quality assurance systems.
  • Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management.
  • Proven track record in leading projects to successful completion.

Recruitment Process

Following application review and an initial screening stage, shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short assessment before interview.

The assessment is designed to understand your experience of using data to identify issues or opportunities, deliver improvement initiatives, and measure outcomes.

Candidates will be asked to provide a real-world example from their professional experience, outlining how they analysed data, implemented change, engaged stakeholders, and evaluated the impact of their actions.

This exercise helps us understand your approach to data-driven decision making, continuous improvement, and delivering measurable results.

Please note: this is a fixed-term position until October - December 2027.

title: Director, Enterprise Insight Platform
description:
Role Summary: We are seeking a strategic product leader to join our organization as the Director, Enterprise Insight Platforms, reporting directly to the Director II, Enterprise Data & Analytics Products. In this pivotal role, you will be the definitive Business Product Owner for Pulse Nexus, AbbVie’s flagship enterprise decision intelligence platform.

Your mandate is to build and scale the ultimate "marketplace for insights"—a single pane of glass for all commercial data and analytics products. You will transform how insights are discovered, trusted, and consumed from senior leaders, brand teams, analysts, and researchers. By leading a dedicated, cross-functional product pod consisting of BI product owners, semantic leads, AI prototypers, and UX researchers, you will seamlessly integrate executive dashboards, AI solutions, and analytics tools into one intuitive marketplace ecosystem.

You will not just build a portal; you will define the enterprise semantic layer and ensure that every insight surfaced through Pulse Nexus is governed, certified, and instantly actionable, empowering U.S. Commercial leaders to make faster, higher-confidence decisions.

Responsibilities:

  • Platform Vision & Product Leadership: Own the end-to-end strategy, roadmap, and backlog for Pulse Nexus. Serve as the authoritative product leader, evolving the platform into a comprehensive decision intelligence ecosystem that acts as the single pane of glass for all commercial data and analytics products.
  • Insight Marketplace Orchestration: Design and scale an intuitive, role-based "marketplace for insights." Ensure that diverse personas (executives, brand leaders, analytics producers) can effortlessly discover, access, and consume the exact data, reports, and AI tools they need without navigating fragmented legacy systems.
  • Semantic & Knowledge Layer Ownership: Own the business logic and semantic architecture of the platform. Enforce enterprise data governance at the point of consumption by establishing canonical KPIs, embedded business glossaries, and certified data lineage, ensuring absolute trust in the numbers.
  • Executive Delivery & Automation: Direct the automation of manually generated reports and shift the organization to automated, always-current narratives consumed directly within the platform.
  • AI-Native Integration: Lead the embedding of next-generation AI into the consumption layer. Partner with Data Science and AI prototyping teams to integrate conversational AI, agentic data retrieval, and intelligent search capabilities directly into the Pulse Nexus user interface.
  • Cross-Functional Pod Execution: Direct an agile, cross-functional execution pod. Define the business requirements, UX/UI design, and semantic logic, while partnering seamlessly with Data Foundation (for underlying pipelines) and Advanced Analytics (for algorithmic inputs) under a committed delivery model.
  • Adoption & Value Realization: Hold ultimate accountability for platform adoption. Spearhead the organizational change management required to migrate users away from disjointed dashboards and spreadsheets, tracking success through active utilization, time-to-insight, and executive feedback.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related discipline; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of professional experience in product management, business intelligence, decision intelligence, or data strategy, preferably within the Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences, or Tech industries.
  • Proven track record of building and scaling enterprise insight platforms, data marketplaces, or highly adopted BI/analytics portals for large, matrixed organizations.
  • Deep understanding of the "Platform-as-a-Product" lifecycle, including UI/UX design, persona-based journey mapping, and agile backlog prioritization.
  • Strong fluency in modern semantic architectures, data governance, and the integration of AI/LLMs into user-facing enterprise applications.
  • Exceptional executive presence and stakeholder management skills; capable of defining acceptance criteria with C-suite/ELT leaders and enforcing standard metric definitions across fiercely independent business units.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional pods (BI analysts, semantic engineers, UX designers) and partner effectively with foundational data engineering and data science teams.

title: Camp Maintenance - Northern Manitoba Remote Camp Operations
description:
WHAT'S THE JOB?

Report to the Camp Manager, the Camp Maintenance Worker is responsible for maintenance in a camp setting to ensure the functionality, safety, and cleanliness of the camp facilities.

This position is safety sensitive and requires a criminal record check.

The position involves a remote work lifestyle in a camp setting with the following amenities:

  • All meals and accommodations are provided
  • Travel is provided to and from the site locations from designated locations in Winnipeg, Thompson, Flin Flon and The Pas.
  • Private room with cable television
  • Access to Wi-Fi
  • Access to laundry facilities and detergents
  • Access to a gym and common areas

General Maintenance & Repairs

  • Perform all site-wide building-related maintenance and complete assigned projects from the Camp Coordinator or Supervisor.
  • Conduct routine inspections and complete preventative maintenance on buildings, appliances, and infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot and perform minor repairs on plumbing, electrical, and mechanical systems.
  • Carry out drywall, carpentry, painting, and general repair work as needed.
  • Maintain HVAC systems and gas-fired appliances in good working condition.

Equipment & System Upkeep

  • Support the operation and maintenance of diesel generators, sump/lift stations, and camp utilities.
  • Maintain, inspect, and repair kitchen appliances (fridges, stoves, dishwashers, fryers), laundry machines, and other essential equipment.
  • Monitor and maintain fire alarms, emergency lights, and safety equipment across camp

Site Services

  • Perform snow removal, sanding, de-icing, and seasonal outdoor maintenance around buildings and access points.
  • Operate small machinery and equipment such as skid-steer loaders when required.
  • Ensure the upkeep of exterior structures such as stairs, walkways, and decks.

Emergency & Safety Response

  • Respond promptly to urgent repair needs, including power outages, leaks, and equipment failures.
  • Ensure systems and repairs comply with safety regulations and internal policies.
  • Conduct fire safety inspections and participate in emergency preparedness procedures.

Administrative & Reporting Duties

  • Document maintenance activities, repairs, inspections, and equipment usage in accordance with company procedures.
  • Use maintenance tracking tools and inventory systems to log work and report deficiencies.
  • Coordinate with camp departments to minimize downtime and support smooth operations.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

  • Related maintenance experience in remote lodge setting or hotel/institutional environment is required
  • Journeyman Trade Certification preferred
  • Valid G Class or Class 5 Drivers License and clean abstract preferred
  • Knowledge of and experience using light power tools is required
  • Must be able to successfully pass a Criminal Background Check
  • Must be able to successfully pass pre-employment drug and alcohol testing
  • Ability to commit to a 2 week on/1 week off rotation
  • A team-player who is committed to providing client satisfaction
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks demands and organize a work schedule
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Familiarity with Microsoft applications and use of maintenance reporting software
  • Ability to handle the following physical demands:
    • Lift, carry, push or pull up to 50 lbs
    • Climb ladders or stairs
    • Stand, walk, squat, kneel or sit according to task for extended periods of time
    • Perform repetitive hand work requiring full use of both hands
    • Work with arms above shoulder height

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • Enjoy excellent work-life balance with a 2 week on/ 1 week off rotation
  • Ability to expand skills in a large camp atmosphere
  • Whereas other companies are downsizing, we are growing!
  • Be #1 on day 1 by joining an industry leader

Work schedule and remuneration:

Camp Maintenance Workers work on a rotational schedule of 2 weeks on/1 week off. Site locations are in remote settings, requiring either air travel to site, or via ground on our shuttle. You may be required to work nights, weekdays, weekends, and general holidays. Wages are paid on an hourly basis with a starting rate of $30.00 per hour.

title: Analog IC Design Engineer
description:
Fairchild Imaging, headquartered in San Jose, California is a specialty image sensor design and manufacturing company with deep experience in developing leading edge performance CMOS image sensors. Our portfolio of image sensors can be found in many high-performance imaging applications like space exploration, medical x-ray, sciences, quantum computing, machine vision, low light, and 360 situational awareness.

Analog IC Design Engineer

We are seeking an experienced Integrated Circuit Engineer who is responsible for designing, simulating, and testing analog circuits using CMOS technology. This role requires ability to work on building blocks such as amplifiers, oscillators, and data converters. The role involves collaborating with other engineers to ensure that the circuits meet performance, power, and area requirements, as well as troubleshooting and optimizing designs for manufacturing. In addition, use specialized software tools for circuit simulation and layout verification.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop precision analog building blocks.
  • Run schematic-level simulations, pre- and post-layout parasitic extractions.
  • Supervise or execute physical layout design.

Required Qualifications

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, or related field.
  • 3 to 8 years of industry experience working with deep-submicron CMOS processes (ranging from mature nodes like 180nm, 65nm down to 20nm
  • Deep understanding of CMOS device physics, analog microelectronics, feedback systems, stability, and low-noise design.
  • Expertise in building blocks like operational amplifiers, bandgap reference, LDOs (Low-Dropout regulators), oscillators (VCO, ring, LC tank), and data converters (ADCs/DACs, PLLs, LVDS, sLVDS, SerDes).
  • Proficiency in simulation and layout software, primarily Cadence (Virtuoso, Spectre, AMS) and Spice.
  • Understanding IC layout constraints, floor planning, and running DRC (Design Rule Checking), LVS (Layout Versus Schematic), and ERC (Electrical Rule Checking).

Preferred Qualifications

  • CMOS image sensor design or sensor readout electronics.
  • Experience with Stacked chips and/or 1D-2D Stitching.
  • Mixed-signal integration with digital blocks.
  • Low-noise and low-power design.

Fairchild Imaging provides our employees with a range in benefits offerings that includes:

  • 9/80 Schedule - You get every other Friday off!
  • Medical, Dental and Vision coverage with multiple plan offerings
  • Health Savings Account with an employer contribution annually
  • 401(k) retirement plans with Employer matching

title: BHI Civics Internship – Spring 2027 (Remote)
description:
About the Role: Civics Team Intern

The Civics Team Intern (CTI) supports Blue Haven Civics, which aims to strengthen the foundations of American democracy. Blue Haven Civics invests philanthropic and occasional for-profit capital in efforts to strengthen youth civic engagement, reduce corruption in politics, and make our tax system more equitable. We believe in equipping the next generation with the tools and skills necessary to create fairer markets, ensure more effective governance, and advance progressive policies. Organizations we support include Higher Ground Labs, Issue One, Voices for Progress, Free Speech For People, and Americans for Tax Fairness.

The Spring CTI is a part-time remote internship (15 - 20 hours a week) and will be compensated at $20 to $22 an hour based on experience. Internships will begin in January and last about 18 weeks. Interns are expected to work within BHC office hours, which are 8:00 am - 5:00 pm ET Mondays through Thursdays, and 8:00 am - 12:00 pm ET Fridays.

Throughout the internship, BHC will operate under the following learning objectives:

  • Introduce interns to how philanthropy and advocacy can advance progressive political issues.
  • Train interns on how to prepare Congressional-quality briefings and research materials.
  • Empower interns to understand the importance of civics education and the youth vote.
  • Provide interns with experiences to engage with a variety of entities beyond the family office, including non-profit organizations, political campaigns, political candidates, and grassroots advocates.
  • Foster an independent spirit in interns by granting them ownership over their work and accomplishments.

Responsibilities of the CTI include, but are not limited to:

  • Drafting research memoranda and visual presentations on items of interest and providing general project support across the portfolio of civic engagement activities.
  • Engaging in, and contributing to, strategy meetings about how to advance work on various projects and campaigns.
  • Preparing the Principal for meetings, speaking engagements, and other events through written materials and verbal briefings.
  • Attending events of interest to BHI and providing written insights on these meetings.
  • Creating, organizing, and managing a folder for briefings, memos, and memoranda.

The ideal candidate will possess the following attributes:

  • Demonstrated long-term enthusiasm about voting and civic engagement, social justice, progressive politics, policy, or youth leadership.
  • Detail-oriented approach to all tasks, large and small.
  • Well-organized and proactive.
  • Able to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, or a willingness to learn.
  • Ability to independently and creatively conduct research, or a willingness to learn.
  • 0 – 2 years of work experience. Experience in organizing, politics, government, philanthropy, or consulting is welcome but not required.

We believe that university degrees are not accessible to everyone. Therefore, this role does not require a university education. At Blue Haven Initiative, we believe that generating social impact starts with diverse teams and partners. This means cultivating an equitable workplace that encourages collaboration and creativity, and we actively recruit and empower people who represent the diverse next generation of leadership. Applicants will never be disqualified nor discriminated against by race, class, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, veteran or disability status, criminal history, or educational attainment.

To Apply

Please apply through our external application. We are accepting applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage potential candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Additionally, you will be asked to answer short writing prompts. Please limit your response to 200 words or less. BHI strongly discourages the use of AI for the purposes of this written statement and we run all applications through an AI checker.

Lastly, please consider answering the Equal Opportunity Employment questions included in our application to help us track and improve the inclusivity of our recruitment process. Answering the survey is entirely voluntary, and whether you respond will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you share will be maintained in a confidential file not accessible to the hiring team.

If you have any questions about Blue Haven or the Civics Fall Internship position, we encourage you to reach out to the team at civicsintern@bluehaveninitiative.com.

title: Field Technician
description:
Astro Pak is the nation's leading precision cleaning and passivation contractor specializing in on-site cleaning of high purity gas and fluid systems, as well as precision cleaning of components and hardware at the company’s Cleanroom facilities. Astro Pak provides services to over 15 sectors including: Data Centers, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical, Aerospace, Semiconductor, and other selected Industrial markets. The company, founded in 1959, has performed on-site precision chemical cleaning in every State of the Union as well as several projects in Asia, Canada, continental Europe, England, Ireland and Mexico.

Astro Pak is looking for motivated individuals who want more than a typical job. As an Associate Field Technician, you’ll travel to cutting-edge facilities across the country while learning a specialized technical trade used in industries like aerospace, semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, and advanced manufacturing.

If you enjoy hands-on work, solving problems, and seeing new places while building valuable technical skills, this role could be a great fit.

********$3,000 Sign-On Bonus********

What You’ll Experience

This is not a typical entry-level job. It’s a traveling technical career path.

You’ll receive immersive training and work alongside experienced technicians performing specialized chemical cleaning and passivation on mission-critical fluid and gas systems.

Every project is different. One week you may be working at a semiconductor facility, the next supporting aerospace manufacturing.

Expect:

  • Extensive travel to project sites across the U.S.
  • Hands-on work with specialized equipment and chemical processes
  • Rapid skill development and certifications
  • Opportunities to grow into senior technician or leadership roles

Travel requirements:

  • 80%+ travel nationwide
  • 30–50% night shift work
  • Overtime, weekends, holidays, and short-notice travel may be required

What You’ll Do

As part of a field service team, you will:

  • Set up and operate specialized equipment for chemical cleaning and passivation
  • Safely handle process chemicals such as citric acid and caustics
  • Use PPE and follow strict safety and compliance procedures
  • Load, transport, and unload project equipment and materials
  • Drive company vehicles to job sites (vans, trucks, forklifts)

title: Executive Business Partner
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Executive Administrative Business Partner

Wherever Waymo works, Business Support teams are on the job. We're the partners who plan events, work with external partners, and orchestrate the daily activities of our teams and leaders, the real estate specialists who find and build amazing workspaces and research facilities; the systems experts who develop and run our intuitive IT and business tools. Together, we do everything it takes to keep Waymo rolling.

In this hybrid role, you will report into Executive Team Leadership.

You will:

  • Independently execute essential administrative functions, including travel, expenses, confidential calendar management, and facilities coordination with limited guidance
  • Proactively solve problems, exercising sound judgment and discretion even with limited information
  • Collaborate effectively and build trust with executives, cross-functional partners (e.g., HR, Finance, Chief of Staff), and teams across the organization to achieve complex objectives
  • Utilize strong communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport, influence collaboration, and engage effectively with diverse internal and external stakeholders
  • Lead and deliver medium-to-large scale projects or events from initiation through completion
  • Influence collaboration between Waymonauts and build rapport, positively impacting team velocity

You have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of experience providing direct executive support, project management, or event planning to senior leaders (VP+) within a fast-paced technology or startup environment
  • Experience managing complex scheduling and logistics with external partners, demonstrating responsiveness, flexibility, and sound judgment with confidentiality.
  • Exceptional organizational, time management, and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple complex tasks in a dynamic setting.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills: Proven ability to build strong relationships, collaborate effectively across diverse teams/functions, and maintain strict confidentiality.
  • Strong business acumen, analytical problem-solving skills, and the ability to adapt effectively to different leadership styles and partnership dynamics.

We prefer:

  • Tech Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to leverage technology for increased efficiency and quickly adopt new tools.
  • Project Leadership & Operational Problem Solving: Proven ability to lead projects, manage processes, and independently resolve operational issues through strategic thinking and data analysis.

Travel Requirement: Occasional travel, while rare, might be needed to support a combination of partnership and internal onsite support at other locations (domestic and international).

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Salary Range
$63.47—$78.37 USD

title: Senior SRE
description:
WirelessCar’s Journey

WirelessCar drives the future of mobility by connecting vehicles and developing cutting-edge digital services. We help leading brands—like Volkswagen, Volvo, and Jaguar Land Rover—innovate, enhance mobility, and accelerate their digital transformation. Join us and shape the next era of automotive technology!
We are looking for a Senior Service Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our Operations team. As an SRE, you'll be responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of our connected vehicle services running in production.

You'll combine software engineering principles with operational excellence to troubleshoot complex production issues, improve system resilience, and drive continuous improvements across our cloud-native platform. Working closely with developers, architects, and other stakeholders, you'll play a key role in delivering highly reliable services that support millions of connected vehicles.

We offer you

  • High-tech company that offers an exciting working environment

  • Involvement with Electric Vehicle services and products that drive sustainability.

  • Tech fund where you pick your choice of tech tools.

  • Flat organizational culture founded on trust and autonomy; at WirelessCar, you are not just a number.

  • Hybrid Work-life balance

What You'll Do

As a Senior Service Reliability Engineer,
8+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Operations, or Infrastructure Engineering.
you will:

  • Monitor and maintain production services to ensure high availability, reliability, and performance.

  • Lead and participate in incident response, including major incidents, with a focus on minimizing Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR).

  • Coordinate stakeholders during incidents and communicate status updates clearly and effectively.

  • Perform root cause analyses (RCA) and facilitate post-incident reviews (PIR) to drive long-term improvements.

  • Identify recurring issues and implement preventive measures through problem management.

  • Support change management activities while ensuring operational stability and service continuity.

  • Troubleshoot complex issues across cloud infrastructure, container platforms, distributed systems, databases, APIs, and backend applications.

  • Collaborate closely with DevOps teams to improve observability, automation, and operational readiness.

  • Continuously improve monitoring, alerting, operational processes, and system reliability.

  • Ensure compliance with security requirements, operational standards, and agreed service level agreements (SLAs).

  • Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation according to team schedules.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm.

  • Solid understanding of AWS fundamentals.

  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Dynatrace, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, or OpenTelemetry (OTEL).

  • Experience troubleshooting Kafka and distributed systems.

  • Database troubleshooting experience with PostgreSQL, Oracle, and/or MongoDB.

  • REST API troubleshooting.

  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or Concourse.

  • Experience troubleshooting Java backend applications and JVM-based services.

Nice to Have

  • MQTT experience.

  • AWS EKS.

  • Infrastructure automation using Ansible or scripting.

  • Experience working with connected vehicle platforms or automotive backend systems.

Operational Experience

We're looking for someone with experience in,

  • Incident Management.

  • Major Incident Management.

  • Acting as Incident Commander during critical incidents.

  • Problem Management.

  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

  • Post Incident Reviews (PIR).

  • Change Management.

  • SLA-driven operations.

  • ITIL-based service management.

Experience with the following is considered an advantage:

  • Service transition and knowledge transfer.

  • SAFe or Agile delivery.

  • Vendor coordination within multi-supplier environments.

Who You Are

You are someone who,

  • Takes ownership and drives issues through to resolution.

  • Has a structured, analytical approach to troubleshooting.

  • Remains calm and focused during high-pressure production incidents.

  • Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Can coordinate multiple teams during critical situations.

  • Makes sound decisions, even when information is incomplete.

  • Is passionate about continuous improvement and operational excellence.

  • Enjoys coaching and mentoring colleagues.

  • Demonstrates technical leadership and strong stakeholder management skills.

  • Thrives in collaborative, cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Professional working proficiency in English.


Why Join WirelessCar?

At WirelessCar, you'll work alongside talented colleagues from around the world in an open, collaborative, and innovative environment. We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, explore new technologies, and continuously grow their careers while building solutions that shape the future of connected mobility.

If you're passionate about reliability, cloud technologies, and solving complex operational challenges at scale, we'd love to hear from you.


Please note:

  • Participation in a 24/7 on-call rotation is required for this position.

Way of Working

The work location for this role is our office in central Bangalore, India.
At WirelessCar we operate in a hybrid setup, combining the benefits of office collaboration with the flexibility of remote work.

Recruitment Process:

Apply now and join our journey!

Last application date: November 30, 2026

Note before applying: Our company language is English, please submit your application in English, cover letter is not required; instead, you will answer a few short questions to help us understand your experience and ambitions.

To join our journey
WirelessCar is always on the move, often into uncharted land. We are curious, believe in collaboration and are always open to new ideas on how we can make a difference. When you join our journey, you will be part of a great crew of highly competent and warm hearted people from all over the world.

title: Director of Finance & Operations
description:
JOB TITLE: Director of Finance & Operations

FLSA status: Exempt

Department: Finance & Administration

Reports to: Vice President of Finance & Operations


Position Summary: The Director of Finance and Operations leads The Night Ministry's accounting, finance and business administration, and oversees technology support and facilities. The Director keeps the organization's finances accurate, compliant and well managed, in support of its mission and strategic goals.

As a member of the Strategic Leadership Team, the Director is a strategic partner to senior leadership. The role works closely with board committees, managers, funders, vendors and staff, and guides the team in sound financial practice across the organization.


Role Qualifications

  • Must work with Vice President of Finance & Operations, management and leadership teams to create long-term strategies that will fulfill the organization’s mission and business development goals
  • Possess a thorough understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Procedures as they apply to nonprofit organizations
  • Must demonstrate professional and interpersonal skills and commitment consistent with the mission of The Night Ministry
  • Must provide leadership in both strategic planning and daily operations for Accounting and Finance functions
  • Ability to effectively collaborate and interact with co-workers and outside constituencies in a manner that is professional, productive, and reflective of The Night Ministry’s core values


Position Responsibilities


Finance

  • Responsible for all aspects of accounting functions at The Night Ministry, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Payroll
  • Responsible for overseeing Staff Accountants preparing of grant vouchers that accurately reflect TNM’s spend against approved funder budgets prepared for government funding sources.
  • Provide analysis of monthly financial reports and clearly communicate monthly and annual financial statements for use by Management and the Board of Directors of TNM and AMO.
  • Create and present custom financial reports by request.
  • Lead annual audit process. Act as a liaison with external auditors and the Audit and Finance Committee of the Board of Directors as well as intermittent financial audit process when requested by funders such as DFSS or IDHS.
  • Oversee and lead the annual budgeting and planning process in conjunction with the Department leaders. Review financial plans and budgets; monitor progress and changes and keep Strategic Leadership Team abreast of organization’s financial status. Manage organizational cash flow. Oversee the cash management function including banking relationships.
  • Continually monitor internal controls to assure safeguarding of assets and reporting systems by implementing appropriate policies and procedures. Also provide for safe custody, handling and keeping of cash.
  • Work closely with VP and Board Treasurer to review and present monthly financial statements, including annual budget and cash flow projections
  • Ensure that accounting practices and results comply with contractual and funding source obligations, applicable government and regulatory requirements, and overall objectives of The Night Ministry. Ensure all financial matters are in accordance with ethical accounting practices and generally accepted accounting principles.
  • Work closely with Vice President to review all insurance policies and prepare renewal paperwork for these policies, including general liability package, Directors and Officers policies, professional liability, and workers compensation insurance.
  • Make technological and efficiency recommendations to VP concerning IT, A/P, accounting and payroll systems
  • Attend meetings of the TNM Board of Directors twice a year to present annual budget and to present audited financial statements, or by request if needed.


Operations

  • Oversee the Technology Support and Facilities management departments.
  • Design, improve, and champion internal workflows and communication protocols to foster collaboration, eliminate friction, and drive team efficiency.
  • Serve as the primary organizational liaison and business partner to external IT consultants and engineering/facilities vendors. In partnership with our IT Manager, oversee compliance with data security policies and ensure staff adhere to protocols related to password management, multi-factor authentication, and secure data handling.
  • Act as an organizational "translator", turning complex operational processes and system updates into clear, digestible guidance for a diverse, mission-driven team.

Administration

  • As a member of the Strategic Leadership Team, collaborates with Team Members to address needs of the Organization and to plan for its future
  • Lead annual budget process for administration department expenses; monitor expenses monthly; approve invoices in a timely manner for payment
  • Meet regularly with employees in supervisory meetings; timely completion of mid-year and annual performance appraisals; timely review and approval of biweekly timecards
  • According to The Night Ministry’s policies, this position is expected to carry a cell phone and is eligible for partial reimbursement of monthly cell phone bills


Essentials Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting required; related master’s degree and/or CPA preferred
  • Minimum 7-10 years’ experience in accounting/ finance; 5 years non-profit accounting experience
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial regulations, and reporting requirements for non-profit organizations.
  • Technology savvy with proficiency in Excel and knowledge and experience with accounting and reporting software
  • A successful track record in setting priorities; keen analytic, organization, and problem-solving skills that support and enable sound decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with an ability to prioritize, negotiate, and work with a variety of internal and external stakeholders; demonstrated experience as a supervisor and manager.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • A multi-tasker with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Personal qualities of integrity, credibility, and a commitment to maintaining confidentiality
  • Deep personal and professional commitment to equity and inclusion in the workplace.


Reporting to this position: Accounting Manager, Staff Accountant, Technology Support Manager and Facilities Manager


Physical Demands and Work Environment: The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit; use hands to handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; climb stairs; crouch or crawl; and talk and hear. The employee must occasionally drive and lift or move up to 20 pounds. Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.


Work Schedule: This is a hybrid role. The employee is expected to work on-site four days per week, with one remote workday. The remote day may change or be eliminated based on business needs.


Compensation: Position offers base salary with benefits package

title: Winkelstage regio Mechelen & Rand rond Brussel
description:
Wat ga je leren en doen tijdens je stage?

Als stagiair(e) krijg je een heldere inkijk in én ervaring met alle facetten van het winkelgebeuren:

  • Winkeloperatie & variatie: je ontdekt de dynamiek van de winkel — van het beheren van de groente- en fruitafdeling tot het vers afbakken van de lekkerste croissants in onze bakkerij.
  • Klantenservice & kassa: je helpt onze klanten met een glimlach verder, kijkt mee aan de kassa en zorgt voor een aangename winkelervaring.
  • Voorraad & beheer: je leert hoe de goederenstroom werkt, hoe we de versheid garanderenen hoe de winkel er altijd strak en uitnodigend bij ligt.
  • Teamwork & begeleiding: je werkt nauw samen met ervaren collega’s, Assistant Store Managers en de Store Manager. Je ziet van dichtbij hoe #teamlidl op de winkelvloer wordt aangestuurd.
Wie ben jij?
  • Je volgt een relevante opleiding (bijv. Retail, Handel, Verkoop,...) verbonden aan een school instantie en zoekt een stageplek voor minstens 4 weken.
  • Je bent minstens 16 jaar.
  • Je bent een echte teamspeler met een flinke dosis enthousiasme en bent een doener die energie krijgt van concrete actie.
  • Je bent leergierig, klantgericht en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.
Wat bieden wij jou?
  • Echte praktijkervaring: een gevarieerde stage waarin je alle kneepjes van het retailvak leert kennen.
  • Topwerksfeer: een warme, open en collegiale werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich thuis voelt en gelijk is.
  • Persoonlijke groei: volop ruimte om te ontdekken wat je in je mars hebt. We moeten allemaal ergens beginnen, toch?
  • Toekomstperspectief: klikt het langs beide kanten? Dan bekijken we graag de mogelijkheden voor een studentenjob of een vaste job na je afstuderen. Lidl biedt je alle kansen!

We zijn ervan overtuigd dat diversiteit onze organisatie sterker maakt en verwelkomen iedereen. Ongeacht leeftijd, afkomst, genderidentiteit, geaardheid, geloof, of handicap. Gelijke kansen en eerlijke beloning staan bij ons centraal.

title: Senior Architect - FO
description:
Hitachi Solutions is seeking an experienced Finance Architect to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale finance transformations. In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to clients, helping organizations modernize financial operations, improve business processes, and maximize the value of their technology investments.

As a Finance Architect, you will bring deep expertise across core financial management functions, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank management, fixed assets, budgeting, and project accounting. You will work closely with business leaders, finance stakeholders, project teams, and executive sponsors to evaluate current-state processes, identify improvement opportunities, and design scalable future-state solutions aligned to strategic business objectives.

A key responsibility of this role is leading discovery activities, requirements gathering, and fit-gap assessments. You will facilitate workshops, translate business needs into functional solution designs, and provide guidance throughout the implementation lifecycle. title: BIM Technician
description:
About Ethos

Ethos is a collaborative team of engineers, consultants, and creative thinkers designing and delivering data centre and energy infrastructure across the world's most dynamic markets. As a multidisciplinary consultancy, we combine technical expertise, creativity, and integrated delivery to lead complex, mission-critical projects.

Built on strong relationships, clear leadership, and a can-do mindset, Ethos is entering an exciting phase of growth, expanding our capabilities and taking on increasingly high-impact projects across EMEA and beyond.

Sustainability guides how we design, collaborate, and deliver, creating innovative solutions and lasting value for our clients and communities — making Performance Made Possible.

About the Job

The BIM Technician is responsible for producing coordinated, high-quality Revit models and drawings on data centre projects, working as part of a wider BIM and Engineering team.

This role focuses on MEP/M&E modelling, drawing production, and clash coordination in support of the BIM Project Lead and Engineering teams. The BIM Technician plays a hands-on role in day-to-day model production, ensuring deliverables are accurate, compliant, and aligned with project requirements.

Responsibilities:

Project BIM Delivery

  • Ensure all BIM deliverables meet project programme and milestones.

  • Monitor modelling progress and report status to the BIM Project Manager.

Model Coordination & Quality

  • Develop and maintain coordinated Revit models with other disciplines.

  • Run clash detection processes and coordinate issue resolution.

  • Identify clashes and communicate them clearly to Engineering Teams for resolution.

  • Ensure models are structured, efficient, and aligned with best practice.

Standard Compliance

  • Ensure all models comply with internal BIM standards and QA processes.

  • Implement client-specific BIM requirements on projects.

  • Maintain model integrity, naming conventions, and data consistency.

  • Ensure drawings extracted from models meet company quality standards.

  • Setup and develop Models in line with Client BEP requirements.

Drawing Production & Output

  • Oversee the production of drawings from Revit models.

  • Ensure drawings are accurate, coordinated, and ready for issue.

  • Maintain consistency across all project outputs.

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Represent Ethos in BIM coordination meetings.

  • Collaborate with Engineering Teams to align BIM models with design intent.

  • Coordinate with external consultants and project stakeholders.

  • Communicate BIM-related issues, risks, and progress effectively.

Model Health & Performance

  • Monitor model performance, file size, and usability.

  • Ensure models remain clean, efficient, and suitable for project use.

  • Implement best practices to avoid model degradation over time.

Key Objectives

  • Deliver coordinated, high-quality BIM models and drawings.

  • Ensure efficient and proactive coordination across disciplines.

  • Maintain consistency with BIM standards and project requirements.

  • Support predictable and reliable BIM delivery on projects.

Authority & Decision Making

  • Responsible for BIM coordination and delivery at project level.

  • Oversees modelling teams and day-to-day BIM activities.

  • Escalates technical or resource issues to the BIM Project Manager when required.

What This Role Does NOT Include

  • Engineering design decisions or approvals.

  • Responsibility for system layouts or technical calculations.

  • Issuing models externally without required approvals.

  • Changing BIM standards independently.

  • Commercial or contractual project management responsibilities.

Key Interfaces

  • BIM Project Manager (reporting and guidance)

  • Engineering Project Managers and Design Engineers

  • External consultants and coordination teams

About You

Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience in BIM delivery within MEP or multidisciplinary projects.

  • Experience working on large-scale or complex projects (e.g. data centres).

  • Experience leading or coordinating BIM teams on projects.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Revit MEP (essential).

  • Experience in clash detection tools (e.g. Navisworks).

  • Understanding of BIM coordination processes and workflows.

  • Familiarity with common data environments (e.g. ACC/FORMA).

  • Knowledge of BIM standards and QA processes.

  • Understanding of ISO 19650 principles.

  • Knowledge of industry Revit add-ins to streamline processes.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.

Success Measures

  • Models are fully coordinated with minimal clashes at issue stage.

  • Drawings are accurate, consistent, and compliant.

  • BIM deliverables meet programme deadlines.

  • Effective communication between BIM and Engineering teams.

  • High model quality and adherence to standards.

Why Join Us?

  • Join collaborative leaders – Work alongside experienced, approachable professionals who

    combine technical excellence with calm, supportive leadership.

  • Make a real impact – Contribute to mission-critical infrastructure projects that support the digital and energy transition across EMEA and beyond.

  • Grow with us – As a rapidly growing consultancy, we offer opportunities to develop your skills, broaden your experience, and build your career.

  • Shape a more sustainable future – Sustainability isn't an initiative—it's embedded in every project, every discipline, and every decision we make.


We offer:

  • Flexible Fridays and a 9-day fortnight working schedule — enjoy every second Friday off to maintain work–life balance.

  • A culture that values flexibility, learning, and teamwork, with clear progression pathways and support toward professional accreditation.

  • Opportunities to work alongside some of the most experienced engineers in the industry, within a forward-thinking, technology-driven consultancy.

Benefits:

  • Flexible working times

  • 20 Days holidays up to 25 days

  • Pension Scheme

  • Refer a Friend scheme

  • Healthcare check-ups and flu vaccinations

  • Gym / Fitness membership Allowance

  • Subsidised Health Insurance Allowance

  • Working travel out-of-pocket expenses

  • Travel tax scheme or bike-to-work scheme

  • Regular training/mentoring / further college support

  • Support for Chartership

  • A Professional Subscription Fee paid by the company

  • Paid Statutory Leaves

  • Heavily subsidised social committee

title: Advanced Physiotherapy Practitioner
description:
Advanced Physiotherapy Practitioner | Kidderminster | Part-time

Salary: £41,000 - £50,850 (pro rata)

Your purpose

As an Advanced Physiotherapy Practitioner (APP) you will be a clinical leader within Ascenti and work at the highest level to promote research-informed practice and clinical excellence across all that we do.

You will provide an advanced level of care to NHS patients presenting with a variety of complex conditions, using contemporary evidence-informed methodologies and with the technology, tools, and support that you need to thrive as an APP.

How your role fits within our team

You will work on your own in clinic or from home, but you will never feel alone.

As an Advanced Physiotherapy Practitioner (APP) you will collaborate with a range of other senior staff and departments across Ascenti, helping to shape our clinical philosophy and development curriculum.

You will also work closely with partners from the NHS service you work on and the managers in your region, at the same time as using our modern online tools to connected with our wider community of 300+ Ascenti physiotherapists.

Key responsibilities

  • Managing patients Independently manage your own clinical caseload of NHS patients presenting with a wide variety of complex conditions and goals.
  • Use high quality neuromusculoskeletal assessment skills to develop evidence-informed and highly effective management plans, utilising advanced theoretical and practical knowledge of complex and / or chronic presentation.
  • Determine clinical diagnosis and formulate individualised management and treatment plans, which may include: advice and discharge, referral to physiotherapy or other professions for management, request further investigations and diagnostic procedures (MRI, X-rays, blood tests) and interpret these in order to appropriately lead the assessment and direction of the patient’s pathway of care.
  • Work to fully understand the wider integrated NHS MSK service and local pathways across primary care, secondary care, and the voluntary sector, including referral criteria and scope of services.
  • Use your outstanding and well-developed patient communication skills to build rapport and inspire trust, managing sensitive subjects and cultural differences diplomatically and professionally.
  • Manage high quality patient notes, future appointments, PROMS (patient reported outcome measures) and compliance using the appropriate NHS and Ascenti systems.

Quality & safety

Maintain high standards of professional conduct and abide by core standards of practice outlined by the HCPC and CSP.

Complete advanced physiotherapy training modules and uphold these standards across all that you do.

Work closely with your manager to identify and manage any risks that may affect quality of care or service.

Personal development

  • Work closely with our Clinical Development Team and your regional training leads to collaborate on any complex cases and advance your practice and the practice of others.
  • Use our award-winning clinical development resources, including our online training platform Absorb, to elevate your knowledge and stay on top of best practice.
  • Attend regular online and offline courses and events, that will contribute to your development as a practitioner and keep up-to-date records of your CPD achievements.

Collaboration

  • Build strong working relationships with your NHS colleagues, regional physiotherapy team and contract providers and partners.
  • Develop strong links with secondary care providers in your area, enabling fast track referrals to specialists and consultants for patients who may need further intervention.
  • Act as the first port of call for expertise in the management of musculoskeletal conditions in your area, providing advice to patients, physiotherapists, other healthcare professionals, GPs and consultants.
  • Stay connected and network with the wider Ascenti team using our award-winning staff newsletter, intranet, events, and other social resources.

Knowledge experience and qualifications

Knowledge/skills

  • Performing treatment interventions appropriately for this advanced level of clinical care.
  • Conducting advanced clinical assessments and prescribing evidence-based treatment plans.
  • Core standards of physiotherapy practice and code of conducted outlined by the HCPC and CSP.
  • Excellent IT skills and computer literacy. Strong verbal patient communication skills.
  • Appreciation of ethical obligations in physiotherapy, with a strong sense of professional integrity.
  • Understanding of safety and legal obligations, including patient rights and consent.
  • Knowledge of emerging clinical trends and contemporary best practice. Mentoring or clinical leadership skills.

Experience

  • Extensive post registration experience working at a senior level within speciality area (at least five years in MSK field).
  • Demonstrable experience in ordering and interpreting diagnostics and histology results.
  • Identifying adverse events/near misses and minimises risk associated with assessment and intervention.
  • Evidence of conducting initial assessments, providing diagnosis, and prescribing advanced treatment plans across a wide range of complex MSK conditions.
  • Track record of strong people skills and outstanding communication with patients.
  • Using communication skills effectively and working collaboratively as part of a team or with other physiotherapists.
  • Evidence of reading / studying in the English language and producing well-structured written documents or reports.

Qualifications /membership

  • Chartered Society of Physiotherapy (CSP) recognised degree or diploma in physiotherapy.
  • Post-registration qualification (MSc or equivalent) in Advanced Practice, Orthopaedic Medicine or equivalent.
  • MSc module / diploma in injection therapy (or working towards).
  • Full Health & Care Professions Council (HCPC) membership.
  • Full Chartered Society of Physiotherapists (CSP) membership.
  • CPD folder with evidence of continued professional development.
  • Enhanced DBS check.


Professional standards

We care about doing the right thing by our people and everyone that we work with.

We also expect our people to do the right thing and to model our values and the behaviours outlined in our Code of Conduct.

As an Ascenti employee you will follow key principles and policies covering Safeguarding, Equality Diversity and Inclusion, Data Protection and Risk Management

Additional benefits: hybrid working (1-2 days WFH per week), fully funded Injection Course training, and the option of a condensed working week.

title: Reporting Specialist
description:
About the Positions

We’re seeking Reporting Specialists of various skill levels to support large, complex heavy civil infrastructure programs, including highways, roads, bridges, transit (bus and rail), aviation (international airports), and water/wastewater projects delivered through both traditional and alternative delivery methods. These roles produce the recurring reporting a program publishes, the monthly, quarterly, and annual packages that reach program leadership, funding agencies, and oversight bodies, along with the input collection, verification, and version control standing behind every figure in them. You’ll run the reporting cycle and get a defensible package out on the date it was promised. If your work is weighted toward building data models, queries, and dashboards, our data analyst bank is the better fit, and if it is weighted toward authoring plans, procedures, and controlled documents, look at our technical writer bank.

This post is for future roles and not for a specific opportunity that is available right now. We accept applications and conduct interviews in advance of upcoming hiring needs. When a candidate is selected, their profile is activated in our talent pool for this specialty area. We notify our talent pool candidates first whenever we have a project need.

Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following:

Note: We are seeking candidates of various skill levels, and the following responsibilities represent the core of these roles. Scope and complexity increase with experience level.

  • Prepare the recurring monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages the program publishes, assembling progress, cost, schedule, change, and milestone content into the program’s approved format.
  • May lead the reporting cycle from data cutoff through review and distribution, tracking who owes what and chasing late or missing inputs so the publication date holds.
  • Collect reporting inputs from project teams, consultants, and contractors, and verify each figure and status statement against the source records held in the program’s PMIS, cost, and schedule systems.
  • Review contractor and consultant reporting submissions for completeness and conformance with the reporting requirements in their contracts, and return submissions that do not meet the standard.
  • Reconcile differences between what a contractor reports, what the PMIS holds, and what program records show, and escalate what cannot be settled before publication.
  • Develop the exhibits behind the reporting, including milestone and progress charts, dashboard extracts, maps, and photo logs, and confirm each one matches the data it was drawn from.
  • Apply the program’s reporting templates, data definitions, and format standards across projects and contracts so figures carry the same meaning at the program level.
  • Maintain reporting trackers, logs, distribution lists, and the repositories where published reporting and its backup live, under version control, so any published figure can be traced back to its source.
  • Coordinate with cost, schedule, change management, risk, quality, and document control teams to settle conflicting figures before they reach leadership.
  • Assemble the documentation supporting funding, grant, and oversight agency reporting, researching project records, correspondence, and submittal and change logs to close the gaps.
  • Prepare ad hoc status summaries and briefing materials for program leadership and project staff across all contract packages.

Attributes

  • Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent multi-tasking and organizational skills.
  • Collaborative mindset that fosters teamwork, trust, and positive relationships.
  • Natural curiosity, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, business administration, or public administration, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5+ years of program or project reporting experience for large (>$500M), complex, heavy-civil infrastructure projects.
  • Experience producing recurring reporting deliverables on a fixed cycle, including assembling content from multiple contributors and meeting a published distribution date.
  • Experience verifying reported figures and status against source records, and resolving discrepancies with the team or organization that submitted them.
  • Working knowledge of program controls and construction management reporting content, including progress, cost, schedule, and change status, and where each of those figures originates.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Power BI, Oracle Cloud Analytics, or other dashboard KPI reporting software.
  • Experience with industry standard program reporting and document management software (e.g., Kahua, Unifier, e-Builder, SharePoint, ProjectWise, etc.).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite/Office 365 (e.g., Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint, etc.).

title: Team Lead, Global Copy Desk
description:
About Us

ISMG is a global intelligence firm and media powerhouse, leading the way in cybersecurity, enterprise IT, and digital transformation. With 10+ brands, 38 digital media properties, and over 400 premier events annually—ISMG connects a network of over 2M executives, decision-makers, and innovators with the insights and opportunities they need to stay ahead.

The Opportunity

ISMG is seeking a senior Copy Editor to join as Team Lead of our Global Copy Desk, a centralized team which provides editing, proofreading, and ghostwriting as a service across ISMG's brands and business units. In this role, you will lead a team of copy editors, manage the desk's day-to-day operations, and serve as a main point of contact for stakeholders who request support from the desk. The role combines people management and workflow planning, along with hands-on editing, and is accountable for the quality and timely delivery of all content that passes through the desk.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Leading, mentoring and supporting a team of copy editors, including onboarding and training new hires.

  • Serving as backup for the manager in their absence.

  • Planning and allocating daily work across the team and shifts to balance workloads and meet turnaround times across global time zones.

  • Serving as a point of contact for editorial, events, marketing and other business teams, and scoping requests, timelines and deliverables.

  • Reviewing edited content as the final quality check before publication, and handling high-priority or complex assignments such as white papers, executive content and transcripts.

  • Ensuring the team consistently applies AP style, ISMG's global editing guidelines and fact-checking standards.

  • Owning the desk's style guide, editorial processes and documentation, and updating them as content needs change.

  • Tracking desk metrics such as volume, turnaround time and error rates, and reporting on them to the manager.

  • Resolving escalations, conflicting priorities and quality issues with stakeholders.

  • Giving regular feedback to team members and contributing to performance reviews and goal setting.

  • Identifying and piloting tools, including AI-assisted editing and transcription tools, that improve the desk's efficiency and consistency.

  • Keeping up with developments and trends in cybersecurity and technology.

What You Bring to the Table

  • 6-8+ years of editorial experience, including at least 2 years leading or supervising a team of editors.

  • Master's degree in journalism, communications, English or a related field is preferred.

  • Expert editing skills and in-depth knowledge of the AP Stylebook.

  • Experience managing editorial workflows and deadlines across multiple stakeholders and time zones.

  • Proven ability to coach, give constructive feedback and build a high- performing team.

  • Strong judgment in prioritizing competing requests and resolving editorial and stakeholder issues.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with content management systems and project tracking tools.

  • Knowledge of cybersecurity and technology would be an advantage.

🎯 Why ISMG?

  • High-growth, global organization with clear momentum and market leadership

  • Collaborative team of innovative thinkers and creative professionals

  • Supportive culture that values autonomy and excellence

  • Continuous learning and professional development

👉 Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now or visit to learn more!

title: Full-Time Day Shift QMAP – Sunday through Tuesday
description:
Position Summary

Responsible for meeting the daily personal care needs of the residents in a manner that aligns with the company’s mission and values. Anticipates, identifies and reports care needs. Supervises medications for residents using established procedures under the supervision of a licensed nurse. Reviews medication administration records (MAR) and administers medications to right resident, right dose, right time, right medication, and right route.

Essential Duties

  • Attends to the personal care needs of residents in a timely manner and provides assistance with ADLs as requested by residents or directed by supervisor.
  • Provides personal care services to residents such as assistance with bathing, dressing, attendance at meals, laundry, etc. with attention to individual resident needs (i.e., hair is combed, shoes are tied, oral hygiene, etc.)
  • Anticipates and identifies any resident care needs and reports to supervisor (i.e., hygiene needs, broken eye glasses, skin rash, lost hearing aids, supply needs, etc.).
  • Responds to the needs of family members as appropriate
  • Maintains open communication with supervisor and/or peers to promote awareness of resident issues.
  • Monitors the safety and well-being of residents
  • Reports suspicion of abuse, neglect or misappropriation of resources as required by regulation.
  • Reports changes in resident status, health or otherwise, to supervisor.
  • Monitors and documents resident’s condition as directed.
  • Assists residents with prescribed daily medication routine as appropriate and in accordance with state law.
  • Alerts RN/LPN and/or supervisor of any questions or concerns with medication records/supply.
  • Ensures that proper documentation occurs timely including any refusal of medication and/or treatment.
  • Restocks medication carts, drawers and/or storage areas with miscellaneous supplies only (i.e. gloves, sanitizer cups, etc.)
  • Completes work orders to communicate necessary replacements or repairs.
  • Attends, participates and contributes to monthly staff meetings addressing resident and departmental needs
  • Other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications & Experience

  • Per the state of operation requirements, Medication certification; QMAP-A/L, Med Tech, Med Aide, Nurse Delegation
  • Must be able to read, write and speak the English language.
  • High school or Equivalent (GED)
  • One (1) year experience in some level of elder care preferred
  • Proficient computer skills preferred
  • Strong self-management and organization skills
  • Strong multi-tasking abilities with the ability to handle competing deadlines, flexible and adaptable (open to change).
  • Ability to effectively handle difficult and sensitive issues and maintain confidentiality

Working Conditions / Physical Requirements

  • Moderate physical activity required by handling objects up to 50 pounds occasionally and/or up to 20 pounds frequently.
  • Constant standing, walking, and grasping. Frequent stooping and reaching above shoulder heights, occasional sitting, crawling, kneeling, and squatting.
  • May have exposure to blood borne pathogens, body excretions and communicable diseases possible.
  • Possible exposure to household chemicals.
  • Sits, stands, bends and moves intermittently during working hours.
  • May be subject to frequent interruptions.
  • Interacts with clients, family members and visitors frequently.

title: Systems Administrator - Rocklin
description:
We offer a competitive salary between $70k-$75k a year with opportunities for merit increase based on performance.

About Carvana

At Carvana, we’re changing the way people buy and sell cars. With an ambitious vision and a fundamentally different approach designed to be fun, fast, and fair, Carvana became the fastest-growing automotive retailer in history. We expanded nationally, went public on the New York Stock Exchange, sold our 1 millionth car, and reached the Fortune 500, all in just eight years.

Today, with 4 million retail customers and counting, Carvana is both the fastest-growing and the most profitable public automotive retailer, and we’re just getting started. We continue to raise the bar for our customers as we tackle the enormous opportunity still ahead in the largest consumer vertical.

Working here means being part of a team that embraces change, celebrates creative problem solving, and always strives to be better. At Carvana, you’ll have the opportunity to take on meaningful challenges, learn quickly, and help shape the future of automotive retail. If you’re driven to grow and make an impact as part of a collaborative team, you’ll fit right in. Learn more about what it’s like to work here from the people that already do.

THIS IS A 100% ON-SITE POSITION (Monday through Friday)

About the team and position

We need to be super approachable and always willing to go above and beyond to help our Carvana family. It could be as simple as connecting their monitor to as complicated as tuning their flux capacitor to precisely 1.21 gigawatts! We expect smart people who are doers with bright ideas, willing to put their game-face on, take on new challenges, and juggle many assignments at once.

In return for your hard work, you'll have an opportunity to work at one of the fastest growing and creative technology companies around, as well as help us promote a life-changing product and develop a world-class team every day.

What you’ll be doing

  • Travel up to 60% to help set up and support new and existing remote Carvana Locations to include (desktop, server, network, security surveillance, and AV).
  • Communicate with internal and external users and vendors on project timeline and completions.
  • Deal with anything that is powered (wired or wireless)
  • When not on the road, take incoming calls, emails, and walk-ups related to all IT issues and requests from both PC and Mac users.
  • Set up IT accessories (monitors, docking stations, phones, etc.) for all new hires and help current users with occasional desk moves.
  • Document solutions to new problems and share them with the rest of the team.
  • Monitoring system performance to ensure everything runs smoothly and securely.
  • Configuring and maintaining networked computer systems including hardware, system software, and applications to ensure availability, reliability and security.
  • Maintain physical security for all infrastructure and endpoint devices and ensure to follow Carvana security best practices.
  • Provides support for implementation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of Information Technology platforms.
  • Participate in hardware refresh project assigned to Carvana locations
  • Participate in providing internal business support by resolving escalation requests and provide technical support when requested.
  • Diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, networking, and system issues when they arise.
  • Monitor helpdesk ticketing system and ensure tickets are resolved on time to meet Carvana defined SLA.
  • Coordinate with 3rd party vendors, IT providers and other business units for any specific requirements or on-site installation or upgrade.
  • Maintain inventory for all infrastructure related hardware in the Carvana inventory System.
  • Document solutions for new problems in Jira.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation and after hours work when needed

What you should have

This is a service desk and user-facing support role. The qualifying candidate must be enthusiastic, energetic, and must take pride in helping people solve their computer problems. Service with a smile is a requirement! Additionally, you will have...

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Valid and current driver’s license.
  • Advanced skills administering Windows Server, Active Directory, DHCP, and other network services.
  • Advanced skills in Windows Operating System (recent flavors: Windows 7,8,10) and the knowledge to create and push images.
  • Knowledge in Mac OS X (recent flavors: El Capitan, Sierra, High Sierra).
  • Experience working with Meraki Security Appliances.
  • Experience with all major types of mobile devices (iOS, Android, Windows).
  • An understanding of enterprise network environments .
  • Basic knowledge and troubleshooting skills for IP Phones.
  • Experience with G-Suite including Gmail, Calendar, and Drive.
  • Intermediate skills supporting MS Office suite, especially Outlook and Office 365.
  • Experience with troubleshooting AV equipment such as HD TVs or Projectors.
  • Project management experience is a plus.
  • 4-6 years of IT experience in fast-paced environments

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-Time Salary Position with a competitive salary.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
  • 401K with company match.
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.
  • Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization.
  • A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development.
  • A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country.

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.
  • Must be able to lift up to 70 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels.
  • Must be able to carry and transport up to 70 pounds up to 20 feet.
  • Requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.
