title: Dierenarts A of B bij De Graafschap Dierenartsen - Paardenkliniek Vorden
description:
Ben jij een paardendierenarts met minimaal één jaar ervaring die graag zelfstandig werkt en een brede interesse heeft in de paardengeneeskunde? Wil je werken in een moderne paardenkliniek waar volop ruimte is voor ontwikkeling, samenwerking en het leveren van hoogwaardige zorg? Dan is dit jouw kans!

In onze paardenkliniek in Vorden werk je samen met een betrokken en enthousiast team van dierenartsen en paraveterinairen. We behandelen een breed scala aan paarden en bieden volop mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen onder andere de orthopedie, interne geneeskunde, tandheelkunde en keuringen. Daarbij beschikken we over moderne faciliteiten en uitgebreide diagnostische en behandelapparatuur.

Dit ga je doen

Als dierenarts ben je een belangrijke spil binnen onze paardenkliniek. Je voert zelfstandig onderzoeken uit, stelt diagnoses en maakt behandelplannen voor uiteenlopende aandoeningen. Je werkt nauw samen met je collega's en krijgt volop de ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen in de gebieden die bij jouw interesses en ambities passen.

Je werkzaamheden zijn onder andere:

  • Diagnostiek en behandeling: Je onderzoekt en behandelt paarden met uiteenlopende gezondheidsproblemen en stelt passende behandelplannen op.

  • Orthopedie: Heb je interesse in orthopedie? Dan bieden we je volop mogelijkheden om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen. Je houdt je bezig met kreupelheidsdiagnostiek en orthopedische vraagstukken en begeleidt paarden van onderzoek tot behandeling en revalidatie.

  • Paardenkeuringen: Heb je interesse in keuringen, maar nog beperkte ervaring? Dan kunnen wij je hierin verder opleiden. Je voert aan- en verkoopkeuringen en andere veterinaire keuringen uit en ontwikkelt je in het zorgvuldig en deskundig beoordelen van paarden.

  • Interne geneeskunde: Je werkt met uiteenlopende interne geneeskundige casussen en krijgt de mogelijkheid om je kennis en ervaring op dit gebied verder uit te bouwen.

  • Tandheelkunde: Je voert tandheelkundige onderzoeken en behandelingen uit. Binnen onze kliniek is hiervoor uitgebreide tandheelkundige apparatuur beschikbaar.

  • Samenwerking en ontwikkeling: Je overlegt met collega's over complexe casussen, deelt kennis en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze zorg.

Onze kliniek

In Paardenkliniek Vorden beschikken we over moderne faciliteiten en uitgebreide apparatuur om paarden zo goed mogelijk te kunnen onderzoeken en behandelen. Zo hebben we onder andere:

  • Een volledig uitgeruste operatiekamer (OK).

  • Zowel vaste als mobiele röntgenapparatuur.

  • Moderne echografie.

  • Een endoscoop voor uitgebreide diagnostiek.

  • Uitgebreide tandheelkundige apparatuur.

  • Diverse faciliteiten voor orthopedische diagnostiek en behandeling.

Hierdoor kunnen we veel onderzoeken en behandelingen binnen onze eigen kliniek uitvoeren en paarden vanuit verschillende disciplines begeleiden.

Dit neem je mee

Je bent een zelfstandige en enthousiaste paardendierenarts met minimaal één jaar ervaring in de paardengeneeskunde. Je hebt een brede interesse, bent nieuwsgierig en praktisch ingesteld en vindt het leuk om samen met collega's naar de beste oplossing voor een patiënt te zoeken.

Verder neem je mee:

  • Een afgeronde opleiding tot dierenarts en minimaal één jaar aantoonbare ervaring in de paardengeneeskunde.

  • Een registratie in het diergeneeskunderegister.

  • Interesse in en bij voorkeur ervaring met orthopedie, keuringen en/of interne geneeskunde.

  • Een zelfstandige en collegiale werkhouding.

  • De motivatie om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen de paardengeneeskunde.

  • Een praktische en patiëntgerichte instelling.

Heb je nog niet op alle gebieden ervaring? Geen probleem. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je een goede basis hebt, enthousiast bent over de paardengeneeskunde en jezelf verder wilt ontwikkelen. Voor onder andere orthopedie en keuringen bieden we mogelijkheden om je kennis en vaardigheden verder uit te bouwen.

Dit krijg je van ons

Wij investeren graag in jouw persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Je komt terecht in een stimulerende werkomgeving waarin je veel ruimte krijgt om je kennis en vaardigheden verder uit te breiden.

  • Een eigen werkbus voor je werkzaamheden.

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een goede pensioenregeling.

  • Volop mogelijkheden voor nascholing en verdere ontwikkeling via de IVC Evidensia Academy.

  • Een prettige en collegiale werksfeer binnen een betrokken en professioneel team.

  • Werken met moderne apparatuur en behandelmethoden binnen een goed uitgeruste paardenkliniek.

  • Veel ruimte om je eigen interesses en expertise verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Mogelijkheden om je verder te specialiseren binnen de verschillende onderdelen van de paardengeneeskunde.

Over IVC Evidensia

Stel je voor: de charme en het hechte teamgevoel van jouw lokale dierenkliniek, gecombineerd met de kracht en kennis van de grootste veterinaire groep van Europa. Dát is werken bij IVC Evidensia.

Bij ons is elke vestiging uniek, met een eigen identiteit. Tegelijkertijd zijn we onderdeel van een netwerk waarin we kennis en expertise met elkaar delen. Zo combineren we de persoonlijke betrokkenheid van een lokale kliniek met de mogelijkheden van een grote organisatie.

Je profiteert van specialistische kennis, ondersteuning en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, zodat jij je kunt focussen op wat je het liefste doet: de beste zorg verlenen aan paarden.

Pak het moment

Ben jij de paardendierenarts die wij zoeken voor onze paardenkliniek in Vorden? Heb je minimaal één jaar ervaring, werk je graag zelfstandig en wil je jezelf verder ontwikkelen binnen een breed en professioneel aanbod van paardengeneeskunde?

Solliciteer dan direct! We kijken uit naar je reactie.

Kjenner du det maritime markedet og trigges av teknisk salg?

Hos CSD får du stor frihet, korte beslutningsveier og muligheten til å forme og utvikle selskapets satsing mot marine og offshore.

CSD søker en kommersiell og teknisk sterk Salgssjef Marine og Offshore som vil få en sentral rolle i selskapets videre vekst. Du får ansvar for å utvikle eksisterende kunder, etablere nye relasjoner og bygge CSDs posisjon i det skandinaviske maritime markedet.

Dette er rollen for deg som liker å være tett på kundene, forstå tekniske behov og omsette dem til gode løsninger og langsiktige kommersielle relasjoner.

Du kommer inn i en liten organisasjon med korte beslutningsveier, stor synlighet og betydelig mulighet til å påvirke hvordan det maritime segmentet skal utvikles videre.

Om selskapet

CSD ble grunnlagt i 1988 og har sitt hovedkontor i Sandefjord, samt lager og salgskontorer i Fosnavåg og i Aalborg i Danmark. I Sverige er vi lokalisert i Gøteborg, Stockholm og Luleå gjennom partnere. På den måten kan vi betjene våre kunder med en rask og presis service.

CSD Sealing & Protecting Systems AS er distributør i Skandinavia, Færøyene og Island, og leverer tekniske og sikkerhetskritiske kabel- og rørgjennomføringer, som blant annet er brann- og eksplosjonssikre samt gass-, vann- og gnagertettere fra Beele Engineering B.V.

Om rollen

Som Salgssjef Marine og Offshore får du ansvar for salg og markedsutvikling innen det maritime segmentet. Salget krever derfor både teknisk forståelse, god behovsavklaring og evne til å skape tillit hos kunden.

Du vil overta en eksisterende kundeportefølje, samtidig som en viktig del av oppgaven blir å identifisere og utvikle nye kunder og forretningsmuligheter. Rollen innebærer tett kontakt med blant annet verft og skipsbyggere, rederier, skips designere og rådgivende ingeniører, systemintegratorer, tekniske leverandører, elektrogrossister og distributører.

Dette blir noe av dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver

  • Drive aktivt teknisk B2B-salg mot marine- og offshoremarkedet

  • Utvikle eksisterende kunder og etablere nye kunder og relasjoner

  • Kommersielt ansvar for budsjetter, omsetning og marginer

  • Kartlegge kundens behov og gi teknisk rådgivning

  • Utarbeide og følge opp tilbud og salgsmuligheter, identifisere nye markeds muligheter

  • Bygge og utvikle en strukturert pipeline

  • Planlegge og gjennomføre operative planer

  • Arbeide systematisk med CRM, salgsprognoser og rapportering

  • Bidra til å videreutvikle CSDs markedsarbeid og bruk av digitale salgsflater

  • Samarbeide tett med daglig leder og tekniske ressurser og fabrikk i Nederland

Hvem ser vi etter

Vi tror du har erfaring med teknisk B2B-salg og trives godt i møtet mellom teknologi, mennesker og forretning. Erfaring fra maritim industri, skipsbygging eller leverandørindustrien vil være en fordel, men vi er også åpne for dyktige tekniske selgere fra nærliggende bransjer.

Teknisk utdanning innen elektro, mekanikk, automasjon eller tilsvarende er ønskelig, men relevant salgs- og bransjeerfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning.

Det viktigste er at du kombinerer kommersielt driv med teknisk forståelse og evner å skape fremdrift også når salgsprosessene er lange og komplekse.

Du vil passe godt inn dersom du

  • er utadvendt og trygg i kundemøter

  • motiveres av å skape salg og utvikle langsiktige kunderelasjoner

  • er teknisk nysgjerrig og raskt setter deg inn i nye løsninger

  • arbeider selvstendig, strukturert og målrettet

  • er initiativrik og komfortabel med oppsøkende salg

  • følger systematisk opp kunder, tilbud og pipeline

  • kommuniserer komplekse tekniske forhold på en forståelig måte

  • bygger tillit og gode relasjoner

  • har utholdenhet til å lykkes i lange salgsprosesser

  • trives i et lite miljø hvor initiativ og samarbeid betyr mye

  • Erfaring med CRM og ERP er en fordel, og du må kunne kommunisere godt på både norsk og engelsk

Hvorfor CSD ?

Her får du ikke en salgsrolle hvor alt allerede er definert.

Du får en nøkkelposisjon hvor du kan være med på å forme både rollen, arbeidsmetodene og utviklingen av det maritime segmentet, i samarbeid med daglig leder. Du får kombinere operativt salg, relasjonsbygging og teknisk rådgivning, samtidig som du får stor påvirkning på hvordan markedet og kundeporteføljen skal utvikles videre.

CSD har ambisjoner om å øke sin deltagelse i dette markedet de neste 2–3 år. Den nye Salgssjefen Marine og Offshore skal være en viktig bidragsyter til denne veksten.

Du blir en del av en liten organisasjon med korte beslutningsveier, lav prestisje og tett samarbeid mellom kommersielle og tekniske ressurser.

Du får konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode pensjon- og forsikringsordninger.

Ønsket arbeidssted er Sandefjord, men andre aktuelle lokasjoner kan vurderes. Rollen innebærer reisevirksomhet knyttet til blant annet kundemøter, messer og seminarer.

For mer informasjon om stillingen, ta kontakt med:

Seniorrådgiver Geir Nordvold, 938 28 100 i Skagerak Consulting

Alle henvendelser behandles konfidensielt.

Søknadsfrist: Snarest, innen 30.11.2026

Søknad med CV registreres i vårt digitale søknadssystem så snart som mulig.

For å unngå bedrageriforsøk vil vi presisere at vi aldri ber om BankID-informasjon i søknadsprosessen.

title: Winkelstage regio Vlaams-Brabant
description:
Wat ga je leren en doen tijdens je stage?

Als stagiair(e) krijg je een heldere inkijk in én ervaring met alle facetten van het winkelgebeuren:

  • Winkeloperatie & variatie: je ontdekt de dynamiek van de winkel — van het beheren van de groente- en fruitafdeling tot het vers afbakken van de lekkerste croissants in onze bakkerij.
  • Klantenservice & kassa: je helpt onze klanten met een glimlach verder, kijkt mee aan de kassa en zorgt voor een aangename winkelervaring.
  • Voorraad & beheer: je leert hoe de goederenstroom werkt, hoe we de versheid garanderenen hoe de winkel er altijd strak en uitnodigend bij ligt.
  • Teamwork & begeleiding: je werkt nauw samen met ervaren collega’s, Assistant Store Managers en de Store Manager. Je ziet van dichtbij hoe #teamlidl op de winkelvloer wordt aangestuurd.
Wie ben jij?
  • Je volgt een relevante opleiding (bijv. Retail, Handel, Verkoop,...) verbonden aan een school instantie en zoekt een stageplek voor minstens 4 weken.
  • Je bent minstens 16 jaar.
  • Je bent een echte teamspeler met een flinke dosis enthousiasme en bent een doener die energie krijgt van concrete actie.
  • Je bent leergierig, klantgericht en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.
Wat bieden wij jou?
  • Echte praktijkervaring: een gevarieerde stage waarin je alle kneepjes van het retailvak leert kennen.
  • Topwerksfeer: een warme, open en collegiale werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich thuis voelt en gelijk is.
  • Persoonlijke groei: volop ruimte om te ontdekken wat je in je mars hebt. We moeten allemaal ergens beginnen, toch?
  • Toekomstperspectief: klikt het langs beide kanten? Dan bekijken we graag de mogelijkheden voor een studentenjob of een vaste job na je afstuderen. Lidl biedt je alle kansen!

We zijn ervan overtuigd dat diversiteit onze organisatie sterker maakt en verwelkomen iedereen. Ongeacht leeftijd, afkomst, genderidentiteit, geaardheid, geloof, of handicap. Gelijke kansen en eerlijke beloning staan bij ons centraal.

title: Senior Change Management Consultant
description:
Excella is a transformative technology firm that helps organizations unlock new possibilities. We believe the key to helping clients challenge the status quo and reach new heights lies in our talented people. That’s why we’re committed to developing talent and providing opportunities for career growth at every stage. Join our collaborative team dedicated to solving complex problems with sustainable solutions while building your future as a leader. At Excella, you’re empowered to make lasting impact, turning today’s challenges into tomorrow’s mission successes.

  • Workplace locations look different for everyone. Excellians are a distributed workforce and whether you're working from your home office or a client site, we support a flexible work/life integration regardless of your location.
  • We offer top of industry medical, dental, and vision benefits with multiple options to choose from such as an employer-contributed health savings account, infertility coverage, and orthodontia so you can select the plan that works best for you.
  • Regardless of what stage of life you’re in, Excella wants to support you. We provide 8 weeks of Parental Leave, discounted pet insurance, and a Care.com membership with 3 back-up emergency child or elder care days annually – all available to you on your first day.
  • Starting day one, every employee is bonus eligible and receives 15 days of paid vacation, 6 federal holidays, and 4 floating holidays.
  • Doing your best work means having the best tools! Excella’s TechEleX program provides you with multiple options to suit your technology needs. Choose between a variety of Mac or PC devices, and to ensure your hardware remains current, at the end of a 3-year period Excella will replace your existing computer with a new model from the program. Plus, we’ll even give you the original device to keep for your personal use!
  • With Excella’s Annual Internet Reimbursement benefit, all employees receive an additional $25 per month to help offset the cost of internet access. This initiative reflects our commitment to supporting you in staying connected and productive, no matter where you work.

  • We encourage mindfulness and overall well-being through employee wellness events, a HeadSpace membership, as well as access to TalkSpace and mental health coverage through our medical plans.

Overview

Senior Change Management (CM) Consultants at Excella apply established change management tools and frameworks to help clients navigate transitions efficiently and effectively. They work independently to implement strategic communications, stakeholder engagement, and organizational readiness activities. Senior CM Consultants act as trusted advisors to ensure alignment between stakeholder interests and business objectives while minimizing the impact of change on organizations and their people.

Responsibilities:

  • Apply change management tools and frameworks to support clients, organizations, and their customers through organizational change.
  • Identify and execute strategic communications, engagement, and outreach activities in support of technology implementations and other initiatives.
  • Lead one or more work streams of change management activities and initiatives
  • Manage stakeholder engagement and relationships across one or more work streams or initiatives
  • Translate complex technical concepts and content into plain language and visual representations for varied audiences.
  • Identify and leverage appropriate feedback mechanisms and assessments to measure the success of change initiatives
  • Work independently on change management efforts, ensuring smooth execution of deliverables.
  • Support internal practice growth initiatives, including culture building, community involvement, and business development.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of Change Management or related experience.
  • Strong understanding and application of Change Management theories, frameworks, and methodologies.
  • Experience working in an Agile environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze research and feedback, identify problems, and propose solutions
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation).
  • Excellent organizational skills and detail orientation.
  • Ability to interact with senior-level clients.
  • Exposure to User Centered and Service Design principles.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office products.

This range represents the minimum and maximum base salary that Excella reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this role. Actual compensation within the range will depend on factors such as skills, experience, training, certifications, and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top or bottom of the range.

Your pay also includes the opportunity for an annual bonus in addition to the base salary. This variable pay opportunity is dependent upon the attainment of shared firmwide goals and objectives as determined by Excella’s Executive Team. Certain eligibility and pro-ration rules apply.

Should your experience and knowledge qualify you for a different position or title within Excella, we may consider you for positions that better align with your qualifications. In that case, we will provide the range for those positions as well.

Position: Landscape Foreman (Stormwater)

Regional Travel: Required, typically 10 days per month (lodging and $55 per diem on travel days)

title: IT Solution Architect
description:
The IT Solution Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing IT solutions that support business objectives and drive digital transformation. This role leads communication and collaboration between business stakeholders and IT teams, translating business requirements into effective, scalable, secure, and sustainable technology solutions.
This position oversees the end-to-end application lifecycle, from solution design and implementation to ongoing operations and continuous improvement, while ensuring system reliability, delivery quality, information security and regulatory compliance. The role also leads IT demands and projects by driving stakeholder engagement and collaboration with global IT teams and external vendors to enhance operational efficiency and deliver sustainable business value.

Key Responsibilities
1. IT Application Management & Operations
◦ Manage and maintain IT applications to ensure stable, secure, and efficient daily operations.
◦ Monitor application performance, troubleshoot technical issues, and implement resolutions to minimize business disruptions.
◦ Analyze application-related issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions in collaboration with relevant technical teams and external vendors.
◦ Manage application lifecycle activities, including system changes, version upgrades, system enhancements, and technical improvements.
◦ Maintain up-to-date system documentation, operational manuals, and application-related knowledge bases.

2. IT Demand & Project Management
◦ Understand business processes and translate business requirements into IT demands, functional specifications, and appropriate solution requirements.
◦ Identify opportunities for digital transformation, process optimization, and application improvements to support evolving business needs.
◦ Assess business impact, technical feasibility, risks, and priorities of application-related requests and initiatives.
◦ Plan, manage, and drive IT demands and projects in collaboration with business stakeholders, regional/global IT teams, and external vendors.
◦ Manage project scope, timelines, deliverables, and resources to ensure successful project execution.
◦ Lead system testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment, and post-implementation activities, ensuring solution quality and alignment with business requirements.


3. IT Security, Risk & Compliance
◦ Ensure IT applications comply with global IT security standards, IT Financial Services guidelines, and applicable local regulatory requirements.
◦ Implement security requirements and controls, including access management, vulnerability remediation, and data protection.
◦ Identify, assess, and address application-related operational risks, security vulnerabilities, and compliance issues.
◦ Execute security assessments, address audit findings, and implement necessary remediation measures to ensure compliance.
◦ Maintain appropriate security documentation, governance processes, and control measures throughout the application lifecycle.
◦ Uphold ethical standards and ensure compliance with company policies, compliance guidelines, Anti-Bribery policies, and applicable competition laws

title: Property Manager
description:
Point Real Estate Management is seeking a dedicated and experienced Property Manager to oversee residential communities located on the East Side of Milwaukee! The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years full-time property management experience, and be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of the property, maintaining high standards of resident satisfaction, and maximizing the financial performance of the community. This is an exciting opportunity for a driven, motivated, and responsible leader and will be available in mid-December.


Duties and Responsibilities


Personnel

  • Motivate Staff
  • Train and be responsible for work performed by all staff members under the Property Manager’s direction
  • Recommend the hiring and termination of employees in accordance with company policy
  • Perform written evaluations of employees and make recommendations for salary increases or advancement
  • Determine transitions and promotions for on-site personnel
  • Establish schedules and assign personnel for routine maintenance and emergency coverage
  • Maintain accurate payroll records as required by the company
  • Adhere to and implement all company policies and all company personnel directives
  • File reports regarding any work related injuries

Marketing

  • Handle all facets of marketing apartments
  • Ensure staff is knowledgeable of the market and competition
  • Maintain positive resident relations
  • Establish and maintain renewal programs
  • Develop strategies and programs designed to ensure long-term residency
  • Insure that an appropriate number of units are “made ready” to show prospective residents on a daily basis.


Lease Administration

  • Oversee the consistency and effectiveness of the Assistant Manager and Leasing Agent associates’ use of the policies and procedures, including priority wait lists, phone techniques, application verification and notification.
  • Ensure leasing practices conform to federal, state, and local law. Ensure that credit and criminal reports are obtained for all prospective residents and ensure that company policies and standards regarding income and prior rental history are met.
  • Prepare, process, and sign all leases and related forms or supervise others in doing so.
  • Collect rents, nsf’s, late charges and handle delinquent accounts or supervise others in doing so.
  • Recommend changes to rent changes and implement scheduled rent increases
  • Aggressively pursue lease renewals. Send notices out at least 45 days prior to expiration.
  • Supervise leasing employees insuring good closing techniques.
  • Handle evictions and landlord liens
  • Maintain all resident files including move in sheets, move out notices, security dispositions and warnings.

Finance

  • Make daily bank deposits
  • Monitor expenses within budget guidelines
  • Review, code and approve invoices for payment
  • Maintain necessary records of all financial transactions of the property, including cash, accounts payable, order office supplies
  • Assist in budget preparation

Resident Service Maintenance

  • Ensure that residents are provided with a clean, safe, well-maintained community
  • Ensure that maintenance requests are handled on an immediate one-call basis, if possible, and that residents are notified if parts must be ordered, causing a delay
  • Maintain the common areas
  • Ensure the availability of make-ready vacant units
  • Oversee risk management and emergency procedures
  • Continually inspect the property and improvements, recording deficiencies and taking the necessary action, within budget limits.
  • Maintain key control coding for all units and areas.

Other

  • Handle emergencies. Report accidents and emergency situations to your property supervisor immediately and prepare all proper reports. Be available 24 hours/day 7 days/week unless regional property supervisor has been notified.
  • Monitor parking lot for unauthorized vehicles
  • Review weekly reports for accuracy and completeness
  • Supervise outside contractors working on the property
  • Keep abreast of local and/or state news regarding housing, employment, utility rates, etc.
  • Immediately inform property supervisor of any dangerous conditions or liability issues on property.
  • As directed by property supervisor, prepare property for code inspections, mortgage inspections, and all other inspections
  • Report to property supervisor any violations of company policies by employees
  • Develop and enforce community policies and rules
  • Other duties as assigned by supervisor

title: Senior IT-Projektledare – Digitalisering, Data & AI
description:
Låter det inspirerande att få vara en del av en mindre verksamhet inom en global koncern med möjligheten att få arbeta med talangfulla kollegor som brinner för ledarskap?

Då kan vi på Chief i Stockholm ha konsultrollen för dig. Hos oss blir du en del av Chief och är med och skapar något unikt inom ledarskap och konsultverksamhet!

Om rollen

Vill du driva digitaliseringsprojekt som gör verklig skillnad – från idé till leverans?

Som IT-projektledare på Chief är du en nyckelperson i våra kunders transformationsresor. Du leder projekt som syftar till att modernisera system, effektivisera processer och utveckla nya digitala tjänster – ofta i komplexa miljöer med många intressenter.

Många av projekten har koppling till digitalisering, datadrivna initiativ och AI, där du är med och driver införande av nya lösningar i verksamheten.

Du arbetar nära både verksamhet och IT, med helhetsansvar för planering, genomförande och leverans.

Exempel på vad du gör i rollen:

  • Driver digitaliserings- och IT-projekt, t.ex. systemimplementationer, automatisering eller regulatoriska anpassningar

  • Leder projekt inom data-, analys- och AI-relaterade initiativ

  • Leder och koordinerar projektteam i agila eller traditionella miljöer

  • Tar fram projektplaner, budget, risk- och resursplanering

  • Säkerställer leveranser i tid, med rätt kvalitet och enligt kravbild

  • Kommunicerar med stakeholders på olika nivåer, från team till ledning

  • Följer upp projektstatus, effekter och affärsnytta

Våra uppdrag finns inom flera branscher – exempelvis bank/finans, retail, energi, life science, fordon, försvar och offentlig sektor – vilket ger dig möjlighet att arbeta i olika typer av organisationer och sammanhang.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är strukturerad, kommunikativ och trygg i ditt ledarskap. Du har erfarenhet av att driva projekt i komplexa miljöer och är van att skapa framdrift, även när förutsättningarna förändras.

Du är konsultmässig i ditt arbetssätt: lyhörd, lösningsorienterad och professionell, med förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya verksamheter och bygga förtroende.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Relevant högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet

  • 5+ års erfarenhet av projektledning inom IT eller digitalisering

  • Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt och verktyg (t.ex. Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Jira)

  • Erfarenhet av att hantera budget, risk och styrning i projekt

  • Flytande svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift

Meriterande är om du även har erfarenhet av:

  • Har drivit eller deltagit i projekt kopplade till AI, data eller avancerad analys

  • Har erfarenhet av uppdrag inom offentlig sektor

  • Har certifiering inom projektledning (t.ex. PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe)

Vilka är Chief?

Chief är en ledande aktör i konsultbranschen med en stark familjär kultur där teknik och ledarskap möts. Hos oss får du en personlig och utvecklande miljö där karriärresa och ledarskap står i centrum – med möjligheterna som följer med att vara en del av en global koncern då Chief är en division inom Alten Group.

Vad erbjuder vi?

  • Gemenskap & utveckling: Vi investerar i dig och din utveckling genom branschöverskridande och spännande kunduppdrag, mentorskapsprogram, Chief Academy, möjlighet till certifiering samt andra interna initiativ som stärker både din kompetens och ditt ledarskap.

  • Större möjligheter: Lokalt engagemang kombinerat med ett globalt nätverk genom vår koncern Alten Group, karriärvägar och spännande uppdrag – utan att kompromissa med den familjära känslan.

  • Trygg anställning: Hos oss får du en kollektivavtalad anställning med konkurrenskraftig lön, friskvårdsbidrag, utbildningsbudget med mera.

Skicka in din ansökan med CV redan idag, intervjuer och återkoppling sker löpande. Vill du veta mer om Chief och rollen? Kontakta oss eller läs mer på vår karriärhemsida! Chief Karriär

title: 2027 Minor League Hitting Coach
description:
Primary Purpose

The Cleveland Guardians are currently seeking a Minor League hitting coach to join the Player Development Department. The ideal candidate will possess a passion for player and personal growth, experience integrating multiple information sources to create and implement development plans, and a thorough understanding of skill acquisition principles. Excellent applicants will demonstrate curiosity, creativity, and a drive to learn new concepts to problem solve. First and foremost, we are looking for great people!

We are committed to creating an equitable interview process that recognizes the unique identities of all applicants and allows candidates to bring their best selves forward. If you are more comfortable with submitting your materials (ie. resume, other documents) in Spanish, please feel free to do so.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Integrate objective information into a detailed and comprehensive player development plan.
  • Create effective training environments based off individual player plans.
  • Collaborate with other Physical domains to effectively plan, implement and monitor a holistic player development plan.
  • Utilize internal tools, resources, and analytics to assess and adjust player plans.
  • Communicate development plans and progress with players and Player Development staff and Front Office throughout the year.
  • Assist field staff with normal daily operations when necessary.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum of two years related experience and/or training required. Previous experience with a professional baseball/softball organization or collegiate baseball/softball program is a plus.
  • Candidate is willing to potentially work year-round at our development complex in Arizona.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of people and backgrounds.
  • Interest in personal and professional development with a desire to be involved in internal continuing education opportunities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Office, and Outlook.

Preferred Experience

We are looking for a variety of skill sets. If you have demonstrated experience with any of the following, you may be who we are looking for to join our team.

  • Fluency in Spanish is a plus but not required.
  • Proficiency in SQL is a plus but not required.
  • Experience working with Trackman, Edgertronic cameras, biomechanics data, and workload monitoring data.
  • Strength & conditioning experience is a plus but not required.
  • Experience with mental performance/sports psychology is a plus but not required.

Organizational Requirements

  • Demonstrates the ability to read, speak, comprehend, and communicate effectively in order to perform job duties and interact with coworkers.
  • Represents the Cleveland Guardians in a positive fashion to all business partners, teammates, and the general public.
  • Ability to build robust, professional relationships with teammates by demonstrating interpersonal skills, approachability, and a collaborative spirit contributing to a positive, respectful work environment.
  • Ability to perform the essential physical requirements of the role as outlined in the job description, which may include extended periods of sitting, standing, lifting, or navigating a multilevel ballpark.
  • Adapts quickly and effectively to a fast-paced, dynamic, and diverse work environment.
  • Ability to act according to the organizational values and service excellence at all times.
  • Willingness to work extended days and hours, including holidays and weekends.
  • Willingness to adhere to all Major League Baseball and Club policies.

About Us

As a proud pillar of the Cleveland community, the Cleveland Guardians are dedicated to building a team that embodies the heart and spirit of our city. We offer compensation and benefits that attract, engage, and retain top talent. We are looking for the best person for the job. If you're interested in this role, we encourage you to apply, even if the salary range below does not meet your expectations.

The expected annual salary range for this position is $60,000–$70,000. This range serves as a general guideline. Actual compensation will be determined based on a candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

At the Cleveland Guardians, we are all about creating an environment that brings out the best in everyone. It is a big part of who we are, how we compete, and how we make an impact in our community. We want every employee to feel like they truly belong here.

We also know that people sometimes hesitate to apply for jobs unless they check every single box on the qualifications list. We are looking for the best person for the job, and we know that you might bring skills and experiences that are not exactly listed but could be a huge asset to our team. So, if this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every single qualification.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
About you
You are a hands-on QA Automation Engineer who enjoys building reliable, maintainable test automation solutions while staying closely connected to the product and its users. You understand that effective quality assurance goes beyond automating test cases; it requires exploring applications, identifying risks, and designing meaningful tests that validate critical business workflows.

You are comfortable balancing automation development with functional testing as project priorities evolve. You bring strong analytical thinking, technical ownership, and a practical approach to test design, knowing when automation adds value and when hands-on testing is more effective. You enjoy collaborating with Developers, Technical Leads, and QA teams, continuously improving testing practices, and using AI-assisted tools with sound judgment.

Note: This position requires availability to work from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM US Eastern Time.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining automated test suites using Playwright.
  • Proven experience establishing test automation framework structures, including reusable components and maintainable test architecture.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, or a comparable programming language.
  • Strong knowledge of test design principles, including the Page Object Model (POM), stable selectors, flaky test management, and test data strategies.
  • Hands-on experience performing functional, exploratory, and regression testing of web applications.
  • Experience using version control and code review workflows with GitHub, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify quality risks, challenge assumptions, and prioritize meaningful test coverage.
  • Ability to quickly understand new products, user workflows, and business requirements before designing automated tests.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions, ask relevant questions, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong ownership, adaptability, and willingness to continuously improve testing practices.
  • Practical understanding of AI-assisted testing tools, including the ability to evaluate generated test quality and identify limitations.
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, including Azure Pipelines or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps and Azure Test Plans.
  • Experience using Playwright MCP or similar AI-assisted testing tools.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with API testing, including Playwright’s built-in API testing capabilities.
  • ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) certification.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and participating in planning, refinement, and retrospectives.
  • Ability to communicate quality risks and test results to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working remotely with distributed teams and communicating asynchronously.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Perform exploratory testing to understand application functionality, user workflows, and critical business scenarios before developing automation.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable Playwright test suites using the Page Object Model and established automation best practices.
  • Develop automated regression and core workflow tests based on documented test cases and the team’s automation strategy.
  • Build reusable test components and maintain reliable automation structures through effective selectors, test data management, and flaky test handling.
  • Integrate automated tests into existing CI/CD workflows to support continuous quality validation.
  • Execute functional, exploratory, and regression testing for new features, bug fixes, and application changes as needed.
  • Identify test coverage gaps, unreliable automated tests, and quality risks, communicating findings and recommendations to QA leadership.
  • Collaborate with Developers, Technical Leads, and QA team members to clarify requirements, investigate defects, and improve testability.
  • Prioritize testing efforts based on user impact, business risks, and project requirements.
  • Review and improve automation code to ensure readability, maintainability, and long-term reliability.
  • Use AI-assisted testing tools when appropriate, validating generated tests to ensure they provide meaningful coverage.
  • Document testing activities, automation decisions, execution results, and identified defects.
  • Adapt between automation development and hands-on testing according to team priorities and delivery needs.
  • Hands-on Playwright automation and framework development.
  • JavaScript or TypeScript programming proficiency.
  • Page Object Model and maintainable test design practices.
  • Functional, exploratory, and regression testing experience.
  • Git-based source control and code review workflows.
  • Strong analytical thinking, communication, and problem-solving skills.

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

This position is highly hands-on and guest-facing, serving as a mentor and ambassador for Founders Club while ensuring the bar team continuously develops their mixology knowledge, technical skills, and confidence behind the bar.

Key Responsibilities:

Beverage & Cocktail Program Development:

  • Serve as the creative architect of the Founder’s Club beverage identity, developing an evolving cocktail program that is distinctive, market-leading, and reflective of the hotel's luxury positioning.
  • Design and execute original cocktails utilizing advanced mixology techniques, house-made ingredients, seasonal products, and innovative presentation methods.
  • Introduce sustainable cocktail initiatives that support responsible sourcing, waste reduction, and environmental stewardship while enhancing creativity.
  • Establish a culture of continuous experimentation through regular research and development sessions, tasting panels, and collaborative innovation workshops.
  • Research global cocktail trends, techniques, ingredients, and industry innovations.
  • Maintain consistency and accuracy of all cocktail recipes and specifications.
  • Collaborate with leadership on seasonal menu updates and special beverage features/activations.
  • Lead menu engineering initiatives that balance creativity, guest appeal, operational efficiency, and profitability.
  • Assist General Manager of outlet to develop and execute an annual strategic plan to elevate Founder’s cocktail program into a nationally recognized destination.
  • Build a reputation for innovation through industry participation, cocktail competitions, media engagement, guest shifts, and collaborative events.
  • Foster a culture of excellence that encourages team members to contribute ideas, pursue education, and achieve professional recognition.
  • Establish measurable standards that align with the operational, creative, and hospitality benchmarks demonstrated by leading bars featured on World's 50 Best Bars and other prestigious industry rankings.

Team Training & Education:

  • Conduct spirit and cocktail training sessions and train colleagues on spirits, cocktail techniques, product knowledge, and storytelling.
  • Mentor bartenders and barbacks to support their professional growth and development.
  • Create and maintain educational resources, venue recipe books, and training materials.

Guest Experience:

  • Deliver elevated, personalized guest experiences that align with Fairmont and LQA standards.
  • Rotate between working behind the bar and engaging with guests on the floor.
  • Create memorable experiences for VIP and repeat guests.

Other responsibilities:

  • Ensure all cocktails are executed consistently and according to approved specs.
  • Maintain high standards of presentation, technique, and service at all times.
  • Support cleanliness and organization within the bar.
  • Monitor glassware, bar tools, and beverage-related supplies.

What will you bring to this role?

  • Embrace the Fairmont brand promise and luxury in your role and in all your interactions.
  • Foster an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued and respected
  • Minimum 8–10 years of experience in luxury hospitality, craft cocktail bars, or elevated beverage programs preferred.
  • Proven experience contributing to cocktail menu development, beverage innovation, and guest-facing cocktail experiences.
  • Strong knowledge of spirits, wine, beer, cocktail techniques, ingredients, and emerging beverage trends.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and guest engagement skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, luxury hospitality environment.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and special events as business levels require.
  • Relevant certifications preferred (ServSafe, WSET, or equivalent beverage education).

Physical Aspects of Position include but are not limited to:

  • Constant standing and walking throughout the shift.
  • Frequent lifting and carrying up to 50 lbs.
  • Frequent kneeling, pushing, pulling, bending, and lifting.
  • Frequent ascending and descending of ladders, stairs, and ramps.

Employee Benefits:

Join our team and enjoy a range of exclusive colleague perks, including complimentary upgrades, extended stays, discounted stays across Fairmont & Raffles properties, special dining and wellness discounts, and added luxuries to enhance your experience. We believe in taking care of our team, ensuring that your hard work is rewarded with exceptional benefits.

What is in it for you:

  • Employee travel program offering discounted rates in Fairmont’s and Accor worldwide
  • Parking/Commuting Discounts
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance available to all full-time employees and their families. Additional supplemental insurance available. Free base employee only medical insurance
  • Paid meal breaks with complimentary meals served in our Staff Dining room.

  • 401K Retirement plans with a 4% match for all colleagues
  • Opportunity to develop your talent and grow within your property and across the world!
  • Ability to make a difference through our Corporate Social Responsibility activities
  • Fun, elegant atmosphere with amazing colleagues!

Our Values

Respect: We value the needs, ideas and individuality of others. We treat everyone with fairness and dignity.

Excellence: We make genuine connections, and we cherish every opportunity to make the people around us feel special.​

Belonging: We celebrate our differences. We support each other and we always stand together.​

Fairmont is committed to creating an inclusive environment where diverse talent thrives. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team.

title: Senior Manager, Information Technology

title: [IT Delivery Center] Junior Test Automation Engineer
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, vn
description:
The Test Automation Engineer ensures quality and reliability for ComLIMS-Quotation, the Eurofins Information Systems (EurIS) regional web-based Customer Commercial Agreement Management application used across Eurofins laboratories worldwide. This role is embedded in the ComLIMS-Quotation Development Team based in Ho Chi Minh City, comprising five local members alongside offshore team members, and is accountable for building and maintaining automated test suites covering functional and non-functional requirements across acceptance and deployment stages. The team delivers software using Agile/DevOps practices and robust modelling techniques such as Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Unified Modelling Language (UML), on a stack including C#, .NET, MSSQL Server, Angular, and DevOps tooling such as Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, and Octopus.

Key Responsibilities

  • You serve as the dedicated Test Automation Engineer within a Scrum team of six collocated Software Engineers and Quality Assurance (QA), ensuring test automation is integrated at every stage of feature development.
  • You contribute to test execution (acceptance, deployment, and more), build automation, and troubleshooting of selected functional and non-functional requirements for target software applications and services, maintaining an automation ratio of80%.
  • You perform exploratory testing in addition to automated UI tests to uncover usability issues, visual glitches, hidden defects and functionality gaps.
  • You adhere to Agile values and practices (Scrum and Kanban), participating in team meetings (stand-ups, backlog refinement acceptance criteria refinement) and performing incremental testing of the application.
  • You follow continuous delivery practices by ensuring ComLIMS-Quotation test suites are automated and system atically executed as part of the Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipeline at acceptance and deployment stages.
  • You apply test strategies and test plans to ensure high-quality product delivery, refining them when necessary.
  • You collaborate with Software Engineers, architects, development managers, and business analysts to achieve comprehensive test coverage and quality.
  • You communicate proactively with product owners, business analysts, development, and testing teams to resolve ambiguity and maintain alignment on test coverage and quality.

Other Assignments

  • You ensure regular follow-up with the Team Manager, providing updates as needed or upon request.
  • You quickly acquire working knowledge of Eurofins EurIS systems, starting with ComLIMS-Quotation, its underlying concepts, models, and the processes and practices of the team.
  • You continuously deepen knowledge of ComLIMS-Quotation concepts, models, and team practices, guided by the priorities of assigned functions.
  • You build effective working relationships with IT and non-IT stakeholders across Eurofins.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • You hold a bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or have equivalent practical experience.
  • You have at least 1+ year of experience in software testing, with a strong focus on automation and proven manual testing skills.
  • You have a thorough understanding of various types of testing and their purposes, including acceptance, regression, sanity and exploratory testing.
  • You have a thorough understanding of software applications at both functional and technical levels, with the ability to extend and refine acceptance criteria, including consideration of corner, edge, and boundary cases.
  • You have working knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and DevOps practices for effective integration of testing into the development process.
  • You are proficient in test automation using object-oriented languages (such as Java or C#).
  • You understand web service patterns using Representational State Transfer (REST) and Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) queuing patterns, and can test them with automation.
  • You have experience with UI automation testing using tools like Selenium or JavaScript frameworks such as WebdriverIO.
  • You are proficient in debugging code and troubleshooting issues across various layers of the application stack.
  • You perform root cause analysis on defects and performance issues.
  • You collaborate effectively with distributed teams across multiple countries.
  • You have hands-on experience with exploratory testing techniques to complement automated test coverage.
  • You are fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • You have conversational proficiency in Vietnamese to facilitate local communication.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • You have initial experience with Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) tools such as SpecFlow/Reqnroll, JBehave, orCucumber.js for writing test cases in a given/when/then format.
  • You have working knowledge of scripting languages like PowerShell, Shell, or Bash for automating tasks and writing test scripts.
  • You have experience testing backend services developed with a DDD approach.
  • You are familiar with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps Pipelines and Jenkins.
  • You have experience in test automation with web frontend languages (JavaScript or TypeScript).
  • You have experience with tools like JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling for performance, load, and stress testing.
  • You can review and interpret performance test results and identify bottlenecks.
  • You have experience working with relational databases and working knowledge of Structured Query Language (SQL).
  • You have strong interpersonal communication skills to collaborate effectively with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders.
  • You have conversational proficiency in Mandarin or French to facilitate communication in a multilingual environment.

We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity! As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us! We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!

Find out more on our Careers page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to ca. 63,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 60 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

title: Assessment, Monitoring, and Evaluation (AM&E) Analyst II, Security Cooperation
description:

About the Project

Responsibilities

AM&E Analysts II will support the design, coordination, conduct, and reporting of Security Cooperation analyses. They will work with key stakeholders to ensure efforts stay up to date with emerging AM&E techniques, tools, and approaches in specific subject matter. Key responsibilities include:

  • Supporting the leadership team in identifying priorities and solutions to problems
  • Providing qualitative and quantitative analysis of security cooperation programs
  • Assisting with the development of indicators and metrics that enable evaluation of security cooperation programs
  • Drafting reports, presentations, and other deliverables for senior leadership review

  • Supporting the development and maintenance of project processes and plans
  • Travel up to 25-50% domestically and internationally as determined by client and portfolio requirements and demands on regional team, while adhering to approved budget, cost reasonableness requirements, and all applicable corporate and federal travel regulations

  • Four (4) years of AM&E experience, including analyzing and summarizing disparate information in a clear and concise manner, drafting data collection methodologies, creating organizational work plans based on higher-level goals, leading and coordinating multiple offices through multiple step processes without being a direct supervisor, and supporting staff with a variety of levels of knowledge and capabilities
  • Strong oral and written communication skills to deal effectively with mid and high-level partner contacts, the host government, and local communities

  • Five (5) years of experience and knowledge of public policy and operations
  • Five (5) years of experience planning, designing and implementing assessment, monitoring, and evaluation programs or projects in the security sector for a national organization, an NGO/IGO, the UN, or private industry
  • Master’s degree (or higher) and formal training or education in the field of assessment, monitoring, and evaluation

title: Singapore Market Operations Lead
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Waymo Operations exists to deliver the Waymo Driver to the world. We are a global team building and scaling the world's first and leading autonomous fleet and operations platform. From component sourcing to end customer management, we enable and create value for Waymo through scaled and orchestrated deployment of the Waymo Driver. At Waymo, we are dedicated to building a culture that promotes collaboration and celebration. You will:

This will initially be focused on testing or validation operations and eventually a commercial service. This individual translates Waymo’s global vision into a disciplined local strategy, ensuring the safe and reliable deployment of autonomous vehicles at scale.     • Build Strategic Relationships: Serve as the senior representative for Waymo, building strong relationships with community leaders, regulators, and strategic partners.
    • Establish Operating Priorities: Establish clear operating priorities, performance expectations, and governance structures across Singapore initially then additional APAC markets.

    • Own Budget Oversight: Own budget planning, cost control, and operational efficiency.
    • Develop Leadership Talent: Build, lead, and develop regional leadership talent, fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and execution excellence.

You have:

  • Experience managing 24/7 safety-critical operations or high-consequence environments maintaining >99.9% operational reliability

  • Expertise in establishing governance frameworks, defining OKRs/KPIs, and setting operational priorities across multi-site operations
  • Proven track record of driving cross-functional alignment across 5+ distinct functional teams (e.g., engineering,

  • Experience in Autonomous Vehicles and / or Fleet Operations

Travel:

title: 4261-Real Property Appraiser
description:
The Office of the Assessor-Recorder is hiring 4261 Real Property Appraisers. New hires in this classification will present and value the Assessor’s residential and small commercial cases at hearings before the AAB, including all associated prehearing conferences, hearing officer hearings and board hearings, as assigned. Under general supervision, they may also perform professional appraisal work in connection with assessing, examining, analyzing, and evaluating real property of moderate complexity for tax assessment purposes. The 4261 is the journey level class in the Real Property Appraisal series.

Essential duties may include but are not limited to:

  1. Appraise various types of moderately complex real property, to establish values for tax assessment purposes, and to make and recommend changes to valuation.
  2. Estimate property value by conducting site inspections and using standardized market, cost and income valuation approaches.
  3. Gather and analyze information from a variety of sources in order to maintain current information on real property. Investigate complaints on property assessments; make recommendations regarding the resolution of such complaints; explain findings to property owners.
  4. Perform special investigations and appraisal surveys, such as commercial area rent surveys.
  5. Prepare appeal packages for properties under assessment appeal; testify and or present before Assessment Appeals Board; may present at other quasi-judicial bodies.
  6. Prepare and maintain various records and reports, including those related to appraisal of real property.
  7. Explain appraisal and assessment procedures to property owners and general public.
  8. Interact with members of the public, City staff of other departments and City officials during the course of business.
  9. Additional duties as assigned.

These minimum qualifications establish the education, training, experience, special skills and/or license(s) which are required for employment in the classification. Please note, additional qualifications (i.e., special conditions) may apply to a particular position and will be stated on the exam/job announcement.

Education:

Requires a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university.

Experience:

One (1) year of experience in the past 10 years appraising real property in a County Assessor’s Office.

License and Certification:

Eligibility for certification from the California State Board of Equalization as an appraiser for property tax purposes. In accordance with the California State Board of Equalization, appointees to this class must possess or obtain permanent certification as an appraiser for property tax purposes, within one (1) year of appointment, and must maintain certification as a condition of continued employment.

Substitution:

1. The required education may be substituted by other qualifying combinations of education and experience as described in the California State Board of Equalization Property Tax Rule 283.

2. Three (3) years of experience in the past ten (10) years appraising real property as a fee, institutional or government appraiser may substitute for the required experience.

3. Five (5) years of experience within the past ten (10) years in any of the following occupations may substitute for the required experience:

A. an accountant, financial auditor, building cost estimator, architectural, civil, or structural engineer, real estate loan agent, real estate loan underwriter, right-of-way agent; OR

B. a real estate licensee, licensed by the California Department of Real Estate or equivalent agency of another state, engaged in buying, selling, leasing or managing real estate; OR

C. an appraiser aide or appraiser trainee in an assessor's office or in the Property Tax Department of the California State Board of Equalization; OR

D. an employee, other than an appraiser, appraiser aide, or appraiser trainee, of an assessor's office or of the Property Tax Department of the California State Board of Equalization, except that such employment time shall be limited to qualifying for only two-thirds of the five-year experience substitution requirement. The remaining one-third of time shall be accumulated by other relevant experience as described in subparagraphs (A), (B), and (C) above.

4. Completion of a 12 month real property appraiser trainee program equivalent to the City and County of San Francisco's 4260 Real Property Appraiser Trainee Program may substitute for one (1) year of professional experience.

title: Security Associate - 3rd Shift
description:
Schedule (Open Availability Highly Preferred):

  • 11:30pm-8:00a Tuesday-Saturday

Pay Range: $20 hourly

About Carvana

At Carvana, we believe buying a car the old-fashioned way sucks — so we're rewriting the playbook. Yes, we're the vending machine people. Yes, we built that on purpose. And yes, we're just getting started.

We're looking for people who want to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit shows up in everything we do — every day, our passion and creativity drive the kind of innovation that moves an industry. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data- and process-driven decisions in everything we do. Here are a few of our stories. We've been changing the game since 2013, and we're not letting up. Want the full story? Check it out here.

About the team and position

Our Safe & Secure team is the heartbeat of every Carvana location. You're the people we trust to protect our associates, our customers, and the thousands of vehicles that flow through our gates every day. Rain, shine, ice, or 110° heat — the mission doesn't change, and neither does the standard.

This is a boots-on-the-ground role. We bring the strategy; you bring the hustle. From clearing snow during a winter storm to running heat-safety protocols in July, you'll be the reason our site stays open, safe, and moving. Some days you'll be at the gate — the literal face of Carvana to every associate, vendor, and visitor walking through it. Other days, you'll be out on the lot scanning vehicles, knocking out safety audits, or restocking the supplies that keep this place humming.

You won't just monitor a perimeter — you'll own it. That means spotting hazards before they become incidents, building real relationships with the folks on site, and stepping up when something needs your attention. You'll be trained and trusted to act in emergencies, partner with our Inspection Center and Logistics teams, and feed sharp, accurate intel back to your Safe & Secure leadership. Hourly position, reporting to your Safe & Secure Functional Lead or Manager.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead with a service-first mindset in every interaction.
  • Live the Carvana values — and make sure they're felt by everyone you work with.
  • Be the face of Carvana at the gate for associates, vendors, and visitors.
  • Communicate like a pro — clear, calm, active listener, no missed signals.
  • Use our Unified Security Platform to monitor live cameras, review footage, and investigate intrusion alerts so nothing on site catches us off guard.
  • When things get hot, keep it cool. De-escalate, win with partners, and remember — we're all in this together.
  • Run point at the gate using the Safe & Secure App (SAS App) and RFID tech, enforcing ingress/egress procedures every single time.
  • Manage and document vehicle movement through the Inspection Center entrance and exit gates.
  • Show up when the team needs you. You'll be trained and certified in first aid, CPR, and AED — and we expect you to use it when the moment calls for it.
  • Know our emergency protocols cold so you can act decisively when seconds count.
  • Keep the site operational in any weather — snow removal in winter, heat-safety protocols in summer, no excuses, no shortcuts.
  • Drive a safety-first culture by spotting environmental hazards, running safety audits, and reinforcing best practices with the people around you.
  • Scan thousands of vehicles a day to keep operational flow tight — between mobile rover tech and manual handheld scans, every car gets accounted for.
  • Cover ground. This role involves serious walking to reach restricted or hard-to-access areas of the lot.
  • Run vehicle location research and deliver clean, detailed reports to leadership when operational questions come up.

Key Metrics:

  • Unit Loss Rate versus Plan
  • Safe & Secure App Execution
  • Inventory Control/Accuracy and Tracking
  • Safety Incident Performance

What you should know/have

  • 1–2 years in a customer service environment
  • Strong verbal and written communication
  • A track record of solid decision-making in a complex, fast-moving environment
  • Ability to build strong working relationships and connect with people quickly
  • Ability to organize, plan, and execute multiple tasks at once in a fast-paced setting
  • Ability to handle conflict in a positive, productive way

We’d love it if you also have

  • Familiarity with CCTV, RFID, Card Access, or other Safe & Secure technology
  • Previous experience supporting an OSHA / Safety Team program
  • Experience with crisis prevention and/or response plans

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-time hourly position with a competitive wage
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match
  • A stack of perks — student loan support, vehicle discounts, pet benefits, and a lot more
  • A wellness program built to keep you healthy, physically and mentally
  • Real opportunities to grow your skills and share what you know across the org
  • A promote-from-within culture with a startup feel — career paths can move fast around here
  • A seat at one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Other requirements

To do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you:

  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • This position is designated as a safety-sensitive position
  • Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; the majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels
  • Must be able to carry and transport up to 60 pounds up to 20 feet
  • Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet, and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance
  • Requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity
  • Requires use of safety equipment that may include, but is not limited to, face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment
  • Requires frequent driving and computer data entry
  • Must adhere to regular and predictable attendance
  • The facility is a 24/7 operation, and gates must be manned at all times

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any protected category.

Please note that this job description is not intended to be a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Azure DevOps Engineer (GitHub Migration Specialist)
description:
About You
You are a GitHub Migration Specialist with hands-on experience in both GitHub Enterprise and Azure DevOps, and you have moved source control and CI/CD pipelines from one platform to another before. You will join a small, fast-moving delivery team that is migrating repositories, pipelines, and development workflows from Azure DevOps to GitHub for several engineering teams.

You take ownership, pay close attention to data integrity and security, and stay calm when troubleshooting live migration or cutover issues. You are pragmatic and balance speed with correctness. You explain technical details clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, and you document your work so others can repeat it.

  • Note: This position is offered under a 3-month contractor framework, with the possibility of extension.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field is desired, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in a DevOps or Platform Engineering role.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub, including GitHub Enterprise (Cloud or Server) administration.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps (Repos, Pipelines, Boards), in administration or development.
  • Experience migrating source control systems and/or CI/CD pipelines between platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Git internals, including branching, history, large file handling, and repository structure.
  • Experience writing GitHub Actions workflows and converting pipelines from other CI/CD tools.
  • Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, or Bash to automate migration and configuration tasks.
  • Understanding of identity and access management concepts: SSO, SAML, SCIM, and RBAC.
  • Familiarity with source control security practices, including secret scanning, branch protection, and dependency management.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues on your own.
  • Strong ownership and attention to detail, especially around data integrity and security during migrations.
  • Collaborative and communicative, with the ability to explain technical details clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Willingness to document and share knowledge.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Nice to haves:

  • Prior experience on a formal Azure DevOps-to-GitHub (or similar platform) migration initiative.
  • Experience with GitHub Enterprise Importer (GEI) or similar migration tooling.
  • GitHub certifications (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitHub Administration).
  • Experience coordinating with Microsoft support or partner teams on licensing, tooling, or technical escalations.
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud infrastructure and services.
  • Experience supporting multiple engineering teams through a platform transition.
  • Experience with AI-assisted pull request reviews and automated API integration testing tools such as Bruno or Newman.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Execute end-to-end migration of repositories from Azure DevOps to GitHub, including history, branches, tags, work items (where applicable), and metadata.
  • Convert and rebuild CI/CD pipelines from Azure Pipelines (YAML/Classic) to GitHub Actions, validating functional parity and keeping deployments to the existing Azure environments.
  • Configure migrated repositories, including repository settings, branch protection rules, environments, secrets, and permissions, in coordination with the Infrastructure team.
  • Partner with Security to make sure migrated repositories meet compliance, access control, secret scanning, and vulnerability management standards.
  • Partner with Infrastructure to coordinate networking, authentication (SSO/SCIM), and tooling integrations such as build agents, runners, and artifact storage.
  • Build and support automation and scripts that speed up repeatable migration tasks, such as bulk repository migration, permission replication, and pipeline conversion.
  • Support the setup of pull request workflows in GitHub Actions, including code verification, security scanning, automated integration tests, and AI-assisted PR feedback.
  • Troubleshoot migration issues related to repository integrity, pipeline failures, permissions, and integrations.
  • Validate post-migration repository and pipeline functionality with engineering teams before cutover.
  • Act as the subject matter expert on GitHub features, limitations, and best practices, advising the Senior Software Engineer and Business Analyst on the feasibility and sequencing of migration waves.
  • Coordinate with Microsoft support and migration teams on tooling, licensing, and technical escalations.
  • Maintain migration runbooks, configuration standards, and technical documentation to support repeatability and knowledge transfer.
  • Support engineering teams after migration with GitHub onboarding, workflow questions, and issue resolution during stabilization.
  • Identify and flag risks, technical blockers, and scope gaps to the Senior Software Engineer and Business Analyst for prioritization.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Enterprise and Azure DevOps.
  • Proven experience migrating source control and/or CI/CD pipelines between platforms, including writing GitHub Actions workflows.
  • Working knowledge of Git internals and scripting (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for migration automation.
  • Understanding of IAM (SSO, SAML, SCIM, RBAC) and source control security practices.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.
