title: Deal Desk Manager
description:
About ClearGov

ClearGov is building the modern financial operating layer for the public sector.

We help US local governments and school districts plan, budget, report, and communicate their finances with clarity and confidence. From long-term planning to financial reporting, compliance, and transparency, our platform connects the work finance teams are already doing and makes it easier to deliver for their communities.

Today, more than 2,000 public sector organizations use ClearGov, and we continue to expand our platform and reach as we grow.

Our Core Values

  • Be Clear & Credible
    • We are authentic in our interactions, communicating with clarity, speaking with honesty, and following through with consistency. We turn transparency into our greatest competitive advantage.
  • Be Human
    • We are human partners to our colleagues and customers and lead with consideration and kindness - making space for others to do the same. We turn empathy into a shared strength.
  • Be Better Together
    • We are committed to building an inclusive community where everyone thrives. We share successes, support each other through challenges, and show up for our teammates the way we show up for our customers. We turn togetherness into our greatest advantage and collaboration into our greatest multiplier.
  • Be Honourable/Honorable
    • We are responsible to our colleagues and customers. We bring our full selves to every conversation, every project, every decision, and every relationship. We act with intention, deliver on our commitments, and lead with integrity - even when no one is watching. We turn honour into the foundation that powers everything we do.
  • Be Connected
    • We are culture builders where people are seen, welcomed, and celebrated. We show up in every interaction - the laughs, the wins, the hard days. We turn connection into opportunities for people to feel they belong.


What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You take ownership and follow through
  • You communicate clearly and effectively
  • You're comfortable solving problems and figuring things out
  • You learn quickly and adapt as things change
  • You care about the team, not just your own work
  • You bring a sense of humor and perspective to what you do

About the Role

We're looking for a Deal Desk Manager to join our team.

The Deal Desk Manager serves as the operational backbone of ClearGov’s go-to-market organization, owning the end-to-end Deal Desk function across new business, expansions, and renewals. This role partners closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships to provide strategic deal guidance, ensure pricing discipline, and mitigate contractual risk.

As the primary point of escalation for deal-related questions, the Deal Desk Manager resolves pricing and contracting challenges while driving process improvements, operational efficiency, and consistency across the revenue organization.

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

  • Build and review quotes for Sales (net-new),CS (renewals, expansions, uplifts) and Partnerships across ClearGov
  • Advise reps and CSMs on packaging, multi-year structures, ramp schedules, and bundling to maximize ARR within pricing guardrails
  • Review discount requests against approval thresholds; approve within your authority and escalate the rest with a recommendation
  • Maintain the price book, product catalog, and quote templates with Finance and Product
  • Track deal desk turnaround times and hold to published SLAs
  • Prepare order forms, renewals, amendments, and co-terms from standard templates
  • Triage redlines and non-standard terms (payment terms, auto-renewal, termination for convenience, price caps, SLAs); route to Legal and Finance as needed
  • Navigate public-sector procurement: RFP pricing, cooperative purchasing contracts, purchase orders, fiscal-year budget cycles, and board-approval timelines
  • Manage e-signature workflow and confirm executed contracts match the booked opportunity
  • Audit Closed Won bookings (ARR, term, products, start dates) before hand-off to Finance and CS onboarding
  • Own the contract repository and keep renewal dates, terms, and uplift clauses accurate in Salesforce
  • Partner with Finance on invoicing hand-off, revenue recognition inputs, and month-end close

What You Bring (Critical Skills + Experience)

  • 5+ years managing Deal Desk or order management at a SaaS company
  • Strong Salesforce skills: admin-level configuration (fields, reports, dashboards)
  • Familiarity with CPQ or comparable quoting tools
  • Experience supporting multiple Sales or CS teams — and managing their competing priorities
  • Working knowledge of SaaS metrics and contract terms: ARR, services, NRR, GRR, pipeline stages, multi-year deals, co-terming, uplifts, renewals
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills (lookups, pivots, reconciliation)
  • Precise with numbers, data, and contract language; comfortable saying no and offering an alternative
  • Builds processes others can follow: clear documentation, training, and a request queue with SLAs

Compensation:

  • In the spirit of transparency, we are excited to share the base salary for this position is $115,000 - $140,000 USD or $105,000 - $130,000 CAD, and exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you are hired at ClearGov, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors such as skills, interview performance, education and/or experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the full base salary for the role. Hiring beyond the base range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth. We also offer a generous compensation and benefits package (more information on benefits listed below).

Why Join ClearGov

  • Remote and flexible work environment
  • Meaningful work that impacts communities across the United States
  • Collaborative, high-performing team
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Opportunities to grow as we scale

Benefits

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance
  • FSA, HSA, and/or Dependent Care FSA (US)
  • Life + AD&D insurance, plus short-term and long-term disability insurance (US)
  • Life + disability insurance (Canada)
  • 401(k) (US) / RRSP (Canada) with 3.5% match
  • 10 company holidays
  • 3 wellness days
  • Paid vacation time off
  • Sick and safe time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid bereavement leave
  • Paid jury duty + civic service leave
  • Employee assistance program
  • 2 summer days + annual end-of-year "Dimming of the Lights"
  • Employee referral bonus program


How to Apply
Ready to join us? Apply online today!


Equal Opportunity Employer

We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or any other protected characteristic. title: Motion Graphics Art Intern - Summer 2027
description:
As a Motion Graphics Artist Intern at Riot, you'll take the player experience to the next level by creating high-quality motion graphics for our gameplay and systems. Your technical skill for motion and compositing will breathe life into the game, transforming static scenes into powerful moments for players. You will collaborate with other artists and designers to establish how assets and UI elements will respond, transition, and increase player immersion.

In your application, you will select which product you prefer to apply to:

League of Legends

As a Motion Graphics Artist Intern on League of Legends, you’ll help bring player-facing UI and product experiences to life across in-game and around-game features. Working alongside motion artists and a multidisciplinary team, you’ll explore how motion can make League’s interfaces feel clear, responsive, and unmistakably part of the game. You’ll create motion studies and UI animatics from visual designs using tools such as After Effects and Spine. With guidance from the team, you’ll help translate approved concepts into real-time experiences in League’s proprietary game engine, balancing visual quality, clarity, and performance while contributing a fresh perspective to League.

Teamfight Tactics

As a Motion Graphics Artist on Teamfight Tactics, you will contribute to in-game and around-game aspects of Teamfight Tactics's UI. You will craft animatics, design eye-catching transitions / interactive states, and visualize full motion user flows in a variety of tools like After Effects, Spine, and Unreal Engine. You will work under guidance of the Motion Graphics craft lead to translate designs into real-time executions by working directly in our game engine. Performance and optimization are top of mind as you push for the highest visual quality.

Responsibilities:

  • Create UI animatics out of static visual designs, following the Teamfight Tactics and League of Legends quality, style and motion conventions
  • Work closely with the Visual Design lead and UI team to support in and around-game features
  • Implement your animations in the most efficient way, carefully balancing performance and visual quality for our range of supported PC and Mobile devices
  • Collaborate with a team of Motion Graphics Artists, UX, Audio, Visual Design and Engineering experts to design + bring new UI to life
  • Reinforce the product's goals by breathing life into the player experience
  • Balance craft and product feedback with a strong empathy and focus on player value
  • Participate in Motion Graphics and Visual Design craft reviews and Community of Practice to get guidance and build skills / confidence while contributing with a fresh perspective.

Required Qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in an art, design or related degree program
  • Graduating during the 2028 calendar year
  • Available to work full-time hours for the 12 week internship duration
  • Eligible to work in the country that you reside in during this remote program
  • Has a portfolio that demonstrates understanding / grasp of motion fundamentals like easing, pacing, timing, sequences, etc.
  • Animation experience in After Effects with plugins like Trapcode, Element, and Lottie
  • Experienced with Photoshop
  • Knowledge of best practices for optimized implementation

Desired Qualifications:

  • Comfortable working in game engines like Unity or Unreal
  • Experience with Spine Animation Software or similar 2D rigging software
  • Experience with VFX authoring tools (Trapcode or Niagara)
  • Familiarity with Figma
  • Familiarity with 3D software (Blender, C4D, Maya)
  • Knowledge of League of Legends / Teamfight Tactics IP and style

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Work Authorization

  • Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States for the duration of the program.
  • This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. We do not sponsor visas for this position or internship conversions.

General Portfolio Advice:

title: Head of Medical Affairs (Hybrid/Remote)
description:
About Ceribell

Ceribell is a medical technology company focused on transforming the diagnosis and management of patients with serious neurological conditions. The Ceribell System is a novel, point-of-care electroencephalography (“EEG”) platform specifically designed to address the unmet needs of patients in the acute care setting, and is being used in hundreds of community hospitals, large academic facilities and major IDN's across the country. Our entire team is driven by a shared commitment to transforming the landscape of critical care through our rapid seizure detection technology, come join the movement!

Position Overview:

Ceribell is seeking a strategic and highly motivated Head of Medical Affairs to lead our clinical education and scientific exchange initiatives. In this pivotal leadership role, you will define our overarching medical affairs strategy, cultivate deep relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and critical care societies, and champion the pathway to new clinical consensus guidelines. Working closely with cross-functional partners in Clinical, Regulatory, and Compliance, you will oversee all scientific communications and advisory boards, ensuring the clinical value and appropriate application of Ceribell’s technology is accurately and effectively communicated across the medical community.

What you'll do:

Medical Affairs strategy

  • Lead the strategy to engage KOLs and societies on medical affairs topics aimed at supporting the appropriate clinical application of our product through scientific education.
    • AES, ACNS, ACEP, SCCN, ADS, NCS
    • Engage and build relationships key society leaders
  • Develop a path to guidelines / consensus statements for these societies
  • Partner with the clinical to develop a scientific dissemination plan across society forums (annual meetings, webinars, regional meetings, etc.)
  • Define overall medical and scientific dissemination strategy

KOL engagement and Advisory board leadership

  • Serve as a key representative of Ceribell at national conferences
  • Develop and maintain relationships with key KOLs across aforementioned societies and academic centers
  • Plan and lead advisory boards focused on KOL and society engagement
  • Recruit KOLs and thought leaders for scientific and non-promotional speaker partnerships with Ceribell

Medical and scientific thought leadership

  • Lead development and medical review of scientific communication materials, including publications, congress materials, white papers, and clinical education content.
  • Serve a Ceribell thought leader for scientific exchange at key forums and conferences
  • Design and build the Medical Affairs organization from the ground up, including recommending optimal team structures, recruiting and mentoring future staff and managing departmental budgets to achieve strategic goals.

Cross Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Clinical Affairs on interpretation and dissemination of clinical trial and real-world evidence data.
  • Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs to ensure promotional and scientific content remains consistent with regulatory submissions and approved claims.
  • Work with Legal/Compliance to ensure adherence to applicable regulations (e.g., FDA, AdvaMed Code of Ethics) and internal compliance policies.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned by your Manager/Supervisor

What We're Looking For:

  • Advanced clinical or scientific degree required (MD, PharmD, or PhD).
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Medical Affairs within the medical device, biotechnology, or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years in a leadership role, with a proven track record of designing, building, and scaling a Medical Affairs function from the ground up.
  • Deep therapeutic area expertise in neurology, neurocritical care, emergency medicine, or intensive care is highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success in identifying, engaging, and building long-term relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and major academic societies (e.g., AES, ACNS, ACEP, NCS).
  • Extensive experience guiding the development of consensus statements, clinical guidelines, and robust scientific publication plans.
  • Proven ability to plan and moderate high-impact scientific advisory boards and clinical forums.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to define strategic goals, manage departmental budgets, and recruit top talent.
  • Comprehensive understanding of FDA regulations, the AdvaMed Code of Ethics, and regulatory compliance standards for scientific exchange and non-promotional medical communications.
  • Exceptional cross-functional collaboration skills, with a history of successful partnerships with Clinical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Legal/Compliance, and Commercial teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex clinical data into clear, scientifically accurate educational materials.
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently (approx. 30-40%) to attend national conferences, society meetings, and academic centers.

Compensation:

SF Bay Area/NY Metro Area/LA Metro: $351,000 - $395,000/year

National: $310,000 - $346,000/year

Compensation Range
$310,000—$395,000 USD

A candidate’s final salary offer will be based on their skills, education, work location and experience, and thus it may differ from the posted range. Compensation may also include bonuses consistent with Ceribell’s corporate compensation plan. Note, the above description is not all-encompassing and Ceribell reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time.

title: Principal Robotics Systems Architect
description:

With talented employees on 4 continents, we have filed 50+ patents to date.

Join Ethernovia’s team to make a lasting impact on the future of packet processor-centric networking solutions to support the real-time sensor, Physical AI, and control data demands of software-defined autonomy across vehicles, robots and intelligent machines. Come share in our success with pre-IPO shares, competitive compensation, and great benefits while growing your knowledge and career with world class talent. We are looking for talented engineers and leaders who have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to drive cutting edge designs from concept to silicon to the future of mobility.

Principal Robotics Systems Architect

Summary:

Work closely with robotics customers and Ethernovia engineering teams to develop optimized system-level connectivity architectures. The role requires a deep understanding of AI compute platforms, cameras, sensors, actuators, distributed processing, and real-time communications. The architect will create practical networking blueprints and reference architectures that help customers accelerate product development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop end-to-end connectivity architectures for humanoid, mobile, and industrial robots.
  • Define networking solutions connecting AI processors, cameras, sensors, controllers, and distributed computing nodes.
  • Create system-level block diagrams, connectivity blueprints, and reference architectures.
  • Optimize designs for bandwidth, latency, determinism, power, cost, and reliability.
  • Work directly with robotics OEMs to understand requirements and recommend solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineering, product management, and customer-facing teams to accelerate adoption.
  • Identify emerging robotics connectivity requirements and help guide product direction.

Required Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or related field.
  • 10+ years in robotics systems, embedded systems, automotive systems, autonomous platforms, or advanced networking architecture.
  • Strong knowledge of robotic systems, sensors, AI compute, and distributed control.
  • Experience with high-speed networking, Ethernet, and embedded communication interfaces.
  • Ability to develop system-level hardware architectures and technical diagrams.
  • Understanding of real-time communication, bandwidth, latency, and synchronization.
  • Excellent technical communication and customer engagement skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with humanoid, autonomous mobile, or industrial robots.
  • Background in robotics OEMs, autonomous systems, or semiconductor companies.
  • Familiarity with ROS 2, DDS, TSN, and industrial communication protocols.
  • Knowledge of high-speed interfaces, physical connectivity, and system integration.
  • Experience creating reference designs and supporting customer design wins.

What You Can Expect From Ethernovia:

  • Technology depth and breadth expansion that can’t be found in a large company
  • Opportunity to grow your career as the company grows
  • Pre IPO stock options
  • Cutting edge technology
  • World class team
  • Competitive base salary
  • Flexible hours
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance for employees

Salary Range:

The annual salary range for this position is $200,000 - $275,000. title: Director of Technical Support Engineering
description:
Director of Technical Support Engineering

Customer Solutions Group | North America

Come help us reimagine GrowthLoop’s technical support function from the ground up. You’ll own the customer support experience end to end, from the moment an issue comes in to the moment the customer confirms it’s fixed. You’ll build and coach a strong team of technical support engineers, and you’ll design AI native systems that get smarter the more they’re used.

You’ll report directly to the VP of the Customer Solutions Group and lead the Technical Support function within CSG, working closely with Product and Engineering. This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll set the direction, and you’ll also dig into the hardest issues yourself, build tooling, and coach your team through the work.

What You Will Do

Build and Lead Technical Support Engineering

  • Recruit, develop and lead technical support engineers who can investigate and solve problems independently. Set a high bar for SQL, APIs, debugging and cloud data systems. Stay hands-on in complex cases.
  • Build a distributed team, with initial expansion focused on India. Use workload, comparable industry benchmarks and unit economics to recommend staffing, hiring models and sustainable coverage while retaining ownership of quality and customer outcomes.

Build an AI Native Support Organization

  • Build AI-assisted intake, triage, investigation and diagnostics connected to approved knowledge, logs, telemetry and authorized customer context. Enable AI agents to manage workflows, maintain knowledge and propose improvements, working toward safe, self-healing support systems.
  • Evaluate against real support cases before deployment. Define permissions, privacy controls, human approval for system changes and clear escalation to human incident response. Expand automation when it improves verified resolution, quality and productivity.

Own the End to End Support Experience

  • Own intake, prioritization, technical investigation, escalation, resolution and customer communication. Establish clear L1, L2 and Engineering handoffs, and define boundaries with Services, and Customer Architects for implementation and advisory requests. Ensure every issue has a clear owner and customers retain continuity through each handoff.
  • Own service levels against customer commitments, including reliable 24/7 critical incident response. Build sustainable on-call rotations across Support and Engineering with clear severity thresholds, escalation paths, handoffs, backup coverage and recovery time after overnight incidents.
  • Track response, resolution, SLA attainment and team workload so coverage meets customer needs without depending on any individual’s continuous availability.

Build Knowledge Tooling and Automation

  • Overhaul customer documentation and internal knowledge as part of the support system. Manage knowledge sources and runbooks in GitHub, own review and publishing standards, and validate workflows with Product and Engineering before guidance is published.
  • Turn investigations into reusable knowledge, diagnostic scripts and tools. Improve visibility into customer workloads, integrations and infrastructure so recurring issues become easier to diagnose or are eliminated. Make documentation and automation part of the team's daily work.

Partner Deeply with Engineering and Product

  • Partner with Engineering to establish shared escalation ownership, response expectations and a clear path for stalled issues. Reduce unnecessary Engineering interruptions through independent investigation and reproducible escalations, while maintaining joint accountability for incident response, root cause analysis and permanent fixes.
  • Bring support trends by product area into customer and product discussions. Route internal technical questions through a clear support path, validate answers, and partner on reliability, observability, diagnosability and customer self-service.

What You Bring

Required Experience

  • A proven record of building or transforming technical support, hiring and coaching distributed technical support engineers, and owning customer outcomes end to end while staying active in investigations.
  • Hands-on troubleshooting across SQL, APIs, authentication, schemas, data syncs and exports, plus evidence of building diagnostic scripts, tools or automation that improved support.
  • Experience designing and evaluating AI-enabled support systems, including grounded answers, permissions, failure analysis and human handoffs. Show what improved and how you controlled risk.
  • Experience turning investigations into reliable, version-controlled knowledge and runbooks, with clear review and publishing ownership.
  • Strong customer judgment under pressure. Prioritize issues using customer impact, severity and contractual commitments, including when the cause or scope is unclear. Communicate uncertainty honestly, set clear expectations and work across teams to move stalled issues toward resolution.
  • Strong judgment in capacity planning, comparable benchmarking and support economics, plus clear customer communication and effective partnership with Engineering, Product and customer-facing teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise data platforms, cloud warehouses or marketing technology, including audience activation and destination integrations.
  • Experience scaling an India-based technical team, implementing Knowledge-Centered Service or safely expanding an internal AI assistant into customer-facing support.

About GrowthLoop

GrowthLoop built the first composable CDP, helping marketers leverage live, first-party data from their cloud warehouse to launch highly targeted campaigns. That composable foundation gave way to the Compound Marketing Engine, an evolution of the composable CDP that drives compound growth by using agentic AI to accelerate the marketing cycle.

Now, we’re building what comes next: an agentic system that uses causality data to find the actions that actually improve customer outcomes and gets smarter with every campaign cycle.

Founder-led, we’re partnering with the world’s most innovative brands to close the loop between people, data, and AI. Enterprise marketing teams at Google, Costco, Ford, and Whirlpool (to name a few) choose GrowthLoop to launch smarter, more personalized marketing programs that compound growth with every campaign.

Support helps customers use those capabilities confidently, resolve technical issues, and turn what they learn into repeatable ways of working.

About You

You do not let unresolved customer problems drift. You own outcomes, streamline systems, share credit and communicate honestly about uncertainty. You are comfortable investigating a ticket, building a tool, improving a runbook and coaching a teammate. Our values are Love Our Customer, Make It So, Put We Over Me, Be Human and Aim High.

What We Offer

You will have the opportunity to rebuild and lead GrowthLoop's technical support function, combining engineering talent, AI-native systems and a scalable operating model. You will work closely with technical and customer-facing teams in a culture that values customer outcomes, practical action and shared success.

title: Silicon Front End CAD Verification Engineer
description:
Grow with us

About this opportunity:

Silicon Front-End CAD DV Engineer – Dual-Vendor Flows, Methodology & AI
Austin, Texas. This is not a remote work opportunity


Shape how Ericsson’s ASICs and FPGAs are verified, from IP testbench to SoC regression. Combine deep SystemVerilog and UVM expertise with software engineering and practical AI to build faster, more reliable verification flows across silicon programs.
Work on ASIC and FPGA programs for Ericsson’s 5G and 6G portfolio at advanced nodes, including Intel 18A and TSMC 3/2nm. Drive measurable gains in verification quality, coverage closure, and regression turnaround through reusable testbench architecture, qualified DV flows, and AI-driven automation.

Ericsson Silicon develops ASICs and FPGAs for telecommunications infrastructure. We are seeking a hands-on engineer to advance our front-end verification methodology, DV flows, and infrastructure—not simply support existing tools.
You will join a global methodology team spanning Austin, Stockholm, Lund, and India, working across verification methodology, EDA flow support, and OneRun, our front-end flow orchestration platform. Partner with IP and SoC verification teams, design and back-end methodology owners, and EDA vendors. Own qualified engineering solutions in your area; partner with the Silicon CAD Technical Program Manager on delivery and adoption. Project verification leads retain signoff approval.
What you will do
• Architect scalable DV environments: Build layered, reusable SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches with clean separation, automated regression, and clear documentation. An early deliverable is a maintainable testbench for our register generation tool.
• Develop high-quality VIP: Create efficient, reusable UVM verification IP with strong protocol checking, coverage, and low simulation overhead, independent of any single vendor’s VIP library.
• Advance verification methodology: Develop IP-to-SoC methodology across constrained-random and directed simulation, assertions, formal, and coverage closure. Keep environments portable across Cadence and Synopsys simulation and formal tools.
• Apply AI to DV engineering: Use and improve AI tools such as ChipAgents and Kiro for testbench creation, spec-driven development, debug, and regression triage. Validate benefits against reproducible baselines; retain engineering review.
• Deliver production-ready capabilities: Automate regression and release qualification in Jenkins CI and OneRun. Run representative pilots on real designs and support controlled rollout without disrupting active tapeout schedules.
• Multiply technical impact: Resolve complex flow and tool issues, influence EDA vendor improvements, and mentor engineers through design reviews, documentation, and shared ownership.

Join our Team

What you will bring
• 5+ years in ASIC/FPGA design verification or DV methodology, with evidence of production deployment and successful tapeout contributions.
• Deep hands-on expertise in SystemVerilog and UVM testbench architecture at IP, subsystem, and SoC level, including constrained-random verification, SVA, and functional and code coverage closure.
• Strong experience with Cadence Xcelium and/or Synopsys VCS, and formal or lint/CDC tools. Specialist depth in one domain is valued; expertise in every domain is not required.
• Strong Python and scripting skills, with experience building maintainable automation using Linux, version control, code review, CI, automated tests, and controlled releases.
• Demonstrated ability to turn difficult verification problems into reusable solutions across projects, explain technical trade-offs, and collaborate effectively in distributed teams.
• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.

Critical Exposure:
Practical application of AI/ML or LLM-based tools to testbench generation, coverage prediction, or failure triage; register-model development (UVM RAL, SystemRDL, IP-XACT); migrating verification environments between EDA vendors; or measurable improvements in coverage closure time and regression cost.

Own the engineering behind the verification flow—not just a step within it. Influence methodology, work directly with IP and SoC teams and EDA vendors, and turn new DV and AI ideas into production capabilities. Your impact will be measured in higher silicon quality, faster coverage closure, and verification environments that engineers trust across programs.

What happens once you apply?
Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.

Ericsson uses a merit-based hiring approach that values people with different experiences, perspectives and skillsets. We truly believe this approach drives innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer, learn more.

If you need assistance or to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact Ericsson at hr.direct.americas@ericsson.com.

They are not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required for this position, and you may be required to perform additional job tasks as assigned.

Job details: Developer

Primary Recruiter: Jim Everett

Compensation and Benefits at Ericsson
At Ericsson, we know that our people are the key to our success. We offer a competitive package to help with your individual needs and goals.

Your Pay
The salary range for this position is dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, location, and the candidate’s combination of job-related knowledge, qualifications, skills, education, training, and experience

Short-Term Variable Compensation Plan: Your pay also includes the opportunity for an annual bonus. Actual bonus payouts are based on performance of the business against the unit’s objectives, individual performance, and the individual bonus target. Certain eligibility and pro-ration rules apply.

Your Health
Ericsson offers excellent health benefits including the choice of three medical plan options and a dental plan option that allow an employee to select the level of coverage that suits their needs. Employees will receive company credits in an amount equal to the cost that Ericsson pays toward the cost of their medical and dental premiums for themselves and eligible covered dependents.

Your Financial Security

We invest in both your short and long-term financial wellbeing. The Ericsson US 401(k) Plan offers an automatic 3% company contribution and Ericsson match $1 for every $1 you put into the 401(k) Plan on the first 3% of your eligible pay, plus 50 cents on every $1 on the next 2% of eligible pay. When you contribute at least 5% of eligible pay, you are receiving Ericsson’s full matching contributions of 4%. Matching and company automatic contributions stop when your total eligible pay for the year reaches the IRS limits. Employees will also receive company credits in an amount equal to the cost of basic life insurance and basic accidental death and dismemberment coverage, as well as short-term and long-term disability coverage. Employees also have the option to participate in Ericsson’s Stock Purchase Plan.

Your Time
Your work-life balance is important to us. New employees are provided a minimum of 15 days of accrued vacation, up to 3 personal days per year, 11 annual holidays, 8 hours of volunteer time, and 80 hours of sick time annually. Projektipäällikkö / Rakennustekninen valvoja

Tule rakentamaan kanssamme rohkeasti parempaa! Kanssamme pääset osaksi innokasta ja vahvan osaamisen omaavaa tiimiä, jonka kanssa on mukavaa kehittää alaa parempaan suuntaan. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden tulla vahvistamaan toimialamme yksikköä Keski-Suomen alueella. Etsimme osaavia ihmisiä ratkaisemaan mielenkiintoisia haasteita monipuolisissa projekteissa ja kasvavassa sekä kehityshaluisessa työyhteisössä.

Rakennusteknisenä valvojana pääset mukaan rakentamaan kasvavaa ja kehittyvää organisaatiota, monipuolisiin ja vaihteleviin hankkeisiin rakennuttamisen projektihallinnan ja valvonnan tehtävissä Jyväskylän alueella. Vastaat rakennustöiden laadun, turvallisuuden, suunnitelmien mukaisuuden ja sopimusten toteutumisen valvonnasta sekä osallistut aktiivisesti hankkeiden sujuvan etenemisen varmistamiseen yhteistyössä tilaajien, suunnittelijoiden ja urakoitsijoiden kanssa.

Toivomme, että tartut rohkeasti niin pienempiin projekteihin kuin isompiin hankkeisiin, tehtävässä pääset mukaan erilaisiin niin liiketila-, julkisen rakentamisen, toimitila-, teollisuus- kuin datakeskushankkeisiin. Työsi voi sisältää esimerkiksi työmaakatselmuksia, laadun ja aikataulun seurantaa, dokumentointia sekä havaittuihin poikkeamiin puuttumista ja korjaavien toimenpiteiden johtamista/seurantaa. Kokemuksesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan voit ottaa vastuuta myös vaativammista valvonta- ja rakennuttamistehtävistä sekä projektihallinnasta, tarjoamme myös vahvan tuen osaamisen kehittämisessä kasvupolullasi.

Tehtävän nimetty toimipiste on Jyväskylä, osittaisin etätyömahdollisuuksin. Kohteet sijaitsevat Keski-Suomen alueella ja satunnaisesti valvontakohteet voivat sijaita kauempana, tehtävät edellyttävät ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.

Tehtävässä onnistumiseen tarvitset

· tehtävään soveltuvan rakennus- tai talotekniikan koulutuksen

· kokemusta rakennusteknisistä tai taloteknisistä valvontatehtävistä ja ymmärrystä työmaiden käytännöistä sekä projektien johtamisesta

· kykyä tulkita suunnitelmia, sopimusasiakirjoja ja teknisiä vaatimuksia sekä viedä havaintoja käytännön toimenpiteiksi

· oma-aloitteista, järjestelmällistä ja vastuullista työskentelyotetta

· hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kykyä toimia luontevasti tilaajien, suunnittelijoiden ja urakoitsijoiden kanssa

· sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa, kerrothan mikäli pystyt käyttämään työkielenä myös englantia tai ruotsia.

Eduksi katsomme RAV-pätevyyden sekä kokemuksen P1- ja Terve talo -rakentamisesta ja teollisuuden hankkeista. Myös muu tehtävää tukeva valvonta-, rakennuttamis- tai talotekninen osaaminen on meille plussaa.

Satsaamme sinuun ja työyhteisöösi
Haluamme, että ihmisemme voivat kehittyä osaajina omannäköisellään tavalla. Saat ympärillesi osaavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön sekä laajan asiantuntijaverkoston, jonka kanssa pääset ratkaisemaan vaativia suunnitteluhaasteita.

Tarjoamme sinulle joustavat työskentelytavat, monipuoliset henkilöstöedut sekä ison yrityksen mahdollisuudet työyhteisössä, joka kuuluu työntekijöidensä arvioimana Suomen innostavimpiin ja tekniikan alan ammattilaisten silmissä alan vetovoimaisimpiin työnantajiin (Innostavimmat 2026 ja Universum 2026).

Kiinnostuitko?
Jätä meille CV:si ja vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi 2.12.2026 mennessä osoitteessa . Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, joten suosittelemme hakemaan tehtävää mahdollisimman pian. Tietoturvasyistä emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä sinulle antaa:
Rakennuttajapäällikkö Matti Lappalainen, matti.lappalainen@ains.fi tai 040 5770 580

A-Insinöörit - ihmisiä, joiden kanssa rakennat rohkeasti parempaa. Tutustu meihin ja rakennuttamisen, arkkitehtisuunnittelun, rakennesuunnittelun, korjaussuunnittelun, teollisuus- ja talotekniikka sekä yhdyskunta- ja ympäristösuunnittelun toimialoihimme .

title: Investment Associate - Samlino Group
description:
Are you ready to thrive in a dynamic and exhilarating environment where you'll be entrusted with significant responsibilities? Are you seeking to join an extraordinary team of young, motivated, and highly ambitious individuals? If you have a genuine passion for connecting with people and driving remarkable outcomes, then you could be the perfect fit for our Founder's Associate position.

About us

We are on a mission to help consumers save time and money by matching them with the best products for their needs with banking, insurance and utilities. Samlino Group () operates across three markets, we empowered over 10 million users last year alone, propelling them toward living healthier financial lives.

What we offer you

As our Investment Associate, you get the unique opportunity to be a key driver of our exponential growth curve. Sunny Lisbon will be your home base, but you’ll travel to and work with our three markets! To facilitate a steep growth curve, we provide you with the following:

  • The chance to create a genuine impact - experience the thrill of working in a fast-paced environment where your efforts and results are tangible, shaping the destiny of our business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - work closely with our high-performing teams alongside our international peers and founder.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we firmly believe in nurturing talent from within, fostering an environment where the sky's the limit.
  • The passport to adventure - as a part of our international organization, you spread your wings and learn from our other markets while applying both strategic and executive skills.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - fuel your interpersonal, digital, entrepreneurial, organizational, project management, and business prowess through hands-on experience in an organisation that values training and development.

Your Responsibilities

You will own your own projects and be responsible for driving results across various projects and initiatives. Responsibilities in this job will evolve and be defined and redefined throughout your time with us. The aim is to take ownership of and drive the development of progressively larger opportunities. Success requires the following:

  • Setting ambitious yet achievable goals, developing strategic plans to reach them, and executing with urgency and intensity to deliver measurable outcomes
  • Take ownership of assigned projects or tasks from inception to completion, including defining clear objectives, plans, and deliverables
  • Proactively identify potential bottlenecks or obstacles and develop mitigation strategies
  • Drive accountability by ensuring all team members understand their roles and responsibilities
  • Act as a champion for our results-driven culture within the team and organization
  • Build, coach, and empower A+ teams to reach their potential and provide 5-star experiences to our users and partners
  • Project-based assignments with clear objectives spread across different geographies
  • Deep dive into value creation, process improvement and organizational growth
  • Thinking out of the box, brainstorming and strategizing to challenge status quo and aim at accelerating our momentum and efficient scaling

What we expect from you

We are seeking a dynamic individual who thrives in a results-oriented environment to join our team and help us reach our objectives. Industry experience is not a requirement, but you do need to be highly ambitious, proactive, forward-thinking, a fast learner, and driven to succeed.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have proactive mindset, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Are self-motivated, detail-oriented, and possess a track record of successfully owning projects from conception to completion
  • Possess an unwavering drive and desire to be the very best at what they do
  • Are passionate about making an impact and driving tangible results
  • Exude an unparalleled work ethic fueled by an urgency to progress
  • Embrace ownership and proactively following through on commitments
  • Possess an insatiable curiosity about business, data, and people, relishing the opportunity to build and nurture relationships that fuel lasting success
  • Master the art of communication, wielding their words with impact both verbally and in writing
  • Showcase unrivalled organizational skills, skillfully structuring and prioritizing their work to achieve maximum efficiency
  • Danish speaker, fluent in English and an EU work permit is required

Start Date and Location

Flexible start date.

The role will be full time, onsite in Lisbon, Portugal.

It will cover all three markets, so regular travel will be part of what we have in mind for you! It will also include extended stays working hands-on with the teams in the different locations.

title: Director, Clinical Operations
description:
The Opportunity:

As Director, Clinical Operations – Global Study Lead, you will be accountable for the end-to-end planning and execution of one or more global studies within Relay Tx’s breast cancer (BC) program. You will lead cross-functional study teams and CRO partners to deliver registrational-quality studies with speed, rigor and data integrity. You will be an integrated member of the BC clinical development team, bringing operational insight to study design and program strategy, and translating Relay’s innovative science into impactful medicines for patients with breast cancer. You will report to the Vice President, Clinical Operations.

Your Role:

  • You will serve as the Global Study Lead, accountable for the delivery of assigned BC studies from protocol concept through study start-up, enrollment, database lock and clinical study report, on time, on budget and to quality.
  • You will lead the cross-functional study team (Clinical Science, Medical, Biostatistics, Data Management, Clinical Supply, Regulatory, Safety, Quality and Translational), setting clear priorities, driving decisions and escalating risks appropriately.
  • You will bring operational and feasibility input to protocol design, country and site selection, and enrollment strategy, ensuring study plans are aligned with the BC clinical development strategy and corporate goals.
  • You will own the study’s integrated timelines, budget, forecasts, risk and mitigation plans, and key performance metrics, and provide clear, data-driven status updates to program and senior leadership.
  • You will select, contract and oversee CROs and specialty vendors (e.g., central lab, imaging, IRT, eCOA), holding partners accountable for performance and quality through governance and active issue management.
  • You will drive enrollment and site performance across a global footprint (North America, Europe and other regions), using data and creative recruitment and retention approaches to accelerate timelines.
  • You will build and maintain strong relationships with investigators, key opinion leaders, site staff and cooperative groups in the breast oncology community, and be able to explain complex scientific and operational topics to these stakeholders.
  • You will ensure inspection readiness and compliance with GCP, ICH, and applicable global regulations, including oversight of the Trial Master File, monitoring strategy, protocol deviations and corrective/preventive actions.
  • You will contribute the Clinical Operations sections of key regulatory and study documents (e.g., protocols and amendments, IND/CTA submissions, briefing packages, NDA/MAA components, annual reports, study postings and clinical study reports).
  • You will partner with Clinical Operational Excellence to apply and improve study systems, processes and SOPs, and share lessons learned across the BC program and the broader Clinical Operations team.
  • You will lead, coach and develop clinical study managers, clinical trial associates and other study team members, and serve as a leadership role model within Clinical Development Operations.

Your Background:

  • You bring 10+ years of experience in the biopharma or CRO industry, including significant experience leading global studies as a study lead or equivalent.
  • You have led global Phase 2 and/or Phase 3 oncology studies end to end; experience with registrational studies is strongly preferred.
  • You have breast cancer or solid tumor oncology experience; familiarity with endocrine therapy, targeted therapy combinations, or the metastatic breast cancer treatment landscape is a plus.
  • You have a track record of hands-on CRO and vendor oversight in an outsourced model, including contracting, budget management and performance governance.
  • You have strong, current knowledge of global regulatory and compliance requirements, including US CFR, EU CTR, and ICH GCP, and have supported inspections or audits.
  • You have a proven ability to deliver to aggressive timelines, using data, technology and creative problem-solving to accelerate enrollment and maintain data integrity.
  • You lead through influence, building alignment across functions and with external partners, and you communicate clearly and confidently with senior leaders, investigators and vendors.
  • You are a motivated self-starter who flourishes in a fast-paced, growing biotech environment and can manage multiple priorities with a high degree of attention to detail.
  • You have line management or team leadership experience and enjoy mentoring and developing talent.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or health-related field required; advanced degree preferred.

#JO1

About Relay Therapeutics

Relay Therapeutics is a clinical-stage precision medicines company transforming the drug discovery process with the goal of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. Built on unparalleled insights into protein motion and how this dynamic behavior relates to protein function, we aim to effectively drug protein targets that have previously been intractable, with an initial focus on enhancing small molecule therapeutic discovery in targeted oncology. Our Dynamo platform integrates an array of leading-edge experimental and computational approaches to provide a differentiated understanding of protein structure and motion to drug these targets. We have built a world-class team of leading experts from each of these disciplines, and they are driven by a deep collaboration at every step of our drug discovery process.

Our team is equal parts fearless and relentless, with a shared passion for working collaboratively in intellectually stimulating environments. If you’re excited by the challenge of putting protein motion at the heart of drug discovery and passionate about making a difference in the lives of patients, join us!

title: After-Hours Consultant

title: Winkelstage regio Gent & Vlaamse Ardennen
description:
Wat ga je leren en doen tijdens je stage?

Als stagiair(e) krijg je een heldere inkijk in én ervaring met alle facetten van het winkelgebeuren:

  • Winkeloperatie & variatie: je ontdekt de dynamiek van de winkel — van het beheren van de groente- en fruitafdeling tot het vers afbakken van de lekkerste croissants in onze bakkerij.
  • Klantenservice & kassa: je helpt onze klanten met een glimlach verder, kijkt mee aan de kassa en zorgt voor een aangename winkelervaring.
  • Voorraad & beheer: je leert hoe de goederenstroom werkt, hoe we de versheid garanderenen hoe de winkel er altijd strak en uitnodigend bij ligt.
  • Teamwork & begeleiding: je werkt nauw samen met ervaren collega’s, Assistant Store Managers en de Store Manager. Je ziet van dichtbij hoe #teamlidl op de winkelvloer wordt aangestuurd.
Wie ben jij?
  • Je volgt een relevante opleiding (bijv. Retail, Handel, Verkoop,...) verbonden aan een school instantie en zoekt een stageplek voor minstens 4 weken.
  • Je bent minstens 16 jaar.
  • Je bent een echte teamspeler met een flinke dosis enthousiasme en bent een doener die energie krijgt van concrete actie.
  • Je bent leergierig, klantgericht en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.
Wat bieden wij jou?
  • Echte praktijkervaring: een gevarieerde stage waarin je alle kneepjes van het retailvak leert kennen.
  • Topwerksfeer: een warme, open en collegiale werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich thuis voelt en gelijk is.
  • Persoonlijke groei: volop ruimte om te ontdekken wat je in je mars hebt. We moeten allemaal ergens beginnen, toch?
  • Toekomstperspectief: klikt het langs beide kanten? Dan bekijken we graag de mogelijkheden voor een studentenjob of een vaste job na je afstuderen. Lidl biedt je alle kansen!

We zijn ervan overtuigd dat diversiteit onze organisatie sterker maakt en verwelkomen iedereen. Ongeacht leeftijd, afkomst, genderidentiteit, geaardheid, geloof, of handicap. Gelijke kansen en eerlijke beloning staan bij ons centraal.

title: Interline Baggage Ramp Agent (LAX) - Full-Time
description:
As an Interline Baggage Ramp Agent, you'll play a key role in ensuring passengers’ baggage is accurately transferred, staged, and routed to the proper destination. You’ll work in a fast-paced, outdoor environment where teamwork, safety, and attention to detail are essential. If you’re ready for a physically active role that makes a real impact, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Safely lift, load, unload, and transport baggage from conveyor belts.
  • Deliver passenger luggage to designated locations within an allotted timeframe.
  • Safely drive and operate ground equipment, such as tugs, in areas of congestion.
  • Operate baggage scanners to ensure baggage is routed accurately to the customer's destination.
  • Monitor weather conditions and take appropriate safety measures.
  • Perform regular equipment inspections and basic maintenance checks.
  • Comply with all federal, state, municipal, airport authority and carrier safety and security requirements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support McGee’s successful business operation.

Required

  • A valid driver's license with a good driving record.
  • Ability to pass a pre-employment drug test.
  • Ability to pass a physical capability test. (SEA and SFO only)
  • Ability to pass a criminal background check.
  • Ability to obtain & maintain an airport SIDA badge, US Customs seal, and USPS security clearance.
  • Ability to work any shift, including early mornings, late nights, weekends and Holidays.
  • Lifting up to 75 pounds on a frequent basis.
  • Proficiency in English (written and spoken).
  • Must be able to bend, stoop, squat, reach, and grasp.
  • Ability to maintain reliable attendance.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to get along with others.
  • Ability to work at a constant and quick pace.
  • Understanding and ability to utilize electronic tools to interpret flight schedules and airline flight destination information.
  • Performing basic mathematical functions. (e.g., counting bags)
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S.

Preferred

  • Previous airport experience.
  • Previous experience working in a physically demanding or safety critical job.

This job description outlines the essential functions and requirements for this position. Team Member must be able to perform these key responsibilities, with or without reasonable accommodation, unless doing so would cause undue hardship to the Company.

Pre-Employment Requirements

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable pre-employment requirements. Depending on the position, these may include a criminal background check, drug test, driving record review, employment verification, and other job-related screenings.

Any criminal background check will be conducted after a conditional offer of employment and in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Physical Demands & Work Conditions
Lifting/Carrying: Ability to frequently lift, push, pull, and carry baggage and cargo weighing up to 50 pounds regularly, and occasionally up to 75 pounds or more. This often involves lifting items onto raised surfaces or into confined aircraft bins.

Movement:

  • Frequent standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping, squatting, crawling, and twisting for extended periods (up to 8-hour shifts or more).

  • Ability to climb stairs/ladders and work in cramped or high places.

  • Manual dexterity required for handling documents and operating equipment.

Driving/Operating Equipment: Must be able to operate various ground support equipment (GSE) such as tugs, belt loaders, and baggage carts, which requires a valid driver's license and the physical capability to do so safely.

Vision/Hearing: Clear vision (including depth perception and peripheral vision) and hearing are required for monitoring flight information, communication via radio/headsets, and safety compliance in a noisy environment.

Outdoor Exposure: The job is performed primarily outdoors in all weather conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, and snow.

Noise and Environment: The work environment is very noisy, near active aircraft engines and ground support machinery, and may involve exposure to fumes, dust, and other airborne particles. Hearing protection is usually provided and required.

Physical Capabilities Testing
This position requires significant physical agility; you may be required to complete a Physical Capabilities Test post offer that will demonstrate your ability to:

  • Lift, carry, and place weighted standardized boxes, suitcases, or duffel bags from floor height to overhead.
  • Climb steps carrying weighted standardized box, suitcase, or duffel bags.
  • Sit and rotate to the left, right, and behind and visually identify a letter or number.
  • Pull a weighted sled a standardized distance.

Union Information
This position is part of a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA). Per the CBA, work schedules are awarded based on seniority. New hires are awarded their initial shift based on operational need. Therefore, the company cannot guarantee certain days off.

EEO Statement
McGee Air Services does not tolerate discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Employees or applicants who inquire about, discuss, or disclose their compensation or the compensation of other employees or applicants are also protected by law. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions absent undue hardship and consistent with applicable law.

title: IT-sikkerhedsspecialist
description:
Om jobbet

Som IT-sikkerhedsspecialist får du en central rolle i arbejdet med at styrke vores operationelle IT-sikkerhed. Du arbejder tæt sammen med vores driftsteams om at identificere, prioritere og håndtere sårbarheder på tværs af vores infrastruktur. Desuden arbejder du tæt sammen med vores eksterne sikkerhedspartnere og specialister, når der opstår hændelser.

Rollen er hands-on, men du kommer ikke til at sidde alene med teknikken. Du er med til at gøre sikkerhed forståeligt og prioriteret for både udviklere, driftsteams og kolleger uden teknisk baggrund.

Stillingen er placeret inden for almindelig kontortid og er ikke omfattet af vagtordning.

Dine opgaver

  • Konfigurere og drive vores værktøjer til sårbarhedsscanning og sikkerhedsovervågning, fx Tenable, Microsoft Defender og Security-centeret.

  • Prioritere fund og lave anbefalinger til patchning og hærdning af infrastruktur.

  • Holde opfølgningsmøder med driftsteams og få indsatser sat i gang.

  • Udarbejde månedlig rapportering om IT-sikkerhed, blandt andet patch-hastighed.

  • Bidrage til sikkerhedsscanninger, vurdering af sikkerhedsrapporter og input til kolleger i Informationssikkerhedsteamet.

Hvem er du?

Du har en teknisk sikkerhedsprofil med erfaring og interesse for, hvordan infrastruktur og cloud hærdes i praksis. Dokumenteret erfaring med Tenable vægter positivt, men er ikke et krav.

  • Du kan analysere og forstå trusselsbilledet og forklare det til andre

  • Du kan vedligeholde og optimere sikkerhedsværktøjer

  • Du forstår overvågning, detektion og hændelseshåndtering

  • Du formidler tekniske fund og risici tydeligt og pragmatisk, også til ikke-tekniske kolleger

  • Du er serviceminded, tager ansvar og arbejder gerne tæt sammen med andre

Hvorfor Danske Spil?

Hos os får du et job, hvor IT-sikkerhed betyder noget i hverdagen. Du arbejder i en reguleret virksomhed, hvor sikkerhed og certificeringer fra blandt andre Spillemyndigheden og World Lottery Association er kritiske krav, og vores sikkerhedsarbejde tager afsæt i rammeværker som NIST 2.0, ISO 27001 og CIS-kontroller.

Teamet dækker alle områder inden for IT-sikkerhed og vi arbejder også intenst med de muligheder og sikkerhedsudfordringer, som AI skaber, og du får samtidig en unik mulighed for at være med fra starten i etableringen af en sikker AI-understøttelse på tværs af organisationen. Du får indflydelse på de sikkerhedsmæssige rammer for anvendelsen af AI, herunder AI Harness, MCP samt connectors, så vi kan udnytte AI’s potentiale sikkert og ansvarligt.

Du bliver en del af afdelingen Infrastructure & Service Management, hvor vi tager ejerskab for stabil drift og sikkerhed, hjælper hinanden og er handlekraftige, når det gælder. Tonen er uformel med plads til humor og personlighed, og du får direkte sparring med en senior IT-arkitekt.

Vil du være med til at underholde danskerne?

Vi læser ansøgninger igennem løbende, men deadline for at søge er den 3. december 2026. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jesper Tjørnlund på jest@danskespil.dk. Hvis du har spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Business Partner, Mette Overgaard Holm på MEHO@danskespil.dk.

Stillingen er placeret i en afdeling, hvor fremvisning af straffeattest er påkrævet. Hvis du indkaldes til samtale, skal straffeattesten derfor indhentes og uploades i rekrutteringssystemet inden 1. samtale.

title: Operation Model and Service Transition Analyst, Contact Centre
description:
We are looking for a Service Transition Analyst, Contact Centre to help define the target operating model and service transition for a major Canadian bank's contact centre migration to a cloud platform, spanning 39 lines of business.

You will work directly alongside the Service Transition Lead as a two-person unit. You will sit in the sessions where the operating model is decided, interview the people who run the legacy platform today, and produce the service transition artifacts the operations team will use on day one. The model does not exist yet; this is not backfill work on an established program.

The Lead holds stakeholder relationships, design decisions, governance and transition negotiation. You will drive information gathering, analysis, drafting, decision capture and follow-through. This is not a scribe or project coordination role: you are expected to draft with judgment and challenge inconsistency across artifacts.

Working Model: This is a hybrid role requiring 2 days per week in a downtown Toronto office.

Responsibilities:

  • Draft operating model and service transition artifacts under the Lead's direction, including process definitions, RACI, resolver group and escalation documentation, role descriptions, capability maps, and SLA and OLA documentation.

  • Produce runbooks and service operations documentation with the existing operations team, capturing current-state practices and required changes, and documenting processes with no existing written procedures, including access provisioning and attestation, monitoring and alert routing, disaster recovery runbooks, and line-of-business onboarding and offboarding.

  • Draft ServiceNow artifacts based on the legacy implementation, including catalog item definitions, assignment and resolver group mappings, incident and change workflows, CMDB requirements, and knowledge base articles.

  • Maintain the artifact register, transition RAID log, service readiness tracker, decision log, gap register, skills matrix, and document version control. Track open items and follow-ups, and escalate contradictions with prior decisions to the Lead before they are incorporated into artifacts.

  • Prepare session materials, pre-reads, and templates; support and co-facilitate workshops and breakouts where a second facilitator is needed; capture decisions, actions, and open items live; and turn session outputs into draft artifacts within days.

  • Conduct current-state interviews and shadowing with operations teams, assembling the operational baseline covering ticket volumes, effort distribution, tooling, monitoring coverage, and existing ServiceNow content.

  • Execute detailed service readiness assessments across people, processes, tooling, monitoring, documentation, support models, knowledge management, and supplier dependencies; escalate readiness patterns to the Lead; assemble and validate data for the Lead's run-cost and resourcing model; maintain the skills matrix and gap register; and support sourcing options analysis through comparable research.

  • Track transition activities and readiness by release, flag slippage, coordinate scheduling across delivery teams, operations, vendors, and lines of business, and maintain the stakeholder map and knowledge transfer tracker, including named receivers for each function.

  • 7+ years as a business analyst, service management analyst or equivalent, including service transition or operations work.
  • 4+ years of hands-on operational experience with an enterprise cloud contact centre platform;
  • 2+ years of experience in Genesys Cloud contact centre solutions
  • Supported at least one enterprise platform go-live, producing operational readiness or service acceptance documentation.
  • Contact centre or technology operations domain experience, including familiarity with queues, adherence and after-call work.
  • Track record of producing operational documentation that teams actually use.
  • Experience capturing and supporting facilitation in live working sessions with senior stakeholders in the room.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL service management, particularly Service Transition, Change Enablement and Knowledge Management.
  • Hands-on ServiceNow experience, including service catalog, assignment groups and knowledge base.
  • Solid Excel skills for registers, trackers and data analysis.
  • Ability to interview operational staff and surface how work really happens, not just how it is documented.
  • Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail, with the confidence to challenge inconsistencies and escalate appropriately.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in a regulated or financial services environment.
  • ITIL Foundation certification.
  • Prior work inside a systems integrator or multi-vendor delivery model.

We offer:

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

title: Rakennesuunnittelija korjausrakentamiseen
description:
Tervetuloa töihin ennakkoluulottomaan rakentamisen ja rakennetun ympäristön suunnittelu- ja konsulttitoimistoon! A-Insinööreissä luomme kulttuuria, jossa asiantuntijamme ja asiakkaamme voivat onnistua yhdessä. Tarjoamme ison yrityksen edut, mutta pienen talon mutkattomuuden innostavassa, palkitussa työyhteisössä.

Haussa nyt
Rakennesuunnittelija korjausrakentamiseen

Tule rakentamaan kanssamme rohkeasti parempaa! Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden erottautua massasta, tule työkaveriksemme ja pääset mukaan vahvistamaan toimialamme yksikköä Kuopion alueella konsernimme muiden suunnittelupalveluiden vahvalla tuella. Etsimme osaavia ihmisiä ratkaisemaan korjausrakentamisen haasteita kiinnostavissa projekteissa, kasvavassa ja kehityshaluisessa työyhteisössä.

Korjausrakentamisen rakennesuunnittelijana työskentelet monipuolisissa korjausrakentamisen suunnittelutehtävissä tiiviissä yhteistyössä sisäisten ja ulkoisten sidosryhmien kanssa ja vastaat työtehtäviesi korkealaatuisesta toteutuksesta asiakkaillemme korjausrakentamisen hankkeissa. Pääset näyttämään taitosi monimuotoisissa kohteissa työporukassa, jossa jokaisen ääntä kuunnellaan. Lisätietoja meistä löydät osoitteesta .

Työsi sisältää monipuolisia suunnittelutehtäviä erilaisissa peruskorjaus- ja muuntorakentamisen hankkeissa. Toteutamme korjaussuunnittelua vaativiin suojeltuihin kohteisiin, julkisiin rakennuksiin, asuinrakennuksiin, liike- ja toimistotiloihin sekä teollisiin kohteisiin.

Näiden lisäksi voit myös tehdä kuntoarvioita sekä työmaavalvontaa. Kuulemme mielellämme millaista osaamista ja kokemusta toisit mukanasi. Kuulemme mielellämme, mikäli sinulla on aikaisempaa kokemusta projektinjohtotehtävistä, tämä voidaan huomioida lopullisessa tehtävänkuvauksessa. Tässä tehtävässä on mahdollisuus kasvaa, kehittyä ja ottaa haltuun erilaisia vastuualueita oman kyvyn, osaamisen ja kiinnostuksen mukaan.

Tehtävän nimetty toimipiste on Kuopio, joustavin etätyömahdollisuuksin. Kohteet sijaitsevat Itä-Suomen alueella, tehtävät edellyttävät ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.

Tehtävässä onnistumiseen tarvitset uteliasta mieltä, tarkkuutta ja halua osoittaa asiantuntemustasi sekä kehittyä. Toivomme sinulta rohkeutta tuoda osaamisesi esille, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja itsenäistä työotetta, tiimityöasennetta unohtamatta.

Edellytämme sinulta suunnittelutehtävään soveltuvaa tutkintoa: rakennustekniikan RI(AMK/YAMK)/DI, sekä tietämystä vanhoista rakenteista ja rakennusmateriaaleista sekä kokemusta korjausrakentamisen tietomallipohjaisesta rakennesuunnittelusta vähintään kolmen vuoden ajalta. Vertex-osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.

Arvostamme myös rakennuttamisen pätevyyksiä ja/tai niiden hakemiseen riittäviä edellytyksiä. Kerrothan myös, mikäli suomen lisäksi pystyt työskentelemään myös englanniksi.

Satsaamme sinuun ja työyhteisöösi
Haluamme, että ihmisemme voivat kehittyä osaajina omannäköisellään tavalla. Saat ympärillesi osaavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön sekä laajan asiantuntijaverkoston, jonka kanssa pääset ratkaisemaan vaativia suunnitteluhaasteita.

Tarjoamme sinulle joustavat työskentelytavat, monipuoliset henkilöstöedut sekä ison yrityksen mahdollisuudet työyhteisössä, joka kuuluu työntekijöidensä arvioimana Suomen innostavimpiin ja tekniikan alan ammattilaisten silmissä alan vetovoimaisimpiin työnantajiin (Innostavimmat 2026 ja Universum 2026).

Kiinnostuitko?
Jätä meille CV:si ja vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi 1.12.2026 mennessä osoitteessa . Kerro hakemuksessasi.

Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, joten suosittelemme hakemaan tehtävää mahdollisimman pian. Tietoturvasyistä emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä sinulle antaa:
Suunnittelujohtaja Jari Jäntti, jari.jantti@ains.fi tai p. 040 6531 725
Suunnittelujohtaja Timo Vuolle, timo.vuolle@ains.fi tai p. 040 776 0043.

title: Last Mile Manager - PUS - Jumia (Full Time)
description:
At Jumia, mobility is at the heart of our people development approach. This job board helps us establish more transparency in available opportunities in the company to promote mobility.

You need to follow simple guidelines:

  • Before applying, make sure you discuss the opportunity with your direct manager and that both of you agree that this is positive for your development (written approval from your direct manager will be required).
  • Apply with your Jumia e-mail.

As our Last Mile Manager – Pick Up Stations (PUS), you will lead, scale, and optimize Jumia’s pick-up station network, driving seamless collection experiences for our customers while maximizing operational efficiency. In this role, you will be responsible for defining the end-to-end station footprint strategy, managing station partner and 3PL performance, controlling unit delivery economics, and steering cross-functional initiatives to ensure parcels move swiftly and safely from fulfillment hubs to customer hands.

What you will be doing:

  • Network Expansion & Footprint Strategy: Spearhead the scale-up and geographical expansion of Jumia’s Pick Up Station (PUS) network and third-party logistics partners, ensuring optimal coverage, accessibility, and capacity in key and emerging markets.
  • Cost Optimization & Unit Economics: Design and own the end-to-end PUS unit cost strategy, driving down delivery and handling costs while maintaining strict customer experience (CXP) and vendor experience (VXP) benchmarks.
  • Station Operations & SLA Governance: Oversee daily operations across owned and partner-operated pick-up stations, tracking core fulfillment metrics such as package dwell time, collection success rate, inventory accuracy, and station capacity utilization.
  • Partner & 3PL Performance Management: Establish strong partner governance, lead regular business reviews, and drive community management across station operators and 3PL vendors to ensure strict adherence to service-level agreements and corporate standards.
  • Material Handling & Quality Control: Instill a culture of best-in-class package handling and security across all stations, minimizing loss, damage, and process bottlenecks during inbound hub-to-station transfer and final customer pick-up.
  • Process Transformation & Tech Roadmap: Collaborate with supply chain, logistics, and IT teams to implement workflow improvements and feed operational requirements into the systems/tech roadmap, speeding up station inbound processing and enhancing the customer pick-up journey.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Development: Manage, mentor, and build a high-performing operations team, setting clear operational targets and nurturing leadership across station supervisors and field teams.

What we are looking for:

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
  • Domain Expertise: Minimum of 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in logistics, last-mile operations, station/hub fulfillment, or complex distribution network management. In-depth knowledge of local market logistics operations is strongly preferred.
  • Network & Strategic Acumen: Proven track record in scaling physical distribution networks, managing third-party operational partners, and executing unit economics/cost-reduction strategies.
  • Analytical & Process Focus: Strong analytical and conceptual skills with a data-driven approach to solving operational bottlenecks, tracking KPIs, and optimizing workflow processes.
  • Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Excellent team management capabilities with the ability to influence cross-functional partners (IT, HSE, Central Logistics) and manage external vendor relationships effectively.
  • Tool Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace (Google Sheets, Docs, Drive).

Deadline for applications: 30-11-2026

Rounds of Interviews: 1. HR Screening; 2. Technical interviews with potential managers
