title: Product Owner - Data Platform
description:
Vill du leda och forma moderna dataplattformar – på riktigt?

Hos Chief får du möjligheten att utveckla din expertis i ett innovativt sammanhang där vi tillsammans med våra kunder formar framtidens datadrivna lösningar. Som konsult är du vårt ansikte utåt och skapar konkret affärsvärde hos våra kunder.

Vi söker nu en senior Produktägare inom Data som vill driva roadmap, prioritera krav och affärsvärde samt bygga skalbara dataprodukter i uppdrag hos våra kunder i Stockholm eller Örebro.

Om rollen

Som Produktägare ansvarar du för att driva och prioritera utvecklingen av en central dataplattform. Du sätter riktning, äger backloggen och säkerställer att rätt dataprodukter byggs – med tydlig koppling till verksamhetens behov och mål. Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan affär och teknik, i nära samarbete med stakeholders, arkitekter och data engineers.

  • Prioriterar backlog och roadmap för dataplattformen

  • Driver kravarbete från behov till konkret lösning – från discovery till färdiga user stories

  • Säkerställer att krav är tydliga, prioriterade och förankrade hos både verksamhet och utveckling

  • Säkerställer att dataprodukter stödjer analys, BI och AI-use cases

  • Arbetar nära utvecklingsteam (data engineers, arkitekter)

  • Fattar prioriteringsbeslut och skapar struktur i komplexa miljöer

  • Följer upp leverans, användning och affärsnytta

Rollen ger dig möjlighet att påverka riktningen för strategiskt viktiga dataplattformar i organisationer med höga ambitioner inom data och AI.

Vem söker vi?

För att trivas i denna roll är du kommunikativ, analytisk och drivande. Du har en förmåga att ta ägarskap och hitta kreativa lösningar som skapar värde för både verksamheten och teknikteamet. Du är prestigelös och brinner för att förstå och forma datadrivna lösningar.

Du är konsultmässig i ditt arbetssätt: lyhörd, lösningsorienterad och professionell, med förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya verksamheter och bygga förtroende.

Vi ser att du:

  • Har minst 5 års erfarenhet som Produktägare eller liknande roll

  • Har arbetat med dataplattformar, dataprodukter eller data mesh

  • Har god teknisk förståelse för dataflöden, arkitektur och system

  • Är van att arbeta agilt (Scrum, Kanban)

  • Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska

Det är starkt meriterande om du har:

  • Har erfarenhet av AI, machine learning eller avancerad analys

  • Erfarenhet som projektledare

  • Har arbetat nära data engineers eller utvecklingsteam

Vilka är Chief?

Chief är en ledande aktör i konsultbranschen med en stark familjär kultur där teknik och ledarskap möts.

Hos oss får du:

  • Uppdrag med verklig påverkan inom digitalisering, data och AI

  • En miljö där vi satsar på din utveckling genom mentorskap, utbildning och certifieringar

  • Ett starkt lokalt team – med globala möjligheter via Alten Group

- Vi kombinerar det bästa av två världar: den personliga kulturen i ett mindre bolag och möjligheterna i en global koncern.

Vill du vara med och forma framtidens datadrivna lösningar? Då är vi rätt plats för dig!

Skicka in din ansökan med CV och personligt brev, eller något annat innovativt som uppfyller samma syfte. Intervjuer och återkoppling sker löpande så skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Vill du veta mer om Chief och rollen? Kontakta oss eller läs mer på vår karriärhemsida!

Kontaktpersoner:
Joshua George, TAP-teamet
joshua.george@alten.se

title: Character Designer - Feature
description:
The Character Designer is in charge of exploring all options when crafting the look, feel, personality, and appeal of a character. Working with the Production Designer, Art Director, and other creative leads, you will explore multiple looks for each character to bring them to life. This is a union covered position.

Sony Pictures Animation is an animation studio based in Los Angeles, California, creating both feature animation and animated series with artists from around the world. We pride ourselves on empowering filmmakers to lead the creative process and allowing the hand of the artist to be truly felt, with the goal of producing bold and innovative visual storytelling.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with the Production Designer and Art Director, along with other creative leads, throughout the pitch, design and production process to visually explore and discover the characters' look, feel, and personality
  • Create multiple iterations of each character (including character poses, expressions and turnarounds) in rough pass form and approved final designs
  • Propose design approaches that consider downstream departments (modeling and texturing)
  • Ensure all artwork is accurately backed up, organized and stored appropriately
  • Contribute creative solutions, respond effectively to feedback, and iterate on designs throughout production
  • Proactively communicate questions, issues, or production concerns to supervisors and production staff
  • Meet production schedules and deadlines while maintaining a high level of artistic quality and consistency
  • Able to work independently and within a team environment

Qualifications:

  • Previous experience on an animated feature film, tv series, or game preferred.
  • Ability to articulate creative ideas.
  • Excellent draftsmanship.
  • Skilled in character pose, facial expressions and character turnarounds.
  • Outstanding research skills and an understanding of costume design.
  • Knowledge of anatomy and volumetric drawing.
  • We value inventiveness! Each Sony Pictures Animation project has its own distinctive and outstanding visual language so it is helpful to have stylistic versatility.
  • Photoshop knowledge required.

The anticipated base salary for this position is $53.37 to $90.00/hour. This role qualifies for benefits pursuant to the collective bargaining agreement. The actual salary offered will depend on a variety of factors.

To apply, please include a resume and a link to your portfolio. Please make sure to include any passwords to your work in your cover letter and/or in your resume.

Sony Pictures Animation is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or other protected characteristics.

title: Pest Control Specialist
description:
Groma is blending real estate and technology to unlock a new real estate asset class while making it easier for everyone – from institutional investors to the residents in our buildings – to participate in ownership. Our property technology platform uses AI to bring new efficiencies to the small unit count multifamily sector, enabling us to efficiently acquire, upgrade, and operate these 2-20 unit multifamily buildings and bring institutional performance to this massive but historically overlooked sector. Our investor technology platform makes owning these assets accessible to a broad array of investors, with bespoke vehicles available to institutional and family office investors and our flagship vehicle, the blockchain-powered GromaREIT, available to everyone, with a special focus on enabling ownership for the residents in our buildings. Visit www.groma.com to learn more about us.

About the Role

We are seeking a Certified Pest Control Specialist to inspect, treat, and prevent pest activity across our residential portfolio in greater Boston. The specialist holds a Massachusetts commercial pesticide certification, applies pesticides in occupied apartments, common areas, and building exteriors, and documents every service visit. This role works closely with maintenance technicians, the Maintenance Associate, and the property management team to correct the building conditions that allow pests to return. This position is field-based and reports to the Regional Maintenance Supervisor.

Inspection and treatment

  • Inspect occupied apartments, common areas, basements, and building exteriors for rodents, cockroaches, bed bugs, ants, flies, stinging insects, and other pests
  • Identify species, harborage, entry points, and conducive conditions, and select the appropriate treatment
  • Apply pesticides, baits, insect growth regulators, and dusts in accordance with product labels and Massachusetts Department of Agricultural Resources (MDAR) regulations
  • Install, service, and monitor rodent bait stations, traps, and monitoring devices on a scheduled route
  • Inspect and treat bed bug cases, including adjacent units as required by company protocol
  • Treat and remove stinging insect nests, including emergency removals at entrances and walkways

Integrated pest management

  • Prioritize sanitation, exclusion, and monitoring before and alongside chemical treatment
  • Seal entry points and complete minor exclusion work, including door sweeps, pipe penetrations, foundation gaps, and vent screening
  • Report building conditions that require repair by other trades
  • Conduct whole-building assessments where activity recurs at the same property

Documentation and compliance

  • Complete a service record in the work order system after every visit, including findings, products applied, EPA registration numbers, quantities, application sites, and photos
  • Maintain pesticide application records required by MDAR
  • Follow company protocols for triage, inspection scope, and follow-up intervals
  • Store, transport, mix, and dispose of pesticides in compliance with label and state requirements
  • Maintain required PPE and Safety Data Sheets for all products carried
  • Maintain an active certification, including annual renewal and continuing education credits

Resident services

  • Interact professionally with residents, including explaining preparation requirements, re-entry times, and prevention steps
  • Coordinate access and scheduling with the Maintenance Associate and property management team
  • Provide guidance to technicians on pest identification and exclusion
  • Track supply inventory and maintain tools, equipment, and supplies

Schedule

Monday to Friday, starting at 8:00 AM at the first property and running until 4:00 PM, with a 30-minute lunch break

Experience

  • Active Massachusetts Commercial Certification issued by MDAR in Category 41, General Pest Control, in good standing
  • At least two years of residential or multifamily pest control experience
  • Demonstrated experience treating rodents, cockroaches, and bed bugs in occupied residential buildings
  • Working knowledge of pesticide labels, safe handling, PPE, and spill response
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Attention to detail, ability to follow instructions, and ability to work independently
  • Comfortable driving in Boston (company vehicle provided)
  • Basic computer skills, including mobile work order and project management tools
  • Physical demands include standing, walking, lifting up to 50 pounds, climbing ladders, crawling, working in confined spaces, and working indoors and outdoors in all weather
  • Ability to wear a respirator and pass a fit test where a product label requires it

Preferred

  • Additional MDAR certification in Category 43, Termite and Structural Pest Control, or Category 44, Vertebrate Pest Control
  • Experience with exclusion carpentry and sealing materials
  • Familiarity with the Massachusetts State Sanitary Code as it applies to pest conditions in multifamily housing
  • Rhode Island pesticide certification, or willingness to obtain it
  • Conversational Spanish, Portuguese, or Haitian Creole

About our Culture

At Groma, we’re looking to build something big and are on a very fast growth trajectory. While a healthy work-life balance is important to our team, we want to be upfront that there may be times when we expect commitments outside of the standard 9-5. We strive to respect individuals and their needs, while also acknowledging the reality that we have a small team that is trying to accomplish some very ambitious goals in a short period of time. We have an ever-evolving list of values and conventions that guide how we operate as a company, but here’s a high-level overview of how we think about doing what we do:

We have an ever-evolving list of values and conventions that guide how we operate as a company, but here’s a high-level overview of how we think about doing what we do:

  • We’re committed to building an inclusive, equal opportunity, anti-discriminatory workplace that reflects the diversity of people and cultures that live, work, and play in the communities we seek to serve.
  • We approach our work with pragmatic idealism that enables us to focus on our desire to make the world a better place in ways big and small while also being open to intelligent compromises that accelerate us on our path to serve our broader societal goals.
  • Our whole team believes strongly in a value we shorthand as Justice League, not Superman. The challenges we are trying to solve require effective teams, not individual heroes. (Note: Yes… we are aware that Superman has been a member of the Justice League for quite some time now, but the analogy here is an easy, yet powerful, one for people to grasp. We don’t need a hero, we need a collaborative team of heroes who each bring something unique to the table to help solve problems that any of us individually would find daunting.)

Compensation

  • $25-$35 per hour, commensurate with experience

Benefits & Perks

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, and paid time off. If you are interested in this exciting opportunity, please submit your resume and MDAR certification number for consideration.

  • 5% 401k match
  • Fully covered insurance premiums for dental, health, and vision plans
  • Fully covered commuter passes for bus, subway, boat, or commuter rail
  • Generous paid time off policy including vacation, holiday, sick time, and parental leave
  • 13 official company holidays, 1 floating holiday
  • Replacement of tools and equipment broken on the job
  • Certification renewal fees and continuing education costs covered by Groma

Position Salary Range
$25—$35 USD

title: Director, Software Engineering
description:
About Spark Advisors

We're building healthcare tech for a system that desperately needs it.

Each year, millions of Americans deal with confusing changes to their Medicare plans that impact their prescriptions, access to care, and pocketbooks. These aren’t just inconveniences – they are potentially life-altering changes that leave seniors medically and financially vulnerable.

Independent Medicare advisors play a crucial role in guiding seniors through this complexity and helping them find the right coverage for their needs. But their ability to be effective healthcare advocates has long been hamstrung by broken tools and outdated systems.

Spark is fixing that. We’re the fastest-growing Medicare platform in the country, combining AI, an industry-leading CRM, and client services to transform how 10,000+ brokers acquire, enroll, and support clients in their local communities.

Join a talent-dense team from Square, Ramp, Yext, Oscar, and Cedar — backed by Primary Ventures and Viewpoint Ventures — that is serious about building technology to expand access to quality healthcare. We offer remote work, sabbaticals, company retreats, and other generous benefits that earned us recognition as one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces of 2025

Healthcare is overdue for innovation. Let’s redefine what its future looks like — together.

Summary

Spark is looking for a Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering across our broker productivity product and core platform. You'll make sure our platform keeps up with a fast-growing customer base, and you'll keep our web-based broker platform sustainable as it scales.

In this role, you'll own engineering delivery for multiple squads, along with the practices that span all of software engineering. You'll partner with product leaders on roadmaps, own our infrastructure roadmap, and be the point person for the security of our software platform. Today you'll manage engineers directly through strong tech leads. As the organization grows, you'll build and manage a layer of engineering managers. Reporting to our SVP of Engineering, you'll be the default owner for software engineering problems that don't have a clear home, so teams can stay focused on what they do best.

More about our stack and the role

  • Our stack is Python, Django, Celery, Vue, Redis, and Postgres, deployed on AWS with modern tooling for version control, continuous deployment, testing, and observability
  • You'll manage around six engineers across three squads at full headcount, and own the hiring plan as we grow
  • We operate in a HIPAA-regulated environment, and security and compliance are part of how we build
  • Every leader at Spark stays hands-on in some way. In this role that means design reviews, specs, code reviews, and spikes, while staying on the critical path for no more than one project at a time

What You'll Do

  • Drive engineering delivery for our broker productivity squads, partnering with product on sequencing, scoping, and delivery commitments
  • Own and communicate our infrastructure roadmap, including platform migrations, vendor integrations, sustainability work, and AI enablement
  • Lead security for our software platform, including pen test and audit remediation, in partnership with our IT, DevOps, and data teams
  • Own engineering-wide practices across all squads: cross-squad coordination, onboarding, QA and testing, and bugs and support processes
  • Hire senior and staff engineers, develop tech leads, and design a team structure that scales
  • Take ambiguous problems from definition to resolution, deciding what to own, what to delegate, and what to decline
  • Represent software engineering in company-wide planning and cross-functional work

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in software engineering, including meaningful time in a startup environment
  • 3+ years managing engineers, including leading multiple teams or managing through tech leads. Experience managing managers is a strong plus
  • Strong technical foundation in web applications (Python/Django or similar, and JavaScript frameworks like Vue or React), with the judgment to review designs and code credibly
  • Experience owning a platform or infrastructure roadmap and explaining it to non-technical leadership
  • Experience delivering large migrations or third-party integrations
  • Working knowledge of application security and compliance in a regulated environment (HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar)
  • Proven track record hiring and developing senior engineers and tech leads
  • Comfort working across many kinds of problems at once, with good judgment about where to spend your time
  • Strong written and verbal communication, especially with leadership and cross-functional partners

Compensation

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company’s size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Spark. In accordance with New York City, Colorado, California, and other applicable laws, Spark is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. Individual pay decisions are ultimately based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, geography, and balancing internal equity. A reasonable estimate of the current salary range is listed below. We expect most candidates to fall in the middle of the range. We also believe that your personal needs and preferences should be taken into consideration, so we allow some choice between equity and cash.

Base Salary
$230,000—$260,000 USD

Why you should join our team

By joining Spark, you will get in on the ground floor of a fast-moving, well-funded, and mission-driven startup where you will have a profound impact on the brokers and beneficiaries we serve. And you'll learn, grow, be challenged, and have fun with your team while doing it.

We strive to help you and your family thrive. We're committed to supporting your happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing a comprehensive benefits program. In addition to your base salary, we also offer:

  • Equity compensation
  • Health care, including dental and vision
  • Flexible work location; co-working available
  • 401k
  • Paid Time Off
  • Monthly Remote Work Stipend (help cover costs of home-office needs)
  • Paid Parental Leave
    • Up to 14 weeks for birthing parents
    • Up to 8 weeks for non-birth parents
  • 11 paid holidays
  • 2 week sabbatical at 5 years of employment
  • Wellbeing Perks through SpringHealth, Calm, and more!

Compliance

Spark is a proud participant in E-Verify. As part of our commitment to compliance, we use the E-Verify program to confirm the employment eligibility of all employees working in the United States. For more information about E-Verify, please visit .

Furthermore, for security and compliance requirements, we’re unable to accommodate international remote work. While we fully support travel and time off, all work must be conducted from an approved location within the U.S.

At Spark, we are committed to hiring the best team to serve our clients regardless of their background. We need diverse perspectives to reflect the diversity of our problems and the population we serve. We look to hire people from a variety of backgrounds, including, but not limited to, race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, disability, and veteran status.

AI Notice: We may use AI-enabled tools to assist with certain aspects of our hiring process. These tools do not replace human decision-making, and all employment decisions are made by qualified team members in compliance with applicable laws.

title: Corporate Relations Manager
location: Remote in the United States or Canada
description:
Mercy For Animals aims to end industrial animal agriculture by constructing a just and sustainable food system. We envision a world where animals are respected, protected, and free.

As a leading farmed animal advocacy organization, we know that achieving this goal requires a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative work environment—one that welcomes and sparks new perspectives and innovative ideas. If you are passionate about our mission, driven to make a big impact for animals, and eager to be part of a dedicated team, join us!

We currently seek a Corporate Relations Manager to join our Corporate Impact team. In this role, you will lead strategic corporate engagement efforts that persuade businesses in the food industry to adopt, implement, and uphold meaningful animal welfare and plant-based procurement policies. Manage a team that builds influential corporate relationships, develops evidence-based engagement strategies, and negotiates meaningful commitments in pursuit of ending factory farming.

You will do invaluable work:

  • Lead corporate engagement strategies tailored to target-company priorities, commercial incentives, stakeholder interests, and opportunities to secure meaning policy changes with clear objectives and measures of success.
  • Manage and develop Corporate Relations Specialists; set goals, delegate execution, review work, and foster strong strategic judgment and professional growth.
  • Coordinate closely with the Corporate Campaigns Manager to sequence outreach, negotiation, and escalation as part of an integrated target strategy.
  • Build strategic relationships with corporate executives, procurement leaders, sustainability professionals, and other decision-makers to influence corporate policies.
  • Lead research into target companies' ownership, business models, financial incentives, supply chains, procurement practices, sustainability commitments, and decision-making structures.
  • Lead negotiations with corporate decision-makers to secure measurable commitments, including clear implementation timelines and accountability mechanisms.
  • Apply insights from sales, conflict resolution, and behavioral science to build relationships, overcome objections, and negotiate policy commitments.
  • Continuously develop expertise by learning from other industries, social movements and emerging engagement strategies.
  • Monitor corporate commitments, identify barriers to implementation, and coordinate with Corporate Campaigns to address noncompliance through engagement or escalation.
  • Collaborate with departments across MFA to advance shared objectives and strengthen long-term organizational power.
  • Oversee corporate communications, materials, records, budgets, timelines, and evaluations, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
  • Coordinate with the Legal and Communications departments to ensure corporate agreements, communications, and engagement activities comply with relevant laws and align with Mercy For Animals' messaging.
  • Build partnerships with aligned advocacy organizations to advance corporate engagement objectives.
  • Represent Mercy For Animals in corporate meetings and events, as needed.
  • Follow organizational policies and procedures and ensure compliance from direct reports.
  • Keep up-to-date on industry developments to identify strategic opportunities to further Mercy For Animals’ corporate engagement work.
  • Continuously explore and adopt emerging technologies, tools, and practices to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and impact.
  • Perform any other duties assigned by the team lead.

Your qualifications will take our Corporate Impact team to the next level:

  • 5+ years’ experience in corporate engagement, corporate advocacy, corporate affairs, sales, or related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, psychology, public relations, political science, public policy, communications, or related fields preferred.
  • Demonstrated success negotiating corporate commitments, influencing business decisions, or securing meaningful changes in corporate policies or practices.
  • Working understanding of the food industry, corporate procurement and supply chains, and the impacts of factory farming on animals preferred.
  • Strong understanding of corporate decision-making, business incentives, stakeholder interests, and negotiation strategies.
  • Ability to build constructive relationships with corporate decision-makers while maintaining a firm commitment to organizational objectives and accountability.
  • Strong, emotionally intelligent, interpersonal skills and ability to communicate professionally, persuasively, and diplomatically in both writing and verbally.
  • Exceptionally strong work ethic and drive to succeed.
  • Exceptional research, organizational, time-management, and project-management skills.
  • Willingness and ability to travel 2-3 times per year.
  • Commitment to the mission, values, and objectives of the organization.
  • A commitment and openness to continued personal and organizational growth in diversity, equity, inclusion, and justice principles.

Compensation and Benefits (exempt)

Earn an annual salary of $66,730 - $79,700 USD, depending on qualifications, and enjoy a commute-free life as a remote team member. In addition to a collaborative and innovative work environment, you will be able to take part in our benefits package, including no- or low-cost health, vision, and dental insurance; generous paid time off and sick leave; and 401(k) retirement plan, with a dollar-to-dollar employer match of up to 3.5% of your annual earnings.

Application Details

We consider traditional and nontraditional qualifications and carefully review each application, resume, and cover letter. Feel encouraged to go outside a traditional cover letter and state how you would add to our culture; what we would gain from having you on our team; and how you align with our organizational vision, mission, and values. To ensure fairness in the hiring process, we request that all applicants refrain from submitting materials that are generated entirely by artificial intelligence tools. We recognize that such tools can be useful in refining tone, grammar, and clarity, but please ensure that your materials reflect your personal experience, qualifications, and authentic voice.

Our Commitment to You

Mercy For Animals is a globally minded organization. We are committed to the principles of equity and justice, and our culture celebrates authenticity—enabling every team member to shine. All employment decisions are based solely on individual qualifications, job needs, and job requirements, and potential team members of every color, orientation, age, gender, origin, veteran status, and ability are encouraged to apply. We strive to include candidates from historically marginalized communities and those from or in communities impacted by environmental, social, and economic injustice. In addition, please let us know if you have a reasonable accommodation request at any point within the hiring process.

Come as you are, and help us transform our society and construct a truly compassionate food system.

By submitting your information, you are indicating that you have read our Privacy Policy and accept its terms.

title: Senior Associate, Development & Asset Management
description:
Headquartered in the Greater Washington area, American Real Estate Partners (AREP) is a US-based leading institutional fund manager and real estate partner with over $13 billion deployed across key U.S. markets. Specializing in data center, residential, industrial, and office assets, AREP has acquired more than 34 million square feet of Class A real estate and currently manages over 25 million square feet.

PowerHouse Data Centers, a wholly owned division of AREP, is a developer and owner of next-generation data centers and provides technical real estate solutions for hyperscalers across the country. Backed by strategic joint venture partnerships, PowerHouse leverages its proven leadership and best-in-class technical expertise to deliver innovative real estate solutions.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for supporting SVP of Asset Management for all aspects related to the financial, operational, and implementation oversight of comprehensive value-add transactions for the AREP portfolio.

This position reports to the SVP, Asset Management. It is based at our McLean, VA headquarters and has an in-office schedule.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Perform complex financial analysis modeling for assets within the manager’s portfolio.
  • Build, maintain, and update Argus and Excel valuation analysis models on a quarterly basis.
  • Assist, coordinate, and manage the pre-development development budgeting process, including reforecasts and quarterly spend versus commitment cash flows for the projects by strategically working with the capital markets, construction, and property management departments.
  • Complete ad hoc project-level analysis sensitivities for prospective leasing, investment strategy, debt tracking, recapitalizations, re-financings and dispositions including joint venture waterfalls.
  • Benchmark return performance against underwriting for investment strategy decision-making
  • Participate in regular operations, leasing, and market discussion with construction and leasing/marketing teams.
  • Assist the SVP of Asset Management with weekly communication updates with operating partners regarding asset performance related to operations, leasing, and approval requests
  • Help prepare the draw requests on a monthly basis during the pre-development period and review the draw requests to lenders
  • Possess and maintain an up to date understanding on the data center market landscape and the trends impacting it with regards to fiber, water, power & entitlements
  • Participate in aspects of the due diligence process during the financing or disposition of assets including informational and analytic requests from the SVP, internal capital markets teams, brokers and prospective lenders.
  • Provide assistance in business plan execution including leasing, asset repositioning, capital projects, budgets, tenant relations and marketing.
  • Operate as a mentor to Associates.

Key Qualifications & Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in math, real estate, business finance, economics, political science or related areas, or additional significant relevant working experience in lieu of degree.
  • 5+ years of development experience in the commercial real estate industry. Candidates with real estate financial experience in the data center industry are strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of development, leasing and construction processes and concepts.
  • Strong technical skills in the Microsoft Office suite. High proficiency in Word, Project Management, and Excel. Experience in Argus and financial modeling is required. Experience in Yardi highly preferred.
  • Proven experience with office/multifamily or data center financial modeling.
  • Excellent written communication, verbal and analytical skills necessary to communicate with internal and external partners.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment as a hands-on contributor.
  • Strong time management skills, attention to detail, and commitment to getting the job done.

AREP is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, as well as any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

If you require special accommodation, please email HR@americanrepartners.com.

AREP does not accept unsolicited resumes or identifiable candidate information from third-party recruiters. Any unsolicited information will not be considered for engagement purposes.

title: Food and Beverage Attendant - Granada Tavern
description:
Food & Beverage Attendant | Granada Tavern

We’re searching high and low for a true ‘people person’ with a real passion for pub food and drinks. Sure, everyone serves food and drinks but you bring the magic and make it unforgettable!

A day in the life of a F&B Attendant:

  • Be the face of the floor, connecting with guests and making sure every visit is a memorable one.

  • Share your passion for our products and recommend the perfect meal or drink to make a guest's day.

  • Deliver top-notch customer service and make every interaction fun and memorable.

  • From the first pour of the day to the final lock-up, you'll be on the front lines, making sure our standards are sky-high and the experience is one to remember.

  • Help the gaming and wagering team when needed and legally able

Inherent requirements:

  • This is a hands-on role that involves manual handling and lifting as part of regular duties (e.g. moving stock, kegs, and deliveries). Applicants must have the ability to perform physical tasks safely and efficiently.

About you:

  • You’re a natural at making people feel welcome and have a knack for the little details.

  • You’re a team player who is motivated to create magic for both guests and teammates.

  • You have a current RSA certificate and flexible availability.

  • Some gaming experience or willingness to learn would also be an asset.

title: Principal Engineer, EDG SSD Hardware
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Key Responsibilities

SSD Hardware Architecture and Development

  • Lead end-to-end SSD hardware architecture, design, validation and productization.
  • Own schematic design, component selection, PCB stack-up, placement, routing and design reviews.
  • Define hardware requirements covering performance, power, thermal, reliability, form factor and manufacturability.
  • Drive high-speed interface design and validation for PCIe, NVMe, ONFI, NAND and other relevant interfaces.
  • Lead controller, NAND, DRAM, PMIC, clock, power-delivery and peripheral device integration.
  • Develop hardware solutions for standard form factors, including M.2 and BGA, as well as customer-specific automotive and embedded form factors.
  • Champion an AI-first engineering mindset across SSD hardware design, validation, debug, and product execution.
  • Apply AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate schematic reviews, component/BOM analysis, design-rule and DFM checks, requirements analysis, technical documentation, and engineering data analysis.
  • Develop and deploy Python-based automation and AI-assisted workflows for repetitive hardware engineering tasks, including test-data processing, log analysis, validation reporting, failure triage, and design checks.
  • Leverage Generative AI and agentic workflows to capture engineering knowledge, lessons learned, design guidelines, failure history, and reusable debug methodologies.

Automotive Hardware Requirements

  • Exposure to ASIL standards.
  • Translate customer and system-level automotive requirements into hardware design and validation specifications.
  • Design for extended automotive operating temperatures, typically including −40°C to +85°C or +105°C, depending on the product and application requirements.
  • Ensure the design meets applicable automotive reliability expectations for: Temperature cycling and thermal shock High-temperature operating life Mechanical shock and vibration Humidity and moisture resistance Board-level solder-joint reliability Power cycling and extended mission-profile operation
  • Support component qualification and product-level assessments aligned with applicable AEC-Q100, AEC-Q104 and AEC-Q200 expectations.
  • Apply appropriate design margins and derating guidelines for voltage, current, temperature and component lifetime.
  • Address automotive power-transient, brownout, reset, power-loss protection and startup/shutdown sequencing requirements.
  • Evaluate system-level EMC and ESD risks and support compliance testing against applicable automotive customer and regional requirements.
  • Support requirements related to long product lifecycles, component traceability, controlled BOMs, PCN management and obsolescence planning.

Functional Safety and System Robustness

  • Collaborate with systems, firmware and functional-safety teams to support product development aligned with ISO 26262.
  • Contribute to hardware safety analysis, including: Hardware Failure Mode and Effects Analysis FMEDA inputs Diagnostic coverage assessment Single-point and latent-fault evaluation Safety mechanism definition and validation
  • Familiarity with Automotive SPICE development and traceability expectations is preferred.

SI/PI, Thermal and Mechanical Engineering

  • Own signal-integrity and power-integrity analysis for high-speed interfaces, NAND channels, clocks and critical power rails.
  • Correlate pre-layout and post-layout simulations with laboratory measurements.
  • Optimize PCB stack-up, impedance control, return paths, via structures, power distribution and decoupling.
  • Partner with mechanical and thermal teams to evaluate heat spreading, thermal-interface materials, airflow, enclosure constraints and junction-temperature margins.

AI & Engineering Automation

  • Demonstrated exposure to AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows, with a strong mindset toward adopting AI to improve engineering productivity and quality.
  • Ability to leverage tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude/Claude Code, or equivalent AI platforms for engineering analysis, documentation, scripting, automation, and technical problem-solving.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to apply AI and automation across the hardware development lifecycle, including design reviews, PCB/DFM checks, validation, data analysis, debug, and reporting.
  • Champion an AI-first and automation-first engineering culture, developing reusable workflows and sharing best practices across the team.

title: Erfaren konsult inom IT-infrastruktur till XLENT i Hudiksvall
description:
På XLENT vill vi jobba med människor som är riktigt bra på det de gör, men som också bidrar till teamet, bygger relationer och tycker att det är viktigt att trivas på jobbet. Vår kultur är en stor del av vilka vi är.

Hos oss på XLENT i Hudiksvall får din erfarenhet göra skillnad. Här är det nära till beslut och du kan påverka både din vardag och bolagets utveckling. Med långvariga kundrelationer får du också följa hur dina idéer och lösningar gör nytta.

Vi hjälper företag och organisationer att få en IT-vardag som fungerar och utvecklas med verksamheten. Uppdragen varierar från löpande förbättringar och rådgivning till större förändringar av kundens IT-miljö.

Nu behöver vi förstärka med en erfaren IT-infrastrukturkonsult som är trygg i konsultrollen och van att ta ansvar och arbeta nära kunden.

För oss märks erfarenhet lika mycket i hur du arbetar som i vad du kan. Du ser vad som behöver göras och förbättras, tar initiativ och följer arbetet hela vägen. Du lyssnar, involverar kunden och dina kollegor och bidrar aktivt till laget. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap, är nyfiken på andras perspektiv och tar hjälp när det behövs. Genom bra leveranser och uppmärksamhet på nya behov bidrar du till både fortsatt förtroende och nya uppdrag.

Vi söker dig som har bred erfarenhet av IT-infrastruktur och är van att ta ett behov från dialog och förståelse till en lösning som faktiskt fungerar i kundens vardag. Vi arbetar mycket i Microsoftmiljöer, med bland annat Microsoft 365, Azure och lokal infrastruktur, där drift, nätverk och säkerhet hänger ihop. Du använder AI som verktyg i ditt arbete och vill fortsätta utveckla hur AI och automation kan komma kunderna till nytta.

Här finns engagemang och en vilja att göra varandra bättre. Genom konceptet Hållbara konsulter vill vi skapa en vardag där vi hjälps åt, mår bra och utvecklas över tid. Du blir del av ett lokalt team med hela XLENT som kollegialt nätverk. Du behöver inte kunna allt. Vi är lika nyfikna på vad du kan bidra med som på vad du vill lära dig.

Nyfiken på om vi passar varandra?

Vi börjar gärna med ett samtal om dig, oss och om vi kan trivas tillsammans. Hör av dig!

title: Contract Data Scientist (40 hrs/wk)
description:
Layer Health was founded in 2023 by leading machine learning researchers from MIT and Harvard Medical School. We are building an AI layer that can accurately and scalably synthesize information from medical records, with the mission to reduce friction everywhere in healthcare. Our LLM-powered platform is solving chart review once and for all, across use cases. For health systems, our first product dramatically accelerates clinical registry abstraction in areas ranging from surgery and cardiology, to oncology. Our long term vision is for our AI layer to safely transform patient care and minimize unnecessary heartbreak. Layer Health’s diverse founding team brings expertise across machine learning, UI/UX, large language models, and medicine.

Here’s a collection of articles about our product, mission, recent funding round, etc.

Job Description

You will work with the Layer Health ML team applying our existing ML workflow to tailor models for a specific clinical use case. You will design, build, evaluate, and iterate on these models — combining strong data science fundamentals with modern LLM techniques to deliver high-accuracy, production-ready solutions across new clinical domains.

This is a high-velocity, high-ownership role for someone who enjoys diving deep into error modes, making targeted improvements, and closing the loop between model performance and real-world impact.

This contract will require full-time hours.

What you’ll do:

  • Own end-to-end development of models for specific use cases: Build and iterate using our ML/LLM-powered workflows for new clinical areas, from initial prototyping through production refinement.
  • Conduct evaluation & error analysis: Own rigorous evaluation of model performance; perform deep error analysis to identify systematic failure modes and drive targeted improvements.
  • Ship frequent, high-quality updates to models based on data, feedback, and observed edge cases.
  • Leverage LLM application & tooling: Apply modern LLM techniques (prompting strategies, structured outputs, tool use, eval frameworks) to improve accuracy and robustness.
  • Support analytics & metrics: Contribute to metrics, reporting, and internal dashboards that track model performance and downstream impact.

We look for:

  • Good data science fundamentals, including knowledge of best practices for evaluating model performance and error analysis. (A proven track record of successful projects in healthcare or clinical applications is a bonus, but not required.)
  • Familiarity with modern applied LLM techniques and their practical implementations, for example e.g. standard prompting techniques, LLM frameworks, structured output usage, etc. (any experience using these techniques is a bonus).
  • Solid programming skills in Python.
  • A strong technical communicator who thrives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive mindset to identify and solve problems, continuously improving our data science capabilities.
  • An excited and adaptable team player who wants to disrupt the healthcare industry with AI/ML, alongside an awesome team.
  • Willingness to be hybrid with our team in either our Boston or NYC office 3 days per week.

Expected compensation range for this role is $40 - $70/hour. Compensation is dependent on experience, overall fit to our role, and candidate location. Expected compensation ranges for this role may change over time. If your compensation requirement is greater than our posted salary ranges, please still consider applying to our role. We will make a determination as to whether an exception can be made.

If you are excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement. We're eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways. We welcome diverse perspectives, rigorous thinking, and fearlessness in challenging the status quo.

Join us and help us transform healthcare with AI. Layer Health is committed to foster an environment of inclusion that is free from discrimination. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer where employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Technical Program Manager, Etch Programs
description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.


What We Offer


Salary:

$110,500.00 - $152,000.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Role Overview

Central Engineering is seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the development and commercialization of Central Engineering capabilities required by Etch products.

This role has end-to-end program accountability for complex, cross-functional initiatives spanning platform, robotics and automation, software, systems integration, and advanced R&D capabilities. The TPM will work across Etch product groups and Central Engineering functions to translate product and chamber requirements into clearly scoped engineering programs and drive those programs from requirements definition through development, system integration, lab readiness, customer introduction, and commercialization.

The TPM is expected to operate as an accountable program owner, not simply as a coordinator between organizations. The role owns program definition and execution across multiple engineering organizations, including scope, priorities, deliverables, schedule, resources, dependencies, risks, customer introduction, and Product Development Process execution.

Success requires strong technical judgment, systems thinking, program leadership, and the ability to drive execution across organizations where engineering resources and priorities must be negotiated and aligned.


Key Responsibilities

Program Ownership and Execution

  • Own end-to-end execution of cross-functional technical programs supporting Etch product development and commercialization, from initial requirements and program definition through engineering development, integration, lab validation, customer introduction, and release.
  • Serve as the single-point accountable owner for Product Development Process execution for assigned Central Engineering programs supporting Etch.
  • Establish clear program scope, objectives, technical requirements, milestones, deliverables, resource requirements, dependencies, risks, and success criteria.
  • Drive programs to deliver integrated, working solutions, ensuring individual engineering deliverables come together successfully at the system level rather than managing functional activities independently.
  • Maintain accountability for program commitments and proactively drive recovery plans when technical, resource, schedule, or integration issues place commitments at risk.

Requirements and Systems Integration

  • Partner with Etch product and engineering organizations to scope and translate chamber and product requirements into requirements for Central Engineering capabilities, including platform, robotics and automation, software, controls, systems engineering, and advanced R&D technologies.
  • Drive requirements alignment across product, chamber, platform, software, robotics, and engineering organizations to ensure interfaces, dependencies, and system-level requirements are clearly understood.
  • Work across multiple technical disciplines to identify integration risks, architecture dependencies, qualification requirements, and gaps that could impact product readiness or customer introduction.
  • Ensure engineering solutions are developed and integrated to meet the needs of the Etch product roadmap and intended customer use cases.

Portfolio, Priority, and Resource Management

  • Manage a portfolio of Central Engineering programs and capabilities supporting Etch, maintaining visibility across program health, engineering resources, technical maturity, milestones, dependencies, risks, and customer commitments.
  • Lead the scoping and prioritization of new program requests and determine the engineering capabilities, resources, and organizations required for execution.
  • Negotiate and align priorities between Etch product groups and Central Engineering functions when resource capacity, technical dependencies, schedules, or competing priorities require trade-offs.
  • Identify portfolio-level resource constraints and cross-program dependencies early and drive decisions with appropriate engineering and product leadership.
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility into program health, resource needs, critical risks, decision points, and recovery actions.

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership

  • Work across Product and Engineering disciplines to establish clear ownership and drive teams toward a common technical and program outcome.
  • Lead cross-functional execution across organizations responsible for platform, robotics, automation, software, controls, systems integration, and advanced engineering technologies.
  • Drive decisions across organizational boundaries and hold teams accountable for agreed deliverables, timelines, and technical outcomes.
  • Influence without direct authority by establishing clear requirements, data-driven priorities, decision frameworks, and escalation paths.
  • Resolve ambiguity around scope, ownership, priorities, interfaces, resources, and execution responsibility before those gaps affect program delivery.

Risk and Customer Introduction

  • Own identification and management of technical, integration, resource, schedule, qualification, and customer-introduction risks across assigned programs.
  • Establish mitigation and recovery plans for critical program risks and escalate decisions when cross-organizational alignment or leadership intervention is required.
  • Coordinate readiness across engineering teams for lab integration, system qualification, product release, and customer introduction.
  • Ensure issues discovered during system integration or customer introduction are driven to root cause, corrective action, ownership, and closure.

Qualifications

Required

  • BS or MS degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in high-tech product development, systems engineering, systems integration, engineering program management, or technical program management.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, multidisciplinary engineering programs involving multiple engineering organizations and technical dependencies.
  • Strong understanding of structured product development processes and experience driving programs from requirements through development, integration, qualification, and release.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage scope, schedules, resources, dependencies, risks, and technical integration across matrixed organizations.
  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to understand interactions between hardware, software, automation, controls, and product-level requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to negotiate priorities and drive decisions and execution without direct authority.
  • Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate program status, risks, trade-offs, and decisions to technical and business leadership.

Preferred

  • Experience in semiconductor capital equipment or semiconductor manufacturing technology.
  • Experience supporting complex semiconductor equipment development involving process chambers, platforms, robotics and automation, controls, embedded or application software, and system integration.
  • Experience with New Product Development, Product Development Process, NPI, system qualification, and customer introduction.
  • Familiarity with Etch equipment and technologies such as process chambers, vacuum systems, RF/plasma systems, gas delivery, automation, robotics, controls, and related platform technologies.
  • Experience driving engineering execution across product engineering, systems engineering, software, hardware, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, service, and business organizations.

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate is a technically credible program leader and systems thinker who can operate across both product and engineering organizations.

This person does not need to be the subject-matter expert in every technical discipline, but must be able to understand how the pieces come together at the system level, challenge assumptions, expose gaps and dependencies, and drive engineering organizations toward an integrated solution.

The ideal candidate can take an initially ambiguous product or chamber requirement and turn it into a well-defined technical program with clear requirements, architecture dependencies, engineering ownership, resources, priorities, milestones, risks, and customer deliverables, and then remain accountable until the solution is working and successfully introduced.


Why This Role Matters

Etch products increasingly depend on capabilities that span multiple Central Engineering organizations and technical disciplines. Successful execution requires more than coordination of individual engineering activities. It requires system-level ownership of how those capabilities are scoped, prioritized, developed, integrated, qualified, and delivered as a working solution.

The Technical Program Manager provides that ownership.

By managing both individual programs and the broader portfolio of Central Engineering commitments supporting Etch, this role will improve requirements clarity, resource and priority alignment, engineering integration, risk management, Product Development Process discipline, customer readiness, and predictability of execution.

title: Micron Research Labs Infrastructure, Director
location: Boise, Idaho, United States of America
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.


Micron is seeking a highly capable MRL Infrastructure Director to connect Micron Research Labs (MRL) with the project team building MRL's flagship research facility in Boise, Idaho. You will help the MRL leadership team guide the facility from requirements definition and design through construction, laboratory installation, commissioning, and research readiness.

Acting as MRL's owner representative, this leader will translate the research mission into clear user requirements for the building, laboratories, technical infrastructure, convening spaces, and shared amenities. They will align researchers and internal stakeholders, keeping requirements traceable and actionable, and represent the MRL leadership team in meetings with construction, architecture and engineering (A&E), facilities, procurement, contracting firms, and other delivery partners.

The leader will drive timely decisions, manage interfaces and risks, challenge designs for functionality and flexibility, and verify that the completed facility meets approved requirements. The role extends through construction, equipment integration, commissioning, acceptance, and handoff readiness.

This role requires a credible technical leader and hands-on builder who can connect scientific users with design and construction teams. Successful candidates will combine disciplined requirements management, sound engineering judgment, executive communication, influence without direct authority, and decisive execution in a complex greenfield program.

The successful candidate will operate in an AI-enabled environment and leverage AI-powered and digital technologies to improve requirements management, design coordination, risk assessment, decision-making, project execution, and operational readiness throughout the facility lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities:

Owner Representation & Facility Delivery

  • Serve as the primary MRL representative and conduit to the project team for planning, design, construction, laboratory installation, commissioning, and acceptance of the flagship facility.
  • Define, prioritize, validate, and control user requirements for the building, laboratories, technical infrastructure, convening spaces, and shared amenities.
  • Represent the MRL leadership team in design reviews, construction meetings, and decisions involving construction, A&E, facilities, procurement, contracting firms, and key suppliers.
  • Align research users and delivery partners; identify tradeoffs, secure timely decisions, and protect scope, budget, schedule, quality, safety, and research functionality.

User Requirements & Research Infrastructure

  • Translate research workflows, equipment, utilities, environmental controls, security, data and compute, and EHS needs into coordinated design criteria.
  • Define and validate current and future technical infrastructure requirements, including compute, network, and data capabilities.
  • Define requirements for welcoming, functional shared spaces—including conference and collaboration areas, auditoriums, and spaces for employees, external researchers, partners, and visitors.
  • Convene researchers and functional experts to resolve competing needs, confirm adjacencies and workflows, and approve requirements at each design stage.
  • Coordinate laboratory outfitting and equipment planning, including procurement interfaces, installation sequencing, site readiness, utility connections, and commissioning dependencies.
  • Ensure the design remains flexible for evolving research programs, partnerships, technologies, and equipment.

Project Governance, Commissioning & Readiness

  • Establish governance, decision rights, escalation paths, change control, and reporting that enable timely, informed decisions.
  • Track requirements, design decisions, interfaces, risks, issues, actions, and commitments through closure.
  • Coordinate pre-handoff readiness requirements, including staffing assumptions, procedures, training, documentation, warranties, service strategies, and acceptance criteria.
  • Lead MRL participation in commissioning, integrated testing, punch-list closure, equipment qualification interfaces, occupancy readiness, and final acceptance.

Safety, Compliance & Commercial Stewardship

  • Embed safety, security, EHS, code, permitting, and regulatory requirements throughout design, construction, commissioning, and acceptance.
  • Support capital planning, change evaluation, commercial reviews, vendor selection, contracting interfaces, and stewardship of project commitments.
  • Hold internal and external partners accountable for decisions, deliverables, quality, schedule, and closure while sustaining constructive relationships.

Required Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree with 10+ years OR a Master's degree with 8+ years of relevant experience in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Facilities Engineering, or a related technical field with leadership experience delivering complex capital projects and


  • Experience delivering research facilities, advanced manufacturing facilities, laboratories, or comparable technical infrastructure in semiconductors, research institutions, or other advanced technology environments.
  • Experience as an owner's representative or as a lead for facility users from programming and design through construction, commissioning, acceptance, and handoff.
    Experience delivering specialized technical facilities and integrating equipment, utilities, controls, data and computing infrastructure, security, and EHS requirements.
  • Expertise in user-requirements definition and management, including prioritization, traceability, design validation, and change control across multiple user groups.
  • Strong knowledge of design and construction delivery, coordination, contracting, capital planning, schedule and risk management, constructability, and commissioning.
  • Knowledge of applicable codes, permitting, quality, security, EHS, and compliance requirements for complex technical facilities.
  • Experience translating user needs into functional laboratories, convening spaces, and shared environments for employees, external researchers, partners, and visitors.
  • Executive communication and influence skills to drive consequential decisions, resolve conflict, and align multidisciplinary teams without direct authority.
  • Demonstrated ability to build capabilities from the ground up and drive execution through design, construction, commissioning, and readiness.
  • Experience leveraging AI and contemporary digital tools to improve the speed, quality, and effectiveness of technical and program execution.

title: IC6 - Sr Tech Product Specialist
description:
IC6 - Sr Tech Product Specialist -- Core Banking

Objective of the Role

Leads the design, delivery, and optimization of high-impact technology solutions that align with business goals and drive innovation. This role combines advanced technical knowledge, strategic thinking, and strong leadership to address complex challenges, influence product roadmaps, and ensure seamless execution of cross-functional initiatives. The role fosters collaboration across teams and acts as a mentor to elevate the skills and performance of the broader product organization.

  • Drives the development of end-to-end solutions for highly complex business problems, leveraging deep technical expertise and industry insights to deliver strategic value.
  • Leads the prioritization, negotiation, and alignment of features or enablers across stakeholders, ensuring alignment with business objectives and maximum impact on product outcomes.
  • Collaborates closely with leadership to shape product roadmaps and strategic priorities, providing data-driven recommendations and technical insights to support decision-making.
  • Oversees the design and documentation of advanced functional and technical specifications, ensuring clarity and precision for development teams and stakeholders.
  • Proactively identifies opportunities for product innovation and process improvement, leading efforts to integrate cutting-edge technologies and best practices into product solutions.
  • Leads and executes functional testing and validation for critical product initiatives, ensuring quality, performance, and alignment with business and user requirements.
  • Manages the implementation of complex, high-priority changes and new functionalities, ensuring successful delivery within scope, timeline, and quality expectations.
  • Monitors post-implementation performance and drives continuous improvement through detailed analysis, proposing and leading enhancements to optimize product performance.
  • Builds and maintains comprehensive technical and functional documentation for advanced solutions, ensuring knowledge transfer and scalability across teams.
  • Acts as a mentor and advisor to other specialists and analysts, providing technical guidance, fostering collaboration, and promoting professional growth across the team.
  • Facilitates cross-functional collaboration among engineering, product, and business teams, ensuring seamless communication and alignment on product goals and initiatives.
  • Represents the organization in strategic discussions, serving as a subject matter expert and contributing to the alignment of technical and business strategies.
  • Actively participates in product roadmap discussions, providing data-driven insights and technical expertise to shape strategic priorities.
  • Promote an autonomous work culture by encouraging self-management, accountability, and proactive problem-solving among team members.
  • Serve as a Spin Culture Ambassador to foster and maintain a positive, inclusive, and dynamic work environment that aligns with the company's values and culture.

Required Knowledge and Experience

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in product analysis, tech product management, or related fields, with a proven ability to lead and deliver high-impact initiatives.
  • Mastery of agile methodologies, including backlog management, sprint planning, and leading cross-functional teams in dynamic environments.
  • Deep expertise in financial or technology products, with strong knowledge of regulatory requirements and market trends relevant to the assigned area.
  • Advanced proficiency in collaboration and technical tools, such as Jira, Confluence, Postman, AWS, Power BI, SQL, and non-relational databases, with the ability to assess and implement new technologies.
  • Exceptional skills in technical and functional documentation, ensuring comprehensive and accessible resources for all stakeholders.
  • Superior analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to address complex challenges and propose innovative, scalable solutions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leadership and align diverse teams.
  • Demonstrated leadership in mentoring and developing team members, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence.
  • Proven track record of managing multiple large-scale initiatives simultaneously, maintaining quality and achieving strategic objectives.
  • Proactive in adopting emerging technologies and trends, driving innovation and continuous improvement in product strategies and solutions.
  • Experienced in collaborating on the validation and functional testing of products, ensuring the quality of delivered solutions.

  • A track record of consistently delivering revenue numbers, producing accurate forecasts, while maintaining a focus on team development and growth
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

title: Entry-level Auto Technician
description:

As an Entry-Level Technician, you’ll be expected to perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.

Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

  • Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.
  • Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires
  • Mid-Level (Mechanical Repair / Build / General) Technician (min 3 years of professional experience): perform light to medium automotive repairs and minimal diagnostics on our vehicles
  • Experienced Technician (min 5 years of professional experience): perform extensive repairs and heavy engine work, as well as advanced vehicle diagnostics on all makes and models, including electric and hybrid vehicles

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

title: Rebar Detailer
description:

title: Vet Assistant - Kensington, Maryland
description:
Wheaton Animal Hospital, located in Kensington, Maryland just outside of Washington D.C. and Baltimore, has been providing quality, compassionate care for Maryland's pets since 1947. Treating dogs, cats, and exotic animals, our team is staffed by compassionate professionals focused on providing pet care in a relaxed environment. Our facility offers modern technology and a wide range of services, including wellness care, surgery, dentistry, diagnostics, and emergency care. With more than sixty years of experience, the Wheaton Animal Hospital team are tried and true specialists whose goal is the safekeeping of our small animal patients.

Vet Assistant

Wheaton Animal Hospital | Kensington, MD

Compensation: $22.00-$24.00 per hour, based on experience and qualifications

Wheaton Animal Hospital is seeking a dedicated and compassionate full-time Veterinary Assistant to support our medical team in delivering exceptional care to pets and their owners. This role is ideal for an experienced veterinary professional who enjoys a fast-paced environment and is passionate about patient care, client service, and teamwork.

As a Veterinary Assistant, you will play an important role in both medical and surgical operations, assisting veterinarians with patient treatments, diagnostics, procedures, and client education while helping maintain efficient daily hospital operations.

What You'll Do

Patient Care & Clinical Support:

  • Assist veterinarians during examinations, treatments, diagnostic procedures, and surgeries.
  • Prepare patients for medical and surgical procedures, including pre-operative and post-operative care.
  • Monitor patient comfort and recovery following surgical procedures and anesthesia.
  • Safely restrain pets using fear-free and low-stress handling techniques.
  • Collect samples for laboratory testing, including blood, urine, and fecal specimens.
  • Administer medications, vaccines, and treatments under veterinary direction.
  • Place and maintain IV catheters and provide nursing care for hospitalized patients.
  • Maintain accurate treatment records and medical documentation.

Laboratory & Diagnostic Procedures:

  • Perform in-house diagnostic testing, including hematology, urinalysis, cytology, and fecal evaluations.
  • Assist with diagnostic imaging procedures, including radiography and ultrasound preparation.
  • Maintain and sanitize laboratory and diagnostic equipment according to hospital protocols.
  • Record and communicate diagnostic findings appropriately.

Client Service & Communication:

  • Educate pet owners regarding preventive care, medications, treatment plans, nutrition, and follow-up recommendations.
  • Provide clear, compassionate communication throughout the patient's visit.
  • Assist with appointment flow, client check-in/check-out, and general client inquiries.
  • Support the veterinary team by ensuring a positive client experience from admission through discharge.

Hospital Operations:

  • Help maintain clean, organized, and fully stocked treatment, exam, and surgical areas.
  • Accurately enter charges, treatment plans, and medical notes into the practice management system.
  • Assist with inventory organization and daily operational tasks as needed.
  • Follow all hospital policies, safety guidelines, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, professional, and patient-focused culture.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of veterinary assistant experience preferred, with exposure to both appointment and surgical settings.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Working knowledge of anesthesia monitoring, venipuncture, radiology, laboratory procedures, and dentistry support.
  • Comfortable utilizing practice management software and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a client-service mindset.
  • Ability to remain composed and professional during emergency or emotionally challenging situations.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to multitask effectively in a busy hospital environment.
  • Commitment to delivering compassionate care to patients and exceptional service to clients.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to safely assist with handling animals weighing up to 130 pounds.
  • Comfortable standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and moving throughout the workday.
  • Ability to work around disinfectants, anesthetic gases, radiation, animal waste, and zoonotic disease exposure in a veterinary setting.

Benefits

Eligible team members receive a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Paid time off
  • Paid holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Schedule

This is a full-time position. Candidates should be available to work a flexible schedule based on hospital needs and operational hours.

title: Construction Scheduler
description:
We are seeking experienced Construction Schedulers to provide schedule analysis and project-controls support for major NAVFAC construction programs.


The Scheduler will evaluate contractor schedules, develop and maintain Integrated Master Schedules, identify potential delays and conflicts, and provide independent schedule analysis to Government project personnel.


Responsibilities

  • Review contractor baseline and updated construction schedules.
  • Analyze schedule logic, sequencing, durations, critical paths, and progress.
  • Identify schedule deficiencies, delays, and potential conflicts.
  • Provide recommendations regarding acceptance or rejection of contractor schedules.
  • Develop and maintain Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) for multiple construction projects.
  • Coordinate schedule interfaces between multiple concurrent projects.
  • Perform schedule scenario analysis.
  • Review equipment delivery schedules and construction progress.
  • Provide monthly Construction Work in Place projections.
  • Conduct schedule analysis associated with contractor delay claims.
  • Develop Independent Time Impact Analyses for change-order negotiations.
  • Review schedule FRAGNETs and changes to critical-path activities.
  • Provide schedule reports, written comments, briefs, and recommendations.
  • Participate in project scheduling and coordination meetings.
  • Notify project leadership of potential schedule impacts affecting active or future projects.
