title: Network and Technical Change Lead - Manager / Senior Manager
description:
The context:

Our people work from offices, client sites and home, and they rely on fast, secure access to Scyne systems, cloud services and SaaS applications. This role looks after the Palo Alto Networks platform that makes that possible, and the change process that keeps the whole environment stable.

As the Network and Technical Change Lead, you will own Scyne's network and secure access architecture, built on Palo Alto Networks, and you will run technical change across Scyne's technology environment, including chairing the Change Advisory Board (CAB). You will make sure network, cloud and security changes are well designed, safely deployed and keep Scyne secure.

You will decide whether a change is ready to go ahead. You will chair CAB, hold our managed service provider (MSP) and internal teams to a high standard of planning, testing and rollback, and keep improving how change is delivered. You will bring practical experience of modern cloud deployment practices, such as infrastructure as code and automated pipelines, so that change is faster and safer, and you will make sure security is considered in every change.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the design, configuration and lifecycle of Scyne's Palo Alto Networks environment, including Prisma Access (SASE), GlobalProtect, next-generation firewalls, and management through Strata Cloud Manager or Panorama.
  • Manage security policy across the Palo Alto stack: rule review and clean-up, identity-based access, URL filtering, threat prevention, SSL decryption, and logging to security monitoring tools.
  • Maintain secure, reliable connectivity for users, offices and cloud environments, including remote access, site connectivity, DNS, and network integration with Azure, AWS and GCP.
  • Run Scyne's Change Advisory Board: set the agenda, chair the meeting, assess risk and impact, and approve, defer or reject changes.
  • Own the technical change management process across network, cloud, security and applications, including change types, lead times, emergency changes, freeze periods, post-implementation reviews and reporting on change success.
  • Review MSP and internal change requests for quality, including implementation steps, testing, rollback and communication plans, and send back those that are not ready.
  • Bring cloud deployment practices into change: infrastructure as code, pipeline-based deployments in GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, environment promotion and automated testing, and define where standard, pre-approved changes can safely be used.
  • Make sure every change is assessed for security impact, and work with the cyber security team on vulnerability remediation, patching windows and urgent security changes.
  • Track vulnerabilities and software versions across the Palo Alto stack, and plan and lead upgrades.
  • Lead network and change-related incident and problem management with the MSP, and drive lasting fixes.
  • Produce and maintain network diagrams, standards, configuration records, change templates and runbooks.
  • Report on change and network performance to the Director, Head of Architecture and Cloud, and recommend improvements.

Ideally, you'll have some of the following:

  • 10+ years' experience in network engineering or network security, including significant hands-on work with Palo Alto Networks technologies.
  • Practical experience designing and operating Prisma Access (SASE), GlobalProtect and Palo Alto firewalls; experience with Prisma SD-WAN, Prisma Access Browser or Prisma Cloud is valued.
  • Proven experience running a Change Advisory Board and owning change management, applying ITIL change, incident and problem practices.
  • Experience with cloud deployment practices, including infrastructure as code (such as Terraform), CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, and cloud networking in Azure, AWS or GCP.
  • Strong network security knowledge, including zero trust, segmentation, secure remote access, and familiarity with the ASD Essential Eight and the Information Security Manual (ISM).
  • Strong grasp of networking fundamentals: routing, switching, VPN, DNS and load balancing.
  • Experience directing and governing a managed service provider.
  • Experience leading technical teams and influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Clear written communication, with the ability to produce diagrams, standards and change records that others can follow.
  • Palo Alto Networks certifications are highly desirable, such as PCNSE or a Prisma Access or SASE specialisation; ITIL Foundation or higher is valued.
  • A tertiary qualification in information technology, computer science, engineering or a related discipline is desirable.

  • Market leading Parental Leave: Allows either carer to take 26 weeks of leave, flexibly, until a child is two years of age. A six-month minimum service requirement for new starters applies. We also make full superannuation contributions for up to 12 months (including unpaid parental leave).
  • Flex working: Our people have the autonomy to choose where and when they work so they can integrate their professional and personal lives, finding the right balance that fuels their growth, wellbeing, engagement and productivity. If it works for them, their teams, and their clients, it works for us.

title: Animation Art Intern - Summer 2027
description:
As an Animation Artist Intern at Riot, you will bring champions and characters to life through classic animation principles and body mechanics. You will create high quality animations for a diverse and rapidly growing universe, including bipeds, quadrupeds, and creatures. A great reel will showcase a variety of body types, a diverse selection of action oriented game-related animation, and a strong foundation in the principles of animation, including weight, anticipation, and impact. Also working to expand our current content pipeline, you will collaborate with designers and artists to develop new features and technologies. Your craft expertise will breathe life into iconic and beloved characters for players.

In your application, you will select which product you prefer to apply for:

Teamfight Tactics

As an Animation Artist Intern on Teamfight Tactics, you will animate a large variety of things, ranging from champions (old and new), creatures, and even props! Your animations will have to consider how to synthesize both animation principles and the needs of strict gameplay requirements. Throughout development you will be hand-keying/editing animations in Maya, learning about League’s proprietary game engine, and implementing assets within the Unreal Game Engine. Throughout the internship you will have an onboarding partner and a team supporting you through our set development.

League of Legends

As an Animation Artist Intern on League, you will focus on champion animation. You will collaborate with animators on character lore, their motivations, and incorporate their core identity with project requirements to create impactful character performances. Your animations will be hand keyed in Maya using classic animation principles. You will also be responsible for implementation within our proprietary game engine. Throughout the process you will have an onboarding partner and a mentor to guide you through our development process.

Responsibilities:

  • Create high quality animations for a diverse and expanding universe, including bipeds, quadrupeds, and monsters
  • Help develop new features and technologies to expand the content pipeline
  • Collaborate with designers and artists to create animation assets that fulfill the requirements of the project’s game and visual design
  • Recognize areas of opportunity and help other animators level up to AAA-title-standards
  • Consistently meet project deadlines in a timely manner without compromising artistic integrity
  • Balance craft and product feedback with a strong empathy and focus on player value
  • Consistently communicate by proactively collaborating, directing next steps, and providing clear goals and outcomes to your team

Required Qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a college, university or non degree program
  • Available to work full-time hours for 10-12 week at our Los Angeles Headquarters
  • Authorized to work in the U.S.
  • Experience with action and combat based animations showcasing locomotion cycles for characters and creatures of diverse shape and size (bipeds, quadrupeds, etc.)
  • Experience with Maya

Desired Qualifications:

  • Gaming specific animations through professional or personal work
  • Experience w/ Unreal Engine and Animation Blueprints

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will certainly be looking at your past studies and experience, but for this role, we also look for dedicated people with a personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about the experiences of players, this could be the role for you!

Work Authorization

  • Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States for the duration of the program.
  • This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. We do not sponsor visas for this position or internship conversions.

General Portfolio Advice:

  • Please limit application submission to 1 role. You will automatically be considered for similar roles based on your portfolio
  • Online format is preferred (Artstation, personal websites, etc.)
  • If you have private work that is under NDA, please include the password in your application. Otherwise, we recommend you do not password protect your portfolio
  • Test that your Portfolio or reel is accessible. Please include access to your portfolio on your resume in addition to the application form in case the link breaks
  • Ensure your portfolio showcases your best work
  • Fan Art? Sure! It shows your versatility as it relates directly to our art style
  • Depending on the role, immersing yourself in the game to get the feel, tone and look can go a long way for your portfolio

Riot Internships are paid, and interns can also participate in our 401(k) plan. You can expect in-game perks, and the ability to participate in our Play Fund, so you can broaden and deepen your knowledge of our players and community through games. The University Programs team also invites you to intern focused events so you can connect with your fellow interns and Rioters to make the most out of your experience.

title: Specjalista / Specjalistka Modelu Danych Bankowych
description:
Poszukujemy osoby, która dołączy do naszego zespołu i będzie uczestniczyć w rozwoju oraz modernizacji procesów przygotowania danych na potrzeby sprawozdawczości obowiązkowej Banku BPS i Banków Spółdzielczych. Jeśli znasz zagadnienia sprawozdawczości bankowej, lubisz pracę z danymi i chcesz mieć realny wpływ na rozwój nowoczesnych rozwiązań analitycznych, zapraszamy do współpracy.

Tak organizujemy naszą pracę

Tak pracujemy

  • wewnątrz organizacji

Twój zakres obowiązków

  • Udział w projektowaniu, budowie i rozwoju procesów przygotowania danych na potrzeby sprawozdawczości obowiązkowej Banku BPS i Banków Spółdzielczych (. FINREP, COREP).

  • Analiza istniejących rozwiązań sprawozdawczych opartych na bazie danych Oracle oraz udział w ich migracji do środowiska Google BigQuery.

  • Opracowywanie i utrzymywanie reguł mapowania danych źródłowych na model biznesowy systemu sprawozdawczego dostawcy zewnętrznego.

  • Analiza wymagań biznesowych i regulacyjnych oraz ich przekładanie na zasady przygotowania i przetwarzania danych.

  • Konfiguracja mapowań, uruchamianie procesów przetwarzania oraz weryfikacja poprawności i kompletności przygotowanych danych.

  • Identyfikacja i analiza rozbieżności w danych, wyjaśnianie przyczyn błędów oraz współpraca przy ich usuwaniu.

  • Wprowadzanie niewielkich modyfikacji w procesach ETL/ELT oraz udział w testowaniu i wdrażaniu nowych rozwiązań.

  • Współpraca z jednostkami biznesowymi, zespołami IT oraz dostawcami zewnętrznymi w zakresie rozwoju i utrzymania procesów sprawozdawczych.

  • Tworzenie i aktualizacja dokumentacji dotyczącej mapowań danych, reguł biznesowych oraz procesów przetwarzania.

Nasze wymagania

  • Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w obszarze sprawozdawczości obowiązkowej w sektorze finansowym, preferowane doświadczenie w sektorze bankowym.

  • Znajomość produktów bankowych oraz zagadnień z obszaru finansów i bankowości.

  • Znajomość zasad i procesów przygotowywania sprawozdawczości obowiązkowej (. FINREP, COREP).

  • Umiejętność analizy i interpretacji danych finansowych oraz identyfikowania i wyjaśniania rozbieżności.

  • Umiejętność analizowania wymagań biznesowych i przekładania ich na reguły przetwarzania oraz mapowania danych.

  • Zdolność analitycznego myślenia, samodzielność i dokładność w realizacji powierzonych zadań.

  • Umiejętność współpracy z jednostkami biznesowymi oraz zespołami IT.

Mile widziane

  • Znajomość SQL umożliwiająca samodzielne przygotowywanie zapytań i analizowanie danych.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z relacyjnymi bazami danych, w szczególności Oracle.

  • Znajomość środowiska Google Cloud, w szczególności BigQuery.

  • Doświadczenie w mapowaniu danych pomiędzy systemami źródłowymi a systemami sprawozdawczymi.

  • Znajomość procesów ETL/ELT i podstawowych zasad działania hurtowni danych.

  • Doświadczenie w projektach wdrażania lub migracji systemów sprawozdawczych.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z narzędziami do wizualizacji danych (np. Lightdash, Looker, Power BI).

To oferujemy

  • praca w systemie hybrydowym (praca stacjonarna z Centrali BPS przy ul. Grzybowskiej 81 w Warszawie - komfortowy budynek na przeciwko Muzeum Powstania Warszawskiego, w okolicach Ronda I. Daszyńskiego)

title: Integrated Systems Technician Trainee
description:
VSC Fire & Security delivers integrated, cutting-edge fire protection, life safety and security solutions, including fire suppression and detection systems, fire sprinklers, alarms and security systems.

The company was founded in 1958 on quality craftsmanship and exceptional customer service, with integrity and reliability at the center of everything we do. As the premier provider of fire protection and life-safety solutions across the Southeast, VSC Fire & Security provides every customer with comprehensive solutions through outstanding design, efficient installation, reliable service and repair, and thorough inspections.

VSC Fire & Security in Springfield, Virginia is seeking candidates for the position of Integrated Systems Technician Trainee.

Position Summary:

Assists in performing activities concerned with the installation, service and/or inspection of integrated systems under the guidance of a licensed Integrated Systems Technician. Integrated Systems may include any of the following: Fire Alarm; Intrusion Detection; Access Control; CCTV; IP Cameras; Networking Infrastructure; Telecom; BDA (Bi-Directional Antenna systems); DAS (Distributed Antenna Systems); Audio/Video; Nurse Call; Area of Refuge; Intercom; Crestron; Extron; Honeywell; Notifier; Gamewell FCI; Silent Knight; Fire Lite; Siemens; AutoCall/JCI; or RATH.

What we offer:

  • Excellent pay $20.00 - $30.00 and up based on experience
  • Overtime eligible
  • Paid vacation and company holidays
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance options for you and your family
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) or Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Company paid life insurance for full time employees
  • Employee apparel program
  • Company paid long term disability insurance
  • Bonus for referring new employees
  • Parental leave for full-time employees
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Boot Allowance
  • NICET certification test reimbursement
  • Opportunities for training and advancement
  • All needed Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) provided

What you need:

  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and communication skills.
  • Eagerness for professional development and growth.
  • Ability to pass various background checks where required.
  • Reliable transportation, valid State Driver's License with acceptable driving record for use of company vehicle.
  • Desirable (but not required):
    • Experience in the construction or electrical industry.
    • Competence in reading and interpreting electrical plans, drawings, schematics, and specifications.

What you will do:

  • Accurately interpret instructions and directives as assigned by supervisor.
  • Effectively communicate relevant project or service information to supervisor.
  • Complete work in a timely manner as outlined by supervisor.
  • Effectively communicate with others – including by not limited to co-workers, supervisors, and job site
  • Occasional use of computers, phones, email, copier and/or other office technology.

  • Exercise a modest level of independent judgment in to perform assigned duties.

This may include, but not limited to; fire alarm, fire suppression, access control, video surveillance, intercom, sound/security systems, and other life safety and integrated systems.

VSC Fire and Security is a drug free workplace.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Storeperson Distribution and Logistics
description:
• Together we’ll achieve results for our customers by the accurate handling, warehousing, and distribution of aircraft parts.
  • Experience pride in what you’ll achieve in a supportive environment.
  • Permanent, full-time opportunity based at Adelaide Airport on a rotating shift roster (4 on, 4 off).

We’re constantly evolving, and this means the opportunities for our people are endless. In every role there’s the opportunity to embrace personal development and career growth, ownership of projects, and the ability to make an impact.

We understand our priorities and what needs to be delivered, taking the initiative to keep things moving. Navigating through our complex work environment, we bring teams and individuals together to deliver on our customers’ expectations.

With the opportunity to work in an environment that fosters strong workplace relationships and inspires flexibility, your new position as Storeperson Distribution & Logistics will see you working as part of a small, dedicated team based at Adelaide Airport.

In this role, you’ll support the efficient handling, warehousing and distribution of aircraft parts and materials, ensuring requirements are processed accurately and within required timeframes. You’ll monitor changing operational priorities across the warehouse and reprioritise work where required to meet customer and stakeholder needs.

You’ll be responsible for a range of warehousing activities, including receipting, binning, issuing and dispatch, along with maintaining accurate control of Qantas and client stock. You’ll also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance productivity and efficiency, while working collaboratively across the broader logistics team to deliver a safe and reliable operation.

To be successful in this role you will have:

  • Previous warehousing experience, with a minimum of three years performing receipting, binning and dispatch activities
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise competing tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced operational environment
  • A proactive, self-motivated approach with demonstrated initiative
  • Strong attention to detail and sound data entry skills
  • The ability to adapt to changing operational requirements and contribute to continuous improvement
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective working relationships
  • A good understanding of logistics, warehousing and inventory control
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office
  • A current Australian driver’s licence, with the ability to drive a manual vehicle preferred
  • A current Forklift Licence
  • Eligibility to hold an Aviation Security Identification Card (ASIC)
  • A Dangerous Goods (DG) Certificate, or willingness to obtain one
  • Flexibility to work across a rotating day and night shift roster

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave (plus superannuation payments on all paid and unpaid parental leave until your child turns 1) and additional purchased leave options for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

The Qantas Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

If you’re ready to step into a culture that will challenge and excite you, submit an application and let’s explore how we go places together.

Applications Close: Wednesday 25th November 2026

title: Senior Water Resources Engineer
description:
How you’ll make a difference

Through the current successes of the AECOM Water Resources team in Sydney, we have a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Senior Water Resources Engineer to be part of, and influence, the continued growth of our business.

As a member of the Water Resources team, this role will see you working closely with engineers, scientists, drafters and other professionals across a variety of disciplines throughout the AECOM business. You will provide technical support in water resources (including impact assessment, water balance modelling, water quality, flood modelling, erosion and sediment control) for projects in the resources, waste, industrial, infrastructure (road, rail, utilities) and developer sectors.

Our Hunter Water Resources team is currently helping to deliver a diverse range of projects such as a waste facility water and leachate management strategy (water balance modelling), Leppington Five Roads (drainage design, erosion and sediment control plan) and a gold mine raw and potable water management supply strategy. As a Senior Professional, you will be responsible for the technical delivery of water resources impact assessments, management plans and strategies, compliance reports, water management system design and water licensing assessments. You will be given the opportunity to actively participate in and contribute to the technical aspects of a range of projects so that they are consistently and successfully delivered according to plan.

  • 4-8 years of Industry experience in a similar role is essential;
  • Knowledge of Australian and New Zealand Guidelines for Fresh and Marine Water Quality, NSW Water Management Act 2000, Water Management (General) Regulation 2025, Managing Urban Stormwater – Soils and Construction Volume 1 and Volume 2, Best Practice Erosion and Sediment Control and AR&R2019;
  • Experience in water resource impact assessment, water balance modelling, water quality investigations and modelling and management plan preparation (e.g. water management plans, erosion and sediment control plans);
  • Experience in hydrological studies and flood modelling;
  • Knowledge of detailed road and/or rail designs, and multidisciplinary interfaces;
  • Software technology applications (e.g. GoldSim, TUFLOW, MUSIC, HECRAS etc.);
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.

The qualities that help you thrive

The following qualifications and experience are highly desired, but if you don’t tick all the boxes, you could still be a perfect fit for this role. Please apply, all applications will be considered.

  • Bachelor of Engineering (Environmental, Civil or Chemical) or Environmental Science, or equivalent – essential.
  • Experience with GoldSim and GIS software – essential.
  • Experience with TUFLOW, HECRAS and MUSIC software – desirable.

Why you’ll love working with us

  • Flexible work arrangements, including alternative start/finish times, job-sharing and hybrid work options
  • Up to 22 weeks parental leave, 2 weeks paid partner leave and up to 12 weeks paid alternative primary carer leave
  • Purchase up to 6 weeks additional annual leave per year
  • Flex public holidays – swap Easter or other holidays for ones that suit you better

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

AECOM acknowledges the Traditional Owners and Custodians of the lands on which we, our clients and our communities live and work around Australia. We pay our respects to their cultures and to their Elders — past, present, and emerging. We are committed to connecting to Country in our work through meaningful engagement with First Nations peoples and businesses. Find out more about our Australian Reconciliation Action Plan here: https://aecom.com/au/our-vision-for-reconciliation/.

About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity

You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion – a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation and benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We also provide a robust global well-being program. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

title: System Analyst
description:
Dołącz do Knowit i wykorzystaj swoje doświadczenie w analizie systemowej przy realizacji międzynarodowego projektu w sektorze publicznym.

Dla naszego klienta – europejskiej agencji działającej w obszarze zarządzania granicami zewnętrznymi i bezpieczeństwa – poszukujemy doświadczonej osoby na stanowisko System Analyst (Advanced).

Planowany start współpracy: 4 stycznia 2027 r.
Język projektu: angielski

O projekcie i roli

Rola obejmuje analizę systemową oraz projektowanie funkcjonalności oprogramowania. Kluczową częścią pracy będzie tworzenie modeli UML i dokumentacji opisującej działanie systemów – od ról użytkowników i przypadków użycia po logiczne modele danych oraz elementy interfejsu.

Szukamy osoby, która potrafi porządkować złożone zagadnienia, rozwiązywać problemy i przekładać wymagania na czytelną specyfikację rozwiązania.

Zakres odpowiedzialności

  • Analiza i projektowanie funkcjonalności systemów informatycznych.

  • Tworzenie i aktualizowanie modeli UML oraz dokumentacji systemowej.

  • Modelowanie ról systemowych, przypadków użycia i ich przepływów.

  • Definiowanie reguł systemowych oraz logicznych modeli danych.

  • Specyfikowanie formularzy i elementów interfejsu użytkownika.

  • Wykorzystywanie narzędzi do modelowania systemów, takich jak Sparx Enterprise Architect.

  • Wyjaśnianie zagadnień analitycznych i wspieranie komunikacji dotyczącej projektowanych rozwiązań.

Wymagania

  • Minimum 8 lat doświadczenia zawodowego w IT, w tym minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w analizie systemowej lub na podobnym stanowisku.

  • Wykształcenie wyższe na poziomie minimum licencjat lub inżynier. Kierunek informatyczny nie jest wymagany.

  • Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie minimum C1, potwierdzona certyfikatem lub oceną poziomu językowego. Kopia potwierdzenia jest wymagana na etapie przedstawiania kandydatury klientowi.

  • Udział w co najmniej jednym pełnym cyklu tworzenia rozwiązania informatycznego.

  • Znajomość projektowania funkcjonalności oprogramowania i modelowania UML.

  • Umiejętność modelowania ról systemowych, przypadków użycia i ich przepływów, reguł systemowych, logicznych modeli danych oraz formularzy i elementów UI.

  • Znajomość metodyk wytwarzania systemów.

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość narzędzi do modelowania systemów, takich jak Sparx Enterprise Architect.

  • Bardzo dobre umiejętności komunikacyjne, umiejętność tworzenia czytelnej dokumentacji oraz rozwiązywania problemów.

Wymagana certyfikacja

  • Minimum jeden certyfikat Certified UML Professional na poziomie Intermediate lub równoważny certyfikat uznawany międzynarodowo.

Mile widziane

  • Doświadczenie w definiowaniu standardów analizy i projektowania systemów lub rozwoju oprogramowania.

  • Praktyczna znajomość Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) i metodyk Agile.

  • Doświadczenie w analizie systemowej projektów obejmujących integracje między systemami i platformami danych.

  • Doświadczenie w analizie aplikacji zintegrowanych z GIS, w tym prezentujących dane na mapach.

  • Doświadczenie w analizie aplikacji służących do zbierania danych i raportowania.

  • Doświadczenie w analizie biznesowej.

Oferujemy:

  • Współpracę w formule B2B opartą na partnerskich zasadach

  • Możliwość realizacji ambitnych projektów dla klientów z różnych branż

  • Udział w projektach technologicznych z obszaru AI, data oraz transformacji cyfrowej

  • Współpracę z organizacją realnie zaangażowaną w zrównoważony rozwój i odpowiedzialne wykorzystanie technologii

  • Elastyczność w zakresie organizacji i sposobu realizacji zadań projektowych

  • Dostęp do środowiska ekspertów i wymianę wiedzy w ramach realizowanych przedsięwzięć

  • Projekty realizowane z wykorzystaniem nowoczesnego stosu technologicznego i najnowszych rozwiązań rynkowych

  • Poszerzanie doświadczeń poprzez udział w innowacyjnych przedsięwzięciach i wdrożeniach

title: Business Consultant - Identity and Access Management (IAM)
description:
About Justera Group
Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high-performing technology teams and delivering end-to-end IT solutions. Led by dynamic female executives, Justera Group focuses on helping businesses harness the power of digital technologies to continuously evolve in today’s rapidly changing economy. Justera Group manages the entire talent lifecycle, from hiring to ongoing management, ensuring the right fit for each project on time and within budget. With their strong commitment to quality, collaboration, and client success, Justera Group is a trusted partner for technology innovation across Sweden.

About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Consultant - Identity and Access Management (IAM) for an exciting opportunity in Gothenburg, Sweden. This is a 100% onsite position with 0% remote work, requiring a senior-level professional with excellent written and spoken English (Advanced level).

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in IAM business governance, operational coordination, stakeholder management, and business process ownership.

title: Game Designer (Live Content)
description:
WHO WE ARE

At 2K, we create some of the most iconic and culture-shaping video games in entertainment, including NBA® 2K, one of the top-selling franchises in the world, and legendary titles like BioShock®, Borderlands®, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization®, and XCOM®, as well as fan favorites WWE® 2K, TopSpin®, and PGA TOUR® 2K. We build unforgettable experiences by pushing the boundaries of creativity, authenticity and innovation across every genre.

Our portfolio is brought to life by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Visual Concepts, Firaxis Games, Hangar 13, Cat Daddy Games, 31st Union, Cloud Chamber, Gearbox, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab create world-class experiences across platforms.

But what truly powers 2K is our people.

We believe the best ideas come from teams that feel empowered, supported, and inspired. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace where people are encouraged to come as they are and do their best work.

WHAT WE NEED

HB Studios is a driving force in the creation of sports games and the studio behind PGA TOUR 2K Golf – presently working on PC and Consoles. HB Studios has an opportunity for a Game Designer (Live Content) who is knowledgeable about golf, and passionate about the art of game development to join their team.

As a Game Designer with a focus on game content and Live Ops, you will work with a team of professionals designing and developing one of the fastest growing sports game franchises in the industry!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Work with feature owners to understand existing game systems, and drive plans and implementation of content to support those features.
  • Design, author and maintain the playable gameplay-, event-, and objective-based content needed to fuel a thoughtful, and engaging player experience.
  • Design and implement supplementary level designs on top of existing courses to support gameplay needs such as Challenges gameplay.
  • Shepherd content through implementation, focusing on hands-on work; including playtesting, tuning, data entry, content creation, and scripting.
  • Ensure all tools and features are working as intended and coordinate with the QA team to report bugs and reproduction steps.
  • Use the provided toolset and operate on the outlined processes for handling working files, implementing levels, vetting check-ins, etc.
  • Generate and design new ideas and extensions that improve our Live Service features over time.
  • Contribute to our growing philosophy of game design and how we make games.

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU A GREAT FIT

  • Typically, a minimum of 2 to 4 years of experience in Game Design.
  • A strong grasp on the game of golf, the world of professional golf, and PGA TOUR.
  • Strong systems design foundation with demonstrable understanding of game loops, player motivations, and retention.
  • A solid understanding of technical and production aspects of game development, backed by associated experience, including at least one shipped title or project.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and clearly document and present ideas in a distributed team that relies on Slack and video calls.
  • Proficiency with common game development software and tools.
  • Self-motivated individual with a desire to explore, research, grow, and become a go-to subject-matter expert in areas of need.
  • Strong working knowledge of current design trends and mechanics across major modern sports franchises.
  • Experience with live service games is a plus.

We believe the ideal candidate is a creative person with a love for game design, and hunger to deliver high-quality, inviting, and engaging golf experiences through video games. We value a proven ability to breakdown game issues, mechanics or concepts into lay terms and share views on game-specific issues in a constructive manner. We are seeking both detail-minded, and big-picture persons who work well with others and consider all forms of feedback.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need reasonable accommodation.

Location & Relocation

This position is based in Nova Scotia. Relocation support is available for the right candidate. Nova Scotia offers unparalleled access to nature, rich cultural experiences, and a vibrant, balanced lifestyle.

Please note that 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, only use 2K.com accounts.

title: Master's Thesis: From Tokens to Actions: System-One Decision Models for Low-Latency Wireless Control
description:
About Huawei Sweden R&D

Founded in 1987, Huawei Technologies has grown into a global leader in telecommunications and network solutions, with innovation at the core of everything we do. Huawei established its first overseas R&D office in Sweden in 2000, and since then, we’ve expanded rapidly. Today, our R&D engineers are pushing boundaries in Stockholm, Gothenburg, and Lund, working on groundbreaking 6G wireless systems that shape tomorrow’s technology.

Join us on our journey to develop the future of tech and be a part of a team that thrives on innovation, works hard to solve the industry’s biggest challenges, and collaborates with top engineers worldwide. If you’re ready to contribute to world-changing advancements, we want you on board!

About the Project: System-One Models for Wireless Decision-Making Applications and Performance Evaluation

This thesis evaluates System-One models — probabilistic, decision-native models that map an observed network state and a typed query directly to a calibrated distribution over a bounded action set, replacing token-by-token LLM generation — as the execution engine for the fast decision path of an agentic cellular modem.

Expected Contributions:

  • To formalize the decision structure of representative wireless control tasks as System One queries.

  • To implement and evaluate system-one model calibration pipeline for those tasks using open wireless datasets or simulated state-action traces.

  • To design and benchmark a confidence-threshold escalation policy against pure-LLM and pure-fast-path baselines.

  • To characterize the quality–latency–calibration trade-offs across calibration levels and decision tasks.

Timeline

Given our current project schedules, we are looking for master’s students available to start in spring 2027.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Background: Master's student in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering field, with a strong interest in agentic AI system.

  • Communication: Strong command of English, both spoken and written.

  • Team & Independence: Capable of working effectively both in teams and independently.

  • Commitment to Quality: High attention to detail and dedication to producing high-quality work.

  • Desirable Experience: Programming experience in Python. Knowledge of large language models (LLMs), AI agent frameworks, prompt engineering, or reinforcement learning is an advantage.

Are you ready to apply your skills in a real-world setting and help us lead the charge in tech innovation? Join Huawei Sweden R&D, and let’s make tech history together!

title: Senior Site Reliability Specialist (SRE)
description:
About AlayaCare

At AlayaCare, we’re more than just a fast-growing SaaS company, we’re a team of people passionate about transforming home healthcare. Our cloud-based platform empowers care providers around the world to deliver better outcomes for their clients.

With 550+ employees across Canada, the US, Australia, and Brazil, we’re united by a shared mission and a strong culture of transparency, growth, and human connection. Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned expert, AlayaCare offers the opportunity to grow your impact, your skills, and your career.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Site Reliability Specialist (SRE) and will be reporting to the Manager, Software Development you will scale our AWS cloud infrastructure, evolve Kubernetes deployment pipelines, improve monitoring, alerting, and resiliency, and develop tooling that enables product teams to deliver safely and efficiently. For acquired Azure-based products, the focus is on monitoring, alert triage, and runbook-driven incident response rather than greenfield platform design.

The Senior SRE will own shared platform services across cloud regions, including databases, messaging, logging, search, and tenant provisioning. The candidate will lead major infrastructure initiatives and proof-of-concept efforts, contributes to technical planning and prioritization, and partners with product teams to reduce operational incidents.

The team also develops and operates AI-driven tools to streamline runbooks, accelerate incident response, and generate operational insights from platform telemetry to improve reliability and reduce manual effort.

What You’ll Do

Development, Automation, and Tooling

  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure and platform services, including Kubernetes and observability tooling.
  • Implement infrastructure as code, configuration management, and automated testing to ensure reliable, repeatable environments.
  • Contribute to code and configuration reviews to improve scalability, maintainability, and reuse.

Reliability and Operations

  • Monitor production systems, troubleshoot issues, and improve logging, monitoring, alerting, and runbooks.
  • Participate in on-call and help desk rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews to improve long-term reliability.

Requirements and Collaboration

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and development teams to translate requirements into reliable and operable infrastructure solutions.
  • Identify risks across operability, security, performance, and cost, and recommend practical trade-offs.

Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to operational quality through runbooks, security hardening, performance tuning, and process improvements.
  • Stay current with emerging SRE practices, including AI-assisted operations and modern AWS platform patterns.

What You Bring to the Team

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical or demonstrated learning experience.
  • 4 to 6 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Solid hands-on experience with AWS in a multi-account, multi-region environment: EKS, AWS Organizations, IAM, and KMS.
  • Strong proficiency with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code workflows, including Atlantis/GitOps, state management, and module/provider upgrades.
  • Practical experience running workloads on Docker and Kubernetes in production, including Gateway API ingress patterns and cluster lifecycle management (upgrades, addons, node provisioning).
  • Strong experience with Linux systems administration and production troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in at least one development or scripting language such as Python, Go, or Bash.
  • Experience with an observability platform (e.g. New Relic, OpenSearch, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, Honeycomb, Datadog) and event-driven alerting (e.g. EventBridge, SNS, PagerDuty).
  • Knowledge of system and network security fundamentals, including WAF, least-privilege IAM, secrets management, and backup/disaster recovery.
  • Experience participating in incident management (on-call, triage, remediation, post-incident review) and writing operational runbooks.
  • Hands-on experience operating Aurora MySQL and PostgreSQL in production, including migrations, performance tuning, and backup/restore.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex operational issues through practical, scalable solutions.
  • Experience working in Agile environments and delivering iteratively.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams in a distributed environment.
  • Experience with AWS is required; Azure experience is an asset.
  • Relevant cloud or Kubernetes certifications are an asset but not mandatory.
  • Experience with cloud cost optimization (rightsizing, reserved capacity, and cost allocation tagging) is an asset.
  • Experience with Flux/ArgoCD, Karpenter, or Ray/Anyscale GPU infrastructure is an asset.
  • Experience monitoring production systems on Azure is an asset.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in both French and English, with the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences. English fluency is required to collaborate effectively with colleagues, clients, and partners outside Quebec, where English is the primary working language.

Why Join AlayaCare?

Work With Purpose

At AlayaCare, you’ll help build technology that empowers care providers and improves outcomes for patients and families. Every line of code and every customer interaction contributes to making care more connected, accessible, and human.

Grow in a High-Trust Culture

We believe in transparency, feedback, and assuming positive intent. Here, you’ll feel safe to share your ideas and career goals, and be supported to achieve them through mentorship, career mobility, and a promote-from-within philosophy.

Balance That Works for You

We value flexibility and well-being. From “Wellness Fridays” to volunteer time off, to flexible vacation, we make sure you have the space to recharge, contribute to your community, and live your best life.

Benefits That Matter

  • Equity in a well-funded, scaling company.
  • Comprehensive health benefits, telemedicine, and lifestyle spending accounts.
  • Parental leave top-up and family support programs.

Inclusive by Design

We celebrate diverse perspectives and foster belonging through our DEIB initiatives. Employee-led events, summits, and social activities, both in-person and virtual, create meaningful connections across our global teams.

Location and Work Model

This role is based in Montreal. At AlayaCare, our hybrid model includes 2 set in-office collaboration days/week, and it is expected that team members are present in the office on those days to foster connection, innovation, and teamwork.

Ready to Join Us?

Apply today and be part of a company that makes a real difference in the future of home and community care. Not the right role for you? Share this posting with someone who might be a great fit.

AlayaCare uses AI tools during our hiring process to support fair, consistent, and objective decision-making. Some initial screening steps may be automated to help identify qualified candidates. If your application is declined automatically, you may request a human review.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone belongs. If you require accommodation during the application process, please reach out to careers@alayacare.com.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
About Us

AGE Solutions is a premier technology and professional services company, providing in-depth consulting, advanced technology solutions, and essential services throughout the U.S. government, defense, and intelligence sectors. Prioritizing innovation and client-focused solutions, we assist major agencies in addressing intricate issues and ensuring a more secure future.

AGE Solutions is looking for a Senior Network Engineer to join our team in support of a secure network modernization initiative with our DoD customer. This position will serve as a senior engineering and architecture resource responsible for designing, implementing, integrating, and optimizing secure networking and cybersecurity solutions supporting SIPRNet modernization initiatives.

The Senior Network Engineer will provide technical leadership in SD-WAN, secure access technologies, Commercial Solutions for Classified (CSfC), cybersecurity architecture, network transformation, and enterprise modernization efforts across globally distributed secure environments.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Design and implement secure networking and cybersecurity solutions supporting Army SIPRNet modernization objectives.
  • Lead engineering activities involving SD-WAN, secure network connectivity, security controls, and infrastructure modernization.
  • Support the implementation of CSfC solutions, secure mobility capabilities, and classified network access technologies.
  • Develop technical architectures, solution designs, implementation plans, and engineering documentation.
  • Integrate network, security, identity, and infrastructure technologies across enterprise environments.
  • Evaluate network performance, security posture, scalability, resiliency, and operational effectiveness.
  • Provide technical leadership for network migration, deployment, modernization, and transformation initiatives.
  • Collaborate with architects, engineers, cybersecurity personnel, customer stakeholders, and program leadership to meet mission requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex networking, cybersecurity, and infrastructure challenges.
  • Conduct technical reviews and provide recommendations supporting future-state architecture and modernization objectives.
  • Support cybersecurity assessments, compliance initiatives, vulnerability remediation, and risk management activities.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions to enhance network security, performance, and mission readiness.

Required Skills, Qualifications and Experience:

  • Education and Certifications:
    • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant professional experience will be considered.
    • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCNP, CCIE, PCNSE, Security+, or equivalent.
    • Must meet applicable DoD 8140 qualification requirements (formerly DoD 8570).
  • Experience:
    • Minimum of twelve (12) years of relevant professional experience in network engineering, cybersecurity engineering, secure communications, or enterprise infrastructure modernization.
    • Demonstrated experience supporting SD-WAN, network security, secure access technologies, and large-scale infrastructure initiatives.
    • Experience developing technical architectures, solution designs, and implementation strategies.
    • Experience supporting federal government, DoD, classified networking, cybersecurity, or enterprise architecture environments preferred.
  • Citizenship and Clearance:
    • U.S. Citizenship is required.
    • Must have and maintain an active DoD Secret security clearance.
    • Must be able to obtain and maintain customer-specific access and credentials as required.
  • Skills and Knowledge:
    • Expert knowledge of secure networking, SD-WAN technologies (Versa Networks preferred), cybersecurity architecture, and enterprise infrastructure.
    • Strong understanding of Commercial Solutions for Classified (CSfC), Zero Trust principles, secure access technologies, and classified network environments.
    • Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and optimize scalable, resilient, and secure network solutions.
    • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges.
    • Ability to translate technical and mission requirements into effective engineering solutions.
    • Demonstrated technical leadership and ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering and cybersecurity teams.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop technical documentation and present recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Location:
    • This is a full-time, onsite position located at Fort Huachuca, Arizona.
    • Up to 25% travel may be required, including occasional CONUS and OCONUS travel.

The projected salary for this position is $120,000+ annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including years of relevant experience, certifications, technical expertise, skillset, and overall qualifications.

At AGE Solutions, we reward performance, invest in growth, and share success. Our benefits support the whole person, professionally, financially, and personally.

  • 26 Days Paid Leave: Includes vacation, sick, personal time, and holidays. You choose how to use it.
  • Performance Bonuses: Performance bonuses are awarded based on individual contributions and company-wide results, aligning recognition with impact.
  • 401(k) with Match: We match 3% of your contributions with immediate vesting.
  • Financial Protection: Company-paid life insurance up to $300K and options for additional coverage for you and your dependents.
  • Health Benefits: Multiple medical plans, dental, vision, FSA and HSA options to fit your needs.
  • Parental Leave: 15 days of fully paid leave for new parents, because family matters.
  • Military Differential Pay: We bridge the gap for employees on active duty, so they don’t take a financial hit while serving.
  • Professional Growth: Paid training and certifications, tuition reimbursement, and the tools and tech to get the job done right.
  • Shared Success: In the event of a company sale, our CEO has committed to returning 80% of net proceeds to employees. This ensures our team shares in the long term value they help create.

At AGE, you’ll do work that matters, supported by a company that delivers for its people.

title: Technical Operations Engineer - Linux Systems Administrator
description:
At Two Six Technologies, we build, deploy, and implement innovative products that solve the world’s most complex challenges today. Through unrivaled collaboration and unwavering trust, we push the boundaries of what’s possible to empower our team and support our customers in building a safer global future.

Overview of Opportunity

Two Six Technologies is seeking a Technical Operations Engineer to support the deployment of web-based infrastructure and applications powering critical cybersecurity and national security research programs. In this role, you’ll contribute to high-impact platforms that ingest, analyze, and contextualize complex data to support decision-making and operational agility. You’ll work side-by-side with product teams, DevOps engineers, and operators to ensure the system is both stable and secure.

This position is ideal for an engineer who thrives in fast-moving, mission-driven environments and enjoys working at the intersection of backend systems, cloud infrastructure, and user-facing capabilities.

The work will be in our Colorado Springs, CO office.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the development of custom data visualizations using SQL to support mission requirements.
  • Receive, analyze, preprocess, and ingest data into the product data model leveraging python.
  • Deploy, configure, and administer product servers on unclassified and classified networks in support of the customer.
  • Provide customer support through the performance of on-site installation, as well as overseeing any necessary diagnoses, troubleshooting, service, and repair of systems.
  • Provide tactical level APP and deployment support to U.S. Government agencies and Military communities integrating their custom APIs and datasets.
  • Participate in the establishment, measurement, and achievement of customer satisfaction metrics
  • Support project management function from client engagements to include identification, scheduling, tracking, and reporting
  • Provide client feature requests to project engineering teams and project support personnel
  • Develop and write documentation as required
  • Support the training and familiarize operators on equipment and systems developed by Two Six Technologies

Requirements:

  • 5 years of technical experience including 2 years of experience working with Cybersecurity domain experience and knowledge
  • Demonstrated experience Linux system administration, including user management, file permissions, shell scripting, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Working experience with LINUX and the command line
  • Experience leading projects
  • Experience working with Python and Docker
  • The ability to travel greater than 15%
  • Active TS/SCI Clearance

Nice to Have:

  • Scripting using Ansible, Python, or similar dynamic languages.
  • Experience working with SQL
  • Experience with DevOps and/or Agile is a huge plus; Atlassian collaboration tools
  • Experience with Kubernetes, AWS, Docker
  • DoDD 8140 (former 8570) IAM/IAT level II or higher certification
  • IAT level III certification

Clearance:

  • Active TS/SCI Clearance

title: Director - Organisation Workforce Transformation
description:
As a Director, Organisation Transformation, you will play a critical leadership role in shaping and delivering transformational outcomes for our clients. You will be recognised as a trusted advisor to senior executives, leading large-scale transformation engagements, driving business growth, developing high-performing teams and bringing innovative solutions to the market.

The impact you’ll make:

As a Director you will play a critical leadership role in shaping and delivering transformational outcomes for our clients. You will be recognised as a trusted advisor to senior executives, leading large-scale transformation engagements, driving business growth, developing high-performing teams and bringing innovative solutions to the market.

You will combine strategic thinking with practical execution to help organisations navigate complex change, align stakeholders, and realise the full value of transformation initiatives.

You will bring depth in organisation and workforce transformation, strong commercial judgement, and the ability to lead teams through complex work. You will work closely with Partners, other Directors and teams across Deloitte New Zealand and our global network to bring relevant thinking, methods and experience to our clients.

Your typical day will include:

  • Leading organisation and workforce transformation work with senior client leaders, from early problem definition through to delivery.
  • Helping clients make decisions on organisation design, operating models, workforce planning, culture, leadership, employee experience and change.
  • Designing practical approaches that support adoption, build capability and improve how work gets done.
  • Leading workshops, interviews and working sessions with executives, leaders and teams.
  • Managing complex programmes, including scope, quality, commercial performance, resourcing and client outcomes.
  • Building strong client relationships and identifying opportunities where Deloitte can add further value.
  • Providing executive counsel and leadership to senior clients and stakeholders
  • Leading proposals, pursuits and commercial discussions.
  • Bringing a clear point of view on workforce trends, technology, data and responsible AI.
  • Coaching and developing team members, including Managers, Associate Directors and specialists.
  • Working across Deloitte locally and globally to bring the right expertise to client work.
  • Acting as part of the Leadership Team of Human Capital to deliver on our annual plan and overall strategy.

Your expertise:

Bring your expertise in organisational transformation, workforce transformation and senior stakeholder leadership, and see what impact you can make.

You'll also have:

  • 15+ years’ relevant experience across organisation transformation, workforce transformation, change management, operating model design, workforce strategy, HR transformation or related fields.
  • Experience leading complex people, workforce or organisation programmes in professional services, consulting, industry or the public sector.
  • Strong knowledge in two or more of the following areas: organisation design, operating models, workforce planning, change adoption, culture, leadership, employee experience, learning, inclusion, workforce analytics, HR technology or service delivery.
  • Proven ability to work with senior leaders, understand their priorities, and translate complex issues into clear choices.
  • Commercial experience, including shaping work, leading proposals, managing engagement economics and growing client relationships.
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to lead structured conversations and support decision-making.
  • Confidence working with data, technology and AI-enabled approaches in a workforce or organisation context.
  • Experience leading and developing high-performing teams.
  • A practical, inclusive and collaborative leadership style.
  • A relevant tertiary qualification in business, organisational psychology, human resources, organisational development, change management, commerce, leadership, communications or a related discipline is preferred.
  • Experience working in a professional services or consulting environment preferred but not essential

Making an impact that matters, together:

We are driven by our desire to create positive outcomes for our clients, communities, and people. Everything we do is with intent - the intent to make a meaningful difference.

Our shared values are at the heart of everything we do. Living these values, including ‘taking care of each other’ and ‘fostering inclusion’, is essential to ensuring everyone feels included at work and able to reach their full potential. For us to succeed and thrive as an organisation, we understand the importance of creating a culture where diverse perspectives matter and where everyone is given an equal opportunity to grow and develop.

How you’ll be rewarded:

We hold a simple belief – that our people’s hard work should be recognised and rewarded beyond their remuneration. The Deloitte experience is founded on concepts of trust, balance, wellbeing and the importance of personal connection.

We offer you:

  • Flexible work arrangements – work in a way that suits you, us and our clients best
  • Paid professional memberships
  • Subsidised health insurance
  • Income protection insurance
  • 22 days annual leave
  • Social events, social sports teams, and monthly firm drinks
  • A focus on wellness and well-being, including a monetary wellness benefit
  • Director sabbatical
  • Community focused volunteer days
  • A focus on the environment and sustainability
  • Plus much more

Does this sound like the sort of role and organisation for you? Then apply now! We’d love to hear from you.

We believe the strongest teams are made up of diverse individuals and we are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We recognise that women and individuals from under-represented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don't meet all criteria. If you're passionate about this role and believe you have the skills, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience, ideal working hours or qualifications aren't a perfect match.

title: SAP Analytics Specialist
description:
Work Arrangement / Work Shift: Work Arrangement / Work Location: Overseas – Saudi Arabia (All-expense-paid relocation with accommodation provided)

We are seeking an SAP Analytics Specialist with functional and technical development skills to build data reporting solutions. In this role, you will model complex CDS views, construct embedded analytics models, and deliver custom Fiori analytical applications. You will bridge business reporting requirements with technical SAP data architecture to enable real-time operational insights.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Modeling, creating, and performance-tuning SAP Core Data Services (CDS) views for analytical consumption.

  • Building S/4HANA embedded analytics dashboards, KPIs, and operational reporting models.

  • Developing and deploying custom SAP Fiori analytical applications for business end-users.

What You’ll Need:

  • Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in SAP reporting and analytics domain (combining functional and developer capabilities).

  • Technical proficiency in CDS view modeling, SAP embedded analytics architecture, and Fiori analytical application development.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business analytics requirements into high-performing S/4HANA data models.

What Will Set You Apart:

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines and extracts for Microsoft Power BI dashboards.

About Atticus:

Atticus Advisory Solutions Inc. is a specialized remote staffing and IT offshoring firm based in the Philippines, providing vetted, high-quality Filipino talent to global tech startups, SMEs, and consulting firms, focusing heavily on niche areas like ERP (NetSuite), Accounting and Finance and IT, offering integrated recruiting, upskilling, and HR support to ensure high retention and reliable offshore teams.


Atticus provides a comprehensive solution for international companies to build dedicated, outsourced teams and efficiently scale their technical and administrative capabilities by leveraging skilled Filipino talent, managed with a focus on quality and long-term retention. We ensure the teams perform like extensions of the client’s own operations.


Who We Are:

We are a customer-focused organization that puts people at the heart of everything we do. We believe great outcomes come from strong collaboration, where ideas are openly shared and teamwork is valued.

Our team members are proactive and confident—they take ownership, speak up, and are not afraid to ask questions. We encourage curiosity and continuous improvement, empowering everyone to challenge the status quo and find better ways of working.

We foster a growth mindset, where learning is continuous, feedback is welcomed, and mistakes are seen as opportunities to grow. Here, you are supported to develop your skills, improve processes, and make a meaningful impact.


Why Join Us:

At Atticus Advisory Solutions Inc, we value our employees and provide a positive and collaborative work environment. We offer competitive compensation, benefits, annual leaves, health and medical insurances. Our culture offers flexible working arrangement and opportunities for growth and development.

title: Food and Beverage Associate
description:
Are you into video games, bowling, or karaoke? Are you friendly, and outgoing? Do you enjoy being around people and working in a fun environment? Then you’re the kind of person we’d love to hire!

This position is responsible for providing exceptional customer service while supporting the operation of the Food and Beverage Department.

Please note you MUST have a High School Diploma or GED to apply.

We require ALL staff that handles alcohol to be 21+.
Bartending experience preferred but not required.
Open availability, especially night shift and weekends is preferred.

Essential Duties:
  • Operates POS register for food and drinks (includes bar register when directed).
  • Prepares food and beverage items utilizing the policies and standards of the company.
  • Resets and bus the food court seating area.
  • Washes and dries dishes, glasses, and other cooking/food prep utensils.
  • Conducts all opening and closing procedures. (Opens and closes cash tills, kitchen cleaning, etc.).
  • Manages food and beverage inventory by the store’s policies and procedures.
  • Maintains proper temperature for refrigerators and freezers.
  • Manages plates, cups, and other utensil inventory by the store policies and procedures.
  • Conducts restroom checks and cleaning including laundry of rags.
  • Responds responsively, and politely with a friendly demeanor to customers’ requests.
  • Occasionally Operates POS system to collect payments and allocate bowling lanes.
  • Occasionally Operates POS system to collect payments and lends out facility and equipment. (Karaoke, billiards, darts, ping pong).
  • Occasionally operates POS system to collect payments and issues cards and credits for arcade (AM).
  • Other duties and responsibilities assigned by Store Management.

Non-Essential Duties:
  • Conducts alcohol and age restriction control by company policies.
  • Conducts lost and found procedures according to company policies.
  • Seeks constant improvement or more efficient and less expensive ways and means in department work processes.
  • Compiles and maintains confidentiality of all company policies and procedures.
  • Responsible for maintaining a clean and safe working area.

Education/Experience:
  • A High School diploma and a minimum of one to two years of experience in a hospitality or retail environment are required.
  • Experience in a bowling establishment is preferred, but not required.
  • Bartending experience preferred.

Work Environment:
While performing the duties of this job, the employee regularly works in a bowling center/arcade environment where high levels of noise, dust, and activity can be expected. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

Physical Demands:
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to bend, stretch, twist, climb, and have a high level of mobility/flexibility in small spaces. The employee is required to stand and walk for extended periods without breaks during busy times. In addition, the employee will need to be able to use their hands/fingers to handle feel, and reach with hands and arms. Lifting and/or moving up to 100 lbs with assistance is required.

Benefits:
  • 1 hour to play (non-prize) arcade games per week.
  • 90 minutes of bowling per week (shoes included).
  • 1 hour of karaoke/billiards per week.
  • 50% discount on food items per working shift.
  • 1 complimentary beverage per working shift.
